title: Makine Mühendisi – Tank ve Basınçlı Kap Tasarım Mühendisi (LPG / Kriyojenik)
company: MANIFEST HR DANIŞMANLIK HİZMETLERİ LTD ŞTİ
description: Pozisyonun Amacı Kriyojenik tanklar, hidrojen tankları, LPG tankları, akaryakıt tankerleri ve basınçlı kapların mekanik tasarım, projelendirme ve detay mühendislik çizimlerini gerçekleştirmek; tasarımların ilgili ulusal ve uluslararası standartlara, müşteri şartnamelerine ve üretim gerekliliklerine uygunluğunu sağlamak. Görev ve Sorumluluklar Kriyojenik tanklar, hidrojen depolama tankları, LPG tankları, akaryakıt tankerleri ve basınçlı kapların mekanik tasarım ve detay mühendislik çizimlerini hazırlamak. SolidWorks ve AutoCAD programlarını kullanarak 2D ve 3D tasarım, modelleme ve teknik çizim çalışmalarını yürütmek. Tankların iç ve dış gövde, bombe, şase, izolasyon sistemleri, bağlantı elemanları, nozullar, flanşlar ve diğer mekanik bileşenlerinin detay çizimlerini oluşturmak. Çift cidarlı ve vakum izolasyonlu kriyojenik tankların tasarım ve imalat detaylarını hazırlamak. Hidrojen tankları ve ilgili depolama sistemlerinin mekanik tasarım ve detay çizimlerini gerçekleştirmek. LPG tankları ve akaryakıt tankerlerinin gövde, bölme, şase, ekipman yerleşimi ve montaj çizimlerini hazırlamak. Tank kesitleri, kaynak detayları, montaj resimleri ve imalat teknik resimlerini oluşturmak. Malzeme seçimi, ölçülendirme, tolerans ve teknik hesaplamaları ilgili tasarım standartlarına göre gerçekleştirmek. AD 2000, ADR, ASME ve EN 13445 standartları doğrultusunda tasarım ve teknik çizim çalışmalarını yürütmek. Tasarımların üretilebilirliğini değerlendirmek ve üretim departmanıyla koordineli çalışmak. Tasarım değişikliklerini, teknik revizyonları ve proje dokümantasyonunu takip etmek. Müşteri teknik şartnamelerine ve proje gerekliliklerine uygun tasarım çözümleri geliştirmek. Aranan Nitelikler Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği bölümünden mezun. SolidWorks ve AutoCAD programlarını ileri seviyede kullanabilen. 2D ve 3D mekanik tasarım, modelleme ve detay mühendislik çizimleri konusunda deneyimli. Kriyojenik tank, hidrojen tankı, LPG tankı, akaryakıt tankeri veya basınçlı kap tasarımında deneyim sahibi. Tank gövde yapıları, bombe, çift cidarlı sistemler, vakum izolasyonu ve mekanik ekipmanlar hakkında bilgi sahibi. İmalat, kaynaklı konstrüksiyon, sac metal işleme ve montaj detaylarına hâkim. İmalat ve montaj resimleri hazırlayabilen, teknik resim okuma ve yorumlama becerisi gelişmiş. AD 2000 ve ADR standartları hakkında bilgi ve tercihen uygulama deneyimi bulunan. Tercihen ASME ve EN 13445 standartlarına hâkim. Teknik dokümantasyon ve proje revizyonlarını yönetebilen. Teknik dokümanları takip edebilecek seviyede İngilizce bilen. Analitik düşünme, problem çözme ve ekip çalışması becerileri gelişmiş. Kocaeli Kartepe'de ikamet eden veya ikamet edebilecek.

title: PRODUCTION SPECIALIST
description: Gensenta, one of Turkey's leading, oldest, and most established pharmaceutical companies, has been serving public health for nearly a century. With its renewed identity in 2020, the company is working towards providing broader geographical coverage, serving more patients, and offering new and comprehensive solutions, all while facilitating patient access to medication. Also export to the region that constitutes 70% of the global pharmaceutical market through Turkey. As of November 2022, we continue our operations as one of the establishments within the Eczacıbaşı Group. What do we expect from our new team member? Ensure that operations and product quality comply with current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP), Ministry of Health regulations, and Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) policies, with particular focus on sterile manufacturing requirements. Ensure that all GxP activities are conducted in compliance with Data Integrity principles. Monitor and ensure compliance with aseptic techniques, gowning qualification requirements, and cleanroom behavior standards in classified areas (Grade A/B/C/D). Perform Environmental Monitoring (EM) activities and ensure timely trending and evaluation of monitoring results. Actively participate in Operational Excellence (OpEx), productivity, and continuous improvement initiatives. Participate in deviation investigations, including those related to environmental excursions and sterility assurance. Monitor manufacturing activities for sterile products in line with the production plan (e.g., filling, lyophilization, terminal sterilization, where applicable). Support and/or participate in media fill (aseptic process simulation) studies. Verify that Batch Production Records (BPR/MBR) are completed accurately, comprehensively, and in compliance with sterile manufacturing requirements. Prepare and update Master Batch Records (MBRs), Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), forms, and related documentation in line with approved changes. Train operators on updated procedures, aseptic practices, and contamination control requirements. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the sterile manufacturing area. What kind of teammate are we looking for? Bachelor's degree in Bioengineering, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Pharmacy, or a related Engineering discipline. Minimum of 2 years of experience in a similar role within sterile/aseptic pharmaceutical manufacturing, with a solid understanding of GMP requirements. Knowledge of contamination control strategies, cleanroom classifications, and aseptic processing principles. Preferably experienced with SAP and Werum PAS-X systems. Advanced level of English proficiency. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications. Proactive, solution-oriented, and possessing strong communication skills. Committed to continuous improvement and operational excellence. What Do We Offer You? At Eczacıbaşı, you can steadily improve your personal, professional, and technical competencies by participating in training programs that support you and your career. You will have access to opportunities for rotation among more than 50 companies and global experience in over 120 international markets. Vacation time at Eczacıbaşı is calculated according to seniority based on your total work experience. Your bring your seniority with you. We will always recognize your success through different reward methods. You can take advantage of location-independent or hybrid work opportunities through different work models suitable to the nature of your job, and you can determine your own work schedule with flexible work hours. We offer technology and ergonomic support packages to Eczacıbaşı employees who work remotely full-time. As a new parent working at Eczacıbaşı, you are privileged. Eczacıbaşı employees who are mothers are provided with monthly nursery support; Eczacıbaşı employees who are fathers are entitled to a 3-week paternity leave. People who savor culture and art are here! Thanks to the Eczacıbaşı Group’s founding sponsorship of Istanbul Modern, Turkey's first modern and contemporary art museum, you can visit the museum for free. Additionally, thanks to Eczacıbaşı Group’s founding sponsorship of Istanbul Foundation for Culture and Arts (İKSV), you can also enjoy the privilege and discounts of İKSV’s Lale Card to all İKSV events. You can participate in Eczacıbaşı’s volunteering activities, every one of which prioritizes social benefit, and get involved in projects that create social impact. We are committed to ensuring equal opportunity of employment. We value diversity and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or seniority. #WeDoNotDifferentiateBetweenJobsForWomenAndMen Linkedin üzerinden gerçekleştirilen başvurular kapsamında sunulan aydınlatma metnine aşağıda yer alan bağlantı aracılığıyla ulaşabilirsiniz. title: Materials Science Intern
description: Company Description Visynex is the data layer for AI visual inspection. Inspection models only learn the defects they've seen, but well run production lines rarely make them, so most AI inspection projects stall for months waiting for training data. Visynex removes that wait. From a single photograph of a good part, our engine generates realistic defect images on the customer's own product. An independent detection system then checks every image and draws its label, so each defect boundary is measured, not assumed. Manufacturers and machine vision integrators get an inspection ready dataset in days, without waiting for failures or damaging good parts, delivered in the formats their tools already use. We already work across sheet metal, castings, machining, injection moulding, glass, electronics, food and aerospace. Currently, we're taking the same engine into robotics and visual identification for items that have no CAD model, from retail SKUs and packaged goods to fresh produce. Role Description This is a paid, 3 month Materials Science Intern role, hybrid, based in Istanbul, with the option of a full time role afterwards. The hardest part of our work isn't the software. It's making sure a generated defect looks the way that defect really forms. You will bring that knowledge into our pipeline. Every rule, label and finding you add stays in the system and makes it smarter. What you'll do Build the defect catalogue our pipeline learns from: how each defect forms, what it looks like at each severity, and where it appears on a part Judge the realism of our generated defect images, and turn your calls into the scoring rules our automated checks run on Map our severity levels to the standards industry already uses, so orders and checks speak the same language Find and label real defect reference images, used to test our images and to train and evaluate our detection models Help write and check technical guides read by quality engineers Join customer conversations and translate a factory's defect into a clear order the pipeline can generate Qualifications Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Materials Science, Materials or Metallurgical Engineering, or a related field (3rd or 4th year, master's, or recent graduate) Understanding of how defects form in at least one process: casting, sheet metal, welding, injection moulding, glass or machining Interest in applying materials science to AI, and in teaching a machine-vision system what real defects look like A careful eye for detail, and the ability to explain a judgement clearly in writing Proficiency in written and spoken English; Turkish is a plus Able to work independently in a small, fast-moving team where your work ships every week Compulsory internships (zorunlu staj) are welcome

title: DIAS Fellow in Computational Multiphysics Modelling for Sustainable Manufacturing
company: Syddansk Universitet - University of Southern Denmark
description: The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS) and Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME), Faculty of Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) seek an outstanding candidate to fill a tenure track Fellow (Assistant Professor level) position in the field of computational multiphysics modelling for manufacturing processes and sustainable manufacturing. The candidate is expected to start on September 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter, in agreement with the successful candidate. We are looking for a researcher with clear potential for research excellence who thrives in and is inspired by interdisciplinary collaboration. The ideal candidate will be expected to contribute to high-quality research in their field while embracing DIAS’s mission of curiosity-driven inquiry and interdisciplinary dialogue. The successful candidate should have a strong and promising research profile, with potential for attracting external research funding, and a demonstrated ability to work across disciplines. The candidate will be attached to both IME and DIAS and should be prepared to engage in multiple and diverse research environments at SDU. Teaching obligations will be reduced compared to a standard assistant professorship at SDU, allowing more time for research and leadership activities. Who are we looking for As DIAS Fellow, you will join the “Multiphysics Simulation, Optimisation, and Experimentation” (MSOE) research group and contribute to its ongoing projects while also developing your own independent research direction. You will be expected to apply for external research grants, both independently and together with the group and its collaborators, and to contribute to teaching and supervision within SDU Mechanical Engineering’s Bachelor of Engineering and Bachelor/Master of Science programmes. As with your affiliation to DIAS, you will be expected to contribute actively to the academic community, collaboration, and knowledge exchange at IME and SDU Mechanical Engineering. We seek a researcher with expertise in the field of computational multiphysics simulation of manufacturing processes (e.g. welding, casting, injection moulding, or additive manufacturing) , who is eager to develop their research career within the DIAS framework. The ideal candidate should demonstrate: A commitment to engaging in boundary-crossing interdisciplinary research and dialogue. A strong commitment to interdisciplinary collaboration, contributing to research that bridges multiple fields. Strong interest in driving internationally competitive research activities at the highest level of ambition. Engagement in various forms of research dissemination, including interdisciplinary research and dialogue. Qualifications Successful applicants must: Hold a PhD or similar qualifications within relevant fields of computational mechanics, multiphysics simulation, manufacturing process modelling , or similar. To qualify for the position as Assistant Professor you must have obtained a PhD or similar degree by the application deadline. Exhibit curiosity-driven research excellence, thinking beyond traditional boundaries. Be fluent in English. Show potential for attracting external research funding. Experience in applying for external funding and a strong international network are considered comparative advantages. Have research publications that demonstrate their excellence and broad thinking. Have a relevant engineering background, giving them the potential to teach mechanical engineering curricula. Have documented research experience in at least one of the following: manufacturing process modelling; numerical methods for multiphysics simulation; scientific programming and framework/software development; high-performance computing. The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS) DIAS at SDU is a hub for interdisciplinary excellence at and beyond the frontier of knowledge, bringing together outstanding researchers from various disciplines to foster groundbreaking interdisciplinary research and bold innovation. DIAS nurtures a collaborative and curiosity-driven environment, encouraging scholars to think outside the box and challenge conventional boundaries. The institute values open-minded exploration and an ambitious yet collegial atmosphere with a strong sense of community. Researchers affiliated with DIAS are expected to contribute actively to DIAS activities, and engage in interdisciplinary collaborations across faculties and departments, both nationally and internationally. About the Institute and SDU Mechanical Engineering SDU Mechanical Engineering (SDU ME) is part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME) at the Faculty of Engineering, University of Southern Denmark, based at the main campus in Odense. Research activities at SDU ME span fluid mechanics and heat transfer, multiphysics simulation and optimisation, condition monitoring and structural dynamics, composite materials, mechanical design, and maritime engineering. IME is a multidisciplinary institute that also covers high-frequency electronics, microelectronics, batteries and super-capacitors, additive manufacturing, fracture and fatigue, smart structures, and energy technologies, providing an environment where academic curiosity is continually stimulated by neighbouring fields. The DIAS Fellow will join the "Multiphysics Simulation, Optimisation, and Experimentation" (MSOE) research group and will help extend the group's simulation and design-optimisation expertise into manufacturing process modelling – connecting process physics to component design, performance, and sustainability. The DIAS Fellow will also support cross-campus collaboration with the Centre for Industrial Mechanics (CIM) in Sønderborg. Additional information For further information about being a fellow at DIAS, please contact DIAS director Sten Rynning at +45 6550 2193 or via email at director-dias@sdu.dk. title: NVH Attribute Engineer
description: Job Description BSc or MSc degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Acoustics, or a related engineering discipline. Minimum 2-3 years of relevant professional experience in vehicle NVH development, attribute engineering, testing and/or validation. Hands-on experience in vehicle-level NVH testing, engineering evaluation and/or attribute development. Good understanding of structure-borne and airborne noise, vibration behavior and source-path-receiver relationships. Ability to interpret objective NVH data and relate measurement results to subjective vehicle behavior. Strong engineering problem-solving skills and the ability to investigate complex vehicle-level issues systematically. Strong communication and stakeholder coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively with customers, suppliers, and cross-functional engineering teams. Fluent spoken and written English. Willingness to participate in vehicle testing activities and travel when required. And a Good Understanding Of The Following Topics Vehicle NVH domains: hands-on development or validation experience in one or more areas such as road and tire, powertrain or e-drive, thermal/HVAC, aeroacoustics, squeak and rattle, sound quality, acoustic package or electrified-vehicle NVH. NVH measurement and analysis: vehicle-level testing, instrumentation and data acquisition using microphones, accelerometers and tachometer signals; interpretation of FFT, order analysis and spectrograms; objective-subjective correlation and root-cause investigation. NVH tools and countermeasures: experience with HEAD acoustics, Siemens Simcenter Testlab, Dewesoft or equivalent tools, including the development and validation of acoustic and vibration countermeasures. Transfer path analysis and operational modal analysis are an advantage. The successful candidate will take ownership of vehicle-level NVH attribute development, working closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams to achieve customer-focused NVH targets and deliver robust, validated solutions. Profile Description The position requires an engineer who can independently drive NVH topics, coordinate the relevant technical stakeholders and follow issues through to validated solutions. Support the development and validation of vehicle-level NVH attributes for advanced vehicle programs. Take ownership of NVH performance throughout the vehicle development cycle, from target definition and benchmarking to final validation. Coordinate NVH-related activities across testing, CAE, design, manufacturing, and supplier teams. Evaluate cabin noise, vibration, and overall acoustic comfort through objective measurements and subjective vehicle assessments. Drive NVH issues from identification and root-cause analysis through countermeasure definition and final validation. Description of daily responsibilities include, but is not limited to, the following: Plan and execute vehicle-level NVH tests and subjective evaluations under relevant operating conditions. Analyze and interpret NVH measurement data, engineering reports and CAE results to identify performance gaps and development priorities. Apply suitable analysis methods, including frequency analysis, order analysis and source-path-receiver investigation. Conduct vehicle benchmarking to support target setting and identify opportunities for attribute improvement. Coordinate corrective actions with the relevant component, system, and vehicle development teams. Translate NVH findings into clear technical feedback and actionable development recommendations. Track NVH targets, issues, and countermeasures, and communicate technical status within the project. Support continuous improvement of NVH development, testing, and evaluation methods. title: Robotics Control Engineer
description: edelkrone, film yapımcıları ve video üreticileri için kamera hareket ekipmanı tasarlar ve üretir. Ürünler şirket içinde tasarlanır ve Ankara'daki kendi fabrikamızda üretilir; satışların neredeyse tamamı uluslararasıdır. Rol TÜBİTAK 1507 programına başvurduğumuz yeni bir Ar-Ge projesinde, iki tekerlek üzerinde kendini dengede tutan (tersine sarkaç), hafif ve tepesinde 360 kamera taşıyan otonom bir robot geliştiriyoruz. Projenin ana konusu, kameranın altındaki küçük pervanelerle hava itkisinden yararlanarak devrilmeyi önlemek. Bu rolde robotun denge, itki ve duruş kontrolünü modelden gerçek donanıma kadar siz geliştireceksiniz. Görevler - Tekerlek üzerinde tersine sarkaç denge kontrolü (LQR, PID ve benzeri yöntemler) - Pervanelerin itki dağıtımı ve kontrolü - Devrilmeyi önceden sezip pervaneleri devreye sokan öngörü ve kontrol algoritmaları - Kısa süreli itkili hareketlerde duruş (attitude) kontrolü - IMU ve enkoder verisiyle durum kestirimi (Kalman filtresi ve benzeri) - MATLAB/Simulink ya da Python ile modelleme ve benzetim; algoritmaların mikrodenetleyiciye C/C++ ile gömülmesi - Motor sürücüleri (BLDC, ESC, DShot) ve gömülü yazılım ekibiyle entegrasyon - İtme ve eşik test düzeneklerinde ölçüm ve raporlama Aradığımız nitelikler - Kontrol, mekatronik, elektrik-elektronik, makine ya da uzay/havacılık mühendisliğinden lisans mezuniyeti - Kontrol teorisini gerçek bir donanımda uygulamış olmak (denge robotu, drone, robot kol, araç vb.) - C/C++ ile gömülü kod yazabilmek; Python ya da MATLAB ile modelleme yapabilmek - Günlük işinde yapay zekâ araçlarını kullanan; ör. sistem modellerken, gömülü kodu yazıp hata ayıklarken ya da teknik kaynak tararken Tercih sebepleri - Drone uçuş kontrolcüsü (PX4, ArduPilot, Betaflight) ya da kendi kendini dengeleyen robot deneyimi - Durum kestirimi ve sensör füzyonu - STM32 ya da benzeri mikrodenetleyiciler, RTOS, ROS 2 - Robotik yarışma, tez ya da yüksek lisans çalışmaları - Kendi başına prototip çıkarabilmek - İngilizce teknik doküman okuyabilmek Yeni mezunlara ve 1–5 yıl deneyimli adaylara açıktır. Değerlendirmede yıl sayısına değil, kendi elinizle yaptığınız somut işlere (proje, video, kod) bakıyoruz. Çalışma şekli Kalıcı, belirsiz süreli ve tam zamanlı; Ankara Kahramankazan'daki edelkrone tesisinde yerinde. Prototip donanımla her gün çalışılacağı için uzaktan çalışma seçeneği yoktur. Seyahat gerekmez. Başlangıç en kısa sürede.

title: Computer Vision Engineer
description: edelkrone, film yapımcıları ve video üreticileri için kamera hareket ekipmanı tasarlar ve üretir. Ürünler şirket içinde tasarlanır ve 2013'ten beri Ankara'daki kendi fabrikamızda üretilir; satışların neredeyse tamamı uluslararasıdır. Bu roldeki kişi, TÜBİTAK 1507 programına başvurduğumuz yeni bir Ar-Ge projesinde çalışacak. Proje; iki tekerlek üzerinde kendini dengede tutan (tersine sarkaç), tepesinde 360 kamera taşıyan, evin içinde kendi yolunu bulup görüntü toplayan otonom bir robot. Robotun ortamı nasıl algıladığı, nerede olduğunu nasıl bildiği ve nereden çekim yapacağına nasıl karar verdiği bu rolün sorumluluğunda. Ne yapacaksınız: - Ön derinlik kamerası (RGB-D) ve uçurum algılayıcılarıyla görsel SLAM, evin haritasını çıkarma ve odalara bölme - ROS 2 / Nav2 ile yol bulma ve engelden kaçınma - Gerçek zamanlı engel ve kişi algılama, kişi takibi - İyi çekim yeri seçimi ve an algılama - Modelleri robotun içindeki gömülü bilgisayarda (Jetson ya da benzeri kenar yapay zeka kartı) gerçek zamanlı çalışacak şekilde optimize etme (quantization, TensorRT/ONNX) - Gömülü yazılım ve kontrol ekibiyle entegrasyon, testler ve teknik raporlama Aradıklarımız: - Bilgisayar, elektrik-elektronik, mekatronik ya da ilgili bir mühendislik bölümünden lisans mezuniyeti - Python ve C++ ile üretim kalitesinde kod yazabilmek - Bilgisayarlı görü ve derin öğrenme (PyTorch ya da benzeri) ile gerçek bir projede çalışmış olmak - ROS ya da ROS 2 deneyimi - Günlük işinde yapay zeka araçlarını kullanan; ör. makale ve doküman tararken, kod yazıp hata ayıklarken, deneyleri hızla prototiplerken Tercih sebebi: - SLAM (ORB-SLAM, RTAB-Map, VINS vb.) ve Nav2 deneyimi - Derinlik kameralarıyla (RealSense, OAK-D vb.) çalışmış olmak - Jetson üzerinde model optimizasyonu - Robotik, otonom araç ya da drone projeleri (yarışma, tez, yüksek lisans dahil) - Kendi başına araştırıp prototip çıkarabilmek - İngilizce teknik doküman okuyabilmek Yeni mezunlara ve 1–5 yıl deneyimli adaylara açıktır. Değerlendirmede yıl sayısından çok kendi elinizle yaptığınız somut işlere (GitHub, proje, video) bakıyoruz. Çalışma şekli: Kalıcı, belirsiz süreli ve tam zamanlı; Ankara Kahramankazan'daki edelkrone tesisinde yerinde. Prototip donanımla her gün çalışılacağı için uzaktan çalışma seçeneği yoktur. Başlama: en kısa sürede.

title: New Product Development Manager
description: At Patis Food Group, we are shaping the future of food innovation by combining traditional chocolate and confectionery expertise with functional foods, health focused snacking solutions and next generation product technologies. As part of our growth and innovation journey, we are looking for a New Product Development Manager who can bring diverse product categories together under a unified technical vision and transform innovative ideas into commercially viable, scalable products. We are seeking a technically strong, forward-thinking leader who combines scientific expertise, consumer insight, commercial awareness and a passion for innovation. Key Responsibilities Lead end to end new product development projects across chocolate, confectionery, gummies, functional foods and health-focused product categories. Manage formulation, prototyping, pilot production, stability testing, shelf-life validation and industrial scale up processes. Evaluate the application of cocoa, fat systems, confectionery technologies, gelling systems, proteins, fibers, vitamins, minerals and functional ingredients in product development. Monitor global consumer trends, health and wellness markets, emerging ingredients and next-generation food technologies to identify innovation opportunities. Optimize product sensory performance, target costs, manufacturing feasibility and quality standards. Collaborate with relevant subject matter experts to evaluate the technical and regulatory requirements of food, dietary supplements and, where applicable, OTC product categories. Integrate artificial intelligence (AI) and data analytics into product research, formulation development and innovation processes. Collaborate closely with Marketing, Production, Quality, Procurement and other relevant functions to ensure successful product commercialization. Develop the technical capabilities of the product development team and strengthen innovation and project management standards. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Food Engineering is required. Direct product development experience in the chocolate and confectionery industry is essential. Proven experience in industrial formulation, pilot production, scale-up and transition to commercial manufacturing. Strong technical expertise in chocolate, filled products, bars, coated products and confectionery technologies. Strong knowledge of gummies, jellies, functional confectionery, protein bars, vitamin and mineral enriched products and health-focused snacks. Knowledge of gelatin, pectin, sweetener systems, active ingredient stability and functional ingredient applications. Solid understanding of food safety, product stability, shelf life validation and relevant international regulatory requirements. Strong command of English, with the ability to manage international technical projects and communicate effectively with global stakeholders. Ability to effectively leverage AI powered research, formulation and product development tools. Demonstrated experience in technical team leadership and cross-functional project management. Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills and a results-oriented approach to innovation. Preferred Experience Product development experience in functional foods, nutraceuticals and dietary supplements. Formulation and development of gummy supplements and functional confectionery products. Familiarity with the technical and regulatory requirements of OTC product categories. New product development for international markets and private label projects. Management of multi category product portfolios and complex innovation projects. What Makes This Opportunity Unique? The opportunity to shape the innovation agenda of a rapidly growing food group. Exposure to diverse product categories at the intersection of food, science, technology and wellness. The opportunity to lead innovation projects from initial concept to commercial scale production. A dynamic, entrepreneurial environment where technical expertise can translate into tangible business impact. The opportunity to contribute to next-generation products designed for international markets. At Patis Food Group, we believe the future of food is built at the intersection of science, creativity and consumer needs. If you are passionate about turning scientific knowledge into innovative products and shaping the future of food, we would love to hear from you.

title: Mechanical Engineer
description: Voor een nieuw te ontwikkelen robot is H2L Robotics op zoek naar een Mechanical Engineer. Over de functie Bij H2L Robotics bouwen we aan de toekomst van duurzame landbouw met slimme, autonome robots. Onze tulpen- en aardappelrobots zijn al succesvol op de markt. Nu de onderzoeksfase is afgerond, starten we met de ontwikkeling van een geavanceerde nieuwe robot. Als Mechanical Engineer geef je vorm aan de mechanische basis van deze robot. Je ontwerpt constructies en mechanismen die dag in, dag uit betrouwbaar moeten werken tussen zand, modder, stof en trillingen, en die ook goed te produceren en te onderhouden zijn. Je werkt in een nieuw team wat specifiek opgezet wordt voor deze productontwikkeling, waar we een stuk autonomie van je vragen. Tegelijk werk je in een omgeving waar in alle disciplines geruime kennis en ervaring aanwezig is. Wat krijg je? Een salaris tussen € 3800 en € 4800 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring, bij een fulltime dienstverband van 38 uur per week. Daarbovenop krijg je 8% vakantiegeld. Een bonusregeling op basis van de bedrijfsresultaten. Reiskostenvergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer bij een enkele reis van meer dan 10 km. 25 vakantiedagen per jaar, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen bij te kopen. [+ eventuele roostervrije dagen volgens de cao] Pensioen via PMT, volgens de cao Metaalbewerkingsbedrijf. Werken aan technologie die precisielandbouw echt vooruithelpt. Een plek in een dynamische scale-up met ruimte voor initiatief, innovatie en persoonlijke groei. Wie ben jij? Je Bent Een Hands-on Ontwerper Met Een Ondernemende Instelling. Je Werkt Graag Zelfstandig, Neemt Initiatief En Weet Wanneer Je Moet Afstemmen. Je Wilt Je Ontwerp Niet Alleen Op Het Scherm Zien, Maar Ook Gebouwd, Getest En In Productie. Daarnaast Breng Je Mee Een HBO- of WO-opleiding in werktuigbouwkunde, industrieel ontwerpen, mechatronica of een vergelijkbare richting. Zo’n 3 jaar ervaring met het zelfstandig ontwerpen en industrialiseren van voertuigen, machines of mechatronische producten, bijvoorbeeld in automotive, (elektrische) tweewielers, machinebouw of agritech. Ruime ervaring met 3D-CAD, bijvoorbeeld SolidWorks. Ervaring met Onshape is een pré. Kennis van productietechnieken zoals plaatbewerking, verspanen, lassen, en ervaring met het maken van productietekeningen volgens GD&T. Ervaring met het werken met leveranciers, van offerte en technische afstemming tot de eerste goedgekeurde onderdelen. Kennis van methodes als FMEA is een pré, net als ervaring in een start-up of scale-up. Je communiceert helder met collega’s van alle disciplines, met leveranciers en met klanten. Goede beheersing van het Engels, Nederlands is een pré. Rijbewijs B. Wat ga je doen? In deze veelzijdige rol zie je je ontwerpen terug op de robot in het veld. Je bent eigenaar van je eigen ontwerpopdrachten: van concept en berekening tot gedetailleerd 3D-model, productietekening en vrijgave. Je bouwt snel prototypes, test ze op de testbank en in het veld en verbetert je ontwerp op basis van de resultaten. Je ontwerpt met het oog op maakbaarheid, kosten en onderhoud. Je stemt technische eisen af met leveranciers en begeleidt onderdelen tot in de productie. Je zorgt voor complete en eenduidige technische documentatie, zoals tekeningen met toleranties, stuklijsten en wijzigingen. Je werkt nauw samen met de systems engineer en met software- en elektronica-engineers, zodat mechanica, elektronica en software goed op elkaar aansluiten. Je bent regelmatig in het veld bij telers voor tests en demo’s, met extra drukte tijdens het groeiseizoen. Over H2L Robotics H2L Robotics ontwikkelt in Delft robots die de agrarische sector fundamenteel veranderen. Inmiddels rijden er meer dan 150 H2L-robots over de velden. Met 15 collega’s zijn we een informeel team met korte lijnen en een grote ambitie. Jouw technische keuzes zie je bij ons direct terug in de praktijk. Enthousiast, maar nog twijfels? Twijfel je of je aan alle eisen voldoet? Geen probleem. We zoeken mensen die willen bouwen, testen en verbeteren. Ervaring is mooi, maar motivatie is minstens zo belangrijk. Zo Verloopt De Sollicitatieprocedure Kennismaken: een kort online gesprek met HR. Langskomen in Delft: twee gesprekken op locatie. Eén om te kijken of het klikt met het team en onze cultuur, en één technisch gesprek met onze engineers. Match? Dan doen we je een aanbod. Het is ons doel de procedure binnen 3 weken af te ronden. 📩 Solliciteer direct met je cv en een korte motivatie via onze website. 📞 Vragen? Bel Annemarie Burgers (HR) op +31 6 185 37 180. Bureaus en recruiters : we waarderen je enthousiasme, maar voor deze vacature werven we zelf.

And we are where we are because our talents brought us here. At Trelleborg Marine & Infrastructure, we go beyond service, building lasting partnerships with engineers, contractors, and owners to deliver long-term solutions that make a real impact. About The Role As a Mechanical Designer you will be responsible for the design, development, and engineering of Trelleborg Dordrecht B.V.'s mooring, berthing, and towing equipment, from initial customer requirements through to final release for manufacture. Your role transforms customer specifications, project requirements, and applicable classification society standards into safe, reliable, manufacturable, and cost-effective engineering solutions. This includes the delivery of complete technical data packages, comprising 3D models, 2D manufacturing drawings, bills of materials (BOMs), calculations, and supporting technical documentation. In doing so, you will ensure the technical integrity, consistency, compliance, and traceability of the product portfolio. Your position is also responsible for maintaining sufficient engineering support for both project- specific design activities and the continuous improvement, standardisation, and cost optimisation of the standard product range. Furthermore, you will provide technical expertise and day-to-day engineering support to production, service, procurement, and sales functions, contributing to the successful execution of projects and the ongoing development of the business. About Your Responsibilities Translate customer specifications, project requirements and applicable standards into complete mechanical designs for equipment and steel structures. Create and maintain 3D models, welded structures, assembly and part drawings and bills of material in the 3D CAD and ERP systems. Perform and document design calculations. Initiate or support FEM analyses where required. Select materials, standard parts, hydraulic and mechanical components and surface treatments, taking into account marine and offshore conditions, maintainability and life cycle costs. Ensure that designs comply with the Machinery Directive, applicable EN/ISO standards, classification society requirements and Trelleborg's internal design guidelines. Prepare and maintain technical documentation: installation and assembly instructions, spare parts lists, operating and maintenance manuals and test procedures. Carry out change management: engineering changes, drawing revisions and item and bill of material data in ERP, including correct release and archiving. Provide technical support to production, assembly, purchasing, service and sales and resolve technical issues during manufacturing, testing (FAT) and commissioning. Take part in design reviews, risk assessments and prototype and type testing, and capture lessons learned in design standards. Contribute to standardisation, modularisation, design for manufacturing and cost reduction within the product portfolio. Liaise with suppliers and subcontractors on manufacturability, make-or-buy decisions and technical clarifications. What You Bring Bachelor's degree (HBO) in Mechanical Engineering or a comparable technical discipline; secondary vocational education (MBO level 4) with extensive relevant design experience is also acceptable. Relevant design experience in a project-driven, engineer-to-order manufacturing environment; experience in the marine, offshore, heavy equipment or machine building industry is preferred. Demonstrable experience with 3D CAD (for example Solid Edge). Working experience with ERP (item and bill of material management). Practical knowledge of steel and welded structures, machining, surface treatment and hydraulics; experience with FEM analysis is an advantage. Familiar with the Machinery Directive, EN/ISO drawing and welding standards and classification society requirements. title: Project Engineer Machinebouw

Je werkt intensief samen met engineering, werkvoorbereiding, productie en montage om projecten technisch maakbaar, betrouwbaar en efficiënt te houden. Je gaat aan de slag bij een internationale machinebouwer in de industriële automatisering. Dit bedrijf ontwerpt, bouwt en optimaliseert geavanceerde verpakkingslijnen, palletiseersystemen en doseerinstallaties voor uiteenlopende industriële sectoren, zoals food, logistiek, chemie en farma. title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description: At Konecranes, we believe that great customer experience is built on the people behind the Konecranes name. Everything we do, we do with passion and drive. We believe diversity drives business success and is the foundation for our growth. We welcome different backgrounds and skills that enrich our community and we promote a place where we can ALL be ourselves. This is what makes Konecranes a unique place to work. Job Description Every lift, every container move and every shift starts in the cab. Are you a creative Mechanical Design Engineer who wants to see your work make a real difference for the people who drive our forklifts and container-handling machinery? Join us and turn ideas into robust, ergonomic solutions, from first concept through 3D CAD design (SolidWorks and Teamcenter), modeling, technical drawings and product specifications, all the way to machines working in the field. As a Mechanical Design Engineer focused on Cab Design, you will be a key member of a high-performing engineering team working on ergonomics, driver comfort and system integration. You will own the physical architecture, packaging and installation of hoses, cables and auxiliary equipment, and balance customer-specific solutions (Engineering-to-Order) with strategic product development. You will have the freedom to solve complex challenges independently, the support of a collaborative team when you need it, and the chance to find the best balance between functionality, delivery time, quality, reliability and cost. Why cab design matters: what it means for the operator? The operator is our customer’s most important asset, and the cab is their workplace for hours every day. Your design decisions will be felt directly in the operator’s safety, comfort and performance: Comfort that lasts the whole shift: well-placed seats, panels and controls within natural reach zones reduce strain and fatigue. Clear sight, safer operations: good lines of sight to the load, the surroundings and the people around the machine help prevent incidents. Focus and productivity: an intuitive layout and tidy, well-packaged installations let operators concentrate on the task and work efficiently. Confidence and well-being: a quiet, well-integrated and reliable cab environment makes operators feel valued and keeps them performing at their best. Pride in your work: you will see, and hear from the people who use, what you designed, every day, in ports, terminals and industrial sites around the world. In this role you will coordinate and carry out mechanical design, development and packaging for the cab and operator environment, based on the requirements for our systems and platforms. You will design ergonomic driver environments with a focus on reach zones, lines of sight and driver comfort, and integrate panels, controls and seats. You will take responsibility for the physical architecture, packaging and installation of components, cabling, hoses and auxiliary equipment in and around the cab, and make sure that solutions meet customer demands, product safety, legislation and our internal requirements. You will prepare, review and release technical documentation and drawings, and represent cab design in Design Review forums. Your days will mix short-term Engineering-to-Order (ETO) deliverables with long-term development projects (R&D). Together with your Manager and Systems Engineer, whom you will keep updated on outcomes and possible deviations, you will initiate the tests and simulations needed to verify requirements, order materials and components for evaluation of a design, and visit customers and suppliers. You will work closely with Production, Sourcing, Product Management, V&V, Supply, Service and Product Support, sharing your engineering knowledge across functions. Everyone here contributes to a good and safe working environment and follows our routines and guidelines for safety. Qualifications A Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a similar technical field . At least 3 years of experience in mechanical design , preferably within heavy equipment, material handling, lifting applications, or the automotive industry. Experience with modern CAD software, PLM systems, and risk-mitigation tools such as FMEA . A basic understanding of vehicle ergonomics, cab layout, and interfaces with hydraulic or HVAC systems is appreciated. An analytical and fact-based mindset , with the ability to see the big picture while paying attention to details, combined with a curious, cooperative, can-do attitude. Strong verbal and written communication skills , with fluency in English. Additional Information Ready to design the cab operators will love? Please submit your application by 31st December 2026 , at the latest via Apply -link below. We appreciate early applications, as we will start screening applicants and invite them to interviews already during the application period. For further information about the role please contact Global Talent Acquisition Specialist, Mihaela Ban(mihaela.ban@konecranes.com). Konecranes moves what matters . We are a global leader in material handling solutions, serving a broad range of customers across multiple industries. We consistently set the industry benchmark, from everyday improvements to the breakthroughs at moments that matter most, because we know we can always find a safer, more productive and sustainable way. That's why, with 16 000+ professionals in over 50 countries, we are trusted every day to lift, handle and move what the world needs. Konecranes is committed to ensuring that all employees and job applicants are treated fairly in an environment which is free from any form of discrimination.

Vi strävar efter att skapa en miljö där alla kan växa och utvecklas tillsammans. Vår ambition är att tillgodose konsultens önskemål gällande uppdragslängd, sektor och arbetsuppgifter. För oss är en bra balans mellan arbete och privatliv en självklarhet och vi är stolta över att vara en av Sveriges mest attraktiva arbetsgivare. Givetvis har vi också kollektivavtal. Nyfiken på hur det känns att vara en del av vårt gäng? I den här filmen delar några av våra medarbetare med sig av sina tankar om vardagen, gemenskapen och varför de valt just oss: https://vimeo.com/1058313176?share=copy#t=0 OM SID Sigma Industry Development är ett teknik- och konsultbolag inom Sigmagruppen som hjälper både ledande svenska och internationella teknikföretag och innovativa och nytänkande start-ups och scale-ups. Vi verkar inom sektorer så som den gröna energisektorn, fordonsindustrin, transportindustrin, medtech, försvarsbranchen och hållbarhet. Vår vision är att vara det ledande teknikkonsultbolaget och vår kultur präglas av familjär samhörighet där människan är i centrum. Med över 100 engagerade medarbetare är vi i en stark tillväxtfas. Vår kärnverksamhet ligger i konsultuppdrag ute hos kund, men vi har även ett in-house-team som arbetar uteslutande från kontoret. Precis som vårt namn antyder, är utveckling kärnan i allt vi gör och våra medarbetare engageras av att ta Sigma Industry Development till nästa nivå. OM SIGMA GROUP Sigma Industry Development AB (SID) är ett av sex dotterbolag som ingår i koncernen Sigma Industry East/North Group, vilka i sin tur ingår i Sigma Group (som ägs av familjekoncernen Danir AB). title: Mekanikingenjör
description: Mekanikingenjör hos IKG Vill du arbeta med teknikutveckling i framkant och bidra till innovativa lösningar hos några av Sveriges mest spännande industriföretag? På IKG får du möjligheten att utvecklas i uppdrag hos marknadsledande kunder samtidigt som du blir en del av ett engagerat team där trivsel, delaktighet och personlig utveckling står i fokus. Din roll Som mekanikingenjör hos IKG blir du en viktig del av våra kunders produktutvecklings- och konstruktionsarbete. Du arbetar i utvecklande miljöer där du får vara med genom olika faser av utvecklingsprocessen, från idé och koncept till färdig produkt. Beroende på uppdrag kan du exempelvis arbeta med: Mekanisk konstruktion och produktutveckling Konstruktion i 3D-CAD Teknisk kravhantering och konceptutveckling Materialval och tillverkningsanpassning Testning, verifiering och dokumentation Samarbete med tvärfunktionella team inom utveckling, produktion och inköp Hos oss får du möjlighet att utveckla både din tekniska kompetens och ditt professionella nätverk genom varierande uppdrag inom flera olika branscher. Vi söker dig som Är civil- eller högskoleingenjör inom maskinteknik, produktutveckling eller motsvarande Har erfarenhet av mekanisk konstruktion, gärna från produktutvecklande verksamhet Har kunskaper i ett eller flera CAD-system, exempelvis Catia V5, SolidWorks eller NX Har förståelse för materialval samt olika tillverknings och produktionsmetoder Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift Har svenskt medborgarskap då flera av våra uppdrag finns inom försvarsindustrin Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper och söker dig som är nyfiken, ansvarstagande och trivs med att samarbeta för att hitta de bästa tekniska lösningarna. Därför väljer ingenjörer IKG På IKG kombinerar vi tryggheten hos en etablerad arbetsgivare med möjligheten att arbeta i framkant hos spännande kunder. Vi tror att människor utvecklas bäst när de känner delaktighet, får rätt förutsättningar och har kul på vägen. Hos oss får du bland annat: ✅ Fast månadslön, oavsett uppdrag ✅ Sex veckors betald semester ✅ Friskvårdsbidrag på 5 000 kronor per år ✅ Bonusmöjligheter på upp till 2 000 kronor per månad ✅ Kollektivavtal med tjänstepension, försäkringar och föräldraledighetstillägg ✅ Företagshälsovård ✅ Spännande och varierande uppdrag hos ledande teknikföretag ✅ Möjlighet att utveckla din kompetens inom olika produkter, system och branscher ✅ Ett engagerat team och regelbundna aktiviteter och IKG-event Varför IKG? På IKG är människan lika viktig som tekniken. Vår ambition är att alla konsulter ska ha rätt uppdrag, rätt förutsättningar och möjlighet att utvecklas över tid. Genom nära dialog med din konsultchef och en kultur som präglas av delaktighet, enkelhet, ansvar och resultat skapar vi en arbetsplats där du både kan växa och trivas. Vi tror på långsiktiga relationer, både med våra kunder och våra medarbetare. Därför är vi måna om att hitta uppdrag som matchar just dina ambitioner och styrkor. Välkommen till IKG Låter det som nästa steg i din karriär? Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

title: Development Engineer - Gas Customized Trucks
description: Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions. Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future. Role Summary Imagine a Lego kit: are you the type of person who feels accomplished after building the model according to the instructions, or do you enjoy reimagining and rebuilding it in new ways? At Customized Trucks, we embrace Scania’s modularity to craft innovative solutions tailored to our customers' needs. We utilize the "Lego" concept extensively, and sometimes, we even modify the "Lego bricks" to ensure they fit perfectly together. Our responsibility spans the development of customized trucks across various domains, including alternative fuels, electrification, and specialized applications such as mining, heavy haulage, and fire trucks. Every project we undertake begins with a direct customer request, ensuring that our solutions are precisely aligned with their unique requirements. Job Responsibilities The tasks we handle range from routine adaptations, which you can process several times a week, to complex solutions that may require extensive projects. This broad scope and varying complexity offer endless opportunities for you to develop your skills and grow. No two weeks will ever be the same! Your main responsibilities will include: Conducting technical investigations of customer requests. When an order is placed, you will describe the adaptation in the product description system and on drawings. Product ownership of our special gas solutions and ensuring their maintenance over time. Participating in development projects and creating new designs for CNG, LNG, and hydrogen trucks as needed. Addressing and resolving field quality issues as they arise. One of the most exciting aspects of our job is the ability to follow a product from the initial customer request all the way to when the truck leaves the production line! Who You Are To excel in this role, we believe you should be a driven, proactive, and curious individual who isn't afraid to ask questions. You thrive on handling a variety of tasks that may change quickly and enjoy getting hands-on with technical issues when needed. Your positive and enthusiastic attitude makes you a great team player who fosters knowledge sharing and propels the team forward. We also look for the following qualifications: A bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, or equivalent work experience. Previous experience in S-order is beneficial but not mandatory. At least 3 years of experience in product development. Fluency in both written and spoken English. Experience with Scania products, our modular system, and Catia V5 is advantageous. It is also meritorious if you have worked with gas and hydrogen solutions before. This Is Us Our group within the Customized Trucks department specializes in designing gas trucks, including CNG and LNG, at a complete truck level. Recently, we were also involved in the exciting task of developing customized hydrogen solutions. We are a team of nine development engineers and one group manager, and we take great pride in our diversity. Our team members come from various gender identities, ages, life experiences, and cultural backgrounds. We foster an open and supportive work environment where we enjoy our work and support each other. We operate within a value flow, maintaining close contact with other cross-functional teams such as Sales and Marketing, Project Management, Aftermarket, Production, Purchasing, and Certification. This means you will build a broad Scania network from day one! Scania Offers We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions. Scania supports your career growth both locally and internationally through a structured development plan and various courses. Our benefits include training at our health center Gröndal or a wellness allowance, a result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also hosts events for employees and their families, and Stockholm residents can enjoy direct access to Södertälje via the Scania Job express buses. Application Your application should include a CV, cover letter and any relevant certificates. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity in our recruitment processes. Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-10-26. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role. If you have questions or would like more information, please contact: Sourjya Chowdhury, Group Manager, sourjya.chowdhury@scania.com We look forward to your application!

title: Technologist numerical modeling
description: Dit ga jij doen Wil jij met geavanceerde simulaties bijdragen aan de staalfabriek van de toekomst? Als technologist numerical modeling werk je aan complexe vraagstukken op het gebied van warmteoverdracht, thermomechanica en procesgedrag. Je ontwikkelt modellen die niet op de plank belanden, maar direct worden toegepast om installaties betrouwbaarder, efficiënter en duurzamer te maken. Als technologist numerical modeling bij Tata Steel... Maak je complexe processen inzichtelijk. Je ontwikkelt en valideert FEM-modellen voor productie-installaties, vuurvaste bekledingen en productieprocessen. Verbind je data en praktijk. Je gebruikt procesdata en sensormetingen om modellen te valideren en prestaties van installaties beter te begrijpen. Maak je impact op de fabriek. Je vertaalt modelresultaten naar concrete verbeteringen op het gebied van betrouwbaarheid, onderhoud en procesprestaties. Ondersteun je technische besluitvorming. Je analyseert operationele vraagstukken en levert onderbouwde adviezen voor onderhoud, investeringen en procesoptimalisaties. Werk je aan de verduurzaming van Tata Steel. Je ondersteunt projecten op het gebied van License to Operate, energie-efficiëntie en de transitie naar Groen Staal. Breng je verschillende disciplines samen. Je werkt nauw samen met productie, engineering, onderhoud en onderzoekers om verbeteringen succesvol te implementeren. Meer aanbod Dit bieden wij jou De kans om samen met je collega’s bij te dragen aan een leidend en duurzaam staalbedrijf waar iedereen trots op is. Bij ons krijg je veel ruimte om beter te worden in je vak, naar een andere functie door te groeien of je juist in iets totaal nieuws te specialiseren. Wat jouw persoonlijke ambitie ook is; er is bij ons veel mogelijk als je zelf de kansen pakt. Wat we jou nog meer bieden Een salaris conform schaal 17 CAO Tata Steel tussen € 4405,- en € 7786,- bruto per maand op basis van je opleiding en ervaring, en bij een goed bedrijfsresultaat een winstdeling. Deelname aan de collectieve regeling in ons pensioenfonds waarbij we 70% van je premie betalen. Verschillende toeslagen, zoals een vakantietoeslag (8%), eindejaarsuitkering (2%) en individueel keuze budget. Veel vrije tijd je krijgt standaard 34,5 vrije dagen per jaar (24 vakantiedagen en 11,5 adv-dagen) en je kunt via onze flexuren-regeling sparen voor extra vrije dagen. Volop doorgroeimogelijkheden, denk hierbij aan het volgen van cursussen en opleidingen, en doorgroeien naar een hogere functie. Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden waaronder een pensioenvoorziening, tegemoetkoming in je ziektekosten en een onkostenvergoeding. Herken jij jezelf? Je bent analytisch sterk, nieuwsgierig en wilt begrijpen waarom installaties en processen zich gedragen zoals ze doen. Je krijgt energie van complexe technische vraagstukken en vindt het belangrijk dat jouw analyses daadwerkelijk leiden tot verbeteringen in de praktijk. Daarbij schakel je gemakkelijk tussen detailniveau en het grotere geheel en voel je je zowel achter een model als in een productieomgeving thuis. Verder heb je Een MSc of PhD in mechanical engineering, applied physics, materials science of een vergelijkbare richting. Ervaring met FEM-software zoals ANSYS, Abaqus, THERCAST of COMSOL. Ervaring met CFD is een pre. Kennis van warmteoverdracht, thermomechanica en materiaalgedrag bij hoge temperaturen. Affiniteit met industriële processen en productie-installaties. Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal.

title: Sr. Mechanical Engineer

You will collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams and contribute to some of the most impressive offshore operations worldwide. Whether you are working on innovative concepts, designing fit-for-purpose equipment, or working together with subcontractors, your expertise makes a direct and visible impact. Beyond delivering high quality engineering, you help shape the way we work. You share knowledge, challenge existing approaches, support the development of less experienced engineers and actively contribute to a learning and continuously improving organization. At Heerema, we believe great engineers never stop developing. You’ll be given the freedom and trust to take initiative, broaden your technical scope, strengthen your leadership skills and, if you choose, gain hands on offshore experience on our world class vessels. During offshore execution you receive direct feedback on your designs for further future improvements. This is a role for engineers who want responsibility, influence and the space to grow, while making the impossible possible. What you will be working on: Design and development of bespoke offshore equipment for our global fleet, integrating engineering and design in Inventor, including FEM analyses, 3D design and occasionally fabrication drawings; Preparing structural calculations, design reports, component justifications, test protocols and user manuals Realization of equipment with support from external subcontractors; Visiting fabricators to inspect and witness functional testing; Supporting commissioning onboard our vessels and acting as technical liaison for the crew. Key ingredients for success: A Bachelor and/or Master degree Mechanical Engineering or similar; Minimum of 5 years’ experience in designing of tooling and equipment: ability to deliver safe and reliable designs which meet project specifications. Experience in other industries than offshore is also valued; Multiple years of experience in a fabrication environment: ability to deliver designs with a strong focus on manufacturability and cost efficiency; Advanced knowledge of structural and mechanical engineering and a strong drive to deepen your expertise; Analytical, practical and solution-oriented mindset; Confident communicator in English ( spoken and written); Willingness to work temporarily at fabricators, yards, offshore or in our offices; A true team player who enjoys collaborating across disciplines. **Unfortunately, for this position, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or work permit arrangements** Your future colleagues: Of course you are curious to meet us as well! You will be part of a compact, agile team with diverse skill sets where supervisory and coaching skills shine, providing valuable guidance to less experienced engineers. Your Foundation for Success At our core, we champion an entrepreneurial spirit and a relentless pursuit of growth. We seek individuals who excel in personal development, seize opportunities where others see challenges, and turn them into success. Whether you're a creative problem-solver, an ambitious go-getter, or someone who thrives in collaboration, we cultivate a culture of passion, dedication, and continuous improvement. Personal leadership and initiative are non-negotiable: you own your growth and the impact you make. If you tackle challenges with a creative yet practical mindset, drive goals with determination, and add value to diverse teams, you'll thrive with us. Together, we create impact and drive meaningful change, always focused on results. Here's why people love working with us Strong compensation & benefits, including an annual bonus plan tied to company performance; Bonus basis = your annual gross salary + 13th month + 8% holiday allowance; Future-proof pension: gross scheme covering base + 13th month + holiday allowance, with no mandatory contribution up to €72.488,52. 30days off to recharge, with the option to buy 10 extra days; Free access to our in-house gym, including fitness classes; Activities to connect with colleagues (e.g., our Friday-afternoon get-together); A modern and easily accessible office in Leiden. Is this your dream job? Put in your application now!

description: Bedrijfsomschrijving: Locatie: Waalwijk. Deze organisatie houdt zich bezig met de ontwikkeling van dispensers en bijbehorende onderdelen. Vanuit Waalwijk wordt gewerkt aan nieuwe dispenserconcepten, productwijzigingen en de validatie van producten in ontwikkeling. Binnen de innovatieafdeling bestaat het werk rond productontwikkeling uit meten, testen, prototyping en verbeteren. Testplannen en meetmethodes worden opgesteld en afgestemd met fabrieken. De organisatie werkt met internationale projectteams en onderhoudt contacten met onder meer Sales Support, Marketing, Productie en Quality Control. Ook klanten, fabriekslocaties en leveranciers behoren tot de relevante samenwerkingsrelaties. Bij productwijzigingen vindt overleg plaats met specialisten op het gebied van matrijzen, assemblage, lifecycle analyses, mold flow, FEA en productontwikkeling. The role This is hands-on production engineering, with most of your day on the shop floor. The build runs from SMT and through-hole PCB assembly to final assembly and test, mixing automated processes with skilled manual work. Your week is split between sites within about an hour of Exeter. Your job is to find where time and quality are being lost, then fix it for good. Quality is being strengthened at the same time, so you'll work hand in hand with quality from day one. Go after the biggest time sinks first, measuring cycle and takt times and balancing the line Write clear work instructions that give the same result whoever does the build Design jigs, fixtures and error-proofing that make the wrong build hard to produce Rework layouts and flow ready for higher volumes Join root cause investigations with quality and make the fixes stick Give design engineers early manufacturability feedback on new products Work with suppliers and subcontractors when a problem starts outside the building What you'll bring Hands-on experience as a production, process or manufacturing engineer Improvements you can put numbers on: time saved, yield up, rework down Lean tools you've used on a real line, not just trained in You've written work instructions that people actually follow Able to read engineering drawings and schematics The confidence to question how things have always been done, and bring people with you Useful but not essential Electronics or electromechanical manufacturing, ideally including SMT NPI, DFM and DFA experience CAD for fixtures and layouts Experience improving processes at suppliers or contract manufacturers Why apply The timing is the draw. With volumes about to climb, the improvements you make in your first few months will show up on the line straight away. The workforce is settled and long-serving. Electronics experience helps, but if you come from another precision manufacturing sector and want to build a career in electronics, we'd like to hear from you. The package includes 25 days' holiday increasing to 28 plus bank holidays, enhanced pension, enhanced family leave, an employee assistance programme, cycle to work and staff discounts. You might currently be a Production Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer, Process Engineer, Industrial Engineer, Continuous Improvement Engineer, Lean Engineer, NPI Engineer or SMT Process Engineer. You'll need the right to work in the UK. For a confidential discussion, call Daniel Saddi on 01582 350 051. Verso Recruitment Group: the trusted partner of choice to the UK electronics industry.

title: Manufacturing Engineer
description: Job Requirements At Siemens Healthineers, we pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably. Across our global community, we are driven by curiosity, compassion, and a shared desire to create meaningful impact. At our Magnet Technology site in Oxfordshire, you’ll join an inspiring, supportive environment where you can grow, innovate, and contribute to life-changing technology. We encourage individuality, value diverse perspectives, and provide the flexibility and tools to help you thrive both personally and professionally. About The Role We’re looking for a driven and collaborative Manufacturing Engineer to join our Manufacturing Team in Oxfordshire. You will play a key role in shaping world-leading products, supporting quality, productivity, and output while championing our zero‑harm culture. Working alongside talented colleagues across engineering, design, and New Product Introduction (NPI), you’ll help bring advanced technologies from concept through to volume manufacture. What you’ll be doing Applying structured engineering principles to diagnose and resolve manufacturing issues across internal processes and the extended supply chain. Leading projects that enhance quality, productivity, and flow—covering continuous improvement (CI), engineering changes, and capital/value‑stream initiatives. Working closely with the NPI team to own and address a diverse range of technical and process challenges throughout product development. Designing, developing, and implementing new manufacturing processes and equipment to support innovation, digitalisation, and ongoing improvement. Influencing product and component design to ensure concepts are optimised for manufacture, with robust material choices and high‑yield production. Supporting safe, efficient, and reliable operations while contributing to our zero‑harm culture. Work Experience Strong structured problem‑solving capability with experience identifying root causes and implementing effective solutions for complex technical issues. A degree in Engineering, Science, Manufacturing, or a related field—or equivalent hands‑on experience in manufacturing or process engineering. Experience from roles such as Launch Engineer, NPI Engineer, Project Engineer, Manufacturing Technology Engineer, Process Engineer, Advanced Manufacturing Engineer, or similar. Proven ability to collaborate effectively across teams and stakeholders, with clear and confident communication skills. A proactive mindset with a willingness to innovate, explore new ideas, and contribute positively to a high‑performing team environment. Benefits Competitive base salary 26 days annual leave with the option to buy up to 10 and sell up to 5 Up to 10% matched pension contributions BUPA Private Medical Bonus & Share Save Scheme Free-to-use on-site gym 2 paid volunteering days per year Hybrid working (1-2 days a week WFH after initial 3 month training period which will be spent full time on site) Who We Are We are a team of more than 73,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways. How We Work When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably. Siemens Healthineers are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you require any adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know. We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR and other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. Please create a profile within our talent community and subscribe to personalised job alerts that will keep you posted about new opportunities. To all recruitment agencies Siemens Healthineers' recruitment is internally managed, with external support permitted only when a qualified supplier has established a formal contract with us. Unsolicited candidate submissions and referrals, absent a current supplier contract, do not establish consent and are ineligible for fees. We delete and destroy unsolicited information and recommend refraining from such practices. Your adherence to our policies is appreciated.

title: Propulsion System Physical integration Engineer (f/m)
description: Job Description: At Airbus, our purpose is to “pioneer sustainable aerospace for a safe & united world”. As a member of the Propulsion Engineering center, you will contribute to the revolution in aviation by designing and integrating the Powerplant System (PPS). This includes responsibility for all system routings from wing to engine-such as bleed, hydraulic, fuel, fire detection & extinguishing-on main structural components like the pylon. The working environment is multidisciplinary and challenging, dealing with complex interfaces (Level 1, Chief engineering, engine manufacturer, nacelle manufacturer). Our missions are to define the future of propulsion system installation, support production activities, in-service operations, and drive continuous improvements for all commercial programs. This role is vital in advancing the route to decarbonization and preparing for next-generation propulsion systems (e.g., Open Fan, hybrid engines, Fuel Cell architectures). Job Description: We are looking for a motivated junior or early-career engineer to join our team as a Propulsion System Physical Integration Engineer. The propulsion system consists of the engine, the nacelle components (from the air intake to the exhaust nozzle, including fan cowls and thrust reversers), and the pylon. You will join the Propulsion Aerostructure engineering department. As part of the propulsion system physical integration team, you will collaborate with nacelle manufacturers, engine manufacturers, programs, quality, procurement, certification, and customer support. You will work closely with experienced engineers and receive dedicated mentoring and training support to develop your skills. This role involves managing numerous technical deliverables and processes for the propulsion system, both within the department and more broadly in the company. You will have numerous opportunities to develop both your technical and interpersonal skills through: Hybrid metallic/composite structures, including hard metals. Systems installation (ATA 24, 28, 29, 36, 7x, 92) as a physical integrator of these ATAs within the propulsion system. Multiple additional technical aspects: fire protection, lightning strikes, acoustics, and aerodynamics. Collaboration with world-class companies, including nacelle and engine manufacturers. Dynamic programs such as the A320neo, A330neo, and A350, which are currently between serial production and incremental developments, presenting major challenges for Airbus. Hands-on experience with CAD/DMU tools (such as CATIA V5) and digital mockup integration methodologies. Key Responsibilities: Contribution to Interface Control Documents (ICD), the propulsion system installation design data set (DDS) in the FAL, and Digital Mock-Up (DMU) review/management. Coordinating with nacelle and engine manufacturers regarding their activities contributing to our deliverables. Responsibility and configuration management of the definition following modifications to propulsion system elements (pylon, nacelle, engine). Installation and feasibility analysis, including kinematics, tolerancing, and clash analyses to validate definition changes proposed by nacelle/engine manufacturers. Production support by evaluating non-conformances reported by nacelle manufacturers and the FAL, as well as MAP requests. Ensuring a close link with the FAL by analyzing non-conformances, contributing to problem-solving, and proposing improvement projects. These tasks will be performed using a Multi-Functional Team (MFT) approach. In-service support by responding to customer support queries and validating technical documentation (AMM, SB). Management and support of airworthiness topics and in-service issues. You will also contribute to root cause risk assessments and provide the technical data required to close incidents (SB, Mod, etc.). The ideal profile: Degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, or Systems Engineering (recent graduates or up to 2 years of experience welcome). Solid understanding of mechanical design fundamentals, tolerancing, and kinematics. Familiarity or basic working knowledge of 3D CAD modeling software and DMU visualization tools (e.g., CATIA V5, 3DEXPERIENCE). Strong teamwork mindset. Communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Partner and supplier management. Advanced level in English. Why Join Us? Impactful Work: Directly contribute to developing, certifying, and maintaining the airworthiness of commercial and cargo fuselages. Career Opportunities: Access tailored mentorship programs, continuous upskilling, and global career opportunities. Join a great team: Become integral part of a highly energetic and dynamic team, serving a greater, meaningful purpose and enjoying work. This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth. Company: Airbus Helicopters Polska Sp. z o.o. Employment Type: Permanent Experience Level: Professional Job Family: Structure Design & Integration By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus. Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief. Airbus is, and always has been, committed to equal opportunities for all. As such, we will never ask for any type of monetary exchange in the frame of a recruitment process. Any impersonation of Airbus to do so should be reported to emsom@airbus.com . At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.
