title: INGENIEUR DEVELOPPEMENT PRODUIT CALCUL ET VALIDATION MECANIQUE (F/H/D) – CDI
description: À propos du groupe Trench – Big Energy Powered by Bold People Le groupe Trench est un leader technologique mondial des composants et systèmes haute tension pour les réseaux électriques, présent dans presque tous les réseaux de transport d’électricité du monde. Basé à Berlin et fort de plus de 100 ans d’expertise en ingénierie, le groupe Trench conçoit et fabrique des composants haute tension qui relient les réseaux, mesurent leurs performances et garantissent leur fiabilité. Alors que la demande d’électricité augmente et que les réseaux se transforment dans le monde entier, nous sommes un acteur clé des infrastructures dont le monde a besoin – avec 11 usines dans 8 pays sur 4 continents, plus de 3 000 collaborateurs aujourd’hui et l’objectif d’atteindre 4 000 d’ici 2030. Nous sommes bien plus qu’une entreprise de haute tension riche d’un héritage. Nous sommes une communauté mondiale de pionniers, animés par une mission commune et le sens des responsabilités. Nous pensons à long terme, agissons avec audace et croyons qu’un progrès durable demande du travail d’équipe et de l’inventivité. Notre ambition : un impact réel, au-delà des mots. Chez Trench France, le savoir-faire est notre héritage. Fondée en 1922, notre entreprise a bâti sa réputation sur des traversées innovantes de haute qualité, produites sur notre site de Saint-Louis. Ici, des décennies d’expertise technique rejoignent un engagement tourné vers l’avenir en faveur du développement durable, afin de proposer à nos clients des solutions fiables et respectueuses de l’environnement. Découvrez-en plus sur le travail chez Trench Group → Là où votre énergie fait la différence Au sein du pôle technique, vous garantissez la tenue mécanique des appareils haute tension que Trench France conçoit et fabrique à Saint-Louis. Votre expertise technique vous permet de cibler les essais réellement pertinents, de valider les designs avec un haut niveau de confiance et de préserver l’efficience industrielle. Votre travail contribue à la fiabilité des équipements qui soutiennent les réseaux électriques et la transition énergétique. Vos missions Définir le programme d’essais nécessaire à la qualification mécanique d’une gamme d’appareils, en s’appuyant sur le calcul, l’analyse et les essais. Réaliser les calculs de validation de design : tenue mécanique, dynamique vibratoire, tenue sismique, thermomécanique, dimensionnement des interfaces. Statuer sur la nécessité, l’allègement ou la suppression d’essais physiques, et en assumer la justification technique. Piloter le déroulement des essais de qualification retenus et l’exploitation des résultats, en lien avec la R&D et l’Ingénierie. Analyser les non-conformités et écarts d’essai, proposer les actions correctives et faire évoluer les règles de conception. Rédiger la documentation technique associée : notes de calcul, plans d’essais, rapports de qualification, dossiers de justification. Apporter une expertise technique transverse à l’Ingénierie, R&D, au SAV et à la Qualité sur les sujets de validation mécanique. Assurer une veille normative et technologique active, y compris sur les outils numériques et d’intelligence artificielle applicables au calcul et au développement produit. Contribuer à la définition des moyens d’essais mécaniques du laboratoire (bancs, machines d’essais). Votre profil Vous êtes ingénieur mécanique (Bac+5) et justifiez d’environ 10 ans d’expérience en calcul de structures et validation de design, idéalement en environnement industriel exigeant. Vous maîtrisez la mécanique des structures, la résistance des matériaux, la dynamique vibratoire et la tenue sismique. Vous maîtrisez le calcul par éléments finis (ANSYS, Abaqus ou équivalent) ainsi que les outils informatiques. Vous connaissez les démarches de qualification produit et la preuve par similitude, et la connaissance des normes IEC 60137 et IEC 60068-x est appréciée. Vous utilisez les outils numériques et d’intelligence artificielle appliqués à l’ingénierie. Vous parlez couramment l’anglais dans un cadre professionnel. Vous êtes autonome, rigoureux et doté d’un bon esprit de synthèse, d’une force de conviction technique et d’une aisance relationnelle. Vous mettez un point d’honneur à bien faire les choses. Vos collègues ont confiance en votre travail, car vous assumez la responsabilité de la qualité et visez l’excellence. Vous vous adaptez facilement au changement et avez envie d’essayer de nouvelles choses. Vous présentez ce que disent les données avec sincérité, de manière claire et concrète, et vous accueillez volontiers les questions et les points de vue nouveaux. Ce que nous offrons Votre environnement de travail, en toute transparence Contrat de travail : CDI Statut : cadre Temps de travail : cadre forfait jours Lieu de travail : Trench France à Saint-Louis, des déplacements ponctuels sont à prévoir en France et à l’international Votre carrière, portée par la reconnaissance Environnement de travail dynamique et international avec des opportunités d’évolution 10 jours de RTT par an Télétravail selon les modalités de l’accord d’entreprise Indemnités kilométriques forfaitaires selon votre lieu d’habitation ou abonnement de transport pris en charge à hauteur de 50 % Parking privé et parking vélo sécurisé Mutuelle d’entreprise aux conditions avantageuses et à un tarif attractif Cantine sur site avec prise en charge du repas à 50 % par l’employeur Votre performance, équitablement récompensée Prime de 13e mois au prorata du temps de présence Votre bien-être, activement soutenu Le CSE et le comité Qualité de Vie et Conditions de Travail s’engagent à préserver de bonnes conditions de travail et à favoriser une ambiance conviviale. Votre candidature, notre responsabilité Diversité et inclusion Nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif où chacun se sent valorisé, respecté et encouragé à contribuer. Nous accueillons les candidatures de tous les profils qualifiés et célébrons la diversité sous toutes ses formes. Recours

title: Digital Community & Growth Specialist
description: **This hybrid role has a 3-day weekly on-site expectation in our Budapest office.** At Formlabs , we’re building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting-edge products to life-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we’re helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before. We are looking for a highly motivated Digital Community & Growth Specialist to join our team in Budapest. This role is designed for a data-driven technical storyteller and community architect —someone who thrives on the intersection of creative marketing and technology. You will be the bridge between Formlabs’ industry-leading innovation and our global online community, driving our affiliate program, social media operations, and scaling our presence across specialized professional forums. The Job: Social Media & Content Operations Content Collaboration: Work closely with our social media and video content creators to develop editorial calendars that translate complex 3D printing workflows into high-quality, on-brand content. SMM System Management: Lead the day-to-day operations in our Social Media Management tool. You will be responsible for the technical setup, tagging, and organization of outgoing content. Operational Excellence: Manage the administrative side of social media, including link tracking (UTMs), asset organization, and ensuring all posts adhere to brand and technical standards before going live. Community, Forum & Influencer Advocacy Technical Forum Engagement: Proactively grow Formlabs’ presence on Reddit and other specialized industry forums. You will monitor discussions and contribute technical insights to establish Formlabs as a helpful, authoritative voice in the community. SEO & AEO Optimization: Strategically structure forum contributions to enhance SEO & AEO, ensuring Formlabs’ solutions are the top-cited results in both traditional search and AI-driven answer engines. Influencer Recruitment: Drive the expansion of the Formlabs influencer network by identifying, sourcing, and onboarding high-profile technical content creators. Affiliate Program Management Program Scaling: Manage and scale the Formlabs affiliate program by growing our publisher network and driving high-intent traffic via strategic affiliate link placement. Platform Optimization: Maximize the full potential of our automated affiliate platform. You will leverage its advanced features—such as automated workflows, performance tracking, and tiered incentives—to scale the program efficiently. Performance Oversight: Lead the entire affiliate journey, from initial onboarding to ongoing performance optimization. Use data-driven insights to help affiliates succeed and maximize their impact on Formlabs’ growth. You: Professional Experience: 3+ years of experience in social media operations, community management, or affiliate marketing within a technical or engineering-driven field. Industry Knowledge: A sound, technical understanding of digital fabrication and a genuine passion for 3D printing technology. Platform Expertise: In-depth knowledge of the technical social media and forum landscape and best practices across Instagram, X, TikTok, Facebook and Reddit. Search Optimization: Strong understanding of SEO and AEO principles, specifically how to structure forum contributions and social content to improve discoverability in a modern search landscape. Community Focus: Strong understanding of community management and affiliate marketing. Analytical Skills: Experience analyzing social media and community data to meet strategic objectives. Communication: Excellent communication skills in English. Additional EMEA language skills are a plus. Application Quality: Please submit an English CV and a tailored, high-quality cover letter that clearly demonstrates your fit for the role. We Offer: Hybrid work Catered lunch at the office 3 days per week Private health insurance with Medicover (Blue package + hospital coverage) A monthly or quarterly public transportation pass for Budapest Shares in the company (we're a double unicorn company!) Free beverages and snacks at the office All You Can Move sports pass Free 3D prints An inclusive, dog-friendly office with diverse and inspiring colleagues Development opportunities both in-house and off-site Fun team events We build amazing things. Come join us! We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity in our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Even if you don't check every box, but see yourself contributing, please apply. Help us build an inclusive community that will change the face of 3D printing. Your personal data is processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy . If you have any questions or wish to exercise your rights under applicable privacy and data protection laws, please contact us at privacy@formlabs.com .

title: Technical Support Specialist Intern - French speaking
description: About Formlabs A 3D printer is one of the most demanding machines you can build. Lasers, optics, precision motion, thermals, airflow, materials handling, chemistry, sensing, controls, and software all have to work at micron-scale precision, for thousands of layers, with almost no tolerance for error. Making that work reliably is an extraordinary engineering problem. That’s what we do. At Formlabs, we’re building 3D printers that are changing the way things get made. We have the smartest minds across every engineering discipline, and the technology they’re building is deployed at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, and NASA. Our Services team keeps those printers running. We help direct customers, distributors and resellers across EMEA resolve technical issues, investigate machine errors, analyse printer logs and get the most out of their Formlabs ecosystem. Your Impact: As our Technical Support Specialist Intern, you’ll be at the heart of our technology. You’ll diagnose machine errors, analyze printer logs and work hands-on with hardware, firmware, software and materials to find the root cause of complex issues. This is a highly technical role where your engineering mindset and language knowledge are put to work every day. What makes the role special is the combination of deep technical problem-solving and real human connection . Our customers are mainly engineers, dentists, jewelers and manufacturers who rely on Formlabs printers every day. The Job: Respond to technical and product inquiries from direct customers, distributors and resellers in the EMEA region by email, chat and phone. Troubleshoot printer, material and software issues, guiding customers step by step to a fix. Review printer logs and error reports to find the root cause of problems. Document every case clearly in our ticketing system so the team can pick up where you left off. Escalate complex cases to senior specialists and our global engineering team, and follow them through to resolution. Help resellers deliver great service to their own customers. Get hands-on with Formlabs printers in the office to reproduce issues and test solutions. About You: Currently studying engineering. Fluency in French and English (at least C1 level) . Technically curious and comfortable learning how hardware and software work — don't worry, we'll provide all the product training you need. A natural problem-solver with a structured, step-by-step approach to troubleshooting. Patient, friendly and a great listener, comfortable speaking with customers on the phone. Able to work at least 20 hours / week Bonus: a passion for 3D printing or hands-on experience with a 3D printer. We Offer: Catered lunch at the office 3 days / week Free 3D prints An inclusive, dog-friendly office with diverse and inspiring colleagues Hands-on technical training on the full Formlabs product ecosystem. Real experience supporting customers across the EMEA region alongside an expert team. You don’t need to check every box to apply for a role. If you love working with hardware, spending time with smart people, solving hard problems, and winning, we want to hear from you. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Our Candidate AI Guidelines are available here . Please give them a read. Your personal data is processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy . If you have any questions or wish to exercise your rights under applicable privacy and data protection laws, please contact us at privacy@formlabs.com.

title: Müşteri Kalite Mühendisi
description: 1952 yılından bu yana otomotiv sektöründe faaliyet gösteren Tiryakiler Şirketler Grubu’na bağlı firmamız Manisa’daki tesislerinde dünyanın önde gelen araç üreticilerine kardan mili tasarımı ve üretimi yapmaktadır. İŞ TANIMI Kalite metriklerinin takibi ve raporlaması, Müşteri şikayetleri için, ilgili müşterinin özel isteklerine göre belirlenen formatta düzeltici faaliyet çalışmalarına liderlik etmek kaydı ile 5W-Balık kılçığı gibi yöntemler kullanarak kök neden analizlerinin yapılması, düzeltici-önleyici faaliyet raporlarının hazırlanması, aksiyonların takibi ve yönetimini sağlamak Tirsan Kardan Proses kontrollerin uygun olarak yapıldığının kontrol edilmesi, uygunsuzluk durumunda sürekli geliştirme faaliyetleri kapsamında problem çözümlerine katkıda bulunmak, İlgili müşterilerin özel isteklerinin güncelliğinin takibi ve gerekli faaliyetlerin yönetimi, Müşteri portallarının belirlenmiş sıklıklarda kontrolleri ve müşteri kalite performans verilerinin takibi gerektiğinde faaliyetlerin gerçekleştirilmesi, Müşteri ve belgelendirme denetlemelerinde aktif rol almak ve düzeltici faaliyetlere liderlik etmek Kontrol planlarının operasyon kartlarına uygun olarak yapmak ve güncelliklerini sağlamak. title: Servis Saha Teknisyeni
description: “Servis Saha Teknisyeni” olarak ekibimize katılın! Motivasyonu yüksek, kendi kendini yönlendirebilen, yeni zorluklarla karşılaşmaktan heyecan duyan ve müşterilerimiz için çözümler üreten birini arıyoruz. Servis Saha Teknisyeni olarak, müşterilerimize ait çok çeşitli endüstriyel çamaşırhane ekipmanlarının kurulumu, bakımı ve onarımından sorumlu olacaksınız. Müşteri ziyaretlerinde görev alacak ve mükemmel hizmet hedefiyle müşteri memnuniyetini sağlamada çok önemli bir rol oynayacaksınız. Neler Yapacaksınız Kurulum ve Devreye Alma: Yeni satılan çamaşırhane ekipman sistemlerini kurmak ve devreye almak, üretici standartlarına ve müşteri gereksinimlerine uygun çalışmalarını sağlamak Bakım ve Arıza Tespiti: Planlı bakım yapmak, raporlama ve denetimler gerçekleştirmek; ekipmanın arıza ve performans sorunlarını gidererek duruş süresini en aza indirmek, sektör standartlarına ve güvenlik düzenlemelerine uygunluğu sağlamak Teknik Destek: Müşterilere uzman teknik destek sağlamak, sorunları derhal yerinde veya uzaktan çözüme kavuşturmak Müşteri Eğitimi: Müşteri personelinin ekipmanı doğru anlaması ve kullanması için eğitim oturumları düzenlemek Raporlama: Servis raporları hazırlamak, tamamlanan işlerin doğru kayıtlarını tutmak, iş tamamlandığında servis yönetim sistemini güncellemek, idari zaman ve masraf raporlamasını yapmak Müşteri İlişkileri Yönetimi: Müşterilerle güçlü ilişkiler kurmak ve sürdürmek, iş gereksinimlerini öğrenmek, potansiyel müşteriler için servis fırsatlarını, iyileştirmeleri veya ürün yükseltmelerini belirlemek; müşteri geri bildirimlerini almak ve hizmet sunum mükemmelliğini sürekli iyileştirmek için talepleri şirkete iletmek Müşterilerin modifikasyon taleplerine yönelik teknik çözümler önermek Müşteri taleplerinin bir parçası olarak gerekli standart ve standart dışı yedek parça paketlerini önermek Seyahat Saha hizmetleri için yurtiçinde %70'e varan oranda, ayrıca yılda yaklaşık 5 kez uluslararası düzeyde müşterilere seyahat edilmesi beklenmektedir Aranan Nitelikler Eğitim: Mekatronik teknisyenliği geçmişine sahip olmak (güçlü mekanik ve elektrik becerileri veya ilgili bir alanda bilgi) Deneyim: Servis saha teknisyeni olarak minimum 3-5 yıl deneyim, tercihen endüstriyel çamaşırhane sistemleri veya benzer bir alanda; ticari yıkama, kurutma ve ütüleme makineleriyle çalışma deneyimi büyük bir avantajdır Teknik Beceriler: Mekanik, elektrik ve elektronik haberleşme sistemlerinde uygulamalı deneyime dayalı güçlü arıza tespiti becerisi; yazılım yükleme ve PC uzaktan bağlantıları konusunda yeterli deneyime sahip olmak İletişim Becerileri: Türkçe ve İngilizce şart; uluslararası teknik ekiple İngilizce iletişim kurabilmeniz ve müşterilere İngilizce eğitim verebilmeniz beklenmektedir Sürücü Belgesi: Geçerli sürücü belgesi Fiziksel Yeterlilik: Ağır ekipmanları kaldırabilme ve çeşitli çevre koşullarında çalışabilme yeteneği Güvenlik: Endüstriyel ortamlarda güvenlik düzenlemeleri ve uyumluluk konusunda temel bilgi Tercih Edilen Beceriler Elinden gelenin en iyisini yapan, işinin sahipliğini üstlenen ve kararlarının arkasında duran Müşteri sahasında tek başına çalışabilen Kendini geliştirmeyi hiç bırakmayan, bilgisini sürekli güncelleyen Diğer departmanlarla iş birliği yapabilen ve yeni fikirlere açık

title: Quality Assurance Chief (Mechanical)
description: Who We Are? Founded in 1993, Rönesans Holding operates today as a main contractor and investor across a wide geography spanning Türkiye, Europe, Central Asia, and Africa, with activities in construction, real estate, energy, industrial facilities, and healthcare. With more than 40,000 employees and a global team representing over 60 nationalities, Rönesans ranks among the world’s largest contracting companies and continues to deliver innovative engineering projects on a global scale, driven by its vision of building a sustainable future. We are seeking a Mechnical QA Chief to join our LNG Project to be launched in Mozambique. What You’ll Do? Ensure that quality assurance activities in mechanical disciplines are carried out in a planned, systematic, and continuous manner, Plan and supervise the daily activities of engineers and inspectors working under his/her responsibility, Manage the preparation, revision, and approval of mechanical discipline procedures, ITPs, and forms within the scope of the Project Quality Plan, Review and manage approval of subcontractor and vendor quality plans, ITPs, welding procedures (WPS, PQR, WPQ), and personnel qualification records, Ensure that quality control records (inspection and test reports, certificates, approved forms, etc.) are organized, archived, retained, and traceable in line with the project document management system, Ensure that mechanical discipline quality logs (inspection request / RFI, NCR, welding, calibration, audit finding, and document tracking logs, etc.) are maintained accurately and kept up to date, Ensure that deficiencies identified during site activities (punch lists, open items) are listed, tracked with assigned responsible parties and target dates, and verified upon closure, Plan and conduct internal audits and subcontractor / vendor audits for mechanical disciplines, and follow up on the closure of findings, Manage Nonconformance Reports (NCR); evaluate root cause analyses and verify the effectiveness of corrective and preventive actions, Monitor quality Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), perform trend analyses, and develop improvement proposals, Ensure that Mechanical Completion and Final Dossier packages are complete and traceable, Audit the effectiveness of the calibration system for monitoring and measuring equipment, Conduct briefings and training for project teams and subcontractors on quality requirements and procedures, Run lessons learned activities and ensure they are built into the quality management system, Provide regular reporting to the Quality Manager, contribute to monthly quality reports, and support achievement of project quality objectives, Maintain quality assurance communication with the Client / Client’s Representative and coordinate submission of audits, reports, and records. What We Expect from You? Minimum 15 years of quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) experience in industrial facilities, oil & gas, power plants, refineries, and petrochemical projects, At least 10 years of quality assurance experience in mechanical disciplines (piping, welding, steel structure, static / rotating equipment) within oil, gas, and petrochemical facilities, Holding at least one of the following certifications will be considered an advantage: ISO 9001 Lead Auditor, IWE (International Welding Engineer), or CSWIP 3.2 (Senior Welding Inspector), Strong knowledge and hands-on experience with international industry standards and project specifications, including but not limited to ISO 9001, ISO 10005, ISO 19011, ASME B31.3, ASME Section VIII, ASME Section IX, AWS D1.1, API 650, as well as ISO, ASME, API, ASTM, AWS, EN, Ability to plan and manage quality assurance activities in compliance with contract documents, technical specifications, project procedures, and the Project Quality Plan, Proven experience in preparing quality plans, procedures, ITPs, and forms, and in reviewing and approving subcontractor / vendor quality documentation, Proven experience in quality records management, establishment of log systems, and tracking of deficiencies / open items (punch lists), Proven experience in planning, conducting, and reporting internal and external quality audits, Proven competence in managing nonconformance, root cause analysis (RCA), and corrective and preventive action (CAPA) processes, Proficient user of MS Office applications, Strong analytical skills with a solution and results oriented mindset, Proven experience in team management, with strong coordination and communication skills, Proficient English language skills, both written and verbal, sufficient for technical communication with the Client / Client’s Representatives, Ability to adapt to flexible working hours and intensive work schedules. What We Offer? Performance-based bonus practices that recognize and reward success Comprehensive benefits and employee support programs Private Health Insurance benefits designed to support employee health and well-being Training and development programs that foster professional and personal growth Our Diversity and Equality Statement Rönesans Holding is among the signatories of the United Nations Global Compact, which calls on companies to align their strategies and operations with universal principles on human rights, labor, environment and anti-corruption, and to take actions that advance societal goals. Rönesans Holding adopts the universally accepted principles based on the declarations recognized within the framework of the United Nations Global Compact. Rönesans Holding is an employer that aims to ensure equality in its human resources practices by upholding transparent and ethical values, without compromising its core principles of integrity, competitiveness and innovation. All applications are evaluated based on equal opportunity, regardless of gender, language, religion, race or ethnic origin, and no discrimination is applied.

title: Senior Seeker Systems Engineer
description: The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We push boundaries, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who are driven by ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in. At TYTAN , we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty. We are looking for a Senior Seeker Systems Engineer (EO/IR & Radar) to define and develop the sensing capabilities of our next-generation autonomous systems. You will lead the selection, integration, and optimization of onboard sensors, including daylight cameras, thermal imagers, radar, and other targeting payloads, ensuring reliable target detection, tracking, and engagement. News: TYTAN Technologies GmbH https://www.tytan-technologies.com/blog-posts/mercedes-benz-and-tytan-technologies-sign-memorandum-of-understanding https://defence-industry.eu/tytan-technologies-raises-e30-million-series-a-to-scale-ai-air-defence-systems-across-europe-and-ukraine/ https://www.aa.com.tr/tr/bilim-teknoloji/almanyaya-ogrenci-olarak-gitti-dusman-ihalari-etkisiz-hale-getiren-teknoloji-gelistirdi/3274043 Your Roadmap to Make an Impact Lead new EO/IR sensor designs in collaboration with hardware and systems engineering teams. Evaluate and select EO, IR, radar, laser, and multi-sensor solutions. Develop sensor fusion, target detection, tracking, and classification algorithms . Specify sensor performance requirements, including range, field of view, stabilization, and SWaP constraints. Drive integration of sensors into gimbals, payloads, and autonomy systems. Conduct trade studies, system performance analyses, and supplier evaluations. Support in ground testing, validation, and flight trials. Job requirements Degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Optics, Mechatronics, or similar. Experience in missile seekers, guided weapons, EO/IR payloads, targeting systems, gimbals, ISR sensors, or defense electronics. Strong knowledge of: Electro-optical (EO) cameras Thermal / IR imaging systems Radar and RF sensing Sensor fusion and target tracking Experience translating mission requirements into sensor architectures and payload designs. Hands-on mindset with the ability to take ownership of critical technical decisions. You have worked on missile programs, loitering munitions, ISR payloads, targeting systems, or stabilized gimbals and understand how to answer key questions such as: What sensor suite is required for the mission? EO, thermal, radar, or multi-mode seeker? How should sensors be integrated into the autonomy stack? How can detection performance be maximized within strict size, weight, and power constraints? You'll play a key role in shaping the sensing and targeting capabilities of our next-generation autonomous systems. Why TYTAN? Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defense systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security Shape scalable defense capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale Contribute to networked air defense: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defense architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact Define a new generation of defense technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe Our Benefits Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands Flexibility : Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration About us At TYTAN , it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all. We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background.

title: Üretim ve Operasyon Yöneticisi
description: Buzkap'ta Geleceği Birlikte Üretelim! 1941 yılından bu yana profesyonel soğutma ve teşhir çözümleri geliştiren Buzkap olarak, mühendislik uzmanlığımızı, tasarım gücümüzü ve üretim tecrübemizi geleceğin teknolojileriyle birleştiriyoruz. Pastane, fırın, kafe, dondurma ve zincir perakende sektörlerine yönelik geliştirdiğimiz çözümlerle, satış alanlarını yüksek performanslı deneyim platformlarına dönüştürüyoruz. Bugün, 85 yıllık tecrübemizden aldığımız güçle, Buzkap NEXT stratejimiz kapsamında yeni bir dönüşüm yolculuğundayız. Üretim organizasyonumuzu daha verimli, standartlaşmış, dijital, ölçeklenebilir ve sürdürülebilir bir yapıya dönüştürüyoruz. Bu yolculukta, üretim operasyonlarımıza liderlik edecek, mevcut sistemleri geliştirecek ve geleceğin üretim organizasyonunu bizimle birlikte inşa edecek bir Üretim ve Operasyon Yöneticisi arıyoruz. title: Officer, Dyehouse Engineer
description: Coats is a world leader in thread manufacturing and structural components for apparel and footwear, as well as an innovative pioneer in performance materials. These critical solutions are used to create a wide range of products, including ones that provide safety and protection for people, data and the environment. Trusted by the world's leading companies to deliver crucial, innovative, and sustainable solutions, we provide value-adding products including apparel, footwear and specialty threads. With a proud heritage dating back more than 250 years and a spirit of evolution to constantly stay ahead of changing market needs, we have operations across 50 countries with a workforce of over 17,000, serving our customers worldwide. Role Purpose: The Dyehouse Engineer is responsible for supporting and optimizing dyeing operations at the Bursa manufacturing site. The role focuses on ensuring product quality, process efficiency, productivity, health & safety compliance, and continuous improvement across dyehouse operations. Working closely with production, laboratory and technical teams, the Dyehouse Engineer plays a key role in maintaining global manufacturing standards while driving operational excellence. What You Will Do (Key Responsibilities) Dyeing Operations & Process Excellence Monitor and align dyeing processes with Coats global manufacturing standards. Ensure adherence to approved product routings and raw material specifications. Support the implementation of manufacturing best practices and process standardization. Monitor process performance and identify opportunities to improve productivity, efficiency and quality. Support laboratory activities, recipe screening and colour matching processes. Ensure efficient utilization of Dyehouse systems including SAP, Sedomaster, Tecnorama and Color Stitch. Continuous Improvement & Operational Efficiency Apply Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma and Industrial Engineering principles to improve performance. Analyze process data and implement actions to reduce waste and improve productivity. Participate in continuous improvement projects across dyehouse operations. Monitor KPIs and drive initiatives to improve service, quality and cost performance. Support root cause analysis and corrective action implementation. Quality Management Ensure compliance with Quality Management Systems and applicable standards, including IATF 16949 requirements. Support internal and external audits and address non-conformities. Maintain process documentation and ensure procedures remain up to date. Promote a culture of quality and continuous improvement throughout operations. Health, Safety & Environment Support implementation of all Health, Safety and Environmental standards within the Dyehouse. Participate in risk assessments and help establish safe working practices. Ensure employees understand operational risks, PPE requirements and environmental responsibilities. Monitor operations to maintain compliance with Coats HSE standards. People & Collaboration Work closely with production supervisors, laboratory teams and support functions to achieve operational goals. Contribute to employee training and capability development initiatives. Promote teamwork, collaboration and employee engagement. Act as a role model by demonstrating Coats values and ethical standards. Who You Are (Requirements) Essentials Bachelor's Degree in Textile Engineering, Chemical Engineering or a related field. Experience in the textile industry, preferably within dyeing operations, laboratory or production environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Understanding of quality systems and continuous improvement methodologies. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work collaboratively across functions. Strong numerical and statistical analysis skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications. Fluent written and spoken English. Demonstrated commitment to learning and professional development. Desirable Experience with SAP. Knowledge of Sedomaster, Tecnorama or similar dyeing management systems. Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification. Understanding of textile quality management systems and auditing requirements. Knowledge of occupational health and safety standards. MBA or postgraduate qualification in a relevant field. At Coats Group, we are committed to innovation, excellence, and fostering a diverse and collaborative environment where every team member can thrive. If you are passionate about making an impact in the textile industry and eager to join a global leader with a rich heritage and a forward-thinking approach, we invite you to take the next step in your career with us. Apply now to be part of our dynamic team and help shape the future of textiles.

Our platform empowers organizations to protect critical digital assets and ensure compliance through cutting-edge technologies. We serve enterprises worldwide by securing their IT environments against evolving threats and operational risks. As part of our commitment to delivering robust and secure solutions, we are looking for an experienced Test Engineer to join our growing team. About The Role We are seeking a passionate and detail-oriented Test Engineer who will play a key role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our PAM and cybersecurity solutions. This position requires a solid understanding of manual and automated testing processes, as well as familiarity with modern software development practices and tools. You will work closely with software developers, product managers, and fellow QA engineers to design, execute, and improve testing strategies for both web and mobile applications, APIs, and system components. Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain comprehensive test plans, test cases, and automated test scripts. Perform manual and automated testing across web and mobile platforms. Execute API testing, performance testing, and analyze test results to provide actionable feedback to the development team. Identify, document, and track software defects with clear, detailed reports. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (development, product management, DevOps) to ensure quality standards throughout the software development lifecycle. Develop and maintain automated test pipelines in CI/CD environments. Conduct database validation using SQL for back-end and data integrity testing. Work in Linux-based environments for system-level testing, log analysis, and basic scripting. Contribute to the continuous improvement of testing processes, tools, and team knowledge. Use AI-enabled test automation capabilities, such as AI-assisted test creation, self-healing locators, and automated test maintenance, to improve UI test coverage and accelerate regression testing. Create, debug, execute, and maintain automated UI tests using UiPath Test Suite or equivalent AI-enabled or low-code test automation platforms. Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields. 2+ years of experience as a Software Test Engineer or QA Engineer in a technology-driven environment. Strong knowledge of manual testing methodologies and defect management lifecycle. Practical experience with automated UI testing tools (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Appium, Robot Framework). Hands-on experience in API testing using tools like Postman or SoapUI. Proficiency in Python and/or Java for test automation scripting. Familiarity with test management tools such as JIRA, TestRail, or Xray. Solid understanding of software development (SDLC) and software testing (STLC) lifecycles. Experience with CI/CD tools like Jenkins, Git, and pipeline automation. Exposure to performance testing using tools such as JMeter or LoadRunner. Comfortable testing across multiple platforms: Web, Android, iOS. Good working knowledge of SQL for database testing and validation. Experience working with Linux operating systems including command-line usage and troubleshooting. Strong problem-solving and debugging skills with excellent attention to detail. Upper-intermediate or higher level of spoken and written English. Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. Hands-on experience with at least one UI test automation platform, such as UiPath Test Suite or an equivalent AI-enabled or low-code test automation tool. Familiarity with AI-assisted test creation, self-healing locators, or automated test maintenance is an advantage. Bonus Skills Experience with security-related testing in PAM or IAM environments. Familiarity with container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes). Knowledge of scripting languages such as Bash or Shell scripting. Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP). Why Join Kron? Be part of a global team shaping the future of cybersecurity and privileged access management. Work on mission-critical products that help organizations protect their most valuable assets. Enjoy a collaborative, innovative, and growth-oriented working environment with strong leadership support. Take part in continuous learning and development opportunities in one of the most dynamic sectors of the tech industry.

Uitgebreide opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden. Moderne software, tools en engineeringfaciliteiten. Een informele organisatie met korte lijnen. Goede pensioenregeling en aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden. Wat wordt er van jou verwacht? Een afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechanical Engineering of vergelijkbaar. Je komt terecht bij een gespecialiseerd ingenieursbureau waar je werkt aan uiteenlopende technische vraagstukken voor verschillende klanten en industrieën. Voor een internationale opdrachtgever in de hightech machinebouw zoeken wij een ervaren engineer die zich richt op de ontwikkeling van mechanische systemen, modules en machines. title: Project Engineer (Mechanical/Industrial)
description: We are looking for an engineer who enjoys turning ideas into something real. Someone who can take a problem, work out a solution, and see it through to a working result. The projects vary, and that keeps it interesting. About Myne Myne Circular Metals develops technologies that address one of the resource industry's most pressing challenges: the depletion of high-quality metals and the environmental cost of producing them. Our core technologies, the Xorter and MDX, convert chaotic metal waste streams into raw materials that match virgin metals in quality, at lower cost and without downcycling. We do this with ~75 people in Harderwijk, €400M in annual turnover, and close partnerships with universities and specialists. We are scaling fast, with ambitious technical developments still underway. Role Description At Myne, engineers are close to the work — and this role is no exception. As a Project Engineer, you focus on developing and delivering the systems and components that make our technology work, from concept to working result. The subject matter varies: one project might involve a mechanical sorting system, the next a fluid handling setup. What stays constant is your approach: define the requirements, design or source the solution, and make sure it works. You will spend time in the office and in our production facilities, working alongside operators and technicians in a real industrial environment. Key Responsibilities Own: Work independently and prioritize tasks based on project roadmaps Design: Conceptualize and develop components and systems in CAD, whatever the application Make: Prototype, assemble, test, and refine from first sketch to finished and integrated result Collaborate: Coordinate with team members, suppliers, and external partners Deliver: Manage projects from concept to deployment, on time and fully integrated into operations What You Bring Experience: You have experience with designing and delivering technical solutions from concept to working result. Either from a formal degree or hands-on experience, what matters is that you can apply it in practice. (Plant) design proficiency: Comfortable in CAD software (SolidWorks, Inventor, etc.). You might use it daily or pick it up when a design needs working out. Experience with P&IDs and PFDs is considered a plus. Technical curiosity: You pick up new domains quickly and are not put off by projects outside your immediate expertise. Hands-on: Just as comfortable in the workshop, on a phone call or behind a desk. This role requires all. Self-directed: You manage your own workload based on a roadmap, set priorities, and follow through without needing constant direction. On-site: Based in Harderwijk, working daily in an industrial pilot environment where things are still being figured out, and that's exactly what makes it interesting. Education: HBO/WO in Mechanical or Industrial Design Engineering, or equivalent experience. Communication: Professional written and verbal communication skills in English, Dutch is a plus. What We Offer Salary: €3,000-€5,000 gross per month, depending on experience and knowledge (0-5 years) Bonus: Yearly performance bonus based on your contributions Flexible hours: 32-40 hours per week Benefits: Full commuting allowance and solid pension plan Impact: Groundbreaking recycling technologies with direct contribution to the circular economy, alongside leading research institutions Team: A multidisciplinary team where diverse backgrounds and the best ideas are genuinely valued Growth: Development opportunities tailored to your ambitions Apply for the job Excited after reading this description? We welcome your application, even if you don't meet all the listed criteria. Apply today and join us in shaping a sustainable future.

title: Critical Systems Commissioning lead – Mechanical
description: Silent-Aire – Dublin What You Will Do We are seeking an experienced Mechanical Critical Systems Commissioning Lead to help develop and lead the commissioning strategy for advanced cooling systems supporting next-generation data centre applications. This is a technical role within our central commissioning function, combining hands-on commissioning expertise, technical leadership and development of commissioning standards. You will work across product development, factory testing and site deployment, supporting regional teams to ensure safe, repeatable and high-quality commissioning from design review through FAT, SAT, integrated systems testing (IST) and final handover. The role is particularly suited to an experienced mechanical commissioning professional with a strong background in hydronic systems, HVAC, chilled-water systems or mission-critical infrastructure who wants to develop further expertise in liquid-cooled data centre technology. How You Will Do It Commissioning Strategy & Technical Leadership Develop and own the mechanical commissioning strategy for liquid-cooled and mission-critical cooling products. Define commissioning philosophy, test levels, hold points, acceptance criteria and documentation requirements. Provide design-for-commissioning input during design reviews and new product development. Act as a senior technical resource for mechanical commissioning issues, troubleshooting and risk resolution. Drive lessons learned and continuous improvement into future product designs and commissioning processes. Systems Scope The role will cover a range of cooling and mechanical infrastructure, including: Direct-to-Chip (DTC) liquid cooling systems. Coolant Distribution Units (CDUs). CRAHs, AHUs and other mission-critical cooling equipment. Chilled-water and secondary heat-rejection systems. Chillers, dry coolers and plate heat exchangers. Pumps, valves, pipework, filtration and water-treatment systems. Rear Door Heat Exchangers (RDHx), where applicable. Leak detection and containment systems. Mechanical interfaces with BAS/BMS/PLC controls. Associated instrumentation, sensors and control valves. Procedures & Documentation Development Develop, Review And Maintain Commissioning Documentation Including Mechanical commissioning plans and procedures. Pre-commissioning, flushing, cleaning and water-quality procedures. Hydrostatic/pneumatic pressure and leak-testing procedures. Functional performance testing. Thermal performance and load-validation testing. Failure-mode and redundancy testing. FWT, FAT, SAT and integrated testing procedures. Clearly defined and measurable pass/fail criteria. Factory, Site & Regional Team Support Provide governance and technical oversight to factory and regional commissioning teams. Support and audit commissioning execution against agreed standards and procedures. Participate in and witness Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), Site Acceptance Tests (SAT) and critical site activities. Support troubleshooting, root-cause analysis and system optimisation. Help develop regional commissioning capability through coaching, technical guidance and lessons learned. Integrated Testing & Handover Work closely with electrical, controls, engineering and project teams during: Integrated Systems Testing (IST). Failure-mode and redundancy testing. System load and thermal performance testing. Client demonstrations and acceptance testing. Final commissioning documentation and handover. Transition into live IT load and operational readiness. What We Look For Experience & Qualifications Relevant mechanical commissioning, HVAC, building-services or mission-critical engineering experience. Strong practical knowledge of hydronic systems, chilled-water systems and mechanical cooling equipment. Experience commissioning data - centre or liquid-cooling systems is highly desirable but not essential where the candidate can demonstrate strong transferable commissioning experience. Working Knowledge Of Hydronic system operation, balancing and commissioning. Pumps, valves, heat exchangers and associated pipework. Pressure testing, flushing and water-quality requirements. Controls and BMS/PLC interaction. Functional performance testing. Redundancy and failure-mode testing. Experience supporting FWT, SAT or site commissioning activities. Relevant mechanical/building-services engineering qualification, trade background or equivalent industry experience. Experience working across multiple locations or with regional teams is advantageous. What Will Make You Successful You will be comfortable operating as both a technical authority and practical commissioning engineer. You should be able to challenge designs constructively, troubleshoot complex systems, produce clear technical documentation and make sound engineering decisions under pressure. You will also be comfortable travelling to support factory testing, first-of-kind deployments and critical commissioning activities as required. #AVRIL

Du är van vid att ta hänsyn till material, maskiner, verktyg, toleranser och kostnader när du utvecklar en lösning. description: Senior Mechanical Engineer Ely | Salary negotiable depending on experience | Full time, permanent As Senior Mechanical Engineer, you’ll take the lead on mechanical design projects for heavy industrial machinery. What’s on offer Competitive salary 39 hours a week, Monday to Friday, with flexible start and finish times 34 days’ holiday including bank holidays Life assurance and private medical cover after probation And more…! You’ll report to the Engineering Manager and be based on site in Ely throughout probation so you can get hands on with the machinery during product training.

title: Senior Mechanical Test Engineer and Service Manager
description: For more than half a century, Serco has walked alongside the pioneers of space. Serco has supported over 50 ESA missions where our teams have helped launch satellites, guide spacecraft across the void and turn data into discoveries that reshape our world. With thousands of specialists contributing across the entire space lifecycle from satellite testing to launch services, LEOP to operations and surveillance, we’ve become a trusted force in national and European space strategies. And now, the next chapter could include you. As part of our long-standing partnership with the European Space Agency (ESA), we are recruiting a Senior Mechanical Test Engineer and Service Manager to join our on-site team at the ESTEC Test Centre in Noordwijk, the Netherlands. This is a predominantly technical role, with approximately 90% of your time dedicated to engineering and 10% to on-site Service Management . You will contribute primarily to Test Centre facility development and environmental test campaigns, with additional support to mechanical ground support equipment (MGSE) activities alongside experienced specialists. You will work closely with ESA engineers, Test Centre operators, suppliers and a small Serco team to plan and deliver engineering work safely, on time and to the required quality. You do not need to be an expert in every test discipline or software package: we welcome candidates with strong experience in one or more relevant engineering areas and the ability to learn and work across disciplines. Responsibilities Engineering & Test Facilities Delivery (90% of time) Lead or contribute to Test Centre facility development and modification activities, working with ESA and facility operators to consolidate requirements, define the scope of work and develop practical engineering solutions. Prepare or review technical specifications and engineering documentation; support ESA procurement activities and coordinate suppliers, installations, commissioning, acceptance activities and off-site Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), as required. Develop or review facility designs, drawings and technical models using appropriate engineering tools. Depending on your background, this may include mechanical CAD, electrical schematics, P&ID diagrams or structural analysis. Support the preparation and execution of up to four environmental test campaigns per year. Activities may include feasibility assessments, test configuration, equipment selection and coordination of test equipment installation. Contribute to test execution as a Test Engineer or Test Lead, according to your experience and the needs of each campaign. Coordinate shift planning where required, support data analysis and prepare test reports and technical documentation. Provide engineering support to MGSE design, verification, installation and acceptance activities, working alongside the team’s mechanical design specialists. Experience with 3D models, manufacturing drawings or finite element analysis is valuable. Work collaboratively with ESA, Test Centre operators and external suppliers, maintaining accurate technical records and complying with applicable quality, health and safety, security, data protection and export-control requirements. Service & Team Management (10% of time) Act as the on-site Service Manager and main operational point of contact for ESA. Coordinate task intake, priorities, resource allocation, work-package interfaces and delivery planning with ESA representatives and the Serco team. Monitor service progress, deliverables, risks, issues and agreed Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Prepare concise progress reports and coordinate regular service reviews with ESA. Coordinate the small on-site Serco team, including work allocation, leave and absence cover, service continuity, onboarding and training coordination. Promote good communication, accurate documentation and consistent application of applicable procedures. Mandatory Requirements Master's degree (MSc) or PhD from a recognised university in Mechanical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Metrology, Geodesy or an equivalent relevant engineering discipline (including, for example, Aerospace Engineering or Mechatronics). 7+ years of relevant professional experience in engineering, technical operations, test facilities, equipment design, integration, verification or qualification. Proven experience in managing a service or comparable ongoing technical operation. Relevant experience may include management of an engineering service, technical operation, customer-facing work packages or technical teams, with responsibility for planning, resources, stakeholders and delivery. Significant engineering experience in one or more of the following areas: test facility development or modification; environmental testing or qualification; mechanical systems or equipment design; system integration, installation or commissioning. Experience using engineering design tools and preparing or reviewing technical documentation. Experience with 3D CAD is expected; knowledge of structural analysis, electrical schematics or P&ID tools is an advantage. Experience working within structured engineering, quality, health and safety procedures, with an appreciation of configuration control and technical records. Professional fluency in written and spoken English, with clear communication and reporting skills and the ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary teams and customers. Willingness and ability to work on-site at ESTEC in Noordwijk and to successfully complete the applicable ESA security and export-control screening before starting the assignment. Highly Desirable Differentiators Experience in the space, aerospace or another high-reliability engineering environment; familiarity with EN9100, ISO 9001, ECSS or comparable standards. Experience with environmental test or qualification activities, such as thermal vacuum, thermal cycling, solar simulation, vibration, shock or acoustic testing. Test Lead

Knowledge of composite manufacturing processes (VARTM, resin infusion, prepreg, filament winding) and material selection. Master's degree in a relevant field, or progress towards Chartered Engineer (CEng) status through IMechE,IET, RAeS or IOM3.

title: Loads and Aeroelastics Engineer
description: Job Description: About The Role The Loads and Aeroelastics department in Filton, Bristol (UK) is looking for talented individuals to join a highly engaged and international team of experts, specialists and integrators. The Loads Computation team plays a vital role across all stages of aircraft development, from initial concepts and preliminary design right through to certification and continuous support for the in-service fleet, including involvement in research and technology projects. Working closely with other teams in Flight Physics, Airframe, Future Projects, and Landing Gear Systems, the team is responsible for modelling, calculating, and analysing external aircraft and landing gear loads for all Airbus programmes including the A320 family, A330, A350, A220, the new generation maritime patrol aircraft PATMAR, and other future products under consideration. The team is situated at the interface between many different engineering disciplines and we work on the very latest research and technology projects. This role offers a fantastic opportunity to work as part of a collaborative and supportive team and if you want to develop a broad knowledge of the integrated aircraft, our trans-national network of Experts and Specialists can help you do that. Together we will make a key contribution to overall aircraft performance optimisation while upholding the highest standards of safety, operability, and sustainability. Your main activities To be successful in this role you will utilise or establish a broad range of skills to: Develop models (aerodynamic, stiffness, mass and flight control) to simulate the static and dynamic loads that aircraft experience on the ground and in flight. Calculate static and fatigue design load data and support engineering teams in their use of this data. Support relevant aircraft and system test campaigns to validate models for loads calculations such as landing gear drop tests and aircraft flight tests. Support airlines through Airbus Customer Services by carrying out Loads and Aeroelastics analyses of in-service events including the timely response to engineering queries as on-call engineer for Loads In-Service Support. Where also required, perform trouble shooting investigations for development, production (pre-delivery), flight test, and in-service aircraft. Acquire competencies related to new technologies, for example: data analytics, Model Based Systems Engineering, AI, machine learning etc. Develop processes, methods and tools for loads computation, surrogate modelling and machine learning. Pioneer the future through support to existing research and technology activities and propose and define new areas of research. Foster and maintain positive working relationships and team spirit, both within the immediate team and with all relevant stakeholders. As your knowledge and experience grow, you will be relied upon to contribute to aircraft optimization and identify and manage technical risk through innovative multidisciplinary approaches. A good understanding of flight physics and landing gear systems. Excellent communication, team working, and interpersonal skills. A willingness to learn and share knowledge with colleagues and an interest in finding creative solutions to complex problems. You will develop and validate computational models to understand how repair particles move through leaking pipes, accumulate at leaks and form an effective seal. Working with Origin’s engineering team and Newcastle University researchers, you will turn these findings into predictive tools and practical guidance for product development and deployment. You will work closely with Caitlin Woolley, Product Development Engineer at Origin Tech, and an interdisciplinary Newcastle University team led by Dr Weichao Shi and Dr Ben Wetenhall. The university team brings expertise in computational fluid dynamics, multiphase flow, porous media, fluid–structure interaction, pipeline engineering and data-driven engineering methods. The KTP Associate will be an employee of Newcastle University but will spend most of their working time at the company’s premises at address 1 St James Gate, Newcastle upon Tyne, NE1 4BE. You will also work at Newcastle University and attend Origin Tech’s workshop and testing facility as required. The KTP Associate will follow Origin Tech’s working hours and holiday procedure. Your working week will be 40 hours per week. The shift pattern is Monday- Friday, 8 hours per day and there is flexibility within the core hours of 8:00AM-6:00PM. Annual Leave applicable to this role 28 days plus bank holidays and one additional day off for your birthday. This role is a 2-year fixed term contract; however, the role offers strong opportunities for career development and potential longer-term employment with Origin Tech following successful completion of the project. More than 70% of KTP staff gain a permanent job offer by their KTP company. For more information or informal enquiries, please contact Dr Ben Wetenhall at Ben.Wetenhall@newcastle.ac.uk or Dr Weichao Shi at Weichao.Shi@newcastle.ac.uk For further details on the Faculty of Science, Agriculture & Engineering please visit our web page at: https://www.ncl.ac.uk/sage/ For further details about Knowledge Transfer Partnerships please visit the web page at: http://www.ktp-uk.org/ Applications are welcomed from candidates with strong academic modelling experience who demonstrate the potential to develop advanced computational modelling capabilities. Any requested additional documents required as part of your application, should be included within the same file as your cover letter. The total file size must not exceed 10MB. Develop and apply suitable multiphase and particle-modelling approaches, including Euler–Euler and dense discrete phase modelling where appropriate, to investigate particle transport, accumulation and interactions. title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description: To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology. Group/Division The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The SPTS division provides advanced wafer processing solutions—including etch, deposition and vapor-based technologies—designed for R&D through high-volume production. With a global presence and strong customer support network, SPTS helps manufacturers across industries improve performance, yield and cost-efficiency. It also offers comprehensive service and spare parts through a worldwide network of service centers and qualified local agents. What You'll Do In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise. We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Mechanical Design Engineer to join our innovative team at KLA Corporation. This role involves designing, analyzing, and optimizing complex mechanical systems for KLA's advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment, contributing to the development of cutting-edge technology. Job Responsibilities Design and develop mechanical components, sub-assemblies, and systems for KLA's product lines, utilizing CAD software (e.g., SolidEdge ). Conduct detailed engineering analysis, including stress, thermal, vibration, and kinematic analysis, using FEA tools (e.g., ANSYS, Solid Edge Simulation) to ensure design robustness and performance. Generate detailed manufacturing drawings, specifications, and documentation in accordance with industry standards (e.g., GD&T). Collaborate with cross-functional teams including electrical engineers, software engineers, and manufacturing personnel to integrate mechanical designs into complete systems. Experience performing structural and thermal analysis and correlating simulation results with physical testing. Experience with topology optimization and simulation-led mechanical design. Experience managing suppliers, machine shops, and prototype manufacturing partners. Familiarity with optical payload integration and maintaining precision alignment under shock, vibration, and thermal loading. title: Events Logistics Intern (EMEA)
description: About Formlabs: A 3D printer is one of the most demanding machines you can build. Lasers, optics, precision motion, thermals, airflow, materials handling, chemistry, sensing, controls, and software all have to work at micron-scale precision, for thousands of layers, with almost no tolerance for error. Making that work reliably is an extraordinary engineering problem. That’s what we do. At Formlabs, we’re building 3D printers that are changing the way things get made. We have the smartest minds across every engineering discipline, and the technology they’re building is deployed at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, and NASA. Events are a critical way we connect with our users and showcase our products, with over 20 tradeshows and company events across EMEA each year. title: Mühendislik Müdürü, Güç Üretimi ve Döner Ekipman Sistemleri
description: 1948 yılında temelleri atılan Karadeniz Holding, enerji ve gemi inşa başta olmak üzere geniş bir sektör yelpazesinde inovasyonu ön planda tutarak büyümeyi ekonomik ve çevresel sürdürülebilirlik açısından destekleyen, vizyoner sektör lideridir.30 farklı milletten 3.000’den fazla çalışanı ile 20’den fazla ülkede faaliyet gösteren, 8.000 MW’tan fazla kurulu güce sahip Grup, 45 Powership™ ve 11 LNG gemisinden oluşan filosuyla 4 kıtada güvenilir ve temiz elektrik üretirken dünya genelinde 10 bini aşkın kişiye istihdam alanı sağlamaktadır. Powership™ filosunu, uluslararası markası Karpowership altında yöneten Karadeniz Holding; Avrupa, Afrika, Amerika ve Asya kıtalarında faaliyet gösterdiği ülkelerin %10- %100 oranındaki elektrik ihtiyacını karşılamaktadır. Powership™, kara elektrik santralleri ve aynı zamanda yüzen LNG altyapısının dahil olduğu yüksek kapasiteli enerji çözümleriyle, Karpowership ülkelere ve şirketlere enerji geçişi süreçlerinde yardımcı olmaktadır. Genel merkezimizde, Teknik Satış ve Koordinasyon departmanımızda görevlendirilmek üzere “Mühendislik Müdürü, Güç Üretimi ve Döner Ekipman Sistemleri” arayışımız bulunmaktadır. NELER BEKLİYORUZ? Makine Mühendisliği alanında lisans veya yüksek lisans derecesine sahip olmak. Enerji üretimi, güç santralleri veya ilgili mühendislik alanlarında en az 8 yıl profesyonel deneyime sahip olmak. Gaz türbinli enerji santralleri (OCGT/CCGT), büyük ölçekli gaz/dizel motorlu enerji santralleri veya endüstriyel güç üretim tesislerinin mühendislik, kurulum, devreye alma ya da işletme ve bakım (O&M) süreçlerinde deneyim sahibi olmak. Ana güç üretim ekipmanlarının yakıt besleme, yağlama, soğutma, hava emiş ve egzoz gibi yardımcı sistemlerle mekanik entegrasyonu konusunda bilgi sahibi olmak. Teknik şartnamelerin hazırlanması, üretici ve tedarikçi tekliflerinin teknik değerlendirilmesi ve ekipman seçim süreçlerinde deneyim sahibi olmak. Mekanik sistemlerin tasarım, montaj, kurulum ve devreye alma süreçlerinin teknik gerekliliklere uygunluğunu değerlendirebilmek. Mekanik arıza analizi, kök neden incelemesi, teknik problem çözme ve sistem performansını iyileştirme konularında deneyim sahibi olmak. Ekipman güvenilirliği, bakım yapılabilirlik, ekipman ömrü ve operasyonel performansın değerlendirilmesi konularında bilgi sahibi olmak. İlgili mühendislik disiplinleri, proje ekipleri, saha ekipleri, OEM ve O&M organizasyonları ile teknik koordinasyon sağlayabilmek. İleri seviyede İngilizce bilgisine sahip olmak. MS Office programlarını ve AutoCAD'i etkin şekilde kullanabilmek; tercihen Thermoflow bilgisine sahip olmak. Yurtiçi ve yurtdışı seyahat engeli bulunmamak. SİZİ NELER BEKLİYOR? Powership, Non-Powership ve FSRU projelerinde kullanılan gaz türbinleri, büyük ölçekli gaz/dizel motorları ve ilgili döner ekipmanların fizibilite, teknik değerlendirme, ekipman seçimi ve mühendislik süreçlerini yönetmek. Yeni proje ve yatırım fırsatlarının fizibilite ve konsept geliştirme aşamalarında ana güç üretim ekipmanlarının teknik uygunluğunu, kapasite ve performans özelliklerini değerlendirmek. Ana güç üretim ekipmanlarının yakıt besleme, yağlama, soğutma, hava emiş ve egzoz sistemleriyle mekanik entegrasyonunu değerlendirmek ve ilgili mühendislik disiplinleri arasındaki teknik koordinasyonu sağlamak. Gaz türbinleri, motorlar ve ilgili döner ekipmanların satın alma süreçlerinde teknik şartnamelerin hazırlanmasını, üretici ve tedarikçi tekliflerinin değerlendirilmesini ve ekipman seçim süreçlerini yönetmek. İş geliştirme ve teklif hazırlık süreçlerinde ana güç üretim ekipmanları ve mekanik sistemlere ilişkin teknik kapsamı, ekipman gereksinimlerini, tasarım varsayımlarını ve teknik riskleri belirlemek. Kurulum, montaj, devreye alma ve işletme süreçlerinde ortaya çıkan mekanik problemlerin değerlendirilmesini, arıza analizlerinin ve kök neden incelemelerinin yapılmasını koordine etmek. Ana makinelerin ve ilgili mekanik sistemlerin kurulum, montaj ve entegrasyon süreçlerinin teknik gerekliliklere uygunluğunu takip etmek; proje, saha ve OEM ekipleriyle koordinasyonu sağlamak. Ekipmanların mekanik özellikleri, performans gereksinimleri, bakım ihtiyaçları ve teknik sınırlamaları doğrultusunda sözleşme ve teknik şartnameleri değerlendirmek; teknik yükümlülüklerin ve üretici garantilerinin proje gereksinimleriyle uyumunu kontrol etmek. Mevcut tesislerde kullanılan gaz türbinleri, motorlar ve döner ekipmanların güvenilirlik, bakım yapılabilirlik, ekipman ömrü ve operasyonel performanslarını değerlendirmek; iyileştirme, rehabilitasyon ve modernizasyon çalışmalarına teknik liderlik etmek. Teklif aşamasında belirlenen teknik kapsamın, ekipman seçimlerinin, tasarım esaslarının ve mühendislik varsayımlarının uygulama ekiplerine doğru şekilde aktarılmasını sağlamak ve proje devir (handover) süreçlerini yönetmek. Sorumluluğundaki departmanın insan kaynağı, bütçe, ekipman ve zaman gibi kaynaklarını etkin şekilde yönetmek; ekip hedeflerini belirlemek, performans ve gelişim süreçlerini yürütmek. Diğer departmanlar, uluslararası proje ekipleri, üreticiler, tedarikçiler ve diğer dış paydaşlarla iş birliği ve koordinasyonu sağlamak; görev alanındaki risk yönetimi, kalite, çevre ve iş sağlığı ve güvenliği süreçlerinin şirket standartlarına uygun yürütülmesini desteklemek. SİZE NELER SUNUYORUZ? Hibrit çalışma imkanı. Doğum gününde 1 gün izin hakkı. Kapsamlı Özel Sağlık Sigortası. Mesleki ve kişisel eğitim & gelişim fırsatları. Çalışanlara özel indirim ve kampanyalar. Çalışma arkadaşlarımız, adaylarımız ve tüm paydaşlarımızla “Tek Dünya” felsefemiz doğrultusunda başarılarımıza başarı katıyoruz. İlanlarımıza başvuru yapan tüm adaylarımıza ırk, din, dil, cinsiyet gözetmeksizin fırsat eşitliği sağlamayı ilke edinerek; farklılıklarımızla başarılarımızı taçlandırıyoruz. 6698 sayılı Kişisel Verilerin Korunması Kanunu kapsamında, kişisel verilerinizin işlenmesine ilişkin detaylı bilgi almak için lütfen Kişisel Verilerin İşlenmesine İlişkin Aydınlatma Metni'ni inceleyiniz.

title: Teknik Ressam

İŞ TANIMI ve SORUMLULUKLAR Monopomp (progressive cavity pump), esnek pervaneli pompa ve diğer endüstriyel pompa sistemlerinin üç boyutlu modellerini oluşturmak, Rotor, stator, pompa gövdesi, mil, flanş, kaplin, bağlantı ve sızdırmazlık elemanlarının teknik çizimlerini hazırlamak, Müşteri ihtiyaçlarına ve onaylanmış mühendislik kriterlerine göre pompa tasarımlarını uyarlamak, Parça, alt montaj ve komple ürün seviyesinde teknik resimler hazırlamak, Patlatılmış montaj resimleri (exploded view), kesit görünümleri ve montaj detaylarını oluşturmak, Çok seviyeli ürün ağaçlarını (BOM) ve malzeme listelerini hazırlamak, Ürün konfigürasyonlarını, standart parçaları ve ürün varyantlarını yönetmek, Teknik resimlerin üretilebilirlik ve monte edilebilirlik açısından kontrollerini gerçekleştirmek, Mevcut ürünlerin tasarım revizyonlarını ve iyileştirme çalışmalarını yürütmek, Teknik dokümanların kodlama, arşivleme ve revizyon süreçlerini takip etmek, ERP sistemindeki ürün kartları ve ürün reçetelerinin oluşturulmasına sağlamak, Planlama, üretim, kalite kontrol, satın alma ve satış ekipleriyle koordineli çalışmak, Prototip üretimi, montaj ve ürün test çalışmalarına teknik destek vermek. title: Modules Design Technician
description: Webasto is an international systems partner to the mobility industry focused on two business areas: Roof and Electrification. With more than 50 locations, the company is represented in all major automotive markets worldwide. Customers profit from the innovative strength, decades of experience and the global network of Webasto. The family owned top 100 automotive supplier aims to shape the individual mobility more enjoyable and climate friendlier. We are looking for a Modules Engineer Technician to join our Engineering Department. Main Tasks Support the design and product development of mechanical parts, components, and assemblies in line with customer, project, and engineering requirements. Detail 3D part and assembly models based on concepts, draft designs, and technical inputs created by Design Engineers, convert them into manufacturable designs, and prepare the related 2D technical drawings. Develop part and assembly designs considering sheet metal, plastic, machining, and similar manufacturing processes, with attention to assembly, packaging, interfaces, clearances, accessibility, and manufacturability. Support the integration and design of compressors and related mechanical components used in HVAC systems. This includes components such as brackets, fasteners, pulleys, belts, and tensioning systems for engine-driven applications, as well as compressor mounting, mechanical interfaces, packaging, and related unit components for electric compressor applications. Perform the required 3D/2D design and technical documentation updates within product development, product improvement, cost reduction, localization, standardization, and Engineering Change activities. Support the resolution of manufacturing, assembly, and quality-related issues arising during prototype, first-build, and serial production phases, and implement the required design revisions. Support the accurate and up-to-date management of BOMs, CAD data, technical drawings, revisions, and related engineering information in accordance with company standards in PDM/PLM systems. Work closely with Production, Quality, Purchasing, Suppliers, and relevant Engineering teams to ensure that designs are correctly and efficiently transferred into production. Skills & Qualifications Graduate of an associate degree or relevant technical education program such as Mechanical Drafting and Construction, Mechanical Technology, Mechatronics, Computer-Aided Design, Manufacturing Technologies, or a similar field. Preferably experienced in mechanical design, technical drafting, product development, manufacturing, or a similar area; newly graduated candidates with strong CAD skills may also be considered. Knowledge and practical skills in 3D CAD modeling and preparation of 2D technical drawings. Experience with Autodesk Inventor and/or CATIA / 3DEXPERIENCE is preferred. Basic knowledge of technical drawing, dimensioning, tolerancing, and GD&T principles. Basic understanding of part and assembly design, manufacturability, interfaces, and packaging checks. Knowledge of basic manufacturing processes such as sheet metal, machining, and plastic part production. Knowledge of basic machine elements such as mechanical connections, brackets, shafts, bearings, pulley-belt systems, and motor/compressor connections is preferred. Knowledge of PDM/PLM, BOM, revision management, and Engineering Change processes is preferred. Willingness to investigate technical issues in the production environment, perform basic measurements, and contribute to practical solutions. Strong attention to detail and accuracy in technical drawings and product data, with a systematic and disciplined working approach. Good analytical and practical thinking, problem-solving, and follow-up skills. Strong teamwork and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively with different departments. Willingness to learn new CAD, PLM, and engineering tools and to continuously improve technical skills. At least a basic level of English, with the willingness and ability to improve to a level sufficient for understanding technical documents and communicating in a global working environment.
