title: Manufacturing Engineering Supervisor
description: What You Will Do As a Manufacturing Engineering Supervisor, you will lead the manufacturing engineering team to drive operational excellence, continuous improvement, and production efficiency within our Izmir manufacturing facility. You will play a key role in optimizing manufacturing processes, supporting new product introductions, and ensuring world-class standards in quality, safety, productivity, and cost performance. Key Responsibilities Include Lead and develop the Manufacturing Engineering team, providing technical guidance and coaching. Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on productivity, quality, cost reduction, and process optimization. Support new product introduction (NPI) activities, ensuring smooth industrialization and production readiness. Collaborate with Production, Quality, Supply Chain, Maintenance, and EHS teams to achieve plant objectives. Analyze manufacturing performance data and implement corrective and preventive actions. Lead projects related to equipment upgrades, automation, capacity expansion, and process improvements. Ensure compliance with Johnson Controls standards, customer requirements, and applicable regulations. Support Lean Manufacturing and Operational Excellence initiatives across the facility. Manage manufacturing engineering resources, priorities, budgets, and project timelines. How You Will Do It Utilize Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement methodologies to enhance operational performance. Partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders to identify opportunities and implement sustainable solutions. Apply data-driven decision-making to improve process capability, efficiency, and product quality. Develop and maintain manufacturing documentation, work instructions, process flows, and engineering standards. Lead root cause analysis activities and drive timely resolution of manufacturing issues. Foster a culture of safety, accountability, collaboration, and innovation within the team. Support digitalization and automation projects to strengthen manufacturing competitiveness. Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and ensure actions are taken to achieve operational targets. What We Look For Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of manufacturing engineering experience within a production environment. Previous experience leading engineering teams or supervising technical professionals. Strong knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Continuous Improvement, Kaizen, 5S, and problem-solving methodologies. Experience with process optimization, industrialization, automation, and production systems. Strong project management and cross-functional collaboration skills. Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities. Effective communication skills in both Turkish and English. Proficiency in ERP systems and Microsoft Office tools. Experience in HVAC, building technologies, industrial manufacturing, or engineered products environments is considered an advantage. What We Offer Opportunity to join a global leader in smart buildings, HVAC, fire, and security solutions. Challenging and rewarding career opportunities in an international environment. Continuous learning and professional development programs. Collaborative and inclusive company culture. Competitive salary and benefits package. At Johnson Controls, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where employees can thrive, innovate, and make a meaningful impact. If you are passionate about manufacturing excellence and leading high-performing teams, we would love to hear from you.

title: Engineer Process & Project
description: Location: Alipasa Tesis At Sibelco, we advance life through materials. For over 150 years, we’ve been a trusted leader in sourcing, transforming, and distributing specialty industrial minerals. Our work powers progress across industries as diverse as glass, ceramics, construction, coatings, polymers, and water purification. Beyond our materials, we’re proud of our commitment to sustainability, innovation, and empowering people from all walks of life to thrive and make a meaningful impact. Are We the Perfect Match? At Sibelco, we believe building a successful career is a two-way journey. We’re looking for individuals who share our values and vision, just as much as you’re seeking a company that aligns with your aspirations. Together, we can shape the future. Job Description: Your Impact As a Process & Project Engineer, you will play a key role in optimizing plant performance while driving process improvement and capital project initiatives across the operation. By combining technical expertise, data-driven decision-making and project execution capabilities, you will help improve efficiency, reliability, quality and sustainability while supporting the successful delivery of operational and investment projects. In the Role, Your Responsibilities Will Include, but Are Not Limited To: Monitor, analyze and optimize key process performance indicators, including throughput, recovery, yield, OEE, product quality and energy consumption, identifying opportunities to improve operational efficiency and plant performance. Provide technical support to production, maintenance and quality teams, leading troubleshooting activities and root cause analyses to resolve process-related issues and improve process reliability. Develop and maintain process standards, procedures and technical documentation while leveraging operational data to identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities. Lead and support Operational Excellence initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma and structured problem-solving methodologies to improve productivity, quality, cost efficiency and waste reduction. Manage and support process improvement, process development and debottlenecking initiatives, including the planning, execution and evaluation of laboratory, pilot-scale and industrial trials. Support CAPEX projects from concept development through commissioning and performance validation, preparing process calculations, technical specifications and technical-economic evaluations while coordinating internal and external stakeholders. Promote a culture of continuous improvement, operational excellence and data-driven decision-making across the operation. Ensure compliance with Health, Safety, Environment and Quality standards, integrating sustainability, energy efficiency and safe design principles into process and project activities. What You Bring to the Table Degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering or a related engineering discipline. Experience in process optimization, operational support and industrial project execution. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate operational data into practical improvement initiatives. Experience applying continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma and structured root cause analysis. Knowledge of process engineering fundamentals, including process calculations, technical documentation and performance monitoring. Experience supporting or leading CAPEX projects through engineering, implementation, commissioning and performance validation phases. Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and work effectively across production, maintenance, quality and engineering teams. Strong project management, communication and organizational skills. Commitment to health, safety, environmental and sustainability standards. Employee Type: Permanent Why Join Us? Sibelco is more than a workplace—it’s a community that encourages growth, innovation, and collaboration. Here’s what you can look forward to when you join our team: Meet Our People: Careers Learn About Our Recruitment Process: Learn More Discover Our Sustainability Goals: Sibelco priorities We also welcome applications from all backgrounds and are committed to providing reasonable adjustments to support you through the selection process. How To Apply Follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Twitter/X and Facebook to learn more about life at Sibelco. Submit your application in the Apply option. Please note: We do not require agency services as we have a dedicated Global Talent Acquisition Team.

title: Modules Engineer Design-PDM
description: Webasto is an international systems partner to the mobility industry focused on two business areas: Roof and Electrification. With more than 50 locations, the company is represented in all major automotive markets worldwide. Customers profit from the innovative strength, decades of experience and the global network of Webasto. The family owned top 100 automotive supplier aims to shape the individual mobility more enjoyable and climate friendlier. We are looking for a Modules Engineer Design-PDM to join our Engineering Department. Main Tasks Create, maintain and control part numbers, engineering master data and related technical product information in PDM/PLM and ERP systems. Ensure that product data such as part descriptions, classifications, materials, weights, technical attributes and other related information are complete, accurate and consistent. Maintain CAD files, technical drawings and engineering documents in PDM/PLM systems and manage their revision, lifecycle and release status according to defined engineering processes. Support Engineering Change processes by initiating and following required revisions, lifecycle changes, document updates and related system actions until completion. Create and maintain BOM structures and ensure consistency between part numbers, BOMs, technical documents and product master data. Monitor and maintain data consistency between PDM/PLM, ERP and other engineering systems. Identify missing, incorrect, duplicate or inconsistent engineering data and coordinate the necessary corrective actions with relevant teams. Support product classification, engineering document structures and technical data standards. Work closely with Design Engineers, System Engineers, Manufacturing, Quality, Purchasing and other related departments during product release and Engineering Change processes. Support data cleansing, data migration and PDM/PLM system improvement activities. Contribute to the standardization and continuous improvement of engineering data management and PDM/PLM processes. Monitor data quality and process performance and prepare relevant reports when required. Skills & Qualifications Graduate of a vocational school, associate degree or relevant technical education program; a bachelor's degree is not mandatory. Preferably experienced in PDM/PLM, engineering master data, BOM management, part number management, technical documentation or similar activities. Knowledge or experience with PDM/PLM systems such as Windchill, 3DEXPERIENCE, Teamcenter or similar systems is preferred. Knowledge of ERP systems such as SAP, M3 or similar systems is an advantage. Basic understanding of engineering product structures, BOMs, part numbers, revisions, technical drawings and engineering documents. Knowledge of revision, release, lifecycle and Engineering Change processes is preferred. Strong computer skills and ability to quickly learn and effectively use different engineering and enterprise software systems. Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly MS Excel. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy when working with technical data. Systematic, disciplined and well-organized working approach. Strong follow-up skills and ability to track open actions until completion. Good analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. Strong communication and coordination skills with the ability to work effectively across different departments. Good command of written and spoken English for working with global teams and technical documentation.

title: Product Engineer - New Apps & Agents
description: About Sociaaal Sociaaal is the AI operator for consumer software. We use frontier technology to buy apps, build AI agents, and turn them into great businesses. We currently own a fast-growing portfolio of 20 apps and agents. As software becomes increasingly easy to build, monetization and distribution become the real competitive advantages. The results speak for themselves: $16M in annualized revenue, 7 apps scaling, 91% growth in 2025, positive EBITDA, on only $1M in equity raised. We're a lean, seriously ambitious team operating fully remotely, with regular in-person meetups around the world. The Role As Product Engineer, you'll own our new apps and agents lane: launching new consumer subscription software assets at a weekly cadence on top of our agentic build system, the machine that builds the machines. Working hand in hand with our product and tech leads, you'll take each app or agent from the first idea to a shipped MVP, then iterate on what the data says. In your first 7 days, you'll ship your first app or agent on the machine and make one part of it better. What You'll Own New app and agent launches : spot new opportunities and turn them into quality MVPs fast, building with AI coding agents. The machine : build every app and agent inside our shared system and keep improving it, so each launch is faster and better than the last. Iteration & growth : read early performance data with our data and UA teams, ship updates and new features, and decide what to iterate, scale or kill. Who We're Looking For Product first : you think from the user's side. UX and interface design are your craft. Engineer by training (required) : a degree in engineering, computer science or a similar technical field. You're structured, rigorous and systematic, you read and review code (Git and GitHub), and you can hold your own in a technical discussion with our CTO. Proven consumer builder (required) : you have built and shipped apps or digital products used by real customers, with failures and some successes. You know distribution (App Store, Google Play or web), analytics and SDKs. Having launched your own apps or startup is a strong plus. AI-fluent, non-negotiable : you build every day with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar) and know how to brief, review and correct them. Taste & pragmatism : a high bar for what ships, from onboarding to UI. Beautiful code is nice, but what matters iswhether users want it. Ownership & systems thinking : you ship, measure and decide, challenge the team when something looks wrong, and bring problems with a solution attached. What We Offer Ownership of a new lane from day one, with a path to build and lead your own team as it grows. What most indie builders lack: a team that masters distribution, UA and data behind every app and agent you ship. Competitive package, fully remote, with minimal bureaucracy. We're looking for a builder, not just a coder. Someone with taste and method who loves the machine as much as the apps and agents it ships. Reach out at talent@sociaaal.com . Send us your CV, links to 1-3 apps or agents you've built, and a one-line note on why you're made for this role.

product filling—are conducted in accordance with R&D methodologies and quality procedures Monitor production performance indicators, analyze deviations, and take corrective actions Coordinate title: Senior Data Center Design Engineer
description: ­Led by an experienced management team and supported by a strong investor group, including large and experienced institutions and strategic partners, EdgeConneX offers a dynamic, fast-paced work environment where we are bringing flexibility, proximity, power, and connectivity to some of the world’s key businesses. With major offices in Herndon, Denver, Amsterdam, Singapore and Malaysia, we have a global footprint and a unified team of employees committed to providing a premier customer experience and delivering the full spectrum of data center solutions, from core to edge, like no other data center provider can do. Focused on driving innovation and helping our customers define and deliver their own unique vision for the Edge, at any scale, in any market worldwide, for any requirement, we are building tomorrow’s data center infrastructure, today for some of the world’s most demanding Network, Content, and Cloud customers. EdgeConneX is seeking a technically accomplished, delivery-oriented mechanical engineer to serve as Senior Data Center Design Engineer for EMEA within the Global Design & Engineering (GD&E) organization. This role is the senior regional mechanical authority, accountable for the integrity of mechanical design and equipment validation across a portfolio of assigned campuses. The role also serves as GD&E's designated mechanical engineering interface across the broader EdgeConneX organization. GD&E delivers safe, reliable, and cost-effective data center infrastructure by setting world-class design standards, driving disciplined program execution, and partnering seamlessly with internal teams and an external execution partner. Within GD&E, the Senior Mechanical Engineer sits within the EMEA regional pillar and is supported by the Principal Mechanical Engineer in Technical Strategy & Architecture, who owns the global mechanical architecture and standards. The Senior Data Center Design Engineer ensures that this architecture becomes validated, commissioned, critical infrastructure in the field. The ideal candidate is first and foremost a mechanical engineer with data center or critical-infrastructure experience and practical expertise in HVAC systems, including both air and liquid cooling technologies. Key Responsibilities Serve as the senior mechanical discipline authority across the portfolio of assigned campuses in EMEA, ensuring that mechanical designs and installations conform to the standards, guidelines, and templates established by Global Technical Strategy & Architecture. Engage at the milestones where deep HVAC expertise matters most, including design reviews, submittal and RFI resolution for critical mechanical scope, factory acceptance tests (FAT), and commissioning-readiness assessments. Hold the technical position on mechanical readiness by validating that systems are ready before each phase proceeds, while supporting the TPM/DM site team rather than working in parallel with it. Identify where site-specific constraints or customer requirements require a departure from the global standard, and route deviations through the established Technical Strategy & Architecture approval process. Provide informal technical leadership and mentoring to regional SMEs, improving the consistency and rigor of design reviews across the EMEA portfolio. Review and challenge mechanical engineering deliverables produced by the execution partner, including equipment specifications, design parameters, HVAC and piping designs, control narratives, and CFD analyses, for conformance with GD&E standards and sound engineering practice. Validate that customer-specific mechanical requirements are correctly captured in the design and reconciled with the EdgeConneX standard, escalating conflicts through the deviation process rather than resolving them informally. Feed field and commissioning lessons learned back to the Principal Mechanical Engineer so that the global mechanical standard improves with every campus delivered. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or similar required; master's degree preferred. Professional engineering credentials and relevant data center certifications, such as CDCP or ATD (Accredited Tier Designer), are valued. Experience Minimum 10 years of progressive mechanical engineering experience in data centers or mission-critical infrastructure, spanning design, construction support, and commissioning, with a track record of owning mechanical outcomes on delivered facilities. Demonstrated experience on hyperscale or Tier III+ data center projects, including hands-on involvement in design reviews, factory acceptance testing, commissioning, and readiness assessments. Meaningful experience with liquid-cooling technologies and large-scale chilled-water cooling systems. Familiar with the typical electrical equipment in a data center like generators, MV-transformers electrical distribution and UPS-Systems. Experience working with or alongside execution-partner engineering teams, driving quality and standards of adherence through influence within an integrated team. Solid understanding of commissioning methodology for mechanical systems, from individual equipment startup and functional testing through Integrated Systems Testing (IST), including readiness criteria and failure-mode validation. Clear, concise communication, with the credibility to make a ‘not ready’ call on a mechanical system or commissioning plan and support it with evidence and a recovery path. Sound field judgment, including knowing when to resolve an issue directly, when to engage the Principal Mechanical Engineer, and when to escalate through the TPM/DM site team. Travel Significant travel required (25–40%) across assigned campuses in EMEA and vendor facilities for factory acceptance testing, concentrated around design reviews, equipment validation, and commissioning windows, sometimes on short notice.

The role includes responsibility for mechanical development in both new product initiatives and improvements to the global installed base. You will be part of a multidisciplinary Hardware Engineering team of approximately 20 engineers, including a growing mechanical design group of eight engineers. Implement engineering changes for products in the installed base, considering robustness, compatibility, and serviceability. Knowledge of materials, manufacturing processes, and design for reliability and service life. Experience with engineering changes, installed base products, or PLM systems such as PTC Windchill or MyWorkshop is an advantage. Experience with vacuum technology, cooling systems, pressure-containing components, or precision assemblies is an advantage. Familiarity with risk management and regulated product development is an advantage. Experience with simulation tools such as ANSYS (FEA and/or CFD) is an advantage. Ability to take ownership of assigned work, collaborate across disciplines, and seek support when needed. Opstellen en beheren van technische documentatie, revisietekeningen en productspecificaties met toepassing van PLM/PDM-systemen. Communiceren en afstemmen met opdrachtgevers, leveranciers en interne disciplines om projecten conform planning en specificatie op te leveren. title: Lead Aerospace Engineer - Sonic Labs
description: Lead Aerospace Engineer – Sonic Labs Aerlijn B.V. | Amsterdam, on-site | Full-time, Dutch employment contract | Leads a team of 5 engineers Aerlijn is building Europe's strongest integrated air defence company. We build guidance, control, and interceptor systems that let us hit targets at supersonic speeds. Sonic Labs is our internal R&D unit. It builds the products and technologies we need and that no one in our supply chain makes yet - sensor, compute and communications systems that combine hardware, firmware and software - and takes them from concept through prototype to demonstration with real users. The Lead Aerospace Engineer in Sonic Labs owns the aircraft: the airframe, the propulsion, the aerodynamics and the flight control that make those products fly. This is a hands-on lead role in a small team. You design a complete drone from a blank sheet, and you run the engineers who build it with you. On one programme you'll be integrating a small jet engine into an airframe - intake, exhaust, fuel, thermal and the control system that keeps it stable. On another, designing a quadcopter that flies at 700+ km/h while carrying a payload, to set a new world speed record. On a third, designing a drone around autonomy: the sensors, compute and flight-control architecture that let it fly its mission without a pilot. You'll sit next to the hardware and embedded engineers and be at the flight tests when the aircraft has to fly. What you'll do Design the aircraft. Own the full design from requirements to first flight - configuration, sizing, weight and balance, structure, propulsion and avionics layout - and make the trade-offs between speed, range, payload and cost. Get the aerodynamics right. Run the aero from first estimates to CFD and wind-tunnel or flight data - drag, lift, propeller and intake performance, stability - and design the shapes that come out of it. Integrate propulsion. Select and integrate electric drivetrains and small turbojets: motors, ESCs, propellers, batteries, fuel systems and thermal management, matched to the mission. Own flight control. Model the vehicle dynamics, tune and extend the autopilot (PX4 or ArduPilot), design the control laws for high-speed and jet-powered flight, and prove them in simulation before they fly. Simulate before you build. Build and run the simulation chain - aero models, 6-DOF flight dynamics, software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop - so every flight test answers a question. Lead the team. Run a small team of engineers: set the technical direction, split the work, review designs, unblock people and hire the next engineers. Own a work package. Take a sub-system from the programme plan, scope it with the Head of R&D, estimate it, build it, test it and integrate it on the milestone date. Run flight tests. Plan and lead tests and data analysis - keep the aircraft flying under real conditions and feed what breaks back into the next revision. Prepare for production. Keep bills of materials sourceable, drawings and test procedures complete and design files in order, so that a manufacturer can take the product over and build it at scale. Raise the bar. Review others' designs, share what you learn, and help onboard the engineers who join after you. What you'll bring A degree in aerospace or mechanical engineering, or a closely related discipline - or an equivalent track record of aircraft you have designed, built and flown. 5+ years designing and building UAVs or other aircraft, including at least one drone you took from a blank sheet to flight, and experience leading engineers. Strong aerodynamics: you can size a wing or a rotor by hand, then check it in CFD (ANSYS Fluent, STAR-CCM+, OpenFOAM or similar) and lower-order tools (XFLR5, OpenVSP, AVL or similar). Flight dynamics and control: system identification, control-loop design and tuning, in MATLAB/Simulink or Python. Hands-on with autopilots: PX4 or ArduPilot - parameters, tuning, logs, and changes to the flight stack itself. Fluent in a mechanical CAD tool (SolidWorks, CATIA, NX, Fusion or similar), and experience with structural analysis (FEA) and composite or carbon-fibre structures. A builder's mindset: you prefer a flying prototype this week to a complete design next month, and you have crashed an aircraft, found out why and fixed it. Clear, direct communication in English, written and spoken, with engineers and non-engineers. Willingness to travel within Europe for trials and demonstrations, with occasional travel to the US. Right to work in the EU, and eligibility for a national security clearance in at least one of our operating countries. Nice to have We operate our business in English. Knowledge of a European language other than English is beneficial. Ukrainian preferred. Small turbojet or turbine integration (JetCat, Kingtech or similar), fuel systems and engine control. High-speed or transonic aerodynamics, and design for high-G loads and vibration. High-performance electric propulsion: motor and propeller design, high-current battery packs, thermal limits. Simulation environments for autonomy: Gazebo, AirSim, JSBSim or similar, and ROS 2. Guidance, navigation and state estimation: Kalman filters, GNSS-denied navigation, sensor fusion. Wind-tunnel testing, instrumented flight testing and telemetry analysis. Airworthiness and operations: EASA specific category, SORA, permits to fly, test-range work. A competition or record-attempt background - drone racing, Formula Student, rocketry, or a record you set. Exposure to defence, aerospace, automotive or another domain with qualification requirements. Time at a drone or aerospace start-up, or a research lab where you built a flying aircraft with a small team. An existing national security clearance. What we offer A salary that matches what you build, not where you studied. We pay at the top of the Dutch engineering market and review it every year against what you've shipped. Dutch employment contract. 8% holiday allowance. Travel allow

Strong background in electromagnetic theory, radar signal propagation, Fourier analysis, and SAR principles. Experience in the design, development and verification of synthetic aperture radars, radar altimeters, scatterometers, radiometers or real aperture radars (weather radars and ground-penetrating radars). Familiarity with RF components, FPGA/ASIC architectures, and high-reliability PCB design standards. General background and specific experience in the technical domains covered by the position, supporting remote sensing system development, integration and test. Experience in the development and verification of space hardware, with at least four years of professional experience in the technical domains. Understanding of related technologies, R&D trends and the industrial landscape. Experience in the management and monitoring of industrial activities, including participation in reviews. A very good knowledge of modern computer systems, simulation, modelling tools and programming languages. Good knowledge of digital signal processing (DSP) with good MATLAB skills for algorithm development, modelling, simulation including filtering, spectral analysis, FFTs, modulation, sampling theory, and noise reduction. Passion for UAVs; an A1/A3 drone pilot license is a plus. Mission-focused, resilient, with a research-to-deployment mindset. title: Ingénieur calcul de structure - Navires H/F
description: Montez à bord et venez découvrir l'univers de Chantiers de l'Atlantique, acteur incontournable de l'industrie maritime mondiale. Basé à Saint-Nazaire, au bord de l'Océan Atlantique, notre site industriel d'une centaine d'hectares, regroupe quotidiennement jusqu'à 10 000 personnes : nos 4 000 collaborateurs ainsi que notre réseau de coréalisateurs, fournisseurs, clients et autres partenaires. Ensemble, nous concevons, construisons et mettons en service des réalisations uniques. Engagé dans une démarche de progrès et sensible à la transition énergétique, nous proposons des solutions novatrices et durables afin de relever avec passion 3 défis majeurs : la construction de navires (croisière et militaires), de sous-stations électriques pour l'éolien en mer, et la prestation de services pour nos clients (remises aux normes et conformité ou encore modernisation). Embarquez pour une aventure hors norme ! Le bureau d'études Chantiers de l'Atlantique est composé d'environ 800 personnes et dispose d'un exceptionnel savoir-faire de concepteur et d'intégrateur. Dans un souci permanent de réduction de l'empreinte environnementale de ses réalisations, le bureau d'études propose des solutions innovantes à ses clients. Au sein d'une équipe projet pluridisciplinaire, vous validez la faisabilité structurelle des navires de croisière ou militaires et en réalisez le dimensionnement. Les principales missions qui vous sont confiées sont les suivantes : - Modélisation de la structure complète des navires en éléments finis avec le logiciel ANSYS Classic. - Création des cas de chargement - Création de modèle fins pour les analyses de détails - Analyse des résultats selon les critères de limite élastique, flambement et fatigue (dans le modèle global et les modèles fins) - Proposition de solutions de renforcement de la structure en collaboration avec les équipes de conception en coque métallique et en tenant compte des contraintes des autres métiers (agencement général, coordination des réseaux ...) - Rédaction des notes de calcul pour approbation de notre dimensionnement par l'armateur et/ou la société de classification. Vous intervenez tout au long des études, aussi bien dans le cadre de projet de prototypes neufs, d'avant-projets, de R&D ou de rénovation des navires. Nous sommes convaincus que vos compétences, votre engagement et votre épanouissement sont au coeur de notre performance ! Vous avez un profil d'ingénieur ou Master II en mécanique des structures ou architecture navale. Vous avez une bonne maitrise en calculs de structure (RDM), matériaux métalliques et une expérience dans l'utilisation d'au moins un outil de simulation numérique mécanique (ANSYS Classic ou équivalent) Vous possédez des connaissances en CAO et en programmation de macros (idéalement APDL et VBA). Vous êtes à l'aise en Anglais. Vous avez une grande rigueur, un esprit de synthèse et un bon relationnel. En venant chez nous, c'est aussi : - Avoir de belles opportunités de carrière et une multitude de trajectoires professionnelles, - Disposer de nombreux avantages comme par exemple : RTT, prévoyance/ mutuelle familiale (prise en charge à 60% par l'employeur), restaurant d'entreprise avec participation de l'employeur, CSE : chèques vacances, loisirs, voyages, associations sportives, médiathèque gratuite... - La possibilité de bénéficier jusqu'à 6 jours de télétravail par mois (si votre fonction le permet) - Une rémunération sur 13 mois, un accord intéressement et participation , une négociation annuelle obligatoire chaque année - Une excellente situation géographique : proche de l'océan, gare SNCF et lignes de bus à proximité - Intégrer une entreprise attachée à la diversité, notamment à travers notre démarche les Elles de l'Atlantique qui promeut la mixité au sein de l'entreprise. Parce que la mer est notre avenir et bientôt le vôtre ! Notre process de recrutement - Chantiers de l'Atlantique (chantiers-atlantique.com) Ref : 31741054

Lead process quality across metal fabrication: cast resin, sheet metal (punching, laser cutting, bending), welding (manual and stud), paint line (washing, drying, painting), CNC machining and coating. Lead, coach and develop the Team Leader and seven quality operators; set standard work, shift coverage, competence plans and daily quality discipline. Develop and maintain PFMEA, control plans, inspection instructions and control frequencies for all metal fabrication processes. Manage PPAP (in line with NPI Engineer) and first-piece approval for on-site parts; manage drawing and revision changes and release first production approval. Run MSA, SPC and process capability studies (Cp, Cpk) for key and special characteristics; validate inspection methods and gauges. Control special processes: weld quality, welder qualification and procedures; paint and coating thickness, adhesion, coverage and chemical bath checks. Lead root cause analysis and permanent corrective actions with 8D, 5 Why and A3 for internal nonconformities, scrap, rework and customer complaints on fabricated parts. Drive down scrap, rework, CONC and PPM, and improve first-pass yield (FPY) with data-driven decisions; support MRB decisions. Plan and publish process audits, layered process audits and audit reports; follow up on findings to closure (EQS, ISO 9001, IATF 16949). Work closely with Production, Manufacturing Engineering, Product Engineering, Maintenance and Supplier Quality to stabilize processes and prevent recurrence. Review new and changed fabricated parts for manufacturability and inspectability together with Engineering. Train operators and production staff on drawing reading, inspection methods and process requirements; escalate quality issues to front-line leaders. Monitor chemical process analyses and consumable usage in the paint and coating lines within the scope of 5S. Support cost-out, Lean and Six Sigma projects from a quality perspective. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Metallurgical and Materials Engineering or Industrial Engineering (or equivalent) Min 5 years of experience in manufacturing process quality, in a mass-production environment (automotive, white goods or heavy fabrication preferred). Hands-on experience in at least three of: sheet metal, welding, painting/powder coating, CNC machining, coating/plating. Proven experience leading a shop-floor quality team. Skills Strong knowledge of metal materials and their behavior (steel, stainless steel, aluminum, galvanized, copper): mechanical properties, corrosion, welding and surface treatment. High level of technical drawing and GD&T reading skills. Advanced use of PFMEA, control plans, APQP, PPAP, MSA, SPC (Minitab) and 8D/A3/5 Why. Knowledge of IATF 16949 and ISO 9001. Good knowledge of special process controls (welding, painting, coating; AIAG CQI-11/12/15 or equivalent). Preferred: Six Sigma Green Belt or higher, welding inspection certification (e.g., IWI/CWI), familiarity with ISO 3834 and EN ISO 9606. Strong analytical thinking and structured problem solving. Team leadership and coaching skills. Strong communication and influencing skills in a matrix organization. Hands-on, shop-floor presence with high ownership. C1 Fluent English (written and spoken). Available to come to the plant on weekends sometimes.

description: Job Description Summary Advanced Lead Materials Application Engineer provides materials expertise and technical leadership for multiple material systems across a variety of components. The focus of this role is the development and application of metallic materials and processes across a variety of aviation components within the supply chain and services. In this role, you will work with new products and legacy teams to solve complex technical problems. You will also work with external parties on both industry and universities to develop and execute concepts matching short-term and some long-term business goals and strategies. The role requires horizontal partnership with design, sourcing, services and quality to ensure robust technical and organizational solutions for the internal and external customers. Job Description Site Overview: GE Aerospace has an advanced engineering center located in İstanbul, Kartal, complemented by cutting-edge laboratories in Gebze, Kocaeli. Our offices in İstanbul and Ankara provide essential support to commercial and defense engines across the country. Our highly skilled engineers at the Türkiye Technology Center contribute to GE Aerospace’s engineering work on indigenous programs, new engine programs, software development, and additive manufacturing, supporting the country’s position as an advanced aerospace hub. We are committed to a culture based on respect for people and provide professional growth opportunities for our employees. Join us and find an opportunity to shape the future of flight. Role Overview Conceptual, or theoretical activities relating to the development, improvement, and usage of materials, coatings, and processes undertaken to build, apply, or shape the materials. Developing conceptual knowledge of professional discipline. May include support roles with specialized expertise or technical knowledge in broad area. Applies general knowledge of business developed through education or experience. Understands how work of own team contributes to the area. Resolves issues using established procedures. Consults supervisor or more senior team members for issues outside of defined instructions/parameters. Collaborates with others to solve issues. For customer facing roles, develops strong customer relationships and serves as the interface between customer and GE Aerospace. Exchanges technical information asks questions and checks for understanding. The Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate will be a highly experienced materials science engineer with deep expertise in aerospace materials development, strong knowledge of metallic materials, and a proven ability to lead cross-functional projects. Required Qualifications Bachelor of Science in Metallurgical & Materials Science Engineering At least 8 years of experience Good level of understanding on metallic materials, their physical and mechanical properties and processing. Ability to communicate clearly and effectively in writing and orally in English. Proven self-starter and independent worker who can work with cross-functional teams Fast in action but with detailed technical review and good documentation Project Management Skills related to material technologies Strong teamwork and communication skills, eager to learn continuously Preferred Qualifications Master of Science and/or PhD in Materials Science Engineering is preferred Awareness and/or experience in aerospace industry is preferred. Awareness and knowledge of aerospace materials and material testing; titanium, nickel, iron etc. based super alloys and their processing and properties is plus. Ability to coordinate several tasks/projects simultaneously, strategically prioritize work. A self-starter with an eye on problem solving and driving solutions Awareness and knowledge of manufacturing processes such as thermal spray, shot peen, chemical processes, welding, brazing, heat treatment etc. and their potential effects on material. Additional Information GE Aerospace Türkiye offers you the following: Being part of a dynamic global team Hybrid working model opportunity Flexible benefit plan Enhanced paternity leave Health insurance with wide coverage including spouse and children Fitness Benefit Life Assurance Employee Assistance Program Employee Referral Program At GE Aerospace, we have a relentless dedication to the future of safe and more sustainable flight and believe in our talented people to make it happen. title: Field Application Engineer
description: Bei TE Connectivity geben wir Ihnen Raum zur beruflichen Entfaltung, und die Möglichkeit über Länder und Kulturen hinweg mit Kollegen zusammenzuarbeiten, mit dem Ziel eine sicherere, nachhaltige, produktive und vernetzte Zukunft zu gestalten. Jobübersicht As a global technology leader in connectors, cable systems, and relays, TE Connectivity is shaping the future of demanding applications in aerospace, defense, and modern mobility. To strengthen our European team, we are looking for a dedicated Field Application Engineer (FAE) with technical expertise and a strong customer focus. Remote Office: Home-Office is your base in combination with TE Ankara Office Travel: 60% in Turkey, 5 % in Europa, 35% Office Job Working style: Independent, flexible, and closely collaborating with an international team across different TE company functions Stellenanforderungen Technical Adviser & Design-In Expert: You help customers integrate our products into their system architecture – both with existing solutions and potential new developments (e.g., via Webex or on-site). Project Activities: You actively drive new customer projects – from identifying relevant applications to developing technical specifications to system integration (e.g., in RTS, SFDC). Product Presentations & Trainings: Conducting customer trainings, webinars, and product presentations, also focusing on innovative products like PCB connectors, high-speed & high power solutions, and TE Raychem brand products. Technical Support: Customers Contact for technical questions from. Further you support AM, Sales, Distribution, Channel, PIC and BU cross related to AD&M products. Sample Organization (3D) & Prototyping: Support Business with small pre-series, demos, and product-specific demonstration materials. Technical Standards: TE products and competitive products have their own nomenclature. Converting these into a TE part number is an important task to support the sales back office in preparing quotes. Responsible Regions: Your business support is mainly needed in Turkey and working at customer’s field. Exchange with colleagues within Europe is usual. Was Sie Mitbringen Sollten High School or similar Education / Qualification. Experience in technical customer consulting and/or technical sales, ideally in the aviation, defense, or high-tech industry. Solid knowledge of electrical engineering, especially with cables, connectors, heat shrink tubing, and system architecture. Familiar with wiring diagrams, block diagrams, and system designs. Strong in communication, solution-oriented, and confident when dealing with customers. Fluently in Englisch – additional languages are welcome Craft skills (e.g., for trade show setups, product demonstrations) as well as willingness to travel to Exhibitions, Customer Tech. Days Confident handling of presentations, webinars, and digital tools. ÜBER TE CONNECTIVITY TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) ist ein weltweit führendes Industrie- und Technologieunternehmen, das eine sicherere, nachhaltige, produktive und vernetzte Zukunft ermöglicht. In einer Welt, die sich rasant weiterentwickelt, bleibt TE seinem Leitsatz treu: EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. At Saltfoss Energy we are developing a nuclear power plant concept fundamentally different from what exists today. By bringing an advanced molten salt reactor to market, we aim to make nuclear power affordable, sustainable, and safe enough to outcompete fossil fuels and revolutionize energy markets. This is what drives all of us every day: The opportunity to fight climate change and provide millions of people with clean, accessible energy. Our success depends entirely on our brilliant and passionate team. This is your chance to join a collaborative research environment where you can chart an uncommonly diverse career and help change the world. THE ROLE A substantial part of Saltfoss' R&D work requires novel experiments and customized equipment that cannot simply be bought off the shelf. To support our growing research activities and future lab expansions, we are seeking an innovative, pragmatic and hands-on Senior Laboratory Engineer to develop our experimental capabilities and ensure smooth, professional, and compliant operation of our laboratories. As our Senior Laboratory Engineer , you will play a central role, working closely with the chemists, the lab team, and our Prototyping & Validation (P&V) team. With input from our chemists, you will support the design and construction of new experimental setups, from concept and technical drawings to procurement, assembly, and commissioning. At the same time, you will play a key role in keeping our labs with advanced analysis equipment up and running through maintenance, rebuilds, and continuous optimization. You will report to the Laboratory Manager. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES & TASKS Support the design and development of novel experimental setups and custom equipment based on input from chemists and specialists, including technical drawings, procurement, and assembly. Customize and adapt commercial laboratory equipment to the specific needs of our molten salt research. Procure, install, and commission laboratory equipment and experimental setups, and write technical specifications for vendors. Plan and carry out preventive and corrective maintenance, as well as rebuilds and decommissioning of static and dynamic setups, to ensure uninterrupted lab operation with minimal downtime. Continuously optimize our laboratories and contribute to the planning of future lab expansions. Support laboratory QA across all labs, including our isotope laboratory, and ensure compliance with Danish legislation. Support the P&V team and ensure their designs are compatible with Saltfoss facilities. Implement new equipment and workflows in the lab and workshop and train colleagues in their use. PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS An MSc in engineering, chemistry, physics, or related field. Several years of hands-on experience designing, building, and operating experimental equipment in an R&D laboratory. A proven ability to take an experimental setup from idea to working in reality, including technical drawings (CAD), component selection, and assembly. Practical experience with maintenance, troubleshooting, and rebuilds of laboratory equipment. Experience/Familiarity with analytical laboratory equipment such as microscopy, ICP, chromatography or similar. Experience with high-temperature systems, gloveboxes, inert-atmosphere handling, or molten salts is a strong advantage. Fluent written and spoken English. PERSONAL QUALITIES You are innovative and curious, and you enjoy finding creative engineering solutions to problems nobody has solved before. You are as comfortable at the drawing board as with a wrench in hand. No task is too big or too small. You take ownership of your tasks and make sure equipment, and setups are delivered, documented, and working. You communicate openly and clearly and collaborate easily with chemists, technicians, engineers, and external vendors. You work in a structured, thorough way and see health and safety as a natural part of your work. You are adaptable and thrive in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift. WHAT WE OFFER The chance to design and build the experiments behind groundbreaking technology that will impact the global energy landscape. Collaborating with an international and diverse team. Personal and professional development opportunities and support. Informal and flexible work environment. Private health insurance for certain medical expenses and procedures. A share in the company’s future success through our employee warrant program. WANT TO JOIN THE TEAM? Please submit your CV and motivation letter in English by 15 December. To keep our hiring process as fair and unbiased as possible, please don’t include a photo in your CV.

title: Senior Process Engineer
description: Job Description Just imagine helping bring some of the most advanced electronics and mechatronics products in the toy industry from concept into reliable production. Then make it real. About The Role As our Senior Process Engineer, you'll help shape and improve the manufacturing processes behind the electronics and mechatronics products supplied across the LEGO® Group. You'll work with complex box-build solutions, including products such as the SMART Brick, supporting new product introductions, process verification, equipment definition, testing, and continuous improvement. Working close to production, you'll bridge theory and practice to ensure that processes, equipment, and materials operate within LEGO quality standards while contributing to future manufacturing capabilities. Required Qualifications Delivered mechanical, mechatronic, or electrical engineering solutions supported by a BSc degree in a relevant engineering discipline Applied 5+ years of engineering experience within manufacturing, production, or industrial environments Built experience working with assembly processes and production equipment Led investigations, testing, validation, or process verification activities to improve manufacturing performance Managed engineering changes, equipment improvements, or process optimization initiatives with measurable outcomes Preferred Qualifications Applied Six Sigma methods to manufacturing or quality improvement initiatives Developed solutions using design-for-manufacturability principles What You'll Build Support the standardisation and continuous improvement of manufacturing equipment Provide technical guidance for equipment development, design, and construction with external suppliers Develop and maintain digital engineering tools that strengthen manufacturing capabilities Verify, validate, and test process and equipment performance Investigate process variables and evaluate their impact on manufacturing outcomes Assess auxiliary equipment, tooling, and process parameters to ensure consistent product quality Learn existing processes and gradually take ownership of engineering projects and improvement initiatives Build engineering cases, present findings, and influence stakeholders through evidence-based recommendations If you've worked in a role where you improved a manufacturing process, qualified equipment, or implemented a process change with measurable impact, you'll feel at home here. What matters most is your ability to connect a detailed engineering task to a broader manufacturing process and clearly demonstrate the value of your contribution. Life on the team You'll join the Technology Management team within Global Electronics Process Engineering. We're a global team with colleagues based in Budapest, Billund, and Singapore, working together through Microsoft Teams and a hybrid rhythm of three office days and two remote days each week. Our purpose is to develop and support the electronics and mechatronics capabilities that enable products across the LEGO Group. You'll thrive if you're comfortable working through uncertainty, learning new processes, collaborating across cultures, communicating clearly, and building strong relationships with colleagues around the world. This role will be either based in Budapest, Hungary or Billund, Denmark. What Success Looks Like Success means developing a strong understanding of the critical process parameters that drive manufacturing performance and using that knowledge to identify meaningful improvements. You'll contribute to new product introduction projects, support evolving manufacturing capabilities, and work closely with colleagues across Design and Product Development, Production, and EMS suppliers. Over time, you'll take ownership of increasingly complex equipment and process challenges while helping the team deliver scalable and reliable solutions for future products Please note that relocation support is not offered for this role. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. What’s in it for you? Here is what you can expect Family Care Leave - We offer enhanced paid leave options for those important times. Insurances – All colleagues are covered by our life and disability insurance which provides protection and peace of mind. Wellbeing - We want our people to feel well and thrive. We offer resources and benefits to nurture physical and mental wellbeing along with opportunities to build community and inspire creativity. Colleague Discount – We know you'll love to build, so from day 1 you will qualify for our generous colleague discount. Bonus - We do our best work to succeed together. When goals are reached and if eligible, you'll be rewarded through our bonus scheme. Your workplace Your workplace will be the office, store or factory specified in this advert. Hybrid Working Our hybrid work model, Best of Both offers you the option of flexibility to work from home up to two days per week. Your People Leader will discuss the principles of the model, including how this option applies to your role and team. Learn more about our benefits, culture and workplace experience here Children are our role models. Their curiosity, creativity and imagination inspire everything we do. We strive to create a diverse, dynamic and inclusive culture of play at the LEGO Group, where everyone feels safe, valued and they belong. The LEGO Group is highly committed to equal employment opportunity and equal pay and seeks to encourage applicants from all backgrounds (eg. sex, gender identity or expression, race/ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, age and religion) to apply for roles in our team. title: Intresseanmälan - Mekanikkonstruktör
description: Är du mekanikkonstruktör och nyfiken på framtida möjligheter hos Syntronic i Göteborg? Skicka in din intresseanmälan så hör vi av oss när vi har hittat det perfekta uppdraget inom mekanikkonstruktion för dig! På Syntronic arbetar vi med teknikutveckling tillsammans med kunder inom bland annat fordons-, industri- och produktutvecklingsbranschen. Våra uppdrag varierar över tid och därför söker vi löpande kontakt med kompetenta mekanikkonstruktörer inför kommande uppdrag . Som mekanikkonstruktör kan du komma att arbeta med konstruktion och utveckling av produkter, komponenter och produktionslösningar – från koncept och idé till färdig lösning. Vi ser gärna att du: Har högskole- eller civilingenjörsutbildning inom maskinteknik, produktutveckling eller motsvarande Har erfarenhet av mekanikkonstruktion eller produktutveckling Har erfarenhet av CAD, exempelvis CATIA, NX, Creo eller SolidWorks Har erfarenhet av ritningar och teknisk dokumentation Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska Erfarenhet från exempelvis fordons-, försvars-, eller tillverkningsindustrin är meriterande, liksom erfarenhet av simulering, hållfasthetsberäkningar, produktionsutveckling eller PLM. Som person är du nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och ansvarstagande. Du trivs med att samarbeta och uppskattar en konsultroll där du får möta nya tekniska utmaningar. Varför ska du välja oss? Tänk dig att börja arbetsdagen med en färjetur över älven och kliva av mitt i pulsen på Lindholmen Science Park. Där sitter vi, ett växande team av ingenjörer med stora ambitioner, vassa hjärnor och en svaghet för darttävlingar på kontoret. Hos oss får du spännande tekniska uppdrag, måndagsfrukost som kickstartar veckan och fredagsfika som rundar av den med stil. Vi är inte störst i Göteborg (ännu), men vi är på en tydlig tillväxtresa och vi vill ha fler smarta kollegor med på resan. Ansökan Observera att detta endast är en intresseanmälan. Eventuella framtida uppdrag är beroende av verksamhetens och våra kunders behov. Beroende på framtida uppdrag kan krav enligt gällande säkerhetsskyddsbestämmelser förekomma. För säkerhetsklassade roller kan det även finnas krav kopplade till medborgarskap. Din profil sparas i vår kandidatbank upp till två år (då ett nytt mejl kommer skickas ut där du får godkänna medgivande att profilen sparas ytterligare). Vi återkopplar till dig när vi har ett uppdrag som skulle passa din profil. Vi kan använda AI och automatiserade verktyg som stöd i vår rekryteringsprocess. Alla beslut om urval och anställning fattas alltid av människor.

title: Utvecklingsingenjör inom verkansdesign
description: Drivs du av att se dina idéer bli verklighet? Välkommen till vår spännande och teknikintensiva värld. Din roll Vill du arbeta med avancerad produktutveckling där du får följa hela kedjan från idé till färdig lösning? Hos Saab Dynamics i Karlskoga blir du en del av ett tekniktungt sammanhang där innovation, kvalitet och långsiktig utveckling står i fokus. Som utvecklingsingenjör inom Warhead Design arbetar du brett med design och utveckling av verkanssystem. Rollen innebär att du är involverad genom hela utvecklingsprocessen från koncept och konstruktion till testning, verifiering och vidareutveckling av färdig produkt. Det ger dig en unik möjlighet att både påverka tekniska lösningar tidigt och följa dem hela vägen till implementation. Här finns goda möjligheter att fördjupa sig tekniskt och arbeta långsiktigt inom ett avancerat och nischat teknikområde där utveckling och innovation är en central del av vardagen. Du kommer successivt att bygga upp din specialistkompetens inom området. I ditt dagliga arbete kombinerar du teoretisk problemlösning med praktiskt genomförande. Du arbetar med konstruktion och teknisk design i komplexa system, analyserar och löser tekniska utmaningar samt deltar i framtagning av försöksmateriel och genomförande av provning. En viktig del av rollen är också produktvård, där du bidrar med förbättringsförslag, genomför utredningar och säkerställer att produkterna fortsätter utvecklas över tid. Arbetet innebär många kontaktytor både internt och externt. Rollen innebär både självständigt ansvar och nära samarbete med kollegor. Du ingår i ett team med hög kompetens där kunskapsdelning och gemensam problemlösning är en naturlig del av arbetssättet. Samtidigt förväntas du kunna driva dina egna uppgifter framåt och fatta välgrundade beslut. Resor både inom och utanför Sverige kan förekomma. Din profil För att trivas i rollen ser vi att du är en nyfiken och engagerad person med ett genuint teknikintresse. Du motiveras av att förstå hur saker fungerar på djupet och drivs av att utveckla lösningar som håller hög kvalitet över tid. Du har en god samarbetsförmåga och trivs i en miljö där du arbetar nära andra, delar kunskap och bidrar till gemensamma mål. Samtidigt är du självgående i ditt arbetssätt, tar ansvar för dina uppgifter och har förmåga att driva ditt arbete framåt på ett strukturerat sätt. Vi tror att du har: Civil- eller högskoleingenjörsexamen, exempelvis inom maskinteknik, teknisk fysik eller motsvarande Erfarenhet av konstruktion i 3D-verktyg Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift B-körkort Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av konstruktions- eller systemingenjörsarbete. Har du dessutom ett praktiskt intresse och uppskattar att arbeta hands-on, exempelvis i samband med tester och framtagning av försöksmaterial, ser vi det som ett stort plus. Vi värdesätter också att du är noggrann, ansvarstagande och har ett säkerhetsmedvetet förhållningssätt. Befattningen kan komma att placeras i säkerhetsklass, vilket innebär att du måste genomgå och godkännas i en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll enligt gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd innan anställning. Vad du blir en del av Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas. Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med syfte att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidra till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld. Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här.

For those who dream big and push boundaries on the ground and in the stars to change the world for the better, we’ll take you there. For more information, visit www.mda.space. MDA Space’s international footprint in the UK creates opportunities to work with some of the most exciting space industrial players in the country. Delivering all three business area capabilities in Geointelligence, Robotics & Space Operations, and Satellite Systems, our UK team provides support to our European-based customers while specializing in the development of advanced space sensors for exploration missions as well as space-based communication technology. As our presence grows overseas, so does our need for new ambitious team players to help us advance our place in the Universe and beyond. Responsibilities Develop detailed 3D models and manufacturing drawings using Siemens NX, maintaining a high standard of quality and technical rigour. Design mechanical components and assemblies for satellite subsystems, electronic units, and spaceborne instruments, taking ownership of assigned work from concept through to delivery. Produce and review high-quality engineering drawings in compliance with ISO and ECSS standards. Perform tolerance analyses to develop robust and manufacturable design solutions. Own configuration control and documentation, ensuring compliance with established engineering processes and contributing to their improvement. Work closely with multidisciplinary teams including structural, thermal, manufacturing, electronics, and systems engineers. Contribute to design reviews including PDR, CDR, and TRR, preparing the required mechanical design evidence and responding to review actions. Ensure assigned designs comply with project requirements, quality standards, and internal procedures. Contribute to the continuous improvement of mechanical design processes, guidelines, and best practices. Support multiple programmes simultaneously, including optical and telecom payloads. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering, or equivalent. Minimum of 4 to 5 years' experience in mechanical design, ideally within the aerospace, space, defence, or another high-integrity engineering industry. Proven expertise in Siemens NX (3D modelling and drafting); SolidWorks experience also considered. Strong command of mechanical design principles, GD&T, and tolerance stack-ups. Demonstrable experience designing precision-machined components and assemblies for flight or high-integrity applications. Ability to produce and review high-quality technical drawings and documentation to a release standard. Strong communication skills and proven ability to operate effectively in multidisciplinary teams. Preferred Qualifications Solid experience in the space industry with working knowledge of ECSS standards. Experience in the design of electronic enclosures and spaceborne equipment. Knowledge of aluminium structures and thermal design considerations. Familiarity with environmental requirements including vibration, shock, and thermal vacuum. Sound understanding of Design for Manufacture and Assembly (DFM/DFA). Experience working within a regulated or safety-critical engineering environment. Experience coordinating small technical work packages or supporting less-experienced engineers. Suitable Candidates Will Ideally Have The Following Attributes Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the confidence to make and defend engineering decisions. High attention to detail and an uncompromising commitment to quality. Able to work with appropriate autonomy, manage competing priorities, and take initiative while seeking support when required. title: Student Structural Engineering (SE)
description: Wil jij als afstudeerder actief worden in grootschalige nationale- en internationale infrastructuurprojecten? Kom dan ons team versterken! Bij ons word je onderdeel van een leuk en hecht team van gemotiveerde collega’s, maar tegelijkertijd ben je onderdeel van een gerenommeerd internationaal ingenieursbureau met meer dan 7000 medewerkers, met alle voordelen van dien. Je kunt gebruik maken van goede opleidingsfaciliteiten en (internationale) ontwikkelmogelijkheden dit alles in een goede werksfeer. Wat je doet als Student Structural Engineering (SE) Wij zijn op zoek naar een enthousiaste TU afstudeerder die zich wil ontwikkelen op het gebied van verduurzaming van infrastructuur. Bij ons krijg je de kans om innovatieve oplossingen te ontwikkelen en te demonstreren. Je wordt onderdeel van ons gepassioneerde team, dat zowel nationaal als internationaal tot de top in het vakgebied behoort. Bovendien werk je samen met leuke collega’s die je graag ondersteunen in jouw ontwikkeling! Voor jouw afstudeerstage hebben wij het volgende onderwerp in gedachten: Design of Timber Concrete Composite Motorway Bridge. Mogelijke onderzoeksvragen zouden kunnen zijn: Wat is de stand van zaken op het gebied van TCC bruggen? Welke verbindingen tussen hout en beton zijn mogelijk? Hoe ontwerp en controleer je verbindingen op vermoeiing? Hoe duurzaam en circulair is een TCC snelwegbrug vergeleken met een prefab betonnen brug? Welke voordelen (bijv. eigen gewicht, koolstofopslag) heeft een TCC brug ten opzichte van beton? Wat zijn de scenario’s voor het einde van de levensduur van TCC bruggen? Wij zijn echter ook nieuwsgierig naar jouw eigen ideeën en interesses. Uiteraard kunnen wij richting geven en helpen aanscherpen, maar uiteindelijk is het aan jou om het project vorm te geven. Waar je komt te werken Bij Haskoning kom je te werken bij een onafhankelijk adviesbureau dat ingenieurs-, ontwerp- en adviesdiensten combineert met software en technologie. Onze missie, “Enhancing Society Together" drijft ons om een positieve impact op de wereld te creëren. Wij bieden uitdagend werk in diverse internationale projecten, waarbij we gebruik maken van onze 140+ jaar aan expertise. Met meer dan 6.800 medewerkers in meer dan 25 landen zetten we samen uitdagingen om in kansen om zo een positieve impact op de samenleving te maken. We werken samen met toonaangevende klanten in markten zoals infrastructuur, klimaatbestendigheid, hernieuwbare energie, decarbonisatie van de industrie en duurzame mobiliteit. Jij gaat aan de slag op onze afdeling Infrastructuur in ons kantoor in Delft. Hier werken we met zo’n 100 collega’s dagelijks aan uitdagende infrastructurele projecten in Nederland en daarbuiten, met onze focus op de drie werkvelden ondergrondse constructies/tunnels, bruggen en Schiphol. Wat je meebrengt Om deze functie succesvol te vervullen vind je aansluiting in onderstaand profiel: Je bent ondernemend en in staat om klantcontacten te ontwikkelen; Uitstekende beheersing van de Engelse taal in woord en schrift; Je bent bezig met de afronding van een relevante WO opleiding Civiele Techniek/Structural Engineering; Je hebt teamspirit en bent een gezellige collega. Dit krijg je van ons Naast dat je je bij ons kunt ontwikkelen met dit uitdagende project, bieden we je ook: Een goede werksfeer, waarbinnen collegialiteit en ontwikkeling van het bedrijf en de medewerkers de belangrijkste factoren zijn; Je krijgt persoonlijke begeleiding, wordt onderdeel van het team en werkt mee in een project met internationale uitstraling; Naast een mooie leer- en ontwikkelplaats bieden wij ook een stagevergoeding van 600-750 euro per maand. Na succesvolle afronding van het project gaan we graag met je verder als eerste stap in je professionele carrière. Ben jij onze nieuwe stagiair? We maken graag kennis met je! Klik op de solliciteer button onder aan de pagina en upload je cv en motivatiebrief. Heb je vragen over het sollicitatie process? Neem dan contact op met Johan Kuipers, via michelle.spoor@haskoning.com. Bij Haskoning zetten we ons in voor een diverse en inclusieve werkplek waar iedereen zich gewaardeerd, gerespecteerd en empowered voelt. Onze missie, ‘Enhancing Society Together,’ drijft ons om een omgeving te creëren waarin ieders unieke achtergrond, identiteit en perspectief worden omarmd. Ongeacht je ervaring, afkomst, leeftijd, gender, of andere persoonlijke kenmerken—bij ons ben je welkom. We geloven dat diversiteit ons sterker maakt en dat een inclusieve cultuur iedereen de kans geeft om te groeien en bij te dragen. Lees meer over onze ED&I-initiatieven op onze webpagina.

title: Chief Stress Engineer
description: Technical authority. Structural integrity. Trust it with lives. Are you a highly experienced Stress Engineer ready to take technical ownership of structural integrity within a safety-critical aerospace environment? Join Martin-Baker as Chief Stress Engineer and take a leading technical role in ensuring our life-saving aerospace equipment meets the highest standards of structural integrity, safety and performance. Working within our Mechanical Engineering group at Denham, you'll combine hands-on stress analysis with technical governance , providing specialist expertise across FEA, fatigue, damage tolerance and structural mechanics while acting as a key technical authority for engineering decisions and approvals. Direct Impact. Global Scale. Life-Saving Mission. At Martin-Baker, the work we do matters. We design, manufacture and support life-saving equipment used by aircrew around the world. Our products operate in demanding environments where quality, reliability and attention to detail are critical. We're proud of our long history in aerospace and defence while remaining focused on the future. Joining Martin-Baker means becoming part of a business with a clear purpose, strong engineering capability and a long-term commitment to its people, products and customers. With over 7,800 lives saved , your expertise as Chief Stress Engineer will help ensure the structural integrity of equipment designed to protect aircrew when they need it most. The Opportunity as Chief Stress Engineer: As Chief Stress Engineer , you'll hold a senior position within our Mechanical Engineering group, providing technical leadership and authority across structural stress analysis for safety-critical aerospace systems. You'll take ownership of complex analysis strategies from initial assessment through to final technical approval, covering static stress, fatigue, damage tolerance, vibration and Finite Element Analysis (FEA) . Crucially, this isn't a leadership position that moves you away from engineering. You'll remain hands-on technically , contributing directly to challenging stress activities while reviewing and approving analysis produced across projects. You'll also provide specialist structural input into engineering changes, material reviews and failure investigations, giving you significant influence across the product lifecycle. It's an opportunity for an established aerospace stress specialist to combine deep technical expertise, engineering judgement and signatory responsibility within a business where the quality of those decisions has a genuine life-saving purpose. What You’ll Do as Chief Stress Engineer: Technical Leadership : Provide specialist technical leadership and governance across structural stress, fatigue and damage tolerance analysis. Stress Analysis : Remain hands-on with complex analysis, supporting and delivering critical project stressing activities. Finite Element Analysis : Apply advanced FEA and mathematical modelling techniques to assess structural behaviour, loads and performance. Technical Approval : Review and formally approve engineering analysis, technical documentation and supporting data within your delegated authority. Fatigue & Damage Tolerance : Lead the assessment of fatigue life, structural durability and damage tolerance within safety-critical applications. Engineering Change : Provide authoritative stress input into design changes, modifications and engineering change reviews. Failure Investigation : Lead structural and concessional investigations, applying robust engineering judgement and root cause analysis. Material Review : Provide stress expertise to complex material review and concession activity. Technical Problem Solving : Respond to emerging structural issues across the product lifecycle, providing clear and timely engineering decisions. Engineering Standards : Help maintain consistently high technical standards across stress analysis methodologies, documentation and approval processes. About You: We're looking for an established aerospace Stress Engineer or Structural Analysis specialist with significant hands-on experience and the technical judgement to operate as an authority within a safety-critical engineering environment. Extensive experience in structural stress analysis , ideally involving aircraft structures or equipment integrated with aircraft. Advanced understanding of Finite Element Analysis (FEA), structural mechanics, fatigue and damage tolerance . Strong capability in classical hand calculations and analytical methods , alongside numerical analysis. Experience of vibration analysis and mathematical modelling. Expertise with relevant analysis software, ideally including ANSYS Mechanical, NASTRAN and/or LS-DYNA . Strong understanding of structural failure modes and experience supporting failure investigations and root cause analysis . Proven experience reviewing and approving complex engineering analysis and technical documentation. Significant experience within aerospace, defence or another closely related high-integrity engineering environment . A Master's degree or BEng 2:1 or above in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience . Chartered Engineer (CEng) status through a recognised professional institution such as the RAeS, IMechE or IET is preferred, particularly to support signatory responsibilities. Able to balance deep technical analysis with the need to make clear, timely engineering decisions. Comfortable moving between different technical challenges and priorities across the product lifecycle. Share and demonstrate the Martin-Baker values. Whether you're currently working as a Chief Stress Engineer, Principal Stress Engineer, Lead Stress Engineer, Stress Technical Authority or Principal Structural Analysis Engineer, this could be an opportunity to take your expertise into a role with genuine technical influence and life-saving purpose. title: Product / Manufacturing Engineer
description: Job Title: Production / Manufacturing Engineer Salary: £40,000 to £50,000 depending on experience Location: Coventry, fully on site. Permanent, full time, Monday to Friday Most manufacturing engineers wait months to see a change reach the line. Here, it shows up within days. If you like owning a process, reading the data and knowing whether a build is good or bad, this is a role where your work is visible on every vehicle that leaves the line. Why this role A growing eMobility manufacturer that designs and builds its own electric vehicles is doubling output in 2027, across three new models. The line is digitally controlled, the team is small and the engineering is close to the build. You would be the person who makes each launch run properly, starting in January 2027. What you’ll do You will take the new models through pilot and pre-series builds, with PFMEA, control plans, line balance, fixtures and DFM/DFA input. You will manage engineering changes with clean cut-in and traceability, and run root cause using 8D, 5 Whys and poka-yoke. You will also use Lean tools to bring station times down against takt and support the move to a higher-output, dual-sided line. DC tooling is the heart of it, and it is a data job rather than a spanner job. For each new joint you set the torque and angle, pull the tightening data from the first builds, decide whether the joint is behaving as expected, narrow the pass/fail window and sign it off as the standard. You manage the process through software, not by holding the tool. Experience with any controller-driven DC tooling platform, such as Desoutter or Atlas Copco, transfers. So does any digital work instruction or operator guidance system. Your team You will have one direct report, a skilled production engineering technician who came up through the line. Your job is to coach them so they can take the day to day, which frees you to work with Engineering. About you Sector does not matter. Scale does. We want low to medium volume, roughly 1,000 to 5,000 units a year, with complex builds. Off-highway, agricultural, specialist vehicles, buses, electromechanical machinery and similar all fit. New product introduction does not have to mean a whole vehicle. Bringing a new sub-assembly or major variant online, validating it and locking it down counts. EV and high-voltage experience is not required. If you are earlier in the range, you know DC tooling well, understand what good NPI looks like and want a step up. Further up, you have led a small team and taken two or three introductions through to production readiness. You are ambitious, hands on and have no ego. Rewards & growth £40,000 to £50,000 depending on experience, an employer-contribution pension, potential equity and a benefits platform. Once the 2027 launches are running and handed down, you move closer to Engineering, working with designers at concept stage on manufacturability, including higher-power products to come. Pay moves with that. How to apply The business wants to make an offer before Christmas, so please apply soon and tell us your notice period.
