title: Senior Manufacturing Engineer
description: Overview Are you an experienced Manufacturing Engineer who enjoys turning complex designs into practical, robust and efficient manufacturing solutions? Do you thrive in collaborative environments, working across engineering, production, quality and supply chain teams to solve difficult problems? Are you looking for a challenging role that offers flexibility, professional growth and the opportunity to contribute to nationally important engineering programmes? If so, we'd love to hear from you. We are looking for a Senior Manufacturing Engineer to join our growing team and help meet increasing demand across the UK nuclear sector. You will take a leading role in developing and improving manufacturing solutions for complex components, assemblies and equipment, working across the engineering lifecycle from early design and producibility assessment through to product introduction, manufacture and delivery. Your experience may have been gained in nuclear, defence, aerospace, energy or another highly regulated manufacturing environment. Whether working within AtkinsRéalis project teams, alongside clients or with specialist suppliers, you will help ensure that designs can be manufactured safely, consistently and to the required quality. As part of AtkinsRéalis, you'll join a team that values curiosity, collaboration, courage and care, and supports people to build fulfilling and rewarding careers. Your role As a Senior Manufacturing Engineer, You Will Bring Technical Judgement, Structure And Practical Manufacturing Insight To Complex Engineering Challenges. You Will Have The Opportunity To Lead manufacturing engineering activities for complex components, assemblies and equipment, from concept development and design reviews through to production readiness and delivery. Develop, review and improve manufacturing methods, process sequences, manufacturing instructions and supporting technical documentation. Apply Design for Manufacture and Assembly principles to help engineering teams develop solutions that are safe, producible, inspectable and efficient to deliver. Provide practical advice on manufacturing processes, including machining, fabrication, welding and joining, composite manufacture, assembly, inspection and testing, as appropriate to the work. Support New Product Introduction and production readiness activities, ensuring that manufacturing requirements, risks, resources and controls are understood and managed. Review drawings, models and technical packages for producibility, tolerancing, process capability and manufacturing risk. Work closely with design engineering, quality, production, procurement and suppliers to resolve manufacturing issues, non-conformances and engineering changes. Support the selection, assessment and ongoing development of suppliers, building effective relationships and providing proportionate technical oversight. Contribute to process improvement, lessons learned and the development of consistent manufacturing engineering practices. Provide technical input to bids, estimates, delivery plans, schedules and risk reviews. Lead or support technical reviews, clearly communicating recommendations and influencing stakeholders at all levels. Coach and mentor less experienced engineers, sharing knowledge and helping develop capability across the team. About You We're looking for someone who combines strong manufacturing knowledge with sound engineering judgement, clear communication and a collaborative approach. You will have experience working in the UK nuclear defence industry and be motivated to continuously develop your skills, whilst making a positive contribution to critical UK nuclear (civil and defence) programmes. You are likely to bring: Significant experience in Manufacturing Engineering within nuclear, defence, aerospace, energy or another highly regulated engineering environment. A good understanding of manufacturing process planning and the production of clear, controlled manufacturing instructions or methods of manufacture. Practical knowledge of a range of manufacturing and inspection processes, which may include machining, fabrication, welding and joining, composite manufacture, assembly, non-destructive examination, dimensional inspection and testing. Experience applying Design for Manufacture and Assembly, producibility assessment and manufacturing risk management during design development. Experience supporting New Product Introduction, production readiness, gated reviews or the transfer of designs into manufacture. An understanding of engineering drawings, geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, configuration control, change management and quality assurance principles. Experience working with suppliers and multidisciplinary teams to investigate problems, manage interfaces and deliver technically robust solutions. The ability to balance technical excellence with practical delivery, taking account of safety, quality, cost, schedule and manufacturing capability. Confidence in writing clear technical reports, presenting recommendations and engaging constructively with stakeholders at all levels. The ability to organise your own work, manage competing priorities and provide leadership or guidance to others. Most importantly, you'll be motivated by solving real manufacturing problems, helping others succeed and delivering right-first-time engineering outcomes in a safety-focused environment. Rewards & benefits Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life. Rewards and benefits – Careers at AtkinsRéalis About

title: Ingénieur Mécanique – systèmes FSO spatial et défense (H/F)
description: Vos missions au quotidien Notre client est une entreprise technologique innovante et en forte croissance qui développe des systèmes avancés de communication optique et des systèmes photoniques destinés à des applications particulièrement exigeantes. Dans le cadre du développement de ses activités d’ingénierie, nous recherchons un Ingénieur Mécanique – systèmes FSO pour le spatial et la défense (H/F) . Au sein des équipes R&D et Ingénierie, vous contribuerez à la conception et au développement de systèmes optomécaniques de haute précision pour des équipements de communication optique en espace libre (FSO, Free-Space Optical ) destinés à des applications spatiales et de défense. En étroite collaboration avec l’architecte optomécanique référent, vous aurez la responsabilité de sous-systèmes définis tout au long de leur cycle de développement : de la conception initiale et détaillée à la fabrication, à l’intégration, à la qualification environnementale et aux essais. Ce poste se situe à l’interface entre les mécanismes de précision, les structures optomécaniques et le contrôle thermique. Vous concevrez des équipements capables de préserver leur alignement optique, de résister aux conditions de lancement et de fonctionnement, et d’assurer des performances fiables sur une longue durée de vie, sans réglage en service. Conception de mécanismes de précision : concevoir des mécanismes de précision, notamment des platines de déplacement, des montages de roulements, des dispositifs de précharge et des systèmes d’actionnement. Assurer l’intégration des codeurs, définir les chemins de reprise des efforts au lancement et concevoir les solutions de cheminement des câbles. Structures optomécaniques : concevoir des bancs optiques, des boîtiers de précision, des montages isostatiques et cinématiques ainsi que des ensembles structurels, de l’avant-projet à la modélisation CAO détaillée, aux plans de fabrication et aux vérifications de montage. Conception thermique : définir et optimiser l’architecture thermique des instruments optiques, notamment les chemins d’évacuation de la chaleur, les interfaces thermiques, la répartition des éléments chauffants et la puissance nécessaire en mode survie. Étudier les cas thermiques chaud et froid et définir les stratégies d’athermalisation des ensembles optiques sensibles. Analyses structurelles et thermoélastiques : spécifier, réaliser ou piloter les analyses modales et quasi statiques, les analyses vibratoires sinusoïdales et aléatoires, ainsi que les études de déformation thermique, de stabilité de la ligne de visée et de microvibrations. Porter un regard critique sur les résultats de simulation et en tirer des décisions de conception robustes. Gestion des tolérances et stabilité optique : établir et boucler les chaînes de cotes, des pièces élémentaires jusqu’aux exigences d’alignement optique. Évaluer les effets de la suppression des charges gravitaires, de la dilatation thermique et des variations d’assemblage sur les performances optiques. Qualification des mécanismes spatiaux : définir et accompagner la qualification des mécanismes, en couvrant les marges en couple et en effort, les performances des roulements, la tribologie sous vide, le choix des lubrifiants et des matériaux, les essais de durée de vie ainsi que les exigences de dégazage et de propreté. Conception pour la fabrication, l’intégration et les essais : veiller à ce que les équipements puissent être fabriqués, assemblés et alignés. Définir les outillages, les procédures d’intégration et les équipements de soutien au sol nécessaires à leur réalisation et à leur validation. Gestion des fournisseurs : préparer la documentation technique, les spécifications et les demandes de devis ; suivre les opérations d’usinage, de traitement et de fabrication ; organiser les contrôles à réception et intégrer les retours des fournisseurs et des essais aux itérations de conception. Essais environnementaux : contribuer aux campagnes d’essais environnementaux ou les piloter, notamment pour les essais vibratoires et sous vide thermique. Participer à la rédaction des spécifications d’essai, à l’établissement des prévisions, à l’analyse des anomalies, à la résolution des non-conformités et à la constitution du dossier de qualification. Collaboration pluridisciplinaire : travailler avec les équipes d’optique, de thermique, d’électronique et d’ingénierie système pour arbitrer entre les exigences de stabilité optique, d’alignement, de masse, de puissance, de pointage, de fabricabilité et de coût. Ce que l’on cherche Formation : master ou diplôme d’ingénieur en génie mécanique, génie aérospatial ou dans une discipline connexe. Une expérience pratique équivalente pourra également être prise en compte. Expérience professionnelle : vous justifiez d’une expérience concrète du développement d’équipements mécaniques, de la conception CAO jusqu’à la fabrication, à l’assemblage, à l’intégration et aux essais, dans un environnement industriel exigeant. Expérience dans le spatial : une expérience préalable sur des équipements qualifiés pour le spatial est indispensable . Vous connaissez les contraintes liées au vide, aux cycles thermiques, aux charges de lancement, au choix des matériaux, à la maîtrise de la contamination, au dégazage et aux exigences de propreté. Compétences techniques : Très bonne maîtrise d’un logiciel professionnel de CAO paramétrique, idéalement SolidWorks , CATIA , Creo , NX ou un outil équivalent. Excellente maîtrise des plans mécaniques, de la documentation de fabrication et de la cotation et du tolérancement géométriques (GD&T) . Expérience de la conception optomécanique : bancs optiques, boîtiers de précision et solutions de montage cinématique et isostatique. Solides connaissances des mécanismes de précision, des roulements, du dimensionnement des précharges, des systèmes d’actionnement, des codeurs et du cheminement des câbles. Expérience de la tribologie sous vide, du choix des lubrifiants et de l’assurance

title: Ingénieur calcul de structures mécaniques
description: Contexte du poste Nous recherchons une personne pour simuler les sollicitations et justifier la tenue mécanique de pièces ou d’assemblages à partir de cas de charge documentés. Vous travaillerez avec les équipes de conception et d’essais pour définir les hypothèses de calcul et examiner les écarts. Les conclusions éclaireront les choix de géométrie, de matériau ou d’assemblage. Missions principales Analyser les plans, matériaux et hypothèses de chargement. Choisir le niveau de modélisation et préparer les modèles par éléments finis. Définir les conditions aux limites, contacts et maillages adaptés. Exécuter les calculs et vérifier leur convergence et leur cohérence physique. Analyser les contraintes, déplacements et marges selon les critères du projet. Comparer les résultats aux ordres de grandeur analytiques ou aux données d’essais. Proposer des évolutions de conception et évaluer leur effet sur la tenue. Rédiger les notes de justification et présenter les conclusions en revue. Évaluer l’influence des tolérances ou de la dispersion des propriétés si elles affectent la conclusion. Archiver les fichiers de calcul, hypothèses et versions nécessaires à une reprise des études. Compétences techniques requises Résistance des matériaux et mécanique des structures. Modélisation et calcul par éléments finis. Pratique d’ Abaqus , Ansys , Nastran ou équivalent. Choix du maillage et analyse de sensibilité des résultats. Capacité à justifier les hypothèses et limites d’un calcul. Capacité à relier les marges calculées aux critères de dimensionnement du projet. Lecture de plans, données matériaux et résultats de caractérisation mécanique. Compétences complémentaires appréciées Calcul non linéaire, fatigue, flambement ou dynamique selon le projet. Corrélation des simulations avec des essais mécaniques. Préparation et automatisation de calculs avec Python . Expérience de justification de structures assemblées ou soumises à chargements cycliques. Profil recherché Formation en mécanique, génie mécanique ou simulation numérique ou expérience équivalente. Réalisation de calculs et rédaction de notes de justification mécanique. Esprit critique dans l’interprétation des résultats et capacité à présenter une justification vérifiable. Environnement de travail Études numériques en lien avec les bureaux de conception et, selon le projet, les équipes d’essais. Pourquoi rejoindre ce projet ? Utiliser les calculs pour éclairer les évolutions de conception. Confronter des résultats numériques aux mécanismes physiques et aux données disponibles

title: Structural Engineer
description: Doelstelling Als Structural Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het uitvoeren, coördineren en controleren van structurele berekeningen en analyses voor complexe industriële, energie- en infrastructuurprojecten. Je staat in voor het ontwerp en de technische onderbouwing van beton- en staalconstructies en waakt over de veiligheid, stabiliteit en conformiteit met de geldende normen en voorschriften. Daarnaast fungeer je als technisch aanspreekpunt binnen het engineeringteam en draag je bij aan de kwaliteit van de opgeleverde studiedocumenten. Je deelt je expertise met minder ervaren collega’s en ondersteunt hen bij hun technische ontwikkeling. Voornaamste taken Uitvoeren en opvolgen van structurele ontwerpen en berekeningen voor beton- en staalconstructies. Uitvoeren van structurele analyses met behulp van FEM-software zoals ANSYS, SCIA of gelijkwaardige toepassingen. Uitvoeren van statische en dynamische analyses, rekening houdend met verschillende belastingscondities en mogelijke risico’s. Uitvoeren van lineaire en/of niet-lineaire structurele berekeningen. Opstellen, controleren en beoordelen van rekennota’s, technische specificaties en andere engineeringdocumenten. Nakijken van technische documenten en berekeningen aangeleverd door aannemers en externe engineeringpartners. Bewaken van de kwaliteit en technische conformiteit van de uitgevoerde studies volgens de interne QA-procedures. Ondersteunen bij offertes en aanbestedingsdossiers. Afstemmen van technische interfaces met klanten, projectteams en andere engineeringdisciplines. Begeleiden en ondersteunen van junior calculation engineers en delen van technische kennis binnen het team. Profiel Je beschikt over een masterdiploma in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering of een gelijkwaardige richting. Je hebt minstens 10 jaar relevante ervaring in structurele berekeningen en ontwerp van constructies. Je hebt een grondige kennis van structurele ontwerpprincipes voor beton- en/of staalconstructies. Je hebt ervaring met FEM- en structurele analysesoftware zoals ANSYS, SCIA of gelijkwaardig. Je hebt ervaring met statische en dynamische analyses en lineaire en/of niet-lineaire berekeningen. Je hebt een goede kennis van internationale normen en voorschriften, in het bijzonder de Eurocodes. Kennis van Amerikaanse normen zoals ACI en ASCE is een pluspunt. Ervaring binnen complexe industriële, energie- of infrastructuurprojecten is een sterke troef. Ervaring met offshore structure engineering is een pluspunt. Ervaring binnen de nucleaire sector en kennis van nucleaire veiligheidsvoorschriften zijn een meerwaarde. Je beschikt over sterke technische schrijfvaardigheden en kunt berekeningsnota’s en technische rapporten helder opstellen. Je communiceert vlot in het Engels. Kennis van het Nederlands en/of Frans is een pluspunt. Je beschikt over een geldig VCA-attest. Je bent in het bezit van een geldige nucleaire veiligheidsmachtiging (security clearance).

title: Kıdemli CNC Üretim ve Metot Mühendisi
description: Bursa'da faaliyet gösteren, otomotiv ve savunma sanayi sektörlerine yönelik hassas talaşlı imalat yapan firmamız bünyesinde görev almak üzere deneyimli bir çalışma arkadaşı arıyoruz. Bu pozisyon, üretimi ofisten takip eden yöneticiler için uygun değildir. Aradığımız kişi; üretim sahasında aktif rol alan, operatörlerle aynı dili konuşabilen, CNC programlama ve üretim metotları konusunda güçlü teknik altyapıya sahip, karşılaşılan problemlere yerinde müdahale ederek çözüm üretebilen, ekibine örnek olarak liderlik eden ve üretim sonuçlarının sorumluluğunu üstlenebilen bir mühendistir. Bu pozisyon ağırlıklı olarak üretim sahasında aktif çalışmayı gerektirmektedir. Üretim hedeflerinin takibi, ekibin yönlendirilmesi, yeni parçaların üretime alınması, CNC programlama faaliyetleri ve proses geliştirme çalışmaları bu görevin temel sorumlulukları arasındadır. Görev ve Sorumluluklar Talaşlı imalat üretim faaliyetlerinin günlük olarak yönetilmesi Üretim hedeflerinin, terminlerin ve performans göstergelerinin takip edilmesi Operatör ve üretim ekibinin teknik olarak yönlendirilmesi CNC torna ve CNC işleme merkezi programlarının hazırlanması, geliştirilmesi ve optimize edilmesi Yeni ürünlerin üretime alınmasındaki gerekli metot etüdünün yönetilmesi Fikstür, takım ve üretim yöntemlerinin geliştirilmesi Çevrim sürelerinin, verimliliğin ve kapasite kullanımının iyileştirilmesi Teknik problemlerin sahada çözülmesi ve kök neden analizlerinin yürütülmesi Üretim, kalite, bakım ve planlama ekipleri arasında koordinasyon sağlanması Üretim performansının sürekli iyileştirilmesine yönelik çalışmaların yürütülmesi Aranan Nitelikler Talaşlı imalat alanında 15 yıl ve üzeri deneyime sahip CNC işleme merkezi proseslerine hakim Fanuc kontrol ünitesi ve CNC programlama konusunda deneyimli Teknik resim okuyabilen ve toleransları yorumlayabilen Üretim metotları ve proses geliştirme konusunda tecrübeli CATIA kullanabilen Takım teknolojileri, kesme parametreleri ve fikstür tasarımı konularında bilgi sahibi Üretim ekiplerini yönlendirebilecek liderlik yeteneğine sahip Sonuç odaklı, sorumluluk alan ve sahada aktif çalışmayı seven Makine Mühendisliği, İmalat Mühendisliği veya ilgili teknik alanlarda eğitim almış olmak tercih sebebidir. Güçlü saha tecrübesine sahip adaylar için eğitim şartı ikinci plandadır. Otomotiv veya yüksek hassasiyetli talaşlı imalat tecrübesi tercih sebebidir Ek Bilgi Emekli olmuş veya emekliliğe hak kazanmış ancak aktif çalışma hayatına devam etmek isteyen adayların başvuruları da memnuniyetle değerlendirilecektir. Üretim sahasında bilgi ve tecrübesiyle fark yaratacak, ekibine liderlik edecek ve şirketimizin teknik birikimine katkı sağlayacak çalışma arkadaşlarıyla tanışmak isteriz.

title: Technical Office Engineer
description: ABOUT US MAT Filtration Technologies was established to provide the highest possible efficiency equipment and services on water filtration technology. Specifically MAT was established in 2012 in Izmir, Turkey and was founded by fish husbandry industry experts. Our expertise in animal husbandry for over 35 years is our biggest competitive advantage. Furthermore we understand animal behavior and we know in depth the operational needs to run a facility properly. Our company develops and tests the equipment performance and ensures its ease of operation on our marine fish quarantine facility in Izmir. In addition, we have designed our organization to deliver successfully and on-time demanding projects in any part of the world. Finally MAT has developed to become a design, manufacturing and contracting leader in the field of MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) and specialty filtration technologies. Currently, we employ over 600 highly-skilled staff of multiple nationalities and 4 factories. We are seeking a Senior Technical Office Engineer with the qualifications below; Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a related engineering discipline. Minimum 5–7 years of experience in Technical Office, Project Controls, Construction, EPC, or Engineering projects, preferably with Head Office experience. Proven experience in reviewing and controlling quantity take-offs, BOQs, progress payments (IPCs), and project cost data. Strong knowledge of contract administration, Variation Orders (VOs), claims, and change management. Experience in reviewing project budgets, actual costs, forecasts, and cost deviations. Strong understanding of technical documentation, drawings, specifications, BOQs, and contractual requirements. Experience in coordinating and controlling multiple projects simultaneously from a Head Office environment. Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify discrepancies and assess technical, commercial, and contractual risks. Excellent knowledge of MS Excel and other MS Office applications; knowledge of Primavera P6 or other project controls software is an advantage. Strong reporting and data analysis skills with the ability to consolidate information from multiple projects. Excellent communication and coordination skills with Project Managers, Technical Office teams, Planning, Procurement, Finance, and Site teams. Ability to review, challenge, and validate information received from project teams with a strong attention to detail. Good command of written and spoken English. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously. Ability to work independently, take ownership, and communicate effectively with both project teams and senior management. Job Description Monitor and control technical office activities across ongoing projects from the Head Office. Review and verify project teams’ quantity take-offs, BOQs, progress payments (IPCs), and supporting documentation. Ensure that quantities, progress payments, and project records submitted by site/project teams are consistent with approved drawings, contracts, BOQs, and actual project progress. Review and control Variation Orders (VOs), additional works, omissions, and potential claims submitted by project teams. Prepare and monitor project budgets, cost plans, and workforce plans; analyze actual results and report deviations. Monitor project contracts and ensure that technical and commercial activities are carried out in accordance with contractual requirements. Review subcontractor and supplier progress claims and provide HQ-level control over quantities, rates, and contractual entitlements. Consolidate technical and commercial information received from different projects and prepare management reports. Monitor project budgets, committed costs, actual costs, forecasts, and potential cost deviations in coordination with Project Controls and Finance teams. Review and challenge project teams’ submissions where necessary to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with company procedures. Establish and maintain standardized technical office procedures, templates, and reporting formats across projects. Ensure proper documentation and traceability of quantities, IPCs, variations, claims, and contractual correspondence. Coordinate with Project Managers, Technical Office teams, Planning, Procurement, Finance, and Site teams to ensure consistency between project progress, costs, and contractual records. Provide technical and commercial support to project teams regarding contract interpretation, quantity control, progress payments, and variation management. Follow up on outstanding technical and commercial submissions and ensure timely completion of required actions by project teams. Prepare consolidated reports and presentations for senior management, highlighting project status, cost deviations, variations, claims, and key risks.

title: Sensör Sistemleri Geliştirme Mühendisi
description: BU POZİSYON, KIBRIS OFİSİMİZDE GÖREVLENDİRİLMEK ÜZERE AÇILMIŞTIR VE TAM ZAMANLI, OFİSTEN ÇALIŞMAYI GEREKTİRMEKTEDİR. RELOKASYON VE KONAKLAMA DESTEĞİ SAĞLANMAKTADIR. İnsansız hava araçları, modern çatışmaların maliyet dengesini ve harekât temposunu değiştiriyor. TMT, bu değişen harekât ortamı için otonom savunma sistemleri geliştiriyor. Kıbrıs ofisimizde görev alacak bir Sensör Sistemleri Geliştirme Mühendisi arıyoruz. Bu pozisyonda görev alacak mühendis, sistemlerimiz için sensör çözümlerini araştıracak; prototiplerini tasarlayacak, devreye alacak ve ölçecektir. Tasarım kararlarını hesap, simülasyon ve ölçümle doğrulayarak uygun çözümleri sahada kullanılabilecek donanıma dönüştürecek ve zaman içinde bu alanda teknik sorumluluk üstlenecektir. Bir sensör tasarımının simülasyondaki performansının laboratuvar ölçümleriyle, laboratuvardaki performansının da saha testleriyle doğrulanması gerekir. Bu performansı algılama fiziği kadar ön uç elektroniği, kart yerleşimi, kurulum ve çevredeki cihazlar da etkiler. Rolün odağı, farklı algılama yöntemlerini temel fiziğinden başlayarak araştırmak, prototiplerle sınamak ve ölçüm sonuçlarına dayanarak sahaya hazır donanıma dönüştürmektir. ARANAN NİTELİKLER Elektrik-Elektronik, Elektronik ve Haberleşme, Fizik veya ilgili mühendislik bölümlerinden mezun olmak. RF ve mikrodalga, akustik, sonar, optik veya benzeri alanlardan en az birinde sensör donanımı tasarımına yönelik uygulamalı deneyim sahibi olmak. Tasarladığı en az bir sensör devresini ya da kartını üretime göndermiş; prototipini devreye almış, ölçmüş ve ölçüm sonucuna göre revize etmiş olmak. Sistem gereksinimlerinden sensör donanımının mimarisini oluşturmuş ve bu mimari için blok ve komponent seçimi yapmış olmak. Daha önce çalışmadığı bir sensör türünü ya da algılama yöntemini kaynaklardan araştırıp temel fiziğini, sınırlarını ve uygulanabilirliğini hesapla ortaya koyabilmek. Bir sinyal zincirinin kazanç, gürültü ve dinamik aralık bütçesini çıkarabilmek (gürültü figürü, sinyal-gürültü oranı, doğrusallık vb.). Örnekleme, analog-sayısal dönüştürme ve sayısal sinyal işlemenin temellerini (filtreleme, FFT, spektral analiz) uygulamada kullanabilmek. Şematik ve PCB tasarım araçlarıyla (Altium, KiCad vb.) düşük seviyeli analog ya da RF sinyal taşıyan kartların şematik tasarımını ve yerleşimini yapmış ya da yönlendirmiş olmak. Alanına uygun bir simülasyon ya da modelleme aracıyla çalışmış olmak (SPICE, Keysight ADS, Ansys HFSS, CST, COMSOL vb.). Osiloskop, spektrum analizörü, VNA ya da veri toplama sistemleri gibi ölçüm cihazlarıyla ölçüm yapmış olmak; ölçüm düzeneğinden kaynaklanan hatayı donanımın gerçek davranışından ayırabilmek. Ölçüm verisini Python veya MATLAB ile işleyip değerlendirebilmek. İngilizce teknik kaynakları (veri sayfası, uygulama notu, makale) okuyup anlayabilmek. GÖREV VE SORUMLULUKLAR Farklı algılama yöntemlerini literatür, hesap ve deneylerle araştırmak; öne çıkanları hızlı prototiplerle denemek. Sistem gereksinimlerinden sensör gereksinimlerini ve donanım mimarisini çıkarmak; ödünleşim (trade-off) çalışmalarıyla blok ve komponent seçimini yapmak. Sensör ön ucunu ve sinyal zincirini (anten ya da dönüştürücü, yükselteç, filtre ve örnekleme katları) tasarlamak ve simüle etmek. Sensör kartlarının şematik tasarımını yapmak; PCB yerleşimini gerçekleştirmek veya yönlendirmek. Prototipleri devreye almak (bring-up), laboratuvarda ölçmek, hatalarını ayıklamak ve tasarımı ölçüm sonuçlarına göre revize etmek. Prototip verisini işleyerek tasarımın performansını değerlendirmek; bunun için gereken sinyal işleme yöntemlerini uygulamak. Kalibrasyon, kendi kendini test (self-test) ve arıza teşhis işlevlerini tasarıma dahil etmek. Elektromanyetik uyumluluk, ekranlama, ısıl yönetim ve muhafaza gereksinimlerini mekanik tasarımla birlikte ele almak. Sensör verisini işleyen yazılım ve sayısal donanım ekipleriyle donanım arayüzlerini ve veri biçimlerini birlikte belirlemek. Ölçüm ve test düzeneklerini kurmak ve işletmek; test prosedürlerini yazmak. PCB üretimi, dizgi ve komponent tedariki için tedarikçilerle teknik iletişimi yürütmek; tedarik riskini tasarım aşamasında değerlendirmek. Tasarım, ölçüm ve test sonuçlarını, çalışmaların ekip içinde sürdürülebilmesini sağlayacak biçimde belgelemek. Saha testlerine katılmak; sahada ortaya çıkan sensör donanımı sorunlarının kök nedenini bulmak. EK NİTELİKLER Elektronik, elektromanyetik, akustik veya sinyal işleme alanında yüksek lisans ya da doktora Birden fazla sensör türünde donanım geliştirmiş ya da test etmiş olmak RF performans parametreleri (P1dB, IP3, faz gürültüsü) ve kademe (cascade) bütçe analizi deneyimi Anten tasarımı ve anten ölçümü (yansımasız oda, yakın alan ölçümü) deneyimi Çok kanallı alıcı ya da veri toplama sistemleriyle çalışma deneyimi Yüksek hızlı veri dönüştürücüler (ADC/DAC), saat dağıtımı ve FPGA/SoC tabanlı sistemlerle çalışma deneyimi SDR tabanlı geliştirme deneyimi Bir sensör donanımını prototipten nitelendirme testlerine ve seri üretime taşımış olmak EMC ön ölçümleri ve MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-810 gibi askeri standartlar hakkında bilgi Python ile ölçüm cihazı otomasyonu deneyimi Savunma, havacılık, uzay, haberleşme veya test-ölçüm alanlarında sensör donanımı geliştirme deneyimi DİĞER KOŞULLAR T.C. veya K.K.T.C. vatandaşı olmak SAĞLANAN DESTEKLER Relokasyon desteği Şirket tarafından sağlanan konaklama Ulaşım desteği Özel sağlık sigortası Mesleki gelişim ve eğitim desteği

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description: Pozisyon Hakkında Çolakoğlu Grubu, yarım asrı aşan tecrübesi ile kuruluşundan bugüne kadar, güvenilirliği ve kalitesi açısından Türk sanayisinin öncü kuruluşları arasında yer almış ve hem kendisini hem de sektörü daha ileriye taşıma noktasında önemli adımlar atmıştır. En önemli değeri yetişmiş insan gücü olan ülkemizin daha gelişmiş ve uluslararası alanda söz sahibi olabilmesi adına hedefimiz, geleceği sizlerle şekillendirmektir. Bilişim sektöründe faaliyet gösteren grup şirketimiz Biltim Bilgisayar Hizmetleri A.Ş.'nin Data & AI ekibinde görevlendirilmek üzere, iş birimlerinin ihtiyaçlarını LLM tabanlı çözümlere (agent'lar, asistanlar, otomasyonlar) dönüştürecek bir Forward Deployed Engineer arıyoruz. CI/CD, konteynerleştirme ve izleme pratiklerine aşinalık İş birimleriyle doğrudan çalışmaktan keyif alan, teknik konuları sade anlatabilen İyi seviyede İngilizce (teknik dokümantasyon okuyabilecek düzeyde) Tercih Sebebimiz LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI Agents SDK veya benzeri bir agent framework'ü ile deneyim RAG (doküman arama) uygulamaları ve vektör veritabanları MCP (Model Context Protocol) hakkında bilgi Açık kaynak modellerin şirket içinde (vLLM vb.) çalıştırılmasına aşinalık MLflow, Kubernetes, Airflow gibi MLOps araçlarıyla deneyim Üretim / sanayi sektöründe çalışmış olmak Neler Sunuyoruz Üretim odaklı gerçek veriyle çalışma imkanı Alanında uzman bir ekiple, konusunda öncü bir ekibin parçası olma imkanı Stratejik projelerde aktif rol alma fırsatı Gelişim odaklı bir ekip ve mentorluk desteği Hibrit çalışma modeli

title: Ürün Geliştirme Kıdemli Uzmanı
description: Biz Kimiz? KKB olarak 30 yılı aşkın deneyimimizle veriyi güvenle yönetiyor, teknoloji ve uzmanlığımızla değere dönüştürüyoruz. Yapay zeka, bulut teknolojileri, veri analitiği ve sürdürülebilirlik gibi geleceği şekillendiren alanlara yaptığımız yatırımlarla finansal ekosistemin değişen ihtiyaçlarına yenilikçi çözümler sunuyoruz. Gücümüzü; farklı uzmanlıkları bir araya getiren, sürekli öğrenen, gelişen ve birlikte değer yaratan çalışma arkadaşlarımızdan alıyoruz. Yenilikçi bakış açılarına, iş birliğine ve gelişime önem veren çalışma kültürümüzle geleceği birlikte şekillendiriyoruz. Sen de fikirlerinle fark yaratmak, yetkinliklerini geliştirmek ve geleceğe değer katan bu ekibin bir parçası olmak ister misin? Ne sunuyoruz: Günümüzün ihtiyaçları doğrultusunda zamanın yönetimine karşılık veren ve esneklik sağlayan alternatif çalışma saati (08.00-17.00/09.00-18.00) sunuyoruz, Seni önemsiyoruz. Bu nedenle konforlu bir çalışma alanı sağlamakla birlikte bir yandan yeni bilgiler edinerek kendini geliştirebileceğin imkanları seninle buluşturmaktan mutluluk duyuyoruz, Udemy Business gibi platformlarda eğitim hakkı, teknik sertifika alımının karşılanması ve buna ek olarak yüksek lisans, doktora gibi programlarda eğitimine destek olarak kariyer yolculuğuna katkıda bulunuyoruz, Öğrenmenin ve eğitimin bir ömür devam ettiğini biliyoruz ve kariyer rotanda sana destek olabileceğini düşündüğümüz teknik, mesleki, kişisel gelişime yönelik eğitim programlarını ve gelişim fırsatlarını seninle buluşturuyoruz, Sosyal kulüplerimizle yeni hobiler keşfetmene ve takım arkadaşlarınla sosyal ortamda da bir sinerji yakalamana destek oluyoruz, Kurum olarak çalışan gönüllülüğüne önem veriyoruz. Tüm çalışanlarımız KKB Gönüllüleri Platformu çatısı altında sivil toplum kuruluşları ile sosyal sorumluluk projelerine katılabiliyor, ufak iyiliklerle büyük farklar yaratıyoruz, Sağlığını önemsiyoruz; sana ve sevdiklerine (eşin/çocukların) kapsamlı sağlık sigortası paketi ve unvandan bağımsız hayat sigorta güvencesi sunuyoruz, Gelecek hayallerin için Kurum Katkılı Bireysel Emeklilik planı oluşturuyoruz, Geçmiş kıdemlerini de düşünerek yıllık izin politikamızda toplam kıdemini baz alıyoruz, Doğum günü izni ve daha fazlası seni bekliyor! Hakkımızda daha detaylı bilgi alabilmek için lütfen bağlantıyı ziyaret edin. https://www.kkb.com.tr/hakkimizda Bu Rolde Nasıl Değer Katacaksın? KKB’nin temel ürünleri arasında yer alan Risk Merkezi ürünlerinin geliştirilmesi ve sürekli iyileştirilmesi süreçlerinde aktif rol üstleneceksin. Ürün ihtiyaçlarını analiz ederek iş gereksinimlerini, fonksiyonel isterleri, iş akışlarını ve kabul kriterlerini içeren kapsam dokümanlarını hazırlayacaksın. Üye kuruluşlarla çalışma grupları düzenleyerek ihtiyaç, beklenti ve geri bildirimleri değerlendirecek, yeni geliştirme fırsatlarının belirlenmesine katkı sağlayacaksın. Ürün yol haritasının oluşturulması ve güncellenmesi süreçlerine katkı sağlayacak, geliştirme taleplerinin önceliklendirilmesi ve ürün backlogunun yönetilmesinde aktif rol üstleneceksin. Bilgi Teknolojileri ekipleriyle yakın iş birliği içinde çalışarak geliştirme süreçlerini koordine edecek, iş planlarını, kritik bağımlılıkları ve aksiyonları takip edeceksin. Kullanıcı Kabul Testleri (KKT) kapsamında test senaryolarını hazırlayacak, testleri gerçekleştirecek ve tespit edilen bulguların çözümlenmesini takip edeceksin. Yeni geliştirmelerin canlıya alınmasının ardından sürüm sonrası kontrolleri gerçekleştirecek, ürünlerin tanımlanan gereksinimlere uygunluğunu değerlendireceksin. Risk Merkezi faaliyetlerine ilişkin mevzuat, düzenleme ve sektörel gelişmeleri takip ederek gerekli değişikliklerin ürün geliştirme süreçlerine yansıtılmasına katkı sağlayacaksın. Türkiye Bankalar Birliği (TBB) Risk Merkezi ile koordinasyon sağlayarak ürünlere yönelik ihtiyaçların, geliştirme taleplerinin ve ilgili süreçlerin takibini gerçekleştireceksin. Ürün Yönetimi ekibiyle iş birliği içinde çalışarak ürünlerin hayata geçirilmesi, eğitim ve bilgilendirme süreçlerine ürün geliştirme perspektifiyle destek vereceksin. Bu Rolde Senden Neler Bekliyoruz? title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description: About Us Kervan Yazılım was established as a subsidiary of Kervan Gıda to develop AI and data solutions. We build applications for every business process at Kervan Gıda, from production to supply chain and from sales to finance. We run these applications in production and measure the value they deliver. About the Role The Forward Deployed AI Engineer works on site with business teams to analyze processes end to end, and designs, builds and deploys AI-powered solutions. Key Responsibilities Process analysis: Examine production, planning, supply chain, quality, sales and finance processes end to end with business teams; identify bottlenecks, repetitive work and automation opportunities, and design the target process. title: Jeoteknik Mühendisi
description: POSITION DESCRIPTION – Geotechnical engıneer POSITION OVERVIEW Reports to: Geotechnical MANAGER Location: Kışladağ- UŞAK ABOUT US Tüprag A.Ş., a wholly owned subsidiary of Eldorado Gold Corporation in Turkey, is one of the 100 largest industrial enterprises in Turkey, operating for more than 35 years with around 1500 employees. Eldorado Gold, which continues its activities in different continents all over the world, is a listed company and its shares are traded on the Toronto and New York stock exchanges. In Turkey, it operates in Uşak - Kışladağ, one of the largest gold mines in Europe, and İzmir - Efemcukuru region. Its head office is in Ankara. As Tüprag A.Ş., we continue to contribute to our country in every sense with our principle of "People and Environment First, Mining Second", which we have adopted since the first day of our establishment in our company history of more than 35 years. POSITION DETAILS Our company, Tüprag Metal Madencilik, is seeking a skilled and/or to-be-trained Geotechnical Engineer to provide continuous operational geotechnical support to open-pit mining activities, ensuring that geotechnical hazards are identified, monitored, communicated, and controlled during each shift. at Kışladağ Gold Mine. The role will be responsible for enabling safe mining operations through proactive hazard identification, timely interpretation of monitoring data, and effective coordination with all health, safety, and environmental regulations. Key responsibilities are summarized below; To conduct systematic geotechnical inspections of active mining areas, pit walls, working benches, berms, haul roads, and access ramps using all geotechnical instrument data. To identify and report the potential slope instability mechanisms, including wedge failure, planar failure, toppling, rockfall, and progressive slope deformation. To interpret prism data to visualize them in 2D as heat maps (cumulative displacement in vertical and planimetric directions) as well as with cross sections, to understand the direction of movement and failure mechanism, and by comparing prism with InSAR data. To inspect identified geotechnical hazard areas and assess changes in their condition, and evaluate the potential impact of excavation activities, blasting, rainfall, and groundwater conditions on slope stability. To collect all necessary data for reporting and managing geotechnical risk in pit, dumps, and pads. Managing and supervising all drilling and installation of the sensor activities in pit, dumps, and pads. To Prepare a daily geotechnical shift report covering inspections, monitoring observations, identified hazards, and operational controls. To perform and review face/major structural mapping of rock slopes and cuts and stabilization measures. To reconcile mapped data with current pit cuts and update all mapping databases for modeling. To manage and supervise all wall-control studies in the pit. To collect and evaluate all hydrogeological data from all facilities and help to numeric modeling. To support the evaluation of blasting-related geotechnical risks. Working closely with Mine Planning, Drill and Blast, Operation, and Process departments to provide all necessary geotechnical support. VALUES Collaboration – We succeed together. Integrity – We are honest and do the right thing. Agility – We continuously assess, adapt, and navigate to find solutions. Courage – We embrace the unknown and face changes head-on. Drive – We persevere through adversity, remaining committed to delivering on our promises. QUALIFICATIONS, KNOWLEDGE & PREVIOUS EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS Bachelor's degree in Geological Engineering and Mining Engineering. 0-2 years of relevant geotechnical experience in the mining industry. Willingness and ability to work rotating day and night shifts Preferably internship or short-term experience working in open pit mines. Knowledge of open pit slope failure mechanisms and ground control practices Experience interpreting slope stability radar and prism monitoring data. Good command of GIS, Leapfrog, RocScience (Dips, Swedge, Rocplane, Slide, RS2), and Radar HMIs. Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. Good command of English (reading, writing, speaking). Teamwork, flexibility and communication skills.

title: Constructeur Werktuigbouwkunde
description: Aardappelen in je bloed, Techniek in je genen? Een machine ontwerpen is één ding. Begrijpen waarom een constructie werkt, waar de grenzen liggen en hoe je het nóg beter kunt maken? Dat is waar jouw technische expertise het verschil maakt. Als Constructeur ontwikkel jij inschuurtechniek waarin capaciteit, productvriendelijkheid en betrouwbaarheid samenkomen. Je combineert technische diepgang met praktisch inzicht en neemt verantwoordelijkheid van het eerste ontwerp tot de werkende machine. Jouw rol als constructeur Bij inschuurtechniek telt de hele keten. Elke overgang, aandrijving en constructieve keuze heeft invloed op de prestaties van de machine en de kwaliteit van het product. Jij doorziet die samenhang en vertaalt de behoeften van gebruikers naar doordachte mechanische oplossingen. Je ontwerpt, berekent en construeert machines en onderdelen die voldoen aan de functionele eisen en passen binnen de beoogde kostprijs. Daarbij neem je maakbaarheid, veiligheid, onderhoud en standaardisatie vanaf het begin mee. Je stelt kritische vragen, onderbouwt keuzes en zoekt actief naar mogelijkheden om onze machines verder te verbeteren. Wat ga je doen? Ontwerpen met inzicht in de praktijk Je bespreekt nieuwe ontwikkelingen en wijzigingen in het Roadmapoverleg met Productmanagement en Directie en vertaalt deze naar concrete ontwerpen. Je verdiept je in het gebruik van de machines en de omstandigheden waarin ze moeten presteren. Je zoekt daarbij de afstemming met klanten, collega’s en leveranciers. Je ontwikkelt en beoordeelt mechanische concepten op prestaties, betrouwbaarheid, produceerbaarheid en kosten. Je selecteert componenten in overleg met inkoop en leveranciers en weegt technische mogelijkheden af tegen prijs en beschikbaarheid. Je draagt bij aan een samenhangend machineprogramma door slimme standaardisatie en hergebruik van onderdelen en constructies. Van concept naar productie Je werkt ontwerpen uit in 3D en zorgt voor correcte werktekeningen, of begeleidt de Tekenaar bij de verdere detaillering. Je toetst ontwerpen samen met collega’s aan de specificaties en de uitgangspunten voor productie en standaardisatie. Je stelt het technisch constructiedossier op voor CE-conformiteit samen en houdt dit actueel bij wijzigingen. Je zorgt voor actuele eindcontroleformulieren, homologatiedocumenten en technische wijzigingsdocumentatie. Onderbouwen, beproeven en verbeteren Je onderbouwt constructieve keuzes met berekeningen en stemt specialistische analyses af binnen het team. Afhankelijk van jouw expertise voer je zelf sterkteberekeningen en FEM-analyses uit. Je begeleidt de Prototypebouwer en werkt actief mee bij de bouw van prototypes en vertaalt bevindingen naar verbeteringen. Je helpt productie en montage bij technische vraagstukken en werkt aan structurele oplossingen. Je benut ervaringen van montage, service en gebruikers om de betrouwbaarheid, het bedieningsgemak en de onderhoudsvriendelijkheid te verbeteren. Je ondersteunt de serviceafdeling, partners en klanten bij complexe technische problemen. Wat breng je mee? WO-werk- en -denkniveau , vanuit een relevante technische opleiding, zoals Werktuigbouwkunde, of een gelijkwaardig niveau opgebouwd door opleiding en ervaring. Gedegen kennis van machinebouw, mechanische constructies, materialen en productietechnieken. Ervaring met 3D-CAD, technisch tekenen en het zorgvuldig vastleggen van ontwerpen en wijzigingen. Het vermogen om complexe technische vraagstukken te analyseren en te vertalen naar heldere, praktisch uitvoerbare oplossingen. Betrokkenheid bij de agrarische sector en een sterke interesse in inschuurtechniek. Je wilt begrijpen wat telers en gebruikers nodig hebben en hoe onze machines bijdragen aan een efficiënte oogstverwerking met behoud van productkwaliteit. Initiatief en eigenaarschap: je signaleert verbeterkansen, maakt keuzes bespreekbaar en volgt jouw ontwerp tot in de praktijk. Een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse & Engelse taal in woord en geschrift. Wat bieden wij jou? Een uitstekend salaris, gemiddeld circa 15% boven de cao Metalektro. 40 vrije dagen per jaar: 27 vakantiedagen en 13 ATV-dagen. Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder pensioenopbouw en reiskostenvergoeding. Een eigen R&D-werkplaats waar ontwerpen worden omgezet in prototypes en getest. Korte lijnen met collega's uit engineering, productie, montage en service. Een informele, nuchtere werksfeer met betrokken collega's en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Uitdagende technische projecten en mogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Iedere dag gratis soep, vers fruit, goede koffie en fris water in onze kantine. Over Dewulf Dewulf is een internationale topspeler en full-liner in machines voor de teelt van aardappelen en wortelgewassen. Vanuit onze vestigingen in België, Nederland en Roemenië ontwikkelen en produceren we machines voor onder andere grondbewerking, poten, oogsten, inschuren, sorteren en transporteren. Als familiebedrijf met meer dan 80 jaar ervaring combineren we een stevige technische basis met de ambitie om continu te vernieuwen. Bij Dewulf in Winsum werk je samen met circa 180-200 collega's aan machines waarin innovatie, betrouwbaarheid en praktische toepasbaarheid centraal staan. We geloven in vernieuwend denken, afspraken nakomen, prettig samenwerken en met de klant meedenken over economisch verantwoorde oplossingen. Die overtuiging zie je terug in onze producten én in de manier waarop we met elkaar werken.

title: Primair Engineer | Werktuigbouwkunde | Mechanical Engineering | Hoogspanning
description: Van technische concepten tot complete primaire installaties: zet jouw werktuigbouwkundige expertise in voor het energienet van morgen. Welkom bij Akkodis Als Primair Engineer bij Akkodis in Enter werk je op onze interne projectafdeling aan de engineering van hoogspanningsstations van 110 tot 380 kV. Je ontwerpt primaire installaties, waarbij je componenten zoals meettransformatoren, vermogensschakelaars en scheiders technisch uitwerkt en positioneert. Daarbij houd je rekening met de samenhang en de beschikbare ruimte binnen het station. Van grote, meerjarige projecten tot kleinere projecten van enkele maanden: de engineering verzorgen we volledig in eigen huis. Samen met een team van engineers en tekenaars werk je aan zowel de nieuwbouw als de uitbreiding en renovatie van hoogspanningsstations. Je ontwikkelt concepten, werkt ontwerpen uit in Inventor en onderbouwt jouw keuzes met berekeningen. Je werkt nauw samen met collega's uit de primaire en secundaire engineering. Sommigen zijn net gestart, anderen werken al tientallen jaren bij Akkodis. De lijnen zijn kort, de sfeer is nuchter en collega's helpen elkaar graag verder. Ze delen hun kennis, maar staan ook open voor jouw ideeën over oplossingen of verbeteringen. Of je nu jarenlange ervaring meebrengt of nog nieuw bent in de hoogspanning, jouw inbreng telt mee. Hoe ziet jouw werkdag eruit als Primair Engineer? Vertalen van klanteisen naar technische oplossingen Ontwerpen en engineeren van primaire installaties Uitwerken van 3D-ontwerpen in Inventor Positioneren van hoogspanningscomponenten Componenten samenbrengen tot één geheel Onderbouwen van keuzes met berekeningen Oplossen van diverse ontwerpvraagstukken Opstellen en controleren van documentatie Afstemmen met engineers en projectleiding Wat je daarnaast oppakt als je je rol graag verbreedt: Junior engineers en stagiairs begeleiden Kennis delen binnen het engineeringteam Meedenken over standaarden en verbeteringen Een goede match Jij bent een engineer die graag technische vraagstukken uitpluist en verschillende oplossingen tegen elkaar afweegt. Je denkt mee over ontwerpkeuzes, waarbij je oog hebt voor de praktische uitvoerbaarheid. Daarbij zoek je makkelijk de samenwerking op met collega's uit andere disciplines en neem je verantwoordelijkheid voor de kwaliteit van je werk. Hoe word jij succesvol als Primair Engineer? Achtergrond in Werktuigbouwkunde of Mechatronica Ervaring met mechanisch ontwerpen en engineeren Bekend met Inventor of vergelijkbare software Ruimtelijk inzicht en kennis van constructies Oog voor maakbaarheid en detaillering Ook zonder ervaring binnen de hoogspanning kun je bij ons aan de slag. Met jouw werktuigbouwkundige achtergrond en de begeleiding van ervaren collega's maak je je de primaire engineering snel eigen. Jij staat centraal Bij Akkodis hoeft niet iedere engineer dezelfde kant op te groeien. Misschien wil je je verder verdiepen in de primaire engineering, je expertise inzetten binnen andere werktuigbouwkundige projecten of juist meer verantwoordelijkheid nemen als Lead Engineer of Projectleider. Welke richting je ook kiest, we kijken samen hoe je daar kunt komen. Met passende projecten en opleidingen helpen we je om die volgende stap te zetten. Stap jij aan boord? Salaris van €3.500 tot €5.000, met ruimte voor verdere groei en aanvullende bonusregelingen Kies of je 32, 36 of 40 uur werkt, zodat het bij jou past Comfortabel op pad met een leaseauto of vergoeding Flexibele werktijden en mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken Tot wel 36 vakantiedagen om tot rust te komen Toegang tot bedrijfsfitness, fietsplan en gratis fruit Gunstige pensioenregeling voor later Teamuitjes en gave events om te connecten Trainingen, cursussen, coaching en kennissessies Persoonlijk Ontwikkelplan gericht op jouw groei Doorgroeien naar Expert, Lead Engineer of Projectleider: jij bepaalt jouw carrièrepad! title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description: Mechanical Design Engineer (NOTE no visa sponsorship available and must be living in Ireland) About Your New Employer Join an established specialist engineering business designing and manufacturing capital equipment for the pharmaceutical industry. Work alongside a highly skilled mechanical design team on complex, technically challenging equipment used within the life sciences sector. Develop your career in a collaborative engineering environment focused on quality, innovation and technical excellence. Your new employer specialises in the design and manufacture of specialist pharmaceutical equipment. The business works on complex engineering projects where precision, quality and compliance with industry standards are essential. About Your New Job As a Mechanical Design Engineer, you will translate client requirements into production-ready mechanical designs for the fabrication of pharmaceutical equipment. You will: Design and draft mechanical equipment using 3D and 2D CAD, primarily in Solid Edge, SolidWorks or Autodesk Inventor. Review client User Requirement Specifications and develop concepts, detailed designs, general arrangements, manufacturing drawings, parts lists and assembly documentation. Work as part of a project core team to deliver projects within agreed schedules and budgeted hours. Act as the mechanical design Subject Matter Expert throughout the project lifecycle, supporting fabrication and assembly teams with technical and manufacturability queries. Lead Stage-Gate design reviews and manage the approval process for general arrangement drawings and P&IDs with clients. Lead the development of ergonomic mock-up reviews. Develop Bills of Materials, support supplier identification and liaise with procurement, ERP and PLM teams. Support project scheduling, change management and the preparation of Variation Change Requests for client approval. Support the preparation and execution of Factory Acceptance Testing and Site Acceptance Testing protocols. What Skills You Need A degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline. At least three years’ experience in the mechanical design of machines or specialist equipment. Strong proficiency in 3D CAD, ideally Solid Edge. Experience with SolidWorks or Autodesk Inventor will also be considered. Experience with sheet metal design and the generation of flat patterns. Proven experience in concept design, detailed design and the production of manufacturing documentation. A strong understanding of design for manufacture, fabrication and machining. Experience working within the life sciences industry and knowledge of Good Documentation Practices. Knowledge of ATEX, CE, UL and general machine safety standards. title: Safety Engineer - Machinery Safety & CE Marking
description: How do you make a machine safer while it’s still being designed? At DIS/CREADIS, you’ll work alongside the engineers building it, turning risk assessments, legislation and standards into practical design decisions. You’ll take responsibility for machinery safety and CE marking from the first concept through validation and final documentation. You’ll join our Software and Control Systems department, where we deliver automation solutions across industries. You’ll work closely with software, controls, electrical and mechanical engineers and help shape how we approach machinery safety across DIS/CREADIS. What you’ll do Take responsibility for machinery safety and CE marking across all project phases, from concept and risk assessment to technical documentation and the final declaration. Apply the Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 and carry out risk assessments in accordance with EN ISO 12100. Work with design teams to define practical risk-reduction measures, including guards, safety distances, interlocks and emergency stops. Assess the electrical safety of machinery in accordance with EN 60204-1. Specify and validate safety-related control systems in accordance with EN ISO 13849, including determining the required performance level (PLr) and calculating the achieved performance level (PL). Advise project teams and clients on applicable legislation, standards and conformity requirements, including EMC, ATEX and PED where relevant. Prepare and review technical documentation for CE marking, including risk assessments, validation records and declarations. Work closely with mechanical, electrical and automation engineers to ensure that safety requirements are integrated into the complete machine solution. Support client discussions, design reviews, commissioning and final verification as needed. Machinery safety is your core responsibility. When the project portfolio calls for it, you’ll also contribute to electrical engineering and automation tasks. What you’ll bring You can take a safety requirement, explain what it means for the design and work with engineers to implement and document a practical solution. At least three years of relevant experience in machinery safety, CE marking or functional safety. A good working knowledge of European machinery legislation and relevant safety standards. Experience translating safety requirements into technical solutions and clear documentation. A structured approach and the ability to work independently across project phases. Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across mechanical, electrical and automation disciplines. A relevant technical or engineering background, such as electrical, mechanical or marine engineering, or an equivalent qualification. Fluency in English. Danish is an advantage. An interest in automation and the flexibility to support related engineering tasks. Experience with PLC programming or electrical design is an advantage. What makes this role different As the dedicated Safety Engineer in Software and Control Systems, you’ll have a say in design decisions while there’s still room to change them. You’ll work independently on the CE marking process, with experienced colleagues in automation, electrical design and mechanical engineering to draw on. You’ll also help develop the methods and expertise we use across projects. Our informal culture, quick decision-making and hybrid working model give you room to take ownership and see your ideas through from design to commissioning. About DIS/CREADIS DIS/CREADIS is an international engineering consultancy that helps leading companies develop and scale advanced technologies across industries. We offer the scope and opportunities of a global organisation, with the trust to take ownership of your work and the room to grow. You’ll join a community of engineers who hold themselves to high technical standards, share expertise and learn from one another. Could this be your next role? If you’d like to specialise in machinery safety while staying close to the design and automation work, we’d like to meet you. Apply for the Safety Engineer role in Stilling. We’d love to hear about the projects you’ve worked on and what you’d like to do next. location: Kongens Lyngby, Danimarka Başkent Bölgesi, Danimarka
description: Job Description The Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering of the Technical University of Denmark (DTU) has an open PhD position on the topic of “Abrasive flow polishing of metallic, ceramic, and multi-material impellers”. The position is in the context of the project Turbo Impact - TURBOmachinery Innovative Manufacturing, Processing, Analysis, Characterization, and Topology, a new Marie Skłodowska Curie (MSCA) Doctoral Network Programme funded by the European Commission, that brings together 6 universities and 12 industry partners from 9 countries. Find more information at https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101311350 . Turbo Impact trains a new generation of creative and innovative manufacturing and materials researchers, with strong analytical, computational, and experimental skills and a deep understanding of all aspects of producing metallic, ceramic and multi-material small scale turbomachinery components and systems. In the framework of the doctoral network, the PhD student will work closely with a cohort of 14 PhD students working on different but related topics within the domain of turbomachinery components design and manufacturing. General And Project Specific Eligibility Requirements All applicants must fulfil the following general eligibility criteria, or otherwise will be rejected: must have completed a Master's degree or equivalent at the time of start. must not have a doctoral degree at the date of their recruitment; must comply with the mobility rules, where they must not have resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in the country of the recruiting organization for more than 12 months, at any point during the 36 months immediately before their recruitment date (short stays such as holidays or compulsory military service are not taken into account); Essential Language Requirements The working language of Turbo Impact is English. Responsibilities And Qualifications The PhD position is hosted by DTU Construct's Section for Manufacturing Engineering. The research focuses on the development, modelling and experimental validation of abrasive flow polishing process for precision metallic, ceramic and multi-material components used in high-performance turbomachinery applications. The project aims to develop processes, fixtures, tools and models enabling time- and space-controlled material removal applied to AM-produced multi-material components to support ultra-fine surface finish and structural integrity of surface and subsurface, for improved component performance, durability and reliability. Key research activities include: Development of micro/nano scale material removal modelling for abrasive flow polishing of small-scale shrouded impellers. Development of innovative small/micro flow polishing setup including sensing and control. Application of developed process solutions to realization of small-scale shrouded impellers for validation of improvements. The project will utilize a combination of existing and newly developed equipment to generate data, produce test parts and implement closed loop control. Industrial validation will be conducted in collaboration with partner companies. The position involves both theoretical and experimental work, with responsibilities spanning project execution and academic dissemination. The candidate will be expected to: Position the scientific work within the context of current literature. Collaborate with academic and industrial partners through workshops, case studies, and co-development activities. Publish findings in peer-reviewed journals and present results at international conferences. Contribute to teaching, supervision, and student activities within the Section for Manufacturing Engineering. We are looking for candidates with: An excellent academic background in production engineering, mechanical engineering, materials engineering or related fields. Strong knowledge of manufacturing processes and systems applied to metallic and ceramic materials and related characterization techniques. Experience with manufacturing metrology and programming tools such as MATLAB or Python. Familiarity with Machine Learning techniques is a strong asset. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in interdisciplinary teams. Excellent written and spoken English. You should have completed a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) in Mechanical, Production or Materials Engineering, or related discipline, or a similar degree with an equivalent academic level. Approval and Enrolment The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education . Assessment The assessment of the applicants will be made by Associate Professor Giuliano Bissacco according to the qualification requirements stated above. We offer DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility. The Role In this position, you will bridge the gap between two distinct mechanical engineering disciplines: Precision Drug Delivery Devices: Designing compact, patient-centric wearable or handheld delivery systems (e.g., autoinjectors, patch pumps, inhalation devices) requiring tight tolerances, micro-mechanisms, spring/gear trains, fluid-path sealing, and Design for High-Volume Manufacturing (DFM/DFA) using injection-molded polymers. Key Responsibilities End-to-End Mechanical Design: Lead 3D CAD modeling, tolerance stack-up analysis (GD&T), and mechanism design for both micro-scale disposables/wearables and large-scale capital hardware. Qualifications & Experience Required: Education: Bachelor's degree (B.Eng. / B.S.) in Mechanical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or a related discipline (Master's degree preferred). Experience: 5+ years of mechanical product development experience within the medical device industry (or another heavily regulated industry such as aerospace or automotive). Dual-Domain Capability: Proven track record designing either small-scale precision mechanisms/injection-molded devices or complex electro-mechanical capital equipment-with strong foundational physics and a demonstrated aptitude to work across both scales. CAD & Analysis Mastery: Expert proficiency in 3D CAD (SolidWorks, Creo, or NX), GD&T (ASME Y14.5), and statistical tolerance analysis. Manufacturing Knowledge: Deep understanding of injection molding (polymer selection, tooling, ultrasonic/laser welding) as well as capital equipment fabrication (sheet metal, die casting, extrusions, structural frames). Regulatory Literacy: Hands-on experience working within an ISO 13485 Quality Management System, including authoring risk assessments and verification protocols. title: PhD scholarship in Phase-Field Modelling of Corrosion Fatigue - DTU Construct
location: Kongens Lyngby, Danimarka Başkent Bölgesi, Danimarka
description: Job Description Are you fascinated by how materials fail, and would you like to build the simulation tools that can predict it? As a PhD student in the Materials Mechanics group in the Section of Solid Mechanics at DTU Construct, you will help develop the first quantitative, physics-based models for corrosion fatigue – the combined action of a corrosive environment and cyclic loading that limits the lifetime of offshore wind turbines, ships, bridges and pipelines. You will work at the intersection of solid mechanics, electrochemistry and scientific computing. The position is part of the project “Advanced Phase-Field Models for Corrosion Fatigue” (CorFat), funded by the Independent Research Fund Denmark and headed by Professor Christian F. Niordson. The project is carried out in collaboration with international academic partners and the energy company Vattenfall. Responsibilities And Qualifications Engineering design against corrosion fatigue still relies on empirical knock-down factors. In CorFat, we instead resolve the underlying mechanisms by coupling electro-chemo-mechanical modelling with phase-field descriptions of both the evolving metal–electrolyte interface and the cracks – from pit growth, through the pit-to-crack transition, to fatigue crack growth. Your overall focus will be to extend the project’s Julia-based finite element framework into a predictive tool for corrosion fatigue. Your primary tasks will be to: Take ownership of the existing Julia code and develop it further in a well-documented and well-tested way Couple phase-field corrosion models with mechanics, including mechanically enhanced dissolution and passive film rupture Develop phase-field fatigue formulations for crack initiation from pits and subsequent crack growth, including efficient cycle-jump schemes Publish your results in leading international journals and present them at conferences Collaborate with our partners in Denmark and abroad, including an external research stay You have: A strong background in solid mechanics and the finite element method Good programming skills – experience with Julia is an advantage, but experience with a comparable language (e.g., Python, C++, Fortran or MATLAB) is also relevant An interest in multi-physics problems; knowledge of fracture and fatigue, phase-field modelling or electrochemistry is an advantage Good communication skills in written and spoken English You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree. Approval and Enrolment The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education . Assessment The assessment of the applicants will be made by Professor Christian F. Niordson. We offer DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility. Salary and appointment terms The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures . The period of employment is 3 years. The starting date is 1 February 2027 (or according to mutual agreement). The position is a full-time position. You can read more about career paths at DTU here . Further information Further information may be obtained from Professor Christian F. Niordson, cfni@dtu.dk , tel.: +45 4525 4287. You can read more about Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering at www.construct.dtu.dk . If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark . Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “ PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar ” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. Application procedure Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 7 December 2026 (23:59 Danish time) . Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file . The file must include: A letter motivating the application (cover letter) Curriculum vitae Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale You may apply prior to ob­tai­ning your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. Applications received after the deadline will not be considered. All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position. DTU Civil and Mechanical Engineering develops and utilises science and technical knowledge for the benefit of society and the sustainable development. We undertake research, education, innovation, and scientific advice of the highest quality within building design and processes, building construction and safety, building energy and technical services, solid mechanics, fluid mechanics, coastal and maritime engineering, materials technology, manufacturing engineering, engineering systems design, design for sustainability, and thermal energy.

title: Asansör Bakım ve Arıza Teknisyeni
description: Brenner Forge | İstanbul Anadolu Yakası Brenner Forge olarak asansör ve yürüyen merdiven alanındaki teknik uzmanlığımızı saha deneyimimizle birleştiriyoruz. Yeni kurulumdan bakım, onarım ve modernizasyona kadar her çalışmamızda mükemmel hizmet anlayışımızı esas alıyor, yolcu güvenliğini ve sistemlerin güvenilirliğini ön planda tutuyoruz. Bir hastanede, bir iş merkezinde ya da yoğun bir istasyonda asansörlerin ve yürüyen merdivenlerin güvenle ve kesintisiz çalışması, bu alanların gün boyu erişilebilir kalmasına katkı sağlar. Brenner Forge olarak önceliğimiz, insanların bulundukları yapıda bağımsız ve güvenli biçimde hareket edebilmesi ve kullandıkları sistemlere her gün aynı güveni duyabilmesidir. Sizi de Brenner Forge ekibine katılmaya, hizmette fark yaratmaya ve insanların günlük yaşamına değer katmaya davet ediyoruz. İstanbul Anadolu Yakası’ndaki servis ekibimizde görev alacak Asansör ve Yürüyen Merdiven Bakım ve Arıza Teknisyeni arıyoruz. Görev ve sorumluluklar Sorumluluğunuzdaki asansör ve yürüyen merdivenlerin periyodik bakımlarını bakım planına, teknik talimatlara ve iş güvenliği kurallarına uygun şekilde gerçekleştirmek. Arıza çağrılarına müdahale etmek, elektriksel ve mekanik arızaların kaynağını belirlemek ve yetkiniz kapsamındaki onarımları yapmak. Bakım veya onarım sonrasında, üniteyi yeniden hizmete almadan önce gerekli işlev ve güvenlik kontrollerini tamamlamak. Saha kontrollerinde tespit ettiğiniz aşınmaları, güvenlik risklerini ve parça değişim ihtiyaçlarını raporlamak. Tekrarlayan arızalarda ünitenin bakım ve arıza geçmişini inceleyerek teknik ekiple birlikte kalıcı çözümler geliştirmek. Yapılan işlemleri servis formuna kaydetmek ve bina veya tesis sorumlusunu ünitenin durumu, tamamlanan çalışmalar ve varsa sonraki adımlar hakkında bilgilendirmek. Aradığımız nitelikler Meslek lisesi veya meslek yüksekokulunun asansör, elektrik, elektronik, mekatronik ya da ilgili teknik bölümlerinden mezun olmak. Asansör veya yürüyen merdiven sistemlerinin bakım ve arıza süreçlerinde saha deneyimine sahip olmak. Her iki sistemde de deneyim tercih sebebidir. Elektrik şemalarını okuyabilmek ve arıza tespitinde ölçüm cihazlarını kullanabilmek. İş güvenliği kurallarını titizlikle uygulamak, ekip arkadaşları ve müşteri temsilcileriyle açık iletişim kurabilmek. B sınıfı sürücü belgesine sahip olmak, aktif araç kullanmak ve İstanbul Anadolu Yakası’nda saha çalışmasına uygun olmak.
