title: End User Support Technician
description: Spektrum supports apex purchasers (NATO, UN, EU, and National Government and Defence) and their Tier 1 supplier ecosystem with a wide range of specialist services. We provide our clients with professional services, specialised aerospace and defence sales, delivery, and operational subject matter expertise. We are looking for personnel to join our team and support key client projects. Who we are supporting The NATO Communication and Information Agency (NCIA) is responsible for providing secure and effective communications and information technology (IT) services to NATO's member countries and its partners. The agency was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium. The NCIA provides a wide range of services, including: Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats. Command and Control Systems: The NCIA develops and maintains the systems used by NATO's military commanders to plan and execute operations. Satellite Communications: The NCIA provides satellite communications services to enable secure and reliable communications between NATO forces. Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks. Information Management: The NCIA manages NATO's information technology infrastructure, including its databases, applications, and servers. Overall, the NCIA plays a critical role in ensuring the security and effectiveness of NATO's communication and information technology capabilities. The program Assistance and Advisory Service (AAS) The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCI Agency) is NATO's principal C3 capability deliverer and CIS service provider. It provides, maintains and defends the NATO enterprise-wide information technology infrastructure to enable Allies to consult together under Article IV, and, when required, stand together in the face of attack under Article V. To provide these critical services, in the modern evolving dynamic environment the NCI Agency needs to build and maintain high performance-engaged workforce. The NCI Agency workforce strategically consists of three major categorise's: NATO International Civilians (NIC)'s, Military (Mil), and Interim Workforce Consultants (IWC)'s. The IWCs are a critical part of the overall NCI Agency workforce and make up approximately 15 percent of the total workforce. The service Spektrum delivers end-to-end Communications and Information Systems (CIS) services to NATO CIS Support Units on an outcome basis: service desk and end-user support, provisioning and IMAC, CIS operations, systems, network and cyber security services, collaboration and VTC, logistics and configuration management, engineering, projects, exercise and surge support, service transition and training. Personnel work as part of one integrated, cleared on-site team, under Task Orders issued by the client, and are cross-assigned across services within their competence. Internal reference – Labour categories covered L1 Service Desk Technician L2 CIS Technician L3 Desktop Support Specialisty End User Support Technician Role Background The End User Support Technician provides first and second line support to the users of NATO CIS services. The role covers the service desk, the provisioning and installation of end-user equipment (P-IMAC) and the restoration of faulty devices, working within ITSM-driven processes and agreed service levels. Assignments may be delivered in normal working hours, extended hours or on a shift basis, including nights and weekends. Role Duties and Responsibilities Act as a point of contact for users through the service desk: log, categorise, prioritise, diagnose and resolve incidents and service requests at first or second line, escalating with complete information where required. Create, modify, reset and verify user accounts, passwords, MFA and access rights (Active Directory, Exchange) against approved requests. Install, configure and troubleshoot client software, from office automation to specialised and NATO-specific applications, verifying licensing and validating the result with the user. Prepare and provision end-user devices (desktops, laptops, thin clients, mobile devices, printers and peripherals): imaging and OS deployment, domain join, security baseline, role software and inventory registration. Carry out installs, moves, adds and changes (IMAC), including transport, reconnection, functional testing and user acceptance. Restore faulty devices to service: collect, rebuild or repair to the standard build, restore data, test and return the device to the user. Implement standard and pre-authorised changes in line with the change management process. Perform routine checks on assigned endpoints (update and patch status, configuration compliance, connectivity). Record all work in the service management tool so that every ticket is traceable and auditable, and contribute to knowledge articles and work instructions. Support major incidents, exercises and events, including on-call, extended hours and shift work when required. Essential Skills, Experience and Certifications Higher vocational training or secondary education in IT or a related discipline. At least two years of end-user IT support experience (service desk, desktop or deskside support) in an enterprise or operational environment. Hands-on installation, configuration and troubleshooting of Windows 10/11, Microsoft Office/Microsoft 365 and Outlook/Exchange clients. User administration in Active Directory and Exchange. Device imaging and deployment using SCCM/MECM, Intune or equivalent tools; hardware troubleshooting of desktops, laptops, printers and peripherals. Set-up and support of mobile devices (including iOS), remote access/VPN and wireless connectivity. Basic networking knowledge (IP addressing, DNS/DHCP, LAN and Wi-Fi connectivity checks). Experie

title: R&D Engineer II
description: Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact. A Day in the Life As a R&D Engineer II at Medtronic Articulating Technologies, you will get the opportunity to develop advanced medical devices in order to enable next generation surgical procedures. You will gain knowledge and experience covering the full engineering domain of product and process development from conceptual design up to market introduction and scale-up. In a team of engineers, you will work on design, development and testing of surgical instruments and the development of their related manufacturing processes. You will improve product performance and manufacturability by calculating, modelling, prototyping and testing. Furthermore, you will get the chance to master high-tech manufacturing processes such as laser cutting, cleaning, laser welding and assembly. You will be part of our talented team of specialists, and you will learn from our experts who will help you to develop yourself in your role as R&D Engineer. Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned: Assist in designing surgical instruments and related components, supporting new product development from concept through verification and market introduction. You will be responsible creating and maintaining technical drawings and technical documentation. Perform engineering analyses, calculations, and modelling to evaluate product performance, reliability, and manufacturability. Build and test prototypes, execute experiments, and analyze results to support design improvements and technical decision-making. Support development and optimization of manufacturing processes, including technologies such as laser cutting, laser welding, cleaning, and assembly. Collaborate with cross functional teams (engineering, manufacturing, quality, and supply chain) to ensure successful product and process development. Together with experts in mechanics, mechatronics, electronics, software, and mathematics, you will bring high-tech solutions to life, such as advanced lithography machines, compact electron microscopes or medical devices that automate human tissue analysis. From our office in Eindhoven and sometimes at our clients' premises you like to keep yourself busy with: Close collaboration with customers, fellow architects, the Project Manager, Account Manager, and the broader project team to ensure alignment and synergy. You translate customer needs into specifications, define mechanical architecture, budgets, and conceptual designs of (sub)systems. Specification of test and integration requirements to complete the V-model development cycle and ensure product design quality. Building and maintaining internal and external networks to support organizational growth and success. Drive innovation by introducing new technologies and solutions, applying theoretical principles in practical project contexts. Lead by example, motivating designers and engineers to take ownership of their deliverables. As an Architect Mechanics, you manage broader, more complex scopes of work, including stakeholder management, technical leadership, and guiding larger multidisciplinary teams. Sounds good so far? We'd love to tell you more… Your future workplace This is what you bring to the table MSc or PhD in Mechanical or Mechatronic Engineering. Proven track record in mechanical design within high-tech systems and/or equipment. 10 to 15 years of experience in mechatronic and precision system design, depending on seniority level. Broad multidisciplinary orientation, understanding how mechanical expertise integrates within complex systems. Strong analytical and abstract thinking skills, with proficiency in various analysis methods. Excellent communication skills for effective collaboration with both internal and external stakeholders. Recognized as a technical leader and inspirational coach, with deep theoretical and practical knowledge in technical design, mechanisms, precision mechanics, and Design for Excellence (DfX). This is what you can expect in return from Sioux Flexible 32-40 hour working week, with room to work from home. A healthy work-life balance is very important to us. We have 28 holidays with an option to buy an additional 12 holidays. You will work with passionate colleagues who share your drive for technology and business success. By combining our expertise in software, electronics, mechanics, mechatronics, mathematics and assembly, we make the impossible possible for our customers and get to work on challenging high-tech projects. You get a lot of freedom and responsibility; after all, you know exactly what you are doing. Personal coaching and a training budget of €6000 per year, so that you can continue to develop yourself. We also find it important to have fun together. We organize a lot for our employees, from family festivals and sparkling Christmas parties, to inspiring knowledge sessions for the high-tech community. Our Sioux office is located in a prime location in the heart of the Brainport region. At our main office you can enjoy lunch, sports, making music, and sharing your knowledge with colleagues in one of our Tech Labs. High Tech & High Fun We can tell you all about the typical Sioux culture and the challenging high-tech projects. About how you can develop yourself like nowhere else. Programming skills in Python and/or MATLAB for engineering purposes. title: Staff Mechanical Design Engineer - Plastics
description: About Us Machnet Medical Robotics (MMR), founded in 2020, is on a mission to revolutionise medical robotics. Our guiding principle is simple: innovation must improve patient outcomes, support clinicians without disrupting their workflows, and empower healthcare staff rather than add to their burden. MMR is well funded, with long-term investors and a strong financial foundation. Our hardware and software teams have developed a fully functional medical robotic platform that has successfully completed animal trials. We are now refining the mechanical design for production, with a focus on safety, reliability, manufacturability and scalability, as we prepare our technology for deployment in hospitals worldwide. About the Role We are seeking a Staff Mechanical Design Engineer to own the design and industrialisation of the sterile, single-use plastic consumables of our robotic platform. These are the parts clinicians load, handle and discard in every procedure, and they form the interface between the robot and interventional devices such as catheters and guidewires. They must be intuitive to use, safe, and economical to produce at volume. Based in central London, you will hold a senior, hands-on technical position focused on plastic part design for high-volume manufacture. You will take designs from concept through prototyping, verification and transfer to manufacture, working closely with electrical, software, systems, clinical, quality and regulatory colleagues. Key Responsibilities • Design, develop and refine sterile single-use plastic consumables and assemblies, including the mechanical interfaces between the consumables, the reusable robot and the sterile barrier • Own consumable designs from early concept through prototyping, testing and production readiness • Design for high-volume manufacture, covering injection-moulded parts and joining methods such as snap fits, ultrasonic welding, adhesive bonding and overmoulding • Select materials with biocompatibility, sterilisation compatibility, shelf life, performance and cost in mind • Define tolerances and carry out stack-up analyses across moulded parts and robot-to-consumable interfaces • Iterate quickly using 3D printing, prototype tooling and machined parts, and build test fixtures to characterise device grip, friction and loading forces • Work with clinical and usability colleagues so that setup, loading and device exchange are fast, intuitive and error-resistant for gloved users in a sterile field • Contribute to the packaging, sterilisation and shelf-life strategy with quality, regulatory and external partners • Engage with moulders, toolmakers and contract manufacturers on design for manufacture and assembly, tooling reviews, first-article inspection and process validation • Reduce part count and unit cost without compromising safety or performance • Establish and follow engineering best practices, documentation standards and design controls, and contribute to risk management activities • Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior and mid-level engineers • Drive continuous improvement of existing designs based on testing, user feedback and field learnings Who We're Looking For • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field • 6+ years of mechanical design experience, including significant work on single-use medical devices or comparable high-volume plastic products • Strong plastic part design skills and a solid understanding of injection moulding, including tooling, draft, shrinkage and gating considerations • Solid understanding of materials, tolerances and scalable assembly processes • Hands-on experience with rapid prototyping methods such as 3D printing, laser cutting and CNC machining • Proficiency in parametric CAD tools such as SolidWorks • Proven ability to take ownership of designs and deliver them from concept to production • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative startup environment • Eligibility to work on-site at our central London office Experience We Value • Experience developing sterile consumables for robotic, catheter-based or other interventional systems • Knowledge of sterilisation methods (such as ethylene oxide, gamma and e-beam) and their effects on materials and packaging • Familiarity with biocompatibility evaluation (ISO 10993) and sterile barrier packaging (ISO 11607) • Exposure to design controls, risk management, and verification and validation activities under ISO 13485 and ISO 14971 • Experience applying usability engineering (IEC 62366) to devices handled by clinical users • Familiarity with cleanroom assembly, contract manufacturers, process validation (IQ/OQ/PQ) and production ramp-up • Startup experience or comfort working across disciplines and shifting priorities • Experience contributing to patents or protecting mechanical intellectual property Why Join Us? At MMR, you will work at the intersection of robotics, AI and healthcare, building technology that directly affects patient care and clinical outcomes. You will join a mission-driven, collaborative team where your technical expertise will shape the future of medical robotics. We believe technology must serve people responsibly. Human-centred innovation, integrity and long-term responsibility guide how we design our products and how we support our team members' growth and well-being. What We Offer • An international, interdisciplinary team based in central London and Zwolle, Netherlands • A key technical role in a rapidly growing medical device startup with global ambitions • A central London office with a well-equipped prototyping space • Ongoing professional development through training, workshops and conferences • An inclusive, supportive workplace culture • A competitive salary package aligned with industry standards

Experience working within formal engineering processes, such as design reviews, documented requirements and standards. Hardware that has launched. Basic FEA familiarity, MGSE or ground-support equipment design, and electromechanical packaging.

Familiarity with APQP, FMEA and control plans. Experience of tooling and fixture design or development, and of CAD (Catia, AutoCAD or similar). Understanding of GD&T. title: Progettisti Impianti Elettrici e Meccanici | Roma e Viterbo
description: Galileo Engineering S.r.l. , società di ingegneria con sedi a Roma e Viterbo e oltre 50 anni di esperienza, amplia il proprio gruppo di progettazione e ricerca ingegneri e periti industriali a indirizzo elettrico, energetico e meccanico da inserire stabilmente nel proprio organico. La ricerca è rivolta sia a progettisti che abbiano già maturato esperienza nel settore impiantistico , sia a giovani professionisti interessati a sviluppare competenze specialistiche, lavorando a fianco di progettisti esperti su commesse di diversa dimensione e complessità. Offriamo l'opportunità di entrare in una realtà tecnica strutturata, nella quale il progettista partecipa concretamente allo sviluppo delle soluzioni, dalla fase di studio e dimensionamento fino alla progettazione esecutiva e alle verifiche in campo. COSA OFFRIAMO Contratto di lavoro a tempo indeterminato , con applicazione del CCNL Studi Professionali. Retribuzione annua lorda da 28.000 a 40.000 euro , definita in funzione dell'esperienza, delle competenze e del livello di autonomia. Inserimento diretto nei gruppi di progettazione, con coinvolgimento nelle scelte tecniche e nello sviluppo delle soluzioni impiantistiche. Opportunità di lavorare su progetti di rilevanza nazionale, caratterizzati da elevata complessità tecnica e tecnologica. Confronto quotidiano con professionisti di diverse discipline, con possibilità di acquisire competenze trasversali e specialistiche. Partecipazione alle diverse fasi progettuali, dallo studio delle soluzioni tecniche alla progettazione esecutiva, fino alle verifiche durante la realizzazione delle oper Percorso di crescita professionale , con progressiva autonomia nella gestione tecnica delle commesse e possibilità di evoluzione verso ruoli di Project Engineer, responsabile di disciplina e coordinatore della progettazione . L'obiettivo è costruire rapporti professionali stabili, valorizzando le capacità individuali e favorendo un percorso di crescita commisurato alle competenze e alle attitudini di ciascuna persona. I NOSTRI PROGETTI Galileo Engineering opera in diversi settori dell'ingegneria impiantistica e infrastrutturale, sviluppando progetti che comprendono: Ospedali e strutture sanitarie , con impianti tecnologici complessi e sistemi ad elevata affidabilità. Edifici direzionali e complessi immobiliari , con soluzioni impiantistiche integrate, efficientamento energetico e sistemi di supervisione. Infrastrutture ferroviarie, metropolitane e aeroportuali , con impianti elettrici, meccanici e sistemi tecnologici specialistici. Cabine e stazioni elettriche AT/MT e MT/BT , reti elettriche e infrastrutture per la distribuzione dell'energia. P oPorti e sistemi di elettrificazione delle banchine (Cold Ironing) . La varietà delle commesse consente di confrontarsi con problematiche progettuali differenti, acquisendo esperienza su tecnologie e infrastrutture che raramente si incontrano contemporaneamente nella normale attività di uno studio di progettazione impiantistica. AMBITI DI PROGETTAZIONE E ATTIVITÀ Le risorse entreranno direttamente nei gruppi di progettazione e saranno coinvolte, in funzione della propria specializzazione ed esperienza, nello sviluppo di impianti tecnologici complessi, dalla definizione delle soluzioni tecniche alla progettazione esecutiva. AREA ELETTRICA E SISTEMI SPECIALI Le principali attività comprendono: Progettazione di impianti elettrici in bassa e media tensione (BT/MT). Cabine di trasformazione MT/BT, stazioni e cabine AT/MT. Sistemi di distribuzione elettrica, quadri elettrici e reti di alimentazione. Gruppi elettrogeni, sistemi UPS e alimentazioni di continuità. Impianti fotovoltaici e sistemi per l'efficienza energetica. Illuminazione ordinaria, di sicurezza e specialistica. Impianti di rivelazione incendi, sistemi speciali, supervisione e controllo. Sviluppo di calcoli elettrici, schemi, relazioni tecniche, elaborati esecutivi e modelli BIM. AREA MECCANICA ED ENERGETICA Le principali attività comprendono: Progettazione di impianti HVAC, climatizzazione, riscaldamento e ventilazione. Sistemi di trattamento e distribuzione dell'aria. Impianti idrico-sanitari e reti tecnologiche. Centrali termiche e frigorifere, sottocentrali e sistemi di distribuzione dei fluidi. Soluzioni per l'efficientamento energetico degli edifici. Sistemi di regolazione, automazione e supervisione degli impianti. Sviluppo di calcoli termotecnici, dimensionamenti, relazioni specialistiche, elaborati esecutivi e modelli BIM. In funzione delle competenze, le risorse potranno inoltre essere coinvolte nella progettazione antincendio e nelle procedure di prevenzione incendi ai sensi del DPR 151/2011 . Il ruolo del progettista non si limita al disegno CAD o alla modellazione BIM , ma comprende il coinvolgimento diretto nelle scelte tecniche, nei calcoli e dimensionamenti, nell'analisi normativa, nel coordinamento interdisciplinare e nelle verifiche in campo, con la possibilità di seguire concretamente l'evoluzione del progetto fino alla sua realizzazione. REQUISITI E COMPETENZE Valutiamo candidati in possesso di: · Laurea in Ingegneria Elettrica, Energetica, Industriale o Meccanica. · Diploma di Perito Industriale a indirizzo Elettrotecnico o Meccanico. · Esperienza, anche iniziale, nella progettazione di impianti elettrici o meccanici. Costituiscono elementi di interesse: · Conoscenza dei principali software di calcolo e dimensionamento elettrico o termotecnico. · Utilizzo di AutoCAD e Revit. · Conoscenza dei processi e degli strumenti di progettazione e coordinamento BIM. · Familiarità con la normativa tecnica di settore. Non è necessario possedere esperienza in tutti gli ambiti indicati. Le attività e il percorso di inserimento saranno definiti in funzione delle competenze, dell'esperienza e della specializzazione del candidato. Cerchiamo persone tecnicamente curiose, affidabili, capaci di lavorare in gruppo e interessate ad acquisire autonomia progettuale e responsabilità crescenti. È richiesta la disponi

title: Manufacturing Engineer Machining

description: À propos de nous Le Groupe EMITECH, laboratoire d'essais en environnement, ingénierie, formation et conception de bancs de tests est leader dans son domaine avec 77 millions d'Euros de chiffre d'affaires, 19 sites et 700 collaborateurs. Vous interviendrez sur des projets techniques à forts enjeux, depuis l'analyse du besoin jusqu'à la mise en service des bancs d'essais, en collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénierie, les experts techniques et les fournisseurs. Assurer l'intégration des équipements mécaniques avec les systèmes hydrauliques. Identifier les contraintes techniques et proposer des solutions adaptées aux exigences de performance. Pilotage technique des projets Participer aux revues de lancement afin de définir les spécifications techniques et les performances attendues. Une première expérience dans le développement et la mise au point de bancs d'essais constitue un critère particulièrement important. Compétences techniques Solide expertise en conception et dimensionnement de systèmes mécaniques complexes. Maîtrise du dimensionnement des machines tournantes : roulements, arbres, paliers et motorisations. Bonne connaissance des calculs mécaniques et des analyses modales. Expérience dans le développement de bancs d'essais ou de machines complexes. Capacité à gérer les interfaces mécaniques et hydrauliques. Expérience des processus de développement industriel et des revues de conception PDR/CDR. Connaissance des phases de fabrication, d'intégration, d'essais et de validation. Qualités professionnelles Leadership technique et capacité à fédérer des équipes pluridisciplinaires. Autonomie dans le pilotage de projets complexes. Excellentes capacités d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes. Rigueur, organisation et sens des responsabilités. Aptitude à communiquer avec les équipes techniques, les fournisseurs et les différents interlocuteurs du projet. Force de proposition et capacité à prendre des décisions techniques argumentées. Le candidat devra démontrer sa capacité à assurer le pilotage technique de projets complexes, depuis la conception jusqu'à la validation finale. Vous devrez être capable de prendre des décisions techniques, de coordonner les différentes parties prenantes et de résoudre les difficultés rencontrées tout au long du projet, avec l'appui d'un référent technique et d'un réseau d'experts. Pourquoi rejoindre le Groupe EMITECH ? Parce que nous sommes convaincus que nos collaborateurs sont la première richesse du Groupe EMITECH, nous mettons tout en œuvre pour les accompagner, les fidéliser et les faire grandir. Nous proposons un environnement de travail stimulant, des perspectives d'évolution, une rémunération attractive ainsi que de nombreux avantages. title: CDI Ingénieur-chercheur en mécanique des Matériaux Métalliques H/F
description: Vous piloterez la réalisation et l’interprétation de programmes d’essais mécaniques et numériques pour l’étude du comportement d’alliages métalliques et notamment les effets de la métallurgie et du vieillissement thermique sous irradiation des matériaux pour relever les défis d’un nucléaire durable et sûr et pour soutenir les activités de défense nationale. Vous savez faire preuve de rigueur et de précision, d'un bon esprit d'analyse et de synthèse, d'autonomie dans la réalisation de vos missions et bien sûr... d'un bon esprit d'équipe ! title: Sistem Mühendisliği Süreç Yönetimi ve Gelişim Mühendisi
description: Çalışma Yeri: Yerinde  Özgün, cesur ve yenilikçi ROKETSAN, fark yaratan yerli ve milli ürünleriyle, küresel hedeflerine doğru ilerlemeye ve ülkemizin gururu olmaya devam ediyor. Türkiye’nin savunma gücüne yön veren projelerde yer alan ekibimizin bir parçası olarak, kariyer yolculuğunuzda fark yaratma fırsatı yakalayabilirsiniz. Şirketimizin Ankara yerleşkesinde görev alacak Sistem Mühendisliği Süreç Yönetimi ve Gelişim Mühendisi ; sistem mühendisliği süreçlerinin geliştirilmesi, yeni nesil mühendislik yaklaşımlarının yaygınlaştırılması ve kurum genelinde mühendislik yetkinliklerinin artırılması, Model Tabanlı Sistem Mühendisliği (MBSE), maliyet odaklı tasarım ve özel mühendislik disiplinlerinin sistem tasarımına entegrasyonu gibi alanlarda yenilikçi yaklaşımların hayata geçirilmesi faaliyetlerinde aktif rol alacaktır. Beklenen Teknik Nitelikler Havacılık ve Uzay, Elektrik-Elektronik, Makine, Mekatronik, Bilgisayar Mühendisliği veya ilgili mühendislik bölümlerinden lisans mezunu olmak. Savunma sanayii projelerinde sistem mühendisliği alanında en az 7 yıl deneyim sahibi olmak. Gereksinim yönetimi, sistem mimarisi, tasarım, entegrasyon, doğrulama ve geçerleme süreçlerinde deneyim sahibi olmak. ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288 standardı ve INCOSE sistem mühendisliği yaklaşımı hakkında bilgi sahibi olmak. Gereksinim yönetimi ve sistem modelleme araçlarını kullanma deneyimine sahip olmak. Sistem mühendisliği süreçlerinin tanımlanması, uygulanması, değerlendirilmesi ve iyileştirilmesi konularına ilgi duymak. Maliyet odaklı tasarım, ürün yaşam döngüsü maliyeti ve RAMS gibi özel mühendislik disiplinlerinin tasarım süreçlerine etkileri konusunda bilgi sahibi olmak veya bu alanlarda gelişime açık olmak. Analitik düşünme, problem çözme, teknik iletişim ve raporlama becerilerine sahip olmak. Farklı mühendislik disiplinleri ve paydaşlarla iş birliği içinde çalışabilmek; teknik bilgi ve deneyimini paylaşmaya istekli olmak. Tercihen; INCOSE ASEP, CSEP veya ESEP sertifikalarından birine sahip olmak. FMECA, güvenilirlik analizi, bakım yapılabilirlik analizi veya entegre lojistik destek çalışmalarında deneyim sahibi olmak. MBSE metodolojilerinin veya SysML tabanlı modelleme yaklaşımlarının uygulanmasında görev almış olmak. Maliyet odaklı tasarım, üretilebilirlik, ürün yaşam döngüsü maliyeti veya seri üretime geçiş çalışmalarında deneyim sahibi olmak. Sistem mühendisliği süreçlerinin iyileştirilmesi, kurumsal yetkinlik modellerinin geliştirilmesi, teknik eğitim veya mentorluk faaliyetlerinde rol almış olmak. Görev ve Sorumluluklar ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288 ve INCOSE yaklaşımı doğrultusunda sistem mühendisliği süreçlerini tanımlamak, geliştirmek, projelere uyarlamak ve süreç olgunluğunun sürekli iyileştirilmesini sağlamak. MBSE ve model tabanlı tasarım yaklaşımlarının geliştirilmesine, uygun araçlarla desteklenmesine ve kurum genelinde yaygınlaştırılmasına katkıda bulunmak. Maliyet Odaklı Tasarım (Design to Cost) ve Üretilebilirlik için Tasarım (DFM) yaklaşımlarını sistem mühendisliği süreçlerine entegre etmek ve uygulama çalışmalarını yürütmek. Güvenilirlik, kullanılabilirlik, bakım yapılabilirlik, test edilebilirlik ve entegre lojistik destek gibi disiplinlerin sistem mimarisi ve tasarım süreçleriyle bütünleşmesini desteklemek. Sistem mühendisliği süreçlerine ilişkin performans göstergelerini belirlemek, izlemek ve iyileştirme fırsatlarını ortaya koymak. Sistem mühendisliği bilgi birikiminin, yöntemlerinin ve iyi uygulamalarının kurum genelinde yaygınlaştırılmasına yönelik çalışmalar yürütmek; eğitim, rehberlik ve gelişim faaliyetlerine katkı sağlamak. ROKETSAN’ın denizlerin altından uzayın derinliklerine uzanan mühendislik faaliyetlerinde, millî teknoloji hedefleri doğrultusunda yürütülen çalışmalara katkı sunarak bu yolculuğun bir parçası olabilirsiniz. Yarın İçin Yüksel! İlana Başvur Paylaş İlana Başvur

title: Mekanik Tasarım Mühendisi - Dış Donanımlar ve Güç Sistemleri
description: TEI olarak 1985’ten günümüze; havacılık motorları alanında sektöre sunduğumuz yüksek kaliteli ürün, hizmetler ile uluslararası arenada dünya çapında bir üretici ve küresel bir tasarım merkezi konumundayız. Bu güçlü konumumuzdan hareketle kendimizi Gücün Kaynağı olarak tanımlıyoruz. Türk Havacılık Uzay Sanayii, GE Aerospace, Türk Silahlı Kuvvetleri Güçlendirme Vakfı ve Türk Hava Kurumu ortaklığında kurulan şirketimiz, millî projelerle gurur veren başarılarda yerini alma ve geleceğin havacılık hikâyelerine imza atma fırsatı sunuyor. title: Mekanik Tasarım Mühendisi
description: PAVO GROUP , teknolojik gelişmeleri sürekli takip eden, bu gelişmeleri ürün ve hizmetlerine yansıtarak öncü olmaya çalışan, kendisine ve çevresine değer katan, ekibiyle birlikte temel değerleri koruyan, tercih edilen işletme olma hedefiyle ilerlemektedir. Etik kurallarından, iş ahlakından ve dürüstlüğünden taviz vermeden pazarda ortak olmayı hedefleyen Pavo Group; Aviyonik Sistemler, Veri Merkezi & Altyapı Çözümleri, Katma Değerli Endüstriyel Yapılar ve Bilgi Teknolojileri, Yapay Zeka, Siber Güvenlik, Ethernet Çözümleri, savunma ve sivil sektörde sistem entegratörü olarak yerli ve yabancı stratejik ortaklarına sistem çözümleri sunmaktadır. İSTANBUL SAVUNMA SİSTEMLERİ oyun değiştirici olabilecek niş ürünlerle Türkiye'nin savunma ihtiyaçlarının karşılanmasına katkı sağlamayı hedef alır. Tüm ihtiyaçlara cevap verebilecek esnek mimarilerle tasarladığı ürünlerin kullanım, bakım ve entegrasyonunun kolay olmasına özen gösterir. Aynı zamanda olası ürünleri hem sivil hem de askeri kullanım için hazırlamaktadır. Deneyimli kadrosu ile elektro-optik sistemleri geliştirerek çalışmalarına devam etmektedir. GÖREV VE SORUMLULUKLAR Proje başlangıç toplantılarına katılım; teknik şartname ve müşteri gereksinimlerinin analiz edilerek mekanik gereksinimlerin belirlenmesi. Mekanik konsept tasarımın hazırlanması; teknik alternatiflerin değerlendirilmesi, sistem mimarisinin oluşturulmasına ve Sistem Gereksinimleri Belgesi (SRS) ile Sistem Tasarım Tanımı (SDD) dokümanlarına katkı sağlanması. Ön Tasarım Gözden Geçirme (PDR) paketinin teknik çıktılarının hazırlanması, PDR toplantısına katılım ve görsel/müşteri değerlendirmesi geri bildirimlerinin tasarım üzerine uygulanması. Mekanik tasarımın detaylandırılması: SolidWorks, CATIA ve NX programlarında 3 boyutlu modelleme, 2 boyutlu imalat ve montaj çizimleri, mekanik konfigürasyonun tanımlanması ve BOM (malzeme listesi) hazırlanması. Tasarlanan parça ve yapıların ANSYS (Structural, CFD, Thermal) ile sonlu elemanlar, akışkan ve termal analizlerinin yapılması; ağırlık ve kütle özgülükleri (CG) optimizasyonu. Kritik Tasarım Gözden Geçirme (CDR) paketinin teknik çıktılarının hazırlanması, CDR toplantısına katılım ve tasarımın gözden geçirme kararları doğrultusunda nihayetlenmesi. Mekanik test tanımları dokümanının hazırlanması; Teste Hazırlık Gözden Geçirmesi (TRR) ve test hazırlık review süreçlerine katılım. Prototip imalatının (CNC, 3 boyutlu baskı, metal işleme, kompozit, sac işleme) ve montajın takibi; elektronik bileşen, güç dağıtım ve kablajın mekanik yapıya entegrasyonu ile prototip entegrasyon süreçlerine katılım. Mekanik donanım testlerinin (MHT) (stant, tezgah ve ünite testleri) yapılması ve Mekanik Donanım Test Raporu (MHTR) hazırlanması. Kalifikasyon testlerine (çevresel koşullar, EMI/EMC, uçuş, deniz ve saha kabul testleri) katılım; test sonuçlarının analiz edilerek tasarımın iyileştirilmesi. Mekanik üretim paketinin oluşturulması, seri üretim takibi, Montaj Talimatları (II) ve Fiziksel Özellikler (PP) dokümanları ile kabul muayene test prosedürlerinin hazırlanması. Konfigürasyon yönetimi ve değişiklik kontrolünün güncel tutulması; proje kapanış aşamasında Proje Kapanış Formu ve tasarım doküman setinin hazırlanması. GENEL NİTELİKLER Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği bölümünden mezun olmak. Mekanik tasarım ve ürün geliştirme alanında en az 4 yıl deneyim sahibi olmak. İHA (multirotor), faydalı yük (payload) veya E.O gimbal sistemlerinin mekanik tasarımında görev almış olmak. ileri seviyede SolidWorks, tercihen ilave olarak CATIA ve NX programlarında yetkinlik sahibi olmak. ANSYS (Structural, CFD, Thermal) veya benzeri sonlu elemanlar analiz araçlarında deneyim ve sonuç yorumlama yeteneğine sahip olmak. Mekanizma, aktarma, rulman, redüktör, motor ve aktüatör, sarmal kablo gibi mekanik bileşenlerin seçiminde deneyimli olmak. İmalat prosesleri (CNC, 3 boyutlu baskı, metal işleme, kompozit, plastik enjeksiyon), GD&T ve imalat çizim standardizasyonlarına hâkim olmak. FMEA, tasarım gözden geçirme, konfigürasyon yönetimi ve dokümantasyon (BOM, test raporu) süreçlerinde deneyimli olmak. title: Product Definition Engineer
description: Turkiye Technology Center is looking for “Product Definition Engineers” from different experience levels and offering them the opportunity to work with state-of-art technologies and applications, specializing in aircraft and industrial engine repair processes, in a technology base located in Kartal, Istanbul which is being established by General Electric Aerospace, GE MTC (General Electric Marmara Technology Center) and TEI (Tusaş Engine Industries, Inc.). Expected qualification, requirements and desired characteristics from candidates are as below: Required Qualifications BSc or MSc degree in Mechanical Engineering or Aeronautical Engineering Excellent command of written and spoken English Effective problem identification and solution skills Proficiency in the use of CAD modeling programs and PLM software, preferably in Siemens Teamcenter and Siemens Unigraphics NX Strong user of computer aided design (CAD), and PLM softwares, preferably in Siemens NX, and Siemens Teamcenter Strong user of geometric dimensioning and tolerancing as it relates to individual parts and overall assemblies (ASME Y14.5) Desired Qualifications Preferably experience in areas such as aviation, gas turbine or internal combustion engine design. Adaptable to work with teams from various cultures, understand behavioral and communicational differences, open to flex work style as necessary. Have understanding of Lean at Engineering or open to learn and adapt Lean principles. Project management and communication skills, able to monitor project status, business issues, significant milestones. Ability to multi-task effectively in a result oriented, risk managing approach. Proven self-starter and quick learner who can work with cross-functional teams. The essential responsibilities of this position are: Develop reusable parametric CAD master models, improve modeling methods, review, approve and issue models. Apply engine design control structure (associatively linked interfaces); create interfaces and control within the engine design control structure. Develop, review, and release drawings (drafting) and list utilizing knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T); assure high quality of drawings according to requirements. Understand and apply knowledge of assembly methods onto drawings to deliver products that meet quality, cost, and schedule. Create, manage, and execute design and configuration changes across the lifecycle of the product. Demonstrate strong and broad application of design practices, engineering standards and specifications. Understand and manage model-based product definition (digital product definition) creation and consumption from concept to disposal. Guide less experienced engineers in product definition. Document technical data generated by assigned projects consistent with engineering policies and procedures. Experience in mechanical design and design for manufacturing. Ability to use Siemens Teamcenter Visualization Mockup. Collaborate with other engineering disciplines to incorporate concepts to meet design intent. title: Satınalma Mühendisi
description: SATIN ALMA MÜHENDİSİ(Purchasing Engineer) — 3 kişi OPTICOVISION Mühendislik A.Ş. olarak, bir otomotiv ana sanayi projesinde tedarikçilerin seri üretime hazırlığını koordine edecek üç Satın Alma Mühendisi arıyoruz. Göreve başlayacak kişiler, tedarikçi seçimine teknik destek verecek, kalıp ve proses hazırlığını sahada inceleyecek, üretim denemelerine katılacak ve üretim kapasitesini saha verileriyle doğrulayacak. Görevler 1. Tedarikçi seçimi. Tedarikçi seçiminde üretim yöntemini, kalıp planını, kapasiteyi ve teknik riskleri değerlendirerek satın alma ekibine teknik görüş sunmak. 2. Seri üretime hazırlık. Tedarikçi seçiminden seri üretim başlangıcına ve sonrasındaki mutabık kalınan takip dönemine kadar parça, ekipman, kalite ve lojistik hazırlıklarını koordine etmek. 3. Saha doğrulaması. Tedarikçi sahasında üretim denemelerine katılmak, çevrim süresini, üretim hızını, fireyi ve kapasiteyi yerinde kontrol etmek, sorunlar için alınan önlemlerin işe yaradığını doğrulamak ve saha bulgularını satın alma ekibine raporlamak. 4. Tedarikçi geliştirme ve kriz desteği. Tedarikçi geliştirme çalışmalarına destek vermek. Kalite, teslimat ve kapasite sorunlarında kök neden analizine, düzeltici aksiyonların takibine ve üretimin toparlanmasına katkı sağlamak. 5. Raporlama. Haftalık ilerleme raporlarını, saha ziyaret raporlarını, risk ve aksiyon listesini ve görev sonu devir dosyasını hazırlamak. Aranan nitelikler · Üniversitelerin mühendislik bölümlerinden mezun. · İyi düzeyde İngilizce konuşabilen, teknik bulguları toplantılarda İngilizce aktarabilen ve İngilizce iş yazışması yapabilen. · Otomotivde üretim, proses, tedarikçi kalite veya proje mühendisliği alanlarından birinde deneyimli. · Kalıp ve üretim proseslerini değerlendirebilen, üretim denemesi verilerini yorumlayabilen ve kapasite hesabı yapabilen. · Tedarikçi sahasında çalışmaya ve saha ziyaretlerine uygun. · Yurtiçi ve Yurtdışı seyahat engeli olmayan. · Bir otomotiv parçasının seri üretime alınmasında tedarikçi sahasında görev almış olmak tercih sebebidir. · İlgili alanlarda en az 3 yıllık deneyim tercih sebebidir. Çalışma yeri : Arifiye, Sakarya Çalışma düzeni : Ağırlıklı olarak tedarikçi sahasında, gerektiğinde ofiste çalışma Hedef başlangıç : Ocak 2027 Planlanan hizmet süresi : 18 ay

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description: Ben jij een ervaren constructeur die niet alleen tekent, maar ook graag rekent? Voor een gespecialiseerde machinebouwer in de regio Rotterdam zoeken wij een Senior Constructeur. Het bedrijf ontwikkelt zware maatwerkmachines van zo'n 200 ton die wereldwijd worden ingezet in offshore, energie en petrochemie. Jij bent de technische ruggengraat van een klein team. Taken en verantwoordelijkheden Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het mechanisch ontwerp van zware machines op maat. Je vertaalt bestaande ontwerpen naar nieuwe uitvoeringen, bijvoorbeeld groter of breder, en rekent ze door. Je maakt sterkte- en constructieberekeningen en bewaakt de technische kwaliteit. Je ondersteunt en coacht minder ervaren constructeurs inhoudelijk. Je denkt mee met klanten over technische oplossingen en reist naar klanten en projecten. Plaats in de organisatie Je werkt nauw samen met de directeur en de hoofdingenieur in een klein engineeringteam. Er is weinig vaste structuur en veel ruimte voor eigen inbreng. Heb je leidinggevende ervaring, dan is dat welkom, zolang je technisch betrokken blijft. Functie-eisen Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in Werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbaar; een master is een plus. Minimaal 7 tot 10 jaar ervaring als constructeur; richting 15 jaar is ideaal. Ervaring in de (middel)zware machinebouw of offshore. Sterk in rekenen aan constructies. Ervaring met Inventor of een vergelijkbaar 3D CAD-pakket. Bereid om te reizen. Goed Engels; Nederlands is mooi meegenomen, maar niet verplicht. Arbeidsvoorwaarden Een marktconform salaris met snelle groeimogelijkheden. Een vaste 13e maand. 25 vakantiedagen. Een premievrij pensioen. Werken aan unieke machines die wereldwijd worden ingezet. Een goed bereikbare werkplek in de regio Rotterdam. Bij interesse of vragen kun je contact opnemen met Finn Rens via finn@teelor.nl of +31 6 14736826.

title: Electro-mechanical Designer
description: What function? In this role, you support our customers in the high-tech industry with developing cutting-edge equipment, both in the Brainport region and internationally. Together with experts in mechanics, mechatronics, electronics, software, and mathematics, you will bring high-tech solutions to life, such as advanced lithography machines, compact electron microscopes or medical devices that automate human tissue analysis. What excites you as a Electro-mechanical Designer? From our office in Eindhoven and sometimes at our clients' premises you like to keep yourself busy with: Challenging and creative electromechanical designs. The Inspection & Analysis domain demands higher data throughput, faster results, and greater precision, requiring technically innovative solutions. Product and technology development from concept to operational product, whether it’s a one off design or a serial production project. Close collaboration with the system architect, mechanical & electrical colleagues, project manager, other engineering disciplines, suppliers, and the wider project team to ensure alignment and synergy. Translating specifications into an (electro-) mechanical concept, including budgeting, conceptual and detailed design, testing needs, and integration requirements—ensuring a successful development cycle and a high quality final product. Contributing to the electromechanical competence within our organization, supporting technical growth and shared success. Sounds good so far? We'd love to tell you more… Your future workplace This is what you bring to the table Bachelor or Master degree in Mechanical Engineering or Electro-mechanics. Experience developing modules for E‑beam, X‑ray, Optical, and/or High‑Voltage systems. Proven track record in designing mechanical components for electronic devices and PCB assemblies within high‑tech systems and/or equipment, with a preference for high‑voltage systems. Practical experience conducting design verification, building prototypes, and performing mechanical testing and validation, including reporting. Minimum of 7 years of electromechanical design experience. Strong multidisciplinary understanding of how mechanical expertise integrates into complex modules. Strong conceptual thinking, design, and simulation capabilities using relevant tools, combined with a pragmatic, hands‑on attitude. Theoretical and practical knowledge in: Materials (e.g., non‑magnetic) Insulation (conductivity, permittivity) Environmental conditions (vacuum, cleanliness, thermal behaviour, stability) Design for Assembly & Manufacturing (e.g., joining/fixating materials, potting) Extensive background in performing thermal and structural analyses, including full‑module thermal management for electronics and PCB‑based enclosures. Skilled in developing detailed mechanical assemblies such as enclosures, heatsinks, and RF/EMI shielding, with a focus on manufacturability, durability, and cost‑efficient solutions. Highly proficient in 3D CAD tools, delivering complete 2D technical drawings, assembly models, and engineering documentation (specifications, assembly guidelines). title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description: PsiQuantum's mission is to build the first useful quantum computers: machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems. Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries. Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry, including partners like GlobalFoundries, we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don't feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure. That approach has since been tested at the highest level of scrutiny the U.S. government applies to emerging technology, and it has held up. In 2025, PsiQuantum closed a $1 billion funding round that valued the company at $7 billion. In 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce signed a $100 million Letter of Intent under the CHIPS and Science Act, followed by a $125 million agreement with DARPA under Stage C of its Quantum Benchmarking Initiative, PsiQuantum's most valuable U.S. government agreement to date. This year, we also broke ground on our utility-scale quantum computer in Brisbane, Australia, and continued building out our Chicago site. Victor Peng, our CEO, and co-founder Jeremy O'Brien, now Executive Chairman, lead a team and board that reflects how seriously the world is taking this build, joined this year by Intel's Lip-Bu Tan and Atomico's Niklas Zennström. PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies, including Airbus, Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical, to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact. Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift, and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we now have the funding, the government validation, and the sites under construction to make it real. Job Summary PsiQuantum's mission is to build the first useful quantum computers: machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems. Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries. Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry, including partners like GlobalFoundries, we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don't feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure. That approach has since been tested at the highest level of scrutiny the U.S. government applies to emerging technology, and it has held up. In 2025, PsiQuantum closed a $1 billion funding round that valued the company at $7 billion. In 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce signed a $100 million Letter of Intent under the CHIPS and Science Act, followed by a $125 million agreement with DARPA under Stage C of its Quantum Benchmarking Initiative, PsiQuantum's most valuable U.S. government agreement to date. This year, we also broke ground on our utility-scale quantum computer in Brisbane, Australia, and continued building out our Chicago site. Our site at Daresbury is the “tip of the arrow”, performing the cutting edge research for the company, leveraging access to large capacity cryogenic plant and extensive lab facilities. With this we develop advanced knowledge to support the rest of the company. Within the UK Operations team, we manage and deliver the build, operation and maintenance of high technology equipment to underpin quantum experiments primarily at the Daresbury Laboratory but extending to our worldwide facilities as we promote best practices and use our experience to solve global quantum engineering challenges. We are seeking an experienced Mechanical Design Engineer to expand our team working across the areas of vacuum solutions, systems integration, material handling, electro-optics, precision motion/control, structural analysis and thermal-mechanics down to cryogenic temperatures. Working with our Senior Mechanical Engineers, Quantum and Cryogenic engineers, this role will design mechanical components and assemblies, producing manufacturing drawings and working with our suppliers to have equipment manufactured and tested. title: Senior Technologist, Mechanical Engineer (Precision Mechanisms and Actuators)
description: WD is building the infrastructure behind the AI-driven data economy. As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That’s where we come in. We combine deep engineering expertise with global-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide. This isn’t theoretical work. It’s real systems, at real scale, people solving some of the hardest challenges in technology today. We’re looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level. Join us and let’s shape the future of data. Job Description About the role Storage hardware succeeds or fails on mechanisms that hold position to a fraction of a micron, thousands of times an hour, for years, inside an enclosure packed with other machines doing the same thing. This team owns every moving part inside the product: the actuators that position, the rotating assemblies that carry the media, the traverse mechanisms that move across it, and the isolation that keeps all of it stable in a dense rack. What you will own Voice coil actuator design — two- and three-axis, suspension design, frequency response, stroke and settling behavior. Spindle motor selection and integration, rotating-assembly dynamics, runout and wobble budgets, and start-stop cycle life. Sled and traverse mechanisms — lead screw or linear motor, backlash and repeatability, seek profile mechanics. Tolerance stack-up across the full assembly, across temperature and over product life. Shock and vibration isolation, and rotational vibration rejection with many mechanisms in one enclosure. Fluid dynamic bearings, precision flexures, and the rotating-assembly dynamics that follow from them. Materials and process selection for volume — aluminum alloys, stainless steel and engineering polymers, against die casting, metal injection moldings, stamping and precision machining. Contamination control and particle management, treated as a named engineering discipline rather than a housekeeping note. Metrology — CMM programming, vision and non-contact measurement systems, and surface profilometry — and the measurement plan that proves the design. How the role changes with level Engineer to Staff Engineer — Component design and analysis: actuator coils, suspensions, brackets, fixtures. Tolerance analysis and design for manufacture on assigned parts. Test rig build and measurement. FEA and modal analysis. Principal Engineer to Technologist — Own the actuator or the rotating-assembly subsystem end to end, from requirement through supplier qualification to production. Set the tolerance and dynamics budgets. Resolve the problems that have no published method — cross-axis coupling, settling under disturbance, rotational vibration in a dense rack. Senior Technologist — Own the mechanism architecture across product generations. Decide what is designed in-house and what is sourced. Carry the technical relationship with actuator and spindle suppliers. Qualifications What you need Degree in mechanical engineering, mechatronics or precision engineering. Demonstrated design of precision electromechanical mechanisms holding sub-micron positioning in production — not prototypes only. Advanced GD&T applied to tight-tolerance assemblies, and command of tolerance stack-up, modal and structural analysis. Advanced CAD — SolidWorks or equivalent — and FEA including modal and shock/vibration simulation. title: Technologist, Mechanical Engineer
description: WD is building the infrastructure behind the AI-driven data economy. As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That’s where we come in. We combine deep engineering expertise with global-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide. This isn’t theoretical work. It’s real systems, at real scale, people solving some of the hardest challenges in technology today. We’re looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level. Join us and let’s shape the future of data. Job Description About the role Storage hardware succeeds or fails on mechanisms that hold position to a fraction of a micron, thousands of times an hour, for years, inside an enclosure packed with other machines doing the same thing. This team owns every moving part inside the product: the actuators that position, the rotating assemblies that carry the media, the traverse mechanisms that move across it, and the isolation that keeps all of it stable in a dense rack. What you will own Voice coil actuator design — two- and three-axis, suspension design, frequency response, stroke and settling behavior. Spindle motor selection and integration, rotating-assembly dynamics, runout and wobble budgets, and start-stop cycle life. Sled and traverse mechanisms — lead screw or linear motor, backlash and repeatability, seek profile mechanics. Tolerance stack-up across the full assembly, across temperature and over product life. Shock and vibration isolation, and rotational vibration rejection with many mechanisms in one enclosure. Fluid dynamic bearings, precision flexures, and the rotating-assembly dynamics that follow from them. Materials and process selection for volume — aluminum alloys, stainless steel and engineering polymers, against die casting, metal injection moulding, stamping and precision machining. Contamination control and particle management, treated as a named engineering discipline rather than a housekeeping note. Metrology — CMM programming, vision and non-contact measurement systems, and surface profilometry — and the measurement plan that proves the design. How the role changes with level Engineer to Staff Engineer — Component design and analysis: actuator coils, suspensions, brackets, fixtures. Tolerance analysis and design for manufacture on assigned parts. Test rig build and measurement. FEA and modal analysis. Principal Engineer to Technologist — Own the actuator or the rotating-assembly subsystem end to end, from requirement through supplier qualification to production. Set the tolerance and dynamics budgets. Resolve the problems that have no published method — cross-axis coupling, settling under disturbance, rotational vibration in a dense rack. Senior Technologist — Own the mechanism architecture across product generations. Decide what is designed in-house and what is sourced. Carry the technical relationship with actuator and spindle suppliers. Qualifications What you need Degree in mechanical engineering, mechatronics or precision engineering with 10+ years of mechanical engineering experience Demonstrated design of precision electromechanical mechanisms holding sub-micron positioning in production — not prototypes only. Advanced GD&T applied to tight-tolerance assemblies, and command of tolerance stack-up, modal and structural analysis. Advanced CAD — SolidWorks or equivalent — and FEA including modal and shock/vibration simulation. Deep knowledge of at least two of die casting, precision machining, metal injection moulding and stamping, with a shipped product to point to. Experience taking a mechanism from concept through supplier qualification into volume manufacture. What would help Hard disk drive, head-gimbal assembly or comparable precision positioning mechanism experience. Voice coil actuator design, and the control-loop interaction that goes with it. Fluid dynamic bearing spindle experience. Metrology depth — CMM programming, surface profilometry, non-contact measurement. Contamination control and particle management in a precision assembly environment. High-volume consumer electronics or medical device background, where tolerance discipline is enforced by volume. Experience with rotational vibration in multi-device enclosures. The habit of writing mechanical requirements a control engineer can act on. title: Junior Project Engineer
description: Do you want to work in a fast-growing company, where you will be part of the effective and efficient realization of the project engineering activities of a project in accordance with the requirement, wishes and contractual obligations. For our Operational department we are looking for a Junior Project Engineer (Full Time) with a positive critical attitude to continuously improve our business operations. BlueAlp – accelerating plastic recycling Over the years, the discovery of plastic has added great value to the world. However, only 9% of plastic waste is recycled, the rest is burned or goes to landfill. BlueAlp focuses on recycling these plastics into high value products with our proven technology. We do this via our three business models: Developing and licensing our advanced pyrolysis technology to partners Engineering and building our modular plants with our experienced engineering team in Eindhoven in our own fabrication yard. Own & operate pyrolysis plants in the Benelux BlueAlp’s technology development started in Switzerland in the Alp’s with our first demo plant of 3kt per annum. This is where we defined our technology philosophy of a continuous and scalable process. The next milestone was scaling this plant up to 21kt per annum, we have engineered and build this plant in Eindhoven and build it up to Oostende (Belgium). Position in the organization and job expectation As a Junior Project Engineer, you will support the project engineering team in designing, optimizing, and realizing (sub) projects. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate or someone early in their career to gain hands-on experience in a dynamic and innovative environment. You will work closely with senior engineers and multidisciplinary teams to help ensure the successful design and manufacturing of a PTC plant. As BlueAlp’s Project Engineer (Junior) you: Carry out the engineering activities during the entire design and construction phase. Implement detailed modifications as per customer requirements. Attend and contribute to Kick-Off Meetings, internally with all departments involved, to achieve smooth implementation. Monitor the implementation of the project with colleagues from other disciplines (time planning, quality and safety). Set up and develop project documentation, such as P&IDs, data sheets and equipment lists. Support the Quality Control department for the required registrations, inspections, (external) inspections and quality documentation for the client. Provide the correct technical specifications to the purchasing department in a timely manner. Review the technical content of offers, consulting with suppliers to discuss details and attending Kick-Off Meetings with suppliers. Strengthen the continuous improvement culture by identifying and addressing improvement actions on content and process. Recognize changes and initiating and completing the Management of Change process Support the Process department with R&D activities. Excellent teamwork and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative environment. Team player who is proactive, independent and curious. Proficiency in English language. What do we offer? A challenging role within a fast-growing climate technology scale up Strong opportunities for personal and professional development The freedom to shape your role and contribute to BlueAlp’s growth An attractive and competitive salary package 27 vacation days and 13 ADV days (based on a 40-hour work week) 8% holiday allowance Travel allowance Solid pension scheme (PME) A dynamic, informal, international and inclusive working environment that values ownership and responsibility Did we spark your interest? description: Mechanical Engineer – R&D razvojni inženjer strojarstva (m/ž) 📍 Zagreb | Puno radno vrijeme | Rad na lokaciji O nama Što povezuje robotiku, umjetnu inteligenciju i svježe pečeni kruh? No iza naših pekarnica i bistroa postoji i jedna druga, manje poznata strana Boogieja. Upoznajte Boogie Technology – naš vlastiti istraživačko-razvojni odjel. Razvijamo vlastite tehnologije za naprednu i visoko automatiziranu proizvodnju hrane, povezujući strojarstvo, robotiku, elektroniku, razvoj softvera, računalni vid i umjetnu inteligenciju. Od prvih ideja i eksperimentalnih prototipova do specijaliziranih uređaja, robotskih sustava i novih proizvodnih procesa – istražujemo, razvijamo i testiramo tehnologije koje imaju stvarnu industrijsku primjenu. Posjedujemo dva patenta za proizvodne procese , razvijamo vlastita tehnološka rješenja i aktivne AI modele za predviđanje proizvodnih procesa, a cilj nam je nastaviti razvijati sve naprednije oblike automatizacije. Radimo u malom, povezanom timu sa startup energijom, gdje se znanje dijeli, problemi rješavaju zajedno, a dobre ideje ne ovise o tituli ili godinama iskustva. Sada širimo naš R&D tim i tražimo ljude koji žele istraživati, stvarati i razvijati se zajedno s nama. O poziciji – Mechanical Engineer / R&D razvojni inženjer strojarstva Tražimo razvojnog inženjera strojarstva koji želi sudjelovati u osmišljavanju, konstruiranju i testiranju novih mehaničkih sustava i tehnoloških rješenja. Ovo nije klasična pozicija održavanja ili projektiranja standardnih strojeva. U našem R&D timu sudjelovat ćeš u razvoju novih uređaja, laboratorijske i procesne opreme, robotskih prihvata i automatiziranih radnih stanica. Imat ćeš priliku pratiti razvojni proces od početne ideje, preko 3D modeliranja i izrade prototipa, do testiranja i primjene rješenja u stvarnoj proizvodnji. Što ćeš raditi? Sudjelovati u razvoju novih mehaničkih koncepata, uređaja i tehnoloških rješenja. Izrađivati 3D modele, konstrukcije mehaničkih sklopova i tehničke nacrte. Razvijati mehanizme, robotske prihvate ( grippere ) i automatizirane radne stanice. Sudjelovati u izradi prototipova, eksperimentiranju i testiranju novih ideja. Praktično sastavljati, prilagođavati i testirati vlastite konstrukcije. Istraživati i predlagati mehaničke komponente, pogone i izvedbena rješenja. Surađivati s inženjerima drugih disciplina na razvoju funkcionalnih sustava. Sudjelovati u razvoju eksperimentalnih rješenja do njihove industrijske primjene. Što očekujemo? Obrazovanje iz područja strojarstva, mehatronike ili srodnog tehničkog područja. Dobro razumijevanje mehanike, kinematike i mehaničkih sustava. Poznavanje 3D modeliranja u CAD alatima – nije nam presudno koji alat koristiš. Analitički način razmišljanja i interes za rješavanje tehničkih problema. Praktičan pristup radu i spremnost na testiranje vlastitih ideja. Znatiželju, inicijativu i želju za učenjem novih tehnologija. Spremnost na suradnju, razmjenu znanja i zajedničko rješavanje izazova. Prednost, ali nije uvjet: Poznavanje industrijske robotike, automatizacije ili mehatronike. Iskustvo s izradom prototipova i razvojem mehaničkih uređaja. Poznavanje proizvodnih tehnologija, materijala i industrijskih komponenti. Sudjelovanje u fakultetskim, osobnim ili profesionalnim projektima koji uključuju konstruiranje, robotiku ili razvoj uređaja. Zašto Boogie Technology? Zato što ovdje tvoje ideje ne moraju ostati samo na ekranu. Radit ćeš na stvarnim razvojnim projektima, sudjelovati u eksperimentiranju i imati priliku vidjeti kako se ideja pretvara u funkcionalan uređaj. Ne tražimo savršen životopis ni deset godina iskustva. Tražimo dobre tehničke temelje, znatiželju, inicijativu i želju da naučiš nešto novo. Kod nas ćeš raditi u malom, interdisciplinarnom timu u kojem svatko doprinosi svojim znanjem, ali i ima priliku učiti od drugih. Otvoreni smo i za kandidate na početku karijere. Ako si tijekom studija ili samostalno radio na zanimljivim projektima, voljeli bismo čuti o njima. Ako te više zanima kako napraviti nešto što još ne postoji nego kako održavati ono što već postoji – želimo te upoznati.

title: Młodszy konstruktor maszyn
description: Twój zakres obowiązków współtworzenie koncepcji działania maszyn i urządzeń, opracowywanie dokumentacji technicznej i projektowej, projektowanie w środowisku CAD (SolidWorks), udział w montażu oraz uruchamianiu urządzeń w siedzibie firmy oraz u klienta, rozwiązywanie bieżących problemów technicznych. Nasze wymagania wykształcenie techniczne (preferowane kierunki: mechanika i budowa maszyn lub pokrewne) – mile widziani zarówno absolwenci, jak i studenci ostatnich lat studiów, podstawowa znajomość rysunku technicznego, podstawowa znajomość programów CAD 3D (preferowany SolidWorks), umiejętność logicznego i technicznego myślenia, dokładność, zaangażowanie i chęć zdobywania nowej wiedzy, samodzielność w realizacji powierzonych zadań oraz umiejętność pracy w zespole, prawo jazdy kat. B. Mile widziane doświadczenie w projektowaniu maszyn i urządzeń (również praktyki, staże i projekty studenckie), znajomość podstaw pneumatyki i mechaniki, zainteresowanie budową maszyn i automatyką przemysłową, znajomość języka angielskiego technicznego. To oferujemy stabilne zatrudnienie w rozwijającej się firmie, wdrożenie i wsparcie doświadczonego zespołu – nie wymagamy wieloletniego doświadczenia, możliwość zdobywania praktycznej wiedzy i rozwijania umiejętności konstruktorskich, udział w ciekawych projektach maszyn i urządzeń dla branży Automotive i AGD, możliwość realizacji własnych pomysłów i wpływ na powstające rozwiązania techniczne, pracę przy projektach od koncepcji, przez projektowanie, aż po uruchomienie, elastyczne godziny pracy, możliwość rozwoju zawodowego i stopniowego przejmowania samodzielności przy realizacji projektów, możliwość częściowej pracy zdalnej – w zależności od etapu realizacji projektu. O nas GOP Automatyka Sp. z o.o. Projektujemy i budujemy maszyny oraz urządzenia dla nowoczesnych linii produkcyjnych – od koncepcji, przez projekt i montaż, aż po uruchomienie u klienta. Realizujemy projekty dla wymagających branż Automotive i AGD, współpracując z czołowymi producentami oraz dostawcami komponentów automatyki i pneumatyki przemysłowej. Jesteśmy niewielkim, zgranym zespołem, w którym liczy się zaangażowanie, samodzielność i dobre pomysły. Stawiamy na praktyczne rozwiązania, partnerską współpracę i możliwość rozwoju. Nie wymagamy wieloletniego doświadczenia! Chętnie przyjmiemy również ambitnego absolwenta lub osobę rozpoczynającą karierę zawodową. Zapewniamy wdrożenie, wsparcie doświadczonego zespołu i możliwość zdobywania wiedzy podczas realizacji rzeczywistych projektów. Jeśli interesuje Cię mechanika, projektowanie 3D i chcesz zobaczyć, jak Twoje projekty zamieniają się w działające maszyny – zapraszamy do naszego zespołu. Miejsce pracy: Chruszczobród (okolice Dąbrowy Górniczej / Zawiercia).

title: Ingénieur(e) Conception Mécanique Aéronautique (H/F) – Rejoignez l'aventure DUC Hélices !
description: Rejoignez l'aventure DUC Hélices ! 🚀 Leader dans la fabrication d'Hélices et Rotors composites (plus de 70 % à l'export), DUC Hélices Propellers est une entreprise en pleine croissance. Chez nous, on ne fait pas que modéliser derrière un écran : on calcule, on conçoit, on optimise et on éprouve nos produits sur le terrain. Nous cherchons notre futur(e) Ingénieur(e) Conception Mécanique . Un profil passionné, capable de mener des projets de bout en bout et qui comprend que chaque coup de souris a un impact direct sur la qualité de nos produits, nos délais et la performance de l'entreprise. 🎯 VOS MISSIONS En lien direct avec notre équipe et nos clients internationaux, vous serez l’un des moteurs de notre R&D et de notre industrialisation : ⚙️ Conception & Modélisation : Concevoir de nouveaux produits, des structures composites et des moules de production sur SolidWorks, en maîtrisant nos procédés de fabrication. 📐 Ingénierie & Rigueur : Rédiger des dossiers de définition complets et irréprochables (calculs de structures, plans, tolérances, nomenclatures, notices). 💻 Simulation & Automatisation : Réaliser des calculs aérodynamiques (CFD) pour optimiser les performances, et développer de petits scripts (Python) pour automatiser vos tâches à faible valeur ajoutée. 🛠️ Industrialisation & Prototypage : Développer, mettre au point des prototypes physiques et définir les essais de validation sur le terrain. 📈 Gestion de Projet & Économie : Mener plusieurs projets en parallèle. Vous êtes le garant du respect des délais, des budgets et du suivi technique des sous-traitants. 👤 VOTRE PROFIL – LE SAVOIR-FAIRE ET LE SAVOIR-ÊTRE 🎓 Formation & Background : Diplômé(e) d'une école d'ingénieurs (Bac+5), complété idéalement par une expérience "terrain" (type IUT GMP, projets associatifs techniques, fabrication réelle de prototypes). 🧠 Esprit critique (Outils & IA) : Vous maîtrisez SolidWorks. Vous utilisez les outils modernes (simulation, IA générative) comme des accélérateurs, mais jamais comme des béquilles remplaçant votre bon sens de l’ingénierie et vos calculs. 🎯 Pragmatisme : Vous concevez pour que ça fonctionne, que ça se fabrique facilement et que ça se vende au juste prix. Vous avez la culture du résultat. 🏴 Langues : Anglais technique d'un bon niveau (écrit/oral) indispensable pour échanger avec nos partenaires mondiaux. 💎 NOUS VOUS OFFRONS 💰 Un salaire annuel attractif à convenir selon votre profil + mutuelle d'entreprise. 📍 Un CDI à temps plein (39h) basé sur notre site exceptionnel de l'Aérodrome de Villefranche-Tarare. 🏭 Poste 100 % en présentiel : Nos produits sont physiques et nécessitent des interactions constantes avec l'atelier ! (Pas de télétravail possible). 🛫 L'opportunité de mettre réellement les mains dans la technique au sein d'une PME dynamique où chaque initiative compte. ☕ Un environnement de travail dynamique au sein d'une équipe passionnée. 📩 POUR POSTULER Vous avez l'esprit d'un "faiseur" autant que d'un concepteur ? Postuler sur LinkedIn ou envoyez votre CV et lettre de motivation à l’adresse suivante : recrutement@duc-helices.com en précisant la référence DH/2026/BE/CDI/008 . Rejoignez DUC Hélices Propellers et contribuez à l'avenir de l'aéronautique !

title: (Senior) Mechanical Engineer (m/f/d)
description: Your way into the future Join us as Senior or Principal Mechanical Engineer (m/f/d) and work with us on changing the future! What Awaits You At Mynaric You develop and design assemblies and subsystems for our optical communication terminals, working closely with systems, optics, electronics, manufacturing, and test engineers. You take ownership of mechanical solutions from concept through qualification and production, balancing performance, cost, manufacturability, and reliability. You create, analyze, andoptimizedesigns using engineering calculations and simulation tools, including structural, thermal, and dynamic analyses. You derive mechanical architectures, subsystem requirements, interfaces, and design concepts from system-level requirements. You perform simulations and toleranceanalyses, andassess the impact of mechanical design decisions on optical, electrical, and system performance. You support the definition and execution of verification and qualification activities, interpreting testresultsand feeding lessons learned back into the design. You create and maintain CAD models and technical documentation throughout the product lifecycle. You communicate technical trade-offs, analysis results, and design decisions effectively within project teams and design reviews. What You Bring With You University degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline. 10 years of demonstrated experience in designing complex mechanical or optomechanical systems in a high-technology environment, e.g. aerospace, robotics, semiconductor equipment, medical devices, defense or similar. Experience with high-precision systems is a plus (e.g. gimbals, precision rotary stages, preloaded bearing systems, flexures, reaction wheels). Strong systems-thinking and first-principles mindset with the ability to understand and balance multidisciplinary requirements. Solid understanding of mechanics, materials, thermal behavior, and tolerance analysis. Experience performing engineering analyses and simulations. Experience in structural, thermal, and vibration assessments is a strong plus. Ability to translate system requirements into practical and robust engineering solutions that balance quality with development speed and cost. Hands-on mentality and willingness to build, test, troubleshoot, and improve your own designs. Strong knowledge of 3D CAD tools and PLM systems, ideally Siemens NX and Teamcenter. Understanding of manufacturing processes, assembly methods, and design-for-manufacturing principles. Comfortable working across disciplines and engaging constructively with systems, optics, electronics, software, and production teams. Results-oriented, proactive, and capable of taking responsibility for technical decisions. Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken. Enthusiasm for solving challenging engineering problems in an innovative and fast-paced environment. What We Offer You Have you always wanted to wear your favorite space outfit to work? Then you are exactly the right fit for us! Forget the office politics and come and work with inspiring colleagues from all over the world as you embark on an incredible journey with Mynaric to work on unique and challenging projects and make a real contribution to the future of connectivity. We offer you permanent employment, varied areas of responsibility, and attractive employee benefits. Mynaric is absolutely committed to being an equal opportunity employer so we welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of ethnicity, sex, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age. So if this sounds like the kind of place where you would like to work then apply today and be part of the company that is changing the world! About Us Mynaric produces optical fiber for the skies and, as a pioneer in laser communications, enables extremely fast and secure wireless data transmission between satellites, drones and the ground. The products are used by well-known international technology companies to build global communication networks. The emerging Internet over the clouds will connect the previously disconnected 3 billion people, bring the Internet of Things to the remotest corners of the earth and make international communication more secure than ever.
