title: Beräkningsingenjör Linköping
description: Företagsbeskrivning AFRY är ett ledande europeiskt företag med global räckvidd inom teknik, design och rådgivning. Vi accelererar omställningen mot ett hållbart samhälle. Vi är 19 000 hängivna experter inom infrastruktur, industri, energi och digitalisering, som skapar hållbara lösningar för kommande generationer. Jobbeskrivning Vi ser potential att växa inom strukturmekanik och söker nu en ny medarbetare till vår beräkningsenhet i Linköping. Som Beräkningsingenjör hos oss får du chansen att arbeta med beräkning mot några av världens ledande industriföretag. Du kommer att bli inblandad i många spännande produktutvecklingsprojekt och ställas inför utmaningar från flera olika branscher. Projekt och uppdrag kan variera i storlek och innehåll samt utföras antingen in-house i våra egna lokaler eller ute på plats hos våra kunder. Fokus är mot tekniska beräkningar inom strukturanalys, både med hjälp av FEM och analytiska metoder. Du kommer få ett personligt ansvar för dina leveranser och möjlighet att driva dina egna projekt framåt. En av anledningarna att våra konsulter trivs så bra är att vi alltid försöker individanpassa rollen som konsult för att stämma med dina förutsättningar. Det betyder att dina möjligheter att vara med och påverka din egen utveckling är stora. Genom täta avstämningar och utvecklingssamtal kommer du och din chef tillsammans sätta såväl långsiktiga som kortsiktiga karriärsmål, som stimulerar just dig, och du sitter själv i förarsätet för din kompetensutveckling. Utöver grymma kollegor, teknisk framkant, kontinuerlig utveckling och stimulerande uppdrag kan vi erbjuda dig mycket mer som Arbetsgivare. Club AFRY är vår personalklubb som arrangerar sociala aktiviteter på och utanför kontoret. Urval sker kontinuerligt så du är välkommen med din ansökan redan idag! Kvalifikationer Vi söker dig som vill utvecklas till en hängiven beräkningsingenjör, med stort intresse för teknik i olika former och har ett stort engagemang för hållfasthetsanalyser. Som medarbetare hos oss behöver du snabbt kunna sätta dig in i nya sammanhang och läsa in dig på nya tekniker om så behövs. Som person är du engagerad, ödmjuk och en genuin lagspelare som trivs med att arbeta i team där ni tillsammans uppnår goda resultat. Det är en stor tillgång om du har lätt att skapa goda relationer både med kunder och kollegor. Du är en skicklig kommunikatör och kan enkelt förmedla både dig och dina analysresultat på engelska och svenska, i både tal och skrift. Du har en akademisk utbildningsbakgrund inom hållfasthetslära och vi ser gärna att du har en hög känsla för kvalitet i leveransen och kundvärdet. Det är meriterande om du har en erfarenhet från någon av de vanligaste FE-programvarorna. Ytterligare information Vi söker dig som vill vara en del av AFRYs framgångssaga. Brinner du för teknisk utveckling? Gillar du att samarbeta för att hitta den bästa lösningen? Då kan vi erbjuda dig karriärmöjligheter på en modern arbetsplats med utmanande arbetsuppgifter och spännande projekt världen över. AFRY är rankat som en av Sveriges mest populära arbetsgivare bland ingenjörer. Hos oss är du med och utvecklar innovativa och hållbara lösningar inom infrastruktur, energi och industri. Just nu söker vi marknadens vassaste kompetens som tillsammans med oss vill skapa framtidens samhälle. Vi hoppas också att du kommer lära dig lika mycket av oss som vi kommer göra av dig. Kontaktuppgifter för frågor: Sektionschef Thommy Nilsson, thommy.nilsson@afry.com På AFRY driver vi förändring i allt vi gör. Vi anser att förändring sker när modiga idéer möts, när vi samarbetar, skapar innovation och omfamnar kreativa lösningar, det är så vi skapar framtiden. title: Structural Analysis Engineer (Experienced or Senior)
description: Job Description At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us. Boeing Poland is part of the global The Boeing Company engineering network. We support design, analysis, certification and product-support of commercial and defense aircraft structures. By joining our team you will work with international engineering experts, contribute to state-of-the-art aerospace programmes and develop your professional skills in a dynamic, inclusive environment. Role Overview As a Structural Stress-Analysis Engineer you will perform structural integrity assessments of aircraft primary and secondary structures (e.g., fuselage, wing, flight-control surfaces) using both classical hand-calculation and finite‐element methods (FEM). You will support static, fatigue, damage-tolerance and repair analyses, generate documentation required for certification or qualification, and collaborate with multifunctional teams (design, loads, manufacturing, test, operations). You may also support in-service (after-market) issues such as investigations of structural failures and development of repair solutions. Job details: Employer will not sponsor applicants for employment visa status Relocation: This position does not offer relocation Please submit a CV written in English Travel & working conditions: This can require occasional business travel both local and international approx. up to 10% of worktime. This position is expected to be 100% onsite. The selected candidate will be required to work onsite at the listed location option. Hybrid work is the subject to coordination and approval by the direct manager. Key Responsibilities: Perform structural stress and durability/fatigue analyses of aircraft airframe structures (wings, fuselage, fixed and moving surfaces). Calculate structural loads, establish load paths, evaluate joints, fasteners, materials and structural details Use hand‐calculation methods (strength of materials, free-body diagrams, etc.) and analytical methods to assess structural integrity. Develop, validate and execute finite-element models (FEM) and interpret results in terms of stress, strain, margin of safety, damage-tolerance, static and fatigue life Generate, review and maintain structural analysis documentation (e.g., Stress Check Notes, reports) to support certification/qualification and in-service support Participate in failure investigations, root cause analysis and repair development for in-service products Work within applicable regulatory frameworks (e.g., Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) 14 CFR Part 25 & 26, or equivalent) to ensure safety & compliance Collaborate with design, loads, manufacturing, test, quality and supplier engineering teams to ensure structural requirements are met across the product lifecycle Proactively develop or improve methods, tools, processes, or analysis techniques for efficiencies and future programs Communicate technical results clearly (written and verbal) to engineering teams and stakeholders May be expected to travel domestically or internationally (e.g., to suppliers, test sites) up to : 20-25% of time (depending on programme) Stay up-to-date with materials, processes, emerging structural technologies (e.g., composites, advanced alloys) and industry best-practices Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/ Experience): Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering (with a focus on Mechanical, Civil, Aerospace Aeronautical or Material Sciences) 5+ years of experience in structural stress/analysis engineering in aerospace or related high-reliability industries Strong knowledge of engineering fundamentals: material properties, free‐body diagrams, structural loads, load paths, joints, connections, strength of materials Proven experience in structural analysis of metallic or composite airframe structures: static strength, fatigue life, damage tolerance. Ability to carry out hand‐calculations as well as interpret or build FEM models. Familiarity with FEM toolsets (e.g., Nastran, Patran, Abaqus) Solid written and verbal English communication skills (engineering level) Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience): Level 4 (Senior): 9+ years of experience in structural stress/analysis engineering in aerospace or related high-reliability industries Experience in leading or mentoring junior stress analysts (team lead capability) Familiarity with aircraft structure design philosophy, maintenance/repair concepts and in-service support Experience with composite structures, advanced materials or damage tolerance analysis Join us if you want to: Market competitive salary and performance-based incentive program + management incentive plan Have flexible working hours Enjoy additional paid days off for Christmas break (December 24th-January 1st) Develop professional skills with our virtual learning tools and platforms Benefit from Learning Together Program and MyBenefit program Benefit from Employee Recognition Program Get Medical Plan (LuxMed) and life insurance (Warta S.A.) for you and your Family Participate in Employee Pension Scheme (PPE) Enjoy and create with us friendly and inclusive atmosphere in workplace Cooperate and exchange knowledge with international team where we support and respect each other Cooperate and exchange knowledge with world class global engineering team Conflict of Interest: Successful candidates for this job must satisfy the Company's Conflict of Interest (COI) assessment process SALARY RANGE: Please note that the information shown below is a general guideline only. Pay is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations. Summary pay range: LVL 3(Experienced) PLN 164 900,00 – PLN 223 100,00 LVL 4(Senior) PLN 238 000,00 - PLN 322 000,00 Applications for this position will be accepted until Dec. 26,

title: Field Service Engineer - Remote
description: **Please apply with an English resumé!** Do you want to change how the world creates? At Formlabs, we’re building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting-edge products to life-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we’re helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before. As the dedicated Field Service Engineer for Formlabs, you will be the primary technical point of contact and face of our company across the DACH region and beyond. This is a role where you will be traveling 80% or more of the time. You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of the customer's on-site experience: from the initial installation and commissioning of equipment to delivering comprehensive user training and performing critical repairs. You are not just fixing machines; you are empowering customers to use them. We’re a team of hands-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you’re ready to shape the future of fabrication, come build it with us. The Challenge: Installation & Customer Training (On-Site) Equipment Installation: Travel to customer sites to unpack, install, commission, and calibrate new 3D printing systems. User Training: Conduct structured on-site training sessions for new and existing customers. You will teach them how to operate the machinery, utilize software, and perform basic maintenance. Demonstrations: Perform live product demos to inspire confidence in the technology and ensure the customer team is fully up to speed. Break-Fix & Maintenance (On-Site) Rapid Response: Act as a deployable resource for customers facing downtime, often traveling on short notice to perform urgent repairs. Preventative Maintenance: Manage a schedule of annual maintenance visits, ensuring all warrantied customers are serviced within their 90-day target window. Troubleshooting: Employ critical thinking to diagnose electromechanical issues and achieve "single visit resolutions" to minimize travel and downtime. Logistics & Reporting Visit Volume: Execute a high volume of activity. Travel Management: Independently manage a complex travel schedule (flights, trains, hotels, rental cars) and submit expenses on time. Documentation: Maintain meticulous records of installations, training sessions completed, and repairs in Salesforce. Your Profile: You are based in Munich - or within a 45-minute drive (highly preferred due to hub connectivity). You are energized by travel and willing to be on the road 80%+ of the time. You have a strong technical background (electromechanical/hardware) and the soft skills required to teach others how to use that technology. Fluency in German and English (both C1) . You can explain complex technical concepts simply and effectively in German and English. Valid driver’s license is required. Bonus Skills: Fluency in French Passion for 3D printing and emerging technologies Experience in rapidly-growing startup environments Our Perks: Shares in the company (we're a double unicorn company!) Free mental health & well-being sessions with an external partner Learning and development budget Free 3D prints Urban Sports Club discount Supplementary, opt-in German pension scheme Fun team events We build amazing things. Come join us! Even if you don't check every box, but see yourself contributing, please apply. Help us build an inclusive community that will change the face of 3D printing. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Your personal data is processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy . If you have any questions or wish to exercise your rights under applicable privacy and data protection laws, please contact us at privacy@formlabs.com .

title: Proje Mühendisi
description: Büyüyen organizasyonumuzda, arıtma ve pompa sistemleri alanındaki projelerimizin tasarım ve imalat süreçlerinde görev alacak “Proje Mühendisi” arayışımız bulunmaktadır. + Meslek Yüksekokullarının veya Üniversitelerin Makine, Makine Resim ve Konstrüksiyon, Mekatronik, Teknik Resim veya ilgili bölümlerinden mezun, + Tercihen arıtma, pompa sistemleri, proses borulama, mekanik tesisat veya endüstriyel tesis projelerinde en az 3 yıl deneyimli, + Autocad programını iyi/ileri seviyede kullanabilen, + Tercihen Solid Works veya benzeri 3D tasarım programlarında tecrübeli, + Teknik resim standartları, ölçülendirme, geometrik toleranslar ve yüzey işleme sembollerine hakim, + Makine parçaları, çelik konstrüksiyon, borulama (P&ID, izometrik çizim vb.) ve ekipman yerleşim çizimleri hazırlama konusunda deneyimli, + İmalat resimleri, montaj resimleri ve detay çizimleri hazırlayabilen, imalata uygun teknik dokümantasyon oluşturma deneyimine sahip, + Malzeme bilgisi olan; standart makine elemanları, bağlantı elemanları, sızdırmazlık elemanları ve borulama ekipmanlarını tanıyan, + Üretim ve saha ekipleriyle koordineli çalışarak revizyon ve değişiklikleri teknik resimlere doğru şekilde yansıtabilen, + Teknik çizim okuma ve yorumlama becerisi güçlü, detaylara önem veren, + İyi seviyede MS Office programlarını kullanabilen, + Ekip çalışmasına yatkın, iletişim becerileri gelişmiş, çözüm vesonuç odaklı, + Analitik düşünme ve problem çözme yetkinlikleri gelişmiş, dokümantasyon disiplinine sahip, + Yoğun proje temposuna ve gerektiğinde sahada çalışmaya uyum sağlayabilecek. İş Tanımı + Su ve atıksu arıtma tesisleri ile pompa sistemlerine ait makine, ekipman ve çelik konstrüksiyonların 2D ve (varsa) 3D teknik çizimlerini hazırlamak, + Proje mühendisleri ile birlikte çalışarak proses akış şemaları, borulama planları, ekipman yerleşim planları ve detay çizimlerini oluşturmak ve revizyonlarını takip etmek, + İmalata esas imalat ve montaj resimlerini hazırlamak; ölçülendirme, toleranslandırma ve malzeme detaylarını çizimlere aktarmak, + Yeni tasarlanan ekipman, aparat ve konstrüksiyon elemanları için üretime uygun teknik dokümanları hazırlamak ve güncel tutmak, + Tedarikçi firmalardan gelen teknik çizimleri ve dokümanları kontrol etmek, proje ve teknik şartnamelere uygunluğunu değerlendirmek,

title: Engineer - R&D (Thermodynamics & System - Based Modelling)
description: Job description: Discover a Home for Your Talents Within the Beko community, every role feels like home, fostering a sense of belonging and growth. We value mutual respect, progressive thinking, and an inclusive culture where everyone can contribute. Our commitment to sustainable development is driven by trust in technology and a dedication to producing confidently. As a member of our team, you'll have the opportunity to showcase your talents and contribute to building a prosperous future for all. Apply Now and Be Part of Our Journey to Inspire Sustainable Lives in Every Home! What awaits you in this role? We are looking for a passionate Engineer – R&D (Thermodynamics & System - Based Modelling) who will join our team at Central R&D in Beko Corporate. Participate in projects aimed at improving the system performance and energy efficiency of refrigeration and heat pump systems. Conduct experimental and numerical studies to investigate the thermal characteristics of heat pump systems and their effects on cooling and heating performance. Analyze experimental and numerical results to improve product and system designs. Prepare test plans for systems and components, including expansion valves and heat exchangers. Perform theoretical thermal analyses and engineering calculations related to thermodynamics, heat transfer, and mass transfer in cooling and heating applications. Develop digital skills to interpret and evaluate experimental and numerical results. Report, present, and share R&D project outcomes across different departments and functions. The position is located in Çayırova, İstanbul. How do we describe a perfect match? Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering (preferably started M.Sc.), Have strong knowledge of thermodynamics, heat transfer, and mass transfer. Have knowledge and experience in the design and optimization of thermal systems, such as vapor compression refrigeration and heat pump systems. Have experience with programming languages such as Python (preferably). Demonstrate a willingness to conduct both experimental and numerical R&D studies with a continuous learning and development mindset. Have excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. Demonstrate broad business awareness and think strategically. Understand market and customer needs. Strive for excellence and aim to deliver outstanding results. Recognize and understand other people's emotions. Listen to different perspectives and demonstrate flexibility. Build effective collaboration and teamwork. Communicate thoughts and ideas clearly and effectively. At Beko, where it feels like home, we invite you to explore home of… Global Minds: Opportunities to learn, grow, and succeed together as one global team. Impact: Meaningful work that contributes to our communities, the environment, and a more sustainable future. Innovation: A culture that embraces new ideas and technologies and takes on challenges with confidence. Camaraderie: A culture of togetherness built on inclusion, care, respect, and mutual support. Join the Beko Community to open a new chapter in your life journey, where growth, innovation, and personal fulfilment make it feels like home. Get to know us better by watching our company video: Company Video Follow our journey on Instagram @lifeatbeko to see the latest stories on sustainability, innovation, and community initiatives, and explore further on our LinkedIn Life Page: Beko LinkedIn Life Page We are an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, sex, colour, national or social origin, ethnicity, religion, age, pregnancy, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, marital status, or political opinion.

title: Field Engineer – Travel the World Through Technology
description: Your job. Your technology. Your world. What if your engineering career could take you around the world? Imagine flying business class to Japan, Germany, the United States or Switzerland. Picking up your rental car at the airport and driving to some of the world's most impressive technology companies. One week you could be working on advanced robotics, the next on semiconductor equipment, aerospace technology or sophisticated industrial machinery. And when the working day is over? Discover the city, enjoy amazing local food, experience different cultures and make the most of being abroad. This is engineering without borders. You will work on international engineering projects at leading industrial companies and specialised machine builders. Depending on your background and interests, your work may include: Installing and commissioning advanced machinery. Working with robotics, automation and precision equipment. Solving complex mechanical, electrical and mechatronic challenges. Supporting machine development, upgrades and optimisation. Working with PLC systems, servo drives and motion control. Testing and integrating sophisticated production systems. Collaborating with international engineering teams. Where could you go? 🇩🇪 Germany – Robotics, automotive and advanced machinery. 🇨🇭 Switzerland – Precision engineering and high-tech manufacturing. 🇮🇹 Italy – Special-purpose machinery and packaging technology. 🇯🇵 Japan – Robotics and advanced manufacturing. 🇺🇸 United States – Aerospace, automation and advanced production. 🇸🇬 Singapore – High-tech industrial environments. 🇸🇪 Sweden – Industrial innovation and automation. The Travel Experience Business-class flights on eligible journeys. Rental cars ready for collection at the airport. Comfortable international hotels. Visits to impressive industrial facilities. Opportunities to explore destinations after work. Discovering local restaurants, cultures and experiences. We are interested in following backgrounds Mechatronics Engineering. Mechanical Engineering. Electrical Engineering. Industrial Automation. Robotics or Automotive Engineering. Precision Engineering or a comparable technical discipline. Bring your engineering skills, your curiosity and your passport. The world is your workplace.

title: Service Engineer
description: Company Description Founded in 1995 and headquartered in Istanbul, Türkiye, ARMAKSA is a premier provider of vehicles and equipment for fire and rescue, winter maintenance, railroad operations, and specialized public services. With more than two decades of industry experience, the company partners with leading global manufacturers to deliver cutting-edge, tailored solutions. ARMAKSA is recognized for its commitment to excellence, innovative products, and comprehensive after-sales service. A 24/7 support system ensures timely and effective assistance, reinforcing its reputation as a trusted long-term partner. The company continually adapts to market demands and technological advancements to maintain its leadership and focus on quality and service. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Service Engineer role based in Istanbul, Türkiye. The Service Engineer will perform installation, maintenance, and repair of ARMAKSA vehicles and equipment at customer sites and company facilities. Daily responsibilities include diagnosing technical issues, conducting troubleshooting, and providing field service support for fire and rescue, winter maintenance, and other specialized systems. The role involves responding to service requests, documenting work performed, preparing service reports, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure timely resolution of issues. The Service Engineer will also provide technical guidance to customers, support commissioning and testing activities, and contribute to continuous improvement of service processes and customer sati sfaction. Qualifications Strong technical abilities in Troubleshooting and Maintenance & Repair for complex mechanical, hydraulic, and electrical systems. Experience in Field Service operations, including on-site installation, commissioning, and equipment inspection. Proficiency in Technical Support, including diagnosing issues, providing solutions, and advising customers on proper equipment use. Effective Communication skills for interacting with customers, suppliers, and cross-functional internal teams. Relevant technical education (e.g., degree or diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related field). Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, manuals, and service documentation. Comfort working in the field, sometimes under challenging conditions, with a strong focus on safety and quality. Basic computer skills for reporting, documentation, and use of diagnostic tools; proficiency in English is an advantage. Self-motivated, organized, and able to manage multiple service tasks and priorities. Profiency in English

title: Makine İkmal Direktörü
description: Çelikler Holding, 1958 yılından bu yana enerji, inşaat & taahhüt, madencilik ve turizm sektörlerinde faaliyet göstermektedir. 68 yıllık tecrübesi ile, yenilikçi çözümleri ve sürdürülebilirlik odaklı projeleri ile bulunduğu her sektörde öncü konumdadır. Çelikler Holding alanında 10.000’i aşkın güçlü ve dinamik kadrosu, geleceğe yönelik stratejik yatırımları ve teknoloji odaklı yaklaşımı ile Türkiye’nin kalkınmasına destek olmaktadır. Çelikler Holding Ankara Merkez ofisimizde görevlendirilmek üzere; ‘’Makine İkmal Direktörü’ arayışımız bulunmaktadır. Görev Ve Sorumluluklar İş makineleri, araçlar ve ekipmanlarda meydana gelen arızaların tespit, müdahale, bakım ve onarım süreçlerini yönetmek; çalışmaların zamanında ve etkin şekilde tamamlanmasını sağlamak. Tüm makine ve ekipmanların periyodik bakım, kontrol ve muayene planlarını oluşturmak, uygulamaları takip etmek ve kayıt altına alınmasını sağlamak. İşletme bünyesindeki iş makinelerinin bakım ve onarım faaliyetlerini planlamak, sevk ve idaresini gerçekleştirmek. İş makineleri ve araçların teknik durumlarını, kullanılabilirlik seviyelerini ve operasyonel verimliliklerini takip etmek. Tüm iş makineleri, araçlar ve ekipmanlara ait teknik envanter kayıtlarının güncel ve düzenli tutulmasını sağlamak. Atölye ve ambar faaliyetlerinin organizasyonunu, düzenini ve işleyişini yönetmek. Yedek parça ve sarf malzeme ihtiyaçlarını belirlemek, stok seviyelerini takip etmek ve satın alma ile tedarik süreçlerini koordine etmek. Bakım ve onarım maliyetlerini takip etmek, maliyetleri optimize etmeye yönelik çalışmalar yürütmek. İş makinelerinin günlük çalışma saatleri, yakıt tüketimleri, arıza süreleri ve performans verilerini takip etmek, analiz etmek ve düzenli olarak raporlamak. Makine ve ekipmanların verimli, güvenli ve kesintisiz çalışmasını sağlamak amacıyla iyileştirme çalışmaları yürütmek. Bakım ve onarım faaliyetlerine ilişkin teknik raporları, iş programlarını ve performans göstergelerini hazırlayarak yönetime sunmak. Teknik ekipler, saha operasyonları, atölye ve ilgili birimler arasındaki koordinasyonu sağlamak. Aranan Nitelikler Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği bölümünden mezun. İş makineleri, ağır iş makineleri veya endüstriyel ekipmanların bakım ve onarım süreçlerinde en az 15 yıl deneyimli. İş makineleri bakım, onarım ve teknik işletme süreçlerinde bilgi ve tecrübe sahibi. Mekanik sistemler, hidrolik ve pnömatik ekipmanlar konusunda teknik bilgi sahibi. Periyodik bakım, arıza yönetimi ve kestirimci bakım süreçlerine hâkim. Yedek parça yönetimi, teknik satın alma ve tedarik süreçlerinde deneyimli. Ekip yönetimi, iş planlama, organizasyon ve koordinasyon becerileri gelişmiş. Analitik düşünme ve problem çözme yetkinliğine sahip. Teknik raporlama ve performans takibi konularında deneyimli. İleri düzeyde İngilizce bilgisine sahip. Tam zamanlı çalışabilecek ve esnek çalışma saatlerine uyum sağlayabilecek. Erkek adaylar için askerlik hizmetini tamamlamış.

title: Energy Engineer
description: About The Job We believe that our employees are the foundation of our success and the source of our strength. Our vision is to become Turkey's most valuable and preferred industrial company that champions equality in the workplace. Join us in shaping the future of the automotive industry at Ford Otosan! What awaits you in this role? • Monitor the generation and performance of solar power plants (SPPs) under the responsibility of the Eskisehir Plant, conduct efficiency analyses, and prepare performance reports. • Monitor the technical compliance of maintenance and operation activities for SPPs, and manage technical specifications and technical evaluation activities within outsourced service procurement processes. • Plan and ensure the execution of electrical installation inspections, grounding measurements, and relevant statutory periodic inspection processes for SPPs. • Analyze the plant’s energy consumption data, monitor Energy Performance Indicators (EnPIs), and identify improvement opportunities. • Analyze energy costs, compare budgeted and actual expenditures, and prepare reports related to energy efficiency targets. • Conduct technical and economic feasibility studies for energy efficiency projects and follow up on the implementation of investment projects. • Contribute to documentation, performance monitoring, audit preparations, and continuous improvement activities under the ISO 50001 Energy Management System while following applicable legal and regulatory requirements. • Actively contribute to initiatives aimed at reducing carbon emissions and achieving sustainability targets. • Contribute to the development of energy monitoring systems, metering infrastructure, and digital energy management applications, with a focus on improving data accuracy and system effectiveness. • Ensure the continuity of energy monitoring, automation, and control systems used in utilities; monitor their performance and support improvement activities. • Monitor relevant performance indicators within Manufacturing Operating System (MOS) activities, manage improvement actions, and report results. • Follow emerging technologies in energy management, automation, metering technologies, and sustainability, and develop improvement opportunities. What are we looking for in this position? • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Electrical and Electronics Engineering. • Preferably 2-5 years of experience in energy management, energy efficiency, electrical installations, utilities, or industrial automation. • Good command of English. • Class B driving license and active driving experience. • No restrictions on travel. Technical & Behavioural Skills and Competencies • Possession of, or academic eligibility to obtain, an Operation Responsibility Authorization Certificate for High Voltage Facilities issued by the Chamber of Electrical Engineers (EMO). • Knowledge of energy efficiency and industrial energy systems. • Knowledge of the ISO 50001 Energy Management System. • Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Microsoft Excel. • Ability to work with Power BI and similar data analysis tools. • Basic knowledge of PLC, HMI, and SCADA systems. • Strong analytical thinking skills with the ability to analyze technical performance data. • Ability to use AutoCAD. • Preferably holding an Energy Manager Certificate. Role Location • Eskisehir Plant, Eskisehir When You Start Your Career In "Ford Otosan"; • We have hybrid working model and you can enjoy being part of an agile team. • You'll become a member of Koc Pension Foundation. • You and your loved ones will enjoy the benefits of KocAilem. • You'll choose the side benefits with Flextra. The only criterion evaluated in the recruitment and employment is suitability for the job; equal opportunity is provided without any discrimination. What About Us? Ford Otosan, being one of the top three exporting companies in Turkey since 2004, has achieved 13 consecutive years of automotive industry championship and is Turkiye goods product export champion for 9 years in a row. Ford Otosan operates in 4 main centers with its Golcuk and Yenikoy Plants in Kocaeli, Eskisehir Plant in Eskisehir, Sancaktepe R&D Center and Spare Parts Warehouse in Istanbul and Craiova Plant in Romania employs more than 20,000 people. Kocaeli and Eskisehir Plants are listed among Ford's 'Best Vehicle Production Centers' and Eskisehir is the only factory in Turkiye that can produce vehicles, engines, and powertrains in the same center. Ford Otosan, standing out with its sensitivity regarding social responsibilities, also carries out several social responsibility projects in many fields including education, healthcare, culture, arts, and sports on “Future. Now” vision. Ford Otosan, also carrying out awareness studies on gender equality since 2013 with the understanding of "Equality at Work", became the only automotive and the first and only industrial company from Turkiye to be included in the Bloomberg Gender-Equality Index in 2021. The building blocks of our new corporate culture, which we call “Dynamic Balance”, our values are mutual trust and respect, value each other and affection, openness to change and innovation, open and transparent communication.

title: Design Engineer
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Design Engineer based in Turkey. As a Design Engineer, you will shape the visual identity and user experience of a high-impact technology website, translating complex technical products into engaging, intuitive digital experiences. You will combine strong visual design skills with hands-on frontend development, taking projects from early concepts and prototypes through implementation and launch. Working across Design, Marketing, and Growth, you will create compelling website experiences that help developers and business teams understand the value of advanced device intelligence technology. You will contribute to a cohesive design system, build interactive demonstrations, and continuously refine performance, accessibility, and usability. This role offers significant creative ownership within a globally distributed, remote-first engineering environment that embraces experimentation and AI-powered workflows. title: Qualitätsingenieur/-in (Bereich Lack)
description: İş tanımı: Wir entwickeln und produzieren für alle, die die Welt bewegen! Wir als Mercedes-Benz Türk entwickeln und produzieren an unseren Standorten in Istanbul und Aksaray Lkw’s und Busse, um die Zukunft der Mobilität zu gestalten. Wir sind ein wichtiger Teil des Produktions- und Entwicklungsnetzwerks der Daimler Truck AG. Alles, was wir tun, trägt zu einer saubereren, sichereren und effizienteren Zukunft bei. Bei unserer Arbeit hören wir zuerst zu, lassen uns von unserer Vielfalt inspirieren und schaffen gemeinsame Lösungen. Wir führen mit einer langfristigen Perspektive und machen einen Unterschied, indem wir zusammen vorankommen! Bist du bereit, Teil unseres Teams zu werden und die Welt zu bewegen? Warum diese Position spannend ist Qualität ist für dich nicht das Ergebnis einer Kontrolle, sondern das Resultat der richtigen Prozesse? Dann gestalte mit uns die Qualität von morgen. In dieser Rolle bist du die entscheidende Schnittstelle zwischen Kundenfeedback, Produktionsprozessen und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung. Du analysierst Reklamationen nicht nur oberflächlich, sondern gehst den Ursachen auf den Grund und sorgst dafür, dass nachhaltige Lösungen entstehen. Dein Beitrag hat direkten Einfluss auf Kundenzufriedenheit, Produktqualität und die Wahrnehmung unserer Marke – national wie international. Was dich erwartet Analyse und Bewertung von Kundenreklamationen im Bereich Lack aus nationalen und internationalen Serviceorganisationen Koordination und Abstimmung mit internen sowie externen Ansprechpartnern zur nachhaltigen Bearbeitung von Qualitätsproblemen Durchführung von Ursachenanalysen und Ableitung wirksamer Verbesserungsmaßnahmen; Unterstützung und Mitgestaltung von kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsaktivitäten in Produktion und Qualität Erstellung, Auswertung und Präsentation von monatlichen Reklamations- und Qualitätsreports Monitoring relevanter Qualitätskennzahlen im Lackierprozess Darum passt du zu uns Erforderlich Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Werkstofftechnik, Materialwissenschaften, Chemieingenieurwesen oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Sicheres Auftreten im Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern Teamgeist sowie Freude an bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit Ausgeprägte analytische Denkweise sowie strukturierte Problemlösungskompetenz Selbstständige, zielorientierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise Hohe Ergebnisorientierung und konsequentes Follow-up von Maßnahmen Wünschenswert Berufserfahrung im Bereich Lackiertechnik, Lackierprozesse oder Oberflächentechnik Kenntnisse im Qualitätsmanagement, insbesondere in der Reklamationsbearbeitung Erfahrung mit Root-Cause-Analysen und kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsmethoden Erfahrung in der Automobilindustrie oder einem industriellen Produktionsumfeld Kenntnisse relevanter Qualitätsmethoden und Qualitätswerkzeuge Was wir dir bieten • Die Welt voranbringen: 7 von 10 in der Türkei produzierten Lkw’s und 4 von 10 Bussen tragen unsere Handschrift. • Die Zukunft der Mobilität gestalten: Geleitet vom Stern treiben wir Innovationen mit wegweisenden Elektrofahrzeugprojekten voran. Deine Ideen von heute können verändern, wie sich die Welt morgen bewegt. • Globale Wirkung, lokale Wurzeln: Mit 100.000 Kolleginnen und Kollegen an über 40 Standorten leben wir eine multinationale Kultur – und tragen Know-how und Wirkung weltweit bei Daimler Truck hinaus. • Nachhaltigkeit mit Sinn vorantreiben: Für uns ist Nachhaltigkeit kein Trend – sondern eine Verantwortung, die vollständig mit den Zielen für nachhaltige Entwicklung der UN im Einklang steht. • Wachstum ohne Grenzen: Funktionsübergreifende, standortübergreifende und internationale Rotationen – bei uns gibt es keine Grenzen für deine Karriere und persönliches Wachstum. • Lernen & Weiterentwicklung: Nutze kontinuierliche und bedarfsgerechte Mentoring-, Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsprogramme, die dein Wachstum in jeder Phase unterstützen. • Auch abseits der Arbeit aufblühen: Mit über 20 aktiven Hobby- und Sportclubs sowie dem Sponsoring von Nationalteams tragen wir zum sozialen Beisammensein unserer Arbeitskollegen/-innen bei. So kannst du Teil unseres Teams werden: 1) Bewerbung: Wir sind gespannt auf dich – stell dich vor und verrate uns, warum diese Rolle wie für dich gemacht ist! 2) Assessment: Zeig, was in dir steckt – mit unseren Tests und Tools für diese Position. Und denk dran: Jede Rolle ist anders und verlangt nach unterschiedlichen Skills. 3) Interview: Zeit, uns kennenzulernen! Wir freuen uns darauf, mehr über dich zu erfahren. 4) Angebot: Sobald alles geklärt ist, bekommst du unser Angebot – und dann entscheidest du! Bei Mercedes-Benz Türk unterstützen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für eine gerechte und inklusive Unternehmenskultur ein. Wir schätzen die individuellen Kompetenzen unserer Kolleginnen und Kollegen, denn nur so sichern wir die beste Teamleistung und damit den Erfolg unseres Unternehmens. Um die Vielfalt in unseren Teams zu fördern, akzeptieren und bewerten wir gerne alle Bewerbungen mit unterschiedlichem Alter, Kultur, Religion, Geschlecht, Geschlechtsidentität, sexueller Orientierung, Familienstand, Elternstatus und Behinderung. Du bringst nicht alles mit? Kein Problem! Deine Fähigkeiten sind uns wichtig, wichtiger ist uns jedoch deine Motivation. #MAKEYOURMOVE und bewirb Dich jetzt - Wir freuen uns auf Dich!

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
description: MASRAFF HAKKINDA 2017 yılında üç kurucu ortağın gerçek bir iş problemine çözüm arayışıyla başlayan Masraff, bugün Türkiye’de kurumsal harcama yönetimi sektöründe lider konumda bulunan, fintech ve Agentic Finance odağında çözümler geliştiren, Türkiye’den uluslararası pazarlara uzanan bir teknoloji şirketidir. 800’den fazla kurumsal müşterisi, 100.000’i aşkın günlük aktif kullanıcısı ve 5’ten fazla ülkedeki operasyonlarıyla Masraff; Türkiye’nin önde gelen kurumlarına ve uluslararası markalara yapay zekâ destekli kurumsal harcama yönetimi teknolojileri sunuyor. Peki, bu yolculuğun arkasında nasıl bir ekip var? Farklı uzmanlıkların bir araya geldiği, teknolojinin sürekli geliştiği ve öğrenmenin işin doğal bir parçası olduğu bir çalışma dünyası. Masraff’ta bizi heyecanlandıran yalnızca geliştirdiğimiz ürünler değil; çözülmeyi bekleyen problemler, keşfedilecek yeni fikirler ve birlikte ortaya koyabileceğimiz işler. Bugüne kadar başardıklarımızla gurur duyuyor, sıradaki adımları birlikte atacağımız yeni ekip arkadaşlarımızı arıyoruz. ROL HAKKINDA Ürünümüzün değeri, müşterimizin gerçek süreçlerinde çalıştığı an ortaya çıkıyor. Bu anı en hızlı ve en doğru şekilde yaratacak bir ekip arkadaşı arıyoruz. Masraff, şirketlerin masraf, harcama ve kurumsal kart süreçlerini tek platformda yöneten bir SaaS şirketi. Fişten muhasebe kaydına kadar olan akışı otomatikleştiriyor; bankalar, kart programları ve ERP sistemleriyle entegre çalışıyoruz. Forward Deployed Engineer olarak müşterilerimizle yakın çalışarak Masraff'ı sistemlerine kuracak, canlıya alacak ve canlıdaki ek taleplerini çözeceksin . Yeni teknolojileri gerçek müşteri ortamlarında uygulayarak uzmanlığını geliştirirken, sahada öğrendiklerinle Masraff’ın ürününe de yön vereceksin. NELER YAPACAKSIN? Yeni müşterilerin kurulumunu keşiften canlıya ve devire kadar yöneteceksin. Masraff'ı müşterinin ERP, muhasebe, İK ve banka/kart sistemleriyle entegre edeceksin (REST API, webhook, SFTP, SAP vb.). Masraf politikalarını, onay akışlarını ve kullanıcı rollerini müşteriye göre yapılandıracaksın. Canlıdaki müşterilerin ek taleplerini ve hatalarını hızla çözeceksin. Kabul kriterlerini ölçülebilir şekilde tanımlayacak, UAT ve demo süreçlerini yürüteceksin. Talep karşılama, kurulum ve hata çözümünde yapay zekâ agentlarını kullanacak ve geliştireceksin. Tekrar eden talepleri işaretleyip ürünleştirme sürecine taşıyacaksın. ARADIĞIMIZ DENEYİM VE YETKİNLİKLER En az 2 yıl yazılım geliştirme, entegrasyon ya da teknik çözüm deneyimi API entegrasyonu , SQL ve en az bir programlama dilinde (Python, TypeScript veya C#) rahat çalışma Kurumsal müşterilerle doğrudan çalışma ; teknik konuyu teknik olmayan paydaşa sade anlatabilme Talep edilen ile asıl ihtiyacı ayırabilme; her talebe "evet" demeden kapsamı netleştirme Yapay zekâ araçlarını günlük işinde aktif kullanma ; kurulum ve hata çözümünü otomatikleştirme isteği Test, doğrulama ve dokümantasyon disiplini Müşteri lokasyonunda zaman geçirmeye açıklık TERCİH SEBEBİ OLACAK DENEYİMLER SAP, Logo, Netsis, Mikro gibi ERP ve muhasebe sistemleriyle entegrasyon deneyimi Fintech, kurumsal kart, ödeme veya harcama yönetimi alanında deneyim Masraf, seyahat ya da satın alma süreçlerine hâkimiyet Ajan, MCP sunucusu veya otomasyon akışı kurmuş olmak BAŞARIYI NASIL ÖLÇERİZ? Kurulum ve canlıya geçiş süresi Talep ve hata kapanış süresi Müşteri memnuniyeti Ürüne dönüşen saha talepleri ÇALIŞMA MODELİ İstanbul / ŞİŞHANE · Tam zamanlı · Hibrit çalışma BAŞVURU Başvururken bugüne kadar canlıya aldığın bir kurulum ya da entegrasyonu kısaca anlatmanı rica ediyoruz: Ne kurdun, en çok neyi zorladın ve sonucu nasıl ölçtün?

Use AI agents to explore builds and draft tests, verify what they produce and keep the tests worth keeping. Evaluate the AI features our apps ship: the accuracy, consistency and safety of their outputs. Write bug reports a developer can reproduce without calling you and trace them to a root cause. Give the QA sign-off for each release: what was tested, what wasn’t and what risk remains. title: Mechanical Engineer
description: Onze opdrachtgever is al bijna 80 jaar actief in de ontwikkeling van geavanceerde machine oplossingen voor de voedingsmiddelenindustrie. Vanuit Nederland worden wereldwijd innovatieve systemen ontwikkeld, geproduceerd en geleverd. Dagelijks verwerken de machines van deze organisatie meer dan 1 miljard producten wereldwijd. Wat deze organisatie onderscheidt, is dat vrijwel het volledige ontwikkel- en productieproces in eigen huis plaatsvindt. Engineering, productie, assemblage, prototyping, testen en service bevinden zich op één locatie. Hierdoor krijgen engineers de mogelijkheid om hun ontwerpen daadwerkelijk gerealiseerd en gevalideerd te zien. De functie Ter uitbreiding van het R&D-team zijn wij op zoek naar een Mechanical Engineer. Je wordt onderdeel van een multidisciplinair engineering team waarin Mechanical, Hardware en Software Engineers samenwerken aan de ontwikkeling van nieuwe machines, modules en productverbeteringen. Binnen het Mechanical Engineering team werk je samen met ongeveer 12 collega's. Het team bestaat voornamelijk uit ervaren engineers met 6 tot 10 jaar ervaring binnen machinebouw en productontwikkeling. Verantwoordelijkheden Ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van mechanische modules en machines; Uitwerken van technische concepten naar realiseerbare oplossingen; Opstellen van detailtekeningen, berekeningen en technische documentatie; Valideren en testen van ontwerpen; Verbeteren en standaardiseren van bestaande producten; Intensief samenwerken met Product Management, Operations en Service. Wat breng je mee? HBO Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechanical Engineering of Mechatronica; Vanaf 2 jaar ervaring als Mechanical Engineer, Design Engineer of R&D Engineer; Ervaring met Creo Parametric; Ervaring met Windchill is een pré; Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal; Zelfstandig en oplossingsgericht; Rijbewijs B en eigen vervoer. Desired Skills and Experience Creo Parametric, Windchill, Mechanical Design, Product Development, Machinebouw, R&D Engineering, Design Engineering, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Mechanical Engineering Let op: vacaturefraude Helaas komt vacaturefraude steeds vaker voor. Neem dan altijd rechtstreeks contact met ons op via de officiële contactgegevens op onze website. Important: job fraud Unfortunately, job fraud is becoming more common. title: AI Mechanical Engineer
description: Därför är detta jobb för dig AI förändrar hur vi arbetar, utvecklar och löser problem. Men vad innebär det egentligen för oss som arbetar med mekanikkonstruktion och fysisk produktutveckling? Det är en fråga vi vill utforska. Och vi söker dig som vill vara med och hitta svaren! Hos Knightec Group får du arbeta med mekanikkonstruktion och produktutveckling i tekniskt utmanande uppdrag hos våra kunder. Men vi vill också ge dig möjlighet att utvecklas inom ett område som vi tror kommer att förändra vår bransch: AI inom mekanisk konstruktion och produktutveckling. Vi håller på att forma ett internt initiativ där vi tillsammans utforskar hur AI kan användas för att effektivisera konstruktionsarbete, utveckla smartare arbetsflöden och hitta nya sätt att lösa tekniska utmaningar. Här finns inga färdiga svar eller upptrampade vägar. Vi vill samla nyfikna ingenjörer som vill testa idéer, utmana gamla arbetssätt och vara med och sätta riktningen framåt. Du behöver inte vara AI-expert. Men du behöver ha ett genuint intresse för tekniken, viss erfarenhet av att utforska dess möjligheter och en vilja att omsätta idéer till praktisk nytta. Din roll – två världar som möts! Din huvudsakliga roll är som mekanikkonstruktör, där du arbetar med produktutveckling i uppdrag hos våra kunder. Parallellt blir du en del av vår interna satsning på AI inom mekanikkonstruktion. Som Mekanikkonstruktör Kommer Du Att Arbeta med mekanikkonstruktion och produktutveckling, från koncept och design till färdig produkt. Analysera tekniska utmaningar och utveckla genomtänkta, hållbara konstruktionslösningar. Samarbeta med andra ingenjörer och specialister i tvärfunktionella utvecklingsteam. Bidra med din tekniska kompetens och ta ansvar för ditt arbete och dina leveranser. Som en del av vårt AI-initiativ får du möjlighet att: Utforska hur AI och nya digitala verktyg kan användas inom mekanikkonstruktion och produktutveckling. Undersöka möjligheterna med exempelvis generativ design, AI-assisterad CAD, automatisering och optimering av konstruktionsprocesser. Initiera egna idéer, experiment och proof of concepts för att testa nya arbetssätt. Vara med och forma riktningen för hur vi på Knightec Group kan använda AI inom mekanisk produktutveckling. Dela insikter och erfarenheter med kollegor genom interna workshops, diskussioner och kunskapsutbyte. Vi tror att framtidens ingenjörer kommer att behöva kombinera djup teknisk förståelse med förmågan att använda nya verktyg och teknologier. Här får du möjlighet att vara med och utforska den utvecklingen, snarare än att bara följa den. Vem är du? Vi söker dig som har en stabil grund inom mekanikkonstruktion och som samtidigt är nyfiken på hur tekniken kan utvecklas. Kanske har du redan börjat experimentera med AI-verktyg i ditt arbete eller på fritiden. Kanske har du testat att automatisera delar av ditt konstruktionsarbete, utforskat generativ design eller funderat på hur AI skulle kunna förändra CAD-miljöer och produktutvecklingsprocesser. Du behöver inte kunna allt. Det viktiga är att du har börjat utforska möjligheterna och vill fortsätta lära dig tillsammans med andra. Vi Ser Gärna Att Du Har Högskole- eller civilingenjörsexamen inom maskinteknik, produktutveckling eller motsvarande. Minst ett års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet inom mekanikkonstruktion. Vi ser gärna att du har flera års erfarenhet. Erfarenhet av ett eller flera CAD-system. Erfarenhet av PDM-system. Ett tydligt intresse för AI och en grundläggande förståelse för hur tekniken kan tillämpas inom konstruktion, design eller produktutveckling. Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift. Det Är Extra Intressant Om Du Har Erfarenhet Av Generativ design, topologioptimering eller AI-assisterade konstruktionsverktyg. Automatisering, scripting eller programmering, exempelvis Python. Att testa och implementera nya digitala verktyg eller arbetssätt. Produktutveckling inom försvarsindustrin. Som person tror vi att du är nyfiken, initiativtagande och tycker om att dela kunskap med andra. Du behöver inte ha alla svar, men du gillar att ställa frågor, testa idéer och driva utveckling framåt. Varför Knightec Group? Vi vet att det finns många spännande arbetsgivare för ingenjörer i Linköping. Hos oss vill vi erbjuda något mer än nästa konstruktionsuppdrag. Vi vill ge dig möjlighet att kombinera tekniskt utmanande kundprojekt med ett sammanhang där du kan utforska nya idéer, utveckla din kompetens och påverka hur vi arbetar i framtiden. Du blir en del av vårt affärsområde Hardware & Design, där vi kombinerar bred ingenjörskompetens med specialistkunskap inom produktutveckling, design och teknik. Genom vår bredd och våra olika kompetensområden finns också möjligheter att lära av kollegor med andra perspektiv och erfarenheter. Vi tror inte att AI kommer att ersätta behovet av skickliga konstruktörer. Men vi tror att det kommer att förändra vilka verktyg vi använder, hur vi arbetar och vilka möjligheter vi har att skapa bättre produkter. Och den utvecklingen vill vi vara med och forma. Vill du vara med? Praktisk information Detta är en tillsvidareanställning med en provanställning på sex månader, placerad på vårt kontor i Linköping, Tanneforsgatan 3. Resor i tjänsten kan förekomma till våra kunder. Startdatum är så snart som möjligt eller enligt överenskommelse. Skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, men senast 2026-12-20. Om du har några frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Mikael Westh, Talent Acquisition Specialist. Observera att vi, på grund av GDPR, endast tar emot ansökningar via vår karriärsida. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

title: PhD in the nationaal groeifonds growing with green steel project
description: Introduction Are you passionate about sustainability and eager to contribute to pushing the boundaries of steel reuse in new buildings? Do you have a civil engineering or reliability background? Join us in developing verification methods for reclaimed steel to support its safe and responsible reuse in construction. Job Description Large quantities of steel become available from disassembled or destroyed structures. The vast majority of this quantity is suited for re-use, yet only a fraction (approximately 5%) is being re-used. Reclaimed steel often originates from structures that are several decades old and may have mechanical properties that differ from those of modern steel, due to differences in production processes and material quality. As a result, existing verification methods may need adjustment before they can be reliably applied to reclaimed steel. In this PhD project, you will develop verification methods for failure modes of reclaimed steel that account for the statistical variability of its mechanical properties, with particular focus on the strength and deformation capacity of structural elements and connections. The results will support the development of updated verification approaches that enable the safe and responsible reuse of reclaimed steel in construction. Your Main Activities In The Project Will Be Identify the failure modes most strongly influenced by the use of reclaimed steel and select an appropriate damage mechanics model that accounts for material softening in finite element analyses. Use finite element modelling (FEM) to evaluate failure conditions in structural components across a range of material properties. Conduct structural failure tests on selected structural components made from modern and reclaimed steel to validate the FEM models. Develop modified structural verification models using mechanics-based equations instead of FEM. Develop a reliability framework to determine the reliability of structures with reclaimed material. Compare reliability with that of simulations with material properties of modern steel. You will be embedded in the Steel and Aluminium Structures group of TU/e, see Steel and Aluminium Structures. Your project is part of a cross-university project involving more than 70 PhD students and Postdocs, all working on decarbonization and circularity of steel and steel structures, see https://groeienmetgroenstaal.nl/en/. Job Requirements A master’s degree (or an equivalent university degree) in Civil or Structural Engineering or a closely related field. A research-oriented attitude. Experience with structural reliability methods. Experience with finite element modelling and enthusiasm for combining theoretical research with numerical implementation. Motivated to develop your teaching skills and coach students. Fluent in spoken and written English (C1 level). Conditions of Employment A meaningful job in a dynamic and ambitious university, in an interdisciplinary setting and within an international network. You will work on a beautiful, green campus within walking distance of the central train station. In Addition, We Offer You Full-time employment for four years, with an intermediate assessment after nine months. You will spend a minimum of 10% of your four-year employment on teaching tasks, with a maximum of 15% per year of your employment. Salary and benefits (such as a pension scheme, paid pregnancy and maternity leave, partially paid parental leave) in accordance with the Collective Labour Agreement for Dutch Universities, scale P (min. € 3,204 - max. € 4,051 gross base salary per month (full-time)). In addition to your base salary, you will receive an 8% holiday allowance and an 8.3% year-end bonus, both calculated based on your annual gross base salary. Generous leave options: a standard 29 days (based on a 38 hour working week) per year that you can increase to 41 days by working two hours more per week (flexible working hours). This is prorated if you work part-time. As a TU/e employee, you participate in the ABP pension scheme, providing retirement pension and pension benefits for surviving dependents and occupational disability. TU/e pays 70% of the pension premium, while employees contribute the remaining 30%. High-quality training programs and other support to grow into a self-aware, autonomous scientific researcher. At TU/e we challenge you to take charge of your own learning process. An excellent technical infrastructure, and on-campus children's day care. Unlimited access to the modern on‑campus TU/e Student Sports Center at an exceptionally affordable rate. We support your wellbeing with free 24/7 access to OpenUp, providing you and your family with mental health support, expert guidance, and online training. An allowance for commuting, working from home and internet costs. A Staff Immigration Team and a tax compensation scheme (the Expat Scheme) for international candidates. On our website you can discover even more information about our conditions of employment. Build on your career at TU/e! About Us We are a leading international university where scientific curiosity meets a hands-on mindset. We work in an open and collaborative way with high-tech industries to tackle complex societal challenges. Our responsible and respectful approach ensures impact — today and in the future. TU/e is home to over 13,000 students and more than 7,000 staff, forming a diverse and vibrant academic community. Discover what Light Up means to TU/e in our short company video. Our university is located in Brainport Eindhoven — a world‑leading tech region with more than 7,000 high‑tech companies and strong R&D activity. Known for breakthroughs in AI, photonics, semiconductors and advanced manufacturing, Brainport is a place where technology serves people and society. Learn more about the Brainport region here. title: Afstuderen Werktuigbouwkunde: Werpwiel ontwerpen
description: Wat ga je doen? Tijdens deze afstudeeropdracht ga je aan de slag met het ontwerpen van een nieuw werpwiel voor de VSB-straalmachine. Het werpwiel versnelt het straalmiddel en heeft daarmee directe invloed op onder andere de straalprestatie, het energieverbruik, de slijtage en de operationele kosten van de machine. Aan jou de uitdaging om tot een nieuw mechanisch ontwerp te komen dat aansluit op de bedrijfsomstandigheden en gewenste prestaties van de VSB. Je start met het analyseren van bestaande werpwielen en turbineconcepten en stelt op basis daarvan de functionele en technische eisen aan het nieuwe ontwerp op. Vervolgens onderzoek je hoe de geometrie van onder andere het turbinewiel, de werpschoepen, instelbus en verdeler de prestaties beïnvloedt. Je ontwikkelt en vergelijkt verschillende concepten en werkt het meest geschikte concept verder uit in CAD. Concreet Ga Je Je Bezighouden Met Het analyseren van bestaande werpwielen en turbineconcepten; Het opstellen van functionele en technische eisen; Het onderzoeken van de invloed van geometrie op het turbinewiel, de werpschoepen, instelbus en verdeler; Het ontwikkelen en vergelijken van meerdere ontwerpconcepten; Het uitwerken van het gekozen concept in CAD; Het uitvoeren van sterkte-, dynamische- en prestatieberekeningen; Het selecteren van geschikte materialen en productiemethoden; Het beoordelen van slijtage, onderhoud, produceerbaarheid en operationele kosten. Het eindresultaat is een theoretisch gevalideerd mechanisch ontwerp van een nieuw werpwiel voor de VSB-straalmachine. Hierbij zoek je naar een goede balans tussen straalprestatie, energieverbruik, levensduur, betrouwbaarheid, produceerbaarheid en kosten. Daarnaast stel je aanbevelingen op voor de verdere validatie en toepassing van het ontwerp binnen de VSB-straalmachine. Wij vragen Een HBO-opleiding Werktuigbouwkunde. Wij bieden Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand; Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt; Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop, speciaal gereedschap of software; Ervaren coach: goede begeleiding is belangrijk en dus krijg je een vaste coach om je te ondersteunen; Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Over Voortman Wat in 1968 begon in een kippenschuur in Rijssen, is uitgegroeid tot wereldspeler in CNC-staalbewerkingsmachines. Met een team van meer dan 750 collega’s wereldwijd ontwikkelen en bouwen we niet alleen high-end machines, maar ook slimme software en service waarop klanten kunnen vertrouwen. Deze 3 krachtige bouwstenen maken ons Twentse, internationale familiebedrijf uniek.

description: Responsibilities Im Rahmen deiner Tätigkeit wirst du folgende Aufgaben übernehmen: Du unterstützt bei der Entwicklung und Prüfung von HVAC- und mechanischen Hilfssystemen für Offshore-Fundamente, Umspann- und Konverterplattformen - von der Konzeptphase über Pre-FEED und FEED bis zum Detail Design. Dazu gehören je nach Projekt Lüftung, Heizung und Kühlung, Kühlwasser, Trinkwasser, Sanitär und Entwässerung, Druckluft sowie Dieselversorgung. Du arbeitest an der Definition von Systemgrenzen, Schnittstellen, Betriebskonzepten sowie Redundanz- und Wartungsanforderungen mit und lernst, Systemverhalten im Normalbetrieb, bei Ausfällen, Notfällen und Wartung zu bewerten. Du erstellst und überarbeitest unter Anleitung technische Unterlagen wie Auslegungsberechnungen, Layouts, P&IDs, Schemata, technische Spezifikationen und Equipmentlisten. Du stimmst dich mit den Disziplinen Elektro, Struktur, Rohrleitungsbau, Architektur, Brandschutz, Automatisierung und Installation ab und lernst die Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden, Lieferanten und externen Engineering-Partnern kennen. Du prüfst Lieferantendokumentation gegen Projektanforderungen und einschlägige Normen und wirkst bei Design Reviews, Risikobewertungen (z. B. FMEA) und der technischen Beschaffung mit. Du begleitest Fertigung, Installation, Tests und Inbetriebnahme und lernst dabei die Praxis auf Werften und - nach entsprechenden Sicherheitstrainings - auch offshore kennen. Du bringst dich in Projekte und Angebote ein, etwa bei Aufwandsschätzungen und der Abgrenzung von Engineering-Leistungen. Requirements Abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor oder Master) im Maschinenbau, Schiffbau/Schiffstechnik, in der Versorgungstechnik/TGA oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Erste praktische Erfahrungen im maritimen Umfeld, z. B. durch Praxissemester, Werkstudententätigkeit oder Abschlussarbeit in den Bereichen Offshore-Wind, Offshore-Plattformen, Schiffbau oder Schiffstechnik. Grundkenntnisse in HVAC und mechanischen Hilfssystemen, z. B. Thermodynamik, Lüftungs- und Klimatechnik oder Fluidsysteme. Erste Erfahrung mit einem CAD-Tool (z. B. AutoCAD, Inventor, SolidWorks, Revit, Siemens NX) und die Bereitschaft, dich in unsere Tools einzuarbeiten. Von Vorteil: Erfahrung mit Berechnungen, Risikoanalysen wie FMEA oder technischer Dokumentation. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse für technische Abstimmungen und Dokumentation sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise, Freude an Teamarbeit und die Bereitschaft, regelmäßig im Hamburger Büro zu arbeiten und zu Kunden, Werften und Offshore-Anlagen zu reisen. BusinessBike-Leasing: Lease oder kaufe dein Fahrrad über eine steuerbegünstigte Gehaltsumwandlung, mit Paketen von Basic bis Pro. Betriebliche Altersvorsorge: Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 20 % für alle Voll- und Teilzeitbeschäftigten, in Zusammenarbeit mit Bernhard Assekuranzmakler. title: Mechanical Design Engineer

Con sedi in Italia, Europa e Stati Uniti, supportiamo i nostri clienti con competenze ingegneristiche di eccellenza, affrontando sfide complesse e promuovendo l’innovazione in ogni ambito. Sei un progettista meccanico con almeno un anno di esperienza e hai una buona conoscenza del software Siemens NX? Elaborare e aggiornare la documentazione tecnica di progetto. Collaborare alla definizione delle soluzioni progettuali in funzione dei requisiti tecnici. Effettuare modifiche e ottimizzazioni dei componenti meccanici durante le fasi di sviluppo. Supportare le attività di verifica e validazione delle soluzioni progettuali. Analizzare eventuali problematiche tecniche e contribuire alla loro risoluzione. Requisiti: Laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica, Meccatronica o discipline affini. Almeno 1 anno di esperienza professionale nella progettazione meccanica. Buona conoscenza e capacità di utilizzo del software Siemens NX. Conoscenza dei principi di progettazione meccanica e della modellazione 3D. Capacità di lettura e interpretazione del disegno tecnico. Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Ottime capacità di lavoro in team e problem solving. Precisione, proattività e orientamento al risultato. Nice to have: Familiarità con altri software CAD di progettazione meccanica. Conoscenza dei processi di sviluppo e industrializzazione del prodotto. Attitudine all'innovazione tecnologica e al miglioramento continuo. title: Mechanical Engineer / Senior Mechanical Engineer
description: Would you like to design technology that helps make quantum computers possible? Are you interested in hands-on mechanical engineering where physics, precision mechanics, and real-world manufacturability meet? Join us in building the cryogenic infrastructure behind quantum technology, alongside curious, highly skilled colleagues. At Bluefors, we design and manufacture the world’s most advanced cryogenic cooling systems, enabling leading research and emerging technologies such as quantum computing. To strengthen our R&D Engineering team in Helsinki, we are now looking for Mechanical Engineers and Senior Mechanical Engineers. As the work is closely connected to our products, labs and teams, regular on-site presence in Helsinki is an important part of the role. In these roles, you will design systems, subsystems, and components for cryogen-free dilution refrigerators and related high-technology equipment. You will work in product development, productization, and Engineer-to-Order (ETO) projects, taking designs from requirements through detailed design to release. We will match the role and level of responsibility to your experience and strengths. You will report to the R&D Engineering Manager. Your work goes straight into systems used by leading quantum computing companies and research institutions worldwide. Why join us? We offer you an interesting, challenging, and responsible position in a highly skilled, international, and low-hierarchy team where expertise matters more than job titles. You will have ownership from design through manufacturing and customer delivery, room to learn cryogenics from experienced colleagues, and a clear technical growth path toward Lead Design Engineer responsibilities. Your role as Mechanical Engineer As a Mechanical Engineer, you take ownership of defined design tasks and drive them from requirements and concepts through detailed design and release. You work hands-on with 3D CAD and create production-ready engineering documentation. Design mechanical systems, assemblies and components for new products, customer-specific projects and product changes. Create and maintain 3D models, manufacturing drawings, bills of materials and product data. Design machined, welded and sheet-metal parts, considering manufacturability, assembly, serviceability, quality and cost. Support prototype building, assembly, testing, production ramp-up and root-cause investigation. Your role as Senior Mechanical Engineer As a Senior Mechanical Engineer, you combine demanding design work with technical leadership. You may begin as a design engineer in a key project and, as you build product and domain knowledge, progress toward a project-specific Lead Design Engineer role. This is a technical leadership path without formal line-management responsibility. Translate customer, product and system-level requirements into clear mechanical requirements, interfaces and technical specifications that other engineers can implement. Plan the mechanical engineering workstream, break the work into deliverables and prepare realistic engineering effort and schedule estimates. Coordinate and guide other engineers, lead design reviews and make or facilitate key technical decisions. Follow engineering progress, quality, risks and dependencies, and adjust the plan when requirements or project conditions change. Communicate status, changes, risks and resource needs clearly to the R&D Engineering Manager and Project Managers. Share your expertise, support the development of the engineering team and help improve design quality, consistency and ways of working. Take a leading role in customer discussions, especially when clarifying requirements, interfaces, technical options and project changes. What we expect from all candidates B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related field. At least 3 years of relevant experience in mechanical design, product development, engineer-to-order work or productization. Experience with complex, high-value technical equipment, such as scientific instruments, capital equipment, advanced machinery or other demanding electromechanical systems. Strong 3D CAD capability and the ability to create clear, production-ready technical drawings. Understanding of common manufacturing methods and design for manufacturability and assembly. Good written and spoken English and confidence working in a cross-functional, international environment, together with a proactive, collaborative and accountable way of working. Additionally For The Senior Mechanical Engineer Role Approximately 8+ years of relevant mechanical engineering experience, or equivalent evidence of senior-level technical ownership. Experience with complex equipment through the full product lifecycle, from requirements and concept development to manufacturing release and product support. Previous experience as a lead, chief or senior design engineer, or in a comparable technical leadership role. Ability to guide engineers and align stakeholders without relying on formal supervisory authority. We also appreciate Experience with Creo and Windchill or another modern CAD and PLM/PDM environment, including engineering change management and configuration control. Experience in cryogenics, vacuum technology, scientific instrumentation, precision mechanics or other demanding operating environments. Experience designing piping or gas-handling systems and creating P&IDs. Experience with structural, thermal or tolerance analysis using tools such as Ansys or equivalent. Hands-on experience building prototypes, test equipment or fixtures, and practical knowledge of machining, welding, sheet-metal fabrication and supplier collaboration. You do not need to meet every preferred qualification. If you can show strong engineering judgment, ownership, and the ability to learn, we encourage you to apply. Evaluación de piezas que presentan desviaciones con respecto al plano. Gestión técnica de actividades de análisis de acuerdo a los plazos marcados por el Jefe de Proyecto y los requisitos de Cliente. Adquirirás conocimientos técnicos avanzados relacionados con el análisis por elementos finitos de productos complejos con gran valor tecnológico del sector aeronáutico, formando parte de un equipo multidisciplinar de alto nivel de conocimiento. ¿Con quién voy a trabajar? title: Technical Control Senior / Lead Engineer
description: If you want to be a part of the Tüpraş family, let's get to know each other better. Who We Are? Tüpraş is Türkiye’s leading energy producer and largest industrial company. With its four refineries located in İzmit, İzmir, Kırıkkale and Batman totalling to 30 million tons of annual crude oil processing capacity, Tüpraş is the 7th largest refining company in Europe. It is also one of the most complex refining companies in the Mediterranean basin. In addition to refining, Tüpraş operates with its subsidiaries, (OPET) focusing on fuel retail, (Ditaş Denizcilik) marine transportation, (Körfez Ulaştırma) railway transportation (Tüpraş Trading Ltd) crude oil and oil products trading and (Entek Elektrik) electricity generation. In 2021 The company launched its Strategic Transition Plan alongside its goal to become Carbon Neutral by 2050. In 2022, Tüpraş established its corporate venture capital arm, Tüpraş Ventures to invest in, partner with and support technology startups in its strategic focus areas, as well as energy transition solutions. (For further information on Tüpraş Strategic Transition Plan and focus business areas: Strategy - Tüpraş (tupras.com.tr) What You’ll Do? Perform and coordinate periodic and technical inspections of storage tanks and piping systems in accordance with Tüpraş Technical Control Standards and applicable national and international standards. Identify, assess, and report non-conformities detected during inspections; define corrective actions and follow up on their implementation. Supervise maintenance, repair, alteration, and inspection activities for storage tanks and piping systems to ensure compliance with applicable technical requirements and standards. Ensure that inspection, equipment integrity, and technical control data maintained in the IMS database are accurate, complete, and up to date. Participate in root cause analyses and improvement studies related to equipment integrity issues and unplanned events, contributing to actions that prevent recurrence. Support Risk-Based Inspection (RBI) studies by analyzing equipment condition, inspection, and corrosion data and ensuring the accuracy and integrity of relevant information. Stay up to date with industry best practices and developments in national and international standards related to mechanical integrity and reliability, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Develop and evaluate technical solutions for equipment requiring repair, renewal, replacement, or reliability improvement. What We Look For A bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or Metallurgical and Materials Engineering. Proficiency in written and spoken English. Preferably, experience in welding, corrosion, material selection, destructive and non-destructive testing, and technical inspection methods. Preferably, knowledge of international standards and codes such as ASME, ASTM, EN, API (including API 650, API 653, API 571, and API 510), and NACE. A valid API 653 Aboveground Storage Tank Inspector certification is considered an advantage. Preferably, experience in storage tank manufacturing, fabrication, quality control, construction and site inspections, as well as piping systems. Preferably, hands-on knowledge of NDT methods, including VT, MT, UT, RT, and PT. Preferably, experience in preventive and predictive maintenance practices. Strong teamwork and communication skills, combined with a proactive, innovative, and future-oriented mindset. The ability to build effective relationships and demonstrate social responsibility is highly valued, as collaboration and communication are key to success at Tüpraş. Proficiency in MS Office applications. Preferably, at least 5 years of professional experience in relevant technical roles. What’s In It For You? Therefore, we kindly ask you to actively check the mailbox (including junk/spam/junk folders) of the e-mail address you applied to. *The only criterion evaluated in recruitment and employment is suitability for the job; equal opportunity is provided without any discrimination.

İş sağlığı ve güvenliği kurallarına önem veren. Seyahat engeli bulunmayan ve ihtiyaç halinde farklı santral lokasyonlarında görev alabilecek. B sınıfı sürücü belgesine sahip ve aktif araç kullanabilen. Temel düzeyde İngilizce bilen Temel sorumlulukların neler olacak? Hidroelektrik santrallerde bulunan elektromekanik ekipmanların planlı, kestirimci ve arıza bakımlarını organize etmek ve yönetmek Yıllık bakım planlarının hazırlanmasına katkıda bulunmak, bakım faaliyetleri için gerekli personel, malzeme ve ekipman planlamasını yapmak. Yapılacak bakım ve onarım çalışmalarını koordine etmek, teknik raporları hazırlamak ve yöneticisine sunmak. Arıza nedenlerinin araştırılması ve tekrarının önlenmesine yönelik iyileştirme çalışmalarına katkıda bulunmak. Bakım prosedürleri, teknik dokümanlar ve ekipman kayıtlarının güncel tutulmasını sağlamak. Bakım çalışmalarında iş sağlığı ve güvenliği kurallarına uygun hareket edilmesini sağlamak. Bakım başlamadan önce sahanın emniyete alındığını, enerji izolasyonu, EKED ve topraklama işlemlerinin tamamlandığını kontrol etmek. Çalışma boyunca iş sağlığı ve güvenliği kurallarına uyulmasını sağlamak. Seninle enerjimiz nasıl tutar? Hayata dokunan duyarlı bakış açınla, Sorumluluk bilincinle, Dinamik oluşunla, Yenilikçi yaklaşımınla.

Provide technical expertise across beverage manufacturing processes, including water treatment, batching, formulation, ingredient mixing and blending. Essential Process Knowledge: Strong, practical understanding of water treatment, batching, formulation, ingredient mixing and blending processes. Production & Packaging Expertise: Experience with can filling, PET bottle filling, PET bottle blowing and associated packaging equipment. Project Delivery: Proven experience managing manufacturing engineering projects, including new production line installations, commissioning, facility expansions or greenfield developments. Engineering Leadership: Experience coordinating engineering teams, contractors, equipment suppliers and technical stakeholders.
