title: Production Leader
description: Who We Are: Ravago is a Luxembourg company, and a prominent global brand with operations in over 60 countries, more than 350 locations, and over 10,000 employees serving over 58,000 customers. Ravago continues to make a global impact within Europe, North America, Asia, and Africa. Over the years, the ambition of global expansion and market leadership in polymer and chemical distribution, recycling and compounding, and building materials, became a reality. And today, under the proud name of Ravago, we operate both as manufacturer and distributor in Türkiye with our more than 1300 employees, where Ravago Türkiye, as the second biggest producer in the petrochemical sector, serves in raw material production and distribution across 13 locations. We are committed to growing and strengthening our presence every day, upholding our values ofentrepreneurship, professionalism, humility, and human-focus. Get to know us better at Ravago Türkiye - Linkedin We are looking for an “ Production Leader ” to join our Ravaber Stone Wool Factory and contribute to our growing organization. Who We Are Looking For? Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or Chemical Engineering; a double major in both disciplines will be considered a strong asset. Minimum 10 years of professional experience in manufacturing or production operations, preferably within a process-driven industrial environment. Proven experience in leading and managing production teams, with strong people management and leadership capabilities. Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with the ability to communicate effectively in an international business environment. Strong technical understanding of production processes, manufacturing systems, and operational efficiency. Demonstrated experience in continuous improvement, lean manufacturing methodologies, and operational excellence practices. Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Ability to manage production performance, optimize resources, and drive productivity improvements. Solid understanding of occupational health and safety, quality standards, and manufacturing compliance requirements. Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across different functions. Results-oriented, proactive, and capable of leading teams through operational and organizational change. What You’ll Do? Analyze production time, performance, quality, scrap rates, energy consumption, and costs to identify process improvement and productivity enhancement opportunities; create, plan, and monitor action plans accordingly. Ensure that all activities are carried out in compliance with procedures, work instructions, recipes/formulations, and process flows. Identify the training needs of the teams reporting directly to them, ensure these needs are addressed, and monitor the development of employee competencies. Plan production consumables and critical raw material requirements based on sales forecasts, place the necessary orders, and monitor inventory levels. Support the preparation of the production operations budget and capital investment budget during the annual budgeting process. Monitor the impact of raw materials and melt chemistry on product quality and perform technical evaluations in terms of viscosity, melting behavior, and fiberization capability. Monitor the binder/resin system with respect to solids content, pH, viscosity, density, temperature, dosage, and distribution uniformity; conduct root cause analyses with laboratory and quality teams in case of deviations. Analyze the relationships among density, shot content, crimping, curing, compressive strength, tensile/peel strength, thermal conductivity, water absorption, and fire performance, and perform formulation and process optimization. Manage new raw material, chemical, formulation, or process changes through controlled trial plans; utilize DOE (Design of Experiments), SPC (Statistical Process Control), MSA (Measurement System Analysis), FMEA (Failure Modes and Effects Analysis), and process capability studies where appropriate. Ensure the implementation of permanent corrective actions for nonconforming products and process deviations by applying methodologies such as 5 Whys, Ishikawa (Fishbone Diagram), and 8D Problem Solving. What We Offer Continuous learning and development opportunities, Career growth through internal postings within Ravago Türkiye Group Companies, A dedicated Ravpartner to guide and support you from day one, Giving back through a corporate support to a partner non-governmental organization on behalf of our internal trainers in recognition of their contribution, Recognition and reward program that support and celebrate employees’ innovative ideas and successful projects. A collaborative and people oriented culture that encourages ownership, Employee Benefits Health and wellness programs, including access to online psychologists, dietitians, and fitness trainers, to support your well-being, Private health insurance coverage from your first day at Ravago Türkiye, Contribution to Individual Retirement Account (BES) after one year, Year-end bonus system, A sports membership (MultiSport) to support your health and wellbeing.

description: Biz Kimiz? 1993 yılında kurulan Rönesans Holding, bugün Türkiye, Avrupa, Orta Asya ve Afrika’yı kapsayan geniş bir coğrafyada; inşaat, gayrimenkul, enerji, endüstri ve sağlık alanlarında ana müteahhit ve yatırımcı olarak faaliyet göstermektedir. 40.000’i aşkın çalışanı ve 60’tan fazla milletten oluşan güçlü ve çok kültürlü ekibiyle Rönesans, dünyanın en büyük müteahhitlik şirketleri arasında yer almakta; sürdürülebilir bir gelecek inşa etme vizyonuyla yenilikçi ve küresel ölçekteki mühendislik projelerini hayata geçirmeye devam etmektedir. Biz Neler Sunuyoruz? Performans ve başarıyı destekleyen prim uygulamaları Kapsamlı yan haklar ve çalışan destek uygulamaları Özel Sağlık Sigortası kapsamında çalışanlarımızı destekleyen sağlık uygulamaları Mesleki ve kişisel gelişimini destekleyen eğitim ve gelişim programları Çeşitlilik ve Eşitlik Beyanımız Rönesans Holding, şirketlere stratejilerini ve operasyonlarını evrensel insan hakları, çalışma, çevre ve yolsuzlukla mücadele ilkelerine uygun hale getirmeye ve toplumsal hedefleri ilerletecek önlemler almaya çağıran BM Küresel İlkeler Sözleşmesi'nin imzacıları arasında yer almaktadır ve Birleşmiş Milletler Küresel İlkeler Sözleşmesi çerçevesinde evrensel kabul görmüş beyanlara dayalı ilkeleri benimser. Rönesans Holding, ana ilkeleri olan dürüstlük, rekabetçilik ve yenilikçilikten ödün vermeden şeffaf ve etik değerleri gözeterek insan kaynakları uygulamalarında eşitliği sağlamayı amaçlayan bir işverendir. Tüm başvurular cinsiyet, dil, din, ırk ve etnik kökene bakmaksızın fırsat eşitliğine göre değerlendirilir ve ayırımcılık yapılmaz.

title: Motor Bütünü Yapısal Analiz Mühendisi
description: TEI Teknoloji A.Ş. (TEITECH) olarak havacılık motorları ve güç sistemleri alanında özgün teknolojiler geliştirirken; ileri mühendislik, malzeme teknolojileri ve araştırma ve geliştirme yetkinliklerimizi ortak bir hedef doğrultusunda ileri taşıyoruz. TF35000 ve TS3000 motor programlarından yardımcı güç ünitelerine, malzeme teknolojilerinden araştırma ve geliştirme çalışmalarına uzanan geniş yetkinlik alanlarımızla, Türkiye'nin özgün havacılık motoru geliştirme kapasitesine yeni bir ivme kazandırıyoruz. Güçlü araştırma ve geliştirme altyapımız ve nitelikli insan kaynağımızla birlikte özgün motor teknolojileri geliştirme yolculuğumuzda, yetkinliklerini geliştirmek ve ekibimize değer katmak isteyen yetenekleri arıyoruz. Eğer sen de, Eskişehir, Ankara ve İstanbul yerleşkemizde “Motor Bütünü Yapısal Analiz Mühendisi - Explicit Dynamics” olarak değer katmak istersen; Sahip Olduğun Değerler: Üniversitelerin Makine, Havacılık, Uçak, Uzay Mühendisliği veya ilgili mühendislik bölümlerinden mezunsan, Sonlu elemanlar yöntemi (FEA), yapısal statik ve dinamik analiz konularında güçlü teorik alt yapıya sahipsen, Explicit dinamik analizler konusunda tercihen en az 4 yıllık bilgi ve deneyim sahibiysen, Metalik malzemelerin plastik deformasyon ve hasar davranışları ile malzeme modelleme yaklaşımlarına hâkimsen, Sonlu elemanlar modellerinin oluşturulması, analiz sonuçlarının değerlendirilmesi ve sayısal problemlerin çözümü konularında deneyimliysen, ANSYS, Hypermesh, NASTRAN, LS Dyna, LS Prepost ve benzeri FEA yazılımlarından çözüm ve prepost işlemleri için en az birini kullanabiliyorsan, Python, Matlab gibi programlama dillerinden en az birine hakimsen, Analitik düşünme, problem çözme, teknik raporlama ve disiplinler arası ekip çalışması becerilerine sahipsen, Öğrenmeye, araştırmaya ve yeni analiz yöntemleri geliştirmeye istekliysen, Teknik dokümanları takip edebilecek ve raporlama yapabilecek seviyede yazılı ve sözlü İngilizce biliyorsan, Yeni fikirler geliştirme motivasyonuna sahipsen, Kalite odaklı sonuç ortaya koymaya özen gösteriyorsan, İş birliği içinde çalışmayı önemsiyorsan, Değişen koşullara hızlı uyum sağlayabiliyorsan, Yüksek sorumluluk bilincine sahipsen, Yurt İçi / Yurt Dışı seyahat engelin bulunmuyorsa, Eskişehir, Ankara veya İstanbul'da ikamet edebiliyorsan. Öne Çıkan Değerler: LS-Dyna ile gerçekleştirilen explicit darbe (Impact), kanatçık kopması (blade-out), kuş çarpması (bird strike), buz ve/veya dolu yutma (ice and/or hail ingestion) konularından en az bir projede çalışmak veya yayımlı tez hazırlamış olmak, Lagrangian, ALE (Arbitrary Lagrangian Eulerian) ve SPH (Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics) yöntemleri hakkında bilgi sahibi olmak, Gaz türbinli motorlar ve yapısal davranışları hakkında bilgi sahibi olmak, Elastisite ve plastisite teorilerine, implicit ve explicit nümerik yöntemlere, metalik malzemelerin plastik deformasyon ve hasar davranışları ile malzeme modelleme yaklaşımlarına hâkim olmak, CS-E & Askeri Havacılık Standartları veya ilgili doğrulama ve sertifikasyon süreçlerine aşina olmak, Yapısal testler ve nümerik doğrulama faaliyetlerinde deneyimli olmak, Siemens NX gibi CAD programları kullanabilmek, ANSYS, LS-Dyna, LS Prepost, Hypermesh, Nastran gibi yapısal analiz programlarına ileri seviyede hâkim olmak. Değer Katacağın Alanlar: Kanatçık kopması sonrası oluşacak ikincil etkiler, kuş çarpması, buz & dolu yutma gibi oldukça dinamik, kısa süreli arıza senaryoları durumlarına karşı motor bütününün vereceği tepkiyi öngörmek amacıyla, LS-DYNA kullanarak karmaşık, tam motor ölçekli explicit dinamik simülasyonlarının kurulumu, yürütülmesi ve analiz edilmesi süreçlerine liderlik etmek, Motor bütünü yük modelinin kurulmasına ve implicit analizlerini gerçekleştirip ilgili yükleri tasarım ekiplerine sağlayarak tasarıma destek olmak, Altair HyperMesh, Ansys Workbench, Nastran ve LS-Dyna yazılımlarını kullanarak nümerik modellerin hazırlanması ve arıza senaryoları (statik, dinamik, kanatçık kompası, kuş çarpması, buz yutma) için dayanım analizlerini çözdürmek, Sertifikasyon ile ilgili gereksinimlerin geliştirilmesi, doğrulanması ve geçerli kılınması süreçlerine yönelik mühendislik desteği sağlamak, Kullanılan yöntemlerin ve yazılımların doğrulanmasına yönelik test planlama, yürütme ve analiz çalışmalarını (küçük ölçekli malzeme testleri ve balistik testlerden, muhafaza düzeneği ve tam ölçekli motor kanatçık kopma testlerine kadar uzanan süreci kapsayabilir) yapmak, Enstrümantasyon gereksinimlerinin belirlenmesi, test sırasında ve test sonrası verilerin işlenmesi ile değerlendirilmesini de kapsayan motor ve düzenek (rig) test planlamasını yapmak, Teknik ve organizasyonel süreçlerin, talimatların ve en iyi uygulamaların oluşturulması ve hayata geçirilmesi konusunda destek olmak, Kurum içi ve dışındaki çeşitli işlevsel paydaşlarla temel teknik stratejiler üzerinde mutabakata varmak. TEITECH’te Seni Neler Bekliyor? Savunma sanayii projelerinde kariyer fırsatı, Ülkemiz için kritik öneme sahip projelerde yer alma ayrıcalığı, Esnek çalışma saatleri ile haftanı planlama özgürlüğü, Performans prim ödemesi, Evlenme, doğum ve kreş yardımları, Kapsamlı özel sağlık sigortası, Ebeveyn olan çalışanlarımız için psikolojik danışmanlık ve rehberlik desteği, Anlaşmalı olduğumuz firmalardan avantajlı indirim fırsatları, Şirket içi sosyal kulüplerde hobi ve network kazanma fırsatı, Samimi bir çalışma ortamı, şirket içi etkinlikler ve yüksek motivasyon, Öğrenme ve gelişim imkânlarımızdan faydalanabilme.

title: Production Planning Engineer
description: We offer you an Ocean of Possibilities. Join our family. Production Planning Engineer Key Responsibilities Prepare, maintain, and update detailed production plans covering hull construction, outfitting, piping, mechanical, HVAC, insulation, testing, and commissioning activities. Develop daily, weekly, and monthly production schedules in alignment with overall project plans and milestones. Monitor planned versus actual progress, identify schedule deviations, and report potential delays and bottlenecks. Coordinate workforce, capacity, material, and equipment requirements to support efficient production planning. Review technical drawings, specifications, and work packages to ensure production readiness. Follow up on the availability of engineering documentation, materials, and equipment in line with production schedules. Coordinate planning activities across Production, Engineering, Procurement, Warehouse, and Project Management teams. Monitor supplier and subcontractor delivery schedules to ensure alignment with production requirements. Conduct regular production progress reviews and coordinate corrective actions when deviations occur. Evaluate the impact of design changes, additional work, and project revisions on production schedules and resource requirements. Prepare progress reports, capacity analyses, and planning performance updates. Support planning activities related to testing, commissioning, sea trials, and vessel delivery. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives to enhance planning accuracy, productivity, and resource efficiency. Skills & Experience Bachelor's degree in Naval Architecture and Marine Engineering. Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in the shipbuilding industry, preferably in production planning or shipbuilding production. Applications from candidates without shipbuilding industry experience will not be considered. Good knowledge of shipbuilding construction and outfitting processes, including hull construction, piping, mechanical, HVAC, insulation, testing, and commissioning activities. Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, project specifications, and production schedules. Experience in production planning, progress monitoring, resource coordination, and reporting. Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel; knowledge of project planning software is an advantage. Strong analytical thinking, planning, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet project deadlines. Effective communication and cross-functional coordination skills. Very good command of English. Other Requirements Based in Antalya or willing to relocate. Willing to work actively in a shipyard production environment. No outstanding military service obligations (for male candidates). Recruiter Burcu Gökçek Email burcu.gokcek@damen.com Please apply through the Apply Button. Due to GDPR reasons we cannot accept applications by email.

title: Mechanical Engineer
description: Mechanical Engineer | Hightech Machinebouw & Robotica Standplaats: Noord-Brabant Dienstverband: Fulltime (40 uur) Opleidingsniveau: HBO Werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbaar Bouw mee aan de techniek van morgen Ben jij een Mechanical Engineer die energie krijgt van het ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van innovatieve technische producten? Wil je werken aan complexe mechanische constructies waarbij werktuigbouwkunde, elektronica en moderne technologie samenkomen? Voor een innovatieve hightech organisatie in Noord-Brabant zijn wij op zoek naar een ervaren Mechanical Engineer. Je gaat aan de slag met de ontwikkeling van geavanceerde mobiele robots en technische systemen die hun toepassing vinden binnen uiteenlopende sectoren. Van het eerste technische ontwerp tot een product dat daadwerkelijk geproduceerd en getest kan worden: jij bent betrokken bij het complete ontwikkelproces. Daarbij krijg je volop ruimte om jouw technische kennis, creativiteit en ervaring in te zetten. Wat ga je doen? Als Mechanical Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, doorontwikkelen en optimaliseren van mechanische systemen en componenten. Je werkt samen met collega's uit verschillende technische disciplines en vertaalt technische vraagstukken naar slimme, maakbare oplossingen. Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: Ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van mechanische constructies en systemen, inclusief 3D-modellen, technische tekeningen en visualisaties. Uitwerken van complexe samenstellingen en zorgen voor een overzichtelijke technische documentatie. Toepassen van Design for Manufacturing (DfM) en Design for Testability (DfT), zodat ontwerpen efficiënt geproduceerd en getest kunnen worden. Rekening houden met technische aspecten zoals warmtehuishouding, constructieve sterkte en trillingsgedrag. Beoordelen en verbeteren van bestaande ontwerpen en technische oplossingen. Afstemmen met collega's van onder andere elektronica, software en productontwikkeling. Opstellen en presenteren van technische voorstellen, inclusief mogelijke oplossingsrichtingen. Bewaken van ontwerpkwaliteit, technische afhankelijkheden en de maakbaarheid van producten. Ondersteunen en begeleiden van minder ervaren engineers bij technische vraagstukken. Je krijgt daarbij de ruimte om niet alleen aan afzonderlijke onderdelen te werken, maar ook mee te denken over het totale productontwerp. Wat breng je mee? Je bent een technisch sterke engineer die graag verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor zijn of haar ontwerpen. Je kunt zelfstandig werken, maar zoekt ook actief de samenwerking met andere disciplines om tot het beste technische resultaat te komen. Daarnaast beschik je over: Een afgeronde technische hbo-opleiding, bij voorkeur Werktuigbouwkunde of Mechanical Engineering. Minimaal 4 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen mechanical engineering, productontwikkeling of machinebouw. Ruime ervaring met 3D CAD-software, bij voorkeur Siemens NX. title: Optomechanical Engineer
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Optomechanical Engineer based in Ireland. We are looking for an experienced Optomechanical Engineer to contribute to the development of advanced optical instruments and space-qualified telescope systems. In this role, you will take ownership of optomechanical design activities, from initial concepts and detailed engineering through alignment, integration, and environmental qualification. You will work on sophisticated optical assemblies, including large mirrors and lenses of up to 600 mm in diameter, ensuring precision, reliability, and performance under demanding space conditions. Collaborating with multidisciplinary engineering teams, you will combine mechanical design, optical analysis, and hands-on laboratory expertise to deliver mission-critical hardware. You will also contribute to improving engineering methodologies, manufacturing processes, and product reliability. This is an opportunity to work on cutting-edge aerospace technology within an international, collaborative environment, with significant potential for professional growth and increased technical responsibility. Accountabilities Lead the conceptual and detailed optomechanical design of space telescopes and optical instruments, including mirrors, lenses, windows, filters, and focal plane interfaces. Design precision optical mounts, including kinematic, semi-kinematic, flexure-based, and bonded mounting solutions, while minimizing stress and optical distortion. Develop low-distortion flexures, bipods, telescope support structures, metering structures, and manual or motorized focus mechanisms using athermal design principles. Select appropriate materials and adhesives for precision space optics, considering thermal expansion, dimensional stability, mechanical properties, and space qualification requirements. Perform structural and thermal finite element analyses (FEA), including modal, quasi-static, random vibration, and thermo-elastic analyses, while supporting integrated Structural-Thermal-Optical Performance (STOP) assessments. Define and conduct optomechanical tolerance analyses and error budgets, evaluating decenter, tilt, despace, surface figure, and mechanical stability in collaboration with optical designers. Develop alignment and integration strategies and participate directly in laboratory activities, including optical alignment, metrology, and environmental qualification testing. Support vibration and thermal vacuum test campaigns, correlate experimental results with analytical models, and ensure optical performance throughout qualification. Prepare detailed engineering drawings and technical specifications using Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) and ISO 10110 optical drawing standards. Act as a technical point of contact for optics and precision-mechanics suppliers, supporting component specifications, manufacturing, and quality requirements. Produce technical documentation, analysis reports, and engineering deliverables while maintaining accurate optomechanical information within CAD and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems. Collaborate closely with mechanical design, structural, and thermal engineering teams to ensure system-level integration, manufacturability, and compliance with mission requirements. Contribute to the continuous improvement of optomechanical design practices, product reliability, and engineering processes. Requirements Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Physics, or a related discipline, ideally with a specialization in optomechanics or precision engineering. Between 3 and 6 years of professional experience as an Optomechanical Engineer within the aerospace sector. Demonstrated involvement in at least one space or airborne optical instrument project, such as a telescope, camera, spectrometer, radiometer, or LiDAR system, preferably covering the full development cycle through qualification testing. Proven experience designing optical mounts for lenses and mirrors, as well as telescope support structures. Practical experience with finite element analysis of optical systems and environmental testing campaigns, particularly vibration and thermal vacuum testing. Advanced understanding of optomechanical engineering principles, including kinematic mounting, flexure design, athermalization, optical bonding, and mount-induced stress control. Proficiency in 3D CAD software, preferably Siemens NX, and FEA tools using NASTRAN-compatible solvers. Ability to perform STOP analyses, including Zernike polynomial fitting of FEA surface deformations and rigid-body motions, using tools such as SigFit or equivalent in-house solutions. Strong knowledge of precision engineering materials, including Zerodur, ULE, silicon carbide, aluminum, titanium, Invar, and carbon-fiber-reinforced polymers (CFRP), as well as space-qualified adhesives. Expertise in GD&T and optical engineering drawing standards, particularly ISO 10110. Hands-on experience with optical alignment and metrology equipment, such as interferometers, autocollimators, coordinate measuring machines (CMM), and alignment telescopes. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, excellent attention to detail, and the capacity to translate complex engineering challenges into practical solutions. Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary and international teams. Advanced English proficiency, both written and spoken. Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally to offices, laboratories, suppliers, and other project locations, including laboratory activities in Uruguay. Candidates must be eligible to work on projects subject to applicable ITAR export control restrictions; U.S. persons are not eligible for this position. We do this via our three business models: Developing and licensing our advanced pyrolysis technology to partners Engineering and building our modular plants with our experienced engineering team in Eindhoven in our own fabrication yard. Own & operate pyrolysis plants in the Benelux BlueAlp’s technology development started in Switzerland in the Alp’s with our first demo plant of 3kt per annum. This is where we defined our technology philosophy of a continuous and scalable process. The next milestone was scaling this plant up to 21kt per annum, we have engineered and build this plant in Eindhoven and build it up to Oostende (Belgium). Reviewing, checking, producing and modifying mechanical and construction drawings to ensure accuracy, consistency and buildability. Solid knowledge of piping systems, structural steel and pressure vessels. Experience with design reviews, engineering change management and as built documentation. ICT Experience with mechanical engineering tools such as CAD Worx, Inventor, TEKLA, BIM and Autodesk Construction Cloud. description: Institution ALBA is the Spanish synchrotron light source, a large research infrastructure operating thirteen beamlines, complementary facilities, and an Electron Microscopy Center, this last in partnership with other institutions. Currently constructing multiple more beamlines, expanding the Electron Microscopy Center, and integrating advanced data analytics, it sums up a wide range of infrastructures geared toward finding solutions to societal challenges. Located in Cerdanyola del Vallès (Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain), it is funded by the Spanish Government (Ministerio de Ciencia e Innovación) and the Catalan Government (Generalitat de Catalunya, Departament de Recerca i Universitats). The synchrotron light produced by 3 GeV electrons is used by thousands of researchers to analyse and understand the properties and functionality of matter, spanning a wide variety of fields, such as catalytic research, health, energy production/storage, environmental research, communication technologies, or cultural heritage. Our highly motivated staff works in a multidisciplinary work environment with an atmosphere formed by lived diversity, inclusion and respect for our colleagues. title: Racing Structural Performance Engineer
description: Who We Are The history of the Dallara Group began in 1972, when Engineer Giampaolo Dallara—after significant professional experience at Ferrari, Maserati, Lamborghini, and De Tomaso—founded Dallara Automobili da Competizione in Varano de' Melegari, a small town near Parma. Today, the Dallara Group is made up of over 950 Dallara People and is one of the most important players in the design, development, and production of racing cars and hypercars. Dallara is the sole supplier for the following championships: IndyCar, IndyNXT, Formula 2, Formula 3, EuroFormula, Formula E, Super Formula, Super Formula Light, Euroformula Open, Eurocup‑3, and A2RL. It also develops and manufactures some of the cars competing in the WEC and IMSA championships and provides consultancy in other series, including NASCAR and F1. Since the early 2000s, the Dallara Group has offered specialized consulting and professional support to the world’s most prestigious automotive brands, primarily for the development of ultra‑high‑performance super sports cars. On November 16, 2016, the Dallara Stradale—the first road car bearing the Dallara name—was unveiled. It embodies Engineer Dallara’s lifelong dream and synthesizes nearly 50 years of innovation. This was followed by the Dallara EXP, a track‑only version of the Stradale, representing the essence of racing spirit with extreme performance and FIA‑level safety standards. In recent years, the Dallara Group has also begun collaborating on the development of solutions for the aerospace sector. The Role As a Racing Structural Performance Engineer you will join the Racing Structural Performance team at Dallara Automobili, a company within the Dallara Group specializing in the design, pre-series production, and testing of products for the three business units: Racing, Automotive, and Aerospace. In this role, you will conduct simulations and structural analyses for key racing car components such as chassis, suspensions, mechanical parts, and bodywork. Specifically, you will address various aspects of these components from homologation and functionality perspectives, including stiffness, non-linearity, fatigue behavior, and vibratory phenomena. Performance results from the seamless integration of multiple disciplines, and you will have the chance to collaborate with various areas within the Design & Research department and the Vehicle Dynamics & Performance and Aerodynamics departments. What We Are Looking For Master's degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering; Previous experience in similar roles within the motorsport industry is preferred; Excellent knowledge of English; Strong team-working skills; Flexibility and a strong passion for the automotive/motorsport/aerospace fields; Knowledge of HyperWorks and Abaqus software and programming skills in Python are considered a plus. Our Values Humbleness We want to do our job well and with passion, determination and competence, embracing failure, sharing knowledge and overcoming difficulties with resilience, knowing that the greatest danger is to believe that you know. Integrity We believe in keeping our word, in respecting each other and the promises made; we want to develop bonds based on honesty, trust and the earnestness of human relationships. Curiosity We want to do better what we have always done with promptness, enthusiasm and love for knowledge, challenging what exists in new and adaptable ways, with the continued willingness to learn. What We Offer The gross annual salary will be commensurate with the candidate’s experience and level of seniority, with a salary range of €30,000–€35,000 gross per year for Junior profiles and €40,000–€50,000 gross per year for candidates with proven experience in the sector. Comprehensive welfare program – Comunità Dallara; Access to qualified training opportunities; Internal Job Posting system; Smart-working policy; Flexible working hours. Location Varano de’ Melegari (PR), Italy.

Lokasyon: Kocaeli / Kartepe (Merkez Atölye) + Şantiye Sahaları Çalışma Şekli: Tam Zamanlı ​Genel Nitelikler Eğitim : Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği bölümünden mezun. ​ Deneyim: Endüstriyel tesis, mekanik montaj ve paslanmaz proses borulama projelerinde en az 3 yıl deneyimli. ​Tasarım Yetkinliği: SolidWorks programını aktif ve etkin bir şekilde kullanabilen, 3D modelleme ve imalat resmi çıkarabilen. ​ P&ID & Proses Bilgisi: P&ID (Proses ve Enstrümantasyon Diyagramı) okuyabilen, çizebilen ve tesis akış şemalarına hâkim. ​Sektörel Uzmanlık: Süt ve süt ürünleri, gıda işleme veya benzeri endüstriyel hijyenik proses sistemlerinde bilgi sahibi. ​ Teknik Donanım: Paslanmaz çelik (AISI 304 / AISI 316L) malzeme bilgisine, ekipman yerleşimine ve borulama detaylarına hâkim. ​Seyahat & Saha: Yurtiçi/yurtdışı proje sahalarında keşif, ölçülendirme ve montaj koordinasyonu yürütebilecek, aktif araç kullanabilen. ​İş Tanımı ​ Proses Tasarımı & P&ID: Gıda tesisleri ve endüstriyel hatlar için P&ID şemalarını oluşturmak ve revize etmek. ​3D Modelleme & Detaylandırma: SolidWorks ortamında ekipman, tank, boru hatları ve çelik konstrüksiyonların 3D tasarımlarını ve imalat resimlerini hazırlamak. ​ Mühendislik & Şantiye Koordinasyonu: Tasarlanan sistemlerin atölye imalatına ve saha montaj ekiplerine (paslanmaz borulama, TIG/orbital kaynak uygulamaları) teknik desteğini sağlamak. ​ Malzeme & Şartname Takibi: Proje şartnamelerine uygun olarak malzeme listelerini (BOM) çıkarmak ve tedarik sürecine katkı sağlamak. ​Dokümantasyon: Proje süreçlerine ait as-built projeleri, imalat resimlerini ve teknik dokümantasyonu eksiksiz olarak hazırlamak.

title: Upperbody/Bıw Design Engineer
description: Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Automotive, or a related field Minimum 1 year of experience in design and release processes for BIW, Underbody, Chassis, or Closures in the automotive industry Good level of English proficiency Experience in 3D/2D sheet metal part design using Siemens NX (Unigraphics and Weld Assistant) Good knowledge of Teamcenter, Co.DeP, BeStandart, and APQP tools Knowledge of CAD0–CAD3 design maturity stages and engineering change management processes (ODM, ECR/ECO, CN) Knowledge of sheet metal stamping feasibility, DFM, welding/joining, and structural adhesive applications Ability to independently manage multiple design releases Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and effective communication skills with cross-functional teams Job Description Platform and Product Development: Development and release of 3D/2D designs for underbody assemblies and components, including floor panels, cross members, longitudinal members, reinforcements, brackets, fasteners, and Tucker studs within the R&D Underbody function Design Maturity and Milestones: Preparation of technical deliverables and definition of spot welding, continuous MIG/MAG welding, brazing, and structural/semi-structural adhesive and sealing applications Interface and Manufacturing Feasibility: Performing DMU packaging, interface, interference, and clearance checks with battery, powertrain, chassis, exhaust, thermal management, and adjacent body structures. Conducting sheet metal stamping feasibility and DFM assessments Standards, Risk, and Analysis Support: Performing DFMEA and Tolerance Stack-Up analyses in accordance with GD&T standards. Supporting the Calculations Office with FEA model updates for Crash, Durability, Stiffness, and NVH analyses Documentation and Reporting: Managing BOM updates, material data, weight and cost optimization (Value Engineering), engineering change documentation (ODM, ECR/ECO, CN), and Open Issue Tracker follow-up. Preparing weekly project progress reports in English

title: CNC CAM Uzmanı
description: Danışmanlığını yapmakta olduğumuz otomasyon alanında faaliyet gösteren iş ortağımızın için "CNC CAM Uzmanı" arayışımız bulunmaktadır. Görev ve Sorumluluklar 3, 4 ve 5 eksenli CNC freze tezgâhlarında gerçekleştirilecek talaşlı imalat operasyonlarının planlanması, programlanması ve üretime hazırlanması. CAD modelleri ve teknik resimler üzerinden üretilebilirlik analizlerinin gerçekleştirilmesi, uygun işleme stratejilerinin belirlenmesi. CAM yazılımları kullanılarak 2.5D, 3D ve çok eksenli CNC işleme programlarının hazırlanması. Tercihen Siemens NX CAM kullanılarak kaba işleme, yarı finiş, finiş, delik delme, diş açma, kontur işleme ve 3D yüzey işleme operasyonlarının programlanması. 4 ve 5 eksenli CNC işleme operasyonlarında indekslemeli (3+1 / 3+2) ve gerektiğinde eş zamanlı çok eksenli takım yollarının oluşturulması. CNC programlarının post-processor aracılığıyla tezgâha uygun NC kodlarına dönüştürülmesi, simülasyon ve doğrulama süreçlerinin yürütülmesi. CNC tezgâhlarında takım sıfırlama, iş parçası referanslama, takım boyu ve yarıçap kompanzasyonları ile iş koordinat sistemlerinin ayarlanması. Kesici takım, takım tutucu, bağlama aparatı ve fikstür seçimlerinin gerçekleştirilmesi; gerekli durumlarda fikstür tasarım ve geliştirme çalışmalarına teknik destek verilmesi. İşlenecek malzemeye ve operasyon özelliklerine uygun kesme hızı, devir, ilerleme, talaş derinliği ve yan paso gibi işleme parametrelerinin belirlenmesi ve optimize edilmesi. Takım yollarının çevrim süresi, takım ömrü, yüzey kalitesi ve üretim maliyeti açısından iyileştirilmesi. CNC programlarının devreye alınması, ilk parça üretimi, deneme kesimleri ve proses doğrulama çalışmalarının yürütülmesi. Üretim sırasında ortaya çıkabilecek ölçüsel uygunsuzlukların, takım aşınmalarının, titreşimlerin ve işleme problemlerinin analiz edilerek teknik çözümler geliştirilmesi. Teknik resimlerde belirtilen ölçü, geometrik tolerans (GD&T), yüzey pürüzlülüğü ve kalite gerekliliklerine uygun üretimin sağlanması. Kumpas, mikrometre, komparatör, mihengir, iç çap ölçüm cihazları ve benzeri hassas ölçüm ekipmanlarıyla gerekli kontrollerin gerçekleştirilmesi. Operasyon planları, takım listeleri, takım ayar föyleri, CNC programları ve üretim talimatları gibi teknik dokümantasyonun hazırlanması ve güncel tutulması. Üretim, kalite, tasarım ve planlama ekipleriyle koordineli çalışılarak üretim süreçlerinin iyileştirilmesi. İş sağlığı ve güvenliği, kalite yönetimi, 5S ve sürekli iyileştirme prensiplerine uygun çalışılması. Aranan Nitelikler Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği, İmalat Mühendisliği, Mekatronik Mühendisliği bölümlerinden veya Meslek Yüksekokullarının Makine, CNC Programlama, Talaşlı İmalat ve ilgili teknik bölümlerinden mezun. CNC freze tezgâhları ve talaşlı imalat teknolojileri konusunda uygulamalı bilgi ve deneyim sahibi. 3 eksenli CNC freze programlama ve işleme süreçlerinde deneyimli; 4 ve 5 eksenli CNC işleme teknolojileri hakkında bilgi ve tercihen uygulama tecrübesine sahip. CAM yazılımlarıyla CNC programı hazırlama konusunda aktif deneyim sahibi. Tercihen Siemens NX CAM; alternatif olarak Mastercam, hyperMILL, Autodesk Fusion, SolidCAM veya benzeri profesyonel CAM yazılımlarından en az birini etkin şekilde kullanabilen. 2.5D ve 3D işleme stratejilerine hâkim; çok eksenli takım yolu oluşturma ve optimizasyon konularında bilgi sahibi. ISO G-Code ve M-Code programlama mantığını bilen, CNC programlarını okuyabilen, analiz edebilen ve gerektiğinde manuel düzenleme yapabilen. Tercihen Siemens SINUMERIK, FANUC, HEIDENHAIN veya benzeri CNC kontrol sistemlerinden en az birinde deneyimli. Kesici takım geometrileri, takım malzemeleri, takım kaplamaları, kesme parametreleri ve talaş kaldırma mekanizmaları hakkında teknik bilgi sahibi. Çelik, paslanmaz çelik, alüminyum ve diğer mühendislik malzemelerinin işlenebilirlik özelliklerini bilen. Teknik resim okuma, ölçülendirme, geometrik toleranslandırma (GD&T) ve yüzey kalite gerekliliklerini yorumlama konusunda yetkin. Hassas ölçüm cihazlarını kullanabilen ve temel kalite kontrol yöntemlerine hâkim. CNC işleme süreçlerinde takım seçimi, operasyon sıralaması, bağlama yöntemleri ve çevrim süresi optimizasyonu konularında analitik yaklaşım sergileyebilen. CAD ortamında 3D parça modellerini inceleyebilen ve CAM programlama için gerekli temel geometrik düzenlemeleri gerçekleştirebilen. Teknik problemleri analiz edebilen, çözüm odaklı, dikkatli ve sistematik çalışma alışkanlığına sahip. Üretim, mühendislik ve kalite ekipleriyle etkin iletişim kurabilen, ekip çalışmasına yatkın. Teknik gelişmeleri takip eden, öğrenmeye ve sürekli iyileştirmeye açık. Temel düzeyde Microsoft Office uygulamalarını kullanabilen ‘‘Workforce İnsan Kaynakları ve Danışmanlık Hizmetleri Ltd. Şti. İşkur'un denetiminde 2016 yılında kurulmuş olup 24.12.2025 tarihli 897 No'lu lisans sahibi özel istihdam bürosudur.4904 sayılı İş Kanunu gereği iş arayanlardan her ne ad altında olursa olsun menfaat temin edilemez ve ücret alınamaz."

title: Yardımcı Tesisler Uzmanı
description: 1983 yılında kurulan Türk ilaç sektörünün lider şirketlerinden Sanovel; güçlü Ar-Ge’si, 60’tan fazla marka , 180’i aşkın üründen oluşan geniş ürün portföyü ve yaklaşık 1.750 kişiden oluşan özel insan kaynağı ile toplumların bir ömür sağlığı için çalışmaya devam etmektedir. Türkiye’nin köklü ilaç şirketlerinden olan Sanovel, yılda 200 milyon kutu ilaç üretim kapasitesine, EU GMP (İyi Üretim Uygulamaları) sertifikasına ve US FDA (Amerikan Gıda ve İlaç Kurumu) onayına sahiptir. Küresel bir ilaç şirketi olma vizyonuyla çalışmalarını sürdüren Sanovel, ürünlerini 5 kıtada 50’den fazla ülkeye ulaştırmakta, geniş ihracat ağıyla uluslararası pazarlardaki gücünü her geçen gün artırmaktadır. Birçok tedavi alanında pazara ilk eşdeğer ürün sunan şirket olan Sanovel, geleceğe yönelik yatırımları, yenilikçi yaklaşımı, kalite ve insan odağıyla 40 yılı aşkın süredir toplum sağlığı için değer yaratmaktadır. Stratejik öncelikleri doğrultusunda çalışmalarını büyüme, globalleşme ve sürdürülebilirlik odağında sürdüren Sanovel, 2035 vizyonu kapsamında etki alanını iki katına çıkararak endüstrisine ve toplum sağlığına sunduğu katkıyı daha da artırmayı hedeflemektedir. Silivri Üretim Tesisi & Ar-Ge Merkezi’nde Fabrika Direktörlüğü, Yatırımlar ve Yardımcı Tesisler Müdürlüğü bünyesinde “ Yardımcı Tesisler Uzmanı” arıyoruz. Temel Sorumluluklar Su sistemleri bünyesinde yer alan saf su, enjeksiyonluk su, saf buhar, yumuşak su ve deiyonize su üretme, depolama ve dağıtım sistemlerinin kontrol ve bakımlarını gerçekleştirmek, Fabrikadaki temiz alan sınıflandırması gereklerine göre, sirkülasyondaki proses ortam havasının canlı-cansız partiküllere karşı korunmasını sağlamak adına; fark basınç, sıcaklık, nem, hava akış düzeni ve hava değişim kat sayılarını önceden set edilmiş limitler içerisinde tutulmasını sağlamak, gerekli ölçüm, kontrol, bakım, filtre değişimleri ve sistem kalifikasyonlarını yönetmek, BMS sistemine bağlı HVAC klima santrallerini ve çiller soğutma sistemlerini işletmek; GMP kriterlerine göre çalışma alanları için öngörülen genel ısıtma, soğutma, havalandırma ve diğer iklimlendirme koşullarının amacına uygun ve istikrarlı şekilde sürdürülmesini sağlamak, Kazan dairesi, buhar ve kondens hatlarının işletmesini sağlamak, günlük ve periyodik kontrol ve bakımlarını gerçekleştirmek, Tesisin ihtiyacı olan basınçlı havanın yeterli miktarda ve istenen basınçta sağlanması için, kompresörlerin bakımlı ve istenilen nitelikte çalıştırılmasını sağlamak, Fabrika geneli tüm bina, sosyal alan ve dış alanların bakım ve onarımlarının takibini yapmak, Enerji tasarrufu ilkeleri uyarınca, enerji ve ısı kayıplarının minimuma indirilmesini sağlayacak önlemler almak, öneriler getirmek, Sorumluluğundaki sistem, ekipman ve tesisatın, bakım, onarım, temizlik, kalifikasyon ve kalibrasyonlarının planlı, zamanında ve eksiksiz yapılmasını sağlamak, Yardımcı işletmeler bünyesinde gerçekleştirilen projelerde aktif rol almak, Sistemlerde oluşan tekrar eden arızaların analizini yapmak, arızaların, bakım yönetmeliğinde belirtilen standartlar ve prosedürleri referans alarak, kalıcı olarak giderilmesini sağlamak. Beklenen Nitelikler Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği veya Elektrik/Elektronik Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezun, Tercihen ilaç üretim tesislerinde, benzer pozisyonda 3-4 yıl tecrübeli, SAP PM (Plant Maintenance) modülü hakkında deneyimli, BMS, HVAC sistemleri, enjeksiyonluk su ve saf su sistemleri konusunda deneyimli, tesis alt yapı sistemlerine hakim, Gelişim çevikliği yüksek, sonuç odaklı, değişime açık olan, Yeni ve farklı olan her şeye merak duyan, İş birliği yaklaşımıyla ilişki ve görev sorumluluklarını yöneten, Kişisel ve kariyer gelişiminin gerekliliklerini bilerek sürekli gelişme odağında olan, İyi derecede İngilizce dil bilgisine sahip, İyi derecede MS Office ve iyi düzeyde AutoCAD programlarını etkin kullanabilen, Erkek adaylar için askerlik hizmetini tamamlamış Biz, her birimizi eşsiz ve değerli kılan asıl şeyin, bakış açılarımız, hayatlarımız, özgeçmişlerimiz ve farklılıklarımız olduğuna inanırız. Etnik köken, din, dil, ırk, yaş, cinsiyet, cinsel yönelim, uyruk, maluliyet veya kültürel farklılık ayrımı yapmıyor, tüm insan kaynakları süreçlerinde dengeli, eşitlikçi ve adil bir yaklaşımı benimsiyoruz.

title: eDrive Process Planning Engineer
description: İş tanımı: eDrive Process Planning Engineer For all who keep the world moving. We as Mercedes-Benz Türk develop and produce Trucks & Buses in our factories based in Istanbul & Aksaray in order to shape the future of sustainable transportation. We are an important part of the production and R&D network of Daimler Truck AG. Everything we do, contributes to a cleaner, safer, more efficient and distinctive future. We start with listening, build to solve, lead with the long view and progress together! Are you ready to be part of our global team to keep the world moving? Why you matter in this role Our team plays a critical role in driving operational excellence. In this role, you ensure the right balance between capacity, materials, and timelines, enabling production to run smoothly, efficiently, and sustainably. Every plan you create and every decision you support directly impacts production performance, costs, delivery reliability, and customer satisfaction. Your contribution matters because you proactively analyze processes, anticipate bottlenecks, and optimize resources across the production flow. By working closely with manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and engineering teams, you translate strategic objectives into effective and executable production plans. In short, your work ensures that production does not just happen as planned—but happens smarter, faster, and more competitively . Your insights and planning expertise are key enablers of the company’s growth and long-term success. What you can expect Integration of eDrive vehicles into existing production, ensuring efficient production flows alongside ICE vehicles. Responsible for the technical integration and validation of high-voltage (HV) propulsion systems and low-voltage (LV) electrical architectures commissioning processes. Responsible for production process planning activities for pre-assembly, assembly and commisioning of HV-components. Development of an optimum and safe HV-commissioning concept based on the new vehicle types Responsible for defining the framework and technical documentation for HV activities on vehicle based specifications including task classification, work environment conditions, and corresponding instructions for process flow. Create manufacturing BoMs and prepare work plans. Identify production equipment and fixtures; support their commissioning; define workflows; and create or update layout plans. That’s why you are a match Required Preferably Engineering degree in E/E or similar fields. Proficient in English. Knowledgeable in HV systems Good computer skills (MS Office applications). Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. No restriction on travel Nice to Have Proficient in German Successfully completed technical studies with work experience in the automotive industry Familiarity with international, cross-location teamwork. Why join us? • Move the world forward: Every 7 of 10 of trucks and 4 of 10 buses produced in Turkiye carry our signature. • Shape the future of mobility: Guided by the star, we are driving innovation with groundbreaking electric vehicle projects. Your ideas today can change how he world moves tomorrow. • Global Impact, local roots: With 100,000 colleagues across 40+ locations, we embody a truly multinational culture—exporting know-how and impact worldwide in Daimler Truck. • Drive sustainability with purpose: For us, sustainability isn’t a trend—it’s a responsibility, fully aligned with the UN’s Sustainable Development Goals. • Grow without boundaries: Cross-functional, cross-location, and international rotations — here, borders don’t limit your career. Your growth has no boundaries. • Learn & Evolve: Take advantage of continuous learning, mentoring, and development programs designed to support your growth at every step. • Thrive beyond work: With 20+ active hobby and sports clubs and sponsorship of national teams, we celebrate life both on and off the field. To join us: 1) Application: Introduce yourself and share why you’re a great fit for the role! 2) Assessment: Show your skills through the tests and tools we’ve prepared for the position. Don’t forget! Each position is unique and requires different skills. 3) Interview: Let’s meet! We’ll get to know each other! 4) Offer: Once everything’s complete, we’ll make our offer. Time to decide! At Mercedes-Benz Türk, we support diversity and advocate an equitable and inclusive corporate culture. Guided by our principle that ‘jobs have no gender’, we are building a workplace together where everyone feels they belong through our diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives. We base our strategy on fairness and equal opportunity, and we evaluate all applications in line with the principle of equality—regardless of age, culture, belief, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, parenthood, or disability status. So, if you don’t meet all the requirements, we encourage you to go ahead and apply — your unique skills and story might be exactly what we’re looking for.

title: Product Engineer
description: Location: Istanbul / Hybrid - Full-time Stage: Stealth, well-funded, early team Mellon AI is building the digital workforce for financial services: an end-to-end platform to build, manage and govern a regulated enterprise's mission-critical workflows. We're already embedded with two major financial institutions and are preparing to come out of stealth very soon. Think of it as the operating system for enterprise AI agents. It sits between LLM agents and the real operations of a financial institution: underwriting, pricing, insurance claims handling, back-office operations, support and compliance. Anywhere a business currently throws headcount at coordination problems. We focus on orchestration. Not a single chatbot bolted onto a workflow, but a system of coordinated, auditable agents that plan, execute, verify and escalate, deployed inside customer environments and improved in the field. We're led by a founding team from Palantir and McKinsey. We're small, well-funded and moving fast. This is a founding-team-adjacent hire. The role As a Product Engineer, you'll sit at the intersection of engineering and product. You'll design and build the interfaces, workflows and tooling that let customers configure, monitor and trust the agents we deploy into their environments. You own features end to end: framing the problem, deciding what the product should do and shipping the code yourself. There's no separate PM or design function between you and the decision. This is a builder's role, not an implementer's. You'll be handed a rough problem, such as "operators don't trust what the agent did here", and be expected to find the right interface, workflow and abstraction to fix it, not just execute a spec someone else wrote. Much of the work is new territory: interfaces for reviewing and correcting AI agent behaviour, human-in-the-loop approval flows, and trust and verification surfaces that don't have established design patterns yet. What you'll do Design and build the customer-facing product: dashboards, configuration surfaces, approval and escalation flows, and the tools operators use to understand what agents are doing and why Own features end to end, from problem framing and UX decisions through to shipped, production-quality code Build and iterate on interfaces for human-in-the-loop review of AI agent output, where trust, clarity and speed all matter Design the abstractions that let one feature work across multiple customer deployments instead of being rebuilt each time Make fast, defensible product calls in ambiguous situations, then revisit them as the system and customer base evolve Partner with backend, platform and agent engineers so product decisions are grounded in what the system can reliably do Instrument and monitor what you ship (usage, failure modes, and where trust in the product breaks down) and use that to prioritise what's next What we're looking for Professional experience as a product engineer, full-stack engineer or founding engineer shipping user-facing product in production Full-stack, end-to-end ownership: you've taken features from problem framing to production, bringing product thinking about what to build and why, not just engineering Strong proficiency in React and TypeScript, including component architecture, state management, and building complex, data-dense UIs from scratch Solid backend and API experience: building and integrating REST or similar APIs, working with Postgres or an equivalent relational database, and reasoning about data models rather than just consuming someone else's endpoint Required: You've shipped features to real users that use LLMs, and you build with AI natively, designing the product around LLMs, agents, retrieval or data pipelines from the start rather than bolting AI on as an afterthought. You're comfortable deciding when to use an LLM call versus deterministic logic, how to handle model latency and failure in the UI, and how to design for outputs that are probabilistic rather than fixed Required: You've built and shipped agentic systems, such as tool use, multi-step agents or workflow orchestration. Side projects count. Real product judgment: you can tell the difference between what a customer asked for and what they actually need, and you push back when a request doesn't generalise Comfort with ambiguity: requirements will be vague, shift weekly, and need judgment calls without a full spec High agency, strong execution, and enthusiasm for building new products in a fast-moving environment Nice to have Experience building product for enterprise or highly regulated customers (insurance, healthcare, financial services, compliance) Background at a high-growth startup where you worked across the full stack and multiple disciplines A track record of excellence: building a startup, or being top of your class, team or field Why join now You'd be one of the first product engineers at a company defining a new category, shaping how enterprises see, trust and interact with autonomous agents. This is applied, hands-on product engineering: you'll spend your time designing and shipping real interfaces for real customers, not sitting in a large organisation waiting for a spec. Compensation: a highly competitive salary and equity package Impact: a high impact on our product, our customers and how the company is built Growth: room for advancement and leadership as the company grows Equity, autonomy and influence over the product's direction are all higher now than they will be in twelve months.

SEÇME YERLEŞTİRME WAM Turkey’ de Seçme ve Yerleştirme sürecinde adayların her pozisyon için gerekli olan yetkinliklere sahip olup olmadıkları objektif, güvenilir ve geçerli metotlarla tespit edilir; iş hayatı ile kişisel başarıda yetkinliklerin rol oynadığı bir yapı hedeflenmiştir. Tüm başvurular titizlikle incelenir ve başvuru anında açık bir kadro olmasa da, adaylar rutin olarak yapılan mülakatlara davet edilebilir. İhtiyaç olduğunda adayların başvuruları tekrar incelemeye alınır. WAM Turkey’in insan kaynakları ihtiyacı, geniş bir yelpaze ile tanımlanabilir. Başvurular sırasında, ilgili pozisyonun gerekleri doğrultusunda öğrenim, deneyim, lisan bilgisi önemli olmakla birlikte, görüşmelerde gözlenen kişisel niteliklerde, adayın seçiminde önemli rol oynar. ÜCRET POLİTİKASI WAM Turkey’ de ücret artış uygulaması, güncel piyasa trendlerini yansıtabilme politikası ve artan performansı ödüllendirebilmek için her yıl gerçekleşir. Her ücret artış dönemi öncesin de piyasa ücret araştırması yapılır. Dikkate alınan kriterler içinde en üstte yer alan kriter, kişisel yetkinlik ve artan performansı ödüllendirmek olduğu için, WAM Turkey’de performans değerlendirmesi öne çıkmaktadır.

title: Mathematical / Physics Engineer (Volunteer) — Numerical Solvers in C++
description: About Josesoft Josesoft develops free engineering tools for the foundry industry. JoseCast Suite and JoseCast Analyzer turn fluid mechanics, heat transfer and thermodynamics into practical tools for casting engineers. Both are available free of charge on the Microsoft Store. Who We Are Looking For A mathematical engineer, physics engineer or applied mathematician / physicist who writes C++. For you, code is the instrument that turns equations into working solvers. Required • Strong C++: memory layout, cache efficiency, avoiding unnecessary copies in heavy numerical loops • Numerical linear algebra: sparse and dense solvers, iterative methods (CG, GMRES) • Discretisation of PDEs: heat equation, Navier–Stokes (FVM / FDM / FEM) A Plus • Scientific Python and its bridge to C++ (pybind11, ctypes or Cython) • Phase transformation kinetics or numerical optimisation • GPU programming (CUDA / OpenCL), metallurgy or thermodynamics What We Are Working On 1. Solver performance: matrix assembly and time-stepping in mould filling and solidification simulation, and porting the heaviest parts to the GPU. 2. Phase transformation kinetics: coupled thermal–metallurgical models for an upcoming heat treatment and microstructure prediction module. What You Gain This is an unpaid, volunteer collaboration. In return you get: • Hands-on experience with a real industrial simulation code: free-surface flow, solidification and metallurgy, solved in C++ • Real numerical problems with real foundry data, not textbook exercises • Direct one-to-one work with the developer, no bureaucracy • Credit as a contributor in release notes and documentation Please Note The software is closed source. Selected collaborators sign a confidentiality and contribution agreement before getting access to the code. How to Apply Instead of a standard CV, send a short message describing a numerical solver, matrix algorithm or physical simulation you implemented yourself in C++, and how you handled its memory or computational bottlenecks.

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description: Mechanical Design Engineer (Junior/Senior) | Regio Rotterdam Ben jij een Mechanical Design Engineer met een passie voor machinebouw? Werk je graag met SolidWorks en vind je het interessant om technische vraagstukken te vertalen naar praktische, maakbare ontwerpen? Voor een innovatieve machinebouwer in de regio Rotterdam zoeken wij een Mechanical Design Engineer die zich bezighoudt met het ontwerpen, verbeteren en doorontwikkelen van hoogwaardige industriële machines. Of je nu een ambitieuze junior bent die zich verder wil ontwikkelen of een ervaren engineer die zelfstandig complexe projecten oppakt: jouw kennis, ervaring en ambities bepalen de verantwoordelijkheden binnen deze functie. Wat ga je doen? Als Mechanical Design Engineer werk je aan bestaande machineconcepten en klant specifieke oplossingen voor internationale toepassingen. Je maakt onderdeel uit van een engineeringteam en werkt nauw samen met collega's van productie, service en externe leveranciers. Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: Ontwerpen en uitwerken van 3D-modellen, samenstellingen en productietekeningen in SolidWorks. Uitvoeren van FEM-analyses en sterkteberekeningen ter onderbouwing van constructieve ontwerpen. Ontwikkelen van klant specifieke oplossingen voor industriële machines. Rekening houden met relevante normen en richtlijnen, waaronder PED, Ex en ADR. Vertalen van technische vraagstukken naar praktisch uitvoerbare ontwerpen. Afstemmen met productie, service en leveranciers over de maakbaarheid van ontwerpen. Signaleren en doorvoeren van verbeteringen aan bestaande machines en constructies. Bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling en optimalisatie van machineconcepten. De mate van zelfstandigheid en complexiteit van de projecten wordt afgestemd op jouw ervaring. Wat breng je mee? We zoeken een engineer die nauwkeurig werkt, initiatief toont en graag meedenkt over praktische oplossingen. Je hebt affiniteit met machinebouw en vindt het interessant om zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband aan uitdagende projecten te werken. Daarnaast beschik je over: Een afgeronde HBO-opleiding Werktuigbouwkunde of een vergelijkbare opleiding. Minimaal 1 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen de machinebouw of een vergelijkbare technische omgeving. Minimaal 1 jaar ervaring met SolidWorks, waaronder assemblees en sheet metal. Ervaring met het uitwerken van 3D-modellen en technische productietekeningen. Een praktische, nauwkeurige en oplossingsgerichte instelling. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om samen te werken met verschillende disciplines. De motivatie om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen engineering en machinebouw. Een uitdagende functie binnen de internationale machinebouw. Werken aan hoogwaardige machines die wereldwijd worden ingezet. Afwisselende projecten met zowel bestaande ontwerpen als maatwerkoplossingen. Ruimte voor persoonlijke groei en professionele ontwikkeling. Samenwerking met ervaren engineers en collega's uit productie en service. Mogelijkheden om zelfstandig projecten op te pakken en verbeteringen te initiëren. Een informele werkomgeving met korte communicatielijnen. Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden. Een fulltime dienstverband van 38 uur per week. title: Senior Mechanical Engineer – High-Temperature & High-Pressure Equipment
description: MCA Engineering Netherlands is an ambitious and fast-growing high-tech engineering and consulting organization. Originally French, but now operating in Europe, the secondment of engineers and IT specialists focuses on the design and implementation of innovative systems for large-scale industrial projects. The NL office is located in Eindhoven, but the ambition is to open multiple locations in the Netherlands. The company is characterized by a 'can-do' mentality, in which responsibilities lie low in the organization and 'accountability for results' is a natural consequence. At the same time, the focus is on making each other successful and supporting each other, where necessary. About The Role At MCA Engineering, we are looking for an experienced Senior Mechanical Engineer to join a brand-new project in the energy sector. As the first mechanical engineer on the project, you will take a leading role in the conception, design and development of installations and equipment that operate at very high temperatures and high pressures. You will work closely with process, electrical and control engineers to turn concepts into robust, safe and manufacturable designs. This is a hands-on design role with a strong technical focus, rather than a project management or commissioning position. Responsibilities Design and develop mechanical equipment and installations for high-temperature and/or high-pressure applications, from concept to detailed design. Design piping systems, pressure vessels, heat exchangers and related process equipment. Perform engineering calculations and analyses (strength, thermal, pipe stress) and select suitable materials. Apply relevant codes and standards for pressure equipment, such as ASME and PED. Prepare 3D models, 2D drawings, bills of materials and technical documentation. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, suppliers and stakeholders throughout development. Support prototyping, testing and design reviews. Profile Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering or a related field. At least 9 years of experience in mechanical design and development. Proven experience designing equipment or installations for high temperature and/or high pressure, for example in energy, nuclear, oil & gas, petrochemical, chemical process, power generation or hydrogen. Hands-on experience with pressure equipment design, piping systems or heat exchangers. Knowledge of codes and standards such as ASME or PED. Experience with CAD and engineering analysis tools. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently in a new project. Nice to have Experience with CAESAR II or other pipe stress analysis tools. FEA experience (for example ANSYS). Experience with thermal storage, molten salt or nuclear applications. Experience as the lead or first engineer on a new development.

title: Utvecklingsingenjör Hydraulik
description: Vill du arbeta nära tekniken – från idé och koncept till färdig konstruktion? Motiveras du av att utveckla robusta, smarta och användarvänliga hydrauliklösningar för produkter som används av kunder över hela världen? Nu söker vi en Utvecklingsingenjör Hydraulik till vårt R&D-team. Rollen är en viktig del i vår fortsatta satsning på att utveckla egna och applikationsspecifika hydrauliklösningar för framtidens lantbruksmaskiner. Här får du möjlighet att påverka både tekniska lösningar, arbetssätt och produktens funktion – från tidig idé till färdig produkt. Om rollen Som Utvecklingsingenjör Hydraulik får du en praktisk och tekniskt bred roll där du utvecklar, underhåller och förbättrar hydrauliksystem och hydraulikkomponenter för mobila applikationer. Du arbetar med lösningar som ska fungera i verkligheten – i kundens maskin, i tuffa miljöer och i produkter som används varje dag. Rollen handlar om att utveckla genomtänkta hydrauliklösningar och skapa konstruktionsunderlag som fungerar hela vägen från CAD och ritning till test, produktion och kundnytta. Du får även bidra med din tekniska förståelse i frågor som rör befintliga produkter, förbättringar och intern teknisk support. Du blir en del av vårt R&D Mechatronics-team som utvecklar tekniska lösningar för hela JOST, både under egna varumärken och direkt till ledande fordonstillverkare. Teamet arbetar i gränslandet mellan mekanik, hydraulik, elektronik, mjukvara och elektrifiering – områden som blir allt viktigare i våra produkter. Vi utvecklar bland annat manöverventiler, snabbkopplingssystem och andra hydraulikkomponenter som ofta ingår i större styrsystemsplattformar. title: R&D Development Engineer
description: Job Title: R&D Development Engineer IMI plc We are a global specialist engineering company that creates breakthrough solutions. We are curious and like to solve problems, partnering with our customers to solve the demands of today and prepare for the challenges of tomorrow. We embrace innovation and care about outcomes that are good for business, everyday life and making a better world - creating lasting impact for everyone. We design, build and service highly engineered products in fluid and motion control applications. We focus on five market sectors: Industrial Automation, Process Automation, Climate Control, Life Science and Fluid Control, and Transport. Climate Control offers hydraulic solutions for water-based heating and cooling systems to achieve a perfect indoor climate with minimal energy consumption. Our leading brands have been used in over 100,000 building projects worldwide and offer products and solutions in three key areas: Pressure maintenance and water quality, regulation, control and actuators, and thermostatic control. Purpose of the Role The R&D Development Engineer will contribute to the development of new mechanical products and improvements to existing products, working throughout the development process from early ideas and concepts to prototypes, testing and industrialization. The role is suitable for an engineer with a strong interest in technology and product development who wants to develop broad engineering skills in a practical R&D environment. Previous experience from product development is an advantage, but we also welcome candidates early in their engineering career or with experience from areas such as production engineering, manufacturing, testing or industrialization. The role combines engineering, problem-solving and hands-on development, with close collaboration between R&D, laboratory, Operations, Quality, Project Management and other functions. Key Responsibilities Product Development Participate in developing and evaluating new product concepts and technical solutions. Perform mechanical design and create technical documentation. Work with the complete product development process from idea and concept through design, prototype, verification and industrialization. Develop knowledge in mechanical design, materials, tolerancing and Design for Manufacturing (DFM). Participate in technical design reviews and contribute ideas and technical solutions. Use engineering calculations and simulation where appropriate to support development work. Prototyping & Verification Participate in building, evaluating and improving prototypes. Work hands-on with prototype assembly, testing and troubleshooting. Help define test methods and verification activities. Plan and perform testing together with lab engineers and technicians. Analyze results and investigate technical problems and failures. Contribute to structured engineering methods such as Design and Verification Plans and DFMEA. Industrialization Work closely with process engineers, Operations and Quality when moving new products into production. Develop an understanding of how design, manufacturing, assembly, cost and quality influence each other. Participate in solving technical problems during prototype and production introduction. Gain practical experience with manufacturing processes such as casting, machining and assembly. Contribute to designing products that are not only functional, but also practical and efficient to manufacture. Cross-functional Collaboration Work together with R&D engineers, Project Managers, laboratory personnel, Process Engineering, Procurement, Operations and Quality. Participate in discussions around product requirements, manufacturing requirements and technical solutions. Work with experienced colleagues and specialists from different engineering disciplines. Collaborate with colleagues across the global organization. Learn and work according to structured product development methods such as APQP. Education & Experience BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering, Product Development, Production Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering or equivalent. Strong interest in technology, mechanical engineering and product development. Interest in understanding how products work and how they can be improved. Basic knowledge of mechanical design, engineering materials and manufacturing processes. Experience with 3D CAD from education or professional work. Interest in working with both theoretical engineering and practical development. Good problem-solving skills and willingness to learn. Relevant practical experience can be as valuable as previous R&D experience. Candidates may, for example, come from production engineering, manufacturing, testing, quality or another technical role and want to develop towards product development and R&D. Preferred Experience with 3D CAD, for example Solid Edge or comparable software. Experience or education in machining, casting, manufacturing or assembly. Experience with prototyping, testing or technical problem-solving. Basic knowledge of tolerancing and GD&T. Exposure to engineering tools such as simulation, 3D printing or 3D scanning. Experience working close to manufacturing or industrialization. The position is based in Ljung, where R&D works close to casting, machining, assembly and laboratory testing. This provides an environment where an engineer can follow a product from an early idea, through prototypes and testing, all the way into production. Health & Safety The physical demands described within the Key Duties & Responsibilities section of this job description are required to perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities. Please contact the talent team to discuss the specific Work Conditions and Physical Requirements of this role. Health, Safety, and Environmental Duties - At IMI we are all personally committed to protecting our people, minimizing our impact to the environme

title: Rör- och anläggningskonstruktör till Sweco - utvecklas tillsammans med oss!
description: Är du nyfiken på att utvecklas inom rör- och mekanikkonstruktion och vill arbeta i ett framstående konsultföretag? Har du något års erfarenhet inom området och vill ta nästa steg i karriären? Då kan du vara den vi söker! Varför välja Sweco? Hos oss blir du en del av en värderingsstyrd arbetsplats där innovation, samarbete och utveckling står i fokus. Vi erbjuder en flexibel arbetsmiljö med möjlighet att styra din egen utveckling och arbeta nära engagerade kollegor. Här finns stora möjligheter att växa både tekniskt och personligt, i en organisation som värdesätter nyfikenhet och ansvarstagande. Din framtida roll Som rör- och anläggningskonstruktör kommer du att ingå i ett team med god sammanhållning där vi arbetar nära varandra. Du kommer få möjlighet att delta i olika projekt, ofta i nära samarbete med erfarna kollegor. Hos oss kommer du att få stöd i dina arbetsuppgifter men förväntas också ta eget ansvar för att utveckla dina färdigheter. Arbetet kan vara på plats hos våra kunder eller på vårt kontor och du får chansen att växa inom konstruktion och projektledning i en öppen och inkluderande miljö. Ledarskapet Jag tror på ett ledarskap som ger dig frihet under ansvar. Jag strävar efter att skapa en arbetsmiljö där du ges stor möjlighet att ta eget initiativ, utvecklas och växa i ditt arbete. Mitt mål är att se dig utvecklas – du ska känna att du är en viktig del av vårt team och organisationens framgång!” – Jakob Smitterberg, Gruppchef Den vi söker – är det du? Vi söker dig som har Cirka 3 års erfarenhet av rör- och mekanikkonstruktion, gärna inom industriprojekt eller processindustri Relevant högskoleutbildning eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet Intresse för att utvecklas och lära dig mer inom området Gillar att samarbeta och kommunicera med kunder och kollegor Kunskaper i Plant 3D, E3D eller liknande är meriterande men inte krav Behärskar svenska i tal och skrift Varför jobba hos oss? Vi erbjuder dig en arbetsplats som uppmuntrar till personlig och professionell utveckling. Du kommer få arbeta med engagerade kollegor och ett positivt team där vi delar erfarenheter och hjälper varandra att växa. Hos oss kommer du få arbeta med spännande projekt i olika branscher och marknader i Sverige och Europa. Vi erbjuder flexibla arbetsformer och möjligheten att påverka din arbetsdag. Välkommen att söka! Urval sker löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan. Tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Ansök via vårt digitala ansökningsformulär. Har du frågor? Kontakta gärna Jakob Smitterberg, Gruppchef Industri, på telefon 076-604 02 94 eller mail jakob.smitterberg@sweco.se Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig och välkomnar dig till Sweco! På Sweco vill vi vara en arbetsplats präglad av mångfald. Vi tror att fler perspektiv breddar vår förmåga att fortsätta nå våra mål och eftersträvar mångfald i våra rekryteringsprocesser. Sweco planerar och utformar morgondagens hållbara samhällen och städer. Med den samlade kunskapen hos våra 23 000 arkitekter, ingenjörer och andra experter arbetar vi tillsammans med våra kunder för att möjliggöra den gröna omställningen, maximera digitaliseringens potential och stärka Europas konkurrenskraft och resiliens. Sweco är Europas ledande konsultföretag inom arkitektur och teknik med en omsättning på cirka 32 miljarder SEK under 2025. Företaget är noterat på Nasdaq Stockholm.

title: Senior Clinical Mechanical Design Engineer
description: Overview Senior Mechanical Design Engineer | Clinical Systems Develop the next generation of automated clinical and diagnostic technologies. At Waters , we're looking for a talented Senior Mechanical Design Engineer to join our growing Clinical Systems Team . This is an opportunity to work on innovative automated sample preparation solutions that help laboratories deliver faster, more accurate patient results worldwide. You'll play a key role in designing and developing complex electro-mechanical systems, taking products from concept through to launch while collaborating with multidisciplinary teams across engineering, manufacturing, and suppliers. Responsibilities What You'll Do Support the mechanical design and development of innovative clinical instrumentation and automation products. Interpret development requirements and translate them into high-quality engineering solutions that meet performance, quality, cost and schedule objectives . Create, evaluate and refine designs using CAD, prototyping, testing and engineering analysis. Solve complex engineering challenges and drive continuous product improvement. Work closely with manufacturing partners to ensure designs are robust, scalable and cost-effective. Support new product development projects while contributing to the ongoing success of existing products. Mentor and provide technical guidance within cross-functional engineering teams. Qualifications What We're Looking For Degree-qualified in Mechanical or Electro-Mechanical Engineering (or equivalent experience). Strong mechanical design experience within complex products or systems. Proficiency in SolidWorks Experience of design for manufacture, prototyping, testing and problem solving. Understanding of GD&T and engineering best practices. Good analytical thinking with a practical approach to problem-solving Collaborative approach with excellent communication skills. Desirable Automation or robotics experience. FEA experience. Medical device, scientific instrumentation or regulated product development experience. Why Join Waters? Hybrid working: 3 days onsite, 2 days from home Flexible working hours 25 days holiday Private medical and dental cover Competitive pension scheme On-site gym Clear development and career progression opportunities Even if you don't meet every requirement, we'd still love to hear from you. Join a team that's developing cutting-edge clinical technologies and making a real difference to healthcare worldwide. Company Description Waters Corporation (NYSE:WAT) is a global leader in life sciences and diagnostics, dedicated to accelerating the benefits of pioneering science through analytical technologies, informatics, and service. With a focus on regulated, high-volume testing environments, our innovative portfolio harnesses deep scientific expertise across chemistry, physics, and biology. We collaborate with customers around the world to advance the release of effective, high-quality medicines, ensure the safety of food and water, and drive better patient outcomes by detecting diseases earlier, managing routine infections, and combating antibiotic resistance. Through a shared culture of relentless innovation, our passionate team of :16,000 colleagues turn scientific challenges into breakthroughs that improve lives worldwide. Diversity and inclusion are fundamental to our core values at Waters Corporation. It benefits our employees, our products, our customers and our community. Waters complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws. Qualified applicants are considered without regard to sex, race, color, ancestry, national origin, citizenship status, religion, age, marital status (including civil unions), military service, veteran status, pregnancy (including childbirth and related medical conditions), genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, legally recognized disability, domestic violence victim status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Waters is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.
