title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer 1
description: Eaton Wimborne Located in Wimborne, Dorset, Eaton's Aerospace division is a global leader in aerospace fuel systems, renowned for delivering fully integrated solutions for both fixed and rotary-wing aircraft. Our Wimborne facility specialises in cutting-edge air-to-air refuelling systems, advanced refuelling probes, air-to-air and air-to-ground launch systems utilising both pneumatic and pyrotechnic ejection technologies, as well as a range of Defensive Aids Sub-Systems. With over 80 years of industry experience, we are recognised as the world’s leading provider of air-to-air refuelling systems, offering fifth-generation solutions to Air Forces worldwide. Our legacy of innovation and technical excellence sets us apart as the most advanced air-to-air refuelling supplier on the global stage. What You’ll Do The Senior Mechanical Design Engineer will work within the Mechanical Design Engineering team at EATON Wimborne. Design Engineering team are responsible for the development of mechanical designs and production of drawings across all product lines as MSD Wimborne. Design Engineers are allocated to projects as required and the role offers the opportunity to work on a wide variety of products. The role encompasses all aspects of the product lifecycle from support to bids, development of system requirements, concept design through to issue of production standard drawings. The Senior Mechanical Design Engineer will also provide support to production concessions and in service issues where applicable. Produce concept designs for new products or product modifications to meet customer requirements whilst working to agreed timescales and within agreed budgets. Complete stress, performance and tolerancing calculations in support of the designs. Use Design for Six Sigma tools and Design for Manufacture tools to optimise concept design / modifications. Present design solutions to peers and customers. Support supply chain by interpreting and respond to suppliers technical inquiries relating to designs during the manufacture. Sentencing concession and drawing change applications and presenting the assessment to material and change review boards. Provide status updates and participate in design / project team meetings. Report technical progress to Engineering and Programmes team leaders. Help ensure compliance of design to specification requirements and following the Life Cycle Management Process. Ensure compliance of drawings to EATON design and configuration control processes. Management of outsource activities and resource management utilising Eaton project management tools if applicable. Technical management and/or mentoring of junior design engineering Process and procedure development in support of continual improvement philosophy. Qualifications Good engineering degree, Mechanical, Electrical, Aerospace, or equivalent experience. Minimum of 5 years in an Engineering Design & Development organisation; ideally has experience within Aerospace. Skills Demonstrated technical skills leading a design aspect of a project, experience with design processes managing multiple technical project deliverables. Good technical and analytical (Fluid Dynamic, Stress, Electrical …) knowledge base with the ability to understand and generate analysis. Experience in a relevant professional engineering environment ideally gained in the aerospace or equivalent high technology industry. Experience writing Statements of Work for subcontract services and managing remote workers. Experience in New Product Introduction of aerospace products. Experience with electrical and mechanical product design and qualification. Experience with CAD packages such as CREO, Catia or Solidworks Experience working with Geometrical Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) Experience with Six-Sigma quality tools Experience working with data management systems (PLM) Strong verbal and written communication skills. Strong report writing skills. Knowledge or strong interest in aerospace system technology. Good problem solving skills. Strong organizational skills. Authority to work in the UK and within the US ITAR legislation." Excellent written, oral, and interpersonal communication presentation skills and the ability to work well with customers and development team members Train and develop engineers The successful applicant will be in contact with US ITAR controlled technology, goods, and information. title: Design Engineer - Mechanisms
description: As a Design Engineer within our Mechanisms team, you will develop innovative mechanical solutions for the automotive industry, from pedestrian protection hood hinges and traditional mechanisms to active aerodynamics and powered closures. You will take designs from concept through to production, developing 3D CAD, engineering drawings and GD&T definition; supporting prototype builds and testing; and solving engineering challenges that arise along the way. You will combine mechanical design, kinematics and manufacturing know-how to turn challenging concepts into robust, production-ready mechanisms, working directly with our manufacturing divisions, suppliers and OEM customers. Education And Experience Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering or a related field. Graduates and applicants with up to 3 years’ experience are encouraged to apply. Automotive engineering experience preferred, although strong candidates from similar engineering backgrounds will be considered. Excellent knowledge of 3D CAD and engineering drawing creation. Strong mechanical aptitude with the ability to conceptualise and develop mechanical components and mechanisms. Good understanding of mechanical principles including kinematics, loads, tolerances and component interfaces. Working knowledge of manufacturing processes and design for manufacture. Working knowledge of GD&T and tolerance application. Knowledge of failure mode avoidance tools such as DFMEA and PFMEA. Experience in supporting prototype build and design validation would be an advantage. Understanding of active systems, including electric actuation, hydraulics and sensors, would be an advantage but is not required. High level of interest in automotive engineering and mechanical systems. Good written and verbal communication skills. Strong organisational and problem-solving skills. Practical, hands-on approach to engineering and product development. Hold a current passport and be able to travel as required. At Multimatic, we offer more than just a job – we offer a career with purpose. Join a team that values innovation, collaboration, and personal growth. To learn more about Multimatic, check out our youtube channel - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=psOjJIh3t90 If you are interested in this position, apply by sending us your cover letter and resume. Key responsibilities Structural Integrity: Lead static and dynamic FEA on load-bearing structures, delivering sign-offs based on well-founded assumptions rather than padded safety factors. Lightweight Optimization: Drive topology and parametric optimization to minimize mass within the safety margin, validated by physical testing. Dynamic & Fatigue Analysis: Model impact, vibration and cyclic loading to predict failure modes before they appear in testing. Design Collaboration: Partner with the design engineers from the earliest concept stage, turning simulation insight into load-path-aligned design decisions rather than after-the-fact checks. Methods & Standards: Establish the organization's FEA methods, material data and sign-off standards, and correlate them continuously with test results. Your profile We seek builders ready to move beyond theory to real deployment: professionals who value precision and reliability as much as innovation. Must-haves Experience: 5+ years of dedicated FEA/structural simulation in high-performance robotics, aerospace or automotive engineering, with a track record of sign-offs on structures that shipped. FEA Mastery: Expert level in Abaqus or comparable tools for static, dynamic, modal and fatigue analysis - able to defend every modeling assumption behind a sign-off. Materials & Methods: Solid knowledge of metals and composites, topology optimization and multi-body dynamics. Test Correlation: Proven experience correlating simulation predictions with physical test data. CAD Fluency: Comfortable in CAD to translate findings directly into design iterations. Mindset: You balance startup agility with the rigor of industrial-grade engineering. You bridge mechanical, electrical and software teams, and you iterate until predicted and measured failure modes match. Nice-to-haves Explicit Dynamics: Experience with drop and impact simulation. Thermal-Structural Coupling: Experience combining thermal and structural results. Scripting & Automation: Python or similar to automate pre- and post-processing. Robotics Fundamentals: Working understanding of humanoid and/or industrial robotics systems - how perception, actuation and control interact. Why us? The Team: Work alongside leadership with a proven track record of building unicorn-scale companies and defining global robotics standards. Smart Strategy: We operate as disciplined fast followers. Capital is timed to the deployment inflection point, avoiding early-mover dead ends to scale fast on proven foundations. Resources: We are substantially internally funded and attract top-tier investors to avoid any capital constraints for our mission. Historic Opportunity: Join at the dawn of a new industry comparable to the rise of the automobile. Help shape the European champion in this trillion-dollar market. About us We are building a global leader in physical AI, anchored in Europe’s strongest robotics heritage. Founded by entrepreneurs with backgrounds in scaling digital products and advanced robotics, the team is bolstered by senior leadership from top-tier AI research labs and industrial tech companies. Driven by a mission to create versatile and trustworthy embodied AI for physical labor, We fuse deep engineering mastery in AI and mechatronics with a rapid-execution culture. We are addressing the labor shortage by closing the gap to production-grade deployment. This means building the trusted alternative: robots that are safe, secure, and engineered to automotive standards of scale and durability. Our Locations We have two main locations: Munich, Germany and Limassol, Cyprus. This pan-European setup represents our core ambition of building a European technology leader, gives us a great talent base and a strong corporate structure. We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all builders.

title: Ingénieur/Ingénieure chercheur en mécanique de la rupture F/H
description: Rejoindre EDF, c’est travailler dans un Groupe qui lutte au quotidien contre le réchauffement climatique. C’est travailler dans un Groupe avec des valeurs fortes, qui innove avec de solides actifs industriels. Le département Matériaux et Mécanique des Composants (MMC), composé de six groupes, réalise des activités de recherche et de développement dans le domaine des matériaux et de la mécanique des composants et structures. Le groupe Mécanique des Matériaux et des Structures du département MMC étudie les propriétés mécaniques des matériaux métalliques et leur influence sur la tenue mécanique des structures. Il contribue à ce titre aux projets de R&D consacrés à l’étude du comportement des matériaux métalliques (y compris haute température), de la durée de vie en fatigue (amorçage et propagation), de l’endommagement et la rupture. L’emploi proposé ici concerne la réalisation d’études de R&D dans le domaine de la mécanique de la rupture, avec une forte composante expérimentale. Dans le cadre votre mission, vous serez amené-e à : développer des outils et méthodes avancées pour la justification de la tenue à la rupture des composants des unités de production d’électricité. Ces outils et méthodes peuvent être expérimentaux ou basés sur la simulation numérique ; réaliser des études et expertises techniques dans vos domaines de compétences pour répondre aux besoins des directions opérationnelles en charge de l'ingénierie et de la production ; participer à des projets de recherche collaboratifs avec des partenaires français et internationaux (CEA, Framatome, laboratoires universitaires, EPRI...) tout en assurant une veille technologique pour préparer l'avenir. Vous collaborerez avec une équipe de plusieurs personnes au sein du groupe, travaillant sur la mécanique de la rupture, d'un point de vue expérimental et de modélisation. Vos activités principales porteront sur : le dimensionnement, la préparation, le suivi, le dépouillement et, lorsque nécessaire, la réalisation d'essais de rupture sur éprouvettes et structures ; l’interprétation des essais via la simulation numérique par éléments finis (Code_Aster, Salome_Meca, etc.) ; le développement et la validation de méthodes et critères d'analyse en mécanique de la rupture pour les matériaux métalliques. Des connaissances en métallurgie sont appréciées. Une compétence en simulation numérique constitue un atout complémentaire permettant de croiser les approches expérimentales et les analyses mécaniques. Rigoureux-se, organisé-e, vous travaillez en autonomie, innovez et êtes force de proposition. Votre aisance relationnelle et votre écoute, vous permettent de travailler efficacement en équipe avec des personnes de différents profils. Vos possédez des capacités de synthèse et de communication. Un anglais et un français courants à l'oral et à l'écrit sont indispensables, notamment dans le cadre des échanges avec les partenaires internationaux. La diversité alimente notre performance. Dans le groupe EDF, accueillir des personnes en situation de handicap fait partie de notre ADN. Notre objectif est d’ouvrir nos portes à toutes les compétences, toutes les énergies et toutes les personnalités sans exclusion. Le poste proposé est donc ouvert à toutes et à tous. title: Kontrol ve Simülasyon Mühendisi
description: İş ilanı hakkında Firmamız bünyesinde, insansız deniz araçlarına yönelik dinamik sistem modelleme, kontrol algoritmaları geliştirme, simülasyon ortamlarının tasarımı ve geliştirilmesi, sistem performans analizleri, doğrulama ve test süreçlerinde aktif rol alacak takım arkadaşları arıyoruz. İş Tanımı İnsansız deniz araçlarının (İDA) dinamik davranışlarının analiz edilmesi, sistem tanımlama yöntemleri kullanılarak matematiksel modellerinin oluşturulması ve doğrulanması. İnsansız deniz araçlarına yönelik kontrol algoritmalarının tasarlanması, geliştirilmesi ve performanslarının iyileştirilmesi. Geliştirilen dinamik modellerin ve kontrol algoritmalarının simülasyon ortamlarına entegre edilmesi, farklı operasyonel senaryolar altında test edilmesi ve doğrulanması. Geliştirilen model ve kontrol algoritmalarının gerçek sistemler üzerinde test edilmesi, saha testlerinin planlanması ve yürütülmesi, elde edilen verilerin analiz edilerek sistem performansının değerlendirilmesi. Aranan Nitelikler Üniversitelerin Kontrol ve Otomasyon veya ilgili mühendislik bölümlerinden mezun olmak. Dinamik sistemlerin matematiksel modellenmesi, sistem tanımlama (System Identification) ve model doğrulama konularında bilgi ve deneyim sahibi olmak. Klasik ve modern kontrol teorilerine hâkim olmak; PID, LQR, MPC gibi kontrol yöntemlerinin tasarımı, analizi ve uygulanması konularında bilgi sahibi olmak. Alt seviye (Low-Level) ve üst seviye (High-Level) kontrol sistemlerinin geliştirilmesi, gerçek zamanlı uygulamalar ve kontrol algoritmalarının sistemlere entegrasyonu konularında bilgi sahibi olmak. Gazebo ve Unity gibi simülasyon ortamlarında dinamik sistemlerin modellenmesi, fizik tabanlı simülasyonların geliştirilmesi, kontrol algoritmalarının entegrasyonu ve farklı operasyonel senaryoların test edilmesi konularında bilgi veya deneyim sahibi olmak. Simülasyon ortamlarının geliştirilmesi, MIL/SIL/HIL test süreçleri, saha testlerinin gerçekleştirilmesi ve test verilerinin analiz edilerek sistem performansının değerlendirilmesi konularında bilgi veya deneyim sahibi olmak. title: DESIGN ENGINEERING MANAGER
description: ARVEN HR Consultancy is conducting a senior-level recruitment process on behalf of a confidential client operating in the advanced engineering and technology sector. We are seeking an experienced Design Engineering Manager with a strong background in complex product development, mechanical and structural design, systems engineering, and technical team leadership. The ideal candidate will combine hands-on engineering expertise with proven management capabilities, taking responsibility for critical design activities and leading multidisciplinary engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Lead and manage engineering design activities from concept development through validation and qualification. Provide technical leadership to engineering teams while maintaining active involvement in design and development processes. Oversee mechanical and structural design activities, ensuring alignment with technical requirements, performance objectives, and engineering standards. Manage engineering requirements, system interfaces, design verification processes, and weight optimization activities. Lead and coordinate Preliminary Design Reviews (PDR) and Critical Design Reviews (CDR), ensuring technical readiness and design compliance. Evaluate engineering analyses, structural performance assessments, and validation results to identify and implement design improvements. Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams in resolving complex technical challenges and ensuring effective system integration. Oversee engineering modifications, design decisions, and technical documentation, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and traceability. Participate in technical reviews and coordinate engineering activities with internal teams and relevant external stakeholders. Support key development milestones, technical verification, and qualification activities. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline. Minimum 8–10 years of professional engineering experience, including at least 3–5 years in engineering team management. Proven involvement in at least one complex engineering development program, preferably from concept through qualification. Strong expertise in mechanical and structural design, with experience in complex integrated systems. Solid knowledge of systems engineering, requirements management, interface management, PDR/CDR processes, and weight budget management. Ability to interpret engineering analyses, structural performance assessments, and technical test results, translating findings into practical design improvements. Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams and coordinating complex technical development activities. Experience in technically demanding, highly regulated, or project-based engineering environments is preferred. Ability to interpret international technical standards and prepare comprehensive engineering documentation in English. Strong analytical thinking, sound engineering judgment, decision-making capabilities, and effective leadership skills. THE OPPORTUNITY This position offers the opportunity to take on a key engineering management role within a technically sophisticated development program. The successful candidate will lead critical design activities, guide multidisciplinary engineering teams, and contribute directly to technical decision-making, engineering validation, and continuous product development. The role combines engineering leadership with hands-on technical involvement, offering the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to complex and challenging engineering projects. APPLICATION PROCESS The recruitment process will be conducted with strict professional discretion.Further information regarding the organization, project scope, and reporting structure will be shared exclusively with shortlisted candidates at the appropriate stage of the selection process. Qualified professionals are invited to submit their applications for confidential consideration.

title: Structural Design Engineer
description: About the role RT Marine Consulting is seeking Structural Design Engineers at various experience levels to join our engineering team. These fully remote roles are open to candidates based in Ankara, Izmir, Istanbul, or Mugla, TÜRKİYE. As part of RT’s design team, you will contribute to the design and development of maritime infrastructure, working closely with coastal and geotechnical specialists within multidisciplinary project teams working on port, harbour, and coastal infrastructure projects across international markets. The role provides exposure to projects throughout the full engineering lifecycle, from early-stage feasibility studies and concept development through detailed design, tender documentation, and construction support. Key Responsibilities Contribute to the structural design and analysis of marine and coastal infrastructure, including jetties, quay walls, mooring and berthing dolphins, piled structures, and similar waterfront facilities. Develop engineering calculations, basis of design documents, technical notes, and design reports in accordance with international standards, project specifications, and best engineering practices. Prepare structural layouts, typical cross-sections, and technical documentation supporting concept, preliminary, and detailed design phases. Support the development of technical specifications, tender documentation, and design deliverables for port, harbour, and coastal infrastructure projects. Collaborate with coastal, geotechnical, and multidisciplinary engineering teams to deliver coordinated and technically sound design solutions. Participate in design reviews, technical coordination meetings, and client discussions throughout the project lifecycle. Ensure engineering deliverables comply with relevant international standards, authority requirements, and project quality procedures. Provide engineering support during construction, including responses to clarifications, review of contractor submissions, and participation in site visits when required. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering. Minimum 3-5+ years of experience in analysis and design of civil structures Proficiency in engineering analysis and design tools such as SAP2000, APILE, LPILE, DEEPEX, ACAD or similar. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams. Ability to participate in site visits and occasional travel, depending on project requirements. Preferred Qualifications Knowledge of marine, port, and coastal engineering principles, practices, processes. Experience in relevant marine, port, and coastal engineering codes, standards, regulations, compliance practices. Seismic design experience and background. Proficiency in French. Proficiency in Arabic. Application Procedure The role is open to candidates currently resident in Istanbul, Ankara, Izmir or Muğla , Türkiye. Candidates interested in this role are invited to send their CVs to careers@rtproject.com Please be sure to reference DE-TR-26 in the subject line. About RT RT is an international engineering consultancy specializing in coastal, port, and marine infrastructure projects. Our services cover the full range of marine infrastructure development, including coastal engineering studies, port and marina master planning, marine structural design, and construction support. RT frequently collaborates with port authorities, developers, marine contractors and other international engineering consultancies as consultant or project partner, providing regional engineering expertise across Türkiye, Cyprus, the Mediterranean basin, the Middle East, Near East, Eastern Europe, North, East and West Africa, and the Black Sea and Caspian Sea coastlines.

Java, C#, Go, TypeScript) nesne yönelimli ve eşzamanlı (asyncio, thread, process) programlama deneyimi • Veri yapıları, algoritmalar ve zaman/uzay karmaşıklığı konularında temel bilgi • TCP/IP ağ temelleri; TCP ve UDP soket programlama bilgisi • REST API tasarımı ve geliştirmesi; kimlik doğrulama ve yetkilendirme konularında bilgi • İlişkisel veritabanlarında (PostgreSQL tercih edilir) SQL, indeksleme ve şema tasarımı bilgisi • Linux sistem yönetimi ve servis geliştirme: systemd servis (unit) yazımı ve yönetimi, süreç ve log yönetimi (journalctl), dosya sistemi ve izinler, kabuk (shell) betikleri • Linux üzerinde ağ yapılandırması ve sorun giderme: ağ arayüzleri, IP adreslendirme, yönlendirme (routing), NAT, güvenlik duvarı (iptables/nftables), DNS, VPN; SSH ile uzaktan erişim • Git ve Docker kullanımı • Web ön yüz geliştirme (React/TypeScript tercih edilir) veya düşük seviyeli protokol geliştirme deneyimi • Log ve metrik analizi ile sistematik hata ayıklama yetkinliği • Wireshark ve tcpdump ile paket yakalama ve protokol analizi • Teknik İngilizce dokümanları okuyup yazabilme Artı Olacak Nitelikler • SNMP, MQTT, Modbus, CAN veya benzeri ağ/endüstriyel protokollerle çalışma deneyimi • Görüntü işleme / derin öğrenme (OpenCV, YOLO, TensorRT) ve uç cihazlarda (ör. NVIDIA Jetson) model dağıtımı • Redis, mesaj kuyrukları ve WebSocket tabanlı gerçek zamanlı veri akışı • CI/CD (GitLab CI) ve gömülü Linux (Armbian/Yocto/Buildroot) deneyimi • Claude Code gibi yapay zekâ destekli geliştirme araçlarını kullanma deneyimi Aranan niteliklerin tamamına sahip olunması zorunlu değildir; kendini geliştirmeye istekli adaylar değerlendirilecektir. title: Field Service Engineer/Saha Servis Mühendisi Aksaray/Kayseri/Niğde - Turkey
description: Are you… Interested in working for an international and diverse company? Interested in developing your career in a leading Printing, Coding and Marking industry? Looking to use your troubleshooting skill? If so, read on! It’s likely you have purchased or used a product touched by Videojet Technologies this week. From freshness dating to track and trace coding, our technologies help ensure products sold across the globe are authentic and safe for consumers to use in the food, beverage, pharmaceutical, and industrial marketplaces. We recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent. Diversity of experience and skills combined with passion is a key to innovation and excellence. Therefore, we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions. The Field Service Engineer at Videojet Technologies plays a key and vital role in supporting our Customers and ensuring that our ‘Up Time Peace of Mind’ goal is achieved. They are responsible for installing, repairing, and servicing the range of Videojet Equipment. The position will be located in Aksaray, Kayseri or Niğde, Turkiye. In this role, a typical day will look like: Install and commission new Videojet solutions Maintain and Service our customers’ installed base of Videojet equipment Work closely with sales to support Videojet trials and demonstrations Maintain and grow customer relationships through excellent customer service and communication. The essential requirements of the job include: Field Service Experience at customer sites or remotely via phone Experienced within 2-3 years the marking and coding industry, industrial automation or related industry Experienced within automation / PLC communication Demonstrated success in overachieving on personal targets Preferably fluent in written and spoken English Willingness to travel within the Turkiye Videojet is proud to be a Product Quality & Innovation company in Veralto (NYSE: VLTO). Imagine a world where everyone has access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. That is the tomorrow Veralto is creating today. Veralto is a $5B global leader in essential technology solutions made up of over 16,000 associates across our Water Quality and Product Identification segments all united by a powerful purpose: Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources. Siz de… Uluslararası ve farklı kültürlerden profesyonellerin yer aldığı bir şirkette çalışmak ister misiniz? Baskı, kodlama ve markalama sektörünün lider şirketlerinden birinde kariyerinizi geliştirmeyi hedefliyor musunuz? Problem çözme ve teknik arıza giderme becerilerinizi kullanabileceğiniz bir pozisyon mu arıyorsunuz? Cevabınız evet ise, okumaya devam edin! Muhtemelen bu hafta satın aldığınız veya kullandığınız ürünlerden en az biri Videojet Technologies'in teknolojileriyle işaretlenmiş durumdadır. Son kullanma tarihi uygulamalarından izlenebilirlik (track & trace) kodlamalarına kadar sunduğumuz çözümler; gıda, içecek, ilaç ve endüstriyel sektörlerde dünya genelinde satılan ürünlerin orijinalliğini ve tüketiciler için güvenliğini sağlamaya yardımcı olmaktadır. Farklı deneyimlere ve yeteneklere sahip insanların başarıya katkı sağladığına inanıyoruz. Deneyim, bilgi birikimi ve tutkuyla birleşen çeşitlilik; yenilikçilik ve mükemmelliğin temelini oluşturur. Bu nedenle, farklı geçmişlerden gelen tüm adayları açık pozisyonlarımıza başvurmaya davet ediyoruz. Sürdürülebilirliği nasıl desteklediğimizi gösteren Videojet tanıtım videomuzu izleyebilirsiniz! Videojet Technologies bünyesindeki Saha Servis Mühendisi (Field Service Engineer) , müşterilerimize destek sağlamak ve "Up Time Peace of Mind" hedefimizi gerçekleştirmek açısından kritik bir rol üstlenir. Bu pozisyonda görev alacak kişi, Videojet ürünlerinin kurulumu, devreye alınması, bakımı ve onarımından sorumlu olacaktır. Pozisyonun çalışma yeri Aksaray, Kayseri &Niğde, Türkiye 'dir. Bu rolde sizi neler bekliyor? Yeni Videojet çözümlerinin kurulumunu ve devreye alınmasını gerçekleştirmek, Müşterilerimizde kurulu bulunan Videojet ekipmanlarının bakım ve servis hizmetlerini sunmak, Satış ekibiyle yakın çalışarak ürün denemeleri ve demonstrasyon süreçlerine destek vermek, Üstün müşteri hizmeti ve etkili iletişim ile müşteri ilişkilerini sürdürmek ve geliştirmek. Aradığımız nitelikler Müşteri sahasında veya uzaktan telefon desteğiyle servis deneyimine sahip olmak, Markalama ve kodlama, endüstriyel otomasyon veya benzer sektörlerde 2-3 yıl deneyim sahibi olmak, Otomasyon sistemleri ve Plc haberleşme konusunda deneyimli olmak, Kişisel hedeflerini düzenli olarak aşan başarılı bir performans geçmişine sahip olmak, Tercihen yazılı ve sözlü İngilizce bilgisine sahip olmak, Türkiye genelinde seyahat engeli bulunmamak. Veralto bünyesinde faaliyet gösteren Videojet Technologies olarak, gıda, ilaç ve temel ihtiyaç ürünlerinin güvenliğinin herkes için vazgeçilmez bir hak olduğuna inanıyoruz. Ürün tanımlama teknolojilerinde dünya liderlerinden biri olarak geliştirdiğimiz yenilikçi kodlama ve markalama çözümleri sayesinde müşterilerimizin ürün güvenliğini sağlamalarına ve verimliliklerini artırmalarına destek oluyoruz. Videojet, Veralto (NYSE: VLTO) çatısı altında faaliyet gösteren, ürün kalitesi ve inovasyon odaklı bir şirkettir. Herkesin temiz suya, güvenli gıdaya, güvenilir ilaçlara ve temel ihtiyaç ürünlerine erişebildiği bir dünya hayal ediyoruz. Veralto bugün, yarının bu dünyasını inşa ediyor. Yaklaşık 5 milyar dolar büyüklüğünde küresel bir teknoloji şirketi olan Veralto, 16.000'den fazla çalışanıyla , Su Kalitesi (Water Quality) ve Ürün Tanımlama (Product Identification) iş kollarında faaliyet göstermekte ve tek bir ortak amaç doğrultusunda çalışmaktadır: Dünyanın en değerli kaynaklarını korumak. title: Well Engineer
description: General Responsibilities of the Well Planning Engineer Identify and/or prepare all relevant well design and planning requirements in accordance with the company Well Handover Process, prepare and/or review the well proposal and design basis, and technically monitor the execution of the relevant programs. Provide engineering input to Well Programs in accordance with the tasks assigned by the Senior Well Planning Engineer. Prepare detailed well plans, including casing seat selection, casing strength design, kick tolerance calculations, casing/BOP (Blowout Preventer)/equipment pressure test requirements, drill string design, hydraulics, drilling fluid design, and cementing design; review and approve designs prepared by third-party contractors and provide support to the operations team when required. Conduct offset well analysis and prepare well diagrams and schematics and Well Phase Completion Reports; review the Time–Depth and Cost–Depth charts for the well on a daily basis. Maintain and archive all well-related documentation, including photographs, records, and contractor reports, in accordance with the applicable process. Ensure that Company KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) for all drilling activities are recorded and updated; participate in Quarterly Performance Reviews and provide the Performance Lead Engineer with all data required for benchmarking contractor performance. Perform quality control of the weekly Well Performance Report prepared by the Drilling Site Engineer and ensure that NPT (Non-Productive Time) tracking is consistent with the actual reporting in OpenWells™. Prepare cost estimates related to drilling activities for scope definition options identified by the Geoscience Team. Review and provide comments on Drillers’ Instructions. Monitor the status of contracts quarterly together with the Senior Well Planning Engineer, including expenditure against approved contract value and contract validity periods; monitor the inventory of long-lead items under the contracts and coordinate future requirements/requests to prevent shortages. Conduct rig visits, preferably three to four times per year. Perform other duties and projects assigned by the Senior Drilling Engineer, Senior Well Planning Engineer, and Drilling Operations Manager within the scope of the position.

title: (High Tech) Mechanical Engineer
description: About This Vacancy In this role, you will work on something that does not yet exist: a completely new platform within our latest generation of Advanced Packaging machines. This is no development on an existing machine, but true pioneering. If you are passionate about turning complex mechanical concepts into reality and eager to make an impact, this position offers the perfect opportunity to apply your skills. You will work within a growing team where you can truly make impact. You will have the freedom to introduce and develop your own ideas, with ample opportunity for feedback and refinement from our team. You will work closely with our colleagues in Singapore and Hong Kong, as well as with external development partners in the Netherlands. Together we form the driving force behind machines that are deployed worldwide in high-tech industries. Key Responsibilities Design and develop mechanical concepts, modules, and components for high-precision systems, from initial concept through detailed design and release. All design work is done in NX and managed in Teamcenter. Translate functional and system requirements into robust mechanical designs, ensuring performance, manufacturability, reliability, and cost-effectiveness. Perform tolerance analyses and detailed dimensioning, taking into account precision, thermal behaviour, and assembly constraints. Conduct mechanical analyses and simulations (e.g. FEM, stiffness, deformation, eigenfrequencies, thermal effects) to validate design performance. Collaborate closely with system engineers, mechatronics engineers, suppliers, and international teams (including Singapore and Hong Kong) to ensure alignment with system-level performance. Contribute to the definition and realization of mechanical subsystem concepts, including prototype design and implementation. Support integration and testing of prototypes and modules, perform root cause analysis, and implement design improvements. Participate in design reviews and technical discussions, ensuring compliance with performance, quality, safety, and cleanroom (e.g. ISO 3) requirements. Work with suppliers and manufacturing teams to ensure design for manufacturability and assembly (DfM/DfA) and support industrialization. Maintain structured technical documentation (drawings, specifications, change management) and contribute to continuous improvement and innovation, including support in patentable concepts where relevant.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer Machinebouw
description: Jouw toekomst als vertrekpunt Je krijgt energie van het ontwerpen van machines en wilt zelf actief blijven in de techniek. Van complexe 3D-modellen tot slimme, maakbare constructies: jij vindt het mooi om technische ideeën om te zetten in oplossingen die daadwerkelijk gebouwd worden. Als Senior Mechanical Engineer krijg je de vrijheid om zelfstandig te ontwerpen, machines verder te ontwikkelen en op termijn de technische lead binnen projecten op je te nemen. Highlights Salaris tot € 5.800 bruto per maand; Zelfstandig 3D-ontwerpen en construeren met SolidWorks, met doorgroeimogelijkheden richting Lead Engineer; 33 vrije dagen en een mobiliteitsbudget van circa € 750 per maand. Wat ga je doen Als Senior Mechanical Engineer werk je dagelijks aan het ontwerpen en doorontwikkelen van machines en geautomatiseerde productielijnen voor verschillende businessunits. Met SolidWorks vertaal je klantwensen en technische vraagstukken naar gedetailleerde 3D-ontwerpen en maakbare mechanische constructies. Je werkt aan zowel nieuwe machines als bestaande systemen, waarbij je continu kijkt naar functionaliteit, maakbaarheid en betrouwbaarheid. De 2D-productietekeningen worden extern uitgewerkt. Jij kunt deze tekeningen lezen en beoordelen en zorgt dat de technische uitwerking aansluit op jouw ontwerp. Ook werk je met de bijbehorende stuklijsten. Je werkt zelfstandig aan mechanische constructies en stemt jouw ontwerpen af met collega-engineers, projectteams, klanten en andere stakeholders. Daarbij denk je mee over technische verbeteringen en de verdere ontwikkeling van machines en machinelijnen. Door jouw ervaring kun je fungeren als technisch aanspreekpunt voor een specifieke machinegroep of machinelijn en verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor de technische doorontwikkeling ervan. Afhankelijk van het project en jouw ambities krijg je de mogelijkheid om als Lead Engineer te werken, terwijl je zelf actief blijft ontwerpen en construeren. Je werkt in een ondernemende omgeving waar veel technologie in eigen huis wordt ontwikkeld. Niet ieder proces is volledig vastgelegd en juist dat biedt ruimte om zelf initiatief te nemen en verbeteringen aan te dragen. Je krijgt de vrijheid om technische keuzes te maken, jouw ontwerpen verder te optimaliseren en mee te denken over hoe engineering slimmer kan worden ingericht. Zo blijf je jezelf technisch ontwikkelen en kun je stap voor stap groeien in verantwoordelijkheid. Dit breng je mee Een afgeronde technische opleiding in Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar; Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als Mechanical Engineer, Mechanical Design Engineer of Constructeur binnen de machinebouw of bij een OEM; Ervaring met 3D-CAD, bij voorkeur SolidWorks; Het vermogen om zelfstandig mechanische constructies te ontwerpen, productietekeningen te lezen en te beoordelen en met stuklijsten te werken; Een zelfstandige, proactieve werkhouding en het vermogen om technische vraagstukken af te stemmen met collega’s, klanten en andere disciplines. Wat je ervoor terugkrijgt Een salaris tot € 5.800 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring; 25 vakantiedagen en 8 aanvullende vrije dagen; Een mobiliteitsbudget van circa € 750 per maand en vergoeding van toepasselijke tolkosten; Een goede pensioenregeling met 4% werknemersbijdrage; Een thuiswerkvergoeding van € 2,40 netto per gewerkte thuiswerkdag; Een jaarlijks opleidingsbudget van € 500, met mogelijkheden voor aanvullende opleidingen; Doorgroeimogelijkheden richting een inhoudelijke Lead Engineer-rol binnen projecten, met veel vrijheid om zelfstandig te ontwerpen en technische verbeteringen door te voeren. Over de opdrachtgever Deze internationale machinebouwer is een familiebedrijf met vestigingen in binnen- en buitenland. De organisatie ontwikkelt innovatieve automatiseringsoplossingen en investeert sterk in eigen technologie en productontwikkeling. De cultuur is informeel, persoonlijk en ondernemend, met een goede mix van jonge en ervaren engineers. Medewerkers krijgen veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid, waarbij eigen initiatief belangrijker is dan het volgen van volledig vastgelegde processen. ✔ Pluspunt: Je werkt aan zelfontwikkelde technologie en krijgt de ruimte om technische verbeteringen daadwerkelijk door te voeren. ✔ Pluspunt: Je kunt doorgroeien naar een inhoudelijke leadrol binnen projecten, terwijl je zelf actief blijft ontwerpen en engineeren Waarom engineers kiezen voor Comaen Wij reverse engineeren loopbanen. Niet het cv als beginpunt, maar jouw toekomst als vertrekpunt. We kijken naar hoe je wilt werken, waar je energie van krijgt en hoe je wilt groeien. Benieuwd hoe andere engineers dit ervaren? Lees de reviews of ontdek hun succesverhalen. Voor meer informatie over de vacature Senior Mechanical Engineer kun je contact opnemen met Maikel Henckens via mobiel of WhatsApp op 06-11856120 of per e-mail via maikel.henckens@comaen.nl. With rapid growth across regions, many colleagues have progressed from engineering roles into leadership positions — your future development is supported and recognised. title: Konstruktør
location: Middelfart Municipality, Güney Danimarka Bölgesi, Danimarka
description: Tag ansvar for den mekaniske konstruktion fra løsningsforslag til færdigt tegningsgrundlag. Bliv en del af et innovativt miljø! Vær med til at skabe værdi og godt arbejdsmiljø hos vores kunder gennem den nyeste teknologi. Vi søger vi en erfaren Konstruktør, der kan omsætte kundernes behov til gennemtænkte konstruktioner. Du arbejder med layout, gribeværktøjer og mekaniske løsninger, hvor dine tekniske valg får betydning for, hvordan det færdige anlæg fungerer hos kunden. Stillingen er relevant for dig, der: Brænder for udvikling af maskiner eller automatiseringsløsninger. Trives med at indgå i et dynamisk og tværfagligt team, der har fokus på nye teknologier og tilfredse kunder – gennem tæt samarbejde, vidensdeling, kreativitet og innovation. Motiveres af afvekslende projektopgaver med skræddersyede automatiseringsløsninger efter kundens behov. Stillingen Som Konstruktør får du ansvar for den mekaniske konstruktion i dine projekter. Du udvikler løsningen og udarbejder det tegnings- og dokumentationsgrundlag, der skal bruges til at fremstille, samle og vedligeholde den. Du bliver en del af et projektteam og arbejder tæt sammen med fagspecialister og teknikere på tværs af virksomheden. Løsningerne udvikles i dialog med kunder, leverandører og samarbejdspartnere. Du bidrager også med din konstruktionsfaglige viden i tilbudsfasen, hvor du drøfter løsningsmuligheder med salg. Eksempler på dine arbejdsopgaver: Udvikle og konstruere maskiner og mekaniske dele til robot- og automationsløsninger. Udarbejde layout og konstruere gribeværktøjer. Udarbejde detailtegninger og teknisk dokumentation. Reservedelslister og vedligeholdelsesplaner. Prisbevidst indkøb af komponenter og opfølgning på leverancer. Bidrage til teknisk afklaring og drøfte løsningsmuligheder med salg i tilbudsfasen. En opgave kan eksempelvis være at udvikle et gribeværktøj til en kundes robotcelle og udarbejde det tegningsgrundlag, der skal bruges til fremstillingen. Din profil Du arbejder grundigt og tager ansvar for at følge dine konstruktionsopgaver til dørs. Du holder overblik, får afklaret tekniske spørgsmål og følger op på dine aftaler. Du kan arbejde selvstændigt og bruger samtidig dine kollegers viden aktivt. Du har blik for detaljerne og for, hvordan din konstruktion skal fungere som en del af det samlede anlæg. Din faglighed: Du er eksempelvis uddannet maskiningeniør, maskinteknik, produktionsteknolog eller har en anden relevant teknisk baggrund. Du har solid erfaring med konstruktion af maskiner og automationsløsninger, herunder robotløsninger. Vi søger dig, der: Har solid erfaring med AutoDesk Inventor. Er vant til at arbejde projektorienteret. Kan omsætte tekniske krav til konstruktioner og et gennemarbejdet tegningsgrundlag. Kommunikerer godt på dansk og engelsk. Som person trives du i en mindre organisation, hvor der arbejdes i tværfaglige teams. Vi tilbyder Hos Danrobotics får du indflydelse på den mekaniske løsning og ansvar for dine egne konstruktionsopgaver. Kundernes forskellige behov giver variation i arbejdet, og du får mulighed for at bruge din faglighed på tværs af forskellige løsninger. Du får tæt samarbejde og faglig sparring med kolleger, der arbejder med andre dele af samme anlæg. Det giver dig indsigt i sammenhængen mellem din konstruktion og den samlede robotløsning. Vi prioriterer fleksibilitet, personlig og faglig udvikling af den enkeltes kompetencer, medarbejderinddragelse og tillidsbaserede relationer – både internt og eksternt. Vi arbejder med frihed under ansvar og tilbyder løbende udvikling og uddannelse. Lønnen aftales efter dine kvalifikationer. Praktisk information Send din ansøgning og dit CV til Bodil Koertsen på bk@danrobotics.dk. Vil du vide mere om opgaverne og hverdagen som konstruktør hos os? Kontakt Stevan Jensen på +45 61 15 12 62. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og afslutter processen, når vi har fundet den rette kollega. Vi ønsker at besætte stillingen hurtigst muligt.

title: Mechanical Design Engineer - Power Systems
description: Last date to apply: 08 December 2026 We’re one of the world’s oldest start-ups — and we’re just getting started. At Husqvarna Group, innovation is in our DNA. With over 330 years of heritage and a passion for pioneering technology, we design and deliver world class products and solutions for forest, park, garden and construction care. We develop next-generation handheld products where performance, usability, and environmental responsibility are key. At the heart of these products is the powertrain—and that’s where you come in. Join our Base Engine team in Power Systems We are now looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer to join the Base Engine group within Power Systems, part of Handheld R&D. Power Systems is responsible for developing the powertrains in our products. In this team we focus on petrol-powered handheld products, developing engines and engine components for our 2-stroke engines, including cylinder, piston, crankshaft and bearings. Base Engine is a team of around 11 design engineers, some with specialist areas, who work together to develop the next generation of handheld products for forestry and urban environments. We work with the full life cycle of a component, from the first idea to product care. About the role: As a Design Engineer you take responsibility for your own complex components and drive them forward. You will work with both new product development and product care: Develop and design components for new products, for example a new chainsaw, and make sure they fit in the whole product and meet new product requirements Create 2D and 3D drawings and manage design changes, including tooling changes Carry out root cause analyses to understand why failures occur in complex systems Participate in regular sync meetings with your platform lead, for example to discuss changes of supplier for a component Work closely with neighbouring design engineers, test and verification, manufacturing and suppliers In our different product value streams you work together with a platform lead and look at the product as a whole, not only at the component level. This is a cross-functional role with many internal contact points, and you will need to manage several tasks in parallel. You will have support from experienced colleagues, and we encourage you to ask for help when you need it. About you: You’re proactive, curious and take great ownership of your components. You enjoy digging into technical details and complex systems. You are structured and know how to plan your work, keep track of timelines and drive your own tasks forward, while being a good team player who is not afraid to ask for support. You communicate clearly and are comfortable making decisions and recommending next steps. Your skills and background: Degree in Mechanical Engineering At least 3 years of professional experience in mechanical engineering or product development Experience in mechanical design and in creating 2D and 3D drawings Experience with CAD tools such as CATIA V5 and PLM (e.g. Teamcenter) Ability to plan, structure and prioritize your own work Fluent in English and Swedish Meriting: knowledge of combustion engine technology, especially 2-stroke engines Meriting: experience with casting, metal machining, geometry assurance or cost management Location This position is placed in Huskvarna How We Work We believe the best ideas happen when we're connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive. Your Application Apply as soon as possible. We are screening on an ongoing basis and will fill this position as soon as we have found the right person. For more information about the position, contact hiring manager Hilda Lindstrand at hilda.lindstrand@husqvarnagroup.com . For questions regarding the process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Kristin Sundlo at kristin.sundlo@husqvarnagroup.com. Processing of personal data When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer. For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and your rights, please see our privacy notice. Winning Through Culture We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters. title: Mekanikkonstruktör till Design & Development, Special Mission & Regional Aircraft
description: Drivs du av att se dina idéer bli verklighet? Välkommen till vår spännande och teknikintensiva värld. Vill du arbeta med modifieringar och vidareutveckling av flygplan och helikoptrar i operativ drift? Trivs du med tekniska utmaningar där du får kombinera konstruktion, problemlösning och nära samarbete med andra specialister? Då kan detta vara rollen för dig. Din Roll Vi söker nu en engagerad och driven mekanikkonstruktör som vill bidra med sin tekniska kompetens, sitt engagemang och sina idéer i ett team där vi samarbetar och når framgång tillsammans. Hos oss på Design & Development, Special Mission & Regional Aircraft arbetar du med att utveckla, anpassa och integrera tekniska lösningar i befintliga flygande plattformar tillsammans med erfarna och engagerade kollegor. Projekten spänner från mindre modifieringar där du självständigt driver arbetet framåt till mer omfattande uppgraderingar i tvärfunktionella team. Du är med från tidiga koncept och konstruktioner till prototyper, tester och färdig lösning. Arbetet präglas av stor variation, tekniska utmaningar och nära samarbete med kollegor inom flera olika kompetensområden. Arbetet sker ofta i samarbete med kund och resor i tjänsten kan förekomma. Vi erbjuder en öppen och inkluderande arbetsmiljö där varje medarbetare ges stort ansvar, möjlighet att påverka och goda förutsättningar att utvecklas både professionellt och personligt. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter Utveckla och förbättra mekaniska konstruktioner och tekniska lösningar Ta fram koncept, konstruktionsunderlag och tillverkningsritningar Utföra hållfasthets- och konstruktionsberäkningar Säkerställa att konstruktioner uppfyller tekniska krav och regelverk Ta fram och hantera teknisk dokumentation Delta i projekt tillsammans med andra tekniska discipliner Bidra till utveckling av arbetssätt, metoder och förbättringsinitiativ Din Profil För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du är en person som kombinerar teknisk kompetens med nyfikenhet och ett starkt driv att lösa problem. Du kan hantera komplexa konstruktionsutmaningar genom att se helheten samtidigt som du har förmågan att fördjupa dig i detaljer när det behövs. Du arbetar strukturerat och kvalitetsmedvetet samtidigt som du tar egna initiativ och driver ditt arbete framåt. Eftersom många av våra projekt genomförs i nära samarbete med kollegor från olika teknikområden är det också viktigt att du är kommunikativ och uppskattar att arbeta i team. Vi värdesätter både erfarenhet och utvecklingspotential. Därför söker vi dig som vill fortsätta växa tillsammans med oss och bidra till teamets gemensamma framgång. Vi söker dig som har Högskole- eller civilingenjörsexamen inom maskinteknik eller annat relevant tekniskt område Flerårig erfarenhet av mekanisk konstruktion Erfarenhet av hållfasthetsberäkningar Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift Det är meriterande om du har Intresse för eller erfarenhet från flygindustrin Kunskaper i Inventor och AutoCAD Erfarenhet från tillståndspliktig verksamhet Varför ska du välja oss? Hos oss får du arbeta med tekniskt avancerade produkter i en verksamhet där kvalitet, säkerhet och precision står i centrum. Du blir en del av ett engagerat team som arbetar med att vidareutveckla, anpassa och förbättra befintliga system och installationer för nya behov och uppdrag. Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap. Vad du blir en del av Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas. Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med syfte att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidra till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld. Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här Vänligen observera att vi arbetar med löpande urval och att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum har gått ut. Välkommen med din ansökan och bli en del av vårt team som utvecklar och förbättrar flygtekniska lösningar för dagens och morgondagens operativa behov.

title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer - Pneumatic Integration
description: TRATON is a group of strong brands with a shared mission: transforming transportation together to create the future of sustainable transport solutions. Within TRATON, we include MAN, Scania, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. Together, we have the power to transform transportation - Let´s make a difference together. Find out more: www.traton.com Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Role Summary This role is a part of TRATON Group R&D, located in Södertälje, Sweden. We are looking for a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer to join our team developing and integrating modular pneumatic systems for heavy trucks. This hands-on role combines mechanical engineering with technical leadership: developing solutions, guiding engineering activities and helping colleagues grow through knowledge sharing. You will tackle mechanical design, packaging and integration challenges in the truck chassis, including pneumatic pipe routing and component installation. Your solutions will need to work across vehicle configurations, brands and production environments. From early concepts and 3D design to verification and implementation, you will take technical ownership and work across functions to balance performance, modularity, manufacturability and assembly requirements. Alongside your own design work, you will lead technical activities, support engineering decisions and share your expertise through mentoring and practical guidance. You bring more than five years of relevant experience in mechanical design or a related engineering field, together with the ability to guide others. Experience in chassis development, vehicle layout or pneumatics is particularly valuable, but we also welcome transferable expertise from other mechanical engineering applications. As part of TRATON Group R&D, you will also have opportunities to collaborate with colleagues across our global brands and contribute to the continued development of our engineering methods, digital tools and ways of working. Job Responsibilities As a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer, you will: Develop modular pneumatic installations for heavy trucks, including components, air tanks and pneumatic pipe routing. Take technical ownership of mechanical concepts and complex packaging challenges, progressing solutions from concept to implementation. Lead and coordinate engineering activities, clarifying priorities, interfaces and next steps with colleagues. Collaborate with cross-functional and international teams across TRATON. Guide technical discussions and design reviews, evaluate trade-offs and support engineering analyses, testing and verification. Create and maintain technical documentation. Support production and other stakeholders with technical expertise. Contribute to the development of our modular system, engineering methods and digital tools. Mentor colleagues and share knowledge through practical guidance, constructive design feedback and collaboration within our global engineering community. Who You Are You enjoy combining hands-on engineering with helping others succeed. You approach technical challenges in a structured way, explain your reasoning clearly and take responsibility for moving work forward. You provide direction when needed while remaining open to questions and alternative solutions. Your leadership experience may come from a formal role, leading technical activities, coordinating work or mentoring colleagues. What matters is your ability to build shared understanding, guide others towards common objectives and make your knowledge useful to the team. You work effectively across disciplines and value different perspectives. When requirements compete, you help colleagues understand the options and agree on practical, well-founded solutions. For this role, you bring: A Bachelor's or Master's degree in mechanical engineering or a relevant discipline, or equivalent knowledge gained through professional experience. More than five years of relevant professional experience in mechanical design or a related engineering field, with expertise applicable to mechanical development and integration. Experience developing mechanical components or installations using 3D CAD, with an understanding of interfaces, packaging and manufacturing requirements. Experience taking responsibility for engineering work from problem definition to implementation, communicating technical reasoning and collaborating across disciplines. Demonstrated ability to lead technical activities, guide colleagues and share expertise through mentoring or other knowledge-sharing activities. Professional working proficiency in English. The following experience is an advantage, but not a requirement: Automotive, heavy vehicles or a similar engineering industry. Modular product development. Chassis development, vehicle layout or mechanical integration. Pneumatic systems, component installation, piping or routing. Working in international or cross-functional engineering teams. Swedish language skills. If you bring the core engineering experience and technical leadership skills, we encourage you to apply even if you do not have all the additional experience listed above. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds – your unique experience and perspectives is valuable to us. This Is Us We are a team working with pneumatic integration and chassis installations, including air tanks, brake modules, pneumatic pipe routing and everything in between. Our engineering challenges sit at the intersection between components, systems and the complete vehicle. We need to find solutions that work not only for one truck, but across different configurations and applications within a modular product system. At the same time, the transportation industry is changing through electrification, digitalization

title: Spacecraft Mechanical Engineer
description: Company NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there. Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris. Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators. Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it. Your Role We are seeking a Structural Engineer to support the design, analysis, testing, and qualification of structures for our VLEO satellite missions. You will work across the full development lifecycle of flight hardware, from early structural modelling and design reviews through environmental testing and validation, helping ensure the reliability and survivability of spacecraft operating in one of the harshest orbital environments. You will also work closely with mechanical, thermal, propulsion, systems, and AIT teams to develop structurally robust hardware capable of surviving launch and sustained operations in Very Low Earth Orbit (VLEO). Key Responsibilities Perform structural analysis of flight hardware including spacecraft structures, propulsion subsystems, and mechanical assemblies. This includes static, modal, random vibration, sine, shock, and quasi-static load cases. Develop and validate finite element models (FEM) for spacecraft and high-performance aerospace structures. Perform hand calculations for preliminary analysis in support of FEA. Support structural sizing, stiffness optimisation, and load path analysis for launch and in-orbit environments. Plan and execute vibration, shock, and structural qualification testing test campaigns end-to-end: write the test plan, instrument the hardware, interpret the data, correlate the model, and close out the qualification report. Instrument hardware using accelerometers and strain gauges, and correlate test results back to analytical models. Review engineering drawings and collaborate directly with designers to drive structural design decisions. Support qualification activities against relevant aerospace and space standards including GEVS, ECSS, and NASA requirements. Contribute to structural verification activities across development, integration, and test phases. Requirements Education: B.S. or M.S. degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related field. 3+ years of structural analysis experience on flight hardware, including spacecraft, launch vehicles, missiles, or high-performance structures. Experience with structural analysis of a satellite's primary or secondary structure (i.e., the load-bearing bus/frame, not just a subsystem or payload) is strongly preferred. Experience with structural analysis of spacecraft structures and subsystems, including electronic boxes, propulsion systems, hydraulics, or solar panels. Experience with design for manufacturing (DFM). Hands-on experience with FEM and ability to justify modelling assumptions and approaches. Experience with Altair OptiStruct is a strong plus; proficiency with industry-standard solvers such as NASTRAN, ANSYS, or Abaqus is required. Familiarity with launch environments including random vibration PSDs, SRS shock spectra, and quasi-static load factors. Practical experience supporting environmental testing, including instrumentation with accelerometers and strain gauges and model correlation activities. Confidence reading and reviewing engineering drawings and working directly with design engineers on structural decisions. Beneficial Experience with analysis of composite materials. Experience with material testing, metallic and composites Why NewOrbit Space? Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO. Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology. Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success. Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups. Hybrid working - One dedicated remote day per week. Visa sponsorship and relocation support - We sponsor visas and provide relocation support for candidates moving to join us.

We provide support and opportunities to our employees to achieve their full potential and cultivate a rewarding career. Our Protective Design & Security (PD&S) practice prioritises the protection of life and assets by mitigating consequences of security risks in the built environment. With more than 75 years of experience, our risk-led and strategic solutions safeguard people, property, and operations from intentional harm, evolving and emerging threats. Whether safeguarding a cultural landmark, securing a healthcare facility, or planning for crowd safety at a major event, our approach is grounded in intelligence, simulation, and human-centered design to deliver resilient solutions with demonstrable performance and lasting impact. You will apply threat-informed engineering to structural hardening, blast effects, and progressive collapse, helping connect protective measures with architecture, site design, electronic security, and operations across buildings, campuses, and mixed-use environments. With support from your team, you will work in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment while developing technical, analytical, and project coordination skills. Assist with analysis, modeling, and calculation tasks as well as the integration of structural and physical security measures into project designs. Coordinate with architects, engineers, planners, and security specialists in a multidisciplinary team environment. Build familiarity with Thornton Tomasetti’s culture, services, and collaborative working style while growing your technical and professional skills. What You'll Bring Bachelor’s degree in structural or civil engineering, or a closely related field; master’s degree preferred. Interest in protective design, security, resilience, and hazard-resistant engineering. Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills. title: Back To Core – Bring Your Experience To The Core of Engineering (BTC - 2026)
description: TEI TUSAŞ Motor Sanayii / Eskişehir Yayın Tarihi: 22.04.2026 TEI olarak 1985’ten günümüze; havacılık motorları alanında sektöre sunduğumuz yüksek kaliteli ürün, hizmetler ile uluslararası arenada dünya çapında bir üretici ve küresel bir tasarım merkezi konumundayız. Bu güçlü konumumuzdan hareketle kendimizi Gücün Kaynağı olarak tanımlıyoruz. Küresel havacılığa sunduğumuz katkılar ve Türkiye’nin havacılık serüvenine kazandırdığımız ilkler ile başarı hikâyeleri yazmaya devam ediyor; parça ve modül üretimi, motor montaj, test ve bakım, onarım, revizyon, motor tasarımı ve ürün geliştirme alanlarında mükemmeli hedefliyoruz. Türk Havacılık Uzay Sanayii, GE Aerospace, Türk Silahlı Kuvvetleri Güçlendirme Vakfı ve Türk Hava Kurumu ortaklığında kurulan şirketimiz, millî projelerle gurur veren başarılarda yerini alma ve geleceğin havacılık hikâyelerine imza atma fırsatı sunuyor. Bu yolculukta başarımızı teknoloji ile beraber değerlerimizden de alıyoruz: adaletle güven inşa ediyor, birlikte mükemmelliği hedefliyor, kapsayıcı bir ortam kuruyor, yenilikçi bakış açısıyla büyüyor ve sorumluluk bilinciyle hareket ediyoruz. Back to Core , yurt dışında edindiğin bilgi ve deneyimi Türkiye’ye taşıyarak havacılık motorları alanında değer üretmek isteyen mühendisler için tasarlandı. Back to Core ile TEI’de tam zamanlı kariyerine başlarken, global bakış açını mühendisliğin kalbine taşıyacak ve yüksek katma değerli teknolojilerin geliştirilmesine doğrudan katkı sağlayacaksın. title: Yüzey İşlem Mühendisi
description: Kimya İmalat Kaplama Birimimiz Mekanik İmalat Birimi; CNC Torna ve CNC Freze tezgâhları başta olmak üzere talaşlı imalat, eklemeli imalat, kaplama, tesviye ve otomasyon süreçleri ile havacılık ve savunma sanayii için kritik mekanik parçaların üretimini gerçekleştirmektedir. Birim bünyesinde; hammadde girişinden nihai ürün sevkiyatına kadar tüm imalat adımları kontrollü şekilde yürütülmekte, üretim süreçleri kalite ve izlenebilirlik esasları doğrultusunda sürekli olarak geliştirilmektedir. Yüksek hassasiyet gerektiren parçalar için ölçüm, doğrulama ve proses kontrol faaliyetleri entegre bir yaklaşımla uygulanmaktadır. Pozisyonun Amacı Yüzey işlem ve kaplama süreçlerinin teknik standartlara ve kalite gerekliliklerine uygun şekilde yürütülmesini sağlamak, üretim hatlarının verimli ve sürdürülebilir şekilde çalışmasını temin etmek, ileri teknoloji kaplama sistemlerinin (PVD, CVD, ALD, HVOF, LPCVD vb.) üretim süreçlerine entegrasyonunu gerçekleştirerek ürün kalitesini ve proses performansını artırmak. Seni Neler Bekliyor? Demir ve demir dışı alaşımlara yönelik yüzey işlemleri kapsamında; eloksal ve alodin kaplama başta olmak üzere, akımlı ve akımsız nikel, çinko-nikel, mangan fosfat, Nikasil, kadmiyum ve gümüş kaplama süreçleri ile paslanmaz çelik pasivasyonu ve titanyum anodizasyonu uygulamalarında görev almak, Yüzey işlem hatlarının kurulumu, bakımı ve verimlilik artırıcı faaliyetlerin yönetimini sağlamak, PVD, CVD, ALD, HVOF, LPCVD gibi ileri teknoloji kaplama sistemlerinin üretim süreçlerine entegrasyonunu gerçekleştirmek, Eloksal ve alodin kaplama sistemlerinin üretim hatlarına entegrasyonunu sağlamak ve uygulama süreçlerini yönetmek, Yüzey işlem süreçlerinde ortaya çıkan kaplama kusurlarını tespit etmek ve çözüm önerileri geliştirmek, Yüzey işlem hatlarının bakım süreçlerini yönetmek ve verimlilik artırıcı iyileştirme faaliyetlerini yürütmek. Genel Nitelikler Üniversitelerin Malzeme Mühendisliği, Kimya Mühendisliği veya ilgili mühendislik bölümlerinden mezun, Benzer pozisyonlarda en az 5 yıl deneyim sahibi, İleri teknoloji kaplama sistemleri (PVD, CVD, ALD, HVOF, LPCVD vb.) üretim süreçlerine entegrasyon konusunda bilgi ve deneyim sahibi, Yüzey işlem hatlarının kurulumu, yönetimi ve bakımı konularında deneyimli, Kaplama sürecinde oluşan kusurları (çatlama, pürüzlülük vb.) tespit edip etkili çözümler üretebilen, Teknik problemlere analitik yaklaşımla çözüm geliştirebilmek, üretim süreçlerinde verimlilik artırıcı uygulamalar yapabilen, Takım çalışmasına yatkın, etkili iletişim ve proje yönetimi becerilerine sahip olan, Yeniliklere açık, öğrenmeye ve kendini geliştirmeye istekli, Erkek adaylar için tercihen askerlik mükellefiyeti olmayan, Vardiyalı çalışmaya ve yoğun iş temposuna uyum sağlayabilecek çalışma arkadaşları aranmaktadır. Tercih Nedeni Olabilecek Ek Nitelikler • Yüzey işlem ve kaplama teknolojileri alanında akademik çalışmalar (yüksek lisans, doktora, tez, yayın vb.) yapmış, • Farklı yüzey işlem hatları ve kaplama sistemleri (eloksal, alodin, nikel kaplama vb.) üzerinde deneyim sahibi, • Sürekli iyileştirme ve verimlilik artırma projelerinde aktif rol almış, • Yüzey işlem süreçlerine ilişkin proses takip ve analiz araçlarını etkin şekilde kullanabilen, • Üretim hatlarında kullanılan ekipman ve yardımcı sistemler (tanklar, güç kaynakları, ölçüm cihazları vb.) konusunda bilgi ve deneyim sahibi.

title: Ürün Yaşam Döngüsü Mühendisi (PLM)
description: ERP PDM PLM E-BOM/M-BOM Birimimiz Milli Teknoloji Hamlesi’nin öncü gücü Baykar’da; yerli ve milli yüksek teknoloji İnsansız Hava Aracı sistemleri geliştiriyor, kendini kanıtlamış platformlarla küresel ölçekte etki üretiyoruz. Ar-Ge’den üretime uçtan uca mühendislik yaklaşımımızla, sınırları zorlayan projelere imza atmaya devam ediyoruz. Birimimiz: PLM Birimi; ürün geliştirme yaşam döngüsü boyunca ortaya çıkan tüm teknik verinin tekil, izlenebilir ve sürdürülebilir şekilde yönetilmesini sağlar. Mühendislik, Ar-Ge, üretim, kalite ve tedarik gibi paydaşlarla birlikte çalışarak; ürün ağacı (BOM), konfigürasyon/revizyon yönetimi, değişiklik yönetimi ve yayımlama (release) süreçlerini standartlaştırır. PLM platformu üzerinde süreç kurgusu, veri yönetimi, kullanıcı yetkilendirme, raporlama ve sistem entegrasyonlarıyla kurumsal verimliliği artırır. Pozisyonun Amacı Bu pozisyonun amacı; PLM süreçlerinin uçtan uca işletilmesi, iyileştirilmesi ve PLM platformuna doğru şekilde uyarlanmasıdır. Rol; kullanıcı ihtiyaçlarını analiz ederek süreç/uygulama tasarımı yapmak, veri kalitesini ve izlenebilirliği güvence altına almak, değişiklik ve yayımlama akışlarının doğru çalışmasını sağlamak ve ilgili tüm paydaşlarla koordinasyon içinde PLM ekosisteminin sürekliliğini yönetmekten sorumludur. Seni Neler Bekliyor? PLM iş süreçlerinin (değişiklik yönetimi, revizyon/konfigürasyon yönetimi, yayımlama/release vb.) kurgulanması, uygulanması ve sürekli iyileştirilmesi, Ürün ağacı (BOM) yapılarının oluşturulması, ürün yapılandırma mantığının desteklenmesi ve veri doğruluğunun sağlanması, Yaşam döngüsü (Lifecycle/State) akışlarının ve iş kurallarının yönetilmesi; süreç performansının izlenmesi, Kullanıcı yetkilendirme yaklaşımının (rol ve erişim yönetimi) süreç ihtiyaçlarıyla uyumlu şekilde yürütülmesi, Kullanıcılardan gelen taleplerin analiz edilmesi; hata ve sorun durumlarında kök neden analizi yapılarak kalıcı çözümler geliştirilmesi, PLM sistemine yönelik teknik dokümantasyonun (kılavuzlar, prosedürler, iş talimatları vb.) hazırlanması ve bilginin standardize edilmesi, Yeni kullanıcıların sisteme adaptasyon sürecinin yönetilmesi; eğitim planlarının oluşturulması ve uygulamalı eğitimlerin gerçekleştirilmesi, PLM ile entegre çalışan sistemlerle (ERP, MES, raporlama sistemleri vb.) süreçlerin uyumlu şekilde yürütülmesi ve entegrasyon ihtiyaçlarının koordinasyonu, Raporlama/dashboard ihtiyaçlarının belirlenmesi; yönetim ve ekiplerin karar mekanizmalarını destekleyecek çıktılar oluşturulması, Süreç sahipleri ve BT ile koordineli çalışarak altyapı, erişim, yetki ve sürdürülebilirlik gereksinimlerinin takibini sağlamak. Genel Nitelikler Üniversitelerin ilgili mühendislik bölümlerinden mezun (Otomotiv, Makine, Bilgisayar, Yazılım, Endüstri, Elektrik-Elektronik, Uçak-Uzay vb.), PLM/PDM kavramlarına hakim (BOM, revizyon-konfigürasyon, change/release, workflow, doküman yönetimi), Güçlü dokümantasyon disiplinine sahip; süreçleri yazılı hale getirerek standardizasyon sağlayabilen, CAD ekosistemine aşinalığı olan (tercihen CATIA); mühendislik verisinin doğasını anlayabilme becerilerine sahip, Analitik düşünme, problem çözme ve kök neden analizi becerileri güçlü, Paydaş yönetimi gelişmiş; ekipler arası koordinasyon ve iletişim becerileri yüksek, İyi seviyede İngilizce bilgisine sahip (teknik doküman okuma, yazma ve iletişim), Yoğun iş temposuna uyum sağlayabilecek, öğrenmeye açık ve sorumluluk sahibi, Tercihen SQL bilgisi ve veriyle çalışma/raporlama farkındalığına sahip, Tercihen 3DEXPERIENCE/ENOVIA veya benzeri PLM platformlarında süreç işletimi ve kullanıcı destek deneyimi bulunan takım arkadaşları arıyoruz. Tercih Nedeni Olabilecek Ek Nitelikler PLM tarafında gelişmiş yönetim bileşenleriyle çalışma (Lifecycle/Policy, Access Matrix, Relationship/Attribute yönetimi vb.) konusunda deneyim, MQL/trigger mantığı, otomasyon veya sistem davranışlarını kurgulama konusunda tecrübe, REST API ile entegrasyon veya PLM dışa açılım projelerinde deneyim, Veri migrasyonu, veri kalite kuralları ve master data yönetişimi konularına bilgi sahibi, Havacılık/savunma veya yüksek regülasyonlu sektörlerde süreç ve izlenebilirlik deneyimi, Süreç iyileştirme metodolojileri (Lean/Kaizen), gereksinim analizi ve iş analistliği yaklaşımı konusunda bilgi olunması tercih nedeni olabilecek ek niteliklerdir.
