title: Fabrications - Mechanical Engineering
description: Job Description Summary The Mechanical Engineering role is part of the Fabrications team within the Wind Machine Head Engineering Subsection. This position involves ownership of mechanical components with significant human interaction, such as working surfaces, railings, ladders, trays, machinery protections, and brackets. Responsibilities include New Product/Technology Introduction, Validation & Testing, Field Support, and Root Cause Analysis. The role requires design and development of mechanical components under the technical guidance and mentorship of senior engineers. Job Description Key Responsibilities Technical Contribution: Support the design of fabricated wind turbine components and help resolve mechanical engineering challenges under the guidance of senior engineers. Project Execution: Support New Product Introduction (NPI) programs, technology integration, and field issue resolution by completing assigned engineering tasks, with a primary focus on safety, quality, and reliability. Product Safety and EHS: Support the identification and mitigation of risks for safety-critical components, helping ensure designs meet tolerable risk levels. Assist in the resolution of SAFER cases by completing assigned action items in collaboration with cross-functional teams. Systems Thinking & Integration: Develop a "Systems Thinking" mindset to understand how components integrate into the overall turbine design. With support from senior engineers, learn to assess tradeoffs and communicate the implications of component changes on the wider machine. Compliance & Standards: Apply relevant design practices, industry regulations, and standards to the design of mechanical components. Build and maintain knowledge of the engineering requirements affecting wind turbine systems. Tools & Process: Apply standardized engineering tools, analysis, and calculation methodologies to ensure a rigorous engineering approach. Share observations and lessons learned to support continuous improvement of our designs. Risk Management: Participate in risk identification and mitigation activities, including DFMEA sessions, helping to ensure that potential failure modes are identified, addressed, and validated against quality and reliability standards. Prototyping & Validation: Assist in the prototyping and physical testing of mechanical systems. Help investigate and resolve technical issues or defects identified during the validation and testing phases. Critical Soft Skills Accountability: Takes ownership of the quality and integrity of assigned design tasks, working to meet Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC) expectations and seeking guidance when needed. Innovation: Shows curiosity and proposes practical improvements to existing designs or processes within a fast-paced engineering environment. Learns to balance creative thinking with engineering rigor. Proactiveness & Energy: Demonstrate a positive, collaborative energy and a strong willingness to learn across the organization, contributing to an environment focused on continuous learning and technical excellence. Effective Communication: Ability to communicate technical problems, progress, and open questions in clear, factual, and simple terms to team members and stakeholders. Required Qualifications Education: Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field. Experience: Relevant product design and development experience, ideally in the wind industry. Technical Proficiency: Working knowledge of mechanical design (static, fatigue), FEM (Finite Element Method), and manufacturing processes (Sheet metal, machining, welding). Software Tools: Knowledge of CAD (Unigraphics NX 3D-CAD preferred), CAE tools (Ansys, Hypermesh), and PLM tools. Travel: Ability and willingness to travel up to 10% of the time Desired Characteristics Knowledge of structured problem-solving (RCA) and Lean design principles Good interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively in international, multi-disciplinary project teams (Electrical, Structural, and Systems). Familiarity with wind turbine structural components and internal mechanical systems, or with similar mechanical products in other industries. title: Ingeniero/a de Cálculo de Estructuras - Plantas Industriales
description: En Sener Energía deseamos incorporar en nuestro equipo a un/a Ingeniero/a de cálculo de estructuras en nuestro centro de trabajo de Bilbao o Madrid. Orientamos la ingeniería hacia la sostenibilidad de la industria y, de la sociedad. Por eso, desarrollamos proyectos orientados a lograr la máxima eficiencia en la transición hacia un modelo energético sostenible, mediante la innovación y la tecnología. Nos encargamos de la concepción, desarrollo y construcción de plantas energéticas y componentes de las mismas, abarcando desde las tecnologías más convencionales como ciclos combinados, biomasas, etc. hasta las nuevas tecnologías renovables y de futuro como offshore wind, hidrogeno verde, gestionabilidad, economía circular y sostenibilidad. Qué harás: Desarrollar actividades de diseño mecánico y análisis estructural aplicando herramientas FEM para proyectos de energía. Analizar y comprobar el comportamiento global de estructura y de detalle para analizar componentes particulares o no lineales con contactos, fatiga, etc. Definición de planos de fabricación. Desarrollar herramientas (scripts) para automatizar modelización. Realizar informes estructurales. Qué esperamos de ti: Deseable Master en Ingeniería de Caminos, Canales y Puertos. Grado o Ingeniería mecánica. Experiencia en cálculo de estructuras, se valorarán las habilidades de programación, principalmente de Phyton y/o Grasshopper. Conocimientos en software de cálculo por elementos finitos de estructuras y elementos mecánicos (Abaqus, Ansys). Inglés B2 - nivel alto escrito y hablado. Buena capacidad de organización personal del trabajo y de la gestión de tareas. Qué te ofrecemos: Estos son algunos de los beneficios de los que disfrutarás en Sener: Tendrás la oportunidad de participar en proyectos innovadores y de alto nivel tecnológico a nivel internacional, colaborando con un equipo multidisciplinar y altamente cualificado. Disfrutaras de una mejor gestión de tu tiempo a través de nuestras políticas de flexibilidad horaria y trabajo en remoto. Podrás optimizar tu salario con nuestro plan retributivo flexible (tarjeta de comida, seguro médico privado, tickets guardería...) y dispondrás de un seguro de vida y accidentes. Te cuidaremos con nuestro programa de bienestar físico y emocional, que incluye deportes, talleres, etc. Impulsaremos tu desarrollo profesional, con formación técnica, en habilidades, idiomas, etc. para que continúes creciendo y alcanzando tus metas. Promovemos la igualdad de oportunidades, diversidad e inclusión de todas las personas y estamos certificados como Entidad Familiarmente Responsable (efr). Si te sientes identificado/a con nuestros valores y quieres formar parte de una ingeniería familiar internacional puntera, ¡te esperamos! Queremos llegar tan lejos como quieras llegar tú.

title: Senior Security Engineer
description: Listed on CyberJobs.cc, a job board for cybersecurity jobs from the team behind AITraining.jobs. Senior Security Engineer LiteLLM is the world’s most popular AI Gateway, trusted by companies like Adobe, Netflix, and NASA. Our platform gives developers secure, reliable access to LLMs and adjacent services. We’re looking for our first Security Engineer to help secure LiteLLM’s application, infrastructure, and software-delivery pipeline. About The Role This is a hands-on security generalist role with a strong emphasis on application security. You’ll spend most of your time reviewing and hardening LiteLLM’s Python codebase, identifying new attack surfaces, working directly with engineers to fix vulnerabilities, and making secure development practices part of how we build. You’ll also own security work across IT, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, and the software supply chain. The ideal candidate has built application/product/infrastructure security programs from scratch and genuinely enjoys security outside of work - through CTFs, vulnerability research, open-source projects, or independent experimentation. Application security Conduct deep security reviews of LiteLLM’s Python proxy, APIs, authentication systems, and enterprise features. Identify and remediate vulnerabilities involving authentication, authorization, secrets, tenant isolation, injection, and data exposure. Partner directly with engineers throughout design, implementation, code review, and release - not only after code is shipped. Build application-security tooling into the development lifecycle, including SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, and secrets detection. Perform internal red teaming and adversarial testing against LiteLLM’s APIs, proxy, and LLM-specific attack surfaces. Threat-model new products and architecture changes before they reach production. Create secure coding guidelines and train engineers on common vulnerabilities and defensive practices. Infrastructure, CI/CD, and supply-chain security Harden LiteLLM’s Docker images, PyPI packages, GitHub Actions workflows, and release infrastructure. Detect dependency confusion, poisoned packages, compromised dependencies, exposed secrets, and unsafe build practices. Implement SBOMs, signed builds, provenance checks, and reproducible-build practices. Design secure-by-default configurations for cloud and self-hosted deployments, including authentication, IAM, secrets management, and key rotation. Review cloud infrastructure, network boundaries, access controls, and production deployment patterns. IT security and incident response Strengthen employee identity, device, SaaS, and internal access controls. Build monitoring and anomaly detection for suspicious API, model, authentication, and routing activity. Lead security incident response, vulnerability assessment, remediation, post-mortems, and stakeholder communication. Establish formal vulnerability intake, CVE triage, disclosure, and remediation processes. Maintain threat models as LiteLLM’s product and architecture evolve. What we’re looking for A strong security generalist who can work across application security, IT, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, and the software supply chain. Deep application-security expertise, including manually auditing production Python code and working with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities. Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, SSRF, injection, deserialization, secrets management, and common web and API vulnerabilities. Experience using and configuring tools such as Semgrep, Bandit, CodeQL, Burp Suite, and other SAST or DAST tooling. Previous experience at an early-stage security startup during its 0→1 journey. Experience securing containers, GitHub Actions, build pipelines, packages, and software dependencies. Familiarity with SBOMs, Sigstore, Cosign, Snyk, Grype, Trivy, or equivalent tooling. Strong knowledge of OAuth2, JWT, mTLS, IAM, and high-throughput API authentication. Familiarity with prompt injection, LLM data exfiltration, tool abuse, and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications. Experience with incident response, CVSS scoring, vulnerability management, CVE triage, and coordinated disclosure. Experience competing in CTFs during college or independently pursuing vulnerability research, reverse engineering, bug bounties, or security projects. A genuine interest in security outside your day job - you regularly explore new attack techniques, build security projects, or contribute to the security community. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Why join LiteLLM? Work on application-security problems at the intersection of AI, APIs, and developer infrastructure. Secure an open-source product used by enterprises around the world. Work directly with engineers and influence how security is incorporated into product development. Take broad technical ownership in a fast-moving environment. Competitive salary and health, dental, and vision benefits. About LiteLLM LiteLLM is a Python SDK and Proxy Server that enables seamless access to more than 100 LLM APIs through the OpenAI format. Ready to secure the infrastructure powering enterprise AI? Apply now.

title: Lead Engineer, Chip on Carrier Design and Assembly Processes
description: Job Description Location: Järfälla, Sweden At Coherent, we are enabling the future of photonics and optoelectronics through innovation, advanced engineering, and world-class manufacturing. We are now looking for a Lead Engineer, Chip-on-Carrier Design & Assembly Processes to join our R&D team and play a key role in developing next-generation optoelectronic devices. This is a hands-on engineering position for someone who enjoys working close to the technology, equipment, and manufacturing processes. You will be responsible for developing and optimizing chip-on-carrier assembly solutions and supporting the transition of new technologies from R&D into pilot and early-stage production. About The Role As Lead Engineer, you will drive process development activities related to semiconductor and optoelectronic assembly technologies. You will work closely with development engineers, technicians, equipment suppliers, and manufacturing teams to ensure robust, scalable, and reliable assembly processes. Key Focus Areas Include Wire bonding (gold wedge and ball bonding) Die bonding and die attach processes (including eutectic AuSn, SAC, and flip-chip technologies) Vacuum reflow soldering Chip-on-carrier design and assembly optimization Process transfer from R&D to pilot manufacturing This role combines technical leadership with hands-on laboratory and cleanroom work. Key Responsibilities Lead hands-on development and optimization of wire bonding processes (wedge and ball bonding). Develop and optimize chip-on-carrier designs and assembly processes, including die attach technologies such as eutectic AuSn, SAC, flip-chip, and wire bonding. Drive process improvements to enhance performance, quality, yield, and reliability. Support the transition of technologies and processes from R&D to pilot and early-stage manufacturing. Collaborate with equipment suppliers regarding tooling, fixturing, and process optimization. Analyze process data, measurements, and test results to identify improvements and troubleshoot issues. Create and maintain technical documentation, work instructions, and process specifications. Provide technical expertise and support to development projects and cross-functional teams. Participate in laboratory and cleanroom activities related to device assembly and characterization. What You Bring We are looking for a technically strong and practical engineer who enjoys solving complex manufacturing and assembly challenges. Required Qualifications Master's degree in Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, Electronics, or a related technical discipline. 5–10 years of experience in photonics, optoelectronics, semiconductor packaging, or related process development. Experience working with semiconductor assembly processes. Strong hands-on experience in laboratory and/or cleanroom environments. Professional proficiency in English. Preferred Qualifications Experience with wire bonding (wedge and/or ball bonding). Experience with die bonding technologies, including eutectic AuSn, SAC, and flip-chip processes. Experience with vacuum reflow soldering using materials such as AuSn, SAC, or indium. Knowledge of semiconductor back-end processes and micro-assembly techniques. Experience working with assembly tools, equipment, fixtures, and process optimization. Swedish language skills are considered an advantage but are not required. Who You Are You are a curious and solution-oriented engineer who enjoys being close to the technology. You are comfortable balancing development work with practical execution and thrive in a collaborative environment where innovation and continuous improvement are valued. You take ownership of your work, communicate effectively with stakeholders, and are motivated by seeing your ideas transition into real products and manufacturing solutions. Why Join Coherent? At Coherent, you will work with cutting-edge photonics technologies alongside highly skilled colleagues in an international environment. You will have the opportunity to influence future products, develop advanced manufacturing processes, and contribute directly to innovations that make a difference across a wide range of industries. We look forward to hearing from you! About Us Coherent is a global leader in lasers, engineered materials and networking components. We are a vertically integrated manufacturing company that develops innovative products for diversified applications in the industrial, optical communications, military, life sciences, semiconductor equipment, and consumer markets. Coherent provides a comprehensive career development platform within an environment that challenges employees to perform at their best, while rewarding excellence and hard-work through a competitive compensation program. It's an exciting opportunity to work for a company that offers stability, longevity and growth. Come Join Us! Note to recruiters and employment agencies: We will not pay for unsolicited resumes from recruiters and employment agencies unless we have a signed agreement and have required assistance, in writing, for a specific opening.

title: Senior Scientist Ammonia in Maritime Applications
description: About This Position At Naval and Offshore Structures, we contribute to a safe, sustainable, and resilient future. Our team designs, analyses, and tests a wide range of mechanical structures for the maritime, offshore, and defence sectors. Ensuring the safety, reliability, and long-term performance of these structures, even under the most demanding conditions and throughout their entire service life, is at the core of our work. We support the Dutch and European maritime industries in their transition towards sustainable shipping through the safe adoption of alternative energy carriers and propulsion technologies, including methanol, ammonia, and nuclear energy. This requires a holistic approach that balances safety, sustainability, and economic viability. Drawing on our expertise in naval architecture, structural engineering, and materials science, we contribute to TNO-wide initiatives aimed at accelerating this transition, including the development of in-depth knowledge on emerging degradation and damage mechanisms associated with new energy systems. To strengthen our team in this field, we are significantly expanding our activities related to ammonia as a hydrogen carrier. We are looking for an experienced professional who can help shape and lead this growth together with the team. If you are passionate about advancing the future of sustainable maritime energy systems, this could be the opportunity for you. What will be your role? As a Senior Scientist Ammonia in Maritime Applications, you will translate your vision on the adoption of alternative fuels into innovative maritime systems and vessel designs. You understand the challenges faced by the maritime industry as it transitions towards new energy carriers and can connect these challenges with TNO's research capabilities and technological solutions. Working alongside a multidisciplinary team, you will analyse, model, and experimentally investigate maritime structures and systems that enable the safe and cost-effective implementation of next-generation fuel technologies. Your expertise in structural and material behaviour will be instrumental in developing solutions that improve safety, extend service life, and enhance economic feasibility. Your work will focus on hydrogen carrier technologies, with a particular emphasis on expanding TNO's expertise in ammonia-based energy systems. The knowledge generated through your research will contribute directly to the development of future regulations, standards, and guidelines, while supporting industry partners in the safe and efficient introduction of ammonia and related technologies within the maritime sector. You will be part of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary team of specialists from diverse engineering backgrounds and will work closely with clients, industrial partners, and colleagues across TNO. As a Senior Scientist, you will provide technical leadership within research projects, initiate and develop new research opportunities, and play an active role in shaping our long-term research strategy. In addition, you will represent TNO in national and international scientific and industrial forums, establish collaborations with industry and academia, and contribute to TNO's visibility through scientific publications, conference presentations, and industry engagement. You will join the Naval and Offshore Structures department, a team of approximately 60 highly motivated experts with backgrounds in naval architecture, civil engineering, aerospace engineering, applied physics, and mechanical engineering. Our primary application domains are defence and maritime & offshore technology. With access to advanced mechanical testing facilities, we combine experimental and computational expertise to address complex engineering challenges and validate innovative structural solutions. Our research spans topics such as the safe implementation of alternative fuels on board ships, the structural integrity of offshore wind turbines, and blast- and shock-resistant naval structures. Together, we tackle some of today's most pressing challenges accelerating the energy transition while ensuring safety, resilience, and security at sea. What we expect from you You hold a Master's degree or PhD in a relevant engineering discipline, such as Naval Architecture, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Civil Engineering, with a specialization in the design and development of engineering systems and structures. You bring more than ten years of experience within the maritime sector, with demonstrated expertise in alternative fuels and sustainable propulsion technologies. You have a strong theoretical foundation combined with practical insight into the behaviour of maritime systems and the implications of engineering design choices. You are experienced in the application of numerical modelling and simulation techniques and have a solid understanding of the underlying physical phenomena relevant to maritime structures and energy systems. Beyond your technical expertise, you are excited by the opportunity to help build and grow a new research team. You can combine your industry network, strategic vision, and scientific leadership with the expertise available within the department to develop a strong and impactful research portfolio. Strong communication skills, customer focus, and a results-oriented mindset are essential. You have a proven track record of providing technical leadership to multidisciplinary teams and delivering complex projects successfully. Finally, you are fluent in both Dutch and English, written and spoken. What you'll get in return Challenging and varied work with a real impact. And plenty of opportunities as, at TNO, you are in charge of shaping your career. We offer a gross monthly salary between € 5.650,- and € 8.072,- (based on your knowledge and experience), 8% holiday pay, a 13th month bonus of 8.33% and a flex budget (5.58% + € 180). title: Graduate Field Service Engineer

description: Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential. Start your engineering career at the heart of cutting-edge technology What if your first engineering role could take you from Ireland to some of the world’s most advanced semiconductor manufacturing facilities? At ASM , we develop the technologies used to manufacture the computer chips powering modern life, from AI and smartphones to 5G, autonomous vehicles and medical technology . For more than 50 years, innovation has been at the heart of what we do. Today, our engineers work at the forefront of semiconductor technologies including Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD), epitaxy, PEALD, PECVD, vertical furnaces and silicon carbide epitaxy . We are now looking for a Graduate Field Service Engineer to join our team in Ireland. If you are an engineering graduate who enjoys hands-on problem solving, working with complex technology, travelling internationally and learning by doing , this could be the start of an exciting career with ASM. What will you do? As a Graduate Field Service Engineer, you will receive training and support to build your expertise on some of the most advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment in the world. You Will Install and commission advanced semiconductor equipment at customer sites. Support the qualification, preventative maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of ASM systems. Work hands-on with complex electrical, mechanical and electro-mechanical systems. Help install ASM's latest-generation equipment and new technologies at customer sites. Troubleshoot technical challenges, identify root causes and help develop long-term solutions. Work alongside experienced engineers and collaborate with international and cross-functional teams. Build strong relationships with customers and provide high-quality technical support. Develop your skills in technical reporting, project management, problem solving and customer communication. Work in highly advanced cleanroom environments where semiconductor devices are manufactured. You'll be doing real engineering from the start, with the opportunity to see the impact of your work firsthand. Where could this role take you? This isn't a typical desk-based graduate role. You'll be based in Ireland and spend significant time working directly at customer sites. As part of ASM's international Field Service organization, you will also have opportunities to travel to customer and ASM locations across Europe , North America, Asia or the Middle East . Travel can represent up to 75% of the role , combining work at local customer sites with assignments at other locations. title: Senior Loads Engineer (m/f/x)
description: We are building a new generation of AI-controlled unmanned jets designed to strengthen the defence of European democracies. The airframe makes extensive use of Carbon Fiber Reinforced Polymer (CFRP), which allows for a very light and highly flexible structure, and this puts the loads discipline right at the centre of the design. As Senior Loads Engineer you own the external loads that size the aircraft. You will define, calculate and release the flight, ground and system loads used by structures, landing gear, systems and flight controls, from the first sizing loops through to flight test correlation and airworthiness approval. Because the airframe is unmanned, highly agile and flexible, classic loads assumptions do not simply carry over. You will be expected to modify them and to build the process that fits better to the new airframe. Your Mission Loads Process Ownership: Set up and maintain the loads process and the loads model chain, from mass and inertia data, aerodynamic databases and structural dynamic models through to load case generation, sorting and delivery of interface loads and internal load distributions. Manoeuvre Loads: Calculate symmetric and asymmetric manoeuvre loads across the full flight envelope, including high angle of attack and high rate manoeuvres typical for an unmanned, agile platform without physiological limits on the pilot side. Gust and Turbulence Loads: Perform discrete gust and continuous turbulence analyses on a flexible aircraft model, including the effect of the flight control system in the loop. Ground Loads: Cover landing, taxi, braking, turning, towing and arrested or short field operations, in close cooperation with the landing gear and systems teams. Dynamic and Special Loads: Address dynamic landing, buffet, hammershock, bird strike, store carriage and release, failure cases and system malfunctions, including flight control system failures and their load consequences. Loads and Flexibility: Work with the aeroelasticity team on flexible loads corrections, static aeroelastic effects, control surface effectiveness and hinge moments, and with flight controls on load alleviation functions and manoeuvre limiting. Interface to Stress and Design: Deliver traceable, well documented load sets to the structures and stress teams, support sizing loops, and drive the loads iterations that keep the design converging instead of oscillating. Validation: Support ground and flight test campaigns, define loads instrumentation and calibration requirements, evaluate strain gauge and flight test data, and correlate measured loads with the models. Method and Tool Development: Automate and improve the loads chain so that a full loads loop can run in days rather than months, and adapt methods where standard practice does not fit an unmanned CFRP airframe. Certification Support: Prepare loads evidence and reports for military airworthiness authorities and defend the results in internal and external reviews. Your Profile Qualification: University degree (Master or PhD) in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or comparable, with a focus on structural mechanics, flight mechanics, aeroelasticity or lightweight design. Professional Expertise: Several years of hands-on experience in aircraft loads, ideally on fast jets or other high performance platforms. Experience in a military aviation context and with composite airframes is a strong plus. You understand how loads, structural dynamics, aerodynamics and control laws interact, not just your own corner of it. Regulations: Familiarity with the relevant loads requirements, for example CS-23 where applicable and STANAGs, and the ability to argue a sensible interpretation where no rule fits an unmanned aircraft. Simulation Know-how: Loads Assumptions: Solid experience in CS-23 Subpart C, programming analytical tools in Mathcad or comparable tools. Aerodynamic Data: Experience with CFD based aero databases (DLR-TAU, ANSYS Fluent, STAR-CCM+) and with panel methods, including how to build and correct an aero database that is fit for loads. Programming: Strong Python, for building automated loads workflows, coupling solvers and processing large result sets. Version control and clean code habits expected. Aeroelastics (otional): experience with MSC Nastran (SOL 144/145/146), ZAERO or comparable tools is a plus. Mass Properties: Understanding of mass and inertia data management, fuel and store configurations and how mass uncertainty propagates into loads. Analytical Skills: You can break down a complex problem, find the driving mechanism and produce an answer that survives review. You know when a quick engineering estimate is enough and when it is not. Team Player and Communicator: You work closely with aerodynamics, structures, stress, flight controls, landing gear and flight test, and you communicate results clearly to people who are not loads specialists. Languages: Fluent English, written and spoken. German is welcome but not required. What We Offer We are a dynamic, family-owned company with short decision-making processes and an open-door culture. title: Mechanical Engineer Hightech Machinebouw
description: Werk jij graag aan innovatieve, hightech oplossingen in de machinebouw? Als Mechanical Engineer Hightech Machinebouw in Eindhoven ontwikkel je producten die grenzen verleggen binnen de technologie. Ga de uitdaging aan en bouw mee aan de toekomst van de hightech industrie! Wat ga je doen? Voor onze opdrachtgever in de hightech machinebouw ontwikkel je hoogwaardige technische producten die bijdragen aan innovatieve oplossingen. Je werkt aan het ontwerpen, testen en verbeteren van mechanische systemen voor complexe machines. Hierbij gebruik je CAD-software zoals SolidWorks of Creo om nauwkeurige modellen en tekeningen te maken. Ook voer je berekeningen uit voor sterkte, duurzaamheid en kostenefficiëntie van materialen en onderdelen. Je werkt volgens technische specificaties en kwaliteitsnormen, waarbij je voortdurend zoekt naar verbeteringen en optimalisaties. Daarnaast ben je als Mechanical Engineer Hightech Machinebouw betrokken bij het project vanaf conceptontwikkeling tot aan de realisatie van het prototype. Je begeleidt en ondersteund mee binnen het team, je ondersteunt de werkplaats tijdens assemblage, testen en inbedrijfstellen zodanig dat er een werkend systeem aan de klant wordt geleverd. Jouw werkzaamheden Ontwikkelen en ontwerpen van mechanische onderdelen en systemen voor hightech machines; Maken van nauwkeurige 3D-modellen en technische tekeningen met CAD-software zoals SolidWorks of Creo; Uitvoeren van sterkteberekeningen en materiaalonderzoek om de duurzaamheid van ontwerpen te waarborgen; Begeleiden van prototyping en testfases om ontwerpfunctionaliteit te valideren; Ondersteunen van de productie door technische specificaties en instructies op te stellen; Meehelpen bij de uitvoering van haalbaarheidsstudies, design en proces FMEA’s. Wat heb jij in huis? Een hbo-opleiding in werktuigbouwkunde of een vergelijkbare technische richting; Ervaring met CAD-software, zoals SolidWorks, Creo of Siemens NX; Minimaal twee jaar ervaring in de machinebouw of hightech sector; Oog voor detail en het vermogen om nauwkeurig te werken binnen technische specificaties; Probleemoplossend vermogen en de vaardigheid om verbeteringen in ontwerpen aan te brengen; Goede communicatievaardigheden om technische informatie duidelijk over te brengen aan verschillende betrokkenen. Wat bieden we jou Een salaris van €3.489 - €4.527 p.m.; 25 vakantiedagen per jaar; Uitgebreide groene pensioenregeling; Volg kosteloos sessies via het welzijnsplatform empowr; Opleidingsbudget van €2.000; Een persoonlijke Career Coach; Gratis deelname aan bijvoorbeeld de Marathon van Eindhoven of de Strong Viking Run; Werken bij het groenste detacheringsbureau van Nederland; Mogelijkheid tot overname door opdrachtgever. Werken bij Evoke Je gaat via Evoke aan de slag in deze functie. Na een tijdje kun je in dienst bij onze partner, als je wil. Of je begint aan een nieuw uitdagend project via ons netwerk. Wij doen er alles aan om onze mensen op dé werkplek te krijgen. Jouw persoonlijke Career Coach is specialist binnen de sector en samen brengen jullie jouw wensen in kaart. Door écht te luisteren, maken zij steeds de juiste connectie voor jou. Ondertussen bieden wij je alle voordelen als jouw werkgever en Carrière Coach. Zoals een goed salaris, jaarlijks studiebudget en groen pensioen. Samen zetten we zo altijd de beste stappen voorwaarts in jouw loopbaan. Want: Evoke Centers You.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description: Functieomschrijving Wil jij machines ontwerpen die wereldwijd het sorteerproces in de agrarische en voedingsmiddelenindustrie verbeteren? Als Senior Mechanical Engineer werk je van concept tot commissioning aan slimme, tastbare oplossingen en geef je richting aan de verdere professionalisering van engineering. Je vertaalt functionele eisen naar maakbare, onderhoudbare en schaalbare ontwerpen. Daarbij verbind je mechanica met Elektro, Software, PLC, Productie en Service, zodat ieder ontwerp in de praktijk werkt. Ontwikkelen en modelleren van machineconcepten in 3D met Inventor of SolidWorks; Bewaken van samenhang, maakbaarheid, assemblage, toleranties, kosten en standaardisatie; Opstellen van tekeningen, stuklijsten, toleranties en overdraagbare productiedocumentatie; Begeleiden van prototyping, testen, designvalidatie, realisatie, assemblage en commissioning; Technische keuzes onderbouwen, verbeteringen initiëren en minder ervaren engineers begeleiden. Functie-eisen Je bent een ervaren mechanical engineer die overzicht houdt zonder technische details uit het oog te verliezen. Je werkt zorgvuldig, onderzoekt oorzaken en vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar praktische oplossingen. Je zoekt actief afstemming, kunt keuzes helder onderbouwen en spreekt je uit wanneer kwaliteit, veiligheid of maakbaarheid daarom vraagt. Hbo- of wo-opleiding Werktuigbouwkunde; Een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal; Ervaring met Inventor en/of SolidWorks en met 3D-ontwerp en modelleren; Kennis van maakbaarheid, toleranties, materiaalkeuze, assemblage en serieproductie; Een nauwkeurige, integere en resultaatgerichte werkwijze met aandacht voor samenwerking en kennisdeling. Arbeidsvoorwaarden Je krijgt een senior positie waarin je ontwerpen daadwerkelijk worden gebouwd en wereldwijd worden toegepast. Je krijgt ruimte om technische standaarden te verbeteren, nieuwe concepten vorm te geven en invloed uit te oefenen op het complete ontwikkelproces. €4.600–€6.000 bruto per maand bij 38 uur, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring 25 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV-dagen bij een fulltime dienstverband €0,25 reiskostenvergoeding per kilometer Een goede pensioenregeling Veel verantwoordelijkheid, korte lijnen en directe invloed op machines en engineeringprocessen. Info over het bedrijf Onze opdrachtgever is een innovatief en snelgroeiend technologiebedrijf dat slimme machines ontwikkelt voor de agrarische en voedingsmiddelenindustrie. Met behulp van onder andere cameratechnologie, kunstmatige intelligentie en geavanceerde software worden machines ontwikkeld die het sorteerproces bij klanten verregaand automatiseren. Hiermee helpt de organisatie bedrijven om efficiënter, nauwkeuriger en duurzamer te werken. Wat de organisatie technisch interessant maakt, is dat vrijwel het gehele ontwikkelproces in eigen huis plaatsvindt. Zowel de mechanische engineering als de software en intelligente beeldherkenning worden intern ontwikkeld, gebouwd en getest. Hierdoor werken verschillende technische disciplines nauw met elkaar samen en zijn medewerkers direct betrokken bij het complete traject: van een eerste technisch idee en ontwerp tot een werkende machine bij de klant. De organisatie is ontstaan vanuit de praktijk en heeft zich in relatief korte tijd ontwikkeld tot een internationaal actieve speler. Inmiddels draaien honderden machines bij klanten verspreid over verschillende landen. Ondanks deze groei is het karakter van een ondernemend familiebedrijf behouden gebleven. De lijnen zijn kort, medewerkers krijgen veel verantwoordelijkheid en nieuwe ideeën kunnen snel worden omgezet in concrete verbeteringen. title: Graduate Engineer (Highways and Transportation)
description: About The Borough Joining us, you get to work for not just one high performing London Borough, but two. Kingston and Sutton councils have a number of shared services serving both authorities, with some teams and roles more focussed on one council than the other, but the majority are shared across both, meaning you get multiple opportunities to learn from a wider pool of activities and two different political bodies. We work flexibly in both Kingston and Sutton offices, and support working at home or flexible working patterns that enable you to tailor your working and personal life. We provide the equipment and tools to enable you to work flexibly, and in return ask you to use that flexibility to be creative and ambitious in the services we deliver. There are some really exciting things happening in both boroughs. In Sutton, we are developing the London Cancer Hub, a world leading cancer research and treatment hub that will bring together professionals from across different sectors to identify and test new treatments and therapies. Over in Kingston, we are undertaking the largest housing regeneration programme ever delivered in the borough, building new energy efficient housing that will transform some of our oldest Council owned housing. Both boroughs have publicly committed to doing what they can to tackle the climate emergency and are investing in new technologies and societal change that will help bring carbon emissions down and improve our climate impact. You should choose Kingston and Sutton if you are looking for an opportunity that will challenge you to deliver more, support you to achieve personal ambitions, and expect you to put borough residents at the heart of what you do. Kingston is a beautiful Royal borough with a historic setting on the banks of the Thames with excellent schools and a bustling retail centre, all surrounded by open green spaces such as Richmond Park and Bushy Park, former recreation grounds for Tudor Kings and Queens. The Council is controlled by a Liberal Democrat Administration and has a council plan “Greener, Fairer, Safer, Together”, that sets out a vision to be a vibrant, diverse and inclusive borough where residents are active, empowered, engaged and able to remain independent and resilient. The Council engages with residents through a number of forums and events through the year, and like Sutton plays a leading role in developing the South West Region of London. Sutton is a well connected attractive part of London that has a reputation for excellent schools, green and leafy open spaces, and a history that drives a thriving heritage and culture offer through our museums and libraries. The Council is controlled by a long established Liberal Democrat Administration and has high ambitions set out in its corporate plan “Ambitious for Sutton”, that will ensure Sutton remains a great place to live, work and raise a family. The Council plays a leading role in a number of local partnerships and places great emphasis on engaging effectively with its residents, listening to local voices and making their message heard across London Government. About The Role And Our Ideal Candidate The Design team includes a range of grades from Team Lead, Principal Engineer, Senior, Engineer, Graduate, Technician and Apprentices. The wider Design & Delivery team is approximately 30 staff and includes Street Lighting, TMOs, Planned Maintenance, Vehicle Crossovers and Surveys. About The Role To support the Senior Engineer to design and deliver a range of highway and transportation schemes. About You Enthusiastic to learn and develop technical skills in highways & transportation. Undertakes own self-learning and motivated to undertake a range of tasks. Keen to carry out site visits and liaise with various stakeholders. Attention to detail to produce quality drawings and apply relevant design standards and guidelines. Promote Health & Safety practices. IT proficient in software packages. Strong problem-solving skills, logical planned thought process. Understanding of a Local Authority is beneficial. Local knowledge of Kingston and Sutton highway network is beneficial. Good Data analytical skills. About Us Shape the future of our streets and communities. This is an exciting opportunity for a Graduate Engineer (Highway & Transportation) to take an instrumental role within a progressive local authority delivering meaningful, highway schemes from concept to completion. You’ll be at the heart of the full project lifecycle – from early scoping and optioneering through detailed design, procurement and hands-on construction site management – with real influence over outcomes on the ground. Working in a supportive environment, you’ll be part of a growing in-house design team and a wider, highly collaborative highways service that brings together client, commissioning, reactive, permitting and inspection teams. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community. If you’re motivated by variety, technical challenge and the chance to see your work directly improve places and people’s everyday journeys, this role offers both professional stretch and genuine impact. Our Offer To You As an organisation that values and nurtures talent, we’re committed to helping you fulfil your potential and will offer you a supportive, friendly and collaborative environment to grow and develop your career and skills. We’re constantly striving to improve our ways of working so putting your ideas across however big or small; will be fully encouraged and supported by your colleagues and our dynamic and experienced management team. Benefits Employees have access to a wide range of benefits to enable staff to achieve a work life balance, some of which include: A generous annual leave entitlement of 25-32 days, plus bank holidays (pro-rata if part-time working hours apply) depending on service and grade. title: TWD - Graduate Marine Engineer
description: Ready to turn your engineering knowledge into practical solutions for complex offshore challenges and see your work come to life? At TWD, you'll work on engineering solutions for major offshore wind and infrastructure projects around the world. From analysing vessel motions and offshore operations to designing practical installation methodologies, your work will have a direct impact on how projects are executed at sea. You will work alongside experienced engineers, contribute from day one and gradually take more responsibilities as you develop your skills. Foundations of Your Job As an Engineer in the Marine team you turn client requests into effective installation methods and conceptual designs for offshore projects. You leverage knowledge of marine dynamics and practical operations to develop solutions that are both innovative and workable at sea. You deliver high-quality engineering results that meet client specifications while respecting deadlines and budgets. A Glimpse Of Your Responsibilities Performing the technical set up and execution of detailed marine calculations and reports: Motion analyses Mooring studies Dynamic analyses Keeping overview between the link between marine calculations and the structural design Safeguarding the technical quality and timely delivery of project deliverables within budget Acting as the marine point of contact for clients, translating analyses into practical solutions What Makes You Great A bachelor’s or master’s degree preferably in Marine Engineering, mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering or Offshore engineering. Exposure to OrcaFlex and/or Python is a plus. A curious, quick-learning mindset. You like to collaborate, and you are a good communicator, which makes you excel as a team player. You are self-driven, responsible, and committed to get the job done. TWD – A Fun Challenge to Be Part Of At TWD, we love to create construction methods and design installation equipment. We achieve creative, simple, and efficient solutions through dedicated teamwork. Thanks to our core values – Fun, Development, and Happy Clients – we’ve grown rapidly across five locations: Rotterdam, London, Athens, Taipei, and Perth. Every day we contribute to the energy transition and key infrastructure projects worldwide, offering innovative design solutions to our clients, mainly in the offshore wind and heavy civils industry. Why You Will Love Working at TWD Working at TWD means working in an exciting, fast-paced industry and making a difference in shaping a more sustainable future. Collaborate with manufacturing, quality, and development teams to ensure seamless process integration and scalability. Research emerging technologies, materials, and industry trends to inform design decisions. Prepare engineering reports, technical documentation, and participate in cross-functional design reviews. Evaluate patents and competitor products to identify opportunities for innovation. title: Kalite Kontrol Teknisyeni - Mekanik
description: Milvus Robotics Hakkında Milvus Robotics olarak, sadece teknolojik trendleri takip etmekle kalmayıp aynı zamanda öncü olmayı hedefliyoruz. We offer: Market competitive salary bands Meaningful equity program Comprehensive health benefits for you and your family (99% coverage) Flexible time-off, holidays, and winter shutdown to rest & recharge Paid parental leave Remote-first, with quarterly team off-sites At Socket, we Pursue Excellence: We set ourselves apart by consistently delivering work of exceptional quality and distinction. Move with urgency and focus: We prioritize swift, decisive action. Think rigorously: We care about being right and it often takes reasoning from first principles to get there. We value alternative perspectives and have constructive discussions. Trust and amplify: We overtrust, always assume good intent, and give specific feedback to help each other improve. Feel a strong sense of ownership: We wear many hats and feel a strong sense of overall ownership of the company and we're non-territorial regarding our nominal domains. Are customer obsessed: We relentlessly prioritize the needs of our customers, striving to exceed their expectations and delight them at every interaction.

title: Senior Security Engineer (Remote)
description: Listed on CyberJobs.cc, a job board for cybersecurity jobs from the team behind AITraining.jobs. Lightning Labs is seeking to hire a Security Engineer for the ongoing scaling of our growing engineering organization. This is a hands-on role that consists of devising and implementing policies and procedures around best practices in systems security. The ideal candidate has experience in securing web, Bitcoin, and other public-facing network services, penetration testing, and both automated and manual source code security reviews. Due to the domain in which we work, experience with Bitcoin and the Lightning Network is extremely desirable as is knowledge of the cryptographic aspects involved in this area. As we are an international organization, experience and comfort working with highly distributed teams is a must. In addition, the ideal candidate should have a passion for our mission of bringing financial freedom to the world, as well as for Bitcoin as a whole. Although a part of the engineering organization, candidates in this position will work across functional team boundaries to ensure all aspects of the business are appropriately considered and covered by security best practices. Responsibilities may include but are not limited to Designing and deploying active fuzzing, black+white box testing and penetration testing infrastructure for open source and production systems Performing security audits and review of both internal production systems as well as open source software which interacts with Bitcoin+Lightning in a security critical manner Provide mentorship and guidance to level up your teammates Creating global security policy, standards, guidelines, and procedures to ensure ongoing maintenance of security Overseeing security aspects of software release processes and infrastructure Determining security team requirements for future growth Developing and ensuring responsiveness of security incident management processes Performing risk management assessments Preferred Experience At least 5 years prior experience in in systems security An ability to work with a high impact, fast-moving startup team Extensive knowledge of operating system and computer architecture internals Strong understanding of cryptography, protocol design and adversarial analysis Experience in reverse engineering and exploiting of cryptographic protocol (cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin) systems Extensive expertise with professional software development experience in Go, Rust, C/C++, and/or Java Experience in security incident response Experience in security code review and vulnerability triaging Prior experience running an open source facing bug bounty program 2+ years management experience or experience as a senior decision maker Experience working with remote teams Experience working with Kubernetes and AWS infrastructure Working knowledge of fundamental Bitcoin and Lightning design principles Candidates with additional experience are welcome to apply as we are open to adjusting the role accordingly

title: Security Engineer
description: Listed on CyberJobs.cc, a job board for cybersecurity jobs from the team behind AITraining.jobs. Metabase is the easiest way for people to get insights from their data, from tiny startups who get up and running quickly to major corporations with tens of thousands of users. That's why people love us . We bring data tools with the elegance and simplicity of consumer products to the crufty world of enterprise business intelligence. We provide an opinionated open source starting point for how companies should measure, analyze and share their data, which is used by tens of thousands of companies. About The Role We’re looking for a Security Engineer with deep expertise in source code analysis and offensive product security research. You’ll dig into complex software architectures, trace how code behaves at runtime, uncover subtle vulnerabilities, and address the systemic flaws behind them. Embedded in our core engineering team, you’ll help shape security decisions from early design through release and adoption. This is a hands-on engineering and research role: you’ll combine your security expertise with frontier AI tools to find vulnerabilities, develop fixes, and make Metabase secure by default across its product, dependencies, and runtime. Things you’ll do Partner with engineers throughout feature development, bringing security expertise to design, implementation, release, and adoption. Build security-focused features, lead security improvements across the codebase, and implement fixes that address root causes. Use and evaluate advanced AI tools to scale code analysis, vulnerability research, and secure engineering practices. Conduct offensive research into Metabase, develop proofs of concept, and validate vulnerabilities. Assess findings based on exploitability and real-world impact, define clear remediation criteria, and verify that fixes are effective. Turn individual findings into broader improvements that prevent entire classes of vulnerabilities. What you bring A demonstrated track record of finding and exploiting application vulnerabilities through source code analysis and hands-on research. The ability to independently navigate unfamiliar codebases, understand complex architectures, and reason about runtime behavior and trust boundaries. Experience with application security challenges, including authentication, authorization, injection, and unsafe handling of untrusted data. Sound judgment about exploitability and real-world impact, and the ability to communicate findings and remediation options clearly. Strong software engineering skills, including the ability to implement durable security fixes. Experience in Clojure, or a strong desire to learn. A thoughtful approach to AI-assisted security work, using these tools to extend your expertise while independently validating their output. Ownership and curiosity: you pursue difficult questions, collaborate closely with engineers, and follow findings through to resolution. Compensation The US base salary range for this role is $160K–$225K annually , plus equity and benefits. Compensation is determined by role, level, location, and individual qualifications, including skills, experience, and scope of responsibility. Pay may vary by geographic location and other job-related factors. Benefits We offer meaningful equity and a comprehensive US benefits package, including fully employer-covered medical, dental, and vision insurance (with 75% coverage for dependents), a 401(k) with employer match available to enroll after the first 30 days, flexible and unlimited paid time off including sick time, and an asynchronous, remote-first environment. We're a global team (50% outside the US), fully distributed (from Thailand to California), who get things done asynchronously, with plenty of uninterrupted time, supporting each other to do the best work of our careers. We offer flexibility (define your own schedule and work from wherever you want), autonomy, and an environment that fosters growth, learning, and development. We're relentlessly user-focused and believe in building long-term value, not short-term hacks. And we raised a $30M Series B to take our approach to the next level for years to come. For U.S. applicants: Metabase participates in the federal E-Verify program, which confirms employment authorization of newly hired U.S. based employees. E-Verify is not used as a tool to pre-screen candidates and is only initiated upon hire. E-Verify Participation Notice (English/Spanish) Right to Work Notice (English/Spanish)

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description: Ben jij een ervaren mechanisch engineer die graag zelf ontwerpt, maar ook het voortouw neemt bij innovaties en onze specialismes rondom attracties verder uitbouwt? Dan is dit een mooie volgende stap! ETF Machinefabriek BV in Nederweert zoekt een Senior Mechanisch Engineer voor de attracties-tak. Je werkt aan technisch uitdagende attracties en klant specifieke specials, en wordt binnen ons mechanische team dé inhoudelijke sparringpartner op het gebied van Ride Systems. Wat ga je doen? Als Senior Mechanisch Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit en voortgang van de mechanische engineering binnen jouw projecten. Je ontwerpt zelf, bewaakt maakbaarheid, planning en budget, en wordt de productspecialist op Mechanisch gebied voor onze Rides. Je werkt zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband, afhankelijk van wat de taak vraagt. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: het ontwikkelen en uitwerken van innovaties en klant specifieke mechanische ontwerpen voor attracties en voertuigsystemen beoordelen van ontwerpen op sterkte, materiaalkeuze, toleranties en maakbaarheid opstellen en reviewen van productietekeningen, stuklijsten en technische documentatie het bewaken van werk binnen het mechanische team, en waar nodig collega’s begeleiden. afstemmen met elektro, software, leveranciers, productie, assemblage en service leveren van technische input voor offertes, risicoanalyses, keuringen en inbedrijfstellingen het opbouwen en delen van productkennis over onze Rides, en het meedenken over standaardisatie en doorontwikkeling Wat kun je verwachten? Je komt terecht in een compacte organisatie met korte lijnen, waar je veel invloed hebt op techniek, projecten en samenwerking. Je kunt rekenen op: een veelzijdige rol met een mix van eigen ontwerpwerk, specialisme en teamverantwoordelijkheid unieke, technisch uitdagende projecten voor attracties en complexe voertuigsystemen, voor themaparken wereldwijd veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, technische verdieping en innovatie een salaris tussen € 5.000 en € 6.200 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden en een informele werksfeer met betrokken collega's met passie voor techniek Wie ben jij? Je bent een ervaren engineer die een groot deel van de tijd zelfstandig aan projecten of innovaties werkt, maar ook een teamspeler kan zijn. Je communiceert helder, neemt graag initiatief en vindt het leuk om complexe vraagstukken op te lossen en je kennis te delen. Je pakt de rol van kartrekker en aanspreekpunt op wanneer dat nodig is. Je herkent jezelf in het volgende: je hebt een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding Werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbaar je hebt ruime ervaring als mechanisch constructeur binnen de machinebouw en/of complexe systemen je hebt ervaring met 3D CAD, bij voorkeur SolidWorks je bent bekend met (of hebt interesse in) CE-trajecten en relevante normen je communiceert goed in het Nederlands en Engels je kunt werk bewaken en collega's waar nodig ondersteunen ervaring met attracties, voertuigsystemen of dynamisch belaste constructies is een pre je bent bekend met FEM-analyses. Over ETF ETF Machinefabriek B.V. is een moderne internationale organisatie met een rijke historie sinds 1951. Vanuit Nederweert werkt ETF met ongeveer 60 collega's aan maatwerkoplossingen voor klanten wereldwijd, van attracties en voertuigsystemen voor themaparken tot verwerkingsmachines voor de gras-, tapijt-, vinyl- en non-woveninindustrie. Interesse? Ben jij de Senior Mechanisch Engineer die wij zoeken? Solliciteer dan direct ! Heb je vragen over de functie? Bel of app met Niels van Ulzen via 06-57771670

title: Mechanical Project Engineer
description: Met slimme ontwerpen en productontwikkeling (R&D) bijdragen aan de Zero Emission toekomst... iets voor jou? Wordt Mechanical Project Engineer / Product Development Engineer bij eQuip! Jouw werkdag: Bij eQuip ontwerp en begeleid je innovatieve, unieke aandrijfsystemen van zware, robuuste machines voor de Zero Emission toekomst! Je werkt onder één dak nauw samen met andere technische disciplines (hydraulisch, elektrisch, software), binnen een enthousiast en dynamisch team met als doel: een ‘best fit for purpose’ ontwerp. Jouw werkzaamheden in hoofdlijnen: Je ontwerpt modulair inzetbare en/of klant specifieke (sub)systemen die deel uitmaken van een compleet aandrijfsysteem; Zowel in 3D als 2D heb jij oog voor detail en streef je naar kwaliteit; Je bouwt het ontwerp van een klant- of machine-specifiek aandrijfsysteem op uit modulaire subsystemen voor opdrachtgevers van eQuip; Hierbij verzorg of begeleid jij de koppeling tussen de diverse subsystemen (mechanisch / elektrisch / hydraulisch); Je ontwikkelt nieuwe producten (R&D), zoals elektrische lineaire actuatoren en trilblokken; Je voert relatief eenvoudige sterkteberekeningen uit; Je denkt mee over CAD-softwareoptimalisatie en processen rondom kleine serieproductie; Je hebt de mogelijkheid tot het zelf assembleren/inbedrijfstellen van jouw ontwerpen! Wat we je bieden: Naast een geweldige werkomgeving met innovatieve en veranderingsbereide ambities: Een baan voor 32 - 40 uur; Uitdagende projecten en ruimte om met de organisatie mee te groeien; Een werksfeer, waarbij we met en voor elkaar willen werken, samen sparren en kennis delen; De mogelijkheid tot het volgen van trainingen en cursussen; Flexibele werktijden en veel vrijheid; 25 vakantiedagen en de keuze om bruto loon uit te ruilen voor 13 ATV-dagen; Een goede pensioenregeling, conform de Metaal & Techniek cao; Een salaris van € 3500 - 4500 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van opleiding en ervaring. Wat we van je vragen: Naast dat je een zelfstarter bent die zowel autonoom als in teamverband werkt, werk je gestructureerd en kun je goed procesmatig denken. Verder heb je: HBO denk- en werkniveau; Een opleiding richting Mechatronica, Werktuigbouwkunde, Autotechniek of andere bèta studie; Relevante werkervaring als Product Development Engineer of vergelijkbaar; Een probleemoplossend vermogen met een praktische inslag; Goede vaardigheden met 3D CAD ontwerpsoftware; Een goede beheersing van de Engelse en Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift. Het zijn géén vereisten , maar met onderstaande scoor je pluspunten : Ervaring binnen de robuuste aandrijfsystemen of automotive; Ervaring met processen en kwaliteitsborging voor (kleine) serieproductie; Ervaring met PDM en/of 3DEXPERIENCE van SolidWorks; Kennis van elektrotechniek en/of hydrauliek. Over eQuip: eQuip ontwikkelt hoogwaardige klant specifieke aandrijfsystemen om de transitie van fossiele brandstoffen naar schone energie mogelijk te maken. Onze aandrijfsystemen worden toegepast in graafmachines, kranen en ander zwaar materieel voor bouw, industrie en offshore en worden aangedreven door accu’s, brandstofcellen of andere energie dragers. Hierbij is eQuip de spin in het web van de totale machine. Naast projecten investeert eQuip veel in R&D en eigen product ontwikkeling om totaal oplossingen te kunnen realiseren met het hoogst mogelijk rendement. Op deze wijze dragen wij bij aan het verminderen van het energieverbruik en het reduceren van schadelijke emissies voor een betere samenleving. Denk jij dat deze rol je op het lijf geschreven is? Solliciteer dan direct! eQuip werkt voor de invulling van deze vacature exclusief samen met Mijn Prolinq. Wil je meer weten? Neem contact op met Leendert Romijn via 06-13971295 of stuur je cv naar leendert@mijnprolinq.nl.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description: Ben jij een ervaren Senior Mechanical Engineer met een passie voor machinebouw? Kun jij moeiteloos schakelen tussen de verschillende fasen van een project en houd je ervan om technische uitdagingen om te zetten in slimme oplossingen? Dan is deze functie iets voor jou! Als Senior Mechanical Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van mechanische systemen en componenten. Je werkt aan uiteenlopende, uitdagende projecten binnen de machinebouw, waarbij je jouw technische kennis en ervaring inzet om innovatieve en kwalitatieve oplossingen te realiseren. Je bent betrokken bij het volledige projecttraject: van de eerste conceptontwikkeling en het technisch ontwerp tot de testfase en uiteindelijke oplevering. Samen met collega's uit verschillende disciplines zorg je ervoor dat projecten soepel verlopen en voldoen aan de gestelde kwaliteits- en klanteneisen. We zoeken een zelfstandige en gedreven professional die voldoende ervaring heeft om projecten met vertrouwen op te pakken. Uiteraard sta je er niet alleen voor! Je werkt samen met een team van enthousiaste en deskundige collega's die kennis delen, elkaar ondersteunen en samen streven naar het beste resultaat. This is a senior individual-contributor role with significant influence across multidisciplinary teams. The role will be based at the Mervue Campus in Galway, Ireland. Lead the design and development of complex consumable components, instruments and sterile-use assemblies for medical devices, with a focus on material selection, manufacturability, sterilisation compatibility, verification and validation. Create and review detailed 3D models, assemblies, drawings and design documentation using SolidWorks and Creo. Ensure designs meet requirements for reliability, usability, manufacturability, serviceability, cost and applicable quality-system expectations. Lead design reviews, risk assessments, root-cause investigations and complex technical problem-solving activities. Drive best practice in mechanical engineering, including design for manufacture, design for assembly, tolerance stack-up analysis and design documentation. Support supplier engagement, prototype builds, test activities and transfer of designs into production. Mentor engineers and provide technical guidance across projects and programmes. Evaluate new materials, technologies and design approaches to support innovation and continuous improvement. Demonstrated experience designing complex mechanical components, instruments, assemblies or mechanisms. Experience in medical-device and/or robotics product development within a regulated environment. Proven hands-on capability using SolidWorks and Creo for 3D modelling, assemblies, drawings and design documentation. Strong understanding of mechanical design principles, materials, manufacturing processes, assembly methods and tolerance analysis. Experience integrating mechanical systems with electrical, software and systems-engineering interfaces. Demonstrated ability to solve complex technical problems, lead design decisions and influence multidisciplinary teams. Strong communication, collaboration and mentoring skills. Experience with precision mechanical systems, motion control, miniaturised devices, prototyping, test-fixture design, simulation tools or supplier-led industrialisation is advantageous. title: Finmekanisk designingeniør med metodisk nysgerrig og udviklingsfokus - DTU Space
location: Kongens Lyngby, Danimarka Başkent Bölgesi, Danimarka
description: Job Description Vi søger en ingeniør til optomekanisk og finmekanisk design til afdelingen for Måling og Instrumentering. Du vil indgå i vores team af forskere, ingeniører og teknikere, der samarbejder på tværs af faggrupper. Afdelingen Måling og Instrumentering udvikler stjernekameraer og magnetometre, som bruges på mange internationale missioner. Afdelingens forskning fokuserer primært på udvikling af højpræcisionsinstrumenter til rummissioner. Derudover arbejder afdelingen på at optimere kvaliteten og pålideligheden af rumfartssystemers målinger ved at udvikle metoder til at kalibrere og interkalibrere systemerne. Forskningen inkluderer hele processen fra design, udvikling og test til implementering af instrumenter til rumfartøjer og satellitter. Jobbet Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil være udvikling af optomekaniske systemer og støttestrukturer til rumapplikationer. Du kommer til at designe og udvikle nye systemer samt videreudvikle eksisterende enheder. Herunder design og detaljering af systemerne og delementerne i CAD, udfærdigelse af de nødvendige produktionstegninger og dokumentere designet på engelsk. En stor del af arbejdet vil være at analysere og teste på løsningerne i forhold til mekaniske belastninger og termiske miljøer samt supporte vores produktion. De avancerede materialer skal fungere i hårdt belastede systemer og ekstreme miljøer med tilhørende meget fine tolerancer. Du vil skulle varetage kontakten med leverandør og deltage i møder med vores udenlandske kunder. Vores forventninger til dig Du er uddannet maskiningeniør, design-/mekanisk ingeniør eller tilsvarende uddannelsesmæssig relevant baggrund – gerne på civilingeniør eller Ph.d.-niveau. Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra brancher med fine tolerancer fx space, aviation, medico, medicinsk udstyr, høreapparater eller lign. Vi kan både forestille sig en erfaren, alternativt en nyuddannet profil – med mulighed for at tilpasse opgaverne og ansvarsområdet. Uanset hvad efterspørges et drive for at udvikle, en forskningsmæssig nysgerrig på nye metoder, kreative evner samt ikke mindst en stor interesse for nye teknologier. Så ved dine kommende kolleger i DTU Space om nogen, at du – ligesom dem – kommer til at brænde for området. Dine kompetencer indebærer at; Du er som person løsningsorienteret, selvstændig og kan tænke ud af boksen. Du er god til at kommunikere og samarbejde med mange forskellige typer af mennesker. Du skriver og taler godt engelsk, da vores kunder og kollegaer er internationale. Du tør ytre dig, men samtidig være lyttende. Du kan drive et projekt fra start og følge det til dørs. Du skal kunne følge givne standarder og sætte dig ind i disse. Du kunne navigere i mange arbejdsopgaver. Du kan med fordel have erfaring i en række af nedenstående punkter; CAD og CAE samt god forståelse for produktion af emnerne Optomekanisk eller finmekanisk design Mikrostrukturen af metaller og kompositter Finite Element Analyser Vibrations- og shock-test Hvad tilbyder vi dig Vi tilbyder et spændende job med gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling. Arbejdsområdet er et højt specialiseret felt, som få er privilegeret til at arbejde med. Afdelingen for Måling og Instrumentering er en fleksibel, familievenlig arbejdsplads med en uformel og åben omgangsform. Vi er gode til at fejre små som store succeser i hverdagen. Løn og ansættelsesvilkår Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til overenskomst for akademikere i staten. Du ansættes som fuldmægtig, specialkonsulent, chefkonsulent. Der kan desuden forhandles tillæg i henhold til DTU's lønstruktur for AC TAP: https://www.inside.dtu.dk/human-resources/under-ansaettelsen/loen/loenstrukturer Ansættelsen er på fuld tid og tiltrædes snarest muligt. Arbejdssted er DTU Campus i Lyngby. Ansøgning og kontakt Vi skal modtage din onlineansøgning senest den 29. november 2026 . Søg stillingen online på www.job.dtu.dk . Åbn linket "Ansøg nu", hvor du udfylder ansøgningsformularen samt vedhæfter motiveret ansøgning, CV og eksamensbeviser. Ønsker du flere oplysninger om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte, professor Peter Brauer, på +45 20 83 56 44 / pb@space.dtu.dk . Kandidater vil blive kaldt til samtale løbende. Ansøgninger modtaget efter ansøgningsfristens udløb tages ikke i betragtning. Alle interesserede uanset alder, køn, handicap, race, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold, opfordres til at søge stillingen. Da DTU arbejder med forskning i kritisk teknologi, hvormed der gælder særlige regler for blandt andet sikkerhed og eksportkontrol, kan der blive foretage open source-baggrundstjek af kvalificerede kandidater til stillingen. DTU Space er Danmarks nationale ruminstitut, og vi har ca. 230 medarbejdere. Det er vores mål at være en internationalt foretrukken partner i rumprojekter. Instituttet er organiseret i 6 afdelinger og deltager desuden i flere tværgående DTU-centre. Mere information om DTU Space på https://www.space.dtu.dk/ Afdelingen Måling og Instrumentering , Institut for Rumforskning og rumteknologi, DTU Space har designet, udviklet og testet instrumenter til flere end 60 rumfartsmissioner. Læs mere om afdelingen på: https://www.space.dtu.dk/english/research-divisions/measurement-and-instrumentation-systems DTU – Til gavn for samfundet siden 1829 DTU er et af Europas førende tekniske eliteuniversiteter. Med forskning og uddannelser i international topklasse skaber vi løsninger på tidens store samfundsmæssige udfordringer og bidrager til at sikre Europas globale førerposition inden for bæredygtig teknologiudvikling. Siden H.C. Ørsted grundlagde DTU for snart 200 år siden, har vores mission været den samme: Vi udvikler og nyttiggør naturvidenskab og teknisk videnskab til gavn for samfundet. DTU har 13.800 studerende, 1.600 ph.d.-studerende og 6.500 ansatte. Vi arbejder i et internationalt miljø og har en inkluderende, udviklende og uformel arbejdskultur. DTU har campusser i hele Danmark og i Grønland og samarbejder med de bedste universiteter verden over.

title: Maskinkonstruktör till R&D Implements
description: Om tjänsten Som Maskinkonstruktör får du en viktig roll i utvecklingen av framtidens redskap för jordbruk, skogsbruk, bygg och anläggning. Arbetet är varierande och erbjuder stor frihet, eget ansvar och goda möjligheter att bidra med nya idéer och tekniska lösningar. I teamet arbetar vi både med att utveckla nya koncept och att vidareutveckla befintliga produkter inom mekanik och hydraulik. För att skapa så bra och effektiva lösningar som möjligt har vi ett nära samarbete, både inom R&D och med kollegor i vår internationella organisation. Vi söker dig som har ett eget driv, gärna tar initiativ och har en analytisk förmåga. Framför allt tror vi att du är nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och motiveras av att ta dig an tekniska utmaningar. Du blir en del av framtagningen av nya redskap, från koncept till lanserad produkt. Processen inkluderar mekanisk och hydraulisk konstruktion, beräkningar, simulering (t.ex FEM), verifiering i fält- och labbmiljö samt framställning av ritningsunderlag. Vidare ingår arbetsuppgifter som vidareutveckling, produktunderhåll och utredning av prioriterade kvalitetsärenden. Din profil Vi söker dig som är strukturerad, positiv, resultatorienterad och initiativtagande. Du besitter en nyfikenhet på att utveckla tekniken och dig själv, och provar gärna nya metoder. Som person är du ansvarstagande och strävar mot att uppnå gemensamma mål. Vi tror att du har: Civil- eller högskoleingenjörsexamen inom maskinteknik eller motsvarande, med några års arbetslivserfarenhet av produktutveckling inom relevant område. God förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska i så väl tal som skrift. Tidigare erfarenhet av svetsade konstruktioner och beräkning/simulering (t.ex. FEM) är meriterande. Vad kan JOST Umeå erbjuda dig? Hos oss får du arbeta i en internationell miljö för ett världsledande företag. Våra medarbetare beskriver atmosfären hos oss som familjär med härlig stämning mellan kollegor, både inom och mellan avdelningar. Arbetsmässigt finns stor frihet under ansvar, korta beslutsvägar och stora möjligheter till att utvecklas. Att arbeta hos oss innebär att vara en del av ett team med stark framåtanda, drivkraft och ambition – alltid med kundens bästa i fokus. Vi verkar för att våra kunder ska mötas av produkter med hög kvalitet och det är viktigt för oss att vara nytänkande inom branschen. Genom teknisk utveckling i framkant bidrar vi till framtidens jordbruk. Som personalförmåner erbjuder vi bland annat flexibla arbetstider och arbetstidsförkortning då vi tycker det är viktigt att våra medarbetare ska kunna anpassa arbetet efter vad som passar i varje individs livssituation. Vi erbjuder även friskvårdsbidrag och massage på arbetsplatsen. Vi erbjuder dessutom möjlighet till förmånscykel och privat sjukvårdsförsäkring. Inkludering i arbetslivet är en självklarhet för oss. Vi vill tillvarata de kvaliteter som en stor mångfald tillför och vi välkomnar därför sökanden av olika kön och bakgrund. För att säkerställa en trygg och säker arbetsmiljö genomför vi bakgrundskontroller i samband med rekrytering samt tillämpar slumpvisa drogtester på vår arbetsplats. Ansökan Sista ansökningsdag: 2026-12-03.
