title: Konstruktör/designer - Saab Barracuda, Gamleby
description: Vill du påverka och göra skillnad på riktigt? Här bidrar du till att skapa trygghet för människor och samhällen. Det du gör spelar roll. Din roll Vill du kombinera teknisk design och konstruktion med kreativ problemlösning och få möjlighet att följa dina lösningar från kundbehov till färdig produkt? Som designer hos Saab Barracuda blir du en del av vår designavdelning och arbetar med kundanpassade lösningar inom Signature Management. Här får du en varierad roll där du omsätter kundens krav och behov till tekniska och kostnadseffektiva lösningar, med hänsyn till såväl produktens prestanda som våra produktionsförutsättningar. Du arbetar nära bland annat produktion, produktionsberedning/planering, utveckling och marknad. Våra prototyper tillverkas i nära anslutning till designavdelningen, vilket ger dig möjlighet att vara nära hela processen och se dina lösningar ta form i praktiken. Du kommer bland annat att: Driva designuppdrag och projekt från kundbehov och kravspecifikation till färdig lösning. Ta fram kundanpassade design- och konstruktionslösningar i 2D- och 3D-CAD. Arbeta utifrån CAD-underlag från kund eller vid behov genomföra mätning och mallning av objekt. Samarbeta med forskning- och utvecklingsavdelningen för att optimera lösningar utifrån prestanda, tillverkningsbarhet och kostnad. Ta fram produktionsunderlag såsom ritningar, skärfiler och BOM/beredning för överlämning till produktionsberedning/planering. Delta i kundmöten och bidra med tekniska designförslag i det operativa säljarbetet. I rollen ingår även resor inom Sverige och internationellt för bland annat utprovning och montage av prototyper och lösningar. Omfattningen är ungefär 6-8 veckor per år . Din profil Vi söker dig som tycker om att kombinera teknik med kreativ problemlösning och som trivs med att omsätta krav och idéer till praktiska lösningar. Du har en högskole- eller universitetsutbildning inom design, konstruktion eller annat relevant område. Alternativt har du skaffat dig motsvarande kompetens genom arbetslivserfarenhet. Vi tror att du har: Goda kunskaper inom 2D- och 3D-CAD. Förmåga att förstå tekniska krav och omsätta dem till genomförbara lösningar. God kommunikativ förmåga och lätt för att samarbeta med olika funktioner. Ett strukturerat och kvalitetsmedvetet arbetssätt. Goda kunskaper i engelska, både i tal och skrift. Erfarenhet av enklare projektplanering eller att självständigt driva uppdrag. Som person är du nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och kreativ. Du tycker om att testa olika vägar framåt och har samtidigt förmågan att väga tekniska lösningar mot kundens behov, kostnad och produktionsförutsättningar. Det är meriterande om du har: Erfarenhet av AutoCAD och Rhino. Erfarenhet av PDM-system. Intresse för eller kunskap inom programmering. B-körkort. Rollen innehåller praktiska moment i samband med bland annat utprovning och montage av våra lösningar hos kund. Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap. Vad du blir en del av Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas. Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med syfte att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidra till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld. Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här

title: Powertrain Installation Design Engineer - Wheel Loaders
description: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. Great machines are built on great integration. Want to be part of it? Imagine shaping the next generation of wheel loaders, working with complex technologies and seeing your engineering solutions come to life in real machines. At Volvo Construction Equipment, we combine proven engineering with electrification, new technologies and smarter solutions. We are looking for a Powertrain Installation Design Engineer who enjoys technical challenges, thinks beyond individual components and understands the bigger picture. What will you do? As part of our Wheel Loader Installation team, you will develop and integrate powertrain solutions, connecting components, technologies and engineering disciplines across the complete machine with an end-to-end responsibility. You will have the opportunity to influence solutions from early concepts all the way to finished products. Your Key Responsibilities Include Design and optimize powertrain installation concepts, component packaging, mounting solutions and mechanical interfaces in 3D-environment. Contribute to early architecture and concept development, evaluating alternatives and identifying technical risks. Collaborate across powertrain, electrical, hydraulic, manufacturing and aftermarket engineering. Balance quality, delivery, cost, functionality, manufacturability and serviceability. Support verification, prototype builds, industrialization and continuous product improvements. Explore new engineering methods, digital tools and AI-enabled ways of working. Who are you? You have a technical foundation and hold a B.Sc. degree in mechanical engineering, product development, mechatronics or a related field, supported by relevant education or experience. Experience in mechanical design, component installation or system integration is valuable. Knowledge of powertrain systems is an advantage, while experience with CAD tools such as Creo or CATIA is required. But your mindset matters just as much as your experience. You enjoy combining technical depth with a broad understanding of how systems interact. You challenge assumptions, collaborate across disciplines and see opportunities where others see constraints. Above all, you demonstrate learnability, adaptability and curiosity, recognizing that tomorrow's engineering challenges will continue to evolve. Why join us? Join a team where knowledge is shared, ideas are challenged and engineering problems are solved together. You will have the opportunity to deepen your technical expertise, broaden your understanding of the complete machine and influence future products. From the very first idea to a machine in the hands of our customers. We believe in trust, collaboration and continuous learning, creating an environment where both people and ideas can grow. As part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing may be conducted. You will be informed if applicable. Let's build tomorrow together! Last day to apply: 30 November Hiring Manager: Matilda Lagerkvist Location: Eskilstuna, Sweden We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. Who We Are And What We Believe In We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities. Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group . Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment. Part of Volvo Group, Volvo Construction Equipment is a global company driven by our purpose to build the world we want to live in. Together we develop and deliver solutions for a cleaner, smarter, and more connected world. By unleashing everyone’s full potential, we build a more sustainable future for all our stakeholders. Come join our team and help us build a better tomorrow.

title: DV Senior Mechanical Design Engineer
description: Standard Job Description Designs major components, or major portions of a functional system, or technically advanced protoype, promotional or specific products. Develop or improve products and facilitate manufacturing operations. Develops basic data and makes preliminary layouts, sketches, and notes necessary to present design proposal. Investigates pertinent design factors such as ease of manufacture, availability of materials and equipment, interchangeability, replace ability, strength-weight efficiency, and contractual specification requirements and cost. Coordinates with other organizations affected by design development. Makes layouts of assemblies and details parts of devices, mechanisms, structures, and products. Checks completed layouts and drawings for clarity, completeness, conformity to standards, procedures, specifications, and accuracy of calculations and dimensioning. Identifies design errors, omissions, and other deficiencies, and recommends revisions and/or improvements in design layout to responsible engineers or designers. About The Role The Mechanical Design Engineer will be responsible for carrying out the duties of the Engineering department, including design, prototyping, design proving, engineering documentation, and supporting calculations. A key requirement of this role is the ability to obtain and maintain a high‑level security clearance. If you do not currently hold the required clearance, we can support you through the application process. DV Clearance will be required for the role - applicants should either already hold a DV or being prepared to go through an application immediately. This position will require an on-site presence in Ampthill, Bedfordshire. The role demands a high level of innovative thinking and the ability to synthesise ideas into functioning and manufacturable products that are compliant to design specifications and applicable legislation. Working within a team of engineers and Design Authorities to design and develop high integrity components, complex mechanisms and linkages that will function and be durable in challenging environments. Responsibilities and Duties Use requirements specifications and a design brief to develop innovative yet robust design solutions that are compliant and fit for purpose. Use CREO Parametric CAD to produce both concept and detail designs. Produce supporting calculations and analysis to justify design decisions. Work with SMEs, Users and Design Authorities to develop concept design solutions. Work with a team of Design Engineers with agreed interfaces to develop a single sub-system design solution. Work with CAD engineers to enable the production of drawings and design data pack. Create and present Design Review data packs to Senior Engineers and Governors. Assist with the production of prototypes and confirm designs with manufacturing/purchasing teams. Perform physical testing and design proving activities on engineering prototypes. Ensure components and assemblies adhere to applicable, industry and business standards. Ensure components and assemblies adhere to applicable programme safety requirements and governing safety legislation. Required Skills, Qualifications And Experience Must be able to work in the UK without restrictions in accordance with UK National Law and be prepared to successfully undertake an appropriate level of UK National Security Vetting according to UK Government National Security Vetting criteria: DV Clearance will be required for the role - applicants should either already hold a DV or being prepared to go through an application immediately. Experience of working within the defence industry working within the Aeropace or Space domain considered a strong advantage for this role. Proven, direct experience in the design and development of mechanical sub-systems and components. Proven, direct experience in the design and specification of electrical interfaces for sub-systems and components. Understanding of current materials, treatments and finishing technology for use in Defence, Aerospace and Space products. Working knowledge of CREO CAD software and experience of using the tool to produce complex parametric designs. Able to use Windchill PDM system. Knowledge of complex mechanism design and principles. Ability to perform basic structural and kinematic calculations. Proven track record of successful design and product development for use in harsh environments. Impeccable attention to design detail and able to produce high standards of documentation. Ability to plan, schedule, coordinate and problem solve effectively both as an individual and as part of team solve effectively.

title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer
description: 1 Senior Mechanical Design Engineer Pitstone, Tring, Hertfordshire - Hybrid working Skills: CAD, CATIA, NX, Mechanical Design, 3D Design, BOM, PDM, PLM, GD&T, Dimensions, DFM, At Safran Electrical & Power, we recognise that aviation needs to innovate and change in order to protect our environment. We believe that future aircraft power systems will be hybrid-electric or full-electric, which is why we are working to develop and deliver advanced electrical solutions to help decarbonise flight. If you want to help deliver this future, we are looking for enthusiastic and creative people to join our team. The UK Safran Electrical & Power team has expertise in designing and developing electrical systems comprising generators, power conversion, distribution and control, with developing expertise in electric motors for aircraft propulsion. The Role As a Mechanical Design Engineer at Safran Electrical & Power you will help to deliver robust designs and work packages using Catia and NX CAD software to high tolerances for use in the aerospace industry. These will be designed to meeting stringent manufacturing, quality, cost and weight targets. You will be responsible for developing innovative mechanical design solutions, to current and future aerospace industry challenges, as well as the development of through-life improvements and modifications on existing smart motor and power generation technologies. *Create and support the definition of robust mechanical design solutions, for R&D / R&T project/s, by ensuring the designs are technically robust, fit for purpose and meet both the business and customer needs. *Deliver engineering solutions that meet 'Design to Cost' and 'Design to Manufacture/Assembly' requirements. *Produce and maintain CAD models, drawings and parts lists that are compliant with all company standards, associated within the work packages assigned to you. *The focal point for any technical Engineering investigation support requirements to Manufacture Engineering, Operations, Programs and Supply chain, Customer support & Quality. *Mechanical Design of in-service product alterations and tooling including documentation *Review and approve design activities created by themselves and others. *Produce and report on Design Assurance documentation, including; design reports, test procedures and Hand/Stress calculations, such as interference fits, thermal growth, hoop and tensile stresses, thread loadings and tolerance analyses. *Responsible for the oversight and approval of design solutions delivered by more junior Engineers within designated teams. Desirable Experience We are looking for candidates with a range of skills and experience, but we're also keen to help people grow and develop in this role. If you have some or all of the following, we'd love to hear from you: *A Mechanical, Automotive or Aeronautical Engineering degree or equivalent qualification/work experience. *Experience delivering work packages and supervising and guiding other Engineers in a team. *Mechanical design experience with ideally with some exposure to rotating equipment such as shafts, bearings, rotors, motors, generators or other electric machines. *An understanding of engineering materials and production methods relevant to them. *Substantial experience of using 2D & 3D CAD software - ideally Catia and NX. *Good working knowledge of MS Software i.e. Excel, Word, PowerPoint. *Ability to communicate clearly, through written and verbal means, to all levels within the business and be able to interact easily with other Engineering teams. *If you have experience in the design of other complex dynamic system types then you have skills we are interested in and we would welcome your application.

title: Packaging Modeling & Simulation Junior Technologist
description: About The Job Utrecht/Hybrid Do you want to use modelling, simulation, and AI to help shape the next generation of packaging? Join us as our next Packaging Modeling & Simulation Junior Technologist. In this role, you will turn real packaging challenges into virtual models and practical recommendations, helping Danone develop better-performing packaging across its global portfolio. You will combine computational engineering with hands-on experimentation, working at the intersection of packaging, mechanics, materials, data, and digital innovation. As a Packaging Modeling & Simulation Junior Technologist , you will use numerical simulation to understand and predict how packaging performs across its lifecycle, from processing and transportation to consumer use and end-of-life. You will develop and run simulation models, validate them through physical experiments, and translate your findings into clear recommendations for packaging engineers and other technical teams. Beyond simulation, you will contribute to the development of AI-based tools and more efficient ways of managing modelling data. You will also help shape how AI can support areas such as virtual rendering, CAD, reporting, and simulation workflows. Your key responsibilities will be to Model packaging performance Develop and run numerical simulations to predict mechanical performance, consumer interaction, processing behaviour, product-pack interactions, and end-of-life performance across different packaging applications. Turn simulation into actionable insights Analyse simulation results and translate complex findings into clear conclusions and recommendations for packaging engineers and cross-functional teams. Connect virtual and physical testing Design and conduct experiments, including material characterisation and physical measurements, to generate data and validate simulation models. Advance AI and digital modelling capabilities Develop and explore AI-based tools that improve modelling workflows, technical recommendations, virtual rendering, reporting, and team efficiency. Strengthen simulation data and ways of working Help organise and harmonise modelling data, including material properties and simulation input and output files, while contributing to consistent tools and methodologies across the team. Your future manager will be Romain SAVAJANO, R&I Adv Techno Pack Modelling & Simulation Team Leader. About You You are curious about how things work and enjoy using technology to solve complex, real-world engineering problems. You are comfortable moving between simulations, physical experiments, data, and conversations with different technical stakeholders. Experience in other industries involving materials, mechanical performance, simulation, or product development can bring valuable perspectives to the team. To be successful in this role, you must have Master’s degree or PhD in mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, physics, materials science, computational engineering, or another relevant scientific field. Early-career industry or applied research experience in modelling and simulation, ideally involving finite element analysis, computational fluid dynamics, CAD, solid mechanics, or related numerical methods. Hands-on experience with at least one finite element analysis tool, ideally Abaqus or a comparable simulation platform. Experience working in a technical or laboratory environment, including material characterisation, physical measurements, or experimental testing. Understanding of experimental design and model validation using laboratory, pilot, or industrial testing. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to translate technical results into clear recommendations. Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to different audiences. Professional fluency in English. It is nice-to-have Experience in packaging, polymers, materials, consumer products, manufacturing, or a related industry. Experience with AI, machine learning, or data-driven engineering applications. Programming or scripting experience, particularly with tools such as Python or MATLAB. Experience working with simulation data management, automation, or digital engineering workflows. Experience working in an international or cross-functional environment. Working knowledge of French. About us At Danone we are committed to our mission “bringing health, through food to as many people as possible”. We are working together to make sure that our brands, like Nutricia and Nutrilon, create real benefits for people, communities and the planet. You will be part of one of the largest Certified B Corps™ in the world. title: PhD Position in Computational Design and Fabrication of Adaptive 3D-Printed Structures
description: Help shape the future of products that sense and adapt to the human body, using multi-material 3D printing and computational design. Job Description Many products that support or interact with people need structures that do more than carry loads: they must respond reliably to changing forces and patterns of use. Multi-material additive manufacturing makes it possible to integrate different mechanical and functional behaviours within a single structure. Yet designing structures that combine load-bearing performance with embedded sensing and controlled adaptation remains a major challenge. Addressing it calls for new ways to connect geometry, material behaviour and manufacturing with the needs of people who use the resulting products. In this PhD, you will develop and investigate computational design approaches for multi-material 3D-printed structures. You will explore how geometry, material distribution, electronics functions and manufacturing parameters can be designed together to achieve desired structural and functional behaviour. You will also design and fabricate prototypes that incorporate sensing and geometry-driven mechanisms for adaptation. Combining computational modelling with hands-on experiments, you will evaluate structural behaviour, sensing performance and durability under static and cyclic loading. You will interpret the results, refine design methods, integrate promising concepts into demonstrators, and communicate your findings through scientific publications and presentations. Your research will include: Developing fabrication-aware computational workflows for lattice geometries and multi-material layouts. Designing and making 3D-printed prototypes to investigate load-bearing, sensing and adaptive behaviour. Using computational modelling and experiments to evaluate stiffness, deformation, sensing and actuation performance, and durability. Integrating and validating concepts in demonstrators, including a wheelchair cushion to evaluate sitting pressure redistribution and user comfort. You will be part of the Materializing Futures group in the Department of Sustainable Design Engineering, Faculty of Industrial Design Engineering, supervised by Dr. Mehmet Özdemir and Dr. Wolf Song. You will have access to the faculty’s digital fabrication facilities and the Comfort Lab, and collaborate with experts in ergonomics, and smart materials, as well as industry partners. title: Joining Engineer
description: About The Role We are seeking an experienced Joining Engineer specializing in Cold Metal Transfer (CMT) welding and advanced joinery for high-volume automotive manufacturing. In this role, you will lead process development, parameter optimization, and continuous improvement across automated Body-in-White (BIW) and battery structure production lines. You will focus on joining challenging materials—such as thin-gauge aluminum, ultra-high-strength steels (UHSS), and hybrid assemblies—while ensuring high line efficiency, minimal spatter, and strict safety-critical weld quality. Key Responsibilities CMT Process Optimization: Develop, qualify, and stabilize Fronius CMT welding parameters across automated BIW, chassis, or battery tray production lines. Robotic Cell Commissioning: Fine-tune automated welding cells with multi-axis robots (KUKA, ABB, FANUC) for high-speed, repeatable automotive assembly. Defect Reduction & Line Support: Perform root-cause failure analysis (porosity, burn-through, gap variation) and implement immediate counter-measures during pre-series and ramp-up phases. Design for Manufacture (DFM): Work with BIW design teams to optimize automotive joint configurations, gap tolerances, and fixture design for optimal heat input control. Quality & Standards Compliance: Ensure all joints comply with automotive OEM standards, creating Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS), PQR, and executing PFMEAs. Multi-Joining Technologies: Support secondary BIW joining techniques where applied, such as Self-Piercing Riveting (SPR), Resistance Spot Welding (RSW), and structural adhesives. Key Requirements & Qualifications Education: Degree in Joining/Welding Engineering, Metallurgy, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent automotive industry experience. Automotive Background: Minimum 3+ years in automotive manufacturing, specifically within BIW, battery enclosure, or chassis production environments. CMT Expertise: In-depth knowledge of Fronius CMT systems, pulse settings, and low-heat input welding of aluminum alloys and galvanized steels. Robotic Integration: Hands-on experience programming and troubleshooting robotic MIG/MAG welding equipment. Core Quality Tools: Proficiency in APQP, PPAP, 8D problem-solving, PFMEA, and metallographic weld testing (macrosections, cut-and-etch). Desirable Experience Experience in EV/e-Mobility manufacturing (e.g., aluminum battery enclosure welding). Familiarity with automotive quality standards (IATF 16949, ISO 3834). Experience with automated optical weld inspection systems or inline monitoring tools. SEGULA Technologies is a global engineering group, boosting the competitiveness of all major industrial sectors: automotive, aerospace, energy, rail, naval, life sciences, and telecoms. With a presence in more than 30 countries and 140 locations worldwide, the Group prioritizes close relationships with its clients, driven by the expertise of its 15,000 employees. As a leading engineering player putting innovation at the heart of its strategy, SEGULA Technologies manages large-scale projects, ranging from initial studies to industrialization and production. title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description: About us: Xeryon is a fast-growing and innovative Leuven-based scale-up that focuses on the development and production of groundbreaking nano-motors. Supported by strong investors, we are determined to conquer the market and have a global impact. Today we produce 2,000 motors per year and our goal is to go to hundreds of thousands of motors per year within a few years. We are looking for an experienced Mechanical Engineer to join our team and help us achieve our ambitious goals. Job Summary: As Senior Mechanical Engineer at Xeryon, you are the mechanical engineering expert in a fast-growing scale-up. You set the standard for every step of our engineering process: specification and concept, simulation, prototyping and validation, a robust and manufacturable series design, and control over its lifecycle. You raise the level of the whole team by defining how we design, verify and manage our products. Key Responsibilities: You join the mechanical engineering team within R&D. Working closely with our multidisciplinary engineering team, you develop new motion products based on our patented ultrasonic piezo technology and improve existing ones. Precision product development: Design compact motion products based on our ultrasonic piezo motors, from the technical requirements definition through 3D modelling to production-ready part and assembly drawings with sound GD&T. Our products integrate many precision functions in a very small volume, so every design means balancing tight tolerances, interacting mechanical effects and limited space. Contribute to technology development for future product generations. Simulation & analysis: Use FEA (structural, modal, thermal) and analytical models to predict stiffness, dynamics and thermal drift, gain early design insights and correlate the results with test data. Hands-on prototyping: Assemble and test your own prototypes to connect the CAD model to the real world. Get a true feel for our products and feed what you learn back into the design. Reliability support: Support our reliability engineering with your design expertise. Contribute to FMEAs and design-review risk discussions, help define reliability requirements, acceptance criteria and test plans, and review lifetime and validation test results. Drive root-cause investigations of mechanical failures and turn the findings into design improvements. Engineering standards: Set the standard for every step of the engineering process. Take ownership of our SOPs and work instructions for the engineering design process and improve them, so that every design is developed, verified and released with consistent, traceable quality. Design data & lifecycle management: Maintain disciplined CAD/PDM data, BOMs and revisions. Drive a structured engineering change process, and own products from NPI through series production to end-of-life, together with our quality and operations teams. Customer projects: Support customer projects by analysing, testing and debugging complex mechanical systems. Engineer custom and OEM solutions, and act as technical counterpart in complex integration projects. Qualifications You are an experienced precision engineer who combines strong design intuition with analytical rigour. You enjoy fitting complex functionality into compact designs and think at system level about how mechanics, actuation and sensing interact. You have a hands-on mentality: you are as comfortable assembling and testing a prototype as behind the CAD screen. You know that a design is only finished when it is specified, verified, documented and producible at volume, and you like turning that know-how into clear standards for the whole team. title: Technical Support Specialist - French speaking (fresh STEM grads)
description: You studied engineering to solve hard problems. Here, you'll solve them every single day. At Formlabs, we’re building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting-edge products to life-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, and NASA. Together, we’re helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before. We’re a team of hands-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you’re ready to shape the future of fabrication, come build it with us. Your Impact: As a Technical Support Specialist , you’ll be at the heart of our technology. You’ll diagnose machine errors, analyze printer logs and work hands-on with hardware, firmware, software and materials to find the root cause of complex issues. This is a highly technical role where your engineering mindset is put to work every day. What makes the role special is the combination of deep technical problem-solving and real human connection . Our customers are mainly engineers, dentists, jewelers and manufacturers who rely on Formlabs printers every day. You’ll turn your technical findings into clear guidance that gets them back to creating, and share your insights with our global engineering and product teams to shape the next generation of our printers. This role is designed for fresh STEM graduates who love figuring out how things work and enjoy helping others succeed. We’ll give you in-depth, hands-on training on our printers, materials and software from day one, and support you in developing both your technical expertise and your communication skills. In this role you will: Immediately benefit from in-depth technical training: our onboarding covers 3D printing technologies (SLA and SLS), printer hardware and firmware, materials science, our software ecosystem and structured engineering troubleshooting, so you’re equipped from day one Troubleshoot and root-cause complex technical issues across mechanics, electronics, optics, firmware, software and resin/powder materials Analyze printer logs, error codes and print failures to pinpoint what went wrong, and why Run hands-on tests and reproduce issues on Formlabs printers in our Budapest lab Guide customers, distributors and resellers in the EMEA region through technical fixes by phone, email, chat and video, translating engineering findings into clear next steps Partner with our global engineering, product and quality teams: escalate bugs, document recurring issues and feed real-world data into product improvements Become an educator: train resellers and customers on Formlabs printers and help them deliver outstanding service Build and improve technical documentation and troubleshooting guides used across our global support team About You: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a STEM field (required) : e.g. mechanical, electrical, mechatronics, materials, chemical or biomedical engineering, physics or a related field No prior work experience needed; this role is designed for fresh graduates Language requirements: C1 or better fluency in French AND English is required; additional European languages are a plus A natural problem-solver who enjoys taking things apart (literally or figuratively) to understand how they work Analytical and structured: you form a hypothesis, test it and follow the data to the root cause Able to explain technical topics clearly and patiently, in writing and on the phone; we’ll help you sharpen this Able to work independently, while enjoying and thriving in a team environment Bonus Skills: Hands-on experience from university projects, labs, theses, student teams (Formula Student, robotics, rocketry) or internships Experience with 3D printing, CAD, electronics, programming or scripting Passion for additive manufacturing and emerging technologies Our Perks: Shares in the company through our equity program (we’re a double unicorn company!) Hybrid work Catered lunch at the office 3 days per week, plus free beverages and snacks Private health insurance with Medicare (Blue package + hospital coverage) A monthly or quarterly public transportation pass for Budapest All You Can Move sports pass with 9,500 HUF monthly allowance Development opportunities both in-house and off-site An inclusive, dog-friendly office with diverse and inspiring colleagues Fun team events And of course… unlimited 3D prints We build amazing things. Come join us! Even if you don’t check every box, but see yourself contributing, please apply. Help us build an inclusive community that will change the face of 3D printing. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Orbia topluluğunun bir parçası olarak, bugünün ihtiyaçlarına çözüm üretirken geleceğin daha yaşanabilir ve sürdürülebilir şehirlerine katkı sağlamayı hedefliyoruz. Wavin Türkiye’de mühendislik uzmanlığımızı, yenilikçi yaklaşımımızı ve sürdürülebilirlik odağımızı güçlü bir ekip kültürüyle bir araya getiriyoruz. Açık iletişimi, iş birliğini, çeşitliliği ve sürekli gelişimi destekleyen çalışma ortamımızda, birlikte değer yaratmaya inanıyoruz. Bu rolde; günlük üretim operasyonlarının takibinden süreç iyileştirmeye, verimlilik çalışmalarından ekip koordinasyonuna kadar üretimin farklı alanlarında aktif sorumluluk üstleneceksiniz. Key Responsibilities Sorumluluklar Günlük, haftalık ve aylık üretim planları doğrultusunda üretim faaliyetlerini yürütmek ve takip etmek, Üretim süreçlerini analiz ederek verimlilik, maliyet ve kalite iyileştirme çalışmalarını hayata geçirmek, Makine ve üretim hatlarına ilişkin kapasite, çevrim süresi, duruş, KPI ve OEE göstergelerini takip etmek ve iyileştirme aksiyonları geliştirmek, Proses ve kalite problemlerinde kök neden analizleri yapmak, düzeltici ve önleyici faaliyetleri planlamak ve takip etmek, Standart iş talimatları, proses dokümanları ve üretim kayıtlarının güncelliğini sağlamak, Hammadde, yarı mamul ve mamul akışını takip ederek üretim sürekliliğine katkı sağlamak, İş sağlığı, güvenliği ve çevre standartlarına uygun üretim süreçlerini desteklemek, Bakım, kalite, planlama, depo ve diğer ilgili ekiplerle koordineli çalışmak, Üretim ekibinin iş organizasyonu, görev dağılımı ve gelişim süreçlerine destek olmak. Requirements Aradığımız Nitelikler Üniversitelerin ilgili mühendislik bölümlerinden mezun, Üretim alanında en az 2 yıl deneyimli, Proses iyileştirme, verimlilik takibi, kök neden analizi ve düzeltici/önleyici faaliyetler konusunda bilgi sahibi, Tercihen Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, 5S ve sürekli iyileştirme uygulamalarına hâkim, İyi derecede yazılı ve sözlü İngilizce bilgisine sahip, MS Office uygulamalarını etkin kullanabilen, Analitik düşünebilen, iletişim becerileri güçlü ve ekip çalışmasına yatkın, Adana’da ikamet eden veya edebilecek. Our Offer Wavin, Orbia’s Water & Climate Solutions business, is an innovative solutions provider for the global building and infrastructure industry. Backed by more than 70 years of product development experience, we advance life around the world by ensuring safe and efficient water supply, sanitation and hygiene, climate-resilient cities, and better building performance. Wavin has over 10,000 employees across more than 40 production sites worldwide, serving customers in over 80 countries through a global sales and distribution network. Our key commercial brands are Wavin, Amanco Wavin, Pavco Wavin, and Plastigama Wavin.

title: E&I Maintenance Superintendent H/F
description: À propos de SPIE Global Services Energy Filiale internationale du groupe SPIE présente dans une trentaine de pays en Europe, en Afrique, en Asie-Pacifique, au Moyen-Orient et dans les Amériques, SPIE Global Services Energy intervient sur l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur des infrastructures de production d'énergie, de la conception à la maintenance. Forte d'un réseau de proximité qui permet de mobiliser rapidement des ressources, SPIE Global Services Energy répond aux besoins de ses clients dans les meilleures conditions de sécurité. SPIE Global Services Energy s'appuie sur l'expertise de ses 5 000 collaborateurs pour aider les acteurs de l'industrie du pétrole, du gaz et des énergies renouvelables à améliorer la performance technique de leurs infrastructures, leur efficacité énergétique et à réduire leur empreinte carbone. Avec 55 000 collaborateurs, le groupe SPIE a réalisé en 2025 un chiffre d'affaires consolidé de 10,4 milliards d'euros et un EBITA consolidé de 793 millions d'euros. The E&I Maintenance Superintendent is responsible for the following activities: Maintenance Strategy & Planning * Develop, implement, and continuously improve the E&I maintenance strategy in line with company objectives. * Participate in the preparation and optimization of preventive and predictive maintenance programs. * Ensure proper planning and prioritization of maintenance activities to support production targets. Maintenance Execution * Direct and supervise the execution of all E&I maintenance activities (routine, corrective, and shutdowns). * Ensure maintenance activities are carried out in compliance with procedures, safety rules, and quality standards. * Coordinate with supervisors and teams to ensure efficient use of manpower and resources. Reliability & Performance Improvement * Monitor equipment performance and identify opportunities to improve reliability and availability. * Lead or participate in root cause analysis (RCA) for failures and implement corrective actions. * Propose modifications and technical improvements in the field of E&I to enhance maintainability and reduce maintenance costs. Turnaround & Major Maintenance * Prepare and coordinate turnarounds (TA) and major maintenance activities. * Ensure all activities are executed safely, on time, and within budget. HSE Management * Ensure strict compliance with HSE policies, procedures, and regulations. * Promote a strong safety culture within the maintenance teams. * Ensure proper risk assessment and control measures during maintenance activities. Team Management & Leadership * Lead and manage maintenance supervisors, engineers, technicians, and contractors. * Organize work, allocate resources, and define priorities to meet operational needs. * Support training, coaching, and competency development of maintenance personnel. Coordination & Communication * Ensure effective coordination with Operations, Inspection, HSE, and Support departments. * Review and validate maintenance reports and KPIs (daily, weekly, monthly). * Report maintenance performance, issues, and improvement plans to management. CONTRACT TERMS & MOBILITY ⦁ Local employment contract within an international group entity or freelance contract, depending on profile. ⦁ Preparation phase: fully remote, with missions to Cergy (France) and occasional overseas assignments at contract start. ⦁ Phases 2-3: based in Türkiye on a resident or rotational basis. ⦁ Eligible expatriate assignments include company support for accommodation, travel, local transportation and meals, in accordance with company policies. Key Strengths Strong leadership and team coordination in industrial maintenance environments. Excellent planning, organization, and decision-making skills. Analytical mindset focused on reliability, safety, and continuous improvement. Effective communication and stakeholder management in multicultural environments. Results-oriented, accountable, and safety conscious. Fluent in English; (Turkish language skills are an advantage.) Technical Skills Solid knowledge of maintenance management, asset reliability, and asset integrity. Experience with preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance strategies. Proficient in CMMS and maintenance planning systems. Good knowledge of rotating and static equipment (pumps, compressors, turbines, vessels, piping). Familiar with API, ISO, and industry best practices. Strong understanding of HSE requirements, risk assessment, and RCA methodologies. Capable of coordinating maintenance teams and contractors. Experience Minimum 10 years' experience in petrochemical, refining, or industrial maintenance. Minimum 7 years in senior maintenance or superintendent-level positions. Experience in maintenance optimization, operational readiness, and reliability improvement. PDH/Polypropylene (PP) plant experience preferred. Education Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Maintenance Engineering. Reliability, asset management, or maintenance certifications are advantageous.

title: Thermal & CFD Simulation Engineer
description: Support thermal simulation and cooling analysis for PCB assemblies and electronic systems. In this remote freelance project, you'll build and validate simulation workflows that evaluate temperature distribution, heat dissipation and cooling performance. What you'll do Perform thermal analysis of PCB assemblies, components and enclosures. Build CFD models to evaluate airflow, thermal hotspots and cooling effectiveness. Use OpenFOAM for simulation and Gmsh or equivalent tools for geometry preparation and meshing. Define boundary conditions, material properties, power losses and simulation parameters. Develop Python automation and post-processing workflows. Check mesh independence, convergence and numerical stability, and compare results against analytical calculations or reference data. Document modelling assumptions, limitations and verification evidence. What we're looking for Practical experience in CFD and thermal simulation, supported by strong heat transfer, thermodynamics and fluid mechanics fundamentals. Knowledge of conduction, natural and forced convection, radiation, thermal boundary conditions and heat-source modelling. Experience with OpenFOAM or equivalent CFD tools and familiarity with Gmsh or other mesh-generation tools. Python scripting for automation and simulation post-processing. Ability to assess simulation accuracy and interpret results. Preferred Background A bachelor's or master's degree in Mechanical, Thermal, Aerospace or a related engineering field. 5+ years of relevant CFD, thermal engineering or electronics-cooling experience. Experience with PCB thermal analysis, power electronics, semiconductor cooling or electronic enclosures. Project details The expected engagement is approximately 13 weeks, with potential for extension. Availability for 40 hours per week is required, and the team is looking for someone who can start soon. Selection includes an AI interview and an interview with the delivery team. Compensation $16 USD/hour.

Uydu fırlatma, füze ve savunma sistemleri ile sahip oldukları teknolojiler hakkında bilgi sahibi olmak. Uydu fırlatma ve füze sistemlerinde yer alan elektronik, mekanik ve elektromekanik vs. sistemler hakkında bilgi sahibi olmak. Test konularında bilgi ve tecrübe sahibi olmak. Laboratuvar ve saha ortamında test deneyimine sahip olmak Teknik resim, askeri standartlar, teknik şartnameler ve sistem dokümantasyonlarını okuyup yorumlayabilmek. Sistem seviyesinde bakış açısına sahip olmak. Güçlü iletişim ve koordinasyon sağlama becerilerine sahip olmak. Hata tespit etme ve çözüm üretme yetkinliğine sahip olmak. Teknik raporlama becerisine sahip olmak. Tercihen; En az 3 yıl ve üzeri test, doğrulama ve geçerleme tecrübesi olmak. Savunma, havacılık, füze veya silah sistemi geliştirme projelerinde deneyim sahibi olmak. MIL-STD-461/464 ve MIL-STD-810 standartları ve uygulamaları hakkında bilgi sahibi olmak. Gereksinimleri kapsayacak şekilde fonksiyonel, performans, çevresel, güvenlik ve arayüz test senaryolarını çıkarmak. Sistem gereksinimlerine göre Test ve Değerlendirme Ana Planı (TDAP) hazırlamak. Sistem testlerinde test edilen birim(UUT,SUT,LRU) için tasarlanacak test sistemlerinin/ekipmanlarının (ATE/STE/GSE) gereksinimlerinin belirlenmesi ve mimarisinin oluşturulması sağlamak. Test ortamını ve/veya düzeneğini kurmak/kurulmasını sağlamak. Masaüstü entegrasyon, fonksiyonel doğrulama, arayüz ve performans testlerini gerçekleştirmek ve sistemin girdi-çıktı davranışlarını ve doğrulama kriterlerini izlemek. Çevresel koşul ve elektromanyetik testler için test merkezleri (akredite laboratuvarlar veya kurum içi test alt yapıları) ile koordinasyonun ve testlerin gerçekleştirilmesini sağlamak Testler sırasında elde edilen verileri incelemek, değerlendirmesini yapmak ve raporlamak. Tespit edilen uyumsuzlukları kayıt altına alarak ilgilileriyle hata analizi sürecini koordine etmek ve raporlamak. Test süreçlerinin her aşamasında risk analizi yapmak ve güvenlik önlemlerini almak/aldırmak. Seri üretim döneminde gerçekleştirilecek test, üretim ve entegrasyon faaliyetlerine yönelik elde edilen tecrübelerin aktarımlarını sağlamak. ROKETSAN’ın denizlerin altından uzayın derinliklerine uzanan mühendislik faaliyetlerinde, millî teknoloji hedefleri doğrultusunda yürütülen çalışmalara katkı sunarak bu yolculuğun bir parçası olabilirsiniz. title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description: Take a vascular implant, a pharma test rig and a dispense mechanism from first concept to production release, all in the same year. You'll own the mechanical design on each, across moulding, casting, sheet metal and machining, in a team small enough that the engineering is visibly yours. You'll join an award-winning product design and R&D consultancy working across MedTech, pharma and FMCG. It's ISO 13485 certified with a full quality system, and has grown fast into a purpose-built studio with its own workshop and labs. Mechanical engineers work alongside an in-house electronics and software team, so the whole product is developed under one roof. The role Day to day, you'll take parts, sub-assemblies and full top-level assemblies from concept to production release in SolidWorks. You'll design mechanisms and prove them with hand calculations, use FEA where it helps, produce 2D drawings with GD&T, and work directly with suppliers and toolmakers. Projects run four to six months, and you'll carry one or two at a time. You'll also present your work to clients alongside the senior team and keep design intent intact through to manufacture. The Engineering Lead is building his team, so there's a real gap to step into. It suits someone from a smaller, do-everything business who has seen the whole development cycle and wants more of it. What you'll need Proven experience taking a product, fixture or assembly from first concept through to production release, and understanding every step in between. Strong mechanical design and DFM across more than one of injection moulding, die casting, sheet metal and machining. Advanced SolidWorks, with disciplined feature trees, fully defined sketches and clean sub-assembly structures that reflect how the product is actually built. You'll join an international team of engineering specialists who value collaboration, technical excellence and finding practical solutions to complex challenges. Structural integrity: Assess wind turbine and support-structure loading and independently investigate and resolve complex engineering questions relating to fatigue, structural performance and lifetime extension. Project delivery: Technically lead load-related engineering activities, ensuring technical deliverables meet project requirements, quality standards and deadlines, and act as the Structural Loads technical point of contact for assigned projects. Technical collaboration: Work closely with specialists across Wind Turbine Engineering, Primary Structures, Geotechnical Engineering and Metocean to solve multidisciplinary engineering problems where turbine loads, structural response and environmental conditions interact. Your Profile We're looking for an experienced engineering specialist who can independently investigate and solve complex engineering problems, translating detailed analysis into well-founded engineering conclusions and practical solutions. Strong knowledge of wind turbine aerodynamics, structural dynamics, control systems and load-generation mechanisms. Experience interpreting simulation results, validating engineering models and working with measurement data. Experience working within multidisciplinary engineering environments, ideally within offshore wind, turbine manufacturing or renewable energy development. Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical findings and collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders. Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken. Operational load assessments, turbine power upgrades or lifetime extension projects. Above all, you'll bring curiosity, a careful and structured approach to engineering challenges, and a genuine interest in sharing knowledge and developing solutions together. title: Mekanikkonstruktör till Toyota Material Handling Europe – utveckla framtidens truckar
description: Vill du vara med och forma morgondagens materialhanteringslösningar hos ett världsledande företag? Toyota Material Handling Europe söker nu flera mekanikkonstruktörer till Product Engineering inom R&D. Här får du möjlighet att arbeta nära hela utvecklingsprocessen, från idé och konstruktion till testning i vårt labb och färdig produkt i produktionen, samtidigt som du bidrar till innovativa lösningar som gör våra kunders verksamheter mer effektiva och hållbara. Bli en del av framtidens truckutveckling hos Toyota Material Handling Europe! Som Mekanikkonstruktör kommer du att arbeta med: Utveckla och konstruera nya lösningar för framtidens truckar, från koncept och design till färdig produkt. Testa och verifiera konstruktioner i våra laboratoriemiljöer för att säkerställa funktion, kvalitet och prestanda. Driva produktförbättringar och lösa tekniska utmaningar i nära samarbete med kollegor inom R&D, produktion och inköp. Stötta tillverkning och leverantörer med teknisk expertis för att säkerställa effektiva och robusta lösningar. Samarbeta med kvalitetsorganisationen för att förebygga och utreda kvalitets- och säkerhetsrelaterade frågor. Som mekanikkonstruktör inom Product Engineering blir du en viktig del av utvecklingen av Toyotas marknadsledande truckar. Du arbetar genom hela produktlivscykeln, från idé och konstruktion till testning, industrialisering och löpande produktförbättringar. Rollen erbjuder en unik kombination av teknisk utveckling och praktisk problemlösning där du får möjlighet att se resultatet av ditt arbete i både produktion och färdig produkt. Du blir en del av en internationell och innovativ utvecklingsmiljö där samarbete står i fokus. Tillsammans med kollegor från flera teknikområden driver ni utvecklingen av nästa generations materialhanteringslösningar med höga krav på kvalitet, säkerhet, hållbarhet och prestanda. Tack vare korta utvecklingscykler får du snabbt omsätta idéer till verklighet och göra konkret skillnad för kunder världen över. Hos oss får du möjlighet att utvecklas i en roll med stor variation, bredd och teknisk höjd, samtidigt som du bidrar till att forma framtidens hållbara materialhantering. Din profil Till tjänsten som Mekanikkonstruktör söker vi dig som har/är Civilingenjörs- eller högskoleingenjörsexamen inom mekanik, mekatronik eller motsvarande. Minst 3 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet. Erfarenhet av CAD-program, gärna CATIA V5. Kund- och kravorienterat tänkande med förmåga att omsätta kundkrav till tekniska lösningar. Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift. Vi söker en erfaren mekanikkonstruktör som vill vara med och utveckla framtidens tekniska lösningar. Hos oss får du arbeta i en innovativ miljö där du tar ansvar genom hela utvecklingsprocessen, från idé till färdig produkt. Har du erfarenhet eller intresse av Hydraulik så är detta även meriterande. Rollen passar dig som brinner för problemlösning och gillar att gräva på djupet för att hitta orsaken bakom tekniska utmaningar. Här kombineras kreativ konstruktion med spännande detektivarbete, där nyfikenhet, analysförmåga och teknisk skicklighet är nyckeln till framgång. Tillsammans med ett engagerat team får du möjlighet att påverka, utvecklas och skapa lösningar som gör verklig skillnad. Vilka är Toyota Material Handling Europe? Toyota Material Handling Europe är världsledande inom materialhantering och vi gör stora investeringar för att möta framtidens behov. På vår site i Mjölby arbetar 3000 medarbetare med materialhantering från utvecklingskoncept till producerat fordon. Vår produktrange går från manuella handtruckar till självkörande fordon och innovativa energilösningar. Din framtid på Toyota Material Handling Europe Hos oss blir du en del av en trygg, inkluderande och framåtsträvande arbetsplats där respekt, samarbete och utveckling står i fokus. Vi erbjuder en hållbar vardag med flextid, möjlighet till distansarbete beroende på tjänstens förutsättningar, gym och gruppträning samt friskvårdsbidrag. Som anställd omfattas du av kollektivavtal och får tillgång till förmåner såsom försäkringar, bonus, föräldralön och löneväxling. Välkommen med din ansökan Tycker du att tjänsten verkar intressant? Vi ser fram emot din ansökan senast 2026-11-27 Eftersom vi arbetar med löpande urval rekommenderar vi att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Sökande med skyddad identitet är välkomna att kontakta HR för information om hur ansökan kan hanteras på ett säkert sätt. För att värna om en trygg och säker verksamhet kan bakgrundskontroll komma att genomföras för vissa tjänster. Om du går vidare i processen och en sådan kontroll blir aktuell får du information om detta. title: Design Engineer II/III
description: We're growing! SIGI is the world’s largest manufacturer of ergonomic material handling equipment for vertical lifting and work positioning. Our products are designed to improve worker productivity while reducing the potential for worker injuries. Anywhere where workers are lifting and positioning items, handling pallets, working with parts in containers or transporting loads in a factory or warehouse, SIGI has a product to make the job faster, safer, and easier. As an integral part of the global SIGI network, SIGI Europe AB stands at the forefront of the lifting and vertical positioning industry with our flagship brands, Marco and Hymo. With roots extending back to 1935, our presence across Europe is marked by a commitment to quality, innovation, and a deep understanding of the challenges faced by sectors requiring specialized lifting solutions. If you enjoy working as an engineer who solves technical problems and delivers custom solutions, this role is for you. You’ll work on a variety of short‑term projects, keeping the work fresh and engaging, while collaborating with a talented team in a great environment. This position offers the opportunity to make a real impact within a global organization. We are seeking Lift Equipment Design Engineers II / III Turn engineering specifications into lift equipment that performs. As a Design Engineer, you’ll design new products and improve existing equipment, applying mechanical and hydraulic expertise to solve design challenges, support quality, and improve manufacturability. You’ll work closely with Sales, Purchasing, Manufacturing, and Quality to support sales and on-time shipments. At the Design Engineer III level, you’ll also lead cross-functional projects and mentor other engineers. What You’ll Do Design new lift devices and equipment, and modify existing products, from written specifications using established engineering practices and procedures Establish and maintain mechanical and hydraulic design standards and policies Control product costs through material selection and Design for Manufacturability (DFM) Perform complex design calculations to ensure proper function and safety, and ensure compliance with applicable specifications, codes, and established safety requirements Provide technical expertise to Sales, including direct customer contact as required, and support Quality and Customer Service through problem evaluation, resolution, and site visits as applicable Additional Impact at the Design Engineer III Level Support Manufacturing with assembly-floor issues and timely completion of engineering change requests (ECRs) Partner with Purchasing to address part obsolescence and annual cost-reduction initiatives Inspect and test manufactured machines for product development, analysis, and failure analysis, and develop comprehensive, relevant testing requirements Optimize CAD use to minimize design errors and interferences and control costs Provide consulting support within the design engineering group to make efficient use of the existing design base Lead cross-functional projects of varying sizes, often as technical lead, and regularly participate in process-improvement projects Mentor and coach other engineers on design elements What You’ll Bring Design Engineer II Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical field 2+ years of relevant experience Experience with machine design and stress analysis Thorough knowledge of hydraulic and pneumatic power systems and fabricated steel weldments Knowledge of CAD and SolidWorks preferred Design Engineer III Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or mechanical engineering technology 8+ years of relevant design experience and experience with 3D CADD/modeling; SolidWorks preferred Experience drafting parts and assemblies using industry-standard techniques and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T) Expert-level experience performing calculations in statics, dynamics, strength of materials, and machine design Thorough knowledge of hydraulic and pneumatic power systems and fabricated steel weldments Experience using finite element analysis (FEA) to evaluate design integrity MS Office experience with advanced Excel skills, including VBA and pivot tables, preferred Willingness to travel up to 15% of the time to factories and/or customer Put Your Designs to Work Bring your machine design expertise to lift equipment engineering. Help turn customer specifications into practical designs, solve manufacturing and customer challenges, and contribute to quality products from design through shipment.

title: Maskiningenjör
description: Hägglunds är en del av Bosch Rexroth och har en historia som sträcker sig 60 år bakåt i tiden. I dag är vårt företag en ledande tillverkare av hydrauliska drivsystem och lösningar. Våra kunder finns inom branscher som bland annat återvinning, socker- och materialhantering. Hägglunds har sitt huvudkontor och sin huvudproduktion i Mellansel, strax utanför Örnsköldsvik. Här finns alla funktioner under samma tak, från utveckling och produktion till försäljning och service. Hägglunds har cirka 600 medarbetare runt om i världen, varav cirka 350 arbetar i Mellansel. Vill du arbeta med tekniskt avancerad mekanisk konstruktion där precision och fina toleranser gör verklig skillnad? Och lockas du av möjligheten att arbeta nära den produkt du faktiskt är med och utvecklar? Vi söker nu en maskiningenjör till vår utvecklingsavdelning i Mellansel. Oavsett om du är nyutexaminerad eller har några års arbetslivserfarenhet kanske det här är rollen för dig. Jobbeskrivning Som maskiningenjör blir du en del av ett av våra två team för hydraulmotorer, med ansvar för antingen stora eller små motorer. Tillsammans i teamet arbetar ni med produkten genom hela dess livscykel, från koncept och konstruktion till prototyp, provning, verifiering och industrialisering. Utvecklingen slutar inte när produkten är satt i drift. Våra kunders behov och applikationer driver fortsatt utveckling, produktförbättringar och ibland helt nya tekniska lösningar. Du kommer att arbeta nära den fysiska produkten och vägen från konstruktion till verklighet är kort. Utvecklingsavdelningen ligger vägg i vägg med både produktionen och vårt hydrauliklaboratorium. Det ger dig möjlighet att exempelvis undersöka en komponent tillsammans med operatörer i produktionen eller följa en lösning från konstruktion till provning och verifiering i laboratoriet. Rollen ger dig många kontaktytor och ett nära samarbete med bland annat produktion, inköp, logistik, kvalitet och försäljning. Det ger dig möjlighet att se produkten ur flera perspektiv och förstå hur dina konstruktionslösningar fungerar i praktiken, från utveckling och tillverkning till färdig produkt. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att: medverka i teamets arbete med produktutveckling, produktförbättringar och tekniska analyser utveckla och konstruera mekaniska lösningar ta fram ritningar och teknisk dokumentation i våra CAD- och PDM-system planera och följa upp provning och verifiering av hydraulmotorer bidra med teknisk kompetens i produkt- och produktionsrelaterade frågor. Du arbetar tillsammans med erfarna ingenjörer och specialister inom olika teknikområden, i en miljö med mycket erfarenhet och teknisk kompetens. Här finns goda möjligheter att utbyta kunskap, fördjupa din kompetens och utvecklas vidare inom mekanisk konstruktion. Kvalifikationer Vi söker dig som har: civilingenjörs- eller högskoleingenjörsutbildning inom maskinteknik, eller motsvarande kunskap om konstruktionsmetodik och arbete i CAD-system goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska. Erfarenhet av SolidWorks och PDM-system är meriterande. För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du har ett genuint tekniskt intresse och tycker om att förstå hur saker fungerar och omsätta idéer till praktiska lösningar. Rollen innebär samarbete både inom den egna avdelningen och med andra delar av verksamheten. Därför är det viktigt att du trivs med att samarbeta, utbyta kunskap och tillsammans med andra hitta lösningar på tekniska utmaningar. Ytterligare information Vill du veta mer? Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef Henrik Burström på telefonummer 066087161 eller mejl henrik.burstrom@boschrexroth.se Har du frågor om rekryteringsprocessen är du välkommen att kontakta Ida Renström, HR Business Partner, på 0660-87078 eller mejl ida.renstrom@boschrexroth.se För mer information om Hägglunds produkter och drivsystem, besök hagglunds.com Vill du ansöka tjänsten? Vi välkomnar din ansökan senast 2026-12-13 . Urval och intervjuer sker löpande under ansökningsperioden, vilket innebär att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas före sista ansökningsdag. Vi uppmuntrar dig därför att skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Nyfiken på hur det är att bo och arbeta i Örnsköldsvik? Om du inte känner till området sedan tidigare kan du få en inblick i vad livet i Örnsköldsvik har att erbjuda här. Varför jobba på Bosch Rexroth i Mellansel? På Bosch Rexroth får du möjlighet att utveckla både dig själv och vår verksamhet. Mångfald är en naturlig del av vilka vi är, både globalt och lokalt i Mellansel. Här arbetar människor med olika nationaliteter, kön, åldrar, bakgrunder och erfarenheter tillsammans varje dag. Det ger oss nya perspektiv, stärker samarbetet och bidrar till ständig utveckling. Vi vet att vi inte är det enda företaget med duktiga medarbetare, men vi är stolta över den starka gemenskap som präglar vår arbetsplats. Våra medarbetare lyfter ofta fram den stöttande kulturen, lagandan och den genuina viljan att hjälpa varandra. Vi tycker att det ska vara roligt att gå till jobbet och arbetar för en hållbar arbetsmiljö där du kan trivas under hela arbetsdagen och gå hem med samma energi och välmående som när du kom, och med känslan av att vilja komma tillbaka nästa dag. Hur är det att arbeta hos oss? Allt vi gör drivs av en vilja att utvecklas och ta oss framåt. När vi växer och blir bättre skapar vi värde, både för våra kunder och för oss själva. Vår kultur har utvecklats sedan Hägglunds hjärta började slå i Mellansel och har fortsatt att formas av Bosch Rexroths globala högpresterande kultur. Vi beskriver oss som kundfokuserade, innovativa, modiga, agila och med en vilja att alltid bli bättre. Tillit, respekt och uppskattning är grundläggande för hur vi samarbetar, utvecklas och lyckas tillsammans. Vi stöttar varandra och ger konstruktiv feedback för att hela tiden utvecklas, både som individer och som organisation. Som medarbetare på Bosch Rexroth i Mellansel får du goda möjligheter att utvecklas, ta dig an nya utmaninga

title: Senior Design Engineer
description: ASEPT is growing and we are looking for a Senior Design Engineer to join us in Lund! Do you want to turn innovative ideas into products used by millions of consumers worldwide? Do you thrive on solving complex engineering challenges and developing reliable dispensing solutions from concept to production? Then the role as Senior Design Engineer at ASEPT may be something for you! At ASEPT, we develop innovative dispensing solutions for some of the world's leading foodservice brands, eg, Heinz, Unilever, Orkla, and Nestlé. Our products combine mechanical engineering, smart functionality, and user-focused design to create reliable solutions used across global markets. We are now looking for a Senior Design Engineer to join our Product Development team in Lund and take a leading role in developing new products from concept through production. The Role As a Senior Design Engineer , you will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing mechanical products with a strong focus on injection molded plastic components and metal constructions. You will work closely with colleagues, suppliers, and customers throughout the entire product development process, ensuring high-performance, manufacturable, and cost-effective solutions. The role is full-time and located in Lund, Sweden. You will be a part of the R&D team and report to the R&D Manager. Key Responsibilities · Design and develop mechanical products, with a focus on injection-molded plastic parts and sheet metal components. · Lead engineering activities with from concept development through production launch and serial manufacturing · Optimize designs for injection molding with consideration for functionality, quality, cost, and manufacturability · Perform technical analyses and risk assessments · Develop prototypes and plan and execute both functional and lifetime testing · Collaborate with toolmakers and suppliers regarding tooling design, mold trials, and production start-up · Evaluate sample parts and drive continuous design improvements Required qualifications · Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Product Development, or a related field · Minimum 6-8 years of experience in mechanical design and product development · Extensive experience designing injection molded plastic components · Advanced user in SolidWorks or a comparable 3D CAD system · Strong understanding of injection molding processes, tooling design, and manufacturing limitations · Experience from working in teams involving customers as well as colleagues from other parts of the ASEPT Group · Solid knowledge of plastic materials, their mechanical properties, and long-term performance · Experience with tolerancing, engineering drawings, and technical documentation · Fluent in both Swedish and English, written and spoken Preferred Experience · Design of mechanical pumps, valves, or dosing/dispensing systems · Experience with food-contact materials and products intended for foodservice applications · Knowledge of FDA, EU food contact regulations, and NSF requirements · Experience with FMEA, verification, and validation activities · Experience using SolidWorks PDM Who You Are You are a technically curious engineer with a genuine passion for mechanics, product development, and innovation. You enjoy solving complex engineering challenges and turning ideas into robust products. Your skills: · Analytical, detail-oriented, and solution-focused · Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of your designs · Practical and hands-on, with a willingness to test and validate your ideas · Motivated by working in a smaller development team with short decision-making paths · Skilled at collaborating with colleagues, customers, and suppliers across international markets · Equally enthusiastic about developing new products and continuously improving existing solutions Why ASEPT? At ASEPT, you'll join an entrepreneurial and innovative company were engineering expertise drives product success. You'll have the opportunity to work with global brands, influence product strategy, and contribute directly to the development of industry-leading dispensing solutions. We offer: · Exciting and technically challenging development projects · A collaborative and agile engineering environment · Short decision-making paths and significant individual responsibility · International environment and close collaboration with customers and suppliers · The opportunity to contribute to shaping the future of liquid dispensing solutions Join Us! If you're excited about shaping the future of dispensing solutions together with us, we'd love to hear from you! Please send your CV and Cover Letter to; recruitment@asept.com For further information about the role, please contact Nils Hellzén, R&D Manager; nils.hellzen@asept.com

title: Senior Design Engineer - Mechanical
description: About the Role Who sets the standards, to ensure that anything that can be measured is done so with consistency and reliability? We do. Through our vital research, the National Physical Laboratory is helping support scientific and commercial innovations, international trade, environmental protection and health and wellbeing. As a Senior Design Engineer, you’ll be the one who makes sure our metrology, scientific and research equipment is capable of delivering our ambitions. At NPL, we touch ordinary lives in extraordinary ways and you could too. We’re continually finding new ways in which our work can leave its imprint on the world. Yet to achieve our goals, we need highly technical and innovative engineering design solutions. First, you’ll understand what the aim of the project is. You’ll then review a variety of solutions to ensure your proposal matches the brief perfectly and that it can be delivered to the highest quality, on time and within budget. You’ll also provide analysis to test designs and monitor performance, as well as manage the design review process – communicating issues and keeping us on track. As a senior member of the team, you’ll supervise those with less experience – sharing your knowledge and motivating them to do better. As an expert in your field, not only will you provide everyday design solution advice, you’ll also provide a consultancy service as needed across the department. As such, you’ll be expected to be up-to-date with the latest developments. About You As a Senior Design Engineer, you have a proven track record of developing innovative and highly technical mechanical solutions for complex scientific, research, industrial, or precision engineering applications. You are equally comfortable defining requirements with stakeholders, developing concepts, performing analysis, and delivering fully detailed designs suitable for manufacture and assembly. Your expertise in precision mechanical design, engineering calculations, manufacturing processes, and CAD enables you to solve challenging engineering problems and provide trusted technical leadership across multiple projects. Whether designing bespoke scientific instrumentation, high-precision mechanisms, or complex machinery, you take pride in delivering robust engineering solutions that perform first time and meet demanding customer requirements. You are a confident communicator who can engage effectively with scientists, engineers, technicians, suppliers, and project stakeholders. You enjoy collaborating within multidisciplinary teams, leading technical discussions, and mentoring less experienced engineers to help develop the capability of the wider team. Desired A qualification in Mechanical Engineering (minimum HND or equivalent). Significant experience designing precision mechanical equipment, machinery, scientific instrumentation or automation machinery Strong 3D CAD capability, ideally using SolidWorks. Experience producing engineering drawings to BS8888, including GPS/GD&T principles. A good understanding of engineering analysis and mechanical calculations, with FEA experience advantageous. Knowledge of precision manufacturing processes and design for manufacture principles. Experience working within regulated or quality-managed environments, such as ISO 9001. Excellent communication, stakeholder engagement and problem-solving skills. Experience leading technical activities, design reviews, or mentoring engineers. We actively recruit citizens of all backgrounds, but the nature of our work in specific departments means that nationality, residency and security requirements can be more tightly defined than others. You will be asked about this throughout the recruitment process. To work at NPL, you will need to obtain BPSS security clearance. Please note: Applications will be reviewed, and interviews conducted throughout the duration of this advert therefore we may at any time bring the closing date forward. We encourage all interested applicants to apply as soon as practical. About Us The National Physical Laboratory (NPL) is a world-leading centre of excellence that provides cutting-edge measurement science, engineering and technology to underpin prosperity and quality of life in the UK. We strive to nurture and respect individuals to ensure everyone feels valued by treating everyone on the basis of their own individual merits and abilities regardless of their own or perceived identity, as part of our commitment to diversity & inclusion, we ensure we’re creating an environment where all our colleagues feel supported and welcome. More about this on our Diversity & Inclusion page. We are committed to the health and well-being of our employees. Flexible working and social activities are embedded in our culture to create a positive work-life balance, along with a broad range of rewards, benefits and recognition. Our values are at the heart of what we do, and they shape the way we interact, develop our people and celebrate success. To ensure everyone has an equal chance, we’re always willing to make reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process. If you would like to discuss, please contact us.
