description: Job Description – Structural & Composite Engineer (Offshore Structures) Tree Composites is seeking a Structural & Composite Engineer to work at the interface of offshore steel structures and composite materials. The role covers structural analysis and FEA, the design of steel and steel-to-composite connections, post-processing of experimental results, and certification support, in close collaboration with our design, manufacturing and research engineers. If you have a solid background in structural engineering, a passion for composite materials, and want to help bring new technology to the offshore wind market, this role could be your next career step. About Tree Composites Tree Composites develops composite joints for large steel structures, with a focus on offshore wind foundations. By replacing complex welded connections, our technology can reduce steel use and simplify manufacturing while improving fatigue performance. We design and manufacture composite joints for offshore wind foundations that enable faster manufacturing and lower steel use. We are a start-up, founded in 2020 to bring our disruptive technology from TU Delft research to the market. Your Responsibilities Perform structural analysis and design of offshore steel structures and connections, including FEA at global structure and detail level Design and assess composite and steel-to-composite connections under static and dynamic loading Carry out R&D tasks related to composite materials: testing, calculations, report drafting and post-processing of experimental results Draft certification documentation for our products, addressing both steel and composite aspects and ensuring they meet industry and regulatory standards Collaborate closely with design, manufacturing and research engineers to optimise material behaviour and structural integrity Communicate technical results and contribute to project coordination Contribute to continuous improvement of our engineering methodologies Your Background Master's degree in Civil, Structural, Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering or a related field, preferably with a focus on composites or structural mechanics 2–6 years of experience in structural engineering, with FEA at both global structure and structural detail level Experience with composite materials and/or steel structures; affinity with both is a strong plus Proficiency in software tools such as SACS, Abaqus, CATIA, Siemens NX or similar, as well as Python for scripting tasks Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with high proficiency in English; Dutch is a plus but not required Detail-oriented, while able to manage your time effectively to meet deadlines A valid European Union work permit is required for this role What We Offer A full-time job, on site at our location in Delft, reporting directly to the lead engineer A meaningful, impactful role in a sustainable company working to accelerate the energy transition Collaboration with top-tier research institutions such as TU Delft A fun place to work in an informal, young team that enjoys what they're doing The opportunity to grow within a growing company, with ample scope to specialise and shape your role A market-competitive salary, 28 holiday days and pension contributions How to Apply Please send your CV and cover letter to hr@treecomposites.com. If your experience in composite engineering isn't immediately clear from your CV, kindly elaborate in your cover letter or email. Interested? Even if you don’t fit the profile 100%, we would still love to hear from you.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with electrochemical, materials, and testing teams to ensure mechanical designs seamlessly support chemistry and performance requirements. Technical Documentation: Systematically document design iterations, test observations, engineering changes, and key learning outcomes. CAD Proficiency: Strong foundational proficiency in 3D CAD modeling software (such as SolidWorks, Inventor, or similar) and a clear understanding of technical drawing standards. Hands-on Mindset: A proactive, physical problem-solver who genuinely enjoys working with tools, building experimental setups, and handling hardware in a workshop or lab. Analytical Curiosity: Strong analytical and detail-oriented mindset with a fast learning curve and a deep curiosity for battery technology and energy storage systems. Navigating Ambiguity: Comfortable working in an iterative design environment with evolving technical requirements and challenges. Collaboration & Communication: Highly collaborative, open to feedback, and possessing excellent communication skills in English to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams. title: Structural and mechanical engineer
description: Sorontar is a team of engineers and scientists working to rearm France and its allies. Backed by world-class defense investors and angels, we are building a universal weapon architecture where software, design and manufacturing come together to produce more, faster and at lower cost. A product like this calls for a different kind of company. In most large organizations, layers of management stand between people and their work: ownership fades, knowledge travels slowly and energy goes into coordination. We chose the opposite. We keep Sorontar flat and give that energy back to the work, which is why we look for people who need no management once the direction is set. If a lean team driven by its mission is where you do your best work, you will feel at home here. What You'll Get To Do At Sorontar, you will design the structures and mechanical parts of our weapon systems. In the beginning, the role covers both CAD and structural analysis. As the company grows, these activities may be split into specialized teams that you will help build. You will take parts from a blank sheet to production, follow them through manufacturing and acceptance, and keep improving them. When needed, you will work with external firms and manage subcontractors. Your profile You are comfortable with both CAD and structural analysis. Ideally, you have already carried a part through the full cycle, from the first design to production, acceptance and improvement. You have worked with external analysis firms and know how to manage subcontractors. You work in French and English. What Will Set You Apart Experience in aerospace or with lightweight structures will set you apart. Experience in defense counts too. We give priority to candidates with at least a first professional experience, and for candidates early in their career, we look closely at degrees and training. People who thrive at Sorontar also share four traits: You are an owner. You treat problems as your own and carry them through to the result without waiting to be asked The mission stays with you. You keep thinking about the problem, because solving it matters to you You are measured by what you deliver. The result counts more to you than how busy you look You decide with facts. Evidence weighs more for you than opinions, including your own What's critical to us We are looking for brilliant, fearless and good people, and we deeply believe that people do not fit into boxes. Yet while a person is a continuum of qualities, a hiring decision is a yes or a no. To make the best decision possible, we assess every candidate on six criteria, grouped in pairs in the matrices below. Make sure you see the graphs on our career page: here. Brilliant. Talent without responsibility leaves potential unused, and responsibility without talent reaches its limits quickly. We look for people who combine the ability to solve hard problems with the drive to see them through. Fearless. Courage without judgment leads to reckless decisions, and judgment without courage turns into commentary. We look for people who see clearly and act on what they see. Good. Integrity without warmth makes a team hard to work in, and warmth without integrity is charm that does not last. We look for people others can rely on and enjoy working with. Our commitment to you The best companies are the ones where you work alongside the best colleagues. Our first commitment is to surround you with people you learn from every day, which is why we hire with great care. Highly competitive salary. We offer €70,000 to €90,000 gross per year, positioned according to your experience. From there, your compensation follows a clear trajectory that rewards the scope and impact of your missions Equity. Your salary rewards your time, and your equity gives you a share of what your work creates Full ownership of your scope. You choose how to reach the results you are responsible for, and what counts is the outcome Leverage. We give you software, automation and the right tools so that your impact grows faster than your workload Judgment over seniority. Your influence grows with the quality of your decisions, not with your title or your age The essentials. Days off, full life insurance, lunch covered, and more Important information Remote policy: Our work relies on close collaboration and on our ability to adapt quickly, so we have a no-remote work policy Contract: We only offer full-time permanent contracts (CDI) Security and access: Work at Sorontar falls into three categories. Research takes place in restricted-access zones (ZRR) and requires an access authorization. Applied technology builds on known and publicly available technologies and carries no specific access restriction. Programs deliver systems to defense customers and may require a national security clearance We review applications daily and contact selected candidates within two weeks. No reply after that means this role is not the right match today. New roles open often, and we look forward to seeing you apply again

title: Mechanical Maintenance Engineer
description: 1. Position Summary The Mechanical Maintenance Engineer is responsible for developing, planning, technically managing, and supervising the field teams maintenance strategy for the Gas turbine, Steam turbine, Generator, HRSG, Auxiliary systems and all rotating/static mechanical equipment at the Kırıkkale Natural Gas Combined Cycle Power Plant (927 MWNet), a facility classified as critical energy infrastructure. The role covers the execution of planned/unplanned maintenance activities, overhaul and outage organizations, root cause analyses, and reliability engineering work in accordance with OEM standards and company procedures; technical guidance of Mechanical Maintenance Technicians; and coordination with OEM/third-party companies. 2. Key Duties and Responsibilities Preparing and managing the maintenance strategy, periodic maintenance plan, and work schedules for the Gas turbine, Steam turbine, Generator, HRSG, Pumps, Compressors and Auxiliary mechanical equipment. Planning the scope, duration, resources, and budget for planned outages and overhaul organizations; ensuring technical coordination with OEM and subcontractor companies. Conducting root cause analysis (RCA/RCFA) for complex mechanical failures and developing permanent solutions and improvement recommendations. Evaluating predictive maintenance data (vibration analysis, thermography, oil analysis) and developing equipment reliability programs. Planning the work of Mechanical Maintenance Technicians, providing technical guidance, and supervising field work. Managing maintenance plans, work orders, and equipment records in the SAP PM system; monitoring and reporting maintenance KPIs. Determining critical spare parts strategy, optimizing spare parts inventory, and providing technical support to procurement processes. Conducting equipment obsolescence assessments and providing technical input to renewal/modernization projects. Contributing to the preparation of the maintenance budget and monitoring expenditure compliance with the budget. Preparing job safety risk assessments (JSA/OHS analyses), supervising the implementation of LOTO procedures, and leading the development of an on-site OHS culture. Managing OEM technical bulletins, service requests, and warranty processes. Taking mechanical discipline responsibility during start-up/commissioning and performance tests. Preparing and updating maintenance procedures and work instructions, and training field teams. Ensuring technical coordination with other disciplines (Electrical, Instrumentation/Control, Operations). Openness to working with multinational teams and being a team player. Strong motivation and leadership skills. Systematic approach to problems and effective problem-solving ability. Providing technical leadership during emergency response processes under the shift/on-call system, as required. 3. Minimum Education Requirements Bachelor's degree (4-year) in Mechanical Engineering or an equivalent field from a university. A master's degree (in Energy, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field) is preferred. 4. Minimum Experience At least 5 (five) years of professional experience in Mechanical maintenance at Power plants (preferably Natural Gas Combined Cycle); at least 2 (two) years of which in a supervisory/responsible position is preferred. Active involvement in Gas turbine, Steam turbine and HRSG maintenance, as well as planned outage organizations. Practical experience in root cause analysis (RCA), Reliability Engineering (RCM), and Predictive maintenance methodologies. Experience in managing/technically guiding maintenance teams. Experience in maintenance planning and management in SAP PM systems. Experience in Project/maintenance coordination with OEM and subcontractor companies is preferred. 5. Mandatory Certificates, Documents, and Legal Obligations (Turkish Legislation) OHS Basic Training Certificate appropriate for Very Hazardous Class workplaces under Occupational Health and Safety Law No. 6331 (to be completed upon hire if not already held). Command of the periodic inspection and audit processes under the Regulation on Health and Safety Conditions for the Use of Work Equipment. Fitness confirmed by pre-employment and periodic medical examinations. No impediment in criminal record, due to the role's involvement in critical energy infrastructure. For male candidates, completed or deferred military service status. Valid Class B driver's license is preferred. Holding certification in project/maintenance management (PMP, Reliability Engineering, Vibration Analysis Cat. I/II, etc.) is preferred. 6. Technical Competencies Advanced technical knowledge of gas turbine, steam turbine, generator, and HRSG mechanical systems. In-depth knowledge of rotating equipment engineering: alignment, balancing, vibration analysis, and dynamic equipment fault diagnosis. General knowledge of predictive and preventive maintenance (PdM/PM) strategies, Reliability Engineering (RCM), and root cause analysis (RCA/RCFA) methodologies. Competency in technical drawings, P&ID, strength of materials, and materials knowledge. Effective use of SAP PM and maintenance KPI reporting tools. Knowledge of Maintenance budgeting, Resource planning and cost analysis. Team management, Technical leadership and OEM/subcontractor coordination skills. Effective use of MS Office applications and technical analysis software. Ensuring compliance with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 27001, and ISO 50001 requirements within the scope of the role. 7. Language Skills English: Intermediate-advanced level, written and verbal communication (required for technical correspondence and reporting with OEM’s and international stakeholders). A second foreign language is an advantage. 8. Working Conditions The role is primarily within regular daytime working hours; adaptation to call/on-call response, when required, is expected during critical failures or planned outage periods. May require access to the turbine building, HRS

description: Sektör: Petrol, Doğal Gaz ve Enerji Ekipmanları Ağır Sanayi İmalatı Genel Nitelikler * Üniversitelerin Makine, Metalurji ve Malzeme veya İmalat Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezun, * Petrol ve doğal gaz sektörü için basınçlı kap, proses tankı ve borulu eşanjör imalatı kalite kontrol süreçlerinde en az 3 yıl deneyime sahip, * Uluslararası Kaynak Mühendisliği (IWE) veya Avrupa Kaynak Mühendisliği (EWE) diplomasına sahip (tercih önceliğidir), * Uluslararası projelerin teknik dokümantasyon takibi süreçlerinde aktif kullanmak üzere; * İyi derecede İngilizce bilgisine sahip, * Tercihen teknik literatüre ve sektörel terimlere hakim şekilde Rusça bilen, * ASME Section VIII Div. 1 & 2, ASME IX, ASME V, API 650, API 660 kodlarına ve CE / PED (2014/68/EU) basınçlı ekipmanlar direktifine ileri düzeyde hakim, * Kaynaklı imalat metalurjisi, kaynak yöntem şartnameleri (WPS, PQR, WPQR) hazırlama, takip ve onay süreçlerini başarıyla yönetmiş, * Talaşlı imalat süreçlerine, geometrik ölçülendirme ve toleranslandırmaya (GD&T), kumpas, mikrometre gibi hassas ölçüm aletlerinin kullanımına ve teknik resim okumaya çok iyi derecede hakim, * Üçüncü Taraf Gözetim (TPI - Lloyd's Register, Bureau Veritas, TÜV, DNV vb.) ve müşteri denetim süreçlerini bağımsız yürütebilecek, * İmalat sonu Kalite Takip Dosyası (Final Databook / As-Built Dossier) hazırlama konusunda tecrübeli, * İzmir’de ikamet eden veya edebilecek olan adaylar. İş Tanımı * Giriş kalite kontrolden başlayarak; talaşlı imalat, montaj, kaynak, NDT, hidrostatik test, boya ve sevkiyat dahil tüm süreçleri Kalite Planına (ITP) göre kontrol etmek, * Kaynak mühendisliği yetkinliği ile imalat sahasındaki kaynak parametrelerini, kaynakçı performanslarını ve sarf malzemelerini standartlara uygun olarak denetlemek, * Proses Tankları, basınçlı kaplar, borulu eşanjörleri oluşturan tüm parçaların işleme süreçlerinin boyut kontrol formlarına ve mekanik toleranslara uygunluğunu doğrulamak, * İmalat esnasında oluşan uygunsuzlukları (NCR) tespit etmek, kök neden analizlerini yaparak düzeltici ve önleyici faaliyetleri (CAPA) başlatmak, * İmalat sonu Kalite Takip Dosyası’nı hazırlamak, projelerin nihai Kalite Dosyası’nı eksiksiz tamamlayarak müşteriye teslim etmek. * TPI ve müşteri sörveyleri ile koordinasyonu sağlayarak ara ve final teslimat kontrollerini eksiksiz tamamlamak.

title: Sensör Tasarım Mühendisi
description: TEI Teknoloji A.Ş. (TEITECH) olarak havacılık motorları ve güç sistemleri alanında özgün teknolojiler geliştirirken; ileri mühendislik, malzeme teknolojileri ve araştırma ve geliştirme yetkinliklerimizi ortak bir hedef doğrultusunda ileri taşıyoruz. TF35000 ve TS3000 motor programlarından yardımcı güç ünitelerine, malzeme teknolojilerinden araştırma ve geliştirme çalışmalarına uzanan geniş yetkinlik alanlarımızla, Türkiye'nin özgün havacılık motoru geliştirme kapasitesine yeni bir ivme kazandırıyoruz. Güçlü araştırma ve geliştirme altyapımız ve nitelikli insan kaynağımızla birlikte özgün motor teknolojileri geliştirme yolculuğumuzda, yetkinliklerini geliştirmek ve ekibimize değer katmak isteyen yetenekleri arıyoruz. Eğer sen de İstanbul veya Eskişehir yerleşkemizde Sensör Tasarım Mühendisi olarak değer katmak istersen; Sahip Olduğun Değerler: Üniversitelerin Elektrik, Elektronik, Elektrik-Elektronik, Elektronik ve Haberleşme, Mekatronik, Kontrol ve Haberleşme, Makina Mühendisliği bölümlerinin birinden mezunsan, En az 5 yıl savunma, havacılık veya otomotiv sektörlerinde ilgili mühendislik alanında iş deneyimine sahipsen, Sensör teknolojileri konusunda bilgi ve tecrübeye sahipsen, Elektromanyetik tasarım ve analiz programlarından (Ansys Maxwell/EMC plus, Simcenter Feko/Flux vb.) birini kullanabiliyorsan, Sistem mühendisliği tasarım, süreç ve yöntemleri hakkında bilgi ve tecrübeye sahipsen, Gereksinim yönetimi konusunda deneyimliysen, Çevresel testler (MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-810 ve DO160 standartları) hakkında bilgi ve tecrübeye sahipsen, Ürün yaşam döngüsü (PLM), tasarım yayın süreçleri, değişiklik yönetimi, gereksinim yönetimi araçları (SVN, DOORS, JIRA, TEAMCENTER gibi) hakkında bilgi ve tecrübeye sahipsen, SAE ARP4761/A uyarınca emniyet değerlendirme süreçleri ve emniyet analiz yöntemleri (FHA, FMEA/FMECA/DFMEA vb.) hakkında bilgi ve tecrübeye sahipsen, Müşteri ve alt yüklenici teknik yönetimi konusunda deneyimliysen, Gereksinim tabanlı tasarım geliştirme ve doğrulama yaklaşımına hakimsen, Minimum düzeyde teknik yönlendirme ile beklenen çıktıları üretebiliyorsan, İyi derecede yazılı ve sözlü İngilizce biliyorsan, Yeni fikirler geliştirme motivasyonuna sahipsen, Kalite odaklı sonuç ortaya koymaya özen gösteriyorsan, İş birliği içinde çalışmayı önemsiyorsan, Değişen koşullara hızlı uyum sağlayabiliyorsan, Yüksek sorumluluk bilincine sahipsen, Seyahat engelin bulunmuyorsa. Öne Çıkan Değerler : Havacılık veya savunma sanayii sektöründe benzer pozisyonda en az 5 yıl deneyimliysen, Sensör teknolojileri konusunda bilgi ve tecrübeye sahipsen, RTCA/DO160G ve MIL-STD-461/810 ekipman testleri konusunda deneyimliysen, PLM ve gereksinim yönetimi araçları (Teamcenter, DOORS, Polarion vb.) kullanma konusunda deneyimliysen. Değer Katacağın Alanlar: Aviyonik, donanım, kontrol, mekanik, performans, emniyet-güvenilirlik ve ilgili modül tasarımcıları ile koordine bir çalışma gerçekleştirerek özel tasarım sensörlerin teknik şartnamelerinin hazırlanması ve alt yüklenici teknik yönetiminin sağlanması, Üst seviye isterler doğrultusunda alt seviye sensör gereksinimlerinin türetilmesi ve yönetilmesi, Hazırlanan RFI, RFQ, TS dokümanların gözden geçirme sürecinin işletilmesi, Rafta hazır ürün olarak tedarik edilen sensörlerin araştırılması, seçimi ve tedarik sürecinin ilgili ekiplerle takip edilmesi, Yerli ve yabancı sensör tasarım&imalat&tedarik birimleriyle teknik toplantıların gerçekleştirilmesi, Sensörlerin laboratuvar ortamında test edilmesi için laboratuvar test altyapı kurulum çalışmalarına katkı sağlanması ve test faaliyetlerinin gerçekleştirilmesi, Sensörlerin motora entegrasyonu sürecine destek verilmesi, Sensörlerin motor üzerinde yapılan test sonuçlarının incelenmesi ve raporlanması, Motorda yaşanan sensör hatalarında/arızalarında hata analizi gerçekleştirilmesi ve düzeltici aksiyon alınması, FRACAS süreçlerinin sahipliği, Tasarım gözden geçirme süreçlerine dahil olunması ve bu süreçler için gerekli sunumların hazırlanması/sunulması, Tasarım değişiklik süreçlerinin işletilmesi, Alt yüklenici tarafından gerçekleştirilecek tasarım, analiz ve test faaliyetlerinin teknik girdilerinin sağlanması, tasarım/test faaliyetlerinin yorumlanması ve gerekli teknik değerlendirmelerin yapılması, Satış sonrası idamesi için ilgili dokümanlara (installation manual, user manual, operation manual, fault isolation manual, maintenance manual vb.) teknik girdilerin sağlanması, CVE & otorite ile teknik çerçevede görüşmelerin icra edilmesi, sertifikasyon kanıtlarının hazırlanması/sunulması. TEITECH’te Seni Neler Bekliyor? Savunma sanayii projelerinde kariyer fırsatı, Ülkemiz için kritik öneme sahip projelerde yer alma ayrıcalığı, Esnek çalışma saatleri ile haftanı planlama özgürlüğü, Performans prim ödemesi, Evlenme, doğum ve kreş yardımları, Kapsamlı özel sağlık sigortası, Ebeveyn olan çalışanlarımız için psikolojik danışmanlık ve rehberlik desteği, Anlaşmalı olduğumuz firmalardan avantajlı indirim fırsatları, Şirket içi sosyal kulüplerde hobi ve network kazanma fırsatı, Samimi bir çalışma ortamı, şirket içi etkinlikler ve yüksek motivasyon, Öğrenme ve gelişim imkânlarımızdan faydalanabilme.

title: Manufacturing Excellence Lead
description: Job description: For nearly 40 years, Lipton has been contributing to the future of Turkish tea through its commitment to Turkish tea, tea producers, and tea lovers. Its initiatives cover a wide range of areas, including nature conservation programs in the Eastern Black Sea region, social, economic, and health-focused projects supporting tea producers, as well as investments in its production facility and employment opportunities in Sakarya. Until July 1, 2021, Lipton was part of Unilever, both in Türkiye and globally. As of this date, the brand became part of a Luxembourg-based independent investment advisory firm. Today, Lipton continues its journey as one of the leading names in the tea industry, embracing all the regions where tea is grown, produced, and enjoyed as its home. With a culture that values tea-loving communities equally across more than 100 countries, Lipton believes in the power of tea to bring people together and strengthen connections. Guided by its respect for our planet and all forms of life, Lipton continues its initiatives focused on the tea plant, tea producers, and tea lovers. We are looking for a teammate to join our Production Manager organization at our Lipton Tea Packaging Factory in Arifiye, Sakarya , in the position of Production Excellence Lead . KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Analyze manufacturing processes to identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, capacity, and cost performance, and lead improvement projects. Drive the implementation and adoption of continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, 5S, SMED, and Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) across production processes. Monitor and analyze production key performance indicators (KPIs) and develop corrective actions to address deviations from performance targets. Lead initiatives to improve Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), production efficiency, scrap rates, unplanned downtime, and labor productivity. Analyze production losses, conduct root cause analyses, and develop sustainable solutions. Conduct work studies, time studies, line balancing, and capacity analyses to ensure effective utilization of manufacturing resources. Optimize production flows, workforce allocation, and operational processes. Analyze manufacturing costs and develop projects to reduce losses related to labor, energy, raw materials, and consumables. Collaborate with Production, Quality, Maintenance, Planning, Logistics, and Engineering teams to improve operational processes. Actively contribute to new product introductions, process development, and capacity expansion projects. Develop, improve, and monitor the sustainability of standardized work procedures in manufacturing processes. Maintain an active presence on the shop floor to help resolve operational issues, guide teams through improvement initiatives, and increase employee engagement. Support the enhancement of quality and occupational health and safety standards in manufacturing operations. Regularly report on efficiency, quality, and operational performance results and recommend areas for improvement. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor’s degree in Industrial, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Experience in manufacturing, process development, continuous improvement, or operational excellence is preferred. Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, 5S, OEE, SMED, and TPM methodologies; hands-on implementation experience is an advantage. Knowledge of manufacturing KPIs, capacity analysis, productivity, and cost management. Proficiency in problem-solving tools and techniques, including root cause analysis, 8D, 5 Whys, and Ishikawa diagrams. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel; experience with Power BI and ERP/MRP systems is preferred. Strong ability to analyze manufacturing processes and make data-driven decisions. Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and results-oriented skills. Excellent planning, organization, and coordination skills. Effective communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate across functions. Proactive, accountable, and solution-oriented approach. Willingness to work actively on the production floor. Strong leadership potential and ability to align and guide teams toward common goals. Commitment to continuous learning, development, and change. Good command of English is an advantage.

title: Aluminum Forging Production Executive
description: About the Job We are looking for an experienced Aluminum Forging Production Executive to join our manufacturing facility in Ergene, Tekirdağ , reporting to the Aluminum Forging Business Unit Manager . The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing aluminum forging operations, leading blue-collar and white-collar teams, and driving operational excellence through continuous improvement initiatives. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering or Mechanical Engineering. Minimum 8 years of manufacturing experience, including at least 4–5 years specifically in aluminum forging production. Strong technical knowledge and hands-on experience in aluminum hot forging technologies, hydraulic and mechanical forging presses, induction heating systems, and aluminum alloys. Knowledge of heat treatment processes (solution heat treatment, quenching, artificial aging, and T6) and surface treatment applications. Experience in forging die design, die manufacturing processes, and die life optimization. Experience with forging simulation software. Knowledge of IATF 16949, ISO 9001, and AS9100 quality management systems. Practical knowledge and experience in PFMEA, APQP, PPAP, Control Plans, 8D, Root Cause Analysis, and Statistical Process Control (SPC). Experience in production planning, capacity management, process optimization, and production cost management. Proven experience in improving Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), reducing scrap and production losses, and optimizing cycle times. Strong knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, and Total Productive Maintenance (TPM). Proven experience in leading and managing blue-collar and white-collar teams. Proficiency in ERP systems, preferably SAP. Good command of written and spoken English. Willingness to travel when required. Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, decision-making, and leadership skills with a results-oriented mindset. Residing in or willing to relocate to Çorlu, Çerkezköy, Ergene, Tekirdağ City Center, or Lüleburgaz. Key Responsibilities Manage aluminum hot forging, trimming press, induction and furnace heating, heat treatment, and surface treatment operations in line with company objectives. Ensure production plans are executed in accordance with quality, delivery, capacity, and cost targets. Monitor production efficiency, machinery performance, and capacity utilization, and lead initiatives to improve operational performance. Define, standardize, and continuously improve forging process parameters to ensure consistent product quality and production efficiency. Oversee forging die design, manufacturing, commissioning, maintenance, and die life optimization activities. Ensure aluminum hot forging operations comply with technical specifications, customer requirements, and quality standards. Lead root cause analysis and corrective action processes to resolve production and quality issues and prevent recurrence. Conduct manufacturability, capacity, cost, and process feasibility studies for new products and projects, and manage the transition to serial production. Ensure compliance with quality management system requirements and lead customer and process audits within production operations. Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on reducing production costs, scrap, waste, and operational losses. Lead, develop, and manage the performance of blue-collar and white-collar teams, ensuring effective workforce utilization and employee development. Ensure compliance with occupational health and safety (OHS) regulations and promote a strong safety culture across production operations. Collaborate closely with Maintenance, Quality, Planning, Engineering, and other relevant departments to ensure efficient and uninterrupted production operations. About Us Founded in 1994, Sistem Alüminyum is a leading aluminium manufacturer in Türkiye, recognized for its strong manufacturing infrastructure, engineering expertise, and innovative approach. The company operates from its fully integrated manufacturing campus in Ergene, Tekirdağ, complemented by its headquarters in Istanbul. Spanning a total area of 330,000 m², our production campus brings together extensive capabilities across Industrial Extrusion Solutions, Forging Solutions, Architectural Systems, and Aluminium Composite Panel Solutions. With an annual aluminium profile production capacity of 103,000 metric tons, Sistem Alüminyum delivers solutions to a wide range of strategic industries. Today, the company exports to more than 75 countries across the globe. With a team of over 1,200 professionals, we continue to grow our global success story through development, innovation, and shared value. Our strong manufacturing infrastructure and commitment to sustainable growth have earned national recognition. In 2025, Sistem Alüminyum advanced 40 positions to rank 273rd in the ISO 500 – Türkiye’s Top 500 Industrial Enterprises survey and climbed 35 positions to 231st in the Türkiye’s Top 1000 Exporters ranking published by the Turkish Exporters Assembly (TIM). The company has also secured six first-place awards in the Aluminium Rods and Profiles category at the Metallic Stars of Export Awards , organized by İDDMİB.

title: Global Altyapı ve Saha Hazırlama Yönetmeni, Boru Hattı ve Proses
description: 1948 yılında temelleri atılan Karadeniz Holding, enerji ve gemi inşa başta olmak üzere geniş bir sektör yelpazesinde inovasyonu ön planda tutarak büyümeyi ekonomik ve çevresel sürdürülebilirlik açısından destekleyen, vizyoner sektör lideridir. 30 farklı milletten 3.000’den fazla çalışanı ile 20’den fazla ülkede faaliyet gösteren, 8.000 MW’tan fazla kurulu güce sahip Grup, 45 Powership™ ve 11 LNG gemisinden oluşan filosuyla 4 kıtada güvenilir ve temiz elektrik üretirken dünya genelinde 10 bini aşkın kişiye istihdam alanı sağlamaktadır. Powership™ filosunu, uluslararası markası Karpowership altında yöneten Karadeniz Holding; Avrupa, Afrika, Amerika ve Asya kıtalarında faaliyet gösterdiği ülkelerin %10- %100 oranındaki elektrik ihtiyacını karşılamaktadır. Powership™, kara elektrik santralleri ve aynı zamanda yüzen LNG altyapısının dahil olduğu yüksek kapasiteli enerji çözümleriyle, Karpowership ülkelere ve şirketlere enerji geçişi süreçlerinde yardımcı olmaktadır. “ Global Altyapı ve Saha Hazırlama, Boru Hattı ve Proses ” departmanımızda görevlendirilmek üzere “ Global Altyapı ve Saha Hazırlama Yönetmeni, Boru Hattı ve Proses ” arayışımız bulunmaktadır. NE BEKLİYORUZ? Makine veya Petrol Mühendislikleri bölümlerinden mezun, Boru Hattı ve Proses süreçlerinde minimum 10 yıl tecrübesi bulunan, Ölçüm ve Basınç Düşürme İstasyonları (Metering & Pressure Reduction Stations) konusunda deneyimi bulunan, Uluslararası EPC (Mühendislik, Tedarik ve İnşaat) projelerinde tecrübesi bulunan, AutoCad ve MS Office uygulamalarına ileri düzeyde hâkim, Sözlü ve yazılı iyi derecede İngilizce bilen, Yurt dışı seyahat engeli bulunmayan, saha çalışmasına yatkın, Ekip çalışmasına uyumlu, iletişim ve koordinasyon becerileri güçlü. SENİ NELER BEKLİYOR? İnşaat ve montaj faaliyetlerinin kalitesinin proje teknik şartnamelerine ve uluslararası standartlara (ASME, API, ISO, DNV, GMPHOM vb.) uygun olmasını sağlamak, Tesis ve ilişkili sistemlerle ilgili altyapı çözümleri geliştirmek, Boru hattı sistemleri için optimum güzergâhı, boru çapını, malzeme teknik özelliklerini ve işletme basıncını belirlemek. Proje geliştirme süreçlerinde teknik çalışmalar, yatırım maliyeti (CAPEX) tahminleri ve altyapı konseptleri hazırlayarak ticari ekiplere destek sağlamak. Yeni ülkelerde gerçekleştirilecek projeler için teknik durum tespiti (Technical Due Diligence) raporları hazırlamak ve boru hattı altyapısının uygulanabilirliğini değerlendirmek. Deniz üstü (offshore) ve kara (onshore) boru hattı ve proses sistemlerinin montaj faaliyetlerini, mobilizasyon aşamasından mekanik tamamlanma ve devreye alma süreçlerine kadar yönetmek. Kaynak faaliyetlerini, onaylı Kaynak Prosedürü Şartnameleri (WPS), Kaynak Prosedürü Yeterlilik Kayıtları (PQR) ve kaynakçı yeterlilik belgelerine uygun şekilde yönetmek. Tahribatsız muayene (NDT) faaliyetlerini (RT – Radyografik Test, UT – Ultrasonik Test, MT – Manyetik Parçacık Testi, PT – Sıvı Penetrant Testi) yönetmek ve sonuçların kabul kriterlerine uygunluğunu sağlamak, Hidrostatik ve pnömatik basınç testi faaliyetlerini denetlemek. Boru hattı bütünlüğünü, temizliğini, yıkama (flushing), üfleme (blowing), kurutma (drying) işlemlerini ve ön devreye alma (pre-commissioning) hazırlıklarının tamamlanmasını sağlamak. Deniz üstü kaldırma operasyonlarının (offshore lifting), yük bağlama ve kaldırma ekipmanı hazırlıklarının (rigging) ve su altı çalışmalarının (subsea works) güvenli şekilde yürütülmesini sağlamak. NE SUNUYORUZ? Doğum gününde 1 gün izin hakkı, Kapsamlı Özel Sağlık Sigortası, Mesleki ve kişisel eğitim & gelişim fırsatları, Çalışanlara özel indirim ve kampanyalar Çalışma arkadaşlarımız, adaylarımız ve tüm paydaşlarımızla “Tek Dünya” felsefemiz doğrultusunda başarılarımıza başarı katıyoruz. İlanlarımıza başvuru yapan tüm adaylarımıza ırk, din, dil, cinsiyet gözetmeksizin fırsat eşitliği sağlamayı ilke edinerek; farklılıklarımızla başarılarımızı taçlandırıyoruz.

title: Üretim Sorumlusu
company: POREM Porselen Elektrik Malzemeleri / POREM Porcelain Electrical Materials
description: Ekibimize Katılacak Üretim Sorumlusu (Mühendis) Arıyoruz! Grup şirketlerimizden POREM Porselen Elektrik San. Tic. Monitor updates to relevant standards, regulations, and other external technical documentation. Ability and willingness to work at heights and in challenging field conditions. Willingness to travel frequently and take assignments in domestic and international projects. Genel Nitelikler · Meslek Liseleri veya Meslek Yüksekokullarının Makine, Torna-Tesviye, Mekatronik, Hidrolik-Pnömatik veya ilgili bölümlerinden mezun (ya da ilgili MYK/Ustalık Belgesine sahip), · Makine imalatı ve mekanik montaj alanında en az 2 yıl deneyimli, · Teknik resim ve montaj şemalarını okuyabilen , ölçülere ve toleranslara uygun montaj yapabilen, · Mekanik el aletleri, tork anahtarları ve kumpas/mikrometre gibi temel ölçüm aletlerini hassas şekilde kullanabilen, · Hidrolik devre şemalarını takip edebilen , hidrolik boru/hortum çekme, rakorlama ve blok montajı tecrübesi olan, · Tercihen temel düzeyde kaynak (elektrot, gazaltı veya TIG), taşlama ve delme tezgâhı işlerine hâkim, · İş sağlığı ve güvenliği kurallarına titizlikle uyan, · Takım çalışmasına yatkın, sorumluluk sahibi ve pratik çözümler üretebilen, · Gebze veya İstanbul Anadolu Yakası 'nda ikamet eden / edebilecek olan, · Erkek adaylar için askerlik hizmetini tamamlamış veya muaf. İş Tanımı · Tasarımı tamamlanan hidrolik, mekanik ve test sistemlerinin teknik resimlere uygun olarak şasi, mekanizma ve bileşen montajını gerçekleştirmek, · Hidrolik güç ünitelerinin montajını yapmak; boru bükme, hortum çekme, filtre, valf ve pompa gibi hidrolik ekipmanların tesisat bağlantılarını kurmak, · Montaj sırasında gereken tesviye, delme, diş açma ve alıştırma işlemlerini yapmak, · Üretim/tasarım mühendisleri ile koordineli çalışarak montaj sırasında görülen revizyon ihtiyaçlarını iletmek, · İmalatı tamamlanan sistemlerin mekanik ve hidrolik test (sızdırmazlık, basınç vb.) aşamalarına destek vermek, · Çalışma alanının, el aletlerinin ve montaj ekipmanlarının tertip ve düzenini sağlamak. Adaylara Sunulan Olanaklar · Servis imkânı (Gebze ve İstanbul Anadolu Yakası ana güzergâhlar), · Yemekhane, · Fazla mesai durumunda mesai ücreti / yan haklar, · Kurumsal ve uzun vadeli çalışma ortamı.

title: SYSTRA MÜHENDİSLİK ANONİM ŞİRKETİ – Tunnelling & Geotechnical

title: Senior PCB Design & Hardware Simulation Engineer
description: About Gramian Gramian Consultancy is a boutique consultancy specializing in IT professional services and engineering talent solutions. With a strong background in software engineering and leadership, we help companies build high-performing teams by matching them with professionals who truly fit their needs. About The Role We are seeking an experienced Hardware Design Engineer with a strong background in electronic circuit design, multilayer PCB development, and simulation-led hardware optimization. In this role, you will use KiCad to analyze, redesign, simulate, and validate electronic hardware, with a focus on Signal Integrity (SI), Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC), and/or thermal performance. You will investigate existing PCB designs, identify performance and reliability issues, determine their root causes, and implement layout improvements while preserving the original schematic, netlist connectivity, and component selection. The ideal candidate combines substantial hands-on PCB design experience with at least four years of practical simulation expertise in signal integrity, EMC, thermal analysis, or a combination of these areas. We are looking for an engineer who can independently execute technical work, interpret simulation results, and translate findings into measurable hardware improvements. CONTRACT TYPE: Independent Contractor LOCATION: Remote DURATION: Approximately 13 weeks, with potential extension opportunities COMMITMENT: 40 hours per week START DATE: As soon as possible SCHEDULE: Full-time engagement Key Responsibilities Translate product requirements into circuit architectures, hardware specifications, and validated electronic designs Develop and modify schematics and multilayer PCB layouts using KiCad, including component selection, routing, design-rule checks, BOM preparation, and manufacturing documentation Analyze existing PCB layouts and simulation results to identify signal integrity, EMC, and thermal issues Investigate root causes and define measurable acceptance criteria for design improvements Redesign PCB layouts to address identified issues while maintaining the original schematic, netlist connectivity, and component selection Perform and interpret simulations involving impedance, signal reflections, crosstalk, return paths, temperature distribution, heat dissipation, and thermal hotspots Evaluate simulation inputs, boundary conditions, material properties, modeling assumptions, and limitations Document design decisions, corrective actions, simulation outcomes, and verification findings Support prototype bring-up, hardware debugging, and design validation Requirements 8+ years of overall relevant engineering experience, with substantial hands-on experience in electronic hardware and PCB design At least 6 years of hands-on electronics hardware and PCB design experience, including multilayer PCB layouts Practical experience using KiCad for schematic capture and PCB design At least 4 years of practical experience in one or both of the following specializations: Signal Integrity (SI) / Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) simulation Thermal simulation and analysis Strong understanding of circuit analysis, component selection, and electronic component datasheets Solid knowledge of grounding, power distribution, signal integrity, thermal management, and Design for Manufacturing (DFM) / Design for Test (DFT) Ability to independently set up, execute, interpret, and validate relevant engineering simulations Experience correlating simulation results with actual PCB layout characteristics and identifying design-level causes of performance issues Ability to assess model inputs, boundary conditions, material properties, and simulation limitations Strong technical documentation and problem-solving skills

title: Endüstriyel tasarım

Görev Tanımı Parfüm şişesi, kapak ve ambalaj ürünleri tasarlamak. Dünya trendlerini, rakip markaları ve yeni tasarım akımlarını sürekli araştırmak. Konsept geliştirmek, 3D modelleme yapmak ve sunum hazırlamak. Üretilebilir ürünler geliştirmek için AR-GE ve üretim ekipleriyle birlikte çalışmak. Boya, baskı, yüzey efektleri ve dekorasyon alternatifleri geliştirmek. Yapay zekâ destekli tasarım araçlarını aktif kullanarak yeni fikirler üretmek. Yapay zekâ araçlarını (ChatGPT, Midjourney, Flux, Firefly vb.) tasarım sürecinde etkin kullanabilen. Estetik bakış açısı güçlü, detaylara önem veren. Trendleri takip etmeyi seven ve araştırmacı. Avrupa, Çin ve Türkiye ekipleriyle birlikte yeni ürün geliştirme süreçlerinde yer alma. Tasarımdan üretime kadar tüm süreci deneyimleme imkânı. Yenilikçi ve tasarım odaklı bir çalışma ortamı. title: Mechanical Engineer
description: About Vitestro Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™) . This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously. By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability. At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement. Your role “As our Mechanical Engineer in the Consumable Handling team, you design the mechanical subsystems behind some of Aletta’s key functions: the structural frame and housing that carries every other system, the safe disposal of used needles and filled blood tubes, the presentation of bandages, and the delivery of contact liquid and vacuum. It is a broad, integration-heavy role spanning mechanical structure, fluidics and actuation. You translate sub-system requirements into robust designs, integrate them into the wider device, and keep improving them based on production and field data. You build manufacturability, reliability and serviceability into the design from the start, so they are not added afterwards. You work closely with fellow mechanical, electrical, software, production and service colleagues.” First months at Vitestro “In your first months, you start the concept design for the mobility of our device in the hospital, so Aletta becomes easier to move and position wherever it is needed. At the same time, you update and verify our existing sub-system designs using what we learned from the first production runs, service activities and customer feedback. You turn these real-world findings into concrete design improvements and make sure they are verified and documented. You also start concept work on new UIS concepts, which shapes the next generation of our consumable handling.” This is what success looks like “After 12 months, you are recognized within the engineering team for your strong experience in Design for X (DfX), and you have helped incorporate DfX principles into the mechanical engineering community at Vitestro. Your designs move smoothly into production, hold up reliably in the field, and are easy to service. Colleagues come to you for your depth of knowledge, and you help raise the bar for how we design across the team. You enjoy finishing what you start. You like to see a design all the way through, and you take the details seriously. You thrive in a multidisciplinary environment and bring a pragmatic, hands-on mentality to every challenge.” What You’ll Bring: A BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering or a related field 5+ years of experience as a Mechanical (Design) Engineer, ideally on complex electromechanical products A proven track record of designing for Manufacturability, Reliability and Serviceability (DfM/DfR/DfS) Hands-on experience with formed plastic manufacturing techniques (e.g. injection moulding, thermoforming) and/or sheet metal and welded assemblies A finisher mentality with a strong focus on quality and depth: you don’t stop at a first working concept, but dig into the details and engineering fundamentals, and take designs through thorough verification to a robust, production-ready result Comfortable working with input from production, service and customers and turning it into design improvements A finisher mentality with a strong focus on quality and depth: you don’t stop at a first working concept, but dig into the details and engineering fundamentals, and take designs through thorough verification to a robust, production-ready result Fluent in English Nice to have: Design for Six Sigma (DFSS) accreditation Experience in a regulated environment, such as medical devices How We Work At Vitestro, ownership is not a slogan - it is an expectation. title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer

Our work is driven by innovation, precision engineering, and a commitment to redefining heating and cooling for a sustainable world. About the Role As our Senior Mechanical Design Engineer , you will take technical ownership of pressure-related mechanical design within our thermoacoustic heat pump technology, combining hands-on design work with technical leadership across our engineering teams. You will design pressure vessels and mechanical components, guide decisions around materials and design codes, and ensure our solutions meet PED requirements. As the internal expert in this domain, you will work closely with component owners, designers, simulation engineers, and notified bodies, providing technical direction and challenging engineering assumptions where needed. With our first prototype in production, you will join at a stage where your design decisions will directly influence how our technology evolves towards a robust, certifiable, and manufacturable product. Take technical ownership of pressure-related design , guiding engineering decisions across component teams. Perform engineering calculations covering materials, bolts, weld strength, pressure loads, and fatigue. Apply PED, EN 13445, and relevant design codes and support the product certification process. Guide material selection and design decisions, considering mechanical performance, corrosion, manufacturability, and compliance. Critically review designs, calculations, and simulations and work with notified bodies to deliver robust and certifiable solutions. Strong proficiency in SolidWorks and experience with PDM/PLM and geometrical tolerancing. Fluent English and comfortable working across disciplines in a fast-paced scale-up environment. Hybrid work arrangement supporting autonomy and work–life balance. Tailored learning and development opportunities to support your continued growth. Access to OpenUp, because we prioritize mental well-being. Participation in our pension scheme with employer contribution. Commuting allowance, in line with our travel policy. A strategic role in a purpose-driven scale-up, contributing to a greener world and shaping the future of sustainable thermal technology. Learn more about our mission here . null

title: Laboratory Engineer for Underwater Robotic Systems
description: Aalborg University Energy in Esbjerg seeks a Laboratory Engineer for a permanent, full-time position from 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. You will provide practical and technical support for research and teaching in underwater technology and help ensure that researchers and students have reliable, well-documented equipment for laboratory and field activities. Your work tasks You will become part of the underwater technology research environment at Aalborg University Energy in Esbjerg, where research projects combine the development, testing and application of advanced underwater robotic systems. The position provides shared technical support across several projects and contributes to coherent mechanical and electronic design practices. In this way, you will help researchers reduce duplicated technical work, strengthen knowledge sharing and reuse proven solutions across research activities. You will work closely with researchers, students and external collaborators in a role that combines independent technical responsibility with day-to-day collaboration. Your work will take place in laboratories, workshops and field settings, depending on the activities and testing needs of the research projects. A central part of the role is to make equipment ready for use, keep it operational and support colleagues in using it safely and effectively. You will develop laboratory and field-testing setups for underwater robotic systems, including selecting, integrating and maintaining relevant instrumentation, data acquisition equipment and data-logging systems. You will conduct laboratory and field tests involving underwater vehicles and associated sensors, support the standardisation and maintenance of electrical and mechanical hardware, and contribute to the design, development and fabrication of new components. You will also prepare user manuals and technical documentation, assist students in the operation of equipment, and help ensure that technical solutions remain accessible and reusable across projects. Your competencies You have a bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, electronics or a related technical field. You bring practical experience with the design, development and fabrication of mechanical and electronic hardware, preferably for underwater robotic systems or comparable complex technical equipment. You are familiar with control electronics, instrumentation, data acquisition and data-logging systems, and you can use computer-aided design tools to develop and document mechanical solutions. You have experience with robotic testing equipment and understand the importance of reliable instrumentation, systematic test procedures and clear technical documentation. Experience with the Robot Operating System or a comparable robotics framework, as well as MATLAB for data processing and analysis, is required. You communicate confidently in spoken and written English, as this is the working language in the research environment. You work systematically and pay close attention to safety, technical quality and the practical usability of equipment. You approach technical challenges in a structured and solution-oriented way and are comfortable taking responsibility for tasks independently. title: Senior Process Engineer
description: Join us and help shape PtX (Power-to-X) and BtX (Bio-to-X) projects on a global scale, working with an experienced team on the solutions of the future. At Blue Power Partners, we are a global consultancy and project development company dedicated to delivering renewable energy solutions that support sustainable change. Our core expertise is conceptual design and economic modeling of entire complexes, including wind and solar farms, power sourcing, and downstream PtX and BtX facilities. We work closely with our clients, who include one of the world’s largest fund managers in greenfield renewable energy. About the job We are looking for an experienced Senior Process Engineer to contribute to the development of PtX and BtX facilities worldwide. You will join a team of skilled specialists in a role with a wide variety of tasks. The key deliverables are due diligence, feasibility analysis, and initial conceptual design. Your responsibilities will include: Leading process development, including feasibility studies and pre-FEED, and sharing your process expertise as a technical advisor Working with our modeling team on techno-economic optimization by providing technical and economic input Taking part in technical classification meetings, exhibit reviews, and negotiations Supporting proposals, tender processes, safety assessments, and plant commissioning Helping develop in-house tools, such as techno-economic calculation models, to support concept design and benchmarking of PtX and BtX projects Coordinating across project disciplines and stakeholders Managing third-party verification Contributing to knowledge sharing and smooth project delivery You will work from our office in Copenhagen (Tromsøgade 2, Nordhavn) or Aalborg HQ (John F. Kennedys Plads 43). Because we work globally, the role sometimes calls for flexibility, and we offer the same in return. About you You are curious and enjoy learning. You like working in a structured, thoughtful way, and you thrive in an international, multicultural environment where adaptability and teamwork matter. We are looking for someone who brings: An MSc in chemical engineering or another relevant engineering field Around 10 years of experience with chemical processes Strong process experience, including PFDs, process modeling tools (e.g., Aspen HYSYS, DWSIM), equipment design, P&IDs, and process safety A solid understanding of thermodynamics, reaction engineering, fluid flow, heat transfer, and mass transfer Hands-on experience with one or more PtX or BtX production processes, such as electrolysis, steam methane reforming (SMR), Haber-Bosch, methanol synthesis, methanation, synthesis of higher hydrocarbons (SAF), refinery processes, biomass processing, carbon capture, or CO2 sequestration Good collaboration and organizational skills Fluent written and spoken English Contact For more information about the position, please contact Anne Krog Jensen, Head of PtX & Molecules, at akj@bluepp.dk. To apply, upload your resume through our recruitment system via the “Apply” link. We don’t accept applications by email. Why join Blue Power Partners? At Blue Power Partners, we value belonging, purpose, and diverse perspectives, and we believe they contribute to our innovation and long-term success. Our organization is built on trust, entrepreneurship, and balance. You will join a focused team working on specialized technical projects, where you can grow your expertise in PtX and BtX. Joining BPP means becoming part of a consultancy that is contributing to the energy transition, with strong technical roots and an international scope.

title: Mechanical Design Engineer / Mekanikkonstruktör till EMVE Sweden
description: Vill du se dina konstruktioner bli verklighet - från den första idén till en färdig maskin eller komplett produktionslinje? Hos EMVE Sweden får du kombinera kvalificerad mekanisk konstruktion med nära samarbete med produktion, projektledning och marknad i en internationell verksamhet med korta beslutsvägar. EMVE Sweden i Åstorp är inne i en expansiv fas och söker nu en Mechanical Design Engineer / Projektkonstruktör. Rollen passar dig som redan är trygg och duktig inom mekanisk konstruktion, har god helhetssyn och vill arbeta i team. Du tar ansvar för dina projekt och bidrar gärna till att både konstruktionen och att våra arbetssätt blir ännu bättre – tillsammans med erfarna kollegor. Vi ser framför oss att du har minst 3 års relevant erfarenhet efter din ingenjörsexamen. Det är framför allt din kompetens, självständighet och vilja att leverera bra lösningar som är avgörande. Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid och vi anpassar startdatum efter din nuvarande uppsägningstid. Vi gör löpande urval så skicka in din ansökan redan idag. Om tjänsten Som Mechanical Design Engineer / projektkonstruktör blir du en viktig del av teamet och arbetar med konstruktion av maskiner och kompletta produktionslinjer. EMVE är en stark aktör inom livsmedelsindustrin och specialiserar sig på skonsam och effektiv hantering av livsmedel. Lösningarna är ofta kundanpassade, vilket ger teknisk variation och möjlighet att ta ansvar för hela flöden – tillsammans med kollegor och kunder. Du följer konstruktionen genom hela kedjan - från behov, idé och koncept till ritningsunderlag, tillverkning och färdig lösning. Eftersom konstruktion och produktion finns samlade i Åstorp kan se resultatet av ditt arbete i praktiken. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter Konstruera maskiner, delsystem och kompletta produktionslinjer – både kundanpassade lösningar och vidareutveckling av befintliga. Ta fram 3D-modeller, ritningar, produktionsunderlag och teknisk dokumentation. Skapa lösningar med hänsyn till funktion, kvalitet, tillverkningsbarhet, kostnad, servicevänlighet och hållbarhet. Arbeta nära projektledning, marknad, inköp och produktion för att säkerställa robusta och genomförbara lösningar. Bidra i förbättrings- och utvecklingsprojekt inom konstruktion och produktionsteknik. Dela kunskap och bidra till gemensamma arbetssätt och fortsatt utveckling av konstruktionsfunktionen. Du blir en del av ett kompetent konstruktionsteam med sex medarbetare och rapporterar till EMVE:s R&D Manager. Rollens tyngd och ansvar kan i viss mån anpassas efter din erfarenhet: oavsett om du är en etablerad konstruktör som vill bredda dig eller en mer senior specialist som söker större helhetsansvar får du goda möjligheter att påverka. Vem är du? Vi söker dig som tycker om att omsätta tekniska behov i genomtänkta, praktiskt fungerande konstruktioner. Du trivs med att växla mellan självständigt fördjupningsarbete och nära samarbete med andra funktioner. För att lyckas i rollen behöver du vara lösningsorienterad, ansvarstagande och bekväm med att ta dig an uppgifter från idé till genomförande. Utbildning och erfarenhet Ingenjörsexamen inom maskinteknik, produktutveckling eller närliggande område, alternativt annan relevant teknisk bakgrund. Flera års relevant erfarenhet av mekanisk konstruktion efter examen - som riktmärke minst 3 år. Erfarenhet av maskinkonstruktion, produktionsutrustning eller annan tekniskt komplex utrustning inom tillverkande industri. Vana vid projektorienterat arbete och att samarbeta med produktion och andra tekniska eller kommersiella funktioner. Teknisk kompetens God vana av 3D-CAD. Erfarenhet av Autodesk Inventor och Vault är särskilt värdefull; erfarenhet av likvärdiga system kan också vara relevant om du snabbt kan sätta dig in i EMVE:s verktyg. Förståelse för materialval, tillverkningsmetoder, toleranser och produktionstekniska förutsättningar. Förmåga att ta fram tydliga ritningar, produktionsunderlag och teknisk dokumentation. Erfarenhet av affärssystem är meriterande – vi använder Monitor. Personliga egenskaper Du är en kreativ och pragmatisk problemlösare med ett genuint teknikintresse. Du arbetar strukturerat, tar ansvar för dina leveranser och driver dina uppgifter framåt. Du är kommunikativ och samarbetsinriktad och delar gärna med dig av kunskap och erfarenheter. Du är noggrann, kvalitetsmedveten och förstår värdet av väl genomförd dokumentation. Du ser helheten och kan samtidigt fördjupa dig i de tekniska detaljer som avgör om en lösning fungerar i praktiken. För tjänsten krävs flytande svenska i tal och skrift samt goda kunskaper i engelska, eftersom rollen innefattar samarbete med internationella bolag, kunder och partners. B-körkort krävs. I rekryteringsprocessen använder vi arbetspsykologiska tester för kandidater som går vidare till intervju samt bakgrundskontroll av slutkandidat. Därför ska du välja EMVE Helhet och synligt resultat - du följer dina lösningar från idé och konstruktion till tillverkad och driftsatt utrustning. Teknisk variation - du arbetar med kundanpassade maskiner och kompletta linjer där varje projekt bjuder på nya utmaningar. Nära till produktionen - kontor, konstruktion och tillverkning finns samlade i Åstorp, vilket ger snabb återkoppling och smidiga beslut. Påverkan och ansvar – du får ett reellt ansvar och möjlighet att påverka både tekniska lösningar och arbetssätt. Internationell räckvidd - EMVE:s maskiner och linjer levereras till kunder över hela världen. Om verksamheten EMVE är ett familjeföretag med ca 60 anställda och en omsättning på ca 175 Mkr. Vi utvecklar, tillverkar och marknadsför utrustning för skonsam hantering av grönsaker och livsmedel. Vi representerar mer än 100 års kompetens för leverans av maskiner till potatis, morot, grönsaker och livsmedelsindustrier. Vi står för hög kvalitet, service och funktionspålitlighet baserad på hållbar modern teknik. Sedan 2017 arbetar vi enligt Lean-principerna. title: Development Engineer Powertrain
description: At Kalmar, we are moving goods in critical supply chains around the world. As the forerunner in sustainable material handling equipment and services, we set the industry benchmark for a zero-emission future. We are driven by teamwork, innovation, and taking ownership to deliver results. With our global reach and local expertise, our success starts with a strong focus on the customer, ensuring their needs guide our daily work. We are dedicated to respecting others and fostering an inclusive culture where all voices are heard, empowering us to succeed together. With us, your work has an impact. Your work moves the world! Join us and take your career to the next level We're looking for a passionate mechanical or automotive engineer ready to drive the next generation of heavy-duty power systems. As our Development Engineer, Powertrain , you'll take ownership of developing, designing, and validating complete powertrain architectures for machines that move massive loads across global ports and terminals. Working closely with specialized suppliers, manufacturing teams, and advanced test labs, you'll translate demanding safety, efficiency, and legislative requirements into robust, high-performance solutions that set industry benchmarks. If you enjoy seeing your engineering work come to life rather than getting lost in corporate layers, this role offers exactly that. You'll be involved throughout the entire development process, from initial concepts and supplier collaboration to hands-on testing. What makes this opportunity particularly unique is the direct connection to the vehicle itself: you'll have the chance to design, review, and test your own systems, even taking the driver's seat to experience their real-world performance, power, and responsiveness. What Are Your Key Responsibilities Development and Design: Define requirement specifications and develop technical solutions in collaboration with the Powertrain team, Manager Powertrain & Hydraulics, and other stakeholders. Ensure that the powertrain and its components meet technical customer demands, product safety, and legal requirements. Technical Coordination and Supplier Contacts: Lead assigned development work together with colleagues, partners, consultants, and suppliers.Represent your designated powertrain system as the primary technical contact for internal production, service teams, and external suppliers. Cross-functional Collaboration: Contribute to good cross-functional collaboration and coordination of development work with Sourcing and Operation and other engineering departments. Testing and Verification: Initiate and order testing to evaluate and verify design, and in consultation with the manager, handle the purchase of necessary components for these tests. Technical Quality Assurance: Check and approve purchase drawings according to applicable standards, as well as continuously report outcomes and possible deviations to the responsible manager. What We Offer You "Customers depend on us. Our focus isn’t optional - it’s what keeps terminals running and trust alive." Rewards that truly count: We offer meaningful development opportunities through varied assignments, fair and gender-neutral pay, and flexible working conditions - all within a culture that values your growth and celebrates success. Safety that moves us forward: Build your career with a company rooted in safety since the 1940s, ensuring stability and an environment that empowers you to speak and be heard. Purpose that drives change: You'll contribute to solutions that transform global trade, creating environmental and operational innovations. You'll be in the driver's seat of ideas, developing digital and mechanical technologies that set industry standards and position us as the forerunner. People who move together: You'll collaborate with people who build lasting relationships through global expertise, connections, and a commitment to sustainability. Become part of our global network of 485 R&D Engineers, driving innovative, sustainable solutions and making an impact worldwide. What You Bring To The Role Relevant Engineering Degree: B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or equivalent technical discipline. Mechanical Product Development: Proven hands-on experience in mechanical engineering design and end-to-end product development. Powertrain Expertise: Solid technical foundation within powertrain systems, drivetrain components, and mechanical power transmission is considered as an advantage. Digital Engineering Tools: Practical proficiency in modern CAD and PDM environments (hands-on experience with Catia is a strong advantage). Heavy Vehicle Know-How: Prior exposure to non-road mobile machinery (NRMM), heavy-duty rubber-tired vehicles, or related equipment is considered as an advantage. Structured Execution: Analytical mindset with a results-oriented approach to problem-solving, quality assurance, and technical drawings. Collaboration & Communication: Fluent English skills (written and spoken) with a collaborative spirit; Swedish language proficiency is an appreciated plus. Ready to elevate your career? Apply today! We encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis, and the position will be filled as soon as the most suitable candidate is identified. About Kalmar Kalmar (Nasdaq Helsinki: KALMAR) is moving goods in critical supply chains around the world, with the vision to be the forerunner in sustainable material handling equipment and services. The company offers a wide range of industry shaping heavy material handling equipment and services to ports and terminals, distribution centres, manufacturing and heavy logistics. Headquartered in Helsinki, Finland, Kalmar operates globally in over 120 countries and employs approximately 5,300 people. In 2025, the company's sales totalled approximately EUR 1.7 billion. www.kalmarglobal.com

title: CAD Engineer – Automotive Lighting Systems
description: At ALTEN, we’re expanding our team and looking for multiple skilled CAD Engineers to join our projects in the automotive industry. In this role, you’ll contribute to designing and securing engineering solutions for rear lighting systems, working closely with other CAD engineers, design leads, and cross-functional teams. With ALTEN’s global expertise and network, you’ll play a key role in driving innovation and quality in cutting-edge automotive projects. Your Key Responsibilities Design & Engineering: Perform CAD work in Catia V5 and Teamcenter for both interior and exterior components of rear lamps. Interface Management: Secure interfaces with joining areas/departments and within the rear lighting team. Technical Input: Deliver Technical Input (TI) to stakeholders and support decision-making processes. Meetings & Reporting: Participate in and report status during cross-functional engineering meetings. title: Senior IC/MEMS Integration and Simulation Engineer
description: Project Foundation launched by The Fourth Law and Odd Systems is a semiconductor initiative to mass-produce thermal imaging sensors for Ukraine, the rest of Europe and the United States. The initiative covers the development of LWIR sensors and the deployment of a network of partner-operated and in-house manufacturing facilities. It will create a new industrial base for defense and civilian needs and supply affordable sensors to manufacturers of drones, vehicles, and robotics. The first sensors under the initiative are expected as early as 2027. The Fourth Law is a leading Ukrainian manufacturer of autonomy technologies for drones. Our solutions are codified according to NATO standards and are currently utilized by over 50 units of the Security and Defense Forces of Ukraine, as well as 20+ drone manufacturers. Odd Systems is a defense technology company specializing in the development and manufacturing of thermal imaging cameras. It was founded by a group of entrepreneurs, engineers, managers, and tech enthusiasts with prior experience at a number of international technology companies. Purpose of the Role: The IC/MEMS Integration and Simulation Engineer is responsible for designing the microbolometer MEMS architecture and the electrical and mechanical interface with the Readout Integrated Circuit (ROIC). This is a hands-on role involving the design of the microbolometer layout and the redistribution layer (RDL) - ensuring precise alignment between pixel attachment points and the fixed pad array on the ROIC - as well as performing finite element analysis to verify that the resulting structure can withstand the mechanical and thermal loads encountered during packaging and operation. The engineer works closely with a MEMS/semiconductor processing specialist and the broader technical team at the R&D laboratory in Eindhoven, and reports directly to the Chief Technology Officer (CTO). Office location: Eindhoven, the Netherlands Key Responsibilities: • Own MEMS design and layout adjustments that reconcile the microbolometer pixel array with the fixed ROIC pad configuration. • Match microbolometer pixel anchor points precisely to predefined ROIC pad locations, iterating layout across design revisions. • Build and run FEA models of mechanical behavior, including residual stress and the structural integrity of suspended pixel structures. • Simulate thermal behavior across the packaging cycle - die attach, curing, wire bonding, lid sealing - to flag stress or delamination risk before fabrication. • Feed simulation results back into layout and process decisions, working closely with the MEMS/Semiconductor Processing Specialist and packaging partners. • Maintain design documentation and simulation records to support Gen0 qualification and future design iterations. Experience and skills we are looking for: • A degree in electrical engineering, microelectronics, or a related field, with hands-on IC layout experience (RDL design a plus). • Practical experience with FEA tools (e.g. ANSYS, COMSOL) for mechanical and thermal simulation of microstructures or packaged devices. • Understanding of MEMS pixel structures, ROIC pad/bump interfaces, and the constraints of hybrid integration. • Comfortable working from first principles in a pre-production environment — this is a build-it-yourself role, not a mature-process one. • Fluent English, with the communication maturity to work with an international, partly Ukrainian team. It’s a plus if you have: • Prior work on microbolometer, IR sensor, or other MEMS-ROIC hybrid integration. • Experience with wafer-level or die-level hybrid bonding processes and their mechanical failure modes. • Familiarity with JEDEC packaging formats and wire-bond or bump interconnect design rules. • Based in, or willing to relocate to, Eindhoven for the Odd Factory One R&D lab. We are not just looking for employees, but for like-minded individuals who share our values and are ready to build the future of Ukrainian MilTech.

Competence with Excel and the ability to present calculations and results clearly. Clear written and verbal technical communication in English. Analysis assumptions, results and conclusions will be checked by an appropriately qualified engineer before release. Independent technical approval, certification responsibility and leadership of complex analyses are outside the initial scope of the role. Development expectations Build competence progressively in model preparation, engineering checks, interpretation of results and technical reporting. As capability is demonstrated, take increasing ownership of routine analysis tasks while continuing to work within the team’s checking and approval arrangements. Reporting to the UK Quality Manager, you'll lead the technical transfer from an international licensor, coordinate a small cross-functional engine team, and take ownership of production quality and readiness. With production targeted to begin in early 2027, this is an exciting opportunity to build a new capability from the ground up and see your work move directly into production. Production line setup: Coordinate engineering, tooling, test equipment, supplier and facility requirements to establish a fully operational engine production line. Programme delivery: Own the production readiness plan, managing schedules, dependencies, risks and key milestones through to start of production. Quality engineering: Define critical assembly characteristics, lead PFMEA reviews, establish Control Plans and ensure robust production quality processes. Testing and validation: Agree engine test acceptance criteria, lead pilot builds and First Article Inspections, and validate test results against the licensor's requirements. Supplier and configuration management: Coordinate sourcing priorities, manage supplier and licensor changes, and oversee non-conformances and corrective actions. Practical knowledge of APQP and PPAP, including PFMEA, Control Plans and First Article Inspection (EN/AS 9102, EN/AS 9145, AIAG or equivalent). Understanding of engine dynamometer testing and the development of test acceptance criteria. Strong project planning, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills. Willingness and ability to travel overseas for extended periods during the transfer. Nice to have Experience in aerospace, defence or uncrewed systems manufacturing. Knowledge of fuel systems, ignition systems and engine control units (ECUs). Familiarity with castings and precision-machined engine components. Experience planning production line or facility start-ups. Awareness of export control requirements, such as ITAR and EAR. Experience working with international suppliers or technology licensors. Security Requirements Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) To be eligible for this role, you must be able to meet the Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS). This includes confirming your identity, legal right to work in the UK, recent employment history, and criminal record (unspent convictions only). The SYOS Mindset Curious people. Big ideas. No egos. A team that gets things done. We move fast, embrace challenges, and believe the best solutions come from great teams. Care about what they build — take pride in creating technology that matters. We're a team of innovators, engineers, and problem-solvers who believe that great ideas can come from anyone. The best answer wins — regardless of title or experience. In this role, you'll help establish a new engine manufacturing capability, bringing people, processes and technology together to deliver a production line ready for the future of autonomous aviation. We're not looking for people who just want another job. We're looking for people who want to be part of the story. Come build with us. Challenge us. Grow with us.

Voir la fiche de l'entreprise Description Des Activités Significatives De L'emploi Quantel Technologies, gamme de lasers à solide et de diodes laser du Groupe Lumibird, compte plus de 100 salariés basés sur les sites de Villejust (91) et du Barp (33). Pour accompagner son développement, et soutenir de nouveaux projets, Quantel Technologies recherche un(e) INGENIEUR(E) EN MECANIQUE EXPERIMENTE(E) pour son site de Villejust (91).
