Vous prendrez en charge vos projets dans leur globalité, depuis l'analyse fonctionnelle et les choix de conception jusqu'à la justification technique, la validation et l'industrialisation. Cette responsabilité de bout en bout vous permettra de conjuguer expertise technique, autonomie et vision concrète du produit final. En véritable référent mécanique, vous serez garant de la pertinence des solutions développées et contribuerez à l'évolution technique des produits ainsi qu'à l'amélioration continue du bureau d'études. Vos Responsabilités Conception et expertise technique Analyser les besoins, définir les architectures et piloter les études de conception mécanique et micromécanique. Réaliser et valider les conceptions 3D, mises en plan, cotations fonctionnelles et dossiers de définition. Élaborer les dossiers de justification et réaliser les calculs et simulations mécaniques et thermomécaniques. Garantir la robustesse et la conformité des solutions techniques. Pilotage des projets Piloter les projets de manière autonome, de l'analyse du besoin à l'industrialisation. Évaluer les faisabilités techniques, estimer les coûts et garantir les objectifs de qualité, de coûts et de délais. Coordonner les interlocuteurs internes, fournisseurs et sous-traitants. Assurer le suivi des développements et anticiper les risques techniques. Industrialisation et amélioration continue Accompagner le passage en fabrication et apporter un support technique aux équipes de production, montage et contrôle. Analyser et résoudre les problématiques mécaniques rencontrées en production. Proposer et valider les évolutions des produits et des procédés. Contribuer à l'amélioration des méthodes, outils et standards de conception. Référent technique et innovation Apporter votre expertise sur les problématiques mécaniques complexes et accompagner techniquement les équipes. Assurer une veille technologique et proposer de nouvelles solutions de conception et de fabrication. Participer à l'évaluation et à la validation de nouvelles technologies. Profil Votre Profil De formation ingénieur Bac +4/5 en mécanique ou équivalent, vous justifiez d'au moins 10 ans d'expérience en bureau d'études mécaniques, idéalement dans un environnement industriel à forte technicité. Vous Maîtrisez Notamment La conception mécanique et micromécanique, le dimensionnement et la justification de conception. La cotation fonctionnelle, le tolérancement et les chaînes de cotes. La thermique et la thermomécanique (calculs et simulations). Les procédés de fabrication : usinage, fonderie, prototypage rapide. title: Teknik Mühendis
description: Uluslararası “WAM” (Worldwide Asset Management)’in, Türkiye iştiraki olarak faaliyete geçen “WAM Turkey”, Uluslararası Fon yapılanması içinde Portföy Management ve Asset Management alanlarında faaliyetlerini yürütmektedir. “WAM Turkey” dünya çapındaki bilgi birikimi ile etkin ve profesyonel kadrolarıyla yönetimini üstlenmiş olduğu Alışveriş Merkezleri, Lojistik Depolar, Ofis Kampüsler vb. ticari gayrimenkullerde en verimli sonuçlara ulaştırma ve farklılık yaratma hedefiyle, projelere özel strateji geliştirmektedir. Uluslararası knowhowı ile duyarlı dinamik iş planları sayesinde assetlerini uluslararası seviyede 360 derece yönetim anlayışı içinde yöneterek, yer aldığı tüm projelere katma değer katmaktadır. Türkiye'de Avrupa'nın sayılı alışveriş merkezleri arasında gösterilen City’s Nişantaşı, Meydan İstanbul, Kozyatağı City’s İstanbul projelerinde Asset Management hizmeti veren WAM, Avrupa'nın en önemli portföylerini yönetmektedir. City's İstanbul AVM'nin tüm Teknik (Mekanik, Elektrik) faaliyetlerini yönetecek, en az 4 yıl Teknik Mühendis tecrübesine sahip ekip arkadaşına ihtiyacımız bulunmaktadır. İŞ TANIMI AVM’nin fiziki yapı, elektrik ve mekanik sistemleri, tesisat ve inşaat, makine ve araç envanteri dahil tüm bakım, onarım ve işletme faaliyetlerinin yürütülmesini sağlamak, ilgili bakım onarım sözleşmelerinin yıl içerisindeki takibini ve dönem sonu yenilemelerini yapmak. Tesisin tüm teknik sistemlerini etkin ve sürdürülebilir şekilde kullanmak, mevzuat ve tedarikçi kataloglarına uygun olarak periyodik ve koruyucu bakım işlemlerinin yıllık planlamasına uygun şekilde düzenli yapılmasını sağlamak. Alt yüklenicilerin sağladığı hizmetlerin yıllık bakım sözleşmelerine uygun şekilde yapılmasını denetlemek. Yıllık bakım, onarım, yenileme ve enerji bütçelerini hazırlayıp denetlemek. Otomasyon ve enerji dağıtım sistemlerinin bakım ve onarımını gerçekleştirerek, altyapı kalitesini artırmak ve kesintisiz, güvenli enerji teminini sağlamak. Klima sistemleri, trafo panoları, asansörler, yangın ve su sistemleri, jeneratörler gibi teçhizatların günlük ve periyodik kontrollerinin yapılmasını sağlamak. Yangın güvenliği yönetmeliğine uygun olarak, kritik yangın noktalarını kontrol etmek ve yangın söndürme sistemlerinin bakım-onarımını sağlamak. Aydınlatma, ses ve ışık sistemlerinin sürekliliğini sağlamak ve arızalara hızlıca müdahale etmek. Elektrik ve mekanik ekipmanların bulunduğu alanlarda temizlik ve düzenin sağlanmasını denetlemek. Kendisinin sorumlu olduğu hizmetlerin kalitesini artırmak için süreç iyileştirme çalışmaları yaparak iç ve dış müşteri memnuniyetini geliştirmek. Teknik ekiplerin iş planlamasını yapmak ve vardiya düzenini yönetmek. Personelin eğitimlerini düzenlemek ve gelişimlerine katkı sağlamak. Ekip üyelerinin eğitim ve performans değerlendirmelerini yapmak. GENEL NİTELİKLER Üniversitelerin Makine, Mekatronik veya Elektrik Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezun. Tercihen AVM, Havalimanı, Hastane gibi sektörlerinde 2 yıl, benzer pozisyonda en az 5 yıl deneyimi olan. Bina ve tesis yönetimi, teknik hizmetlerin planlanması, bina revizyonu, enerji optimizasyonu, bakım faaliyetleri, bina onarımı ve altyapısal hizmetlerin yürütülmesi konularında deneyimli. Bina ve tesis elektronik, mekanik ve iklimlendirme proje yönetimi yapmış. Tüm teknik ekibin organizasyonu, denetimi, yönetimi ve koordinasyonunu sağlayabilecek. İş Sağlığı ve Güvenliği prosedürleri ve uygulamaları konusunda bilgili. Çözüm odaklı, planlama ve koordinasyon becerileri gelişmiş, ekip yönetimi konusunda deneyimli ve temsil yeteneği güçlü. MS Office ve Autocad programlarını kullanabilen. Esnek çalışma saatlerine uyumlu, disiplinli ve içsel motivasyonu yüksek. İNSAN KAYNAKLARI POLİTİKASI WAM Turkey İnsan kaynakları politikası gereği tüm çalışanların en değerli varlıkları olduğuna inanmaktadır. Çalışanlarına uzun vadeli kariyer planlaması oluşturarak, ilişkilerini sağlıklı ve kalıcı temeller üzerine inşa etmektedir. Bünyesine yetenekli ve başarılı çalışanları dahil etmekte olup; kişisel ve mesleki gelişmelerine yardımcı olmaktadır. Çalışanlara sorumluluk üstlenmesini, inisiyatif kullanmasını ve bu doğrultuda başarılı iş sonuçları elde etmeleri için motive etmektedir. WAM Turkey tüm çalışanlarına istikrarlı ve sürdürülebilir mutluluğa sahip bir çalışma ortamı sunar. SEÇME YERLEŞTİRME WAM Turkey’ de Seçme ve Yerleştirme sürecinde adayların her pozisyon için gerekli olan yetkinliklere sahip olup olmadıkları objektif, güvenilir ve geçerli metotlarla tespit edilir; iş hayatı ile kişisel başarıda yetkinliklerin rol oynadığı bir yapı hedeflenmiştir. Bu hedef doğrultusunda oluşturulan prosedürlere göre insan kaynakları web portallarına verilen ilanlar dışında, kişisel başvuru yolu, yılın her döneminde açıktır. Tüm başvurular titizlikle incelenir ve başvuru anında açık bir kadro olmasa da, adaylar rutin olarak yapılan mülakatlara davet edilebilir. İhtiyaç olduğunda adayların başvuruları tekrar incelemeye alınır. WAM Turkey’in insan kaynakları ihtiyacı, geniş bir yelpaze ile tanımlanabilir. Başvurular sırasında, ilgili pozisyonun gerekleri doğrultusunda öğrenim, deneyim, lisan bilgisi önemli olmakla birlikte, görüşmelerde gözlenen kişisel niteliklerde, adayın seçiminde önemli rol oynar. ÜCRET POLİTİKASI WAM Turkey’ de ücret artış uygulaması, güncel piyasa trendlerini yansıtabilme politikası ve artan performansı ödüllendirebilmek için her yıl gerçekleşir. Her ücret artış dönemi öncesinde piyasa ücret araştırması yapılır. Dikkate alınan kriterler içinde en üstte yer alan kriter, kişisel yetkinlik ve artan performansı ödüllendirmek olduğu için, WAM Turkey’de performans değerlendirmesi öne çıkmaktadır.

Orbia topluluğunun bir parçası olarak, bugünün ihtiyaçlarına çözüm üretirken geleceğin daha yaşanabilir ve sürdürülebilir şehirlerine katkı sağlamayı hedefliyoruz. title: Junior Field Service Engineer
description: Rapiscan, an OSI Systems, Inc. company, empowers those who safeguard our world with the technologies, services, and expertise needed to detect threats, secure commerce, and protect communities. An industry leader in X-ray inspection, radiation and trace detection, metal detection, and optical inspection solutions, Rapiscan has over 100,000 scanning systems installed around the world to assist customs agencies, border security, aviation authorities, law enforcement, military organizations, and security professionals in combatting terrorism, smuggling, and trade fraud. Role Overview We are looking for a motivated Junior Field Service Engineer to join our team in Turkey. Based in Ankara, you will support Rapiscan’s Cargo Vehicle Inspection (CVI) systems across the country, providing hands-on maintenance, troubleshooting, repairs, and customer support. Perform preventative maintenance, inspections, repairs, and fault diagnosis on Cargo Vehicle Inspection (CVI) systems. Serve as the local technical point of contact for customers throughout Turkey. Carry out troubleshooting and corrective maintenance on mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and IT-related systems. Support the maintenance and servicing of Mercedes-based inspection vehicles. Coordinate and perform scheduled maintenance activities on deployed cargo inspection systems. Provide technical support and respond to customer service requests both remotely and on-site. Complete service reports and technical documentation accurately. Maintain company-issued tools, equipment, vehicles, and spare parts. Build positive customer relationships and deliver high-quality service. Follow all health, safety, and operational requirements. BTEC, City & Guilds, HNC, or equivalent engineering qualification. Knowledge of hydraulic, electrical, electro-mechanical, or industrial systems. Understanding of IT networking technologies; CCNP or similar beneficial. Experience with PLC-controlled systems, HV systems, radar, or integrated technology solutions is an advantage. Relevant practical experience will also be considered Candidate Requirements Experience supporting complex technical equipment involving mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, PLC, engine, generator, or networking technologies. Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting skills. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Willingness to travel throughout Turkey.

title: Kalite Kontrol Mühendisi
company: Hlt Makina Sanayi ve Ticaret Limited Şirketi
description: CNC torna, CNC freze, üniversal tezgâh ve kaynaklı imalat süreçlerinde; farklı sektörlerin ihtiyaçlarına yönelik hassas ve teknik resme uygun üretim gerçekleştirmekteyiz. Kalite, verimlilik ve sürekli gelişim ilkeleri doğrultusunda büyüyen ekibimize katılmak üzere, üretim süreçlerimizin kalite kontrol faaliyetlerini yönetecek Kalite Kontrol Mühendisi arıyoruz. İş Tanımı ve Sorumluluklar 1. Üretim Süreçlerinde Kalite Kontrol * CNC torna, CNC freze, üniversal işleme ve kaynaklı imalat süreçlerinde gerçekleştirilen üretimlerin kalite kontrollerini yapmak. * Üretimi gerçekleştirilen parçaların teknik resim, tolerans ve müşteri şartnamelerine uygunluğunu kontrol etmek. * İlk ürün, proses içi ve son ürün kontrollerini gerçekleştirmek. * Üretim aşamalarında oluşabilecek ölçüsel, görsel ve fonksiyonel uygunsuzlukları tespit etmek. * Kritik ölçülerin, geometrik toleransların ve yüzey kalitesinin kontrolünü sağlamak. * Uygunsuz ürünlerin ayrılmasını, tanımlanmasını ve uygun olmayan ürün yönetimi sürecinin yürütülmesini sağlamak. * Seri üretim ve proje bazlı imalatlarda kalite kontrol faaliyetlerini takip etmek. 2. Ölçüm ve Muayene Faaliyetleri * Teknik resim okuyarak ölçüm ve kontrol yöntemlerini belirlemek. * Kumpas, mikrometre, mihengir, komparatör, yükseklik ölçer, iç çap komparatörü ve benzeri hassas ölçüm ekipmanlarını etkin şekilde kullanmak. * Parçaların ölçüsel kontrollerini gerçekleştirmek ve ölçüm sonuçlarını kayıt altına almak. * Geometrik toleranslandırma (GD&T) ve teknik resim sembollerini yorumlamak. * Ölçüm cihazlarının kalibrasyon ve doğrulama süreçlerini takip etmek. * Ölçüm sonuçlarına göre üretim proseslerinin uygunluğunu değerlendirmek. 3. Kalite Yönetim Sistemi * ISO 9001:2015 Kalite Yönetim Sistemi gerekliliklerinin uygulanmasını ve sürdürülmesini sağlamak. * Kalite kontrol planları, kontrol formları, muayene raporları ve kalite kayıtlarını hazırlamak ve güncel tutmak. * Giriş kalite, proses kalite ve final kalite kontrol süreçlerini yönetmek. * İç denetim ve dış denetim hazırlıklarına destek vermek. * Kalite prosedürleri, talimatları ve dokümantasyon çalışmalarını yürütmek. * Kalite performans göstergelerini takip etmek ve raporlamak. 4. Uygunsuzluk ve Sürekli İyileştirme * Üretim ve tedarik süreçlerinde ortaya çıkan uygunsuzlukları analiz etmek. * Kök neden analizleri (5 Neden, Balık Kılçığı vb.) gerçekleştirmek. * Düzeltici ve önleyici faaliyetlerin (DÖF) oluşturulmasını ve sonuçlandırılmasını takip etmek. * Tekrarlayan kalite problemlerinin önlenmesine yönelik iyileştirme çalışmaları yürütmek. * Hurda, fire, yeniden işleme ve müşteri şikâyetleri gibi kalite maliyetlerini takip etmek. * Üretim ve teknik ekiplerle koordineli çalışarak proses kalitesinin geliştirilmesini sağlamak. 5. Tedarikçi ve Müşteri Kalite Süreçleri * Tedarikçilerden temin edilen hammadde ve yarı mamullerin giriş kalite kontrollerini gerçekleştirmek. * Dışarıda yaptırılan talaşlı imalat, ısıl işlem, kaplama ve benzeri operasyonların kalite uygunluğunu takip etmek. * Tedarikçi kaynaklı uygunsuzlukları değerlendirmek ve gerekli aksiyonları takip etmek. * Müşteri kalite taleplerini ve teknik şartnameleri değerlendirmek. * Gerektiğinde müşteri kalite denetimlerine ve teknik toplantılara katılmak. * İlk numune ve ölçüm raporlarının hazırlanmasını ve müşteri onay süreçlerini takip etmek. Aranan Nitelikler; * Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği, Mekatronik Mühendisliği, Endüstri Mühendisliği veya ilgili mühendislik bölümlerinden mezun. * Tercihen makine imalatı ve talaşlı imalat sektörlerinde en az 2 yıl kalite kontrol veya kalite güvence deneyimine sahip. * Teknik resim okuma, ölçülendirme ve toleranslandırma konularında bilgi sahibi. * Geometrik toleranslandırma (GD&T) konusunda bilgi sahibi. * Hassas ölçüm cihazlarını kullanabilen ve ölçüm sonuçlarını yorumlayabilen. * CNC torna ve CNC freze imalat süreçleri hakkında bilgi sahibi. * ISO 9001:2015 Kalite Yönetim Sistemi konusunda bilgi sahibi. * Giriş kalite, proses kalite ve final kalite kontrol süreçlerine hâkim. * Uygunsuzluk yönetimi, kök neden analizi ve DÖF süreçleri hakkında bilgi sahibi. * MS Office programlarını etkin kullanabilen. * Raporlama, dokümantasyon ve kayıt tutma konusunda disiplinli. * Analitik düşünme ve problem çözme becerisine sahip. * Takım çalışmasına yatkın, iletişim becerileri güçlü ve sorumluluk sahibi. * Üretim sahasında aktif olarak çalışabilecek. Adaydan Beklenen Yetkinlikler * Detaylara önem veren ve ölçüm hassasiyeti yüksek. * Üretim kalitesini yalnızca kontrol eden değil, geliştirmeyi hedefleyen. * Uygunsuzlukları tespit etmekle kalmayıp çözüm üretebilen. * Gerektiğinde üretim sahasında aktif rol alabilen. * İş takibi ve zaman yönetimi konusunda başarılı. * Farklı departmanlarla koordineli çalışabilen. * Kalite konusunda objektif, disiplinli ve çözüm odaklı. Başvurularınızı bekliyoruz.

title: Üretim Süreç Analizi ve İyileştirme Uzmanı
description: Üretim Süreçleri ve Dijital Dönüşüm Danışmanı Şirket: DigiShifter Lokasyon: İstanbul Çalışma modeli: Hibrit Saha çalışması: Müşteri fabrikalarına düzenli ziyaretler Digishifter olarak, geliştirdiğimiz smartShifter üretim operasyonları yönetim platformuyla işletmelerin üretim süreçlerini daha görünür, izlenebilir ve yönetilebilir hâle getirmelerine yardımcı oluyoruz. Müşteri fabrikalarında süreçleri yerinde inceleyecek, mevcut işleyişi analiz ederek belgeleyecek, aksaklıkları ve gelişim alanlarını belirleyecek bir Üretim Süreçleri ve Dijital Dönüşüm Danışmanı arıyoruz. Bu rolde, üretim sahasında yaptığınız gözlemleri ve topladığınız verileri somut bulgulara dönüştürecek; işletmelerin süreç iyileştirme ve dijital dönüşüm çalışmalarına yön verecek raporlar hazırlayacaksınız. Görev ve sorumluluklar Müşteri fabrikalarını ziyaret ederek üretim, planlama, satın alma, depo, kalite ve sevkiyat süreçlerini yerinde incelemek. Yöneticiler, bölüm sorumluları ve saha çalışanlarıyla görüşmeler yaparak mevcut işleyişi, ihtiyaçları ve karşılaşılan sorunları anlamak. Siparişten sevkiyata kadar süreç akışlarını; görev ve sorumlulukları, karar noktalarını, malzeme ve bilgi akışlarını belgelemek. Beklemeleri, darboğazları, tekrar yapılan işleri, veri eksiklerini ve departmanlar arasındaki koordinasyon sorunlarını belirlemek. Saha gözlemlerini operasyonel verilerle birlikte değerlendirerek sorunların nedenlerini araştırmak; doğrulanmış bulguları ve ek inceleme gerektiren konuları açıkça ortaya koymak. Bulguları, işletmeye etkilerini ve uygulanabilir iyileştirme önerilerini içeren analiz raporları hazırlamak. Hedef süreçlerin tasarlanmasına ve iyileştirme çalışmalarının etki, uygulanabilirlik ve öncelik açısından değerlendirilmesine katkı sağlamak. Dijitalleşme ihtiyaçlarını belirlemek; ilgili gereksinimleri smartShifter ürün ve proje ekiplerine anlaşılır biçimde aktarmak. Analiz sonuçlarını müşteri ekiplerine ve yönetime sunmak; önerilerin değerlendirilmesi ve uygulama planlarının oluşturulması çalışmalarına katılmak. Aradığımız nitelikler Üretim, üretim planlama, süreç geliştirme, kalite, yalın üretim veya operasyonel mükemmellik alanlarında saha deneyimi. Fabrika süreçlerini gözlem, görüşme ve veri incelemesi yoluyla analiz edebilme becerisi. Süreç akışlarını, departmanlar arasındaki ilişkileri ve sorumlulukları açık biçimde belgeleyebilme. Problemleri nedenleri ve işletmeye etkileriyle birlikte değerlendirebilen analitik yaklaşım. Bulguları düzenli, anlaşılır ve uygulanabilir öneriler içeren raporlara dönüştürebilme. Süreç çizimi ve sunum araçlarını etkin kullanabilme. Operatörlerden üst yönetime kadar farklı görevlerdeki kişilerle etkili iletişim kurabilme. Müşteri ziyaretleri ve saha çalışmaları için seyahat edebilme. Tercih sebepleri Endüstri Mühendisliği, Makine Mühendisliği, İşletme Mühendisliği veya ilgili alanlarda eğitim. Süreç analizi veya iyileştirme çalışmalarında en az beş yıl deneyim. Yalın üretim, değer akış haritalama, zaman etüdü, kök neden analizi veya sürekli iyileştirme çalışmalarında uygulama deneyimi. ERP, MES/MOM veya üretim planlama yazılımlarının kullanımı ya da uygulama projelerinde görev almış olmak. Mevcut süreç ve hedef süreç dokümantasyonu ile iş gereksinimlerinin hazırlanmasında deneyim. Siparişe özel, ürün çeşitliliği yüksek üretim ortamlarını tanımak. B u rolde sizden beklediğimiz çıktılar: Çalışmalarınızın sonunda işletmenin mevcut durumunu anlaşılır hâle getiren süreç haritaları , kanıtlara dayanan bulgu ve değerlendirme raporları , önceliklendirilmiş iyileştirme önerileri ve gerekli durumlarda dijitalleşme gereksinimleri hazırlamanızı bekliyoruz. Başvuru Başvurunuzda, daha önce sahada incelediğiniz bir üretim sürecini, tespit ettiğiniz bir sorunu, kullandığınız analiz yöntemini ve geliştirdiğiniz öneriyi kısaca anlatmanızı rica ediyoruz. Varsa, paylaşma yetkinizin bulunduğu ve gizli bilgileri çıkarılmış bir süreç haritası veya analiz raporu örneği de ekleyebilirsiniz. Üretim sahasını anlayan, doğru soruları soran ve bulgularını uygulanabilir önerilere dönüştüren bir ekip arkadaşıyla tanışmak istiyoruz.

title: Enstrüman Mühendisi
description: Automation & Instrumentation Engineer About Torbalı Industries Founded in 2016, Torbalı Industries is an engineering and fabrication company serving the oil & gas and energy sectors. We deliver metering skids, PRMS, truck loading and gas skids, tank gauging and automation systems for national and international energy companies and EPC contractors, with all engineering, fabrication and instrumentation done in-house. Job Summary Reporting to the Project Manager, you will work on the automation, instrumentation and electrical scope of our skid and terminal projects: control panel and PLC design, field instrumentation, industrial networks, FAT and site commissioning. Responsibilities Design automation/control panels (PLC/UCP, marshalling, power distribution) and junction boxes; prepare panel layouts, wiring diagrams and BOMs, and follow fabrication in our workshop Develop and test PLC programs and HMI/SCADA screens Design panel-level and system network architecture: managed switch selection and configuration, IP addressing plan, fiber optic patch panels, Ethernet cabling and segregation inside panels, ring/redundant topologies Prepare network architecture drawings and integrate PLCs, flow computers, analyzers, HMIs and third-party systems Prepare instrument & electrical design documents: cable schedules, interconnection and loop drawings, instrument index Supervise instrument installation, cable routing and termination on skids Carry out point-to-point checks, loop checks, FAT and SAT; support site commissioning and troubleshooting Work with P&IDs, cause & effect diagrams, datasheets and client specifications; resolve technical queries with clients and EPC contractors Contribute to internal engineering standards and templates Requirements BSc in Electrical, Electronics, Control or Mechatronics Engineering Minimum 3 years of experience in automation projects, preferably in oil & gas Hands-on PLC programming experience (ladder, FBD, ST) HMI/SCADA development experience Good knowledge of industrial networking: TCP/IP, managed switches, VLAN, ring redundancy, fiber optics, and network design inside control panels Familiarity with Modbus RTU/TCP, Profinet, EtherNet/IP, OPC, RS-485, 4–20 mA / HART Control panel design experience; proficiency in AutoCAD or EPLAN Understanding of field instrumentation and process control Experience leading FAT/SAT and site commissioning independently Knowledge of hazardous area concepts (ATEX/IECEx) is a plus Good written and spoken English Willingness to travel to project sites in Türkiye and abroad Valid driving licence; military service completed or exempted (for male candidates) What We Offer Hands-on work on international oil & gas projects, from design to commissioning A multidisciplinary team where engineering, fabrication and commissioning are done under one roof Opportunity to grow with a fast-developing company Location: İstanbul (Tuzla) / Kocaeli (Gebze), with site travel as required

title: Teknik Ofis Mühendisi
description: Smart Güneş Teknolojilerine katılın, yenilenebilir enerjinin geleceğini birlikte şekillendirelim! 🌞 2014 yılında İstanbul'da kurulan Smart Güneş Teknolojileri , dünyanın en yenilikçi güneş enerjisi şirketlerinden biridir. Sürdürülebilirlik, inovasyon ve karbon emisyonlarının azaltılması misyonuyla hareket eden şirketimiz, yüksek verimli fotovoltaik güneş panelleri üretimi ve güneş enerjisi çözümleri alanında uzmanlaşmıştır. Üretim tesislerimizde, arazi ve çatı güneş enerjisi santrallerinde kullanılmak üzere kristal silisyum esaslı yüksek verimli güneş panelleri üretiyoruz. 69.363 m² kapalı alanda faaliyet gösteren tam otomatik üretim hatlarımız , yıllık 2,4 GW üretim kapasitesine sahiptir. İş kalemleri bazında teklif talep paketlerini (RFQ) hazırlamak ve ilgili alt yüklenici ve tedarikçilere iletmek, Gelen teklifleri teknik ve ticari açıdan değerlendirmek, karşılaştırmalı mukayese tabloları hazırlamak, Alt yüklenici ve tedarikçilerle teknik kapsamın netleştirilmesi ve fiyat müzakerelerinin yürütülmesine destek vermek, Güncel tedarikçi ve alt yüklenici havuzunu oluşturmak, birim fiyat veri tabanını düzenli olarak güncellemek. title: Analytics Engineer
description: About the Team At Trendyol Tech, our mission is to create a positive impact in our ecosystem by enabling commerce through technology. We solve complex problems with data, creativity, and agility — always driven by real outcomes. With a culture built on learning, collaboration, and ownership, we grow together while building what’s next. About the Role As an Analytics Engineer, you will act as the bridge between raw data and business insights. You'll create the systems that empower our data teams, building pipelines and data models that transform messy, siloed data into clean, accessible, and reliable datasets. You will play a key role in how we make informed decisions by providing the single source of truth that powers our dashboards, reports, and analytical tools. You will contribute to building internal products and tools that make working with data easier, faster, and more reliable across Trendyol. You will work on solutions such as SQL analysis services, automated data testing, and self-service reporting platforms. Using technologies such as Python, SQL, FastAPI, you will help automate repetitive processes, improve developer productivity, and enhance the overall analytics experience. Responsibilities Partner with Product Managers and engineering teams to design, develop, and maintain scalable and reliable data models and metric layers for new and existing data product initiatives. Transform large, complex datasets from raw sources into clean, tested, and documented data assets that empower self-service analytics for end-users (analysts, data scientists, business teams). Own the end-to-end design, development, and maintenance of SQL-based data models, ensuring consistency, performance, and reliability within the data warehouse. Act as the product owner for our analytics platform, driving the standardization of data definitions and metadata to establish a "single source of truth." Additionally, lead the development of our next-generation platform that enables users to conduct self-service analysis through Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI Agents. Collaborate closely with business teams to understand their data exploration and analysis needs, influencing data roadmaps and prioritization based on their requirements. Deeply understand and empathize with Trendyol's customers and their journey with the product from a data perspective. Develop Python-based applications, APIs, and automation solutions to simplify repetitive tasks and support self-service analytics capabilities. Participate in the end-to-end development lifecycle, including requirement analysis, development, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement. Identify opportunities to automate manual processes, improve existing tools, and enhance the user experience of internal products Expected Qualifications Bachelor's degree or higher in a quantitative discipline such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field. 2+ years of professional experience in analytics engineering, data warehousing, or data modeling. Experience in an e-commerce environment is a strong plus. Strong understanding of modern data warehousing concepts, including fact tables, dimensions, star schemas, and slowly changing dimensions. Expert-level proficiency in SQL and hands-on experience with the data modeling layer of modern BI and data visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau). Proven hands-on experience in data modeling, data lake technologies, and large-scale data warehousing architecture. Experience applying software engineering best practices to data, including version control (Git) and CI/CD. Ability to translate complex data concepts and model designs for both technical and non-technical stakeholders, enabling them to tell stories with data. An agile mindset for data product development. Good programming skills in Python and a solid understanding of software development fundamentals, including object-oriented programming, clean code, and basic design principles. Basic understanding of REST APIs and backend service development concepts, preferably with hands-on experience in FastAPI or similar frameworks Familiarity with object-oriented programming language is a plus. What We Offer - Hybrid working model with flexibility: a schedule that helps you find the right balance between flexibility and team bonding, including work-from-abroad opportunities and a summer working model. - Customisable FlexBenefits budget: Adjust your daily meal allowance, choose your health insurance package (and extend it to your spouse or children), and pick from additional benefits like fuel support or Trendyol shopping credits. - Well-being support: Access to location-based in-house doctors, as well as psychologist and dietitian support, and HPV vaccination provision. - Personalised training allowance and learning opportunities: Use your annual budget for any training or conference of your choice, explore our Learning Management System (LMS) anytime, and join in-person learning sessions offered throughout the year. - Responsibility from day one: Take full ownership from the start in a culture where every voice is heard and valued. - A diverse, international team: Collaborate with global peers across our offices in Berlin, Amsterdam, Dubai, and beyond, in a startup-spirited and collaborative environment. - Opportunities to grow with the best: Tackle meaningful challenges, develop through hands-on experience, and grow with the support of expert guidance and global mentoring. - Meaningful connections beyond tasks: Be part of team rituals, events, and social activities that help us stay connected and inspired. Take the Next Step If this role excites you, apply today, we look forward to taking the next step with you. Want to get to know the team better first? Explore our Career Website, LinkedIn, or YouTube to learn more about #LifeatTrendyol and how we work.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
description: We’re Hiring a Senior QA Automation Engineer We are a technology company developing enterprise software solutions for customers across multiple industries. As we expand internationally, we are looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer to strengthen our test automation capabilities and help us deliver reliable, secure, and scalable products. If you enjoy solving quality challenges through code, building robust automation frameworks, and taking ownership of software quality, we’d love to hear from you. Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks for web applications, mobile applications, and APIs. Build and maintain automated functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end test suites. Take ownership of automation initiatives, from selecting suitable approaches and tools to implementing and maintaining reliable test coverage. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, providing fast and actionable feedback throughout the development lifecycle. Investigate test failures, distinguish product defects from automation issues, and improve test stability by addressing flaky tests. Develop reusable test components and manage test data, configurations, and environments. Collaborate closely with developers and product owners to define testable acceptance criteria and identify risks early. Validate application workflows across different browsers, devices, and network conditions. Identify, document, and track defects, supporting root cause analysis and timely resolution. Review automation code, share best practices, and support the team’s test automation capabilities. Track and communicate automation coverage, execution results, and quality risks. Perform targeted exploratory and manual testing when needed to complement automated coverage. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 7+ years of experience in software quality assurance, including at least 5 years of hands-on test automation development. Strong programming skills in at least one language used for test automation, such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or Java. Proven experience building and maintaining automation frameworks, including reusable components, reporting, and test configuration. Strong hands-on experience with at least one web automation framework, such as Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium. Experience developing automated REST API tests, including authentication, response validation, and negative test scenarios. Hands-on experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI. Proficiency with Git, code reviews, and collaborative software development practices. Solid understanding of test design techniques, risk-based testing, and selecting the appropriate level of testing. Strong debugging skills and the ability to investigate issues using application logs, browser developer tools, and network traces. Ability to work independently, prioritize automation efforts, and communicate quality risks clearly. Strong written and verbal English communication skills. Nice to Have Experience with mobile test automation, particularly Appium. Experience testing real-time applications or complex, integrated enterprise systems. Experience with performance and load testing tools such as k6, JMeter, or Locust. Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and container-based test environments. Experience with cross-browser and real-device testing platforms such as BrowserStack. Familiarity with SQL and database validation. Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve test development, coverage, or failure analysis. Apply If you’re interested in taking ownership of test automation and contributing to the quality of enterprise software products, we look forward to receiving your application. We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics.

title: NOC Engineer (Telecom – Ticket & Operations Focus)
description: We operate in the global telecommunications market, managing Voice and SMS traffic across multiple partners and systems. We are looking for a NOC Engineer who can take ownership of operational workflows, manage ticket flows, and ensure timely resolution of internal and external requests. This is a structured, process-driven role focused on execution, consistency, and operational discipline. title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description: Organisatie- en afdelingsomschrijving Verdien € 4.500 tot € 6.000 bruto per maand als senior mechanical engineer in Oss. Werk aan complexe machinebouwprojecten, krijg de vrijheid om zelf technische keuzes te maken en geniet van 22 vakantiedagen en 13 ATV-dagen. Klinkt als een ontwerp dat goed in elkaar zit? Bel of app Rick Kessels op 06 117 14 520 of mail naar Je gaat aan de slag bij een internationaal opererend ingenieursbureau dat zich bezighoudt met werktuigbouwkundige engineering, machinebouw en industriële projecten. Hier worden technische ideeën niet alleen besproken, maar ook daadwerkelijk uitgewerkt tot slimme, praktische oplossingen. Binnen de afdeling Mechanical Engineering in Oss werk je samen met engineers uit verschillende disciplines. Je krijgt ruimte om zelfstandig te ontwerpen, collega's verder te helpen en jouw technische ideeën in projecten terug te laten komen. Want een goed ontwerp begint vaak met iemand die nét even verder denkt. Functieomschrijving Als senior mechanical engineer werk je aan machinebouwprojecten waarbij jouw technische kennis echt het verschil maakt. Van het eerste concept tot de uiteindelijke oplevering ben je betrokken bij het ontwikkelen van mechanische systemen en componenten. Je werkt met 3D CAD-software zoals NX, SolidWorks, Creo of Inventor. Daarbij houd je niet alleen rekening met wat technisch mogelijk is, maar ook met wat praktisch uitvoerbaar is. Een ontwerp mag er op je beeldscherm prachtig uitzien, maar uiteindelijk moet het natuurlijk ook gewoon werken. Je Werkzaamheden Bestaan Onder Andere Uit Ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van mechanische systemen en componenten. Uitwerken van technische concepten en verzorgen van detailengineering. Bedenken en onderbouwen van oplossingen voor complexe werktuigbouwkundige vraagstukken. Controleren en verifiëren van ontwerpen en vastleggen van technische controles. Bewaken van technische voortgang, planning en projectresultaten. Overleggen met projectleiders, lead engineers, klanten en externe partijen. Begeleiden van junior engineers en delen van jouw technische kennis. Meewerken aan projecten op klantlocaties wanneer dit nodig is. Als senior mechanical engineer krijg je de ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor technische keuzes. Je bent iemand die niet alleen ziet dát iets beter kan, maar ook weet hóé. En die dat vervolgens helder kan uitleggen aan collega's. Aanbod Als senior mechanical engineer in Oss krijg je de ruimte om technisch inhoudelijk bezig te zijn, verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. En gelukkig draait niet alles om deadlines, tekeningen en projectoverleggen. Er blijft ook voldoende tijd over voor het leven buiten CAD. Dit Kun Je Verwachten Een bruto maandsalaris van € 4.500 tot € 6.000. 22 vakantiedagen en 13 ATV-dagen. Dat zijn samen 35 dagen om even helemaal niet aan technische tekeningen te denken. Mogelijkheden om hybride te werken, inclusief thuiswerkvergoeding. Reiskostenvergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer of gebruik van een zakelijke NS-Business Card. Een pensioenregeling bij Nationale-Nederlanden. Mogelijkheid tot deelname aan een collectieve zorgverzekering via VGZ. Een fietsleaseplan, fitnessregeling en mogelijkheid tot deelname aan een hybride warmtepompplan. Opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden om jouw technische kennis verder uit te bouwen. Afwisselende machinebouwprojecten met ruimte voor innovatieve en duurzame technische oplossingen. Samenwerking met ervaren engineers uit verschillende technische disciplines. Een collegiale werksfeer met ruimte voor eigen initiatief en kennisdeling. Een actieve personeelsvereniging met verschillende activiteiten. Kortom, volop mogelijkheden om technisch verder te groeien, zonder dat je vrije tijd daarvoor hoeft in te leveren. Voorwaarden Je hebt al behoorlijk wat uren in engineeringprojecten zitten en weet dat een goed mechanisch ontwerp verder gaat dan een nette 3D-tekening. Wat breng je mee? Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding Werktuigbouwkunde of een vergelijkbare technische richting. Meerdere jaren relevante ervaring binnen de machinebouw. Ervaring met 3D CAD-software zoals NX, SolidWorks, Creo of Inventor. Het vermogen om zelfstandig mechanische ontwerpen en technische oplossingen uit te werken. Inzicht in projectplanning, budgetten en technische kwaliteit. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels. Bereidheid om wanneer nodig bij klanten op locatie te werken. Ervaring met het begeleiden van junior engineers of het coördineren van technische werkzaamheden is een pre. Je hoeft niet iedere technische oplossing al te kennen. Als je maar weet hoe je tot een goede oplossing komt. En af en toe een stevige technische discussie kunt waarderen. Solliciteren bij Wil je als senior mechanical engineer in Oss werken aan interessante machinebouwprojecten en jouw technische ideeën ook daadwerkelijk terugzien in de praktijk? Neem contact op met Rick Kessels van Multiselect Techniek via 06 117 14 520 of Ik vertel je graag meer over de functie, de projecten en de technische omgeving. Een vrijblijvend gesprek kan altijd. Je hoeft daarvoor gelukkig geen compleet 3D-model van je loopbaan mee te nemen.

title: Development Engineer, Internals
description: Wind power is growing, in every sense of the word. Modvion designs and develops a patented modular wind turbine tower made of laminated wood, engineered to reach higher altitudes and unlock wind resources previously out of reach. Laminated wood, nature's carbon fibre, enables efficient logistics for tall towers while substantially cutting the carbon footprint of wind power. We are moving from proven, single-tower projects into a phase of scaling delivery, and every project we take on right now is a critical step in proving that model to the market. The role A wind turbine tower is more than its structure. Inside it, cables, ladders, platforms, lifts, ventilation, lightning protection and aviation lights all have to fit together, work and be certified. Most internals are developed by the turbine manufacturer, while Modvion develops the parts that are specific to a wooden tower, such as lightning protection, and dehumidification. We are now developing our next tower generation, and the internals need to be right from the start. As Development Engineer you will own the internals system technically through all project phases, from requirements to verified solution in production and in the field. You will: Understand the system, its functions and its many interfaces with the tower and the turbine, and represent it in e.g. design reviews Break down and set the requirement specification for the system, including the requirements we put on the turbine manufacturer Manage the technical relationship with the turbine manufacturer and other suppliers: requirements, design input, reviews and follow up of deliveries Develop Modvion-specific internals, such as lightning protection, dehumidification and ventilation, in line with requirements and together with suppliers Manage the interfaces with other tower systems, manufacturing and installation Secure the technical documentation: specifications, interface descriptions, quality assurance and test reports You will work closely with colleagues in Product Development, Manufacturing, Installation, Quality and Certification, and with our turbine partners. Who You Are You have a degree in mechanical engineering or similar and at least 5 years of experience in product development. You know the mechanical design process from concept to released drawings and have basic CAD skills, preferably in Inventor. You are used to working with large suppliers and partners, setting clear requirements and following them up. You are structured and plan and document your work as a matter of course. You deliver to plan but adapt quickly when plans change, and you enjoy working with skilled colleagues and suppliers. You are fluent in English, written and spoken. It is a merit if you have experience of: Wind turbine internals or interfaces to turbine manufacturers Mechanical packaging and CAD assembly management, e.g. space claims, interfaces and coordination Lightning protection, ventilation or climate control Requirements management Wind power or another regulated industry What we offer First of all we offer a meaningful, challenging, and fun everyday job. We also offer you: Flexibility and freedom with your responsibilities, we trust our team to do a great job Wellness hour, meaning you’re free to exercise one workhour every week Planning your daily work to fit with your life Gym and table tennis at work Health and wellness allowance ‘Friskvårdsbidrag’ Team activities and more! The position is based at our office and R&D factory in Gothenburg. We like to meet and work together most of the time, but it’s possible to work from home and use flexible hours when needed. Does it sound like you? If you are ready to take on a new challenge and explore the next generation of wooden wind turbine towers, then you have come to the right place. Come join us!

title: Development Engineer, Sealing & Coating
description: Wind power is growing, in every sense of the word. Modvion designs and develops a patented modular wind turbine tower made of laminated wood, engineered to reach higher altitudes and unlock wind resources previously out of reach. Laminated wood, nature's carbon fibre, enables efficient logistics for tall towers while substantially cutting the carbon footprint of wind power. We are moving from proven, single-tower projects into a phase of scaling delivery, and every project we take on right now is a critical step in proving that model to the market. The role Wood is a fantastic material, as long as it is properly protected from moisture. Our weather protection system keeps the moisture content of the tower stable over its full service life. The system works, and now it needs to work at scale: better, faster, easier to apply in the factory and on site, and verified for the long term. As Development Engineer you will own the system technically through all project phases, from requirements to verified solution in production and in the field. You will: Understand the system, its functions and its interfaces with the rest of the tower, and represent it in e.g. design reviews Break down and set the requirement specification for the system Further develop technical solutions in line with requirements, and plan and run tests to verify them, e.g. adhesion, ageing and moisture testing Secure the technical documentation: specifications, process descriptions, quality assurance and test reports Work with coating and sealant suppliers, from material selection to follow up of deliveries Support manufacturing, installation and service with application methods, inspection and repair You will work closely with colleagues in Product Development, Manufacturing, Installation, Quality and Certification. Who You Are You have a degree in materials, chemistry, mechanical engineering or similar, and at least 5 years of experience as an engineer in product development. You like to dig deep in technical challenges and to see your solutions through to production. You are structured. Planning your work and documenting comes naturally. You deliver to plan, but you can change direction fast when needed. You enjoy coordinating and collaborating with skilled colleagues and suppliers. You are fluent in English, written and spoken. It is a merit if you have experience of: Coatings, sealants or adhesives, especially on wood or composites Durability and ageing testing of materials, and relevant standards Industrial application processes and quality control Rapid prototyping and 3D printing CAD, preferably Inventor Wind power or another regulated industry What we offer First of all we offer a meaningful, challenging, and fun everyday job. We also offer you: Flexibility and freedom with your responsibilities, we trust our team to do a great job Wellness hour, meaning you’re free to exercise one workhour every week Planning your daily work to fit with your life Gym and table tennis at work Health and wellness allowance ‘Friskvårdsbidrag’ Team activities and more! The position is based at our office and R&D factory in Gothenburg. We like to meet and work together most of the time, but it’s possible to work from home and use flexible hours when needed. Does it sound like you? If you are ready to take on a new challenge and explore the next generation of wooden wind turbine towers then you have come to the right place. Come join us!

They're looking for a talented Mechanical Design Engineer / Product Design Engineer who combines strong technical engineering skills with creativity, curiosity and a genuine passion for designing great products. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys solving difficult engineering problems, challenging conventional thinking and turning ideas into real, working products. The business is developing sophisticated electromechanical systems and moving from prototype development into larger-scale manufacturing. As part of a growing engineering team, you'll have the opportunity to influence product design from the earliest stages, through development, testing and ultimately production. We're not necessarily looking for someone who has designed exactly the same products before. We're looking for someone who can think creatively, solve problems and has the engineering ability to bring their ideas to life. What You'll Be Doing Take ownership of mechanical design projects, from initial concepts and ideas through to detailed design, prototyping and production. Develop innovative mechanical solutions for complex, high-performance products and assemblies. Use 3D CAD software to design components, mechanisms and integrated mechanical systems. Explore different design approaches, balancing performance, materials, manufacturing feasibility and cost. Apply mechanical engineering principles to solve challenges involving structural integrity, thermal performance, vibration and precision components. Work closely with engineers across mechanical, electronics and other technical disciplines to develop integrated products. Build, test and refine prototypes, using real-world results to improve your designs. Contribute ideas and challenge existing approaches to help develop better-performing products. Collaborate with suppliers and manufacturing teams to ensure designs can be produced reliably and efficiently. Play an active role in shaping new products as the business continues to grow. What We're Looking For We're particularly interested in engineers who enjoy the creative side of engineering as much as the technical challenges. You might currently be working as a Mechanical Design Engineer, Product Design Engineer, Design Engineer or Senior Mechanical Engineer. What matters most is your ability to develop ideas and turn them into technically sound, practical designs. Ideally, you'll bring: Strong hands-on mechanical design experience, with a track record of developing products or mechanical systems. Excellent 3D CAD skills, ideally SolidWorks or equivalent. A good understanding of mechanical engineering principles, materials, tolerancing and manufacturing processes. Experience taking designs through prototyping, testing and design iteration. The ability to work through complex engineering challenges and develop creative, practical solutions. An understanding of structural analysis, FEA or thermal considerations, or the technical foundations to develop these skills. A proactive, curious approach to engineering, with the confidence to suggest new ideas and challenge existing thinking. Experience working collaboratively with other engineering disciplines. Backgrounds We're Interested In We're open-minded about where you've developed your experience. You could come from: Mechanical / Product Design: Innovative consumer products, complex mechanisms or technically demanding product development. Automotive / Motorsport: Powertrain components, precision assemblies, lightweight structures or performance engineering. Robotics / Automation: Electromechanical systems, actuators, motion control or mechanical mechanisms. Electric Motors / Rotating Machinery: Motor assemblies, bearings, shafts, housings or high-speed rotating components. Aerospace / Advanced Manufacturing: Lightweight mechanical structures, propulsion systems or precision-engineered products. Experience in electric motors, rotating machinery or propulsion would be particularly interesting, but it's not essential if you can demonstrate strong mechanical design ability, creative problem-solving and the aptitude to learn. Why This Role? This is a fantastic opportunity for an engineer who wants more than simply working through a predefined set of design requirements. You'll be joining a growing business where engineering ideas are encouraged, individual contributions matter and you'll have genuine ownership of the products you develop. You'll have the opportunity to: Work on technically challenging products and innovative engineering projects. Take designs from initial ideas through to real, manufactured products. Collaborate with a talented, multidisciplinary engineering team. Develop specialist knowledge in advanced electromechanical and propulsion technologies. Influence product design decisions and contribute to the direction of future developments. Join a business at an exciting stage of growth, with significant opportunities to make an impact. Interested? If you're a creative, technically capable Mechanical Design Engineer or Product Design Engineer who loves solving engineering challenges and seeing your ideas become reality, we'd love to hear from you. You don't need to have worked in aerospace or propulsion before. We're just as interested in your ideas, engineering ability and potential. Apply now or get in touch for a confidential conversation.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer (OptiArray)
description: Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on. Within our Underwater Security business we develop sensing technologies that help detect and monitor underwater threats. Our solutions include OptiBarrier, designed for immediate, over-the-horizon threat detection, and OptiArray, our low-power optical thin-line towed array for unmanned underwater vehicles and submarines. The Role As a Senior Mechanical Engineer at Optics11, you are responsible for the development and engineering realization of the OptiArray system. Your primary objective is to develop robust, structural, easy to manufacture solutions that ensure the array can be easily manufactured, deployed, and operated throughout their intended service life. You translate allocated product and system requirements into engineering solutions that provide structural integrity, mechanical robustness, corrosion resistance, manufacturability, and reliable offshore deployment. You work closely with Product System Engineering, Product Integration, Verification & Validation, Lifecycle Engineering, manufacturing partners, offshore contractors, and specialized suppliers to ensure the array is successfully developed and realized as part of the overall product. Responsibilities Develop and realize the OptiArray subsystems throughout the product development lifecycle. Translate allocated product and system requirements into robust, easy to manufacture structural solutions for offshore deployment and long-term subsea operation. Integrate subsystem assemblies / design into a functioning, robust product. Adapt structural designs to accommodate varying sea conditions and deployment environments while maintaining product integrity and standardization where possible. Produce subsystem specifications, engineering drawings, interface documentation, calculations, and design records. Improve subsystem robustness, manufacturability, maintainability, and lifecycle performance throughout development. Develop prototypes and engineering models to evaluate structural performance and manufacturability. Perform engineering analyses and testing to evaluate structural integrity, lifting loads, fatigue performance, hydrodynamic behaviour, and environmental robustness. Join design reviews, DFMEA sessions of submodules. Give input to improve overall system performance / to meet system requirements. Support Verification & Validation by providing technical expertise during structural verification and qualification activities. Support fabrication suppliers and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) activities by providing technical expertise and assessing structural assemblies against engineering specifications. Share engineering knowledge, lessons learned, and best practices to strengthen team capability and improve future engineering execution. Provide constructive feedback and support peers in solving technical challenges. Contribute to a collaborative and knowledge-sharing engineering culture. What We Offer Join one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech scale-ups. Real impact: your work directly shapes our growth and success. A great team in an international organization with colleagues from more than twenty nationalities. A competitive salary and benefits package. 30 days of holiday per year. Fresh team lunches five times a week, plus regular team activities and company events. Requirements BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering, or related engineering discipline. Minimum 5 years of experience developing mechanical systems that are used in harsh environments. Hands on design experience for systems / products that requires qualification against military (environmental) standards. Proficiency in working with SolidWorks or equivalent CAD systems to develop and review mechanical designs, assemblies, engineering drawings, and technical documentation. Experience designing marine products or subsea mechanical systems. Experience performing structural calculations, load analysis, fatigue assessment, and mechanical interface design. Experience working with fabrication suppliers and manufacturing partners. Experience working within multidisciplinary product development teams. Strong analytical and structured engineering problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Eligible to obtain EU/NATO security clearance. Preferred Experience with corrosion protection, cathodic protection, offshore coatings, or subsea structural design. Hands-on experience with SolidWorks for mechanical design, assembly modelling, and detailed production drawings. Experience taking ownership of a system or significant technical workstream within multidisciplinary engineering projects. Familiarity with systems engineering, product lifecycle management, verification, and configuration management. Screening You will work with clients in the defense and security sectors. Obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD, the Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service, is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. We will explain the process and guide you through the applicable requirements.

title: Mechanical Engineer Defensie
description: Wil jij mechanische systemen ontwerpen en vervolgens in de werkplaats zien hoe jouw ontwerp wordt gebouwd? Als mechanical engineer werk je aan maatwerksystemen voor onder andere sorteerinstallaties, mobiele datacenters en defensietoepassingen. Je vertaalt de klantvraag naar een ontwerp dat technisch klopt én goed te produceren is. Wat ga je doen? Je bent betrokken van het eerste concept tot de bouw en installatie. Je werkt mechanische ontwerpen uit, voert berekeningen uit en kiest passende materialen en productietechnieken. Daarbij stem je af met collega’s, leveranciers en klanten. Tijdens de bouw blijf je betrokken. Je ondersteunt de werkplaats en buitendienst bij technische vragen en kijkt mee wanneer een ontwerp moet worden aangepast. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Vertalen van klanteisen naar mechanische ontwerpen en 3D-modellen; Uitwerken van ontwerpen en productietekeningen in Solid Edge; Uitvoeren van sterkteberekeningen en FEM-analyses; Selecteren van materialen en productietechnieken; Meewerken aan prototypes en testopstellingen; Afstemmen van technische oplossingen met collega’s, leveranciers en klanten; Ondersteunen bij de bouw en installatie van systemen. Wat breng jij mee? Je denkt graag na over hoe een systeem werkt, maar ook over hoe het gemaakt en gemonteerd wordt. Je kunt zelfstandig ontwerpen uitwerken en zoekt collega’s op wanneer je hun kennis nodig hebt. Daarnaast heb je: Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbaar; Ervaring met Solid Edge en het maken van productietekeningen; Kennis van constructieberekeningen en FEM-analyses; Affiniteit met machinebouw, plaatwerk en modulaire systemen; Een goede beheersing van Nederlands en Engels. Duits is een pluspunt. Waar ga je werken? Je gaat aan de slag bij een technische organisatie die complete maatwerksystemen ontwikkelt en bouwt. Ontwerp, productie en assemblage komen hier samen. Daardoor kun je direct afstemmen met de collega’s die jouw ontwerpen realiseren. De projecten lopen uiteen van industriële installaties tot mobiele technische oplossingen en defensiesystemen. Je werkt samen met ruim 100 collega’s in een organisatie met een toegankelijke directie, korte lijnen en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Wat krijg je ervoor terug? Een functie voor 32–40 uur per week, zonder ploegendienst; Salaris, arbeidsvoorwaarden en pensioen volgens de cao Metaal & Techniek, Technisch Installatiebedrijf; Uitzicht op een vast contract; Vrijheid en vertrouwen om je werk zelfstandig uit te voeren; Opleidingsmogelijkheden en kansen om intern door te groeien; Korting op een fitnessabonnement en dagelijks fruit; De mogelijkheid om je ontwerpen van concept tot gebouwd systeem te volgen. Interesse? Wil je meer weten over de projecten, het team of de arbeidsvoorwaarden? Neem dan contact op met Thijs van Talentials via thijs@talentials.com of 06-31348661. Hij vertelt je graag meer over de functie en het bedrijf.

title: Lead Engineer - Mechanical Engineering
description: Job Description Summary Become part of a winning team and help to deliver the Green Energy transition. As a Lead Mechanical Engineer, you will work within the HVDC Valve Engineering team within the Solution Line (SL) of Grid Systems Integration (GSI) in GE Vernova. The purpose of the role is to lead the design and analysis of mechanical systems and structures for our HVDC Valve products that must meet stringent requirements. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including electrical engineers, cooling engineers, and external compliance experts to ensure that our products are robust, compliant, and manufacturable. You will lead the delivery of the relevant aspects of assigned projects through design, investigation, testing and analysis. Collaborate with sourcing and third-party suppliers to ensure GE get best value and drive the delivery. Lead specification and design reviews for compliance with internal, regional and global standards. The role gives an excellent opportunity for a motivated candidate to innovate, expand their skills and personal development within an internationally recognised expert in this exciting field. Whilst ideally based at the HVDC Centre of Excellence in Stafford this role could be located at any of the GE sites. This role offers hybrid working (3 days required on site in Stafford) Job Description Role Purpose As a Lead Mechanical Engineer, you will drive the mechanical design, analysis, and testing of complex mechanical systems and structures for our HVDC Valve products. Operating within a collaborative cross-functional environment, you will partner with electrical engineers, cooling specialists, and compliance experts to ensure our products are robust, safety-compliant, and optimised for manufacturing. Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership: Lead the mechanical design, investigation, testing, and analysis of assigned HVDC Valve projects from concept through delivery. Design & Compliance: Spearhead technical specifications and design reviews to ensure strict adherence to internal, regional, and global engineering standards. Supplier Collaboration: Work closely with Sourcing and third-party suppliers to drive timely delivery, quality, and cost-competitiveness. Cross-Functional Integration: Collaborate seamlessly with electrical, thermal/cooling, and EHS teams to deliver fully integrated, compliant, and manufacturable designs. Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Contribute to New Product Introduction (NPI) and R&D programs, advancing state-of-the-art HVDC technology. HVDC Valves In an HVDC system, converter stations sit at both ends of a high-voltage transmission line to convert Alternating Current (AC) to Direct Current (DC) and back again. The valve is the heart of this converter station. It consists of stacks of high-power semiconductors (such as Thyristors for Line Commutated Converters/LCC, or IGBTs for Voltage Source Converters/VSC) that switch at extremely high speeds and voltages to control massive blocks of power. GE’s Core HVDC Valve Technologies GE Vernova delivers both major types of HVDC converter technologies, each presenting distinct mechanical engineering challenges: VSC (Voltage Sourced Converter) Valves — e.g., GE’s MMC (Modular Multilevel Converter) technology: Modern VSC-HVDC uses a series of modular submodules (essentially small, independent inverter cells containing capacitors and IGBTs) stacked together like building blocks. Mechanical Challenges: Hundreds of submodules must be housed in robust structural racks (valve towers). Each module requires precise mechanical integration, internal busbar routing, secure capacitor mounting, and reliable fluid connections for cooling. LCC (Line Commutated Converter) / Classic HVDC Valves: Traditional, high-capacity thyristor-based valves used for point-to-point bulk power transmission (often over very long distances or underwater cables). Mechanical Challenges: These involve massive physical structures suspended or supported to handle extreme seismic requirements, high-voltage clearances, and complex direct-water cooling circuits handling high water pressures. Candidate Profile & Qualifications While a degree in Mechanical Engineering (or equivalent) is preferred, proven track record and demonstrated hands-on experience in a similar technical domain are our highest priorities. Required Skills & Experience Extensive experience in the mechanical design, integration, and testing of complex electrical or mechanical equipment. Advanced proficiency in CAD software (Creo preferred) and FEA simulation tools (ANSYS preferred). Exceptional ability to create, read, and interpret complex technical drawings and GD&T. An advanced EHS (Environment, Health & Safety) mindset with a track record of applying safety-by-design principles. Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders. Desired Characteristics Prior industry experience in electrical transmission, HVDC, power electronics, or heavy manufacturing. Formal qualifications or demonstrated experience in technical leadership or project management. Direct involvement in New Product Introduction (NPI) and R&D lifecycles. High attention to detail and a passion for engineering excellence. Willingness and ability to travel globally for short periods as needed. About Us GE Vernova is a world leader in the energy solutions market with a portfolio of energy businesses across the globe. Grid Solutions provides equipment, systems, and services to bring power reliably and efficiently from the point of generation to end power consumers. We electrify the world with advanced grid technologies and accelerate the energy transition – and we want you to be part of that change and enjoy imagination at work. If an existing configuration is not optimal, we need someone with agency who will flag, and provide a better alternative. Collaboration throughout the product lifecycle, from R&D design, all of the way through to field deployment. title: JUNIOR PROCESS ENGINEER - BoP (Balance of Plant)
description: Fondata nel 1876, Franco Tosi Meccanica è una delle aziende italiane più storiche e prestigiose nel settore della meccanica pesante. Con sede a Legnano, in provincia di Milano, l’azienda è specializzata nella progettazione, produzione e manutenzione di turbine a vapore, turbine a gas, compressori e altri macchinari industriali. Franco Tosi Meccanica è stata acquisita da Alberto Presezzi, un imprenditore con una lunga esperienza nel settore industriale. Questa acquisizione ha segnato un nuovo capitolo nella storia dell’azienda, portando nuove risorse, competenze e una visione rinnovata per il futuro Sotto la nuova gestione, Franco Tosi Meccanica continua a investire in ricerca e sviluppo per migliorare l’efficienza e la sostenibilità dei propri prodotti. L’azienda è impegnata nella riduzione dell’impatto ambientale delle proprie attività e nella promozione di pratiche sostenibili. Con oltre un secolo di esperienza e una nuova guida, Franco Tosi Meccanica continua a essere un punto di riferimento nel settore della meccanica pesante, offrendo soluzioni innovative e di alta qualità ai propri clienti in tutto il mondo. Posizione: All'interno dell'unità organizzativa BoP (Balance of Plant) , sviluppiamo soluzioni e componenti ausiliari a supporto di impianti equipaggiati con turbine a vapore, turbine idrauliche, turbine a gas e compressori. Per potenziare il nostro team, siamo alla ricerca di un/a Junior Process Engineer , motivato/a a intraprendere un percorso di crescita professionale in un contesto dinamico e altamente tecnologico. La risorsa sarà affiancata da ingegneri senior e coinvolta progressivamente nelle attività di progettazione di processo, acquisendo competenze tecniche e metodologiche attraverso formazione on-the-job e partecipazione a progetti internazionali. In affiancamento al team di ingegneria e sotto la guida di professionisti esperti, il/la Junior Process Engineer si occuperà di: Supportare le attività di progettazione di base di apparecchiature e sistemi ausiliari per impianti di generazione di energia. Collaborare alla preparazione e all'aggiornamento di schemi di processo e P&ID (Piping & Instrumentation Diagrams) . Supportare le attività di dimensionamento preliminare delle linee di processo e di selezione delle valvole. Partecipare alla preparazione delle specifiche tecniche per richieste di offerta e valutazioni preliminari della documentazione tecnica dei fornitori. Collaborare al monitoraggio delle attività tecniche dei fornitori durante le diverse fasi di progetto. Interfacciarsi con team multidisciplinari per sviluppare soluzioni tecniche efficaci e innovative. Contribuire all'analisi e alla risoluzione di problematiche tecniche, sviluppando progressivamente autonomia e competenze specialistiche. Essere disponibile a brevi trasferte presso clienti, fornitori e sedi aziendali in Italia e all'estero. Requisiti: Quali caratteristiche ricerchiamo: Laurea triennale o magistrale in Ingegneria Meccanica, Energetica, Chimica, Aeronautica o discipline affini. Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, sia scritta che parlata. Interesse per il settore dell'energia, dell'impiantistica industriale e delle tecnologie di processo. Attitudine al lavoro in team, curiosità tecnica e forte motivazione all'apprendimento. Capacità di analisi e organizzazione del lavoro. Saranno considerati titoli preferenziali: Esperienze di tirocinio curricolare o extracurricolare in ambito impiantistico, energetico, Oil & Gas o industriale. Attività di tesi, project work universitari o progetti accademici coerenti con il ruolo. Conoscenza degli standard tecnici ANSI, ASME, EN, DIN e PED . Conoscenza di turbomacchine e dei principali sistemi ausiliari di impianto. Utilizzo di AutoCAD o software CAD equivalenti. Conoscenza del settore Oil & Gas, Energy o Process Engineering. Altre informazioni: Cosa offriamo Inserimento in un contesto internazionale e orientato all'innovazione. Programma di formazione tecnica e affiancamento continuo Coinvolgimento diretto in progetti complessi e multidisciplinari nel settore della generazione di energia. Percorso di crescita professionale strutturato, con possibilità di specializzazione nell'ingegneria di processo e negli impianti energetici. Opportunità di collaborazione con clienti e fornitori internazionali. Ambiente di lavoro dinamico, collaborativo e orientato allo sviluppo delle competenze. Se sei un/a neolaureato/a con passione per l'ingegneria e desideri costruire la tua carriera nel settore energetico, questa è l'opportunità ideale per entrare a far parte di un team di professionisti e contribuire allo sviluppo di progetti innovativi su scala globale.

title: Mechatronics Engineer (m/f/d)
description: Job description ATMOS Works is seeking a Mechatronics Engineer (m/f/d) with strong hands-on experience in developing, integrating, and testing electro-mechanical aerospace hardware. In this role, you will work at the interface of mechanical design, electronics, sensors, actuators, and embedded systems to help bring complex aerospace systems from concept through production and qualification. Key responsibilities You will develop, integrate, and refine mechatronic systems from concept through production, ensuring technical, functional, and space-qualification requirements are met. You will design and validate electro-mechanical assemblies, including mechanisms, actuators, sensors, interfaces, and supporting structures. You will create and review 3D CAD models, technical drawings, and assembly documentation, preferably in SolidWorks. You will support prototype builds, assembly, troubleshooting, and test campaigns, including functional, mechanical, structural, and environmental testing. You will collaborate with systems, avionics, software, propulsion, manufacturing teams, and suppliers to ensure seamless integration, documentation, quality, and compliance. Requirements Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechatronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field. Experience in mechatronic system development, hardware integration, testing, prototyping, or mechanical design through internships, working student roles, university projects, or an entry-level engineering position. Good understanding of mechanical design, electro-mechanical systems, sensors, actuators, basic electrical interfaces, materials, and manufacturing processes. Experience with 3D CAD modelling and technical drawings; SolidWorks experience is a strong plus. Strong written and spoken German; English is a strong plus, combined with a structured, proactive, and hands-on working style. P lease note that we can only consider applicants who are nationals of an EU member state* ATMOS Works is a dedicated business unit of ATMOS Space Cargo, based in Kraków, with a business unit in Lichtenau, established to serve European government and defence customers. ATMOS Works develops and operates dual-use orbital capabilities, including the secure, sovereign return of sensitive hardware and data, in-orbit demonstration and validation (IOD/IOV), and advanced space systems. Company description ATMOS was founded as a European company built on the values of freedom, democracy, equality, the rule of law, and human rights. We are committed to protect these values by making our technology available to others who share the same values, strengthening infrastructure and innovation for prosperity on Earth. Our team is multinational and diverse, with offices in Lichtenau and Strasbourg. We work in a collegial, hands-on culture where people support each other, take ownership, and keep learning every day. Motivation for the mission comes first — building spacecraft is not a nine-to-five pursuit. We align the mission, the team, and the individual in mutual dependence. This principle shapes our work environment where exceptional people, as committed as they are competent, can grow and contribute to a mission that matters.

description: About Pangea Propulsion: We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems. Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade. We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry. You will own analysis campaigns end-to-end: from problem framing, modelling, validation, to results interpretation and design recommendations - directly influencing the architecture, performance, and robustness of the next generation of propulsion systems. Within the team, you will serve as a technical reference point for advanced structural analysis methods , help shape internal best practices, and elevate the quality of analyses across projects. A core part of your role will be coaching and guiding junior and consolidated analysts, transferring knowledge, reviewing technical work, and contributing to a high-performance engineering culture. Key Responsibilities Perform and lead FEA campaigns including static, modal, thermo-mechanical, dynamic and transient analyses, dealing efficiently with non-linear problems (contacts, plasticity, large deformation etc.) Plan, build, verify, document and maintain high-fidelity and robust FE models with traceability to loads, material properties, requirements, and assumptions. Provide clear, high-impact design feedback to mechanical design and propulsion teams at both part and subsystem level. Develop and improve analysis methodologies, scripts, subroutines, benchmarks, and guidelines. Lead cross disciplinary interactions with mechanical design, fluidic analysis, and test teams to ensure coherent modelling strategies and proper load mapping. Participate in design reviews, presenting methods, assumptions, results, and recommendations with clarity, conciseness and technical rigor. Mentor junior and consolidated engineers, helping them develop modelling skills, physics intuition, validation strategies, and efficient workflows. Review and challenge analysis approaches to ensure modelling robustness and consistency across projects. What You Need To Be Successful Experience in the aviation or space industry is strongly preferred. Master’s degree (or higher) in Aerospace, Mechanical, or related engineering disciplines. Minimum 5+ years of professional experience performing advanced structural analyses using commercial FEA tools (preferably Abaqus). Proven ability to run non-linear, thermo-mechanical, and dynamic analyses with a high level of autonomy and technical ownership. Strong understanding of structural mechanics, vibrations, fatigue, fracture, material behavior, and numerical methods. Demonstrated experience framing analysis problems, defining assumptions, and ensuring consistency with loads and system requirements. Ability to interpret results critically, identify anomalies, and propose sound engineering solutions. Excellent communication skills—able to articulate assumptions, limitations, and design implications clearly to multidisciplinary teams. Proactive mindset, ownership attitude, and passion for sharing knowledge and elevating team capability. Fluent English. Other Useful Skills Experience in any of the following topics: fatigue (high cycle and low cycle), fracture mechanics, rotodynamics, test-correlation, topology optimization or probabilistic structural methods. Knowledge of rocket propulsion systems: injector heads, thrust chambers, turbomachinery, feed systems, thermal & dynamic environments, etc. Proficiency with meshing tools (e.g., MeshWorks) and scripting languages (Python, MATLAB). Experience writing Abaqus subroutines (UMAT, USDFLD, UEL, etc.). Experience working with ECSS, AIAA and other aerospace structural verification standards. Not hitting every requirement?
