title: Ingénieur Calculs Mécanique (H/F)
description: À propos de MCA MCA est un Groupe de Conseil en Ingénierie et Hautes Technologies qui compte 800 collaborateurs en France et à l’International. Fort de nos 30 ans d’expérience, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la réalisation de leurs projets d'envergure. Nous rejoindre, c'est intégrer une entreprise dynamique qui a à cœur de faire grandir ses collaborateurs via un suivi personnalisé et des formations régulières. Nous recherchons un Ingénieur Calculs Mécanique (H/F) pour intervenir sur des projets techniques à forte valeur ajoutée dans les secteurs du Nucléaire et de la Défense, à Aix-en-Provence. 📍 Localisation : Aix-en-Provence (13) – Bouches-du-Rhône 📄 Contrat : CDI 🚀 Démarrage : Dès que possible Études & Calculs Mécaniques Réaliser des études de calcul et de dimensionnement mécanique dans le cadre de projets industriels complexes. Effectuer des analyses de résistance des matériaux et vérifier la tenue mécanique des structures et équipements. Réaliser des simulations numériques afin d'évaluer le comportement mécanique des systèmes étudiés. Modélisation & Validation Technique Développer et exploiter des modèles de calcul à l'aide de logiciels de simulation numérique. Analyser et interpréter les résultats afin de garantir la conformité aux exigences techniques et réglementaires. Proposer des solutions d'optimisation pour améliorer la fiabilité et les performances des équipements. Documentation & Suivi Technique Rédiger les notes de calcul et les rapports techniques associés aux études réalisées. Participer aux revues techniques et à la validation des solutions proposées. Collaborer avec les équipes d'ingénierie dans le respect des exigences de qualité, de sécurité et de confidentialité. Environnement Technique Logiciels de calcul : ANSYS, APDL, Abaqus, Robot Structural Analysis Méthodes de calcul : Résistance des matériaux (RDM), calcul par éléments finis (FEM/FEA) Calculs mécaniques : Contraintes, déformations, flambage, fatigue, flexion, cisaillement, vibrations Équipements étudiés : Structures métalliques, supportages de tuyauteries, équipements mécaniques Référentiels techniques : Normes et codes de calcul applicables aux installations nucléaires et aux équipements de défense Rémunération & Avantages Rémunération : Salaire fixe de 40 k€ à 55 k€ (selon profil et expérience) Santé & Prévoyance : Mutuelle attractive (prise en charge à 50 %) et prévoyance (prise en charge à 100 %) 12 jours de RTT par an Transports & Repas : Prise en charge des titres de transport à 75 % et tickets restaurant à 60 % Prime de participation aux bénéfices Prime de vacances (Convention collective Syntec) Dispositifs de primes de cooptation et d'apport d'affaires Profils Recherchés Formation : Diplôme d'ingénieur ou BAC+5 en mécanique, calcul de structures ou équivalent. Expérience : Première expérience significative en calcul mécanique, idéalement dans le nucléaire, la défense ou l'industrie. Compétences techniques : Maîtrise d'au moins un logiciel de calcul parmi ANSYS, APDL, Abaqus ou Robot Structural Analysis. Connaissances : Bonne maîtrise de la RDM, du dimensionnement mécanique et des méthodes de calcul par éléments finis. Le Processus De Recrutement Premier contact téléphonique avec un(e) recruteur(se). Échange approfondi (Teams ou physique) avec notre Business Manager. Rencontre finale avec notre Directeur d'agence et présentation chez notre client.

title: Lead Calcul Mécanique Aéronautique
description: Capgemini Engineering, leader mondial des services d'ingénierie, rassemble des équipes d'ingénieurs, de scientifiques et d'architectes pour aider les entreprises les plus innovantes dans le monde à libérer leur potentiel. Des voitures autonomes aux robots qui sauvent des vies, nos experts en technologies digitales et logicielles sortent des sentiers battus en fournissant des services uniques de R&D et d'ingénierie dans tous les secteurs d'activité. Accompagner les ingénieurs calcul dans leur formation et montée en compétence, répartition du temps de travail et faire le lien avec les parties prenantes du projet. Votre Profil De formation Bac +5, Ingénieur en mécanique, vous justifiez à minima de 5 années d'expérience en Calculs de Structures et/ou de dimensionnement mécanique par simulation numérique (calculs aux éléments finis). Vous connaissez le calcul par éléments finis de manière général (la maîtrise des logiciels SAMCEF et/ou HYPERMESH sont un plus) ainsi que la prise en compte de la fatigue mécanique. Vous justifiez de bonnes capacités rédactionnelles, primordiales dans les prestations abordées Vous êtes capable de faire monter en compétence/accompagner une petite équipe sur des aspects techniques et organisation du travail 3 raisons de nous rejoindre Qualité de vie au travail : accord de télétravail en France et à l’international, accord sur l’égalité professionnelle, la parentalité, l’équilibre des temps et la mobilité durable. Apprentissage en continu : certifications et formations en libre accès, accompagnement sur mesure avec votre career manager, parcours d’intégration sur 9 mois. Avantages groupe & CSE : plan actionnariat, activités à tarifs préférentiels, remboursement partiel vacances, remboursement de votre abonnement sportif ou culturel. Nos engagements et priorités Le groupe Capgemini encourage une culture inclusive dans un cadre multiculturel et handi-accueillant. En nous rejoignant, vous intégrez un collectif qui valorise la diversité, développe le potentiel de ses talents, s’engage dans des initiatives solidaires avec ses partenaires, et se mobilise pour réduire son impact environnemental sur tous ses sites et auprès de ses clients. Leader mondial des services d’ingénierie et de R&D, Capgemini Engineering met en oeuvre une connaissance sectorielle approfondie avec la maîtrise des dernières technologies digitales et logicielles pour accompagner la convergence des mondes physique et numérique. Avec plus de 55 000 ingénieurs et scientifiques dans plus de 30 pays, nous aidons nos clients à accélérer leur transformation vers l'Intelligent Industry. Makine elemanları, güç aktarım sistemleri, motor, redüktör, rulman, mil, yataklama, kayış-kasnak ve dişli mekanizmaları konusunda bilgi sahibi. Mil, rulman ve yataklama hesapları yapabilen. Teknik konularda araştırma yapmaya ve çözüm geliştirmeye istekli. Ekip çalışmasına yatkın, iletişim ve organizasyon becerileri gelişmiş. Sorumluluk alabilen ve iş süreçlerini takip edebilen. (ASME, API, EN, etc.) • Continuously monitors technological/sectoral innovations related to their field and changes in legislation and standards related to the work they are responsible for, • Able to reside or be mobile in Aliağa/İzmir. title: Process Engineer
description: Job descriptions may display in multiple languages based on your language selection. What We Offer At Magna, you can expect an engaging and dynamic environment where you can help to develop industry-leading automotive technologies. We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Because we believe that your career path should be as unique as you are. Group Summary The Magna Exteriors portfolio of products includes access systems such as liftgates, exterior trim, modular systems, front-end modules including fascia, active aerodynamic systems and other lightweight structural components for automotive, commercial truck and other industrial markets. Recognized globally as an innovator in all aspects of vehicle exteriors, Magna provides everything needed, from materials development and design through manufacturing and assembly, to help automakers create sleek, state-of-the-art vehicles across the world. Job Responsibilities Job Description: Identify production needs and design cost-effective processes for new products, Develop and update process documentation, work instructions, and standards, Ensure product and process quality meets specifications, Assist in shop floor layout, assembly tooling, and workflow optimization, Implement continuous improvement initiatives and problem-solving activities, Support machinery/equipment installation and process validation, Train production staff on new processes and technologies, Analyze production performance and propose efficiency/cost improvements. title: Field Application Engineer

description: The Impact You'll Make Heat transfer technology affects our daily life without many of us ever noticing it. From keeping data centers cool and ships operating efficiently to supporting food production, district energy systems, and industrial processes, heat exchangers play a critical role in how energy is used across the world. As our new Heat Plate Design Engineer , you will help shape the technology at the heart of these systems. The heat transfer plate is the most important component in a Gasketed Plate Heat Exchanger (GPHE), determining its thermal performance, efficiency, reliability, and manufacturability. Working at the intersection of design, simulation, testing, and manufacturing, you will develop the next generation of heat transfer plates that enable customers to do more with less energy. Your work will directly influence product performance, sustainability, and the competitiveness of our global GPHE portfolio. What You’ll Be Doing As part of our GPHE New Product Development team, you will collaborate closely with specialists across engineering, testing, and manufacturing to develop high-performing and reliable product solutions. You Will Design and optimize heat transfer plate geometry, including flow patterns, distribution areas, ports, contact points, pressing depth, and alignment features Drive product development activities from concept and design through simulation, prototyping, validation, tooling development, and production release Collaborate with heat transfer, fluid mechanics, virtual engineering, laboratory, tooling, and manufacturing teams to achieve performance, reliability, and quality targets Evaluate designs using engineering calculations, 3D CAD, simulation results, testing data, and production feedback to continuously improve product performance Participate in design reviews, DFMEA activities, technical investigations, and new product development projects to identify and resolve engineering challenges Success in this role means delivering robust and manufacturable designs, proactively managing technical risks, and contributing to stronger, more standardized GPHE design practices that can be leveraged across future product platforms. What We're Looking For We're looking for an engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and collaborating across disciplines to develop innovative products. Essential Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, Product Development, or a related engineering discipline Experience with mechanical product design and 3D CAD in an industrial environment Strong understanding of engineering analysis, problem-solving, and structured product development methodologies Ability to collaborate effectively across global, cross-functional teams and communicate technical concepts clearly A proactive and curious mindset with a passion for developing high-quality engineering solutions Preferred Qualifications Experience with sheet metal design, formed components, heat exchangers, pressure equipment, CFD, simulation-driven development, or product validation activities would be an advantage but is not required. What You'll Get From Us You'll join a team developing one of the most critical technologies behind energy-efficient cooling and heating solutions. title: Development Mechanical Assistant
description: Development Mechanical Assistant til Airmaster A/S i Aars Har du erfaring med mekanisk konstruktion? Hos Airmaster får du en nyoprettet stilling, hvor du skal bidrage til at vedligeholde og optimere eksisterende konstruktioner. Du bliver en del af et erfarent konstruktionsteam og får en alsidig hverdag med konkrete tekniske opgaver, tæt kontakt til PTA, indkøb og produktionen samt mulighed for at præge din egen rolle. Om virksomheden Airmaster A/S er en dansk udviklings- og produktionsvirksomhed med hovedsæde i Aars og speciale i decentral ventilation. Siden etableringen i 1991 har virksomheden udviklet energieffektive ventilationsløsninger med fokus på at skabe et sundt indeklima med lav miljøpåvirkning. I dag har Airmaster mere end 120.000 installerede enheder globalt. Udvikling og teknologi er en central del af Airmasters forretning, og mere end 10 % af medarbejderne arbejder med produktudvikling. Hovedkontor, R&D og produktion er samlet i Aars, og virksomheden indgår som en selvstændig del af Lindab Group. Kulturen bygger på værdierne Ordentlighed, Sammenhold, Frihed og Dedikation og er præget af en flad struktur, høj faglighed og et tæt samarbejde på tværs af organisationen. Læs mere på www.airmaster.dk . Hvad tilbyder vi? Hos Airmaster får du en nyoprettet stilling, hvor du får mulighed for at præge din rolle og være med til at udvikle den over tid. Du bliver en del af et fagligt stærkt og tæt samarbejdende konstruktionsteam, hvor sparring, videndeling og hjælpsomhed er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Du får en alsidig hverdag med selvstændighed i opgaveløsningen og gode muligheder for at trække på erfarne kolleger. Kulturen er præget af en uformel omgangstone, korte kommunikationsveje og et tæt samarbejde på tværs af organisationen. Primære opgaver Som Development Mechanical Assistant bliver din primære opgave at vedligeholde og videreudvikle eksisterende mekaniske konstruktioner og sikre, at det tekniske tegningsmateriale er korrekt og opdateret. Du får en central rolle i at håndtere mindre konstruktionsændringer og tekniske tilpasninger, som understøtter en effektiv produktion og sikrer kvaliteten i Airmasters produkter. Du arbejder tæt sammen med konstruktører, produktion, indkøb og øvrige tekniske funktioner og bidrager desuden til udviklingsprojekter med konkrete konstruktions- og dokumentationsopgaver. Dine primære opgaver bliver bl.a. at: Udarbejde, opdatere og kvalitetssikre 2D-tegninger og teknisk dokumentation. Gennemføre ændringer og tilpasninger af eksisterende mekaniske konstruktioner. Tilpasse konstruktioner og tegningsmateriale ved leverandørskift eller ændrede komponenter. Omsætte input fra produktionen til tekniske forbedringer med fokus på montagevenlighed. Udarbejde teknisk tegningsmateriale til indkøb og leverandører. Bidrage til udviklingsprojekter med konstruktions- og dokumentationsopgaver. Bidrage med opbygning af prototyper og test i vores værksted efter behov. Dine kvalifikationer Vi søger en teknisk velfunderet kollega med praktisk forståelse for mekanisk konstruktion og erfaring med teknisk tegningsarbejde. Du er måske uddannet produktionsteknolog, industritekniker eller har en håndværksmæssig baggrund kombineret med relevant erfaring. Det vigtigste er, at du arbejder struktureret, har øje for detaljen og trives med at løse mange forskellige tekniske opgaver. Vi forestiller os, at du: Gerne har 2-3 års erfaring med mekanisk konstruktion og dokumentation fra en produktionsvirksomhed. Har erfaring med Autodesk Inventor eller SolidWorks og er fortrolig med at udarbejde og ændre tekniske tegninger. Har praktisk forståelse for produktion, montage og mekaniske tyndplade konstruktioner. Arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og omhyggeligt med dine opgaver. Trives med en alsidig hverdag, hvor opgaver og prioriteringer kan ændre sig. Er opsøgende og kommunikerer naturligt med kolleger på tværs af forskellige fagområder. Kan indgå konstruktivt i faglige diskussioner og stå fast på dine tekniske vurderinger. Behersker dansk og engelsk både skriftligt og mundtligt. Ansøgning og kontaktoplysninger Guldbrandsen & Lythje håndterer rekrutteringsprocessen, og du er velkommen til at kontakte Partner Dan Lythje på tlf. 93 84 84 49 eller Partner Lise Guldbrandsen på tlf. 20 67 67 57, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen. Vi indkalder løbende til samtale. Du kan søge stillingen via linket til højre i annoncen.

title: Mekanikkonstruktör
description: VEM söker en tekniskt nyfiken Mekanikkonstruktör till VoltAir System AB. VoltAir utvecklar och tillverkar energieffektiva ventilationslösningar som bidrar till ett bättre inomhusklimat och en mer hållbar fastighetsmiljö. Som en del av Volution Group arbetar företaget kontinuerligt med att utveckla sina produkter och tekniska lösningar. Här får du en utvecklande roll där du får kombinera teknisk kreativitet med produktutveckling och vara med och påverka lösningar som gör verklig skillnad. Om tjänsten Som Mekanikkonstruktör på VoltAir får du en viktig roll i företagets fortsatta produktutveckling, med tyngdpunkten på konstruktionsarbete i SolidWorks. Ditt huvudsakliga fokus är aggregatens invändiga mekaniska uppbyggnad, där du utvecklar konstruktions- och monteringslösningar för att integrera tekniska komponenter såsom fläktar, värmeväxlare och filter till en fungerande och energieffektiv helhet. Med förståelse för hur olika konstruktionsval påverkar produktens prestanda använder du tekniska underlag och beräkningar för att utveckla genomtänkta lösningar med fokus på funktion, kvalitet och kostnadseffektivitet. En del av uppdraget innebär att du blir delaktig i ett koncerngemensamt utvecklingsprojekt för den kommersiella luftbehandlingsmarknaden. Här får du bidra med din konstruktionskompetens och vara med och utveckla nya tekniska lösningar. Rollens huvudsakliga fokus ligger på produktutveckling, där du arbetar med såväl nyutveckling som löpande förbättringar av det befintliga produktsortimentet. Du blir en del av ett konstruktörsteam med kompletterande kompetenser och ansvarsområden, i en tekniknära och prestigelös miljö där konstruktion och produktion arbetar tätt tillsammans. Rollen innebär också ett nära samarbete med tekniska specialister, där du får möjlighet att följa dina lösningar från idé till färdig produkt. Du medverkar även vid prototypframtagning och vidareutveckling av konstruktioner utifrån resultat från provning och nära dialoger med produktionen. Om dig Vi söker dig med en relevant teknisk utbildning inom exempelvis maskinteknik eller produktutveckling, alternativt motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet. Du har flerårig erfarenhet av mekanisk konstruktion i 3D-CAD och är van att självständigt utveckla tekniskt komplexa produkter där flera komponenter och funktioner ska samverka. Du har arbetat med produktutveckling och har en god teknisk förståelse som gör att du kan tolka beräkningar och tekniska underlag och omsätta dem till väl fungerande konstruktionslösningar. Du behärskar både svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Vi ser positivt på erfarenhet av att utvärdera och välja tekniska komponenter utifrån funktion och prestanda. Erfarenhet från ventilationsbranschen är särskilt meriterande. Som person är du analytisk, nyfiken och lösningsorienterad med ett genuint intresse för teknik och produktutveckling. Du tycker om att utmana befintliga lösningar och hitta nya vägar framåt. Du är självgående och ansvarstagande, samtidigt som du är prestigelös och uppskattar att arbeta nära andra kompetenser. Med din förmåga att se både detaljer och helhet bidrar du till ett konstruktivt samarbete och utvecklingen av såväl produkter som arbetssätt. VoltAir tar ordet! På VoltAir utvecklar och tillverkar vi flexibla och energieffektiva luftbehandlingsaggregat som bidrar till renare inomhusluft och hälsosamma miljöer. Med kreativ luftbehandling och smarta tekniska lösningar vill vi göra skillnad för både människor och miljö. Våra produkter utvecklas för att kombinera god funktion, låg energianvändning och lång livslängd. Vi är omkring 40 medarbetare med verksamhet i Nyland, Torsby och Växjö, där vi kombinerar tekniskt kunnande med stort engagemang och nya idéer. Hos oss vill vi skapa en arbetsmiljö där människor känner sig delaktiga, uppskattade och får möjlighet att utvecklas. Design, analyse and iterate mechanical systems, from high-temperature structures and insulation to the interfaces between parts. Plan and run prototype builds and tests, both in the lab and in the field, and turn the results into design decisions. Select and manage suppliers, workshops and test partners. Help hire and lead the engineers who join next. Who you are You are curious. Experience from a startup, hardware scale-up or workshop environment. Knowledge of CE marking, pressure equipment or industrial safety requirements. You are entrepreneurial and want to shape a product and a team, not just execute a spec. What we offer A key role with ownership from day one. The chance to shape the product, the team and the way we work at an early stage. A small team of engineers with short decision paths, building technology that takes fossil fuels out of industrial heat. Stock warrants. A flat hierarchy where we value who you are. title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. Mechanical Design Engineer 🛠️ About Our Hardware Engineering Team Wayve's Hardware Engineering team designs and integrates the physical systems that enable our AI Driver to operate on real-world vehicle platforms. The team works across mechanical, electrical and systems engineering to package compute, sensors and supporting hardware into robust, manufacturable solutions that can be built, tested, installed and scaled. 🧠 Your day-to-day As a Mechanical Engineer at Wayve, you'll design and deliver robust integration solutions for compute and sensors on real-world vehicles, working on programmes with some of the world's leading automotive partners. You'll take ideas from concept through prototype and into manufacture, owning quality and design trade-offs along the way. This is a hands-on role with clear impact on how our systems are built, tested, installed and scaled. Applicants are required to submit a portfolio showcasing relevant work alongside their resume. Applications without a portfolio may not be considered. 🧩 What You’ll Be Working On Design and integrate mechanical solutions for sensors and compute across a range of vehicle platforms. Own mechanical design trade-offs across performance, cost, manufacturability and serviceability while maintaining a high quality bar. Develop and build HiLs, test rigs, jigs and fixtures to support validation and integration. Produce clear 2D drawings, assemblies and BOMs, applying GD&T to ensure repeatable builds. Partner with supply chain and external suppliers to source and manufacture parts using processes such as sheet metal, machining, vacuum casting and 3D printing. Collaborate cross-functionally with electronics and other engineering teams to integrate compute and sensor architectures. Create build instructions, inspection checklists and safety/quality documentation, and support knowledge transfer to Fleet and field teams. 🙌 You Should Apply If You have 4+ years of experience in mechanical or design engineering, with a portfolio of relevant work. You are proficient in SolidWorks, and ideally SolidWorks PDM, including master model development and multi-part assemblies. You have experience with common manufacturing processes such as sheet metal, machining, vacuum casting and 3D printing, with strong design-for-manufacture judgement. You have strong experience designing and building test jigs, rigs and fixtures, and are comfortable working hands-on in a workshop environment. You have strong 2D drawing and assembly skills, experience managing BOMs, and a working knowledge of GD&T. You have experience using risk assessment methods such as FMEA or DFMEA. Nice to have You have surface modelling experience. You are familiar with aluminium extrusion-based builds. You have an understanding of electronic systems, such as voltage basics, harness development and compute selection. You have hands-on FDM printing experience. 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More About Wayve 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. 🔍 The Interview Process Our process is clear and respectful of your time: Recruiter screen Hiring Manager interview Technical / Design interviews Deep Dive interview Mission & Values interview We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability. What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually 📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve ✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable ✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs 📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth 🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enha

title: Graduate Optical Engineer
description: Job Description Your impact Are you ready to launch your career and make an impact on real-world projects from day one? At Leonardo, we’re looking for graduates who want to be part of something extraordinary - shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety. We are committed to developing our graduates into leading technical or business professionals, and as such we will also support you through your preferred route for professional development. Our 18-month Graduate Programmes give you the opportunity to work on exciting and challenging projects alongside industry leaders. On joining, you will receive a starting salary of £34,000 per annum, plus a £1,000 welcome bonus. You’ll also be eligible for a £1,000 exit bonus upon successful completion of the programme. In addition, you may be eligible for a Temporary Accommodation Allowance (TAA), subject to specific criteria. We encourage you to spend at least three days each week on site to integrate with your team and maximise your learning experience. We have a fantastic new opportunity for a graduate to join the Advanced Targeting line of business as an Optical Engineer. Your role as a Graduate Optical Engineer will be solve real-world engineering challenges, designing and developing mission-critical solutions that power some of the world’s most advanced defence and security systems under the guidance and support of experienced Optical Engineers. The Graduate programme will offer you 18 months of development, with placements in three phases of the product life cycle. You will learn how to use state-of-the-art tools and technology to explore all aspects of the development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, concept design, and design for manufacture, implementation, test, build and product support. What You’ll Do As a Graduate Optical Engineer As a Graduate Optical Engineer, you will manage your own development towards attaining Optical Engineer level through the Graduate Development Scheme over 18 months. To achieve this goal, you will be placed in programmes responsible progressing different parts of a product life cycle: New product introduction: tasked with learning the core concepts required to increase the manufacturing rate, such as modelling an existing to designs to identify root-cause analysis of observed problems and use of metrology to validate theories. Detailed product design: responsible for developing or improving existing designs and supporting the transfer of optical models into a detailed optical and system requirements. Novel concepts: to develop technologies both future and improvement of existing products. Throughout these placements you will learn skills required to communicate technical concepts across a wide array of disciplines. You will be expected support optical procurement and the wider product team in the creation and changing of drawings, tolerancing and how to develop of experiments to prove capability of your designs. Finally, you will be tasked performing technical reviews to assess the limits on technical capability and for creating and conducting optical tests to lower the technical risks of novel EO-Systems and solutions identified as part of wider technological reviews. What You’ll Bring A minimum of a 2:1 master’s degree or a higher, such as a EngD or PhD. Relevant experience of photonics, such as summer placements, internships or research projects. Experience with technical writing and project planning. Strong analytical, modelling skills and laboratory skills. Evidence of successfully working in a team. Enthusiasm for photonics and an interest in developing your technical capabilities. Experience of modelling tools such as Ansys Zemax Optics Studio, Matlab, LabVIEW, and COMSOL (or equivalent) is desirable. Security Clearance Many of our roles are subject to security and export control restrictions set by UK Government Security requirements and customer obligations. As a result, and in line with the UK Government Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) requirements, all successful applicants will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record declaration information and employment and/or education history verification for the previous five years. For staff operating in more sensitive posts, there is an additional range of personnel security controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV). As part of this process, a range of factors may be considered, including an individual's background, travel history, nationality, previous nationalities held and other information relevant to the vetting assessment. To be eligible for National Security Vetting at SC level, applicants will generally be expected to have continuously resided in the UK for the previous five years. For DV clearance, this is typically ten years. In some circumstances, time spent overseas may be accepted, with additional overseas checks. Additional vetting requirements may apply upon appointment. title: Mechanical & Physical Engineer
description: In Capgemini Engineering, leader mondiale nei servizi di ingegneria, uniamo un team globale di talenti dell’ingegneria, scienza e tecnologia per aiutare le aziende più innovative del mondo a liberare il loro potenziale. Dai veicoli autonomi ai robot salva-vita, le nostre persone esperte in tecnologia digitale e software pensano fuori dagli schemi, offrendo servizi unici di ricerca e sviluppo e ingegneria in tutti i settori. Unisciti a noi per una carriera ricca di opportunità, dove potrai fare la differenza, in un ambiente in cui ogni giorno è unico. IL TUO RUOLO Come Mechanical & Physical Engineer farai parte del team che si occupa di progetti afferenti gli ambiti di Mechanical Product Design, Mechanical Physical Performance e Mechanical Product Development. In questo ruolo sarai un elemento chiave nelle seguenti attività: Progettazione e sviluppo di sistemi meccanici e dispositivi, inclusi componenti strutturali e macchine, utilizzando metodologie di CAD 3D e analisi agli elementi finiti (FEA) per l'ottimizzazione strutturale; Simulazione e analisi delle interazioni meccaniche tramite software avanzati di simulazione per valutare e ottimizzare le performance in scenari reali; Prototipazione, sviluppo e validazione di modelli per la produzione; Installazione e manutenzione delle attrezzature meccaniche, utilizzando metodologie di gestione del ciclo di vita del prodotto (PLM) e tecniche di manutenzione predittiva. LE TUE CARATTERISTICHE Conoscenza dei proncipali tool di progettazione (Catia V5, Creo, Inventor, NX o affini); Conoscenza del metodo agli elementi finiti (FEM); Gradita precedente esperienza in Formula SAE/Formula Student; Conoscenza della validazione CFD e dei test aerodinamici; Note: È richiesta una Laurea specialistica in Ingegneria Meccanica, Autoveicolo o Aeronautica; Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese e italiana. PERCHÉ TI PIACERÀ LAVORARE CON NOI Riconosciamo l’importanza di soluzioni di lavoro flessibili per offrirti supporto. Che si tratti di lavoro da remoto, orari flessibili o entrambi, troverai un ambiente che favorisce l’equilibrio tra vita privata e vita lavorativa; Al centro della nostra missione c'è la tua carriera, attraverso percorsi di crescita professionale pensati per supportarti nell'esplorare un mondo di opportunità; Ci impegniamo a promuovere la responsabilità sociale creando un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, dove talenti diversi sono valorizzati. La diversità è un pilastro della nostra cultura aziendale, arricchendo il nostro lavoro attraverso esperienze, culture, etnie, stili di comunicazione e comportamenti. Location : Bologna, Firenze, Genova, La Spezia, Milano, Modena, Napoli, Padova, Pisa, Pomigliano D'Arco, Roma, Torino e Venezia. SUL GRUPPO CAPGEMINI Capgemini è un partner globale per la trasformazione tecnologica e di business delle aziende, che sfrutta la potenza dell’AI per offrire valore ai propri clienti. Forti di quasi 60 anni di esperienza, siamo un gruppo responsabile e diversificato di 420.000 persone presente in più di 50 paesi nel mondo. title: R&D Engineer (Junior)
description: Who are we? LALIZAS is a company that manufactures marine equipment with a commercial presence in 130 countries . We hold a leading position in the European and International Marine market with over 40 years of experience and expertise in life saving equipment. Our vision is to produce high quality products and distribute them in international markets through our well‐established distribution network. This vision, along with the care for the customers and the indispensable input of the employees, have resulted to the company's growth and will continue to contribute positively in our continuous development. Why join LALIZAS? LALIZAS considers its people as the most valuable asset for its strategic planning, policies, values and vision. Therefore invests in them at all organization levels and constantly aims to further development. By setting high selection standards and especially by emphasizing on the approach, the recruitment and the development of executives with expertise and will, LALIZAS provides a career path full of challenges and professional goals. Therefore, if you wish to join this fast- growing and dynamic team, now is your chance to apply for our “ R&D Engineer (Junior) ” job opening. Job Description: Research, analyze, and benchmark competitor products to support the development of new and improved products. Source and evaluate raw materials by collaborating with existing suppliers and identifying new sourcing opportunities to meet product requirements. Conduct laboratory tests and experiments to evaluate raw materials and support product design, redesign, and validation, while accurately documenting and analyzing results. Prepare, create, and update technical drawings for product components and related documentation. Support the introduction of new products into mass production by coordinating product transfer activities and preparing the required documentation, materials, and quality standards. Build and assemble prototypes, samples, and test units for research and development activities. Provide administrative support to the R&D department, including coordinating and tracking courier shipments and deliveries. Maintain and update departmental records, documentation, and databases to ensure accurate, organized, and readily accessible information. Skills and experience: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Materials Engineering, or a related Engineering discipline. 1–2 years of experience in Research & Development, Product Development, Manufacturing, or a similar engineering role. Proficiency in 3D CAD software, such as SOLIDWORKS, CATIA, or PTC Creo (Pro/ENGINEER). Experience creating and modifying 3D models, assemblies, and technical drawings. Knowledge of product development processes, materials, and manufacturing techniques. Hands-on engineering experience in prototype assembly, testing, and the use of workshop or laboratory equipment is highly preferred. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail. Good organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Good command of written and spoken English. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications. If you think you are a good fit for this role and you want to discover your new career path, we will be glad to meet you!

title: Beräkningsingenjör strukturmekanik - Försvarsindustrin
description: Företagsbeskrivning AFRY är ett ledande europeiskt företag med global räckvidd inom teknik, design och rådgivning. Vi accelererar omställningen mot ett hållbart samhälle. Vi är 18 000 hängivna experter inom infrastruktur, industri, energi och digitalisering, som skapar hållbara lösningar för kommande generationer. Jobbeskrivning Vi har stor efterfrågan på ingenjörer inom strukturmekanik och söker nya medarbetare till vår beräkningsavdelning i Stockholm. Som beräkningsingenjör inom strukturmekanik hos oss kommer du att jobba med olika typer av simuleringar och analyser mot flera av AFRYs världsledande kunder. Uppdragen kan komma att variera i både storlek och innehåll, och utföras antingen på AFRYs kontor eller på plats hos våra kunder. Du kommer att få möjlighet att driva dina egna projekt med stort personligt ansvar för att möta uppsatta mål. Ditt arbete blir en viktig del av sektionens pågående satsning mot försvarsindustrin. Det finns därmed goda möjligheter att forma en egen roll och påverka avdelningens verksamhet. Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer framför allt att omfatta tekniska leveranser, det vill säga att genomföra strukturella analyser (FEA) och redovisa resultaten av dessa, samt diskutera och implementera konstruktionsändringar för att förbättra produkterna du jobbar med. Du kommer även att få möjlighet att agera mentor och stötta dina mindre erfarna kollegor. Kvalifikationer Vi söker dig som har en akademisk utbildning inom teknisk fysik, maskinteknik eller liknande och har minst 5 års arbetslivserfarenhet av strukturmekanik. Du har erfarenhet från försvarsindustrin och har arbetat med olika typer av analyser, bland annat utmattning. Du behärskar kommersiella beräkningsprogramvaror som ANSYS, ABAQUS, LS-Dyna eller liknande, och kan använda dessa obehindrat för att utföra avancerade analyser/simuleringar. Analytiska beräkningar använder du som ett komplement för att bland annat säkerställa kvaliteten i dina FE-analyser. Som person är du analytisk, har du god förståelse för nödvändig kvalitet i dina leveranser och strävar alltid efter att göra ett så bra arbete som möjligt. Du är också en god kommunikatör och har en förmåga att förklara komplexa tekniska problem för personer i din omgivning. title: Mechanical Engineer Food
description: In een zuivelhal waar de pompopstelling net anders wordt ingericht voor een betere doorstroming. Op een verpakkingslijn waar duizenden producten per uur foutloos worden gesorteerd, gevuld en verpakt. Jij ziet niet alleen wat er staat, maar vooral wat er beter kan. Smaakt dit naar meer? Dan wacht hier misschien wel jouw volgende avontuur. Dit ga je doen In de voedingsmiddelenindustrie draait alles om betrouwbaarheid. Producten volgen dagelijks hun weg door het productieproces, installaties vormen het hart van de fabriek en operators vertrouwen op systemen die doen wat ze beloven. Daar lever jij als Mechanical Engineer een belangrijke bijdrage aan. Je ontwerpt nieuwe installaties en productielijnen en werkt bestaande systemen uit tot een slimmer en betrouwbaarder ontwerp. Procesvragen vertaal je naar technische oplossingen die niet alleen op papier kloppen, maar ook technisch robuust en maakbaar zijn. Jij hebt de technische koers in handen, zij bouwen wat jij hebt ontworpen. Jouw Werkzaamheden In Het Kort Je vertaalt functionele en technische eisen naar 3D-modellen, lay-outs en technische tekeningen. Je ontwerpt en optimaliseert mechanische systemen voor productie-, proces- en verpakkingsinstallaties. Je werkt samen met engineers, leveranciers en productie om tot slimme en maakbare ontwerpen te komen. Je bent betrokken van concept tot realisatie en ziet jouw ontwerp terug tijdens de bouw, het testen en de oplevering. Dit ben jij Je hebt een hbo- of wo-opleiding afgerond in Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechatronica, Levensmiddelentechnologie of een vergelijkbare technische richting. Je duikt graag in technische vraagstukken en neemt initiatief om tot een oplossing te komen. Je communiceert in het Nederlands, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Deze Skills Komen Van Pas SolidWorks Inventor AutoCAD Ontwerpen zit in je natuur. Je wilt begrijpen hoe een installatie werkt, welke keuzes het verschil maken en hoe techniek in de praktijk samenkomt. Je schakelt makkelijk tussen verschillende disciplines en weet ideeën te vertalen naar een ontwerp dat klopt. Dit krijg je van ons We bieden een salaris tussen de 3300 en 5700 euro bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur per week, passend bij je ervaring en expertise. Zorgeloos op weg met een kilometervergoeding of leaseauto Trap je werkdag af op 2 wielen. Lease een (elektrische) fiets en blijf in beweging. Focus op vitaliteit met sportdagen en aandacht voor mentaal welzijn Coaching, loopbaanbegeleiding en een opleidingsbudget op maat Je hebt de mogelijkheid om extra vakantiedagen bij te kopen Met 24 vakantiedagen heb je alle tijd voor je avonturen Je krijgt een thuiswerkvergoeding van €2,50 netto per dag Met kennissessies en webinars blijf je bij in je vakgebied Krijg persoonlijke begeleiding van je Performance Manager Een solide basis voor je toekomst met onze pensioenregeling Sluit je aan bij ons jongerennetwerk EPIS Dit zijn wij Je wordt onderdeel van team Mechanical, Proces & Engineering (MPE). Een landelijk opererend team van ruim 50 specialisten bestaande uit procestechnologen, mechanical engineers, lead engineers en projectleiders. Zij beschikken over ruime kennis en ervaring met greenfield- en brownfieldprojecten binnen de sectoren food, pharma, chemie, duurzame energie en water. We werken voor toonaangevende opdrachtgevers zoals FrieslandCampina, Bolletje, Zwanenberg Group, DEMCON, VDL en Nijhuis Saur Industries. De uitdagingen waarmee we ze helpen zijn uiteenlopend. Denk aan het ontwerpen en realiseren van nieuwe procesinstallaties, het ombouwen en optimaliseren van bestaande productielijnen, het integreren van duurzame en energie-efficiënte oplossingen in bestaande fabrieken, het waarborgen van veiligheid en compliance (ATEX, PED, NEN) en bijdragen aan de energietransitie door elektrificatie, circulaire processen en alternatieve grondstofstromen. Bij CLAFIS krijg je dus de kans om aan verschillende projecten te werken voor verschillende opdrachtgevers. Je hebt hier zelf veel invloed op. Wij zorgen ervoor dat jij werk krijgt dat bij jouw ambities past. Zo garanderen wij werkgeluk en zijn we in staat om het verschil te maken voor onze opdrachtgevers. Je werklocatie is afwisselend bij de opdrachtgever op locatie, vanuit één van de inspirerende CLAFIS kantoren (in Heerenveen, Groningen, Alkmaar, Enschede, Arnhem en Best) of vanuit huis. Dit is afhankelijk van de projecten waaraan je werkt en natuurlijk jouw woonplaats en persoonlijke voorkeur. Je hebt hier zelf invloed op. Ben jij de Mechanical Engineer Food die wij zoeken? Herken je jezelf en word je enthousiast van de functie van Mechanical Engineer Food bij CLAFIS? Neem dan contact op, of solliciteer direct middels onderstaand formulier.

title: Sr. Mechanical Engineer & Teamlead
description: Je houdt van techniek. Maar je haalt ook energie uit het ontwikkelen van mensen. Als Sr. Mechanical Engineer & Teamlead bij TSG hoef je niet te kiezen tussen beide. Je combineert inhoudelijke engineering met leiderschap en speelt een belangrijke rol in zowel de ontwikkeling van innovatieve machines als de groei van jouw team. Je werkt aan technische uitdagingen die niet standaard opgelost kunnen worden. Van hightech machines en productontwikkelingen tot slimme systemen voor Food, Life Sciences & Health en Global Security. Samen met jouw team vertaal je complexe vraagstukken naar innovatieve en realiseerbare oplossingen. Dankzij onze eigen protoshop zie je ontwerpen daadwerkelijk tot leven komen. Jouw impact Deze rol bestaat uit twee belangrijke onderdelen. Ongeveer de helft van jouw tijd werk je als senior engineer aan uitdagende projecten. De andere helft besteed je aan het begeleiden, coachen en ontwikkelen van jouw team. Daardoor sta je dicht op de techniek én dicht op de mensen. Je bent een mentor voor engineers, een sparringpartner voor management en een belangrijke schakel in de verdere groei van TSG. Met onze ambitie om richting 2030 uit te groeien naar ruim 200 medewerkers, speel jij een belangrijke rol in het bouwen aan een sterk en toekomstbestendig engineeringteam. Wat ga je doen? Als Senior Mechanical Engineer Ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van complexe machines, modules en technische systemen. Uitvoeren van technische voorstudies en conceptontwikkeling. Opstellen van technische specificaties, requirements en ontwerpdocumentatie. Uitwerken en beoordelen van mechanische ontwerpen met focus op kwaliteit, maakbaarheid en betrouwbaarheid. Uitvoeren van berekeningen, analyses en risicoassessments. Testen, valideren en optimaliseren van prototypes en systemen. Samenwerken met Systems Engineers, Software Engineers en andere disciplines. Technisch begeleiden van junior en medior engineers. Fungeren als technisch aanspreekpunt binnen projecten. Als Teamlead Aansturen, coachen en begeleiden van een team van maximaal 15 engineers. Voeren van ontwikkel-, beoordelings- en loopbaangesprekken. Ondersteunen van medewerkers in hun persoonlijke en professionele groei. Creëren van een veilige, open en inspirerende werkomgeving. Signaleren van ontwikkelbehoeften binnen het team. Fungeren als eerste aanspreekpunt voor niet-project gerelateerde vraagstukken. Bijdragen aan teamontwikkeling, samenwerking en kennisdeling. Sparringpartner zijn voor management en collega's. Wat breng je mee? Je bent een ervaren engineer die inhoudelijke diepgang combineert met oprechte interesse in mensen. Daarnaast beschik je over: Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar. Minimaal 7 jaar ervaring als Mechanical Engineer binnen machinebouw, productontwikkeling of een vergelijkbare technische omgeving. Ervaring met of sterke affiniteit voor het begeleiden en coachen van professionals. Ervaring met machineontwikkeling en complexe technische systemen. Kennis van ontwerpstrategieën en het opstellen van Programma's van Eisen. Ervaring met minimaal twee 3D CAD-pakketten, waarbij SolidWorks een pré is. Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden. Een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal. Waarom kiezen voor TSG? Bij veel organisaties groei je óf richting techniek óf richting management. Bij TSG geloven we dat beide elkaar versterken. Je krijgt de kans om: Technisch inhoudelijk actief te blijven. Een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan de ontwikkeling van collega's. Te werken aan unieke maatwerkprojecten. Betrokken te zijn van concept tot realisatie. Samen te werken binnen multidisciplinaire teams. Jouw ontwerpen daadwerkelijk gebouwd te zien worden. Invloed uit te oefenen op de groei van een ambitieuze organisatie. Te werken binnen een informele organisatie met korte lijnen en weinig hiërarchie. Wat bieden wij jou? Een bruto maandsalaris tussen €4.200 en €6.000 afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring. 28 vakantiedagen (24 + 4 ATV) met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen bij te kopen. Reiskostenvergoeding. Mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken en flexibele werktijden. Bedrijfsfitness met belastingvoordeel. Een uitdagende rol met impact op zowel techniek als mensen. Een informele werksfeer met korte lijnen. Regelmatig leuke activiteiten zoals bowlen, karten en BBQ's. Bouw mee aan techniek en talent Wil jij innovatieve machines ontwikkelen, engineers helpen groeien en een zichtbare bijdrage leveren aan de verdere ontwikkeling van TSG? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Stuur ons je cv en ontdek hoe jij jouw technische expertise en leiderschap kunt inzetten binnen een organisatie die volop in beweging is.

Experience with requirements and specifications, verification, traceability and risk management in a regulated medical device or pharma environment (GMP/GxP/ISO). The ability to independently own a technical area, from assessment and decision to documentation and implementation in the product team and stakeholder landscape. Good stakeholder management skills. Fluent written and spoken English. A creative mindset, pride in delivering on your milestones, and energy for working across functions in a dynamic environment. Useful, But Not Essential Experience with pre-filled syringes, syringes, cartridges, vials, stoppers or container closure systems, including Container Closure Integrity. Knowledge of how drugs and packaging materials interact, such as coatings, plastics, glues, silicone oil, and chemical and physical drug stability. Experience with ISO 15378, ISO 13485 and/or ISO 14971, or with systems engineering. Lifecycle management experience, including system ownership for marketed or late-stage products. Ability to provide technical direction, bring colleagues and stakeholders together, and drive technical activities towards successful delivery. Hands-on experience with technical drawings, tolerances and technical evaluation. What You’ll Do You will help the team take on a wider portfolio of device projects, including new and larger pre-filled syringe formats and the lifecycle management of existing products. Develop primary packaging systems for parenteral administration, such as syringes and vials, from ideation to drug product launch. Bring in new primary packaging solutions, including ones not previously used at Novo, or insource existing solutions from external suppliers. Document design requirements, safety risk management, mitigations and testing, so that Clinical Trial Applications can be submitted. Ensure the right design, material, technical performance, processability and supply chain for each packaging system. Support marketed products through system ownership and late-stage changes. Scout the market, meet suppliers, and coordinate your own workstream with stakeholders to deliver on time. Who You’ll Work With You will join the Pre-Filled Syringe (PFS) Primary Packaging Development team in Drug Delivery Innovation, part of Global Manufacturing & Supply, based in Hillerød with state-of-the-art R&D facilities. In Global Manufacturing & Supply, colleagues work across the value chain from drug and device development to marketed Novo products. Your closest partners will be colleagues in Drug and Device Development, Production and Supply Chain, along with project managers and external suppliers. They bring a constructive, collaborative mindset and offer highly competent sparring on your ideas. Drug Delivery Innovation brings project management, engineering and technical functions together, so you will see how a diverse portfolio of drug, combination product and device projects comes together. title: Elkonstruktör
description: På Krets Consulting Group bygger vi ett konsultbolag där teknik, människor och långsiktighet hänger ihop på riktigt. Vi kombinerar erfarenhet från produktutveckling och produktion med en stark tro på självledarskap, gemenskap och utveckling. Nu söker vi en erfaren elkonstruktör till ett konsultuppdrag i Örebro, där du får utveckla elsystem för avancerade borrmaskiner inom ovanjordsborrning och prospektering. Om rollen Du kliver in i ett utvecklingsteam som förbättrar elsystemen i befintliga maskiner. En stor del av uppdraget handlar om att lösa problem som upptäcks i produktionen eller ute i fält, ersätta komponenter som fasas ut och förbättra maskinernas funktion, prestanda och driftsäkerhet. Arbetet växlar mellan elkonstruktion i AutoCAD Electrical och praktisk felsökning på maskinerna. Du samarbetar med kollegor inom mekanik, hydraulik, pneumatik och mjukvara, liksom med produktion, service och leverantörer. Det här kommer du att göra Ta fram och uppdatera elscheman, kopplingsscheman, kablage och elskåp i AutoCAD Electrical. Ersätta komponenter som fasas ut och genomföra konstruktionsändringar utifrån återkoppling från produktion och fält. Välja och utvärdera givare, ställdon och styrenheter utifrån elektriska krav och de miljöer där maskinerna används. Bygga upp och underhålla produktstrukturer och teknisk dokumentation i Teamcenter. Stötta systemprovning genom att ta fram provspecifikationer, utföra elektriska mätningar och dokumentera resultat. Felsöka elsystem på plats, identifiera grundorsaker och föra tekniska dialoger med leverantörer. Ta fram tillfälliga tekniska lösningar som gör att produktionen kan fortsätta och leveranser hållas medan en permanent lösning tas fram. Vi tror att du har Erfarenhet av elkonstruktion för industrimaskiner, tunga maskiner eller liknande utrustning. Mycket god vana av AutoCAD Electrical och erfarenhet av att ta fram elscheman och kopplingsscheman. Goda kunskaper i konstruktion av elskåp och kabelstammar, inklusive både kraft- och signalkablage. Goda kunskaper om elkomponenter, givare, ställdon och styrsystem samt förståelse för mekatronik eller automation. Erfarenhet av praktisk och systematisk felsökning av elsystem på maskiner. Vana av att arbeta i PLM-system, gärna Teamcenter. Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift. Som person Du tar initiativ, driver tekniska frågor framåt och trivs med att hantera flera pågående ärenden samtidigt. Du gillar att hjälpa kollegor i produktion och service och tar gärna hjälp av andra när en fråga kräver deras kompetens. Det känns naturligt för dig att samarbeta både inom utvecklingsteamet och med andra delar av organisationen. Plats och arbetssätt Uppdraget utförs i Örebro, i huvudsak på plats. Möjligheten till distansarbete är begränsad eftersom rollen innebär nära samarbete med produktionen och praktiskt arbete på maskinerna.

title: Stress Engineer
description: About The Role Imagine this. You are ensuring the structural integrity of the propulsion systems powering the next generation of high performance UAVs. Every analysis you perform helps guarantee that critical engine components can withstand extreme thermal and mechanical loads while delivering exceptional reliability and performance. From early concept development through testing and production, you will work alongside multidisciplinary engineering teams to solve complex challenges and help bring advanced turbojet engines from design to reality. At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations. What You'll Do Perform structural, thermal, and thermo mechanical analyses of turbojet engine components using analytical methods and Finite Element Analysis. Assess centrifugal, thermal, vibratory, and combined loading on rotating and stationary engine hardware. Evaluate the mechanical integrity and durability of compressor and turbine wheels, shafts, blisks, casings, bearing supports, combustor structures, and exhaust components. Predict thermal growth and hot to cold geometry changes to optimize running clearances and engine performance. Perform fatigue, creep, thermo mechanical fatigue, and durability assessments for high temperature engine components. Analyze bearings, shafts, interference fits, couplings, mechanical joints, and sealing systems under operational loading. Develop detailed FEA models and analytical calculations to support design decisions and component sizing. Define critical engine load cases and correlate analysis with rig, endurance, and flight testing results. Collaborate closely with design, manufacturing, aerodynamics, combustion, and test engineers to improve component performance and manufacturability. Prepare technical documentation and contribute to engine qualification and certification activities. What You'll Need Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Between 3 and 8 years of experience performing structural or mechanical integrity analysis for gas turbine or turbojet engines. Strong understanding of rotating machinery operating under high centrifugal and thermal loads. Hands on experience using ANSYS Mechanical, Abaqus, Nastran, or similar FEA software. Solid knowledge of classical stress calculations, structural sizing, fatigue analysis, and durability assessment. Experience evaluating thermal deformation, hot to cold geometry changes, and tip clearance optimization. Understanding of high temperature aerospace materials, creep, thermo mechanical fatigue, and material behaviour. Experience analyzing bearings, shafts, sealing systems, interference fits, and mechanical joints. Familiarity with aerospace manufacturing processes including machining, casting, additive manufacturing, and heat treatment. Strong communication skills with professional English proficiency. Experience with MATLAB or Python is considered an advantage. Who You Are You enjoy solving challenging engineering problems where structural integrity directly impacts engine performance, safety, and reliability. You combine analytical thinking with practical engineering judgement, making decisions that balance performance, manufacturability, and durability. You thrive in a fast moving development environment where testing, iteration, and collaboration are part of everyday work. You are naturally curious, hands on, and motivated by seeing your analyses validated on real hardware while taking ownership of complex engineering challenges from concept through production. Security screening is an integral component of the selection process, ensuring that candidates meet the organization's security standards and safeguarding against potential risks. Providing a Certificate of Conduct (VOG) is a standard part of the application process at Destinus.

title: Ingénieur Analyse Structure Aéronautique FEA
description: AURA AERO, constructeur aéronautique français, conçoit et fabrique des avions à faible émission de carbone présentant une efficacité inégalée. Avec plus de 200 collaborateurs, nous mettons à profit les talents pluridisciplinaires de notre équipe pour apporter des réponses aux enjeux des mobilités d’aujourd’hui et de demain. Nous rejoindre, c’est innover avec passion pour contribuer à l'émergence d’avions de nouvelle génération. Dans le cadre du développement d’AURA AERO, vous rejoignez les équipes d’ingénierie structure et intervenez sur l’analyse des structures . À ce titre, vous interviendrez sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie des avions , pour les programmes ERA ou Integral (R, S et E) , dans le cadre de la montée en cadence de nos programmes. Dans le respect des critères de délai, qualité, coût, cycle de vie et navigabilité , vos missions principales seront les suivantes : Réaliser des calculs de résistance pour des structures soumises à divers régimes de chargement, avec prise en compte des spécificités liées aux choix de matériaux et procédés de fabrication, en intégrant plusieurs critères de rupture ; Construire et adapter des modèles Éléments Finis représentatifs des structures multi-matériaux en intégrant les hypothèses mécaniques pertinentes ; Justifier la tenue en fatigue des structures en tenant compte des endommagements acceptables et des contraintes d’exploitation ; En accord avec les processus et méthodes internes, rédiger des dossiers de justification conformes à la réglementation aéronautiques en vigueur et adaptés aux matériaux utilisés ; Vérifier et valider un dossier de définition en conformité avec les exigences techniques et qualité ; Développer des méthodes de calcul issue de littérature, au travers de scripts de calculs ; Évaluer les dérogations techniques et statuer sur leur acceptabilité au regard de la performance, de la sécurité et de la conformité, en accord avec les processus et méthodes de l’entreprise ; Analyser l’impact des solutions techniques sur la navigabilité en conformité avec la Part 21. Formation supérieure en calcul de structures aéronautique ou équivalent, vous justifiez d’une expérience d’ au moins 5 ans sur un poste similaire. Vous êtes reconnu pour la qualité de votre relationnel, votre aptitude à assurer l’interface avec tous types d’interlocuteurs et votre capacité de négociation. Enfin, vous êtes autonome dans vos activités quotidiennes et êtes orienté résultats. Enfin, vos atouts pour ce poste sont les suivants : Maîtrise du dimensionnement des structures aéronautiques (global avion) ; Compétences/Expériences significatives en statique, fatigue et tolérance aux dommages ; Maîtrise des connaissances techniques : normes, méthodes, matériaux… ; Maîtrise du logiciel Calcul NASTRAN/PATRAN/HYPERMESH ; Capacité d'analyse permettant de définir les solutions techniques appropriées ; Connaissance de la réglementation aéronautique (CS25 / CS23) et PART 21J (DOA) ; Forte appétence pour le terrain et les interactions avec les équipes de production, incluant le contact direct avec le produit et la mise en pratique des solutions techniques. Une expérience sur des essais mécaniques (éprouvette, composant, structure complète) serait un plus. Chaque candidature sera traitée de manière égale dans le respect de la diversité et de l'inclusion et sur les seuls critères de la compétence et de la motivation. title: R&D Manager, MEMS
description: About SiTime SiTime is the Precision Timing company. Timing is the heartbeat of all electronics, ensuring performance, resilience and scalability. For decades, quartz devices, non-silicon technology, have kept systems in sync, but they struggle in harsher, more demanding environments. MEMS-based Precision Timing delivers greater accuracy, smaller size and resilience. Today, MEMS timing powers over 400 applications, including high-growth ones in AI datacenters, automated driving, industrial and humanoid robots, wearables and IoT. Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power, and better reliability. With more than 4 billion devices shipped, SiTime is changing the timing industry. For more information, visit: www.sitime.com . Job Summary SiTime is seeking an R&D Manager to join our team in developing and refining our in-house MEMS simulation and design software. The team comprises software developers, computational experts, and physicists who develop and maintain the MEMS simulation and design environment. This work involves orchestrating complex simulations across multiple physical domains, implementing advanced mathematical algorithms, analyzing trade-offs between key characteristics, verifying simulation results, and ensuring both manufacturability and high predictive power of simulations. As an R&D Manager , you will contribute to development planning in alignment with the company’s product roadmap, communicate with the Design, Fabrication, and Metrology teams, support the product owner, and guide the team’s work toward agreed milestones. You will collaborate with internal users to collect feedback, identify missing functionalities and new milestones, take ownership of system components, and manage several engineers. It is not necessary to meet all job requirements to be considered a qualified candidate for this position. Responsibilities Guide the implementation of new modules and features for the in-house MEMS simulation and design platform. Oversee the verification and validation of new features. Manage 2-5 engineers; participate in hiring activities. Communicate with MEMS designers, project leaders, and department leaders to collect feedback and feature requests. Contribute to maintaining the development roadmap, ensuring alignment with the product roadmap and incoming requests. Identify gaps and limitations in existing functionality and simulations. Contribute to the development of the platform and analyze its accuracy and performance; compare simulation results with experimental data. Provide occasional consultations and training to MEMS design engineers. Qualifications & Requirements (Education Must Be Included) PhD in Physics, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent. Experience with FEA simulation tools (COMSOL, ANSYS, or similar). Deep understanding of Finite Element Analysis and its application to problems in various physical domains (mechanics, electrostatics, thermal conductivity, non-linear effects). Strong mathematics skills: linear algebra, statistics, operator theory, computational methods, and cost-function optimization techniques. Experience in personnel management, project management, product development, or organizing research activities is a strong advantage. Coding skills (sufficient for complex scripting, automation of data analysis, and visualization of results; preferably Python or MATLAB) are a strong advantage. Experience with analysis of experimental data and understanding related challenges is a strong advantage. Passion for working on challenging physical problems and complex multi-factor systems. Strong organizational and interpersonal skills, clear communication, responsibility for the overall success of the project. Technical curiosity. Ability to work well with others in a collaborative, fast-paced team environment. English fluency in written and spoken communication. Compensation Range At SiTime, we believe great work deserves great rewards. We offer a comprehensive and highly competitive compensation package designed to attract top talent. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for a quarterly bonus tied to the achievement of innovation goals—reflecting our commitment to recognizing meaningful impact. We also offer equity grants, providing a meaningful opportunity to share in the company’s future growth and success. SiTime is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law. title: Mašinski tehničar - konstruktor
description: U Ime Našeg Klijenta, Kompanije S-Beca, Koja Se Bavi Proizvodnjom i Montažom Metalnih Konstrukcija i Različitih Tehničkih Rješenja Od Čelika, Aluminija i Inoxa., Manpower BiH Traži Motivisanu i Odgovornu Osobu Za Poziciju Mašinski tehničar – konstruktor (2D/3D) Popis Izrada i dorada 2D tehničkih crteža u AutoCAD-u te izrada 3D modela i razrada konstrukcijskih rješenja. Tehnička razrada projekata koji uključuju čelične, aluminijske i inox konstrukcije, stepeništa, ograde i rješenja za ventilirajuće fasade. Izlazak na teren, uzimanje mjera i provjera uslova za izradu i montažu. Priprema tehničkih rješenja i dokumentacije potrebne za proizvodnju i izvođenje radova. Komunikacija i koordinacija s klijentima, izvođačima i kolegama uključenim u proizvodnju i montažu. Praćenje realizacije radova na gradilištu, kontrola kvaliteta izvedbe i praćenje dogovorenih rokova. Učestvovanje u dogovaranju i organizaciji realizacije projekata te pravovremeno rješavanje tehničkih izazova na terenu. Zaštita interesa kompanije tokom realizacije projekata kroz odgovoran pristup, dobru organizaciju i aktivno praćenje svih faza posla. Požadujeme 2–5 godina relevantnog iskustva u radu s metalnim konstrukcijama, tehničkoj pripremi, proizvodnji ili montaži. Dobro poznavanje AutoCAD-a za 2D crtanje. Poznavanje rada u 3D CAD programu ili sposobnost rada u odgovarajućem programu, u skladu s potrebama posla. Razumijevanje tehničkih crteža, mjera i konstrukcijskih detalja. Praktično razumijevanje proizvodnje i montaže konstrukcija od čelika, aluminija i/ili inoxa. Spremnost za kombinaciju kancelarijskog rada i terenskog angažmana. Iskustvo u izradi i montaži čeličnih stepeništa, hala, ograda, ventilirajućih fasada i sličnih konstrukcija. Iskustvo u samostalnom mjerenju, pripremi tehničkih rješenja, organizaciji i praćenju radova na gradilištu. Iskustvo u komunikaciji s klijentima i izvođačima te koordinaciji različitih faza realizacije projekta. VSS mašinskog smjera

title: Mekanik Süpervizör
description: Şirket Hakkında Arven İK Danışmanlık olarak, İstanbul'da faaliyet gösteren, uluslararası hizmet standartlarına sahip, konaklama sektörünün önde gelen lüks otellerinden biri olan iş ortağımız için Mekanik Süpervizör arayışımız bulunmaktadır. İş ortağımızın Teknik Servis Departmanı bünyesinde, mekanik sistemlerin güvenli ve kesintisiz çalışmasını sağlayacak, bakım ve onarım süreçlerini takip ederek teknik operasyonların koordinasyonunda aktif rol üstlenecek bir profesyonel arıyoruz. Pozisyon Hakkında Bu pozisyon, mekanik sistemlerin işletilmesi, bakım ve onarım süreçlerinde 4–6 yıl deneyime sahip, teknik bilgi birikimini operasyonel koordinasyon becerileri ile birleştirmek isteyen profesyoneller için uygun bir kariyer fırsatı sunmaktadır. Mekanik Süpervizör, otelin mekanik altyapısının günlük operasyonlarını takip edecek, teknik arızaların çözümünü koordine edecek ve ekip organizasyonu ile bakım süreçlerinde departman yönetimine destek verecektir. Görev ve Sorumluluklar ● Otelin mekanik tesisat, ısıtma, soğutma ve havalandırma sistemlerinin günlük kontrol, bakım ve onarım süreçlerini takip etmek. ● Mekanik ekipmanların güvenli, verimli ve kesintisiz çalışmasını sağlamak. ● Sıcaklık, basınç ve diğer teknik parametreleri izlemek; ölçüm cihazlarından elde edilen verileri değerlendirmek. ● Kazan sistemleri ve ilgili teknik ekipmanların çalışma performansını denetlemek. ● Periyodik ve önleyici bakım faaliyetlerini yürütmek, teknik arızaların giderilmesini koordine etmek. ● Mekanik ekibiyle birlikte sahada aktif görev almak, operasyonel ihtiyaçlar doğrultusunda gerektiğinde akşam ve gece vardiyalarında çalışmak. ● Bakım, arıza ve işletme faaliyetlerine ilişkin teknik kayıtları düzenli olarak tutmak ve raporlamak. ● Teknik ekibin günlük iş organizasyonu, vardiya planlaması ve eğitim süreçlerinde departman yönetimine destek olmak. ● Diğer departmanlarla koordineli çalışarak teknik ihtiyaçlara zamanında çözüm üretmek. ● Tüm teknik faaliyetlerin iş sağlığı ve güvenliği prosedürlerine ve kurum standartlarına uygun yürütülmesini sağlamak. Aradığımız Nitelikler ● Teknik lise, meslek lisesi veya meslek yüksekokullarının Makine, Mekanik Tesisat, İklimlendirme ve Soğutma veya ilgili bölümlerinden mezun, ● Mekanik sistemlerin bakım, onarım ve işletilmesi alanında 4–6 yıl deneyimli, ● Tercihen otelcilik veya benzer tesis yönetimi operasyonlarında teknik servis deneyimi bulunan, ● Isıtma, soğutma, havalandırma ve kazan sistemleri konusunda teknik bilgi sahibi, ● Mekanik arıza tespiti, periyodik bakım ve teknik ekipman yönetimi konularında deneyimli, ● Elektrik tesisatı, sarı ve bakır kaynak uygulamaları hakkında teknik bilgi ve uygulama deneyimine sahip, ● Orta seviyede İngilizce bilen, ● Teknik ekip koordinasyonu ve operasyonel iş takibinde sorumluluk alabilecek, ● İş sağlığı ve güvenliği standartlarına hâkim, ● Planlama, organizasyon ve problem çözme becerileri güçlü, ● İletişim becerileri gelişmiş, ekip çalışmasına yatkın ve sorumluluk sahibi çalışma arkadaşları arıyoruz. Bu Pozisyon Neler Sunuyor? Bu rol, mekanik sistemler alanındaki deneyimini uluslararası hizmet standartlarına sahip prestijli bir otel bünyesinde değerlendirmek, teknik operasyonlarda aktif sorumluluk üstlenmek ve ekip koordinasyonu alanında kendini geliştirmek isteyen profesyoneller için önemli bir kariyer fırsatı sunmaktadır. Teknik uzmanlığınızı profesyonel bir otel ortamında değerlendirmek ve kariyerinizde yeni bir adım atmak istiyorsanız başvurunuzu bekliyoruz. Başvurular Arven İK Danışmanlık tarafından gizlilik esasları çerçevesinde değerlendirilecektir.

title: Global Lead Engineer
description: At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. This position reports to: Global Project Execution Manager __ Your Role And Responsibilities Design authority for engineering disciplines related to complete assignments to support local units on tenders, projects or portions projects in accordance with contract specifications, quality standards and safety requirements. In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute our global engineering function, providing technical support across Engineering Units within Sales and Solutions Global Solutions Centers. You will be the focal design authority for engineering disciplines related to complete assignments with the aim to support local units on tenders, projects or portions of projects in accordance with contract specifications, quality standards and safety requirements. The work model for the role is: # hybrid, Position location: EMEA This role is contributing to the Electrification Distribution Solutions Business Division. You will be mainly accountable for: Provides technical support for design activities, preparation of technical documentation, testing, installation, and commissioning procedures. Supports local units in the preparation of tender and project documentation within the assigned scope of work. Actively participates in project and tendering meetings, resolving technical issues to ensure contractual obligations are met. Assists in the preparation of engineering project proposals, presentations, and planning activities. Performs design verification using applicable standards, engineering guidelines, and checklists while ensuring compliance with safety regulations and contractual requirements. Shares best practices and Lessons Learned documentation across projects and disciplines, while identifying process and tool improvement opportunities. Supports technical risk assessments and reports contract, safety, quality, schedule, or cost-related issues to Project Manager(s) for resolution. Collaborates with Supply Chain, factories, and local units to ensure technical solutions are properly manufactured, staged, tested, installed, and commissioned. Supports updates of engineering deliverables after installation and commissioning and shares lessons learned within the global team for future implementation. Qualifications For The Role You are highly skilled in MV/LV systems, Protection & Control, Automation, Auxiliary Systems, eHouse and mobile solutions, with strong understanding of the EPC engineering environment and switchgear engineering processes. You have established experience in Data Center applications, particularly within Hyperscale and Colocation environments. Possess enhanced knowledge of commissioning activities and quality procedures related to FAT and SAT processes. You are passionate about effective communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration across regions and organizational levels. Have demonstrated experience working with engineering projects involving power distribution, automation systems, and switchgear solutions. More About Us ABB's Distribution Solutions Division facilitates the efficient and reliable distribution, protection and control of power by improving electric power quality while strengthening the resilience of the grid. The Division offers segment-specific products and solutions that largely serve utilities, industry and infrastructure segments, often providing the requisite medium-voltage link between high-voltage transmission systems and low-voltage users. With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions at its core, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 66 kilovolts), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, reclosers, fuses, contactors, relays, instrument transformers, sensors, motor control centers, as well as low-voltage switchgear for the ANSI standard markets. This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive. The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards. Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Mekanik Teknisyeni
description: Pozisyon hakkında; Rixos Antalya Residences bünyesinde görevlendirilmek üzere, tesisin teknik işletme, bakım ve onarım süreçlerinde aktif rol alacak Mekanik Teknikeri arıyoruz.
