Periyodik ve önleyici bakım faaliyetlerini yürütmek. Havuz ve SPA sistemleri; Açık havuz ve havuz teknik ekipmanlarının işletme ve bakım süreçlerini takip etmek. Otomatik dozajlama, klorlama ve pH kontrol sistemleri hakkında bilgi sahibi olmak. SPA alanlarındaki mekanik ve su sistemlerinin bakım süreçlerine destek vermek. Elektrik ve otomasyon sistemleri; Temel elektrik tesisatı ve elektrik sistemlerinin bakım ve kontrollerini gerçekleştirmek. Aydınlatma, sensör, zaman saati ve otomasyon sistemlerinin kontrollerini gerçekleştirmek. Elektriksel arızaların tespit ve giderilmesine yetkinliği kapsamında destek vermek. Genel teknik işletme; Rezidansın ortak alanlarında ve teknik mahallerinde düzenli kontroller gerçekleştirmek. Dairelerden ve ortak kullanım alanlarından gelen teknik bakım ve arıza taleplerini değerlendirmek. Teknik ekipmanların güvenli, verimli ve kesintisiz çalışmasını sağlamak. Bakım, arıza ve müdahale kayıtlarını düzenli tutmak. Teknik malzeme ve yedek parça ihtiyaçlarını takip etmek. İş sağlığı ve güvenliği kurallarına uygun çalışmak. Aranan nitelikler Mekanik bakım, onarım ve arıza tespiti konusunda deneyimli. Pompa, motor, hidrofor ve mekanik tesisat sistemlerine hâkim. Havuz mekanik sistemleri ve havuz ekipmanları konusunda bilgi sahibi. Elektrik tesisatı, elektrik motorları ve kumanda panoları konusunda teknik bilgi sahibi. Tercihen otel, rezidans, AVM veya büyük ölçekli tesislerin teknik işletme süreçlerinde deneyimli. Teknik çizim ve şema okuyabilen. El aletleri ve ölçüm cihazlarını etkin kullanabilen. Arıza tespiti ve problem çözme becerisi gelişmiş. Takım çalışmasına yatkın, sorumluluk sahibi ve çözüm odaklı. Tercih sebebi olacak yetkinlikler Havuz işletme ve bakım tecrübesi. SPA ve ısıtmalı havuz sistemleri deneyimi. Bina otomasyon sistemleri (BMS) bilgisi. HVAC ve merkezi mekanik sistemler deneyimi. Otel veya lüks rezidans teknik işletme tecrübesi. title: AI Engineer — Simulation & Training Systems
description: About Us Junosis Teknoloji A.Ş. develops simulation and training systems for land, air, and naval platforms across defense and civilian industries. Our projects bring together software, physical controls, motion systems, and interactive 3D environments to support practical, scenario-based training. We are expanding our AI capabilities to develop intelligent instructor support, adaptive learning, and performance assessment features across our simulation and technical training platforms. Position Summary We are looking for an AI Engineer who can turn AI concepts into reliable, working applications. You will develop AI components that help trainees access technical information, receive feedback, and improve their performance. Working closely with our Unity3D developers and technical specialists, you will integrate these components into simulation and interactive training environments. A key focus of this role is building locally deployed AI systems that can operate without internet access or external cloud services . Responsibilities Develop and integrate AI features for virtual instructors, technical training assistants, and instructor support tools. Build RAG pipelines that retrieve relevant information from approved technical manuals, procedures, and training materials, with traceable source references. Deploy and optimize locally hosted language models for offline and on-premises environments. Develop methods to analyze trainee actions, identify procedural errors, and generate useful performance feedback. Support adaptive training features that adjust guidance or scenario difficulty based on trainee performance. Collaborate with Unity3D developers to connect AI services to simulation environments through well-defined APIs and data interfaces. Evaluate AI outputs for accuracy, relevance, response time, and consistency; implement safeguards for unsupported or incorrect responses. Take solutions from prototype to deployment, including testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and maintenance. Integrate developed AI components into Unity projects and test their functionality, performance, and compatibility within the simulation environment. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Strong Python programming skills and hands-on experience developing AI/ML applications. Practical experience with LLM applications, embeddings, vector search, and RAG pipelines. Experience running and integrating locally hosted models, with an understanding of memory, GPU, and latency constraints. Experience with at least one major machine learning framework, such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. Ability to build APIs and integrate AI components into existing software systems. Understanding of data preparation, model evaluation, and systematic testing of AI applications. Familiarity with Git and collaborative software development practices. Ability to work with software developers and domain specialists to translate training needs into technical requirements. Good command of English for reading technical documentation and communicating technical ideas. Preferred Qualifications Experience integrating AI services with Unity3D or other real-time 3D applications; familiarity with C#. Experience with simulation, interactive technical training, or decision-support systems. Experience with model quantization, inference optimization, or fine-tuning. Familiarity with Docker, Linux, and deploying applications in restricted or isolated network environments. Experience with speech recognition or text-to-speech systems, particularly for Turkish and English. Experience in learning analytics, adaptive learning, or automated performance assessment. Knowledge of computer vision, reinforcement learning, or behavior modeling for simulation applications. Experience with MCP tools and custom AI skills to connect AI models with external tools, data sources, and application workflows. What We Offer The opportunity to develop AI features for real simulation and training products. Close collaboration with software, hardware, and domain specialists. Involvement throughout the development lifecycle, from early prototypes to deployed systems. Opportunities to contribute to national and international projects. A collaborative environment that supports technical ownership and continuous learning. Application Please include examples of relevant projects with your application, where available. A short description of your contribution, the technologies used, and how the solution was evaluated or deployed is particularly valuable. Public repositories or demos are welcome but not required; please do not share confidential project materials.

title: Senior QA Engineer (OTE $50,000/year USD), Sparkrock
description: Are you a senior QA engineer who writes the test automation that keeps enterprise ERP software reliable? At Sparkrock, we help social benefit organizations, such as nonprofits, school boards, and government agencies, reach their full potential through technology. Every day, over 150,000 people use our ERP and product platforms to work more efficiently, freeing up time and resources to focus on the good they want to achieve. When our software works reliably, those people spend their time on their mission instead of on workarounds. We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer to strengthen how we test our ERP products. You will own quality from business requirements to release: planning test cycles, designing and writing test cases, building and maintaining automated tests and frameworks, and tracking defects to resolution. You will work closely with development, product management, and operations. Reporting to the Director of Platform Development, you will shape how QA works across our products and be measured on what you deliver: complete, relevant test coverage, clear test cases, and automated tests that run reliably and are easy to maintain. If you enjoy complex enterprise systems and keep improving your work through metrics and new tools, we would love to hear from you. Responsibilities Analyse business requirements to understand the testing needs and keep testing aligned with business goals. Design test cases and strategies that cover all functionality and scenarios. Plan test cycles and schedule them around development phases and project timelines. Write clear, concise test cases and scripts. Run tests manually and with automation to find issues and bugs. Develop and maintain automated test scripts and frameworks to make testing more efficient. Report test results, give a clear view of software quality, and recommend improvements. Track defects from identification to resolution and make sure they are fixed on time. Maintain the QA testing environment and tools that keep testing efficient. Requirements 5 years or more of experience in QA automation. Hands-on experience writing and maintaining automated test code and frameworks. Experience testing ERP or other enterprise SaaS products in production. Experience turning business requirements into test plans and test cases. Experience managing defects from identification to resolution. Experience working in Agile teams. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field, and an ISTQB, CSTE, or similar testing certification. Fluent, professional English, spoken and written Nice to have Experience with Microsoft Business Central is a huge advantage Experience with writing AL-based tests for Microsoft Business Central is an even greater advantage Daily use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude Code. Benefits We don’t call them perks; they’re just part of what makes working at Sparkrock great. We are 100% remote and global. Live your best life, wherever that may be, and never lose out on career opportunities because of it. Flexible work hours. We work asynchronously and don’t care when you’re online, just that you deliver great results. Dedication to development. We focus on career paths for each and every one of our employees and help provide training to advance at every stage of their careers. Introductions to thought leaders in the space and webinars on cutting-edge tech hot topics Stipend to help set up your ideal home office Focus on culture. Coffee chats, happy hours, cooking classes, book clubs, and more! Sparkrock is an equal opportunity employer and encourages applications from traditionally underrepresented groups. This is a fully remote independent contractor engagement and is not eligible for company-sponsored employee benefit programs. We welcome applications from any country where we can lawfully engage you. If you need an accommodation during the application process, you can request it once you apply. All open roles are for existing vacancies unless otherwise communicated. We notify all interviewed applicants of our hiring decision within 45 days of their interview and retain job postings and related recruitment information for at least three years. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Mechanical Engineer
description: Wat is jouw rol? Bij Lely ontwikkelen we robots en geavanceerde machines die wereldwijd bijdragen aan een duurzamere en efficiëntere melkveehouderij. Als Mechanical Engineer speel je een belangrijke rol in het ontwerpen en realiseren van innovatieve oplossingen die dagelijks worden gebruikt op boerderijen over de hele wereld. Je werkt binnen multidisciplinaire productontwikkelingsteams aan de ontwikkeling van nieuwe producten én de doorontwikkeling van bestaande oplossingen. Daarbij vertaal je gebruikersbehoeften en technische eisen naar slimme, robuuste en produceerbare ontwerpen. Van het eerste concept tot validatie in de praktijk ben je betrokken bij het volledige ontwikkelproces. Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is de combinatie van engineering en praktijk. De ene dag werk je aan een nieuw ontwerp in CAD, de volgende dag test je een prototype in onze werkplaats of bezoek je een boerderij om te zien hoe jouw oplossing presteert in de dagelijkse praktijk. Zo zie je direct de impact van je werk en werk je continu aan producten die betrouwbaar functioneren onder uitdagende omstandigheden. Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden Ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van mechanische componenten, subsystemen en complete machines voor onze robotoplossingen. Samenwerken met collega's uit onder andere software, elektronica, systems engineering en testing om tot geïntegreerde oplossingen te komen. Begeleiden van prototypes van ontwerp tot validatie en ondersteunen bij het testen van nieuwe concepten. Afstemmen met leveranciers over technische oplossingen, maakbaarheid en optimalisaties. Analyseren en oplossen van technische vraagstukken tijdens ontwikkeling, testen of in het veld. Bijdragen aan een soepele overgang van ontwerp naar serieproductie, met oog voor kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en kostenefficiëntie. Solliciteer

title: Senior Principal Mechanical Engineer, Robotics Capital & Test Systems - Surgical
description: Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact. A Day in the Life Making the best possible surgery accessible to every patient. We believe the future of surgery is less invasive and more precise, predictable, and personalised. We bring together sharp surgical expertise, extensive medical knowledge, and cutting-edge technology with a single-minded focus on each patient - wherever they are, and however they need to be treated. Each surgical specialty faces unique challenges, yet the goal is universal: better care for patients. By understanding these differences, we deliver solutions that empower surgeons and keep patients at the heart of every decision. We are seeking a Senior Principal Mechanical Design Engineer – Robotics Capital & Test Systems to provide technical leadership for the design and development of the physical infrastructure used to characterise, verify and validate advanced medical devices and robotic systems. The role will combine deep machine-design expertise with hands-on engineering to deliver robust fixtures, mechanisms, actuators, load-application systems, instrument interfaces, mounting structures and capital-equipment adaptations. This is a senior individual-contributor role with significant influence across multidisciplinary teams. The successful candidate will define mechanical architecture, lead critical design decisions and establish reusable test-system platforms that safely and repeatably reproduce clinically relevant loads, motions and boundary conditions while meeting requirements for accuracy, reliability, usability, manufacturability, serviceability and cost. The role will be based at the Mervue Campus in Galway, Ireland. Lead the mechanical design and development of capital equipment and test systems used for instrument performance testing, characterisation, identification, verification and engineering investigations. Design precision fixtures, mechanisms, actuators, load frames, load-application devices, instrument interfaces, mounting structures, guarding and capital-side adaptations. Translate test objectives, system requirements and measurement needs into robust mechanical architectures and detailed equipment specifications. Create and review 3D models, assemblies, drawings, bills of materials and design documentation using SolidWorks and Creo. Apply machine-design principles including structural design, mechanism and actuator selection, bearings and guides, tolerance analysis, materials, fastening, alignment and maintainability. Integrate mechanical systems with motors, sensors, data-acquisition hardware, controls, electrical cabinets, safety circuits and software interfaces. Perform engineering analysis and appropriately apply calculations, tolerance stack-ups, motor and transmission sizing, structural analysis and finite element analysis. Lead concept generation, feasibility, prototyping, detailed design, design reviews, build, commissioning, verification, troubleshooting and release of test equipment. Ensure equipment provides controlled, repeatable and traceable application of force, torque, displacement, velocity and other relevant mechanical inputs. Embed machine-safety, ergonomics, guarding, risk reduction and safe access for set-up, calibration, maintenance and service activities. Collaborate with test, systems, electrical, controls, software, quality, manufacturing, facilities and external suppliers to deliver integrated solutions. Lead technical problem solving, root-cause investigations and design improvements for complex interactions between instruments, robotic systems and test infrastructure. Key Skills & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline with 10+ years of relevant experience, OR a Master’s/advanced degree with 8+ years of relevant experience. Demonstrated senior-level experience in machine design, capital equipment, automation equipment, test systems or special-purpose machinery. Strong capability in the design of precision fixtures, mechanisms, structures, actuators, load paths and electromechanical assemblies. Proven hands-on capability using SolidWorks and/or Creo for 3D modelling, large assemblies, drawings and design documentation. Strong understanding of mechanical design principles, materials, manufacturing processes, assembly methods, geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, and tolerance analysis. Experience selecting and sizing motors, gearboxes, linear actuators, bearings, guides, transmissions, load cells and other sensors used in test equipment. Experience integrating mechanical equipment with electrical, controls, software, data-acquisition and systems-engineering interfaces. Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical decisions, conduct design reviews and solve multidisciplinary equipment and test-system problems. Strong communication, collaboration, technical leadership and mentoring skills. Experience with machine safety, risk assessment, guarding, ergonomics, equipment commissioning, calibration and preventive-maintenance considerations is desirable. Experience in medical devices, robotics, regulated product development or high-reliability test environments is advantageous. title: Senior Specialist (Product Scale-up), Global Manufacturing
description: Role and impact How do you help a new catalyst product move from development towards production? In this role, you’ll work at the practical heart of scale-up: designing, building and commissioning a catalyst production pilot line, then using it to run tests, develop process knowledge and deliver new capable products to our production plants. Your work will also support production teams with troubleshooting and help plant engineering make informed equipment decisions. Responsibilities Your primary objective will be to deliver capable new catalyst products, supported by well-established and understood process windows, to the industrialization step—the next stage in our new product development stage-gate model. You will plan and carry out work safely, optimize equipment and processes, report your findings, and document relevant best practices. You will also work with production and engineering colleagues to address equipment and process needs. This Will Involve Designing, building and commissioning equipment for a catalyst production pilot line. Performing tests at the Manufacturing Development Centre, including completing safety assessments and reporting results. Troubleshooting production challenges and supporting problem-solving as a subject-matter expert in relevant unit operations and equipment. Assisting plant engineering and EPCM with equipment selection, testing (on site or at vendors) and reviews. What You Will Bring Equipment and/or unit operation subject matter expert in e.g. powder handling, milling, screening, continuous furnaces etc. Experience in Plant process engineering and commissioning experience Minimum 7 -10 years of relevant experience Experience troubleshooting and solving problems in industrial production processes. A practical, hands-on approach and confidence working directly with equipment. The ability to write clear, scientifically sound reports in English and communicate fluently in English, both spoken and written. Flexibility to manage changing priorities and work to tight timelines. Ability to work with several tasks and projects simultaneously, being robust/resilient when faced with challenges It Would Also Be An Advantage To Have Experience with production process scale-up or scale-down. Danish, both written and spoken or with a willingness to learn the language Project management experience. Knowledge of risk assessment, data handling or statistics Ability to think strategically and proactively seek information with respect to what is needed for future pilot development, Project manager experience, knowledge on risk assessment. Knowledge on data handling and statistics an advantage Why join us You’ll have the opportunity to be a part of accelerating new catalyst products to the market by building and operating a pilot facility, take part in practical testing, optimizing, and solve real equipment and production challenges. The role brings together design, hands-on problem-solving and technical reporting, with work that supports scale-up and manufacturing development. Your new Team You’ll join R&D’s Scale-up and Manufacturing Development team. You’ll work with colleagues involved in developing and industrializing new catalyst products, pilot testing, production troubleshooting and plant engineering support. The team’s work connects equipment and process development with the needs of industrial production. How You Can Apply If you would like to be part of a team of skilled and professional colleagues in an informal organization, please submit your documents in English. Application deadline: 23-11-2026. If you have questions regarding the role, feel free to reach out to Ninna Halberg Jokil, Director- Scale up and Manufacturing development, on NIH@topsoe.com. You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application – just include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are applying. Please also avoid the use of photos in your CV. Both these measures are to ensure a fair and unbiased process. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, irrespective of their gender, age, religion, disability, ethnic background, and geographical location. We encourage individuals from diverse cultures and countries to apply and contribute to our global team. To ensure a secure and trustworthy work environment, our recruitment process may include background checks, requests for criminal records, and contact with references. To headhunters: Thank you for your interest in our company. However, we would like to inform you that we have a dedicated internal team managing our recruitment process. We kindly request that you refrain from reaching out to us regarding potential candidates. Thank you for your understanding. About Us Topsoe is a leading global provider of advanced technology and solutions for the energy transition. Built on decades of scientific research and innovation, we are working with customers and partners to drive energy resiliency and to achieve their sustainability goals. We offer world-leading solutions for transforming renewable resources into fuels and chemicals, and we provide technologies needed to produce low-carbon and conventional fuels and chemicals as well as ensuring clean air. We were founded in 1940 and are headquartered in Denmark, with around 2,500 employees serving customers all around the globe. To learn more, visit www.topsoe.com. At Topsoe we strive towards having a safe work environment. We are aware of the risks in our work and continuously optimize our safety procedures.

title: Mekanikkonstruktör – avancerad produktutveckling
description: Därför är detta jobb för dig Du är en erfaren mekanikkonstruktör med en stark bakgrund inom produktutveckling, gärna från försvarsindustrin eller annan teknikintensiv verksamhet. Du har arbetat med komplexa mekaniska konstruktioner där precision, funktion, kvalitet och tillförlitlighet behöver samverka. Hos oss får du möjlighet att använda din erfarenhet i tekniskt utmanande utvecklingsprojekt, där du arbetar med allt från vidareutveckling av befintliga produkter till utveckling av helt nya tekniska lösningar. Projekten kan omfatta avancerade mekaniska system och komponenter där höga krav ställs på prestanda, robusthet och funktion även under krävande förhållanden. Vi tror på att ge våra ingenjörer både ansvar och utrymme att påverka. Du får möjlighet att bidra med din kompetens, dina idéer och ditt tekniska kunnande i nära samarbete med andra specialister i tvärfunktionella team, där samarbete och kunskapsutbyte är en naturlig del av vardagen. Du kommer att tillhöra vårt affärsområde Hardware & Design, där vi kombinerar bred ingenjörskompetens med djup specialistkunskap för att utveckla fysiska produkter och tekniska lösningar – hela vägen från tidiga koncept till färdig produkt och produktion. Arbetsuppgifter Som mekanikkonstruktör arbetar du med produktutveckling i tekniskt komplexa projekt, där krav på funktion, precision, kvalitet och tillförlitlighet är centrala. Beroende på projekt och din erfarenhet kan dina arbetsuppgifter bland annat innebära att: Utveckla och vidareutveckla avancerade mekaniska konstruktioner, komponenter och system. Arbeta med konstruktion och produktutveckling från koncept och detaljkonstruktion till verifiering och produktionsanpassning. Ta fram robusta och tillförlitliga tekniska lösningar med hänsyn till materialval, hållfasthet, toleranser och tillverkningsmetoder. Arbeta med mekaniska gränssnitt och integration av komponenter i större tekniska system. Samarbeta med tvärfunktionella team inom exempelvis konstruktion, beräkning, provning och systemutveckling. Bidra med teknisk kompetens vid kravställning, problemlösning, dokumentation och verifiering av tekniska lösningar. Kvalifikationer Vi söker dig som har en gedigen teknisk bakgrund och erfarenhet av mekanisk konstruktion och produktutveckling. Du är van att arbeta med komplexa produkter och system där flera tekniska discipliner behöver samverka och där höga krav ställs på funktion, kvalitet och tillförlitlighet. Du har ett analytiskt och strukturerat arbetssätt, tycker om att lösa tekniska problem och trivs i utvecklingsmiljöer där noggrannhet, teknisk dokumentation och förståelse för helheten är viktiga delar av arbetet. Vi Söker Dig Som Har Ingenjörsexamen inom maskinteknik, mekanikkonstruktion, produktutveckling eller motsvarande. Minst 6 års erfarenhet av mekanikkonstruktion och produktutveckling, gärna från tekniskt komplexa produkter eller system. Goda kunskaper i 3D-CAD, exempelvis CATIA, Creo, SolidWorks eller Siemens NX. Erfarenhet av konstruktion där faktorer som hållfasthet, toleranser, materialval, funktion och tillverkningsbarhet har stor betydelse. Erfarenhet av att arbeta strukturerat med tekniska krav, dokumentation och kvalitetssäkring genom produktutvecklingsprocessen. Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift. Det Är Meriterande Om Du Har Erfarenhet av produktutveckling i CATIA V5 samt arbete i PDM- eller PLM-system. Erfarenhet från försvarsindustrin, exempelvis Saab, BAE Systems eller liknande verksamheter. Erfarenhet av utveckling av avancerade mekaniska system och komponenter med höga krav på robusthet, precision och driftsäkerhet. Erfarenhet av produktutveckling i större organisationer med etablerade utvecklingsprocesser, kravhantering och verifiering. Säkerhetsprövning Flera av våra kunder anlitar oss för säkerhetsklassade uppdrag så säkerhetsprövning kan komma att ske. Dessa tjänster kan kräva svenskt medborgarskap. En spännande resa med Knightec Group Knightec Group är idag en av Norra Europas ledande strategiska partners inom produkt- och digital tjänsteutveckling – hur häftigt är inte det? Genom att förena ingenjörskompetens, digital expertis och affärsförståelse hjälper vi våra kunder att omvandla ny teknik till verkliga lösningar som skapar värde. Work that matters - Unlike many consultancies we also get involved at the pre-product stage. If your part of a project is going great and another is struggling, don't settle for polishing a chunk of a struggling ship Socials: Table tennis every lunch, personal project evenings, pub trips, trail running club, and more Office: Spacious, modern space in central Sheffield, with parking and bike storage. Develop detailed FEA models and analytical calculations to support design decisions and component sizing. Solid knowledge of classical stress calculations, structural sizing, fatigue analysis, and durability assessment. Experience evaluating thermal deformation, hot to cold geometry changes, and tip clearance optimization. Understanding of high temperature aerospace materials, creep, thermo mechanical fatigue, and material behaviour. Experience analyzing bearings, shafts, sealing systems, interference fits, and mechanical joints. Familiarity with aerospace manufacturing processes including machining, casting, additive manufacturing, and heat treatment. Strong communication skills with professional English proficiency. You thrive in a fast moving development environment where testing, iteration, and collaboration are part of everyday work. You are naturally curious, hands on, and motivated by seeing your analyses validated on real hardware while taking ownership of complex engineering challenges from concept through production. title: Research Associate in Modelling and Robotics
description: Research Associate in Modelling and Robotics About The Role We are seeking a motivated Research Associate to join our research team at the University of Bath, contributing to the ARIA-funded Robot Dexterity Programme. The project aims to advance the fundamental understanding, modelling and control of robotic systems, with a particular focus on developing new analytical and computational frameworks for dexterous soft robotic manipulators. The successful candidate will contribute to ground breaking research at the intersection of computational mechanics, robotics and intelligent modelling, working within a multidisciplinary team to bridge fundamental physical principles and practical robotic applications. Key Responsibilities Include High-fidelity computational modelling: Develop and validate advanced physics-based models of robotic systems, including nonlinear mechanics, structural dynamics, large deformation and multi physics interactions, using numerical simulation tools such as COMSOL, ABAQUS or ANSYS. Robotic modelling and dynamics: Investigate the kinematics, dynamics and actuation of robotic manipulators, particularly soft and continuum robots, and establish computational frameworks that capture their complex physical behaviour. Experimental validation: Design and conduct experiments to validate high-fidelity computational models of robotic systems, integrating experimental measurements with numerical simulations to assess model accuracy, investigate dynamic behaviour and support the development of robotic manipulation and control. Research collaboration and validation: Work closely with researchers in robotics, modelling and control to validate theoretical developments through simulations and experiments, contribute to scientific publications, and support the delivery of project achievements. About You You will have a PhD (or be close to completion) in Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, Computational Mechanics, Applied Mathematics or a closely related fields. Experience in robotics, finite element analysis, multi physics simulation would be particularly advantageous. This position offers an opportunity to contribute to an ambitious ARIA research programme, combining fundamental engineering science with the development of next-generation intelligent robotic systems. We are looking for a motivated researcher with a strong background in computational modelling and robotics, who enjoys tackling challenging engineering problems and working collaboratively within a multidisciplinary research team. Essential Qualifications, Skills And Experience A PhD (or nearing completion) in Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, Computational Mechanics, Applied Mathematics or a closely related STEM field, or equivalent relevant research experience. Strong knowledge and practical experience in high-fidelity computational modelling, particularly finite element analysis (FEA), nonlinear mechanics, structural dynamics or multi physics simulation. Experience using numerical simulation software such as COMSOL, ABAQUS or ANSYS, or equivalent computational modelling tools. A good understanding of robotic systems, including kinematics, dynamics, actuation and control. Strong programming and numerical analysis skills, preferably in MATLAB, Python or equivalent environments. Ability to conduct independent research, analyse complex technical problems and communicate findings effectively. Good interpersonal and collaborative skills, with the ability to contribute effectively to a multidisciplinary research team. We welcome applications from candidates with diverse technical backgrounds who can demonstrate relevant expertise and a willingness to develop new skills. Further information The role is offered on a full time (36.5 hours per week) fixed term basis with an expected start date of January/February 2027. For an informal discussion about the role, please contact Professor Min Pan at m.pan@bath.ac.uk. We consider ourselves to be a university where difference is celebrated, respected and encouraged. You will be supported by an experienced engineering team, with the opportunity to build specialist knowledge and take on increasing technical responsibility as your experience develops. title: Ingénieur-e Développement Mécanique F/H
description: Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie, actif dans l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements, intérieurs), l'espace et la défense. Sa mission : contribuer à un monde plus sûr et à un transport aérien plus écologique, confortable et accessible. Présent sur tous les continents, Safran emploie 110 000 collaborateurs, réalise 31,3 milliards d'euros de chiffre d'affaires en 2025, et occupe des positions majeures, seul ou en partenariat, sur ses marchés mondiaux ou européens. Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME. Safran Transmission Systems, héritier d'une tradition d'innovation, fait partie des leaders mondiaux des systèmes de transmission de puissance mécanique pour avions commerciaux, d'affaires et militaires, avec plus de 50 000 produits en service et 80% de parts de marché sur les avions court et moyen-courriers. Ses 2 000 collaborateurs, principalement en France et en Pologne, couvrent R&D, conception, fabrication et maintien en service, pilotant un réseau d'une centaine de fournisseurs majeurs. Safran Transmission Systems développe des systèmes innovants pour la prochaine génération de moteurs et la propulsion électrique et hybride, participant à la décarbonation de l'aéronautique. Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi. Au sein de notre équipe Développement, vous serez responsable des études techniques, de la conception, de la fiabilisation de matériels. Vos principales activités sont : * Piloter et exécuter les phases de conception mécanique dans le cadre du processus de développement, en garantissant le respect des coûts, de la qualité et des délais. * Réaliser des simulations (éléments finis, calculs structurels) et interpréter les résultats pour ajuster vos solutions et proposer des évolutions méthodologiques. * Rédiger et contrôler la documentation technique (notes de calcul, plans , dossiers d'essais, rapports de conformité) selon les procédures internes. * Veiller à la fabricabilité et à la maintenabilité des matériels tout au long du cycle de vie produit. * Identifier et valoriser vos innovations par le dépôt de déclarations d'inventions * Capitaliser et transmettre les bonnes pratiques auprès des autres ingénieurs et des réseaux d'expertise. De formation Bac + 5 en génie mécanique, ou doctorat dans un domaine proche Vous possédez une expérience d'au moins 3 ans sur une fonction similaire, idéalement dans l'aéronautique, l'automobile ou un secteur industriel exigeant. Au cours de votre parcours vous avez acquis des compétences en : * Conception et dimensionnement mécanique (familiarité avec les normes de cotation et de tolérancement) * Maîtrise des outils de simulation et d'analyse (éléments finis, calculs matériaux…) * Rédaction de documents techniques et suivi de validation (NT, CAD, DECs, plans d'essais) Enfin vous savez faire preuve : * D'esprit d'équipe et bonnes aptitudes relationnelles * De sens de l'organisation, rigueur et fiabilité * D'autonomie, curiosité technique et capacité à prendre des initiatives * Et avez des notions de gestion de projets et d'amélioration continue

title: Entwicklungsingenieur:in Mechanik / Maschinenbau (m/f/d)
description: Job Description Agilent inspiriert und unterstützt Entdeckungen, die zur Verbesserung der Lebensqualität beitragen. Wir versorgen Labore in den Bereichen Life Science, Diagnostik und angewandte Märkte weltweit mit Instrumenten, Dienstleistungen, Verbrauchsmaterialien, Anwendungen und Know-how. Agilent ermöglicht seinen Kunden, die Antworten und Erkenntnisse zu gewinnen, die sie suchen, damit sie das tun können, was sie am besten können: die Welt um uns herum verbessern. Weitere Informationen über Agilent Technologies: www.agilent.com. Für unser R&D Mechanical Engineering Team in Waldbronn suchen wir eine:n erfahrene:n Entwicklungsingenieur:in mit Schwerpunkt Maschinenbau. In dieser Rolle entwickelst du anspruchsvolle mechanische Baugruppen für analytische Instrumente und verantwortest technische Arbeitspakete von der Konzeption über Konstruktion und Prototyping bis zur Verifikation und Vorbereitung für die Produktion. Dabei verbindest du fundiertes Mechanical Engineering mit Hands-on-Mentalität, Eigenverantwortung und enger interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit. Deine Aufgaben Du entwickelst und konstruierst komplexe mechanische Komponenten und Baugruppen von der Konzeptphase bis zur Produktionsvorbereitung. Du entwickelst und bewertest technische Lösungskonzepte hinsichtlich Funktion, Robustheit, Toleranzen, Fertigbarkeit, Kosten und Entwicklungsaufwand. Du erstellst parametrische 3D-CAD-Modelle, fertigungsgerechte Zeichnungen und Toleranzanalysen und legst geeignete Werkstoffe und Fertigungsverfahren fest. Du analysierst auch komplexe technische Probleme selbstständig, entwickelst Lösungsansätze und treibst daraus resultierende Designentscheidungen voran. Du planst, koordinierst und bewertest Prototypen- und Entwicklungsversuche und leitest aus den Ergebnissen konstruktive Verbesserungen ab. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für technische Arbeitspakete, identifizierst Risiken und Abhängigkeiten und vertrittst deine Lösungen in Design Reviews und gegenüber dem Projektteam. Du koordinierst die technischen Schnittstellen zu anderen Engineering-Disziplinen sowie zu NPI, Einkauf, Qualität, Fertigung und externen Partnern. Abhängig von deiner Erfahrung und dem Projektumfang kannst du auch die technische Verantwortung für komplette mechanische Module übernehmen. Qualifications Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossenes Studium im Maschinenbau, in der Mechatronik, Feinwerktechnik oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung. Mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung in der mechanischen Produktentwicklung, typischerweise mindestens 4 Jahre. Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Entwicklung komplexer mechanischer Komponenten oder Baugruppen, idealerweise von der Konzeption über Konstruktion und Prototyping bis zur Verifikation. Sicherer Umgang mit einem parametrischen 3D-CAD-System. Erfahrung mit Siemens NX ist von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung. Gute Kenntnisse in fertigungsgerechter Konstruktion, technischen Zeichnungen, Toleranzen, Passungen und Form- und Lagetolerierung (GD&T). Sehr gutes Verständnis spanender Fertigungsverfahren sowie Erfahrung mit Werkstoffauswahl und Toleranzanalysen. Praktische Erfahrung mit Prototyping, Testing, Verifikation und strukturierter Ursachenanalyse. Grundverständnis weiterer Fertigungstechnologien wie Blechbearbeitung, Kunststoff/Spritzguss sowie von Oberflächen und Beschichtungen ist von Vorteil. Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie die Fähigkeit, technische Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar zu vertreten. Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit und daran, technische Themen auch über Funktionsgrenzen hinweg aktiv voranzutreiben. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens Niveau C1 sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Von Vorteil sind Erfahrung mit Siemens NX und Teamcenter Kenntnisse in Blechkonstruktion und Kunststoff/Spritzguss Kenntnisse zu technischen Oberflächen und Beschichtungen Erfahrung mit additiver Fertigung und Rapid Prototyping Erfahrung im Umgang mit Lieferanten bzw. externen Entwicklungspartnern Erfahrung in einem NPI-Umfeld erste technische Verantwortung für größere Baugruppen, Teilsysteme oder Module Additional Details This job has a full time weekly schedule. title: Ingénieur Calcul de Structures Mécaniques (H/F)
description: À propos d’ACALY 🚀 Créée en 2015, ACALY est une société de conseil en ingénierie implantée en France (Lille, Paris, Lyon et Nantes), en Suisse et en Belgique. Partenaire privilégié des entreprises industrielles, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la réalisation de projets à forte valeur ajoutée, en mobilisant notre expertise technique et notre engagement. Chez ACALY, nous proposons un accompagnement solide dès votre intégration et tout au long de votre parcours professionnel, avec de réelles perspectives d'évolution. ➡️ Description du poste Dans le cadre d'un projet innovant dédié au développement d'un système de stockage d'énergie cinétique à haute vitesse de rotation, vous interviendrez sur des composants mécaniques critiques, avec un rôle essentiel dans la fiabilité, la performance et la sécurité du système. Missions principales : Réaliser les calculs de dimensionnement mécanique des pièces et ensembles en rotation, en tenant compte des contraintes liées aux vitesses de rotation élevées. Construire et exploiter des modèles par éléments finis (FEA) sous ANSYS, en définissant les hypothèses de calcul et en sélectionnant les méthodes de simulation adaptées. Analyser le comportement dynamique du rotor et de ses paliers , notamment les vibrations, les modes propres et les phénomènes de résonance. Étudier la résistance mécanique et la tenue en fatigue des composants , en évaluant les contraintes et les risques de défaillance dans des conditions de fonctionnement exigeantes. Interpréter et valider les résultats des simulations , vérifier la cohérence physique des modèles et proposer des solutions techniques pour améliorer la fiabilité et la sécurité du système. ➡️ Profil recherché Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme d'ingénieur ou d'un Master en mécanique, calcul de structures ou domaine équivalent. Vous disposez idéalement d'une expérience en calcul mécanique, avec une connaissance des machines tournantes et des systèmes fonctionnant à haute vitesse. Compétences techniques : Bonne maîtrise du calcul et du dimensionnement mécanique. Expérience en calcul par éléments finis et capacité à interpréter les résultats de simulation. Connaissances en analyse des contraintes, résistance des matériaux et fatigue. Compréhension des phénomènes de dynamique vibratoire, des modes propres et des fréquences de résonance. Maîtrise du logiciel ANSYS pour les simulations et calculs mécaniques. Connaissance d'un logiciel de CAO mécanique, notamment CREO . Les avantages ACALY Rejoindre ACALY, c’est bénéficier d’un CDI à temps plein et d’un package de rémunération adapté au niveau de responsabilité du poste. Nous proposons notamment un véhicule de société selon le profil et les besoins de la mission, des chèques repas, des écochèques, une assurance santé, et d'autres avantages.

İş Tanımı Proje ve müşteri gereksinimleri ile uygulanabilir standartlara uygun sistem emniyeti ve güvenilirlik programını planlamak; analiz, gözden geçirme, teslimat ve raporlama faaliyetlerini yürütmek. Emniyet ve RAMS gereksinimlerini sistem, alt sistem ve birim seviyelerine ayrıştırmak, tahsis etmek; gereksinimlerin mimari, tasarım ve doğrulama çıktılarıyla izlenebilirliğini sağlamak. Tehlikeleri sistematik olarak belirlemek; riskleri şiddet ve olasılık açısından değerlendirmek, tehlike kaydını (hazard log) güncel tutmak ve risk azaltma aksiyonlarının kapanışını takip etmek. Projenin niteliğine göre FHA, PSSA, SSA, PHA, SHA ve SSHA gibi emniyet değerlendirmelerini gerçekleştirmek veya ilgili disiplinlerle koordineli yürütmek. Hata Ağacı Analizi (FTA), Hata Türleri, Etkileri ve Kritiklik Analizi (FMEA/FMECA), güvenilirlik blok diyagramı ve ortak neden analizleri gibi yöntemleri uygulamak ve raporlamak. Güvenilirlik hedeflerini sistem ve alt sistem seviyelerine tahsis etmek; arıza oranı, MTBF, hazır bulunuşluk, idame edilebilirlik ve test edilebilirlik hesaplarını veya tahminlerini yürütmek. Sistem mimarisi, fonksiyonel ayrıştırma, arayüzler ve tasarım alternatiflerine emniyet ve güvenilirlik girdisi sağlamak; teknik gözden geçirmelere ve tasarım kararlarına katılmak. Sistem, mekanik, elektronik, yazılım, analiz, test, kalite ve proje yönetimi ekipleriyle koordinasyon kurarak emniyet ve güvenilirlik aksiyonlarının proje planına uygun şekilde tamamlanmasını sağlamak. Doğrulama ve test planlarına emniyet ve güvenilirlik girdileri sağlamak; güvenilirlik gösterim, çevresel test, hata enjeksiyonu veya benzeri doğrulama sonuçlarını değerlendirmek. Prototip, test, üretim ve saha kullanımından gelen arıza verilerini FRACAS kapsamında takip etmek; kök neden, düzeltici faaliyet ve etkinlik doğrulama çalışmalarına katkı sağlamak. Uygunluk matrisi, emniyet değerlendirme raporu, güvenilirlik raporu ve müşteri teslimatlarını hazırlamak; önemli riskleri, sapmaları ve aksiyon durumlarını proje yönetimine düzenli raporlamak. Aranan Nitelikler Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği, Mekatronik Mühendisliği, Uçak Mühendisliği, Havacılık ve Uzay Mühendisliği veya ilgili bölümlerinden mezun. Sistem, alt sistem veya birim seviyesinde emniyet ve/veya güvenilirlik çalışmalarında en az 6 yıl proje deneyimli. FTA, FMEA/FMECA, tehlike analizi, risk değerlendirme ve güvenilirlik tahmini yöntemlerinden birkaçını uygulamalı olarak kullanmış. Gereksinimlerin ayrıştırılması, tahsisi, izlenebilirliği ve doğrulama yöntemlerinin belirlenmesi konularında bilgi sahibi. Arıza oranı, MTBF, hazır bulunuşluk ve benzeri güvenilirlik ölçütlerini hesaplayabilecek; nicel verileri ve analiz varsayımlarını sorgulayabilecek düzeyde istatistik ve mühendislik bilgisine sahip. Proje kapsamına bağlı olarak MIL-STD-882, SAE ARP4761/ARP4754, MIL-HDBK-217 veya eşdeğer emniyet ve güvenilirlik standartlarından en az birine aşina. Ansys medini analyze, PTC Windchill veya eşdeğer emniyet analizi, gereksinim ve PLM araçlarından biriyle çalışmış olması tercih sebebidir. Teknik rapor hazırlama, literatür ve güvenilirlik verisi araştırma, kanıta dayalı değerlendirme ve sonuçları tasarım ekiplerine aktarabilme yetkinliği gelişmiş. Sistem, tasarım, analiz, test, kalite ve proje ekipleriyle etkin iletişim kurabilen; aksiyon takibi ve sonuçlandırma konusunda disiplinli. Analitik düşünebilen, detaylara dikkat eden, problem çözme ve teknik karar alma becerileri güçlü. İyi derecede İngilizce bilen. Seyahat engeli olmayan ve Ankara'da ikamet eden veya edebilecek. Erkek adaylar için askerlik hizmetini tamamlamış veya muaf.

title: Field Service Specialist
description: ZEISS is technology and innovation. Founded in Germany, in 1846, ZEISS is an internationally leading technology enterprise operating in the optics and optoelectronics industries across 50 countries. As a company wholly owned by a foundation, ZEISS is committed to responsibility in all its activities. As a pioneer in scientific optics, its employees across the globe continue to push the boundaries of what is possible. With a strong focus on quality and innovation, ZEISS creates value for its customers and helps shape new ways of seeing the world. We’re looking for a Field Service Specialist to join us in Istanbul or Ankara, Türkiye, with frequent travel to customer sites. ZEISS Research Microscopy Solutions (RMS) provides advanced microscopy solutions for life sciences, materials research, semiconductor, and academic institutions. Our portfolio includes light, confocal, electron, and X-ray microscopy systems, supporting scientific discovery and technological innovation across research and industry. Your Role As a Field Service Specialist, you will be responsible for providing high-quality technical service and support for advanced ZEISS microscopy systems at customer sites. You will work closely with customers, internal teams and global technical experts to ensure equipment performance, customer satisfaction and long-term system reliability. The Role Of Field Service Specialist Will Involve: Installing, commissioning, maintaining, calibrating, upgrading and troubleshooting advanced microscopy systems, including SEM, FE-SEM, FIB-SEM and related equipment. Performing preventive and corrective maintenance, acceptance testing, performance verification and system upgrades in accordance with manufacturer standards. Diagnosing complex technical issues across mechanical, electronic, electrical, computer and software systems, using a structured root cause analysis approach. Providing on-site and remote technical support, identifying customer needs and developing effective, long-term solutions. Working closely with Sales, Applications, Customer Support, Product Management and Global Technical Support teams to resolve technical issues and manage escalations. Providing technical guidance and basic user training to customers on equipment operation, maintenance and best practices. Identifying spare part requirements, supporting service planning and ensuring preventive maintenance activities are completed effectively. Preparing accurate service reports and maintaining complete records of technical activities within CRM, service reporting and ticketing systems. Building strong, long-term customer relationships and maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction. Following all relevant health and safety requirements, including those related to high-voltage systems, vacuum technology, radiation/X-ray safety and laboratory environments. Your Experience Bachelor’s degree in Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Physics, Physics Engineering or a related technical discipline. 1–3 years of experience in a technical service, field service or similar engineering role, preferably within an international organisation. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and develop sustainable solutions. Ability to read and interpret electrical/electronic schematics, technical drawings, service documentation and maintenance instructions. Ability to troubleshoot and analyse mechanical, electronic, computer and software-related issues. Comfortable working with measurement instruments, diagnostic equipment and technical testing tools. Strong customer-facing and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical information clearly and professionally. Good command of written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate effectively with international technical teams. Valid driving licence and active driving experience. Willingness and ability to travel frequently to customer sites. For male candidates, completion of military service or no military obligation is required. It Would Be Desirable If You Had: Experience with electron microscopy, vacuum technology, high-voltage electronics, precision mechanics or scientific instrumentation. Previous experience working with SEM, FE-SEM, FIB-SEM or similar high-technology equipment. Experience with CRM systems, remote support tools, service reporting systems or ticketing platforms. Previous experience working with medical devices, analytical instruments, laboratory equipment or other complex technical systems. Your Benefits If you join ZEISS, you will have access to a range of benefits, including: Working with advanced technologies and highly skilled international teams. Opportunities for technical training, professional development and career growth within a global technology organisation. The opportunity to work directly with customers and contribute to the performance of advanced scientific and research equipment. Role Details Location: Istanbul or Ankara, Türkiye Working conditions: Field-based role with frequent travel to customer sites across Türkiye and occasional international travel as required. Apply now to take the next step in joining ZEISS, where you can push technological boundaries, shape markets and contribute to the advancement of society. Elektronik kart, PCBA, mekanik parça ve cihazlarda giriş, ara ve final kalite kontrollerinin gerçekleştirilmesi, IPC-A-610, IPC/WHMA-A-620 ve J-STD-001 standartlarına göre elektronik kart, lehim, kablo ve montaj kontrollerinin yapılması, Konformal coating, komponent sabitleme ve benzeri özel proseslerin kontrollerinin gerçekleştirilmesi, Mekanik üretimlerde kaynağında muayene (KM / Source Inspection) faaliyetlerinin yürütülmesi, Teknik resim, şartname, kalite planı ve ilgili dokümanlara göre ürün uygunluğunun kontrol edilmesi, TS EN ISO/IEC 17025 kapsamında kalibrasyon süreçlerinin takip edilmesi, Tespit edilen uygunsuzlukların kayıt, Düzeltici Faaliyet / CAPA ve takip süreçlerinin yürütülmesi, DO-254 ve SOI süreçlerinde kalite faaliyetlerine destek olunması, Kalite verilerini takip ederek periyodik raporlar hazırlanması, Kalite kayıtları ve ürün izlenebilirliğinin sürekliliğinin sağlanması. Savunma sanayi ekosistemini deneyimleme fırsatı, İnisiyatif ve sorumluluk alabileceğiniz çalışma alanı, Özel Sağlık Sigortası, Yemek kartı, Ulaşım desteği ya da servis hizmeti opsiyonu, Şirket içi ve şirket dışı etkinlikler, Şirket adaptasyon süreci ve Pavelsis Buddy uygulaması. title: Mechanisch ontwerper - Product Development
description: Werk jij mee aan precisiemechanica voor grensverleggende wetenschap en technologie? Binnen JPE ontwikkelen en leveren we binnen onze CNP-afdeling (Cryo & Nano Products) compacte en uiterst nauwkeurige positioneeroplossingen voor gebruik in cryogene en vacuümomgevingen. Deze technologie wordt wereldwijd toegepast in onder andere quantumtechnologie en wetenschappelijke instrumentatie. Wij zoeken een Mechanical Design Engineer – Productontwikkeling die graag ontwerpt en construeert én producten daadwerkelijk wil bouwen, testen en verbeteren. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor de ontwikkeling en verdere verbetering van onze CNP-producten. Je werkt in een klein team en bent betrokken bij vrijwel de volledige levenscyclus van onze producten: van een eerste idee of verbetering tot engineering, prototypebouw, validatie, documentatie en uiteindelijk toepassing bij de klant. Wat ga je doen? Als Mechanical Design Engineer werk je aan de ontwikkeling en realisatie van onze CNP-positioneerproducten. Daarbij combineer je werktuigbouwkundige engineering met praktisch testen en een goed begrip van de toepassing waarvoor het product wordt ontwikkeld. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Ontwikkelen en verbeteren van mechanische onderdelen, modules en complete CNP-producten Vertalen van functionele eisen naar slimme, nauwkeurige en maakbare constructies Uitwerken van ontwerpen in 3D CAD en productietekeningen Bouwen, assembleren, testen en valideren van prototypes voordat producten worden vrijgegeven Opstellen en onderhouden van technische productdocumentatie, zoals manufacturing data, design reports, assembly manuals, user manuals, datasheets en 3D STEP-modellen Uitvoeren van klantspecifieke aanpassingen en custom engineeringprojecten Technisch ondersteunen van klanten en sales bij selectie, integratie en toepassing van onze producten Signaleren en uitwerken van verbeteringen aan bestaande producten en ideeën voor uitbreiding van het portfolio Verder structureren en verbeteren van onze engineering- en productontwikkelprocessen Technisch actueel houden van productinformatie voor de website Door de omvang van het team is je werk breed. De ene dag werk je aan een nieuw mechanisch concept, de volgende dag analyseer je testresultaten of denk je met een klant mee over de integratie van een positioneeroplossing in zijn systeem. Wat zoeken wij? Je bent een werktuigbouwkundig engineer die graag verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor een product en verder kijkt dan alleen het CAD-model. Je wilt begrijpen waarom een constructie werkt, hoe deze zich in de praktijk gedraagt en wat nodig is om er een betrouwbaar product van te maken. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende: HBO of MSc Werktuigbouwkunde, Precision Engineering of vergelijkbaar Goede kennis van mechanisch ontwerpen en construeren Affiniteit met precision engineering en fijnmechanische constructies Kennis van en affiniteit met onderwerpen zoals: - statisch bepaald construeren - stijfheid en sterkte - toleranties en tolerantieketens - materiaalkeuze - thermisch gedrag - precisiegeleidingen en lageringen - maakbaarheid en assemblage Ervaring met 3D CAD Je werkt analytisch en kunt ontwerpkeuzes technisch onderbouwen Je vindt het leuk om naast engineering ook praktisch bezig te zijn met assemblage, testen en validatie Je kunt zelfstandig werken, maar zoekt actief de samenwerking met collega's uit andere disciplines Je spreekt goed Nederlands en kunt gemakkelijk deelnemen aan zowel technische overleggen als informele gesprekken binnen ons team. Daarnaast communiceer je gemakkelijk in het Engels met collega's, leveranciers en klanten. Je werkt gestructureerd en vindt het belangrijk dat ontwerpen, testresultaten en productdocumentatie goed worden vastgelegd Een pré is ervaring met: Het ontwikkelen van mechanische systemen voor vacuüm-, ultrahoogvacuüm- en/of cryogene omgevingen Constructieprincipes binnen precision engineering Aangrenzende vakgebieden zoals electronica, mechatronica Wat maakt deze functie bijzonder? In deze functie werk je niet alleen aan de ontwikkeling van afzonderlijke producten, maar bouw je mee aan een eigen technisch productportfolio. Je gebruikt feedback uit productie en van klanten om een volgende generatie producten beter te maken. Je blijft betrokken bij producten die je eerder hebt ontworpen: je ontwerpbeslissingen werken daardoor door in de verdere ontwikkeling. Die betrokkenheid loopt van de eerste engineering tot de daadwerkelijke toepassing bij een klant. Tegelijkertijd werk je binnen JPE, waardoor je kunt terugvallen op collega's met veel ervaring op het gebied van precision engineering, mechatronica, analyse en systeemontwikkeling. Zo combineer je de verantwoordelijkheid en korte lijnen van een klein productteam met de technische kennis en disciplines binnen de bredere JPE-organisatie. Wat bieden wij? Een brede engineeringfunctie met veel technische verantwoordelijkheid Werken aan hightech producten voor internationale klanten en onderzoeksinstellingen Directe betrokkenheid bij de volledige product lifecycle Veel vrijheid om producten én werkwijzen verder te verbeteren Een klein team met korte lijnen en ruimte voor eigen initiatief Samenwerking met ervaren engineers binnen JPE Mogelijkheden om je verder te ontwikkelen in precision engineering, cryogene techniek en productontwikkeling Marktconforme arbeidsvoorwaarden Wil jij niet alleen ontwerpen, maar jouw ontwerp ook zien uitgroeien tot een product? Een product dat wereldwijd wordt toegepast in geavanceerde systemen en grensverleggende toepassingen? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Stuur je CV, motivatie en contactgegevens naar Maurice Teuwen via maurice.teuwen@jpe.nl. Directe sollicitaties van kandidaten hebben de voorkeur. Voor deze vacature werken wij niet samen met werving-, selectie- of detacheringsbureaus.

title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer - HVAC
description: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer – HVAC / Data Centre Cooling Location: Dublin 12 Working Arrangement: Fully on-site The Opportunity We are seeking an experienced Senior Mechanical Design Engineer to join a growing engineering team specialising in the design and development of advanced HVAC and data centre cooling solutions. This is a senior technical leadership position, offering the opportunity to take ownership of complex mechanical design projects across Air Handling Units (AHUs), Computer Room Air Handling (CRAH) systems, Fan Wall units and Cooling Distribution Units (CDUs). Working closely with customers and multidisciplinary engineering teams, you will translate complex technical requirements into practical, innovative and manufacturable solutions. You will lead projects from initial concept and detailed design through prototype development, validation and final production release. This role would suit an experienced HVAC mechanical design engineer who combines strong technical expertise with customer-facing experience and the ability to mentor and guide other engineers. Key Responsibilities Lead the mechanical design and development of bespoke HVAC and data centre cooling equipment, including AHUs, CRAHs, Fan Walls and CDUs. Act as the primary technical interface between customers and internal engineering teams. Lead customer meetings and technical discussions to understand, challenge and define project requirements. Translate customer specifications into practical and manufacturable engineering solutions. Drive projects from concept development through detailed design, prototype testing, validation and production release. Conduct technical feasibility assessments, design reviews and engineering risk evaluations. Perform coil, fan and pump selections using relevant engineering methodologies and selection software. Review and approve engineering designs, technical submittals and customer-facing documentation. Support prototype testing, performance verification and resolution of technical issues. Work closely with manufacturing, quality, sourcing, controls and project management teams. Provide technical leadership, guidance and mentorship to mechanical engineers. Ensure designs comply with relevant industry standards, project specifications and internal engineering practices. Support customer presentations, technical proposals and bid reviews. What We Are Looking For Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline. Minimum 10 years' experience in HVAC mechanical design engineering. Extensive knowledge of Air Handling Unit (AHU) design and HVAC equipment. Experience leading complex, customer-driven engineering and product development projects. Strong understanding of mechanical design principles, manufacturing considerations and product development lifecycles. Experience taking engineering projects from initial concept through prototype validation and production handover. Practical experience with coil selection, fan selection and pump selection. Previous experience engaging directly with customers in a technical or engineering capacity. Demonstrated ability to review, approve and technically sign off engineering designs. Strong communication, problem-solving and technical leadership capabilities. Desirable Experience Experience designing or developing data centre cooling equipment, including CRAH, CRAC, Fan Wall or CDU systems. Knowledge of chilled water and refrigerant pipework design. Familiarity with relevant HVAC industry standards, codes and regulatory requirements. Experience with prototype development, performance testing and product validation. The Package Competitive salary, dependent on experience. Opportunity to take on a senior technical leadership position within a specialist engineering environment. Involvement in complex, technically challenging HVAC and data centre cooling projects. Opportunity to influence product development and engineering standards. Apply If you are an experienced HVAC Mechanical Design Engineer looking to take on a senior technical leadership role within a specialist engineering environment, we would be interested in hearing from you. Apply today or contact our engineering recruitment team for a confidential discussion.

title: Process and Technical Solutions Engineer
description: Om stillingen/rollen Som Proces & Technical Solutions Engineer får du en central rolle mellem salg, projektafdelingen og R&D. Du er med til at sikre, at kundernes behov bliver omsat til teknisk korrekte, konkurrencedygtige og gennemførlige løsninger. I tilbudsfasen fungerer du som teknisk sparringspartner for salgsorganisationen. Du analyserer kundekrav, udfører procesberegninger og bidrager til dimensionering og specifikation af procesudstyr og komponenter. Når et projekt går fra tilbud til ordre, følger din tekniske viden med videre. Her understøtter du projektafdelingen, så projektet får et solidt teknisk grundlag fra start. Dine Primære Arbejdsområder Bliver Teknisk sparring med salgs- og, projektafdelingen og nye- og eksisterende kunder i forbindelse med tilbud og kundedialog Analyse af kundekrav og omsætning af disse til konkrete tekniske løsninger Masse- og energiberegninger samt øvrige procesberegninger Dimensionering og specifikation af procesudstyr og komponenter Udarbejdelse af teknisk dokumentation og beregningsgrundlag til tilbud Samarbejde med R&D om videreudvikling af eksisterende produkter og nye løsninger Hvad forventer vi af dig? Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant teknisk uddannelse, eksempelvis som procesingeniør, energiingeniør eller tilsvarende. Du har en god teknisk forståelse og kan både gå i dybden med beregninger og bevare overblikket over den samlede løsning. Samtidig trives du i en rolle, hvor teknik ikke står alene, men skal fungere i praksis og give mening både for kunden og for det projekt, der efterfølgende skal gennemføres. Du kommunikerer sikkert på dansk og engelsk, både mundtligt og skriftligt. Vi Forventer, At Du Har Specifik Erfaring Med Procesanlæg og tekniske løsninger Dimensionering og specifikation af teknisk udstyr og komponenter Det er en fordel, hvis du også har erfaring med: Tilbudsarbejde og teknisk support til en salgsorganisation Masse- og energiberegninger samt andre relevante procesberegninger Teknisk projektarbejde og samarbejde med projektledere Samarbejde med leverandører om tekniske løsninger og komponenter Produktudvikling eller samarbejde med R&D Relevante regulativer og standarder inden for procesanlæg og teknisk udstyr Personlige egenskaber Rollen indebærer mange forskellige kontaktflader, så det er vigtigt, at du kan bevare overblikket og følge dine opgaver til dørs. Samtidig kommunikerer du tydeligt og konstruktivt med både kunder, leverandører og kolleger. Du er udadvendt, opsøgende og relationsskabende. Du tager naturligt initiativ til dialog med både kunder og kolleger og er komfortabel med at kommunikere på tværs af fagligheder og organisatoriske niveauer. Du trives med samarbejde på tværs af fagområder og bidrager til at skabe sammenhæng mellem salg, projektering og den tekniske løsning. Hvad kan du forvente af os? Vi tilbyder en spændende stilling i en international virksomhed med gode udviklings- og karrieremuligheder. Vores organisationsstruktur muliggør hurtige beslutninger, og vi værdsætter iværksætterånden og entreprenørskabet. SANOVO TECHNOLOGY PROCESS er en del af SANOVO TECHNOLOGY GROUP, og er specialiseret i spraytørringssystemer og avanceret varmebehandlingsudstyr til forskellige applikationer. Vi beskæftiger i øjeblikket 30 medarbejdere. Fundamentet for vores arbejde er rettet mod en bæredygtig fremtid, hvor vores udstyr optimerer (rest)produkters anvendelse og øger fødevareproduktionen til både mennesker og dyr. Lønpakken indeholder bl.a. en firmapensionsordning, virksomhedsbetalt sundhedsforsikring, god kantineløsning samt adgang til en lang række personalegoder. Vi prioriterer fællesskabet højt, og vi har sociale arrangementer flere gange årligt. SANOVO TECHNOLOGY GROUP (STG) beskæftiger ca. 850 medarbejdere, heraf ca. 220 i Danmark, og servicerer kunder over hele verden. Virksomheden er kendt for sin høje kvalitet og sikre levering af unikt udstyr inden for produktionslinjer til bearbejdning af æg og æggeprodukter. Hovedkontoret er i Danmark/Odense med salgs- og servicekontorer på seks kontinenter og produktion af udstyr i Danmark, Holland, Italien, Kina, USA og Slovakiet. SANOVO TECHNOLOGY GROUP er en del af THORNICO A/S, der er ejet af Christian Stadil. title: Project Engineer, Marine & Offshore - Vexve

Join Vexve and take the lead on inspections, commissioning and optimization of Frese FUELSAVE® systems at shipyards and onboard vessels worldwide. title: Application Engineer
description: The Impact You'll Make As our new Application Engineer, you will help customers turn technical requirements into practical solutions using frequency converters, drives and power conversion technologies. You will combine technical expertise with commercial understanding, supporting customers from the first technical discussion and pre-sales phase through solution design, quotation, project execution, testing and commissioning. An important part of your role will be to support marine and electrification applications, including battery energy storage systems, helping customers select, size and successfully implement the right solutions. Based in Silkeborg, you will join a small, experienced application team where everyone manages their own customers and projects while sharing knowledge and supporting each other. What You’ll Be Doing Partner with our sales team and customers to understand technical requirements and design and size frequency converters, drives and power conversion solutions for customer applications. Act as trusted technical point of contact for key customers throughout the customer journey. This includes participating in customer meetings, project scoping and technical clarifications, and translating requirements into solutions and quotations. Manage the technical side of projects from pre-sales through implementation, verification testing and commissioning. Perform technical analyses such as harmonic distortion simulations, verification tests and evaluations against customer specifications, helping resolve technical challenges throughout the project. Share your expertise through technical presentations, product and software-tool training, and collaboration with sales colleagues, service partners and internal technical teams. The role involves regular customer interaction and travel, primarily within Denmark and potentially Norway and Sweden. You can expect up to approximately 50 travel days per year. What We're Looking For We are open to different levels of experience. You may already have relevant industry experience, or you may be a recent graduate ready to build your career in a customer-facing technical role. Furthermore, you have: A relevant technical background e.g. in Marine Engineering, Electrical or Mechatronics engineering, or a technical trade or service background with extensive electrical understanding. A solid interest in motor control, frequency converters, drives and power conversion, with the technical curiosity to develop your understanding of products, systems and customer applications. Confidence working directly with customers and different stakeholders, combined with a proactive and structured approach to managing projects and priorities. Fluency in Danish and English, as you will work directly with Danish customers as well as colleagues and stakeholders across borders. Willingness to travel and work directly with customers and partners on-site when needed. Je doet onderzoek naar nieuwe structurele ontwerpen via analyses en optimalisaties van metaal (3D-geprint), composiet en hybride constructies. Hierbij maak je gebruik van bestaande CAD en FEM software. Je ontwikkelt ontwerpmethodologieën of geavanceerde rekenmodellen voor duurzame lichtgewicht én economisch haalbare concepten voor toepassing in de lucht- en ruimtevaart. Dit kan gaan om detail berekeningen voor componenten tot globale structurele modellen van vliegtuigen. Verder werk je mee aan de ontwikkeling van nieuwe proces simulaties van nieuwe innovatieve fabricage concepten en ondersteun je experimentele testen met simulaties. Dit doe je binnen projecten die we uitvoeren voor klanten in Nederland en het buitenland. Daarvoor werk je nauw samen met je collega’s en onze fabricage- en testafdelingen. Je werkt in teamverband aan projecten en het werk biedt volop mogelijkheden voor je verdere inhoudelijke en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wat breng je mee? Academische opleiding afgerond op Master niveau in de Lucht- en Ruimtevaart of Werktuigbouwkunde met specialisatie Computational Mechanics; Ervaring met Finite Element Modelling en CAD software; Oog voor nieuwe ontwikkelingen binnen het vakgebied én daarbuiten; Teamgeest, resultaatgerichtheid, initiatief en zelfstandigheid; Een deskundige en open houding richting klanten en collega’s; Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels. Wat bieden wij jou? Werken bij NLR, betekent werken in een nationale en internationale hightech omgeving. Samenwerken en betrokkenheid staan bij ons hoog in vaandel. Door jou vrijheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid te geven, ben jij het best in staat om tot baanbrekende innovaties te komen. Wil jij jezelf vakinhoudelijk én op persoonlijk vlak ontwikkelen? Ook dat kan bij NLR als lerende organisatie, met daarnaast een opleidingsbudget, een mentor, interne coaches en goede contacten met mbo’s, hbo’s en universiteiten. Naast Dit Alles Bieden Wij Jou De kans om bij te dragen aan complexe en maatschappelijk relevante vraagstukken; Voldoende vakantie- en ATV-dagen (in totaal 45 bij fulltime dienstverband) voor een goede werk-privébalans; Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8%; Een tegemoetkoming in jouw zorgkosten; Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof; De mogelijkheid om jezelf te ontwikkelen met opleidingen en cursussen die passen bij jouw ambities. Vanuit die drijfveer maken wij de wereld van lucht- en ruimtevaart veiliger, duurzamer, efficiënter en effectiever en staan wij voor baanbrekende innovaties.
