title: Materials & Integrity Engineer
description: EPZ zoekt voor de afdeling Engineering een Materials & Integrity Engineer met focus op verouderingsbeheersing, materiaalkunde en de technische integriteit van de veiligheidsrelevante systemen, structuren en componenten van Kerncentrale Borssele. Dit is een inhoudelijk sterke engineeringfunctie binnen een uniek werkveld. Je werkt aan vraagstukken rond materiaaldegradatie, inspecties, levensduur, normering en technische onderbouwingen voor veilige en betrouwbare bedrijfsvoering. Bij deze rol hoort, na inwerktraject en formele aanwijzing binnen EPZ, de bevoegdheid om technische onderbouwingen te accepteren, voorwaardelijk te accepteren, op te schorten of te weigeren wanneer integriteit of vergunningsconformiteit onvoldoende onderbouwd is. Daarmee draag je direct bij aan de technische basis voor de bedrijfsduurverlenging. Wij zoeken een ervaren engineer die inhoudelijke diepgang combineert met eigenaarschap. Iemand die technische conclusies zorgvuldig onderbouwt, standhoudt onder druk en helder communiceert met collega’s, leveranciers en externe stakeholders. Help jij ons in ons streven naar technische excellentie? Jouw functie Je draagt vanuit jouw materiaalkundige en integriteitstechnische expertise bij aan het beheer, de ontwikkeling en de beoordeling van verouderingsbeheersing binnen de kerncentrale, met focus op de primaire systemen, het reactorvat, de stoomgeneratoren en secundaire systemen. Je houdt je bezig met degradatiemechanismen, inspectieresultaten, technische normering en de beoordeling van de restlevensduur van componenten. Je rapporteert aan de Chef Engineering. Concreet Betekent Dit Dat Je Verouderingsmechanismen identificeert, beoordeelt en vertaalt naar passende beheersmaatregelen; Ageing Management Reviews en verouderingsbeheersingsplannen opstelt, beoordeelt en actueel houdt, conform IAEA SSG-48 en de IGALL-systematiek; Inspectie-, test- en monitoringprogramma’s ontwikkelt en de resultaten daarvan technisch beoordeelt — onder meer voor In-Service Inspection (volgens ASME XI), PRD-bevindingen, reactorvat-surveillance en embrittlement-monitoring (conform KTA en ASME XI); Trends, afwijkingen en degradatiebeelden analyseert en vertaalt naar onderbouwde adviezen voor inspectie, herstel, vervanging of voortgezet bedrijf; Interne en internationale operationele ervaring, gewijzigde regelgeving (IAEA SSR-2/1, IAEA SSG-48, Nederlandse nucleaire wet- en regelgeving) en externe ontwikkelingen beoordeelt en vertaalt naar verbeteringen in programma’s en werkwijzen; Technische onderbouwingen, vendor-documenten en externe rapportages (van bijvoorbeeld Framatome, TÜV SÜD, NRG) beoordeelt vanuit de rol van deskundige opdrachtgever; Bijdraagt aan risicoanalyses, fit-for-purpose beoordelingen, Item Equivalency Evaluations bij obsolescence en technische onderbouwingen voor voortgezet bedrijf ( Justification for Continued Operation ); Samenwerkt met collega’s op het gebied van inspectie, vermoeiing, equipment qualification, ontwerp, onderhoud, operations en reliability; Projectplannen opstelt, planning en budget bewaakt en zorgt voor duidelijke voortgangs- en eindrapportages, inclusief de jaarrapportages binnen je domein; Jouw kennis actief deelt binnen EPZ en in internationale vakgroepen (FROG, IGALL, PWROG, ASME-codecommissies). Binnen deze functie werk je in een omgeving waarin technische oordeelsvorming belangrijk is. Niet iedere vraag heeft direct een eenvoudig antwoord. Juist daarom zoeken we iemand die zorgvuldig kan omgaan met onzekerheden in data, modellen en inspectieresultaten, en die helder kan aangeven wat technisch wel en niet verantwoord is. Jouw profiel Eisen Een afgeronde technische academische opleiding, bij voorkeur in materiaalkunde, werktuigbouwkunde of een vergelijkbare richting; Ruime relevante ervaring (typisch 5 jaar of meer) in een nucleaire of vergelijkbaar streng gereguleerde (proces)industrie, met aantoonbare praktijk in degradatie-analyse, integriteitsbeoordeling of inspectie-evaluatie; Kennis van materiaaldegradatie, sterkteleer, breukmechanica en inspectie- en lastechnieken; Kennis van en werken met de relevante internationale normen, zoals bijvoorbeeld: ASME XI, KTA, IAEA SSG-48, ENIQ; Kennis van risico- en veiligheidsanalyse, inclusief het werken met probabilistische modellen, empirische data en deterministische compliance — het komen tot een verantwoord oordeel onder onzekerheid is voor deze rol een kerncompetentie; Vlot lezen van Engels (IAEA, ASME, ENIQ), en helder schrijven in Nederlands en Engels.Specifieke plantkennis (Konvoi-veiligheidsconcept, ontwerp en vergunningskader van de Borssele-kerncentrale) bouw je bij EPZ verder op via opleiding, begeleiding en praktijkervaring. Pré Vlot lezen van Duits voor KTA- en Konvoi-documentatie, of de bereidheid om dit op werkniveau te ontwikkelen na indiensttreding; Aanvullende opleiding of certificering op inspectietechnieken, lastechniek of fitness-for-service-analyse (API 579 / ASME); Ervaring met gangbare integriteits-, monitoring- en transient-tracking-systemen (zoals FAMOS, COMSY of vergelijkbaar); Eerdere deelname aan internationale vakgroepen of IAEA-missies (Pre-SALTO, SALTO, OSART). Wat we naast vakkennis belangrijk vinden Voor deze functie zoeken we niet alleen een technisch sterke engineer. We zoeken iemand die ook past bij de rol die de afdeling Engineering binnen EPZ heeft. Dat Betekent Dat Je Nieuwsgierig blijft en technische conclusies niet zomaar overneemt zonder eigen oordeel; Verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor je adviezen en conclusies; Zorgvuldig werkt en keuzes goed vastlegt; Constructief samenwerkt met andere disciplines, ook wanneer belangen of prioriteiten verschillen; Rustig en duidelijk communiceert, ook wanneer de boodschap technisch of organisatorisch lastig is; EPZ professioneel vertegenwoordigt richting interne en externe stakeholders. Ons aanbod Een bruto salaris conform de cao PLb en cao EPZ van minimaal €5.535 en maximaal €7.472 bij een fulltime dienstverband, afhankelijk van ervaring

title: Marine Engineer - Global Engineering
description: Working at Boskalis is about creating new horizons and sustainable solutions. In a world where population growth, an increase of global trade, demand for (new) energy and climate change are driving forces, we challenge you to make your mark in finding innovative and relevant solutions for complex infrastructural and marine projects. In your job you will work for the offshore energy division. Boskalis has one of the largest global fleets of specialized offshore vessels, allowing us to carry out a broad range of offshore activities. We provide innovative and sustainable all-round solutions to tackle major worldwide maritime challenges. Our Offshore Energy division supports sustainable energy solutions such as wind energy as well as traditional fossil facilities. We’re involved in the entire journey from developing and transporting to maintaining and decommissioning these facilities. Vacatureomschrijving Make your mark as a Marine Engineer at the Global Engineering department of Boskalis Offshore Energy. As a Marine Engineer, you assist multidisciplinary project engineering teams, which are responsible for the complete engineering of complex projects - from the concept design all the way to the supervision and assistance of the actual execution phase. Your knowledge of ocean environments, behavior of floating structures, machinery and (lifting) equipment is of vital importance for the understanding of offshore operations. Therefore, your expertise could be of great importance for the success of a project. Your Responsibilities. You commence project specific Vessel Motion Analysis, Station Keeping Analysis (Anchor Moorings and/or DP), Cable/Pipeline installation Analyses, Offshore Lifting Analyses, Sea fastening calculations, Stability calculations and many more. In addition to actual calculation assignments, you will be assisting in engineering various maritime and offshore related procedures as Towing manuals, Lifting procedures and Installation TaskPlans. Besides project specific engineering, you’ll also be involved in assisting the tender department with technical queries on future projects. Your Qualities And Experience You can move ahead as a Marine Engineer if you have: A bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanical engineering, Civil engineering, Marine engineering, Offshore Engineering or Naval Architecture. Knowledge and experience with programming language (Python, Matlab) is required. Knowledge and experience with Hydrodynamic software packages such as Orcaflex are highly appreciated. Willingness to stay on board during start-up & execution of offshore projects (approx. 4 to 6 weeks each year). Functie-eisen What You Can Expect A dynamic environment: A job that allows you to collaborate with a talented team of experts from different backgrounds and contribute to making a significant impact. Rewarding conditions: A competitive salary and much more, including holiday allowance, holiday entitlement (based on a full-time contract), a non-contributory pension scheme, collective schemes such as company health insurance, travel allowance, and much more. Career development: We offer you plenty of opportunities to bring out the best in yourself, for example, through (online) courses at our Boskalis academy. The Boskalis Campus: Experience the unique Boskalis vibe at our Papendrecht site, complete with restaurants, a sports field, and a wharf where our vessels dock. We offer a state-of-the-art auditorium, brainstorming rooms, an experience center for client meetings, and a barista corner where you can connect with colleagues. Young Boskalis: Are you under 36? Come and join Young Boskalis! Have fun and join in social and sports activities ranging from pub quizzes to yoga, bootcamps, and an annual sailing boat race. Networking and knowledge sharing are a vital part of Young Boskalis as well. Extra information Your team: You will be part of the Boskalis Global Engineering team in Boskalis Offshore Energy, based in Papendrecht. The 15 persons international team is characterized by their informal yet professional way of working together, flexibility, adaptability, and work hard play hard mentality. Full/part-time job: The position can be full-time or part-time (24 to 40 hours per week). Working location: The role is Papendrecht office based. Next steps: Apply easily by completing the online application form. Interviews are held online or in the office. Once it’s clear we’re a good match, we’ll make you an offer – and look forward to welcoming you to the company. Aanvullende informatie We are more than happy to answer your questions about the position of Marine Engineer. Please contact Thijs Wanders, Corporate Recruiter, via thijs.wanders@boskalis.com Please note: Boskalis never requests a financial contribution to arrange visas or other documents related to a job vacancy. Be wary of individuals who pretend to be our recruiters and do ask for such contributions. Disclaimer for Recruiters and Recruitment Agencies We appreciate your interest in our vacancies and understand that your candidate might be enthusiastic about this exciting opportunity. However, our recruitment process is not structured this way, at Boskalis we handle recruitment ourselves. Therefore, we do not accept unsolicited applications or CVs from recruitment agencies. Any submission will be treated as a direct application.

title: Senior Staff R&D Mechanical Engineer
description: About SAVA All the health information we need is within us. Just below the skin. SAVA is redefining the way people interact with their health by developing the most advanced biosensing technology science has to offer, capable of accessing bodily information in a painless, real-time and affordable way. The Role We are hiring a senior R&D Mechanical Engineer to own and lead experimental and analytical work to support the development of our wearable sensor. You will set experimental strategy, own the selection and sourcing of test equipment, and turn complex data into clear engineering decisions that shape the product. More generally, you will also support R&D efforts through research, analysis, modeling and simulation, as required to support engineering development. The technical challenges for this role are far-reaching and diverse. Some examples include understanding adhesive interfaces with the skin, modelling how the body interacts with our sensors, mechanically simulating our product under stress conditions, and carrying out root cause analyses of some of our most elusive technical challenges. You will be a technical authority in the team, mentoring others and setting an example for how we carry out R&D with creativity and rigour. You will be expected to be comfortable with desk-based analysis, lab-based experiments, technical planning, reporting of technical results, and leading others in their work. Suitable candidates may be considered for a Team Lead role. What You'll Do Own major workstreams that feed directly into product development, such as functional testing of materials, modelling of device subsystems, and simulation of component interactions. Lead root cause analyses to fully understand failure modes, and subsequently implement engineering solutions. Champion best-practices and define SOPs for experimental methods, statistical analyses and modeling approaches. Where necessary, lead the selection, evaluation and qualification of new test equipment, and author the methods and SOPs behind it. Work with the Product Engineering Team on investigative and verification testing. Collaborate with other teams across the business (e.g. Biomaterials, Data Science, Clinical etc.) to drive technical progress, whether this be in the form of bench testing, theoretical analysis or internal clinical trials focusing on real-world device performance. Effectively communicate results and recommendations to the leadership team. Mentor, lead and train junior engineers on experimental design, statistical analysis and good lab / workshop practices. What You'll Bring A Masters or PhD in mechanical engineering or a closely related field. 6+ years of hands-on experimental R&D, including time in a relevant industry. A track record of leading technical workstreams from open questions to clear outcomes. Deep expertise in experimental design and a good understanding of statistical approaches. Strong understanding of engineering fundamentals. Experience with mechanical and materials testing. Confidence in designing test fixtures and prototypes (CAD, 3D printing, machining). Fluent data analysis in Python, MATLAB, Minitab, JMP or similar. Sound engineering judgement: be able to make good calls even with incomplete data and defend your rationale. A mature approach to engineering risk: be able to thoroughly analyse risks as relevant to different development stages, and drive progress with appropriate mitigations. A practical approach to fast-paced engineering development: balance quick, informative experiments and intuitive engineering judgement with rigorous testing and documented engineering development. A thirst for knowledge: Gaps in experience should be filled through research, continuous learning, and active exposure to new areas of engineering. Bonus Points Exposure to medical device development (ISO 13485, design controls, verification testing). Experience with simulation software (FEA, CFD), such as ANSYS, COMSOL, Abaqus or similar. Experience in tolerance analysis. Previous work in a fast-paced and agile workplace, such as another engineering startup. Expertise in a specialist engineering field, such as polymer science, soft materials simulation or microfabrication techniques. Experience leading engineering teams and/or projects. Experience setting up a lab or specifying capital equipment.

title: Structural Analysis Engineer
description: Job Description At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us. BGS Commercial Modifications Engineering Europe are looking for an experienced Mechanical Engineer to join our team to support the certification of large aircraft modifications to demonstrate compliance with relevant regulatory and customer requirements and procedures defined in the company’s Design Organization Handbook (DOH). Role Responsibilities: Reporting to the Structures Engineering Manager and working with the global engineering team, across multiple time-zones, in order to identify requirements and their associated solutions for active and upcoming projects Capable of leading certification activities to ensure compliance with design requirements, and be a technical focal for certification and stress issues relating to large aircraft modification programmes. Compile and critically review structural substantiation documents related to: Product certification and integration to the aircraft of: New seating installations and new monument and furniture Installations such as Galleys, Lavatories, class dividers, first class suites and VVIP furnishing, Cabin interior changes including LOPAs, Passenger Service Unit layouts and LRU installations, etc. Primary structure changes including Antenna Installations and Fuselage Modifications. You will act as a Boeing representative during customer meetings such as ITCM, PDR, CDR and FAI in support of active and up-coming projects. Provide additional on-site support to assist the customers’ during the embodiment phase of the project. Promote a culture of innovation, safety, and quality throughout the engineering organization. Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience): Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering (with a focus on Mechanical, Civil, Aerospace Aeronautical or Material Sciences). Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience): Equivalent of a minimum of five (5) years relevant experience is desirable. Your role will be to prepare blast engineering analysis and design of structural and façade systems, working in collaboration with multi-disciplinary design teams formed of architects, engineers, cost consultants and project managers to integrate our design solutions into the built environment. title: Structural Simulation Engineer
description: Responsibilities The Structural Simulation Engineer will support the structural design and development of Liebherr container cranes through Finite Element Analysis (FEA) and simulation activities. The primary focus of the role will be the assessment and optimisation of crane components and structures using Ansys, including both static and transient/dynamic simulations. The successful candidate will also have the opportunity to develop skills in multi-body dynamics modelling and control system simulation using MATLAB/Simulink and Simscape Multibody, working closely with structural, automation and control engineering teams. Key Elements of the Role: Responsibilities shall include, but are not limited to the following: Perform structural analysis of crane components and assemblies using the Ansys suite of software. Conduct static, nonlinear and transient dynamic simulations to support product development and verifi-cation activities. Evaluate structural strength, stiffness, fatigue performance and dynamic behaviour of crane structures and mechanical systems. Prepare, review and interpret finite element models, simulation results and technical reports. Support the development and validation of simulation methodologies and best practices within the de-partment. Collaborate with design engineers to improve component and system performance through simulation-led design. Develop and maintain simplified and detailed simulation models for complex mechanical systems. Support the modelling of crane mechanisms using MATLAB/Simulink and Simscape Multibody. Collaborate with automation and control engineers to understand the interaction between mechanical systems and control algorithms. Contribute to the development of simulation tools, automation workflows and engineering processes us-ing Python, Ansys APDL and VBA. Work with CAD models generated in PTC Creo and prepare geometry for simulation activities. Constructively collaborate with the simulation engineering community within MCC and the broader Liebherr Group. Qualifications, Requirements & Experience The successful candidate will hold a third-level qualification in an engineering discipline – preferably L9 or L10. A strong interest in engineering simulation, numerical methods and analytical problem solving. Knowledge of Finite Element Analysis principles is essential. Experience with Ansys Mechanical or similar FEA software is desirable. Knowledge of structural mechanics, strength of materials and dynamics. Exposure to transient or dynamic analysis methods would be advantageous. Experience with MATLAB/Simulink, Simscape Multibody or similar modelling environments would be advantageous. Experience with CAD software, particularly PTC Creo, would be beneficial. Basic programming skills are desirable, with Python considered a significant advantage. Demonstrated aptitude for learning new software tools, simulation techniques and engineering methodologies. We do not require the assistance of recruitment agencies for this role. #LCC Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Jennifer Connolly. One Passion. Many Opportunities. The Company Liebherr Container Cranes Ltd. is one of the world's leading manufacturers of ship to shore cranes, rail mounted gantry cranes and rubber tyre gantry cranes. From its base in Killarney, Ireland, the company designs, builds and exports container cranes worldwide. Founded in 1958 as the first Liebherr factory outside of Germany, today, container cranes manufactured by Liebherr in Ireland are renowned for their quality, longevity and productivity. title: Shell Graduate Program Netherlands - Mechanical Engineer

This role offers the opportunity to combine engineering knowledge with practical field experience. Rather than being purely desk-based, you will spend significant time working alongside operational teams, troubleshooting equipment issues, monitoring performance, and supporting machinery reliability improvements. You will gain hands-on exposure to a wide range of mechanical systems, including compressors, pumps, turbines, and other critical equipment. We are looking for individuals who enjoy solving real-world engineering challenges, are eager to learn, and have a genuine passion for machinery and industrial operations. As part of Shell's graduate programme, you will have opportunities to develop your technical and professional capabilities while contributing to the energy systems of today and tomorrow. Investigate equipment performance concerns, including vibration issues, reliability challenges, and mechanical failures. Assist in troubleshooting rotating and static equipment to identify root causes and recommend practical solutions. Monitor equipment performance and reliability indicators to ensure machinery operates safely and efficiently. Support the installation, commissioning, and optimization of mechanical equipment and systems. Work closely with maintenance, operations, and engineering teams to improve equipment performance and operational reliability. Participate in field inspections, equipment assessments, and technical reviews. Contribute to reliability improvement initiatives by analyzing equipment trends and recommending corrective actions. Develop practical engineering solutions that balance technical requirements, operational needs, and business objectives. Build technical knowledge of compressors, pumps, turbines, pressure systems, and other critical mechanical equipment. Collaborate with stakeholders across different functions while maintaining strong safety and operational standards. Continuously develop engineering expertise through on-the-job learning, coaching, and structured development opportunities. What you bring A Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline. Strong interest in rotating equipment, machinery, mechanical systems, and industrial operations. Demonstrated practical engineering mindset with a willingness to apply technical knowledge in real-world environments. Interest in troubleshooting, problem-solving, and improving equipment reliability and performance. Ability to balance technical understanding with awareness of operational and business priorities. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. A proactive attitude and willingness to learn from experienced engineers and operations professionals. Good communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams. Comfort working both in office environments and on-site operational locations. Curiosity, resilience, and a hands-on approach to engineering challenges. Interest in developing expertise in compressors, pumps, turbines, vibration analysis, and other mechanical systems. A strong commitment to safety, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. What we offer You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself. Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together. Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead. Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices. Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise. Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself. Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working. Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world. title: Ingénieur R&D Conception Mécanique (H/F)
description: À propos de nous Shape & Share Sustainable Links LISI est un groupe industriel mondial, spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions d’assemblage et de composants à forte valeur ajoutée pour les secteurs de l’aéronautique et de l’automobile. LISI AEROSPACE, filiale du groupe LISI produit des fixations et de structure/moteurs pour les plus grands acteurs mondiaux du secteur aéronautique avec un chiffres d’affaires de 1 milliard d’€ en 2024, 6279 collaborateurs répartis sur 19 sites dans 8 pays. Portée par son sens de l’innovation et de l’excellence opérationnelle, LISI AEROSPACE est en recherche de futurs talents afin d’accompagner sa croissance et atteindre ses objectifs ambitieux. Mission CDI – Saint-Ouen-l’Aumône (95) Rejoignez LISI AEROSPACE et participez au développement de solutions mécaniques innovantes pour l'aéronautique ! Vous êtes passionné(e) par la conception mécanique et aimez voir vos idées se concrétiser en solutions techniques ? Vous souhaitez intervenir sur des projets de développement, de la définition du besoin jusqu'à la validation des produits, tout en évoluant au sein d'une équipe d'experts ? Rejoignez notre Centre d'Études R&D de Saint-Ouen-l'Aumône ! Votre environnement LISI AEROSPACE est un acteur international de référence dans la conception et la fabrication de solutions d'assemblage et de composants de structure pour l'industrie aéronautique. Au sein de notre Centre d'Études, vous rejoignez une équipe à taille humaine composée de collaborateurs permanents et de partenaires techniques, où l'expertise, la collaboration et l'innovation occupent une place centrale. Rattaché(e) au Responsable Conception, vous prenez en charge le développement de sous-ensembles mécaniques, notamment des outillages destinés à l'installation de fixations aéronautiques . Véritable acteur du développement de nos solutions techniques, vous intervenez sur l'ensemble du cycle de conception. À ce titre, vous serez amené(e) à : Concevoir et développer des sous-ensembles mécaniques et des outillages de pose de fixations aéronautiques, depuis l'analyse du cahier des charges jusqu'à la validation technique. Réaliser les études et dimensionnements mécaniques, en vous appuyant sur les outils de CAO, de gestion des données techniques (PLM) et de simulation numérique. Piloter les développements techniques, en assurant le suivi des différentes étapes, le respect des exigences et la coordination des intervenants. Construire les plans de validation, suivre les essais et rédiger les dossiers de justification technique. Coordonner fonctionnellement les ingénieurs et techniciens mobilisés sur vos projets, ainsi que les prestataires externes. Contribuer à l'amélioration continue de nos produits, de nos méthodes de conception et de nos processus de développement. Participer aux échanges techniques et au partage d'expertise au sein de notre communauté Conception Mécanique. Vous interviendrez notamment sur des projets de développement d'outillages de pose, au cœur des enjeux de performance et de fiabilité de nos solutions d'assemblage. Profil Issu(e) d'une formation supérieure en mécanique ou conception mécanique, idéalement de niveau Bac+5, vous justifiez d'une expérience confirmée de 5 à 10 ans en conception et développement de sous-ensembles mécaniques . Vous disposez : D'une solide maîtrise de la conception mécanique et des outils de CAO. De connaissances en dimensionnement mécanique et simulation numérique. D'une expérience dans le développement de produits ou d'outillages mécaniques. D'une capacité à piloter des études techniques et à coordonner différents interlocuteurs. De connaissances en méthodologie de développement et de gestion de projets, de type APQP ou équivalent. La connaissance de CATIA ainsi que des compétences en programmation Python constitueront des atouts supplémentaires. Au-delà de votre expertise technique, nous recherchons avant tout une personnalité autonome, proactive et collaborative . Vous aimez travailler en équipe, partager vos connaissances, proposer des solutions et contribuer activement à l'amélioration des pratiques. Votre curiosité technique, votre esprit d'initiative et votre capacité à fédérer différents interlocuteurs seront essentiels pour réussir dans cette fonction. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Des projets techniques concrets et stimulants, au service de l'industrie aéronautique. Une réelle autonomie dans la conduite de vos développements. Un environnement collaboratif, au contact d'ingénieurs, de techniciens et d'experts métiers. La possibilité de proposer et de concrétiser vos idées, en contribuant directement à l'amélioration de nos solutions. L'opportunité de développer votre expertise au sein d'un groupe industriel international reconnu pour son savoir-faire. un salaire fixe avec un variable de 10% Envie de concevoir les solutions d'assemblage aéronautiques de demain ? Rejoignez LISI AEROSPACE et mettez votre expertise au service de projets où la technique, l'innovation et le collectif font la différence.

title: Ar-ge Mekanik Mühendisi
description: Biz kimiz? Temelleri 1994 yılında atılan TEKSAN, serüvenini dünya çapında global bir marka olma yolunda sürdürüyor. Kalite ve inovasyonda öncü bir mühendislik şirketi olarak güvenilir güç mottosu ile çıktığımız bu yolculuğumuzda sürdürülebilir bir yaşam için güvenilir ve yenilikçi ürünler geliştirerek bugün, 2 Fabrika ve 750 kişiyi aşkın çalışan ile 6 kıtada 140’tan fazla ülkede hizmet veriyoruz. Dünya çapındaki onlarca bayimizin yanı sıra İngiltere ve ABD ofislerimiz ile sürdürülebilir yaşam, enerji ve jeneratör denince akla gelen ilk marka olma kararlılığı ile büyüyoruz. Neden biz? Çeyrek asrı aşkın tecrübemiz ile kurulduğumuz günden beri, hep en yeni ve en iyiyi yapmayı hedefliyoruz. Çalışma ortamımızda birbirimize destek oluyor, ortak aklın ve takım çalışmasının gücüne inanıyoruz. Ar-Ge merkezimizde yeni şeyler öğrenme ve gelişim için fırsatları yakalayabileceğin, yurt dışı ile bağlantılı çalışma fırsatı yakalayacağın ve büyük başarıların parçası olmayı deneyimleyebileceğin bir kariyer yolculuğu Teksan’da seni bekliyor. Her geçen gün büyüyen şirketimize yaratıcı, yenilikçi, heyecanı yüksek, takım çalışmasını seven arkadaşlar katmak istiyoruz. Eşsiz tecrübemiz ve birikimimiz ile misyonumuzu benimseyen, vizyonumuzu paylaşan, değerlerimizi kendi değerleri ile örtüştüren geleceğin Teksanlıları ile tanışma heyecanı içindeyiz. Seni neler bekliyor? Teksan Akademi ile eğitim gelişim fırsatları İlham veren liderlik Farklı lokasyon ve iş kolları arasında geçiş Sosyal Destek Ödemeleri Sağlık Sigortası Burs İmkanları Genel Nitelikler Üniversitelerin ilgili bölümlerinden mezun, (Makine Mühendisliği) İlgili mühendislik departmanlarında minimum 5 yıl deneyimli, Yapısal analiz, ısı transferi ve akışkanlar mekaniği konularında en az orta seviyede teorik bilgiye ve uygulama deneyimine sahip, Ansys (Mechanical/Workbench) programını aktif olarak kullanabilen, İyi derecede İngilizce dil bilgisine sahip, Tercihen Proje Yönetim Metodolojisi Bilgisine hâkim, Ekip çalışmasına yatkın, yönetim ve raporlama becerisi gelişmiş, Erkek adaylar için askerlik hizmetini tamamlamış, Yurtiçi/Yurtdışı seyahat engeli olmayan, İstanbul Anadolu yakasında ikamet eden, “Ar-Ge Mühendisi ” ekip arkadaşı arıyoruz. İş Tanımı Ar-Ge faaliyetleri ile yenilik tanımı kapsamındaki projelerde, yeni bilgi, ürün, süreç, yöntem ve sistemlerin oluşturulmasında görev almak, Görevlendirildiği projelerle ilgili teknik fizibilite hazırlamak, iş paketleri ve proje takvimi oluşturmak ve dokümante etmek/ edilmesini sağlamak, Projelerle ilgili gerekli test ve ölçümleri yapmak/yaptırmak/uygunluğunu denetlemek, Uzmanlık alanının gerektirdiği mühendislik hesap ve analizlerini yapmak, yapılan analizleri kontrol etmek, Devlet destekli projelerde proje yürütücüsü veya proje mühendisi olarak çalışmayı gerçekleştirmek, teknik raporları hazırlamak veya usul yönünden kontrol etmek, Yeni ürün ve teknoloji araştırmaları yapmak, Gerektiğinde numune ürün tedariğini sağlamak, uygunluğunu test ederek raporlamak, Yenilikler ve gelişmeleri takip etmek için fuar, eğitim, seminer, tanıtımlara katılmak. Bu ekibin bir parçası olmak istersen, başvurunu bekliyoruz!

title: Production and Process Engineer
description: Mubea is a globally recognized, family-owned engineering and manufacturing group serving both the automotive and aviation industries through innovative lightweight solutions and advanced production technologies. With manufacturing, engineering, and sales locations worldwide, Mubea partners with many of the world's leading vehicle and aircraft manufacturers. In Türkiye, Mubea operates automotive manufacturing facilities in Manisa and Çerkezköy , supplying high-quality components to the automotive industry. In addition, through Mubea Aviation, the Group continues to expand its presence in the aviation sector with advanced manufacturing investments in Ergene, Tekirdağ , producing high-precision metal and composite components for leading international aviation programs. This diversified industrial footprint reflects Mubea's commitment to innovation, engineering excellence, and sustainable growth across multiple industries. At our Manisa plant , we are currently seeking a motivated and hands-on Production and Process Engineer to join our team. Key Responsibilities: Ensure production is carried out in line with the production plan, customer requirements, and targets for quality, cost, delivery, productivity, and workplace safety. Monitor daily production performance, analyze deviations, and take action. Ensure lasting solutions to non-conformities through root cause analysis and corrective and preventive actions (CAPA); drive continuous improvement through Kaizen, Lean, SMED, 5S, and error-proofing activities. Lead and support sample, prototype, commissioning, and series-production launch of new products, processes, machines, tooling, and molds within APQP/PPAP. Keep process documentation and production records up to date, and ensure accurate data entry in the ERP system. Manage shift plans and workforce allocation; monitor the team’s compliance with instructions and identify training needs. Work closely with other departments, and suppliers; ensure autonomous and periodic maintenance, equipment condition, and the planning and stock control of tooling, fixtures, and consumables. Ensure health and safety, environmental, and legal requirements are met in the production area, take part in the Occupational Health and Safety Committee and the Environmental Management Team. Core Competencies: Degree in Mechanical, Mechatronics, or Industrial Engineering. Proficiency in ERP systems, quality management systems, lean manufacturing methods, and blue-collar team management. Experience in metal processing and forming. CNC experience. Serial production experience. Experience in digital data processing, and in developing and managing reporting. Fluency in English. Strong analytical thinking, planning, and interpretation skills. Ability to identify risks and opportunities, follow up on actions, and contribute to business excellence and self-assessment activities. Compliance with rules protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of company information assets, and reporting of information security incidents. Experience in the automotive industry. Why Mubea? Be part of a global, family-owned engineering company with a people-focused culture, operating across both the automotive and aviation industries. Opportunities to contribute to production and process projects and to develop technical skills within Mubea’s global network. Continuous learning and development opportunities. Opportunities for professional growth in a scaling organization.

title: Maintenance Engineer
description: At ARaymond, we create cutting-edge fastening and assembly systems for the machines and products that keep the world moving. Founded in Grenoble in 1865, and still headquartered in the city to this day, we’re a family-run business with a proud history of innovation – including the invention of the press stud. Human values have driven our success for over 160 years, embodied by our servant-leadership model of management that empowers employees and puts their wellbeing first. Today we employ more than 8,500 people in 25 countries worldwide. And we’re committed to leading in sustainability for the global fastening and assembly market. Connect with ideas that solve big challenges Join our global engineering team to develop ideas and products that shape a better future. Feel inspired in our culture of innovation and creativity, which generates over 1,000 new fastening solutions every year. Since beginning its journey in Türkiye in 2005, ARaymond Türkiye has been operating in Gebze, Kocaeli, serving as an important solution partner for OEM and Tier suppliers in the automotive industry. We are looking for a Maintenance Engineer to join our dynamic team. Role And Responsibilities Follow up on corrective, planned, predictive, and preventive maintenance activities for production machines and equipment in our automotive manufacturing facility. Ensure the continuous, safe, and efficient operation of production machines and respond promptly to breakdowns. Diagnose failures in electrical, electronic, mechanical, pneumatic, and hydraulic systems and implement permanent solutions. Perform fault analysis on PLC and automation systems and carry out the necessary adjustments and interventions; have knowledge of 3-axis and 5-axis robot programming. Plan maintenance activities for building equipment, machinery, assembly machines, fixtures, and other equipment in accordance with supplier instructions and maintain up-to-date records. Plan the commissioning processes of injection molding machines, assembly machines, and utility systems, while working in coordination with relevant teams. Maintain accurate and up-to-date maintenance records and reports, monitor machine downtime and maintenance KPIs (MTTR, MTBF), and prepare reports. Collaborate with Production, Quality, and other relevant departments to participate in continuous improvement activities aimed at increasing machine efficiency. Identify and analyze critical spare part requirements, conduct risk assessments, and support inventory tracking activities. Collect technical procurement quotations related to maintenance activities, prepare the necessary documentation, follow up on processes, and provide recommendations. Identify areas for improvement within maintenance processes, inform the Maintenance Manager, and provide improvement recommendations. Plan and follow up on activities performed by external suppliers. Carry out maintenance activities in compliance with Occupational Health and Safety regulations. Education And Experience Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Proficient in MS Office applications. Basic knowledge of AutoCAD. Knowledge of SAP PM. Knowledge and experience in TPM and 5S applications. Experience in industrial maintenance processes and knowledge of PLC systems. Experience in ensuring the continuous and efficient operation of production machinery. Minimum 3 years of experience in the manufacturing industry; experience in plastic injection molding is considered an asset. Good command of English. Native Turkish proficiency and a valid work permit for Turkey are required. No travel restrictions. Residing in or able to relocate to the Gebze, Kocaeli region.

Through partnerships with leading international technology and engineering companies, we select, supply and commission equipment for comminution, beneficiation, dewatering, tailings management, metal recovery and lime calcination. The Role We are looking for a Field Application Engineer with strong mineral processing knowledge and field experience to act as a technical interface between YSK Group®, our clients and international technology partners, from the initial customer visit through after-sales follow-up. What you will do Conduct regular visits to client plants and offices, and maintain close, ongoing communication with client representatives and partners to understand their needs and expectations. Observe on-site operations, assess client challenges, and identify opportunities where our equipment, spare parts or services, and those of the companies we represent, can add value. Communicate field observations, new project opportunities and client requirements to the sales and engineering teams. Deliver technical presentations to clients when required. Join the sales team’s client visits and meetings to provide technical support. Monitor after-sales activities, including spare parts supply, service requests, performance issues and client feedback, and follow each matter through to resolution. Participate in on-site installation, commissioning and performance testing in coordination with the engineering team and partners. Provide data-driven technical input from the field to support the development of commercial quotations and proposals. Represent YSK Group® at client sites, partner facilities and industry events. What you bring Turkish citizenship BSc/MSc in Mining Engineering or Mineral Processing Engineering 3–5 years of experience in a processing plant, field service or technical sales role in the mining sector Practical familiarity with mineral processing operations A proactive, client-oriented attitude and interest in the commercial side of the business Good written and spoken English Good communication skills and a reliable approach to follow-up Willingness to travel frequently, both in Türkiye and abroad Driving licence (B class) Preferred Commissioning, FAT or site acceptance experience Exposure to plant projects, such as schedule follow-up and site coordination Ability to read P&IDs, flowsheets, layouts and equipment datasheets Basic understanding of mass balance and equipment sizing, and experience collecting site data for technical evaluation Why join us Work on mining and mineral processing projects across Türkiye and regional markets, in direct collaboration with international technology partners and clients, and take real technical responsibility from project development through commissioning and after-sales support.

Raflarımız ödül ve başarılarla dolu… 20 yıldır “Türkiye’nin En Beğenilen Perakende Şirketi” seçilmek, Türkiye’nin ilk sadakat programını yaratmak, Türk perakende müşterisini kasiyersiz kasa ile tanıştırmak, Perakende sektöründe ilk AR-GE merkezini kurmak başarılarımızdan sadece birkaç tanesidir. Migroslular olarak biz, Perakendenin geçmişine ve geleceğine çok meraklıyız! Türkiye’de modern perakende sektörünün öncüsü olarak, 1954’ten bu yana bizim işimiz, iyi geleceği tasarlamaktır! Her Migroslu’nun kendi kariyer hikayesini yaratmasına fırsat sağladığımız “İyi Gelecek Yolculuğumuzun” bir parçası olmak isterseniz, başvurunuzu bekliyoruz! Migros’ta Bizler; 😊 Yaptığımız her işte mutluluk yaratırız. 🤝 Kendimize güvenir, karşımızdakine güven verir ve güven duyarız. 🌿👫 Hassas noktamız doğa ve insandır. 🌟 İyi geleceğe öncülük ederiz. 🏆 Potansiyeli aşarız büyük başarılar yaşarız. 🚀 İyi fikirler geliştirir "yok artık" denilen fikirlere "var artık" deriz. Sizde aradığımız özellikler neler? Üniversitelerinin Makine Mühendisliği, Elektrik ve Elektronik Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezun, İlgili alanda en az 5-6 yıl deneyimli, Saha koordinasyonu ve operasyon yönetimi konusunda deneyimli, Elektrik, mekanik ve teknik altyapı sistemleri konusunda bilgi sahibi, Arıza tespiti, bakım ve teknik problem çözme süreçlerinde aktif rol alabilen, Planlı bakım, ekipman kontrolü ve saha operasyonlarını yönetebilen, Teknik raporlama, ekip takibi ve operasyon süreçlerini disiplinli şekilde yürütebilen, İş sağlığı ve güvenliği kurallarına hakim, Seyahat engeli olmayan ve aktif araç kullanabilen, MS Office ve AutoCAD programlarına hakim, Analitik ve inovatif düşünce yapısına sahip, iletişimi kuvvetli, Problem çözme becerisine ve sonuç odaklı çalışma anlayışına sahip. Aramıza katıldığınızda neler yapacaksınız? Üretim tesisindeki mekanik, elektrik ve yardımcı işletme sistemlerinin günlük operasyon süreçlerini yürütmek, Arıza, bakım ve teknik müdahale süreçlerini takip etmek ve gerekli aksiyonları almak, Planlı bakım faaliyetlerini prosedürlere uygun şekilde gerçekleştirmek, Üretim sürekliliğini etkileyebilecek teknik riskleri önceden tespit etmek, Soğutma sistemleri, HVAC, kompresör, pompa, konveyör, pano ve benzeri ekipmanların kontrolünü sağlamak, Teknik ekipmanların periyodik kontrollerini yapmak ve kayıt altına almak, Taşeron ve servis ekiplerinin saha çalışmalarını takip etmek, Enerji tüketimleri ve ekipman performanslarını izlemek, İş güvenliği kurallarına uygun şekilde saha operasyonlarını yürütmek, Acil durum, arıza ve kritik teknik olaylarda hızlı müdahale sağlamak, Teknik raporlama ve günlük saha formlarını düzenli olarak doldurmak. Yetenek Kazanımı Sürecimiz Nasıl İlerleyecek? Özgeçmiş Ön Değerlendirme Süreci İnsan Kaynakları Görüşmesi Değerlendirme Testleri Birim Görüşmesi Referans Araştırması Teklif Süreci 🤞🏻 *Görüşülen pozisyonun niteliğine göre süreç adımlarında değişiklik gerçekleşebilir. 📲Sosyal Medya kanallarında iş fırsatlarımızı takip etmeye devam edebilirsiniz. #Migros #İyiİşİyiGelecek *Sürdürülebilir büyüme, eşit imkanlar ve farklı bakış açılarıyla mümkündür. Lead Network Europe (NPO)’nun Gold Partneri olarak; İnsan Hakları ve Fırsat Eşitliği politikamız doğrultusunda, Migros’ta herkesin şeffaf, adil ve eşit haklara sahip olması gerektiğine inanıyor ve çalışıyoruz.

title: MRI Field Engineer
description: Company Description Medical Imaging Academy (MIA) is a global multi-modality service provider specializing in the full lifecycle of medical imaging equipment, including installation, de-installation, transportation, packing, storage, repair, calibration, and turnkey radiology solutions. The organization supplies spare parts, complete used systems, and offers professional support to hospitals, universities, and research clinics across Europe, the Middle East, Asia, and Africa. MIA’s highly qualified and experienced team delivers onsite clinical applications training, helping partners maximize the performance and safety of their imaging systems. With over 20 years of field experience and consistently positive feedback from clients in multiple countries, MIA has built a strong reputation as a reliable radiology partner. The company is committed to pushing boundaries in every project and maintaining long-term, trust-based relationships with its customers. Role Description The MRI Field Engineer role at MIA │ Medical Imaging Academy is a full-time, on-site position based in Istanbul. The MRI Field Engineer will perform installation, maintenance, calibration, and repair of MRI systems, ensuring optimal performance, safety, and regulatory compliance. Daily responsibilities include conducting diagnostic tests, troubleshooting hardware and software issues, performing preventive maintenance, and documenting all service activities clearly and accurately. The role involves visiting customer sites, providing technical support and guidance to clinical and technical staff, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure timely resolution of service requests. The MRI Field Engineer will also support project execution for equipment upgrades and turnkey solutions, contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, and uphold MIA’s quality and customer service standards. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong troubleshooting and technical support skills for MRI and related medical imaging systems. Candidates should possess field service experience, including on-site installation, maintenance, and repair of complex equipment. Candidates should possess effective communication skills to interact with clients, clinical staff, and internal teams in a clear and professional manner. Candidates should possess project management abilities to plan, coordinate, and complete equipment deployments and service projects on schedule. Relevant technical education (e.g., degree or diploma in Biomedical Engineering, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, or a related field) and prior experience with MRI or other medical imaging modalities are highly beneficial. Ability to read and interpret technical documentation, follow safety protocols, and work independently in the field is essential. Willingness to travel within the region as needed, and proficiency in English and local languages, is an advantage.

title: Automation Engineer
description: At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. This position reports to: Service Manager - Southern __ More About Us - B&R Industrial Automation The pursuit of Perfection in Automation has inspired and guided B&R for over 40 years. To us, perfection means more than developing the best solutions in industrial automation, it also means developing the best relationships, with our customers and partners as well as our employees and suppliers. Keen foresight and entrepreneurial courage helped us rise quickly into the ranks of top global players in industrial automation. An intuitive sense of market dynamics and emerging trends has established us as a pioneer, leading the way with the most innovative technology on the market. Our role as the ABB Group's global center for machine and factory automation strengthens our position of leadership and adds new momentum to our impressive record of sustained growth. Your Role And Responsibilities In this role, you will have the opportunity to act as a design authority for an engineering discipline with low to medium complexity. Each day, you will complete assignments on small projects or portions of larger projects in a cost-effective manner. You will also showcase your expertise by applying basic design thinking/design for excellence concepts in projects. The work model for the role is: {hybrid} This role is contributing to the Machine Automation Division (B&R), Service organization in Türkiye. You will be mainly accountable for: Evaluating, selecting, and applying standard techniques and procedures to perform engineering assignments. Providing technical support for testing, installation, and commissioning activities. Assisting in preparing proposal/presentation of engineering projects. Reports any integrity, compliance, safety, cybersecurity, quality, contract, program, and cost issues to the management and/or project manager(s) for resolution. Ensures that engineering activities and deliverables comply with safety and cybersecurity regulations and standards and contractual requirements. Ensures the project meets the technical requirements of the contract and is technically completed as part of contract closure activities. Collaborates with the supply chain function and the project manager(s) to meet the contractual obligations. Coordinates with commissioning / service functions to ensure the designs are appropriately installed and commissioned (if applicable as part of the contract) Assists in preparing proposal / presentation of engineering projects / programs (provision of bills of materials, estimated engineering hours, etc.). Qualifications For The Role Degree in Automation Engineering or Mechatronics Engineering, At least 2 years of experience in the industry. Possess an enhanced interest in automation, programming, digitalization, AI and innovation. You are passionate about structured programming, with basic knowledge of IEC 61131 languages or C. You are familiar with industrial automation products, such as PLCs, motion control systems, and SCADA. You possess basic knowledge of electronics, mechanics, mathematics, control theory and AI infrastructures. Knowledge of object-oriented programming is also appreciated. Knowledge of major simulation and modeling tools (Matlab Simulink, MapleSim) and familiarity with theoretical and practical concepts of artificial vision are also appreciated. You are at ease communicating English, both written and spoken and fluent in Turkish. You have willingness to work in a team and have a strong inclination for continuous training and improvement You are available to travel within the assigned area, as well as occasionally throughout Türkiye and abroad for short trips. Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Technical Inspection Manager, Mechanic
description: Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding engages in various sectors, primarily energy, shipbuilding, finance, and real estate industries. The Group is the only owner, operator and builder of the first Powership™ (floating power plant) fleet in the world and plays an active role in medium to long-term investments with more than 2.500 employees around the world in different 19 countries in Europe, Africa, Latam and Asia. About Karpowership Karpowership, part of the Karadeniz Holding, is the owner, operator and builder of the only Powership™ (floating power plant) fleet in the world and plays an active role in medium to long-term investments; providing access to fast-track, affordable and reliable electricity. Powerships have a range of 30 MW to 470 MW and are delivered ready to operate in less than 60 days. Currently, Karpowership owns and operates over than 30 Powerships with an installed capacity exceeding 3,500 MW and another 5,000 MW are under construction or in the pipeline. In addition to a Powership fleet, Karpowership owns and operates its own LNG fleet. With expertise and experience in the field, Karpowership serves as a one-stop-shop for LNG to Power solutions, as a single provider delivering all parts of the value chain; including but not limited to LNG sourcing, transport, delivery, regasification, and electricity production; with the mission of powering life wherever needed. With more than 2,000 employees globally; Karpowership is operational in Mozambique, Ghana, Sierra Leone, Guinea Bissau, Gambia, Senegal, Sudan, Ivory Coast, New Caledonia, Brazil, Dominican Republic and Cuba. We are looking fo r a Technical Inspection Manager to join our Operational Excellence at our Head Office located in Kağıthane, Istanbul. WHAT DO WE EXPECT? Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering, or Naval Architecture Engineering Minimum 10 years of experience in the maritime, power generation, shipbuilding, or industrial sectors. Strong technical expertise in diesel engines (HFO/LNG), gas turbines, and auxiliary mechanical systems. In-depth knowledge of equipment reliability, automation systems, and protection systems. Proven experience in Root Cause Analysis (RCA), risk assessment, and reliability engineering methodologies. Solid understanding of preventive, predictive, and condition-based maintenance practices. Ability to interpret technical drawings, P&IDs, and maintenance documentation. Experience with ERP/CMMS platforms, preferably SAP. English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above. Availability for both domestic and international travel. WHAT AWAITS YOU? Ensure that technical inspection and operations within power generation plants are conducted in full compliance with corporate management systems, international regulations, and industry standards, while maintaining the highest levels of safety, reliability, and operational excellence. Plan, coordinate, and execute technical audits and inspections across power generation facilities and mechanical systems, ensuring effective closure of audit findings through structured follow-up processes. Evaluate and report on equipment condition, maintenance effectiveness, and the implementation of preventive and predictive maintenance programs. Lead the preparation of technical incident and failure investigation reports. Assess technical operational processes, identify corrective actions, and document observations, findings, and improvement opportunities. Monitor equipment performance trends and evaluate oil analysis reports, vibration measurements, and condition monitoring data. Participate in root cause investigations and failure analyses, contributing to the development of preventive measures and best practices. Identify reliability risks, recurring failures, and maintenance deficiencies, and develop recommendations for technical improvements. Lead root cause analysis activities for critical equipment failures. Drive initiatives aimed at enhancing equipment reliability, asset performance, and operational efficiency. Prepare comprehensive technical inspection reports and present findings to senior management. Coordinate effectively with plant teams, OEMs, and third-party technical specialists. Support the development of technical teams and contribute to technical training and capability-building initiatives. WHAT DO WE OFFER? Opportunity to work on large-scale international energy projects. Exposure to diverse operational environments across multiple countries. Collaboration with industry-leading experts and access to mentoring opportunities. A dynamic and growth-oriented environment that supports career advancement. Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package. Hybrid working opportunity, One day off on your birthday, Comprehensive Private Health Insurance, Professional and personal training & development opportunities, Exclusive discounts and campaigns for employees. In line with our "One World" philosophy, we are adding success to our achievements with our colleagues, candidates, and all stakeholders. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, religion, language or gender and we crown our success with our diversity. In accordance with the Law No. 6698 on the Protection of Personal Data, please review the Personal Data Protection Notice for detailed information regarding the processing of your personal data.

title: SCADA & Project Engineer
description: We are the catalyst for the industrial world’s digital transformation. For more than 35 years, ground breaking technologies and business models engineered and developed by Siemens Turkey R&D department contributes to the global success of Siemens Our R&D activities focused on the fields of electrification, automation and digitalization, provides end-to-end support to our global customers on their unique digital transformation journey. We aim to increase our strength on solution and product development with world class SW development experts, with the vision to be the digitalization partner for our global customers. We need game changers like you, to bring the next level of smart manufacturing and infrastructure from mere concept to reality, develop tomorrow’s smart cities, and address the most critical digitalization challenges across a comprehensive range of industries. What part will you play? Develop, maintain, and enhance SCADA applications and industrial software components, with a strong focus on reliability, performance, and maintainability. Plan, track, and manage project progress, tasks, and milestones to ensure on-time delivery while coordinating support activities and handling customer inquiries. Perform rigorous testing of crane products, applications, and SCADA solutions, with a strong emphasis on user interface (UI) and user experience (UX) quality, operator ergonomics, and intuitive visualization. Contribute across the project and product lifecycle, translating requirements into delivery-ready solutions and using customer feedback and field experience to improve quality. Work with customers and solution partners to clarify requirements and deliver industrial automation projects, from system design to commissioning and handover. Plan and implement upgrades and migrations for existing systems, ensuring compatibility and minimizing operational disruption. Integrate SCADA solutions with in-house and 3rd-party automation systems and higher-level applications using industrial communication protocols. Address IT/OT integration and cybersecurity requirements within automation projects to ensure solutions fit the customer's operational environment. Provide hotline, remote, and on-site technical support to customers worldwide for product-related issues. Deliver technical training and workshops for customers, solution partners, and internal teams. Support pre-sales activities through feasibility assessments, technical scope definition, system configurations, bills of materials, product demonstrations, and technical presentations. Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including user manuals, configuration guides, and troubleshooting resources. What You Need To Make Real What Matters. A bachelor's degree in Control and Automation Engineering, Electrical or Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. A very good command of written and spoken English for seamless collaboration with international customers, partners, and cross-functional teams. At least 5 years of relevant experience in industrial automation and SCADA engineering, including hands-on customer project involvement. Strong hands-on expertise in SIMATIC WinCC and its ecosystem, including SCADA development, associated options, tools, and integration capabilities. Strong organizational skills with hands-on experience in project tracking, task management, and coordinating multi-tiered support activities. İnsansız hava araçları, modern çatışmaların maliyet dengesini ve harekât temposunu değiştiriyor. TMT, bu değişen harekât ortamı için otonom savunma sistemleri geliştiriyor. Mekanizma ve mekanik tasarım çalışmalarımızı yürütmek üzere Kıbrıs ofisimizde görev alacak bir Mekanik Tasarım Mühendisi arıyoruz. Bu pozisyondaki mühendis, hava aracı mekanizmalarından yapısal parçalara, test düzeneklerinden yer ekipmanlarına kadar farklı bileşenlerin tasarımı ve imalata hazırlanmasında görev alacaktır. Mekanizmanın hangi işlevi yerine getireceği mühendislik ekibi tarafından tanımlanır. Çözümün kurgulanması, tasarlanması, üç boyutlu modellerin ve imalat resimlerinin hazırlanması bu pozisyonun sorumluluğundadır. Tasarımların mukavemet, ağırlık, üretilebilirlik ve montaj gereksinimleri birlikte değerlendirilerek geliştirilmesi beklenmektedir. ARANAN NİTELİKLER Makine, Mekatronik veya ilgili mühendislik bölümlerinden mezun olmak. SolidWorks ile katı modelleme ve montaj tasarımı konusunda yetkin olmak. Mekanizma ve kinematik tasarım konusunda deneyim sahibi olmak. Teknik resim, toleranslandırma ve geometrik ölçülendirme bilgisine sahip olmak. İmalat yöntemlerine hâkim olmak; 3B baskı, CNC işleme, sac, talaşlı imalat ve plastik enjeksiyon kısıtlarını gözeterek tasarım yapabilmek. Mukavemet hesapları ve sonlu elemanlar analizi ile parça boyutlandırması yapabilmek. Standart mekanik bileşen seçimi yapabilmek. Ağırlık, dayanım ve üretilebilirlik arasında denge kurabilmek. Montaj sürecini izleyerek tasarımını revize edebilmek. İngilizce teknik kaynakları okuyup anlayabilmek. Yapay zekâ destekli çalışma araçlarını iş akışına entegre edebilmek. Yoğun çalışma temposuna ve esnek çalışma saatlerine uyum sağlayabilmek. Takım çalışmasına yatkın, disiplinler arası çalışmaya açık ve öğrenmeye istekli olmak. Seyahat engeli bulunmamak. Katlanma, kilitleme ve benzeri mekanizmaların tasarımını yapmak. Üç boyutlu katı modelleme ve montaj tasarımı yapmak; hareket analizleriyle çalışma zarfını ve girişimleri doğrulamak. İmalat resimlerini hazırlamak; toleranslandırma ve geometrik ölçülendirme çalışmalarını yürütmek. Tasarımı imalat yöntemine göre uyarlamak; 3B baskı, CNC işleme, sac, plastik enjeksiyon ve hazır bileşen kullanımına uygun hale getirmek. Tasarlanan parça ve mekanizmaların mukavemet analizlerini yapmak; yük senaryolarını tanımlayıp gerilme, deformasyon ve emniyet katsayısı sonuçlarına göre tasarımı boyutlandırmak. Hava aracı gövde ve yapısal parça çizimlerine destek vermek. Test standı, montaj aparatı ve yer ekipmanı tasarımlarını yapmak. Bağlantı elemanı, rulman, yay, lineer eleman ve benzeri standart mekanik bileşenlerin seçimini yapmak. Üretilen parçaların montaj sürecini takip etmek; tespit edilen uyumsuzlukları tasarıma yansıtmak. Parça numaralandırma, revizyon takibi ve malzeme listesi (BOM) yönetimini yürütmek. EK NİTELİKLER Yorulma, titreşim veya darbe analizi gibi ileri seviye yapısal analiz deneyimi Hareket ve kinematik simülasyonu deneyimi Plastik enjeksiyona uygun parça tasarımı deneyimi; et kalınlığı, çekme payı, ayırma yüzeyi ve kalıptan çıkma açısı konularında bilgi Kompozit ve hafif yapı tasarımı deneyimi İnsansız hava aracı veya havacılık alanında yapısal tasarım deneyimi PDM / PLM sistemleriyle çalışma deneyimi Fusion 360, CATIA, NX veya benzeri diğer CAD araçlarına aşinalık CAM yazılımı ve CNC iş hazırlama bilgisi Servo, solenoid veya lineer eyleyici içeren aktüatörlü mekanizma tasarımı deneyimi Kişisel projeler, yarışma takımı çalışmaları (TEKNOFEST, Formula Student vb.) veya açık kaynak katkılarından oluşan teknik portföy Savunma sanayii, havacılık veya insansız sistemler alanında deneyim DİĞER KOŞULLAR T.C. veya K.K.T.C. vatandaşı olmak SAĞLANAN DESTEKLER Relokasyon desteği Şirket tarafından sağlanan konaklama Ulaşım desteği Özel sağlık sigortası Mesleki gelişim ve eğitim desteği

title: PhD scholarship in Experimental Clearance Flow Research - DTU Construct

description: Job Description The PhD candidate will, as part of a collaboration project between a private enterprise and DTU Construct, carry out experimental clearance flow research with ammonia and other sustainable marine fuels. Pressure and temperature conditions, resembling those in a marine engine booster pump, are created in an in-house designed clearance flow test rig. Measured clearance flow data will be used to develop and validate accurate flow models. The test rig will be further modified to enable testing and evaluation of different sealing solutions. Responsibilities And Qualifications The PhD candidate will be responsible for continuing our development of a high-pressure ammonia flow rig, conduct test campaigns with different ammonia pump components and develop both theoretical and experimental foundation for developing ammonia compatible sealing techniques. The candidate should have significant experience with: Safe handling of ammonia and other liquified gases in test setups. Design and wiring electronic data acquisition and control systems using PC Schematics. LabView programming. Mechanical design and FEM analysis using Solid Works. Data processing of large experimental sets of dynamic flow and pressure data using statistical methods in Matlab. CMM (Coordinate Measurement Machine) measurement and preferably have experience with Calypso Software. Data processing large complex geometric data sets from CMM measurements for 3-dimensional analysis of tested pump components. You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree. Approval and Enrolment The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. Application procedure Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 19 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time) . DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

title: Design for Value & Cost Engineer – from concept to competitive edge, GN Hearing, Ballerup
description: Are you ready to apply your engineering, project leadership and sourcing expertise to the world of product development and manufacturing? Join us as Senior Project Manager in Design for Value (DfV) and impact the way we design, develop, and manufacture products at GN Hearing in Ballerup. The Team You Will Be Part Of Based at our global HQ, located in Ballerup, Denmark, you will join the Design for Value team in Global Manufacturing & Operations, reporting directly to Director René Bergqvist. In this role, you will collaborate with internal and external stakeholders worldwide, ensuring value and cost are managed effectively and optimized in our products from the early concept phase through to mass production. Your Contribution Is Appreciated And You Will Optimize products by supporting the organization with cost / value analysis in our products, modules, platforms and architecture Investigate and motivate for cost-effective design and manufacturability, e.g. via mapping of value / cost opportunities related to roadmap, product, and design options Manage cost targets and running estimate for ramp up in development projects Facilitate and support project sourcing activities including availability reviews, supplier selection, RFQs, and negotiations Support building positive business cases together with R&D & Product Marketing Facilitate and conduct project reviews related to Design for Value, Cost and Manufacturing Follow up and guard the cost in product development by working with R&D on their suggested specification, manufacturing or material selection You will also work on introducing new technologies and innovations during product development and play a key role in approving targets and results before critical milestones are passed. You will also support key cross-functional projects that are part of strategic initiatives (“must-win battles”) with significant value or savings impact from an Operations and Sourcing perspective. Role To perform well in the role, we imagine that you - besides having a technical mindset and a good business understanding - have: A degree or similar within engineering, preferably within electronics Experience within platform and product development, supplier sourcing or cost/value optimization in a R&D environment are positive differentiators Good at solving both technical and commercial issues General understanding of manufacturing processes and industrialization Experience with LEAN, Design for Value/Cost, or supplier sourcing in Asia, are positive differentiators Presentation, negotiation, and communication skills in English, both written and spoken In addition, you have an engaging personality and possess facilitation skills, enabling you to build networks and engage stakeholders. You also possess solid analytical and problem-solving abilities, which you use to identify issues and propose effective solutions. You are, furthermore, steadfast and enjoy working in a multicultural, changing environment. You take initiative and, most importantly, follow through on the initiatives you start. We Offer A unique opportunity to grow and gain experience across both engineering and business A supportive and dynamic work environment where you can learn to navigate change with confidence Opportunities for professional and personal growth in a top-tier global high-tech company. The chance to contribute meaningfully to GN An international and collaborative workplace We encourage you to apply We highly value a mindset, motivation, and energy, that aligns with our core values, to not only ensure your growth, but for your team and the wider GN organization as well. We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process. Should you have any special requirements for the Interview please let the hiring manager know upon accepting invitation to interview. How to apply? Use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than 25 November 2026. Applications are assessed on a continuous basis, so don’t wait to send yours. On a time crunch? Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying – quick and easy. Join us in bringing people closer GN brings people closer through our leading intelligent hearing, inspired by people and driven by innovation, we deliver technology that enhances the senses of hearing and sight. We help people with hearing loss overcome real-life challenges, improve communication and collaboration for businesses and provide great experiences for audio and gaming enthusiasts. GN has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement here. We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description: We are looking for an experienced Mechanical Design Engineer to strengthen our engineering team and contribute to ongoing product development projects and continuous improvement activities. In this role, you will be responsible for understanding technical requirements, developing mechanical design concepts, and delivering high-quality engineering solutions in accordance with established processes, standards, and customer expectations. You will work across the complete mechanical design lifecycle, from concept development and realization to 3D CAD modelling, technical drawings, and product specifications. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of mechanical engineering principles, manufacturing processes, materials, and proven experience working with industrial product development. Key Responsibilities Develop and realize mechanical design concepts based on project requirements and technical specifications. Perform 3D CAD design, modelling, and product development using Creo. Create, modify, and maintain detailed engineering drawings and product specifications. Perform machine element dimensioning, including screw joints, bolted connections, and welded attachments. Apply knowledge of general machine design, weld technology, manufacturing methods, and material selection. Ensure designs meet functional, quality, reliability, manufacturing, and cost requirements. Work in accordance with established engineering processes, design standards, and ways of working. Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams and stakeholders to ensure successful project execution. Analyse technical challenges, identify potential solutions, and drive design improvements. Ensure timely delivery of engineering outputs while maintaining high-quality standards. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related technical field. Proven experience in mechanical design and product development. Strong knowledge of general machine design and mechanical engineering principles. Hands-on experience in 3D CAD design and modelling using Creo. Knowledge of machine element dimensioning, including screw joints, bolted connections, and weld attachments. Understanding of welding technology, manufacturing processes, and engineering materials. Experience in preparing engineering drawings and product specifications. Good understanding of mechanical design principles and industrial product development. Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal. Preferred Qualifications Experience working with Teamcenter PLM. Knowledge of Geometrical Product Specifications (GPS), particularly ISO 8015. Previous experience with the client's products, engineering systems, processes, and ways of working. Experience working in cross-functional product development environments. Knowledge of design for manufacturing and assembly (DFMA). Personal Attributes Self-driven and proactive, with the ability to take ownership of assigned tasks. Strong analytical and structured approach to problem-solving. Ability to independently handle complex engineering challenges and recognise when support is needed. Responsible, organised, and committed to delivering high-quality results. Strong teamwork and collaboration skills. Ability to balance functionality, quality, reliability, delivery timelines, and cost. Strong technical interest and willingness to learn new technologies and engineering methods.
