title: Mechanical Engineer
description: Job Description Tulip Tech designs and manufactures high-density lithium battery systems for drones and electric aircraft. Our silicon-anode technology extends flight times well beyond conventional packs. Every system is designed, built, tested, and assembled in-house in Den Bosch. Following a 2025 partnership with the Dutch Ministry of Defence, we are scaling from prototype development to volume production. The technology is proven. Our focus now is building it reliably, at scale, without losing the engineering quality that got us here. Designed, built, and proven in Europe. Why this role matters Our batteries fly. What keeps them in the air is a mechanical assembly that has to be light, strong, thermally sound, and manufacturable at volume. As our Mechanical Engineer, you own that chain end to end: from the first CAD model, through prototyping and validation, to production handover. There is no separate test team to hand off to and no decades of in-house mechanical standards to fall back on. You design it, build a prototype, and stress-test it until you know it survives heat, vibration, and assembly before it goes anywhere near an aircraft. As we industrialize, you also help define how mechanical design and validation work here. It is real ownership over a core part of the product. What You Will Achieve Battery enclosures and mechanical assemblies, designed in SolidWorks to be light, thermally efficient, and manufacturable at scale. Designs validated for structural integrity and environmental durability under real airborne conditions, using FEA and thermal analysis. Prototypes built and tested with CNC, 3D printing, and shop tools before anything moves to production. A measurable reduction in mechanical iteration time, through earlier prototyping and design-for-manufacture feedback to the engineering team. Repeatable mechanical design and validation practices the team can reuse as we scale from prototype to volume. Specifications, test results, and compliance documentation that hold up to certification review. Job Requirements Proven mechanical design experience in a real manufacturing or production environment, ideally around 2 - 7 years. Strong SolidWorks skills: assemblies, drawings, and BOM management. FEA and thermal analysis to validate designs under structural and thermal load. Working knowledge of manufacturing methods: CNC machining, injection molding, sheet metal, and extrusion. A hands-on mentality: you build and break things to prove they work, not just model them. The judgment to work from engineering knowledge and experience, not procedures alone, and to correct a design when it is wrong. Nice to have Thermofluid knowledge or experience with thermal management systems A background in battery, EV, drone, automotive, or aerospace hardware Experience taking a design from prototype through to volume production Why join A genuine core engineering challenge: you own the mechanical design of a product that flies, from CAD to production handover. Real ownership and influence over technical decisions in a flat, engineering-led organization. A clear mission: enabling electric flight and contributing to European defense capability. Salary between 3300,- and 5800,- 38 paid days off per year (25 vacation + 13 ADV via CAO Metaal & Techniek). 8% holiday allowance, travel reimbursement, pension via PMT, and daily lunch on-site. An international team of more than 10 nationalities, with regular team events.

To work with a vibrant, agile and multi-functional team in delivering projects on time, safely, to budget and to the required quality standards. To benefit from Kirby’s Career Development Programmes that will enhance your leadership capability. To work with the best. Excellent package on offer with room for negotiations About Kirby Group Engineering Kirby Group Engineering is an international multi-disciplinary engineering services contractor and leading provider of high-value engineering services to a number of ‘blue chip’ companies. Operating across Ireland, the UK, Europe and South Africa, Kirby has become the engineering service provider of choice in growth segments such as pharmaceuticals, data centres and power transmission and distribution. Our culture is innovative, collaborative and performance focused. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to grow and develop in a company committed to developing talent and rewarding performance. We are seeking an experienced and motivated HV Substation Protection & Control (P&C) Design Engineer to join our growing engineering team. This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in the design, development, and delivery of protection and control systems for high-voltage substations. Working on complex transmission and distribution projects, you will be responsible for developing innovative and reliable protection schemes, control system designs, substation automation solutions, and communication architectures that ensure the safe and efficient operation of electrical power networks. The successful candidate will work closely with multidisciplinary teams, clients, equipment vendors, and third-party design consultants to deliver industry-leading solutions that comply with national, international, and utility standards. Key Responsibilities Design HV substation protection and control systems for transformers, transmission lines, busbars, and switchgear. Develop protection philosophies, relay settings, control schematics, and interlocking schemes. Support SCADA integration, communication architectures, and IEC 61850-based solutions. Perform protection coordination, fault analysis, and system studies. Produce and review technical documentation, drawings, specifications, and reports. Support testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and system upgrades. Liaise with clients, contractors, consultants, and multidisciplinary project teams. Review third-party designs and ensure compliance with project and industry standards. Requirements Degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline. Experience in HV Substation Protection & Control design. Strong understanding of power system protection, control, and substation automation. Knowledge of IEC, IEEE, ANSI standards and IEC 61850 protocols. Experience with power system and design software such as ETAP, DIgSILENT, EPLAN, Helinks, or similar. Excellent technical, analytical, and communication skills. If you are passionate about power systems, protection engineering, and delivering critical infrastructure projects, we would love to hear from you. Apply today and help shape the future of the electrical grid. For more information on this role, or other Construction / Engineering opportunities across Ireland, the UK, Europe, or South Africa please review our careers page (Vacancies - Kirby Group Careers) or contact the Talent Acquisition Team at Kirby Group in confidence on +353 (0)1 454 0411. Kirby Group Engineering is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates, regardless of race, gender, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or age.

title: JUNIOR MECHANICAL ENGINEER
description: Azienda: ATM Gestiamo il trasporto pubblico locale di Milano e dell'area metropolitana: metropolitane, tram, autobus, filobus e funicolare. Nella Direzione Operations Esercizio Superficie, l'area Controllo Esercizio presidia la sicurezza e la regolarità del servizio di superficie e la messa in servizio di nuovi mezzi e infrastrutture. Il ruolo Lavorerai nel controllo dell'esercizio del trasporto pubblico di superficie di Milano (tram, autobus, filobus e funicolare). Ti occuperai di sicurezza normativa, messa in servizio di nuovi mezzi e analisi delle performance, per garantire un servizio sicuro e regolare. Cosa farai Redigerai procedure, regolamenti di esercizio e documentazione del Sistema di Gestione della Sicurezza per l'esercizio di superficie, analizzando i processi aziendali su rotabili e infrastrutture. Valuterai caratteristiche e impatti dei progetti di nuovi rotabili e infrastrutture e redigerai capitolati di gara e specifiche tecniche per le relative forniture. Seguirai l'avanzamento delle commesse e gli iter di messa in servizio di nuovi tram, autobus e filobus, interfacciandoti con ANSFISA, Ministero dei Trasporti, Regione Lombardia, Agenzia TPL e Comune di Milano. Analizzerai i dati di esercizio per misurare le performance del servizio e verificare il rispetto degli impegni del contratto di servizio. Definirai azioni di mitigazione per gli eventi critici in esercizio, coordinandoti con le Direzioni aziendali per ripristinare la regolarità del servizio. Contesto tecnico Sistema: rete TPL di superficie di Milano (tram, autobus, filobus e funicolare terrestre) con le relative infrastrutture. Quadro normativo: Sistema di Gestione della Sicurezza dell'esercizio e normativa nazionale sul TPL, sotto la supervisione di ANSFISA. Strumenti principali: pacchetto Office per la documentazione tecnica e l'analisi dei dati di esercizio. Ambiente operativo: ufficio tecnico dell'area Controllo Esercizio, con uscite in deposito e sulla linea. Vincoli distintivi: sicurezza dell'esercizio, continuità del servizio e conformità agli impegni con gli enti affidanti. Chi cerchiamo Requisiti essenziali Laurea Magistrale in Ingegneria Meccanica o in un altro indirizzo di ingegneria affine. Basi di meccanica applicata ai veicoli sufficienti a leggere e valutare specifiche tecniche di rotabili. Capacità di interpretare testi normativi e tradurli in procedure e documentazione tecnica strutturata. Uso avanzato di Excel per l'analisi dei dati e di Word per la redazione di documenti tecnici. Interesse concreto per il settore trasporti, dimostrato da tesi, tirocini o progetti accademici. Requisiti preferenziali Abilitazione all'esercizio della professione e iscrizione all'Ordine degli Ingegneri. Tesi, tirocinio o prima esperienza su rotabili, infrastrutture di trasporto o esercizio TPL. Familiarità con la normativa di sicurezza per il trasporto pubblico locale e con il ruolo di ANSFISA. Cosa offriamo Sede: Via Monte Rosa 89, Milano (M1 Lotto). Modalità di lavoro: full on site, con smart working disponibile in modo occasionale. Field work: uscite in deposito e sulla linea quando necessario; nessuna reperibilità richiesta. Contratto a tempo indeterminato, CCNL Autoferrotranvieri; selezione con colloquio su Teams e colloquio in presenza. Pacchetto retributivo: RAL 30–35k€ + premio di risultato convertibile in welfare + mensa aziendale + assistenza sanitaria integrativa Unisalute + viaggi gratuiti illimitati sulla rete ATM.

title: Systemingenjör inom mekanik på Landställ & Hydraul Gripen
description: Vill du vara med och utveckla landställ & hydraulsystem på Gripen? Vi tror att framsteg och möjligheter skapas bäst tillsammans i en stimulerande miljö. Välkommen till en arbetsplats med tekniken i fokus där du har möjlighet att göra skillnad. Din roll Vi söker nu två engagerade medarbetare till sektionen för Landställ & Hydraul. Som systemingenjör hos oss kommer du att arbeta med integration av våra avancerade system i flygplan. Du kommer främst att jobba med Gripen, men ev även med andra flygande farkoster. I vår moderna och innovativa utvecklingsmiljö är du en nyckelperson i systemutvecklingen, från kravanalys via systemdesign och verifiering ända fram till driftsättning hos kund. Driftuppföljning, förbättringar och produktstöd av system hos kund är ett annat mycket viktigt område där du kan göra en stor skillnad. Du kommer att arbeta tillsammans med motiverade, stödjande och kompetenta medarbetare och ledare som snabbt tar dig med i gemenskapen. Samarbete med leverantörer, kunder och kollegor från andra system i flygplanet är en naturlig del av arbetet. Vanligt förekommande arbetsuppgifter Systemutveckling och design med avseende på funktionalitet Kravanalys och rapportering för kund- och myndighetskrav Systemsäkerhetsarbete Analysera och delta i verifiering, validering och prov i simulator, rigg, mark- och flygprov Delta i förstudier av framtida flygsystem Utföra utredningar av ärenden som uppstått i kunders verksamhet Arbeta med utveckling och förvaltning av apparater i nära samarbete med inköp och leverantörer Driftuppföljning och produktstöd av system till kund Rollerna är mångsidiga och erbjuder möjlighet att bredda och fördjupa sig i teknikområdet. Inriktningen på dina arbetsuppgifter kommer till stor del att styras av din erfarenhet, dina styrkor och intressen. description: We are seeking an experienced Simulation Engineer to support a major offshore wind energy programme off the Polish coast, based in Gdansk, Poland. The successful candidate will contribute to engineering design optimisation, structural integrity assessments and simulation-driven decision-making throughout the project. Key Responsibilities Develop, set up and execute Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) simulations to assess wind, wave and current loading on offshore foundations, transition pieces and installation equipment. Perform Finite Element Analysis (FEA) for static, fatigue, modal and buckling assessments of steel structures, brackets, lifting tools and mechanical components. Develop and execute coupled fluid-structure interaction (FSI) studies to evaluate the impact of fluid loads on structural behaviour and deformation. Simulate motion, mechanical loads, clearances and operational behaviour of automated and remotely operated offshore installation and handling systems. Prepare high-quality computational meshes and perform mesh independence and convergence studies to ensure simulation accuracy and reliability. Prepare detailed technical calculation reports, simulation documentation and engineering recommendations. Present simulation findings and technical conclusions to structural designers, mechanical engineers, project managers and client representatives. Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams, including structural, mechanical and robotics specialists, to support design development and optimisation. Maintain accurate, traceable and reusable simulation models, calculation files and technical documentation. Requirements Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Civil Engineering, Naval Architecture or a closely related engineering discipline. Minimum 6 years of professional experience in engineering simulation, preferably within offshore, marine, renewable energy or heavy industrial sectors. Strong hands-on experience with Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) software such as ANSYS Fluent, ANSYS CFX, STAR-CCM+ or OpenFOAM. Good understanding of turbulence modelling, transient simulations, fluid flow behaviour and hydrodynamic loading. Proven experience in Finite Element Analysis (FEA) using ANSYS Mechanical, Abaqus or equivalent simulation software. Strong knowledge of static, dynamic, linear and non-linear structural analysis, fatigue assessment, modal analysis and buckling calculations. Ability to perform mesh quality assessments, mesh independence studies and simulation validation. Strong understanding of engineering mechanics, structural behaviour and environmental loading conditions. Experience preparing technical calculation reports and presenting simulation results to multidisciplinary engineering teams. Excellent analytical, problem-solving and technical communication skills. Professional proficiency in written and spoken English is essential. Polish language proficiency will be an advantage but is not mandatory. Previous experience in offshore wind projects, wave loading, hydrodynamic analysis or marine engineering will be highly preferred. Exposure to multibody dynamics, motion simulation or robotic and lifting system analysis will be an added advantage. Experience in fatigue assessment of welded structures and joints will be beneficial.

title: Lead Robotics & Automation Engineer
description: Job Description Summary Ingénierie associée au processus de fabrication. Responsable de la planification et/ou de l'exécution des opérations du département ou axé sur l'exécution d'activités professionnelles au sein d'une discipline technique. Fonctions dotées d'une certaine autonomie, mais guidées par les politiques établies ou l'analyse des résultats finaux. Ce poste est autorisé à modifier les procédures et les pratiques en relation avec les tâches dans la mesure où les résultats finaux répondent aux normes d'acceptabilité (qualité, volume, respect des délais, etc.). Job Description Rôles et responsabilités Travaille sur des « usines exceptionnelles » et d'autres systèmes de fabrication basés sur l'informatique. Les personnes dans ce domaine ont une expertise informatique mais sont principalement spécialisées dans la fabrication. Se fonde sur une connaissance approfondie d'une discipline technique, un esprit d'analyse et une expérience technique pour mettre en œuvre une politique/stratégie. Possède une connaissance approfondie des meilleures pratiques et de la manière dont son propre domaine s'intègre aux autres. Possède une connaissance pratique de la concurrence et des facteurs qui les différencient sur le marché. Fait preuve de discernement et est en capacité de proposer différentes solutions en dehors des paramètres définis pour traiter des processus de fabrication plus complexes comportant une variété d'aspects techniques et/ou de cycles de production interdépendants. Se fonde sur son expérience technique et un esprit d'analyse. Fait appel à des ressources limitées internes et externes en dehors de ses propres équipes pour l'aider à prendre une décision. Agit en tant que ressource pour ses collègues moins expérimentés. Peut piloter de petits projets avec des risques et des besoins en ressources faibles. Explique les informations. Développe des compétences pour amener les membres de l'équipe à un consensus autour de sujets relevant du domaine. Transmet les attentes en matière de performances et peut gérer des problèmes sensibles. Qualifications De Base Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis - Ce rôle nécessite une expérience significative de la fonction et de la station de travail audio numérique. Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une licence dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent). Pour les rôles aux États-Unis - Licence d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 4 ans d'expérience dans la fonction). Caractéristiques souhaitées Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides compétences relationnelles et de leadership. Capacité à influencer les autres et à diriger de petites équipes. Mener des initiatives d'envergure et d'impact modérés. Capacité à coordonner plusieurs projets simultanément. Identification efficace des problèmes et compétences en résolution de problèmes. Capacités d'analyse et d'organisation prouvées.Remarque : Pour se conformer aux exigences légales américaines en matière d'immigration et autres, il est nécessaire de préciser le nombre minimum d'années d'expérience requis pour tout poste basé aux États-Unis. Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis, pour assurer la conformité avec la législation applicable, les juristes doivent mentionner le niveau d'expérience requis et non PAS un nombre minimum d'années.Cette description de poste a pour but de fournir un guide détaillé du rôle. Toutefois, il n'est pas prévu de modifier ou de restreindre et/ou d'élargir de quelque manière que ce soit les tâches requises de chaque employé, telles qu'elles sont définies dans leur contrat de travail respectif et/ou convenues d'un commun accord entre un employé et son responsable. Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: No

title: Mekanik Dizayn Şefi
description: Biz Kimiz? 1993 yılında kurulan Rönesans Holding, bugün Türkiye, Avrupa, Orta Asya ve Afrika’yı kapsayan geniş bir coğrafyada; inşaat, gayrimenkul, enerji, endüstri ve sağlık alanlarında ana müteahhit ve yatırımcı olarak faaliyet göstermektedir. 40.000’i aşkın çalışanı ve 60’tan fazla milletten oluşan güçlü ve çok kültürlü ekibiyle Rönesans, dünyanın en büyük müteahhitlik şirketleri arasında yer almakta; sürdürülebilir bir gelecek inşa etme vizyonuyla yenilikçi ve küresel ölçekteki mühendislik projelerini hayata geçirmeye devam etmektedir. Bu Rolde Seni Neler Bekliyor? Konsept ve avan projelerinden son uygulama projesine kadar olan tüm dizayn süreçlerinin koordine edilip ve yönetilmesi, Mekanik tesisat projelerine ait tüm hesap, rapor, çizim ve detayların hazırlatılması, Mekanik tasarım firması tarafından hazırlanan/hazırlatılan projelerin, teknik şartnamenin, hesapların ve raporların Uluslararası Şartnameler ve Yönetmelikler niteliğinde değerlendirilmesi, Keşif çalışmalarının gerçekleştirilmesi, Proje maliyetin çıkartılması gibi konularda destek verilmesi, dizayn çözümlerinin bütçe aşamasında belirlenen prensiplerle birlikte yürütülmesi ve olabilecek farklılıkların bütçesel olarak raporlanması, Gerçekleştirilen değer mühendisliği çalışmalarının maliyetsel olarak raporlanması, Haftalık ve aylık olarak mekanik dizayn faaliyet raporlarının hazırlanıp sunulması, Projelerde kullanılacak malzemeler için verilen marka listesinin genel planlama ve maliyet kontrollerinin yapılması, dizayn çözümlerini etkileyen konuların koordinasyonu, Mimari, elektrik, statik vb. gibi diğer disiplinlerle gerekli koordinasyonun sağlanması ve takibinin yapılması, Saha ekipleri ile gerekli koordinasyonun sağlanması, imalat programının takibi ve uygulama proje süreçlerinin sahayı aksatmayacak şekilde organizasyonun sağlanması, Mühendis ve teknik ressamlardan oluşan ekibin sevk ve idare edilmesi. Adaylardan Beklentilerimiz Şirketimizin İstanbul'da yapımını üstlendiği Veri Merkezi Projesi’nde değerlendirilmek üzere; Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezun, Büyük ölçekli ve yoğun disiplinler arası koordinasyon gerektiren projelerde minimum 8 yıl deneyim sahibi, Tercihen veri merkezi, endüstriyel tesis, sağlık yapıları, havalimanı veya yüksek teknik gereksinimli projelerde görev almış, Yerel ve uluslararası şartname ve yönetmeliklere hakim, Revit programını aktif ve ileri seviyede kullanabilen Navisworks, AutoCAD ve MS Office uygulamalarına hakim, Mekanik tesisat dizaynı ve hesapları konusunda tecrübeli, İleri seviyede İngilizce bilgisine sahip, Yoğun çalışma temposuna ve saha koşullarına uyum sağlayabilecek, İstanbul’da ikamet eden/edebilecek olan ''Mekanik Dizayn Şefi'' arayışımız bulunmaktadır. Biz Neler Sunuyoruz? Performans ve başarıyı destekleyen prim uygulamaları Kapsamlı yan haklar ve çalışan destek uygulamaları Özel Sağlık Sigortası kapsamında çalışanlarımızı destekleyen sağlık uygulamaları Mesleki ve kişisel gelişimini destekleyen eğitim ve gelişim programları Çeşitlilik ve Eşitlik Beyanımız Rönesans Holding, şirketlere stratejilerini ve operasyonlarını evrensel insan hakları, çalışma, çevre ve yolsuzlukla mücadele ilkelerine uygun hale getirmeye ve toplumsal hedefleri ilerletecek önlemler almaya çağıran BM Küresel İlkeler Sözleşmesi'nin imzacıları arasında yer almaktadır ve Birleşmiş Milletler Küresel İlkeler Sözleşmesi çerçevesinde evrensel kabul görmüş beyanlara dayalı ilkeleri benimser. Rönesans Holding, ana ilkeleri olan dürüstlük, rekabetçilik ve yenilikçilikten ödün vermeden şeffaf ve etik değerleri gözeterek insan kaynakları uygulamalarında eşitliği sağlamayı amaçlayan bir işverendir. Tüm başvurular cinsiyet, dil, din, ırk ve etnik kökene bakmaksızın fırsat eşitliğine göre değerlendirilir ve ayırımcılık yapılmaz.

title: Project Engineer
description: Who we are? Wilo is proud to be one of the leading companies in the pump industry and a premium supplier for building technology, water management and the industrial sector. By developing excellent products and solutions, we not only move water, but also the future for people all over the world. Major movements like globalization, digitalization and energy shortages shape some of our largest future challenges. Challenges that we are happy to accept and dive into. We understand the trends that influence our company and our business and act accordingly. By developing products and solutions we move not only water, but we also move the future for people all over the world. As a pioneer in the pump industry, we focus as much on our employees as on our high-quality pumps. Those of you who want to be part of the Wilo will experience a constant flow of personal and organizational development as well as sufficient space for the implementation of own ideas. At Wilo you will move the future, for yourself and for others. We are looking for a Project Engineer to join the Production Department of our organization in Turkey. Job Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering Minimum 5–7 years of relevant experience Experience in electrical design, including Low Voltage (LV) projects Experience in automation project drawings and commissioning Proficiency in WSCAD or Eplan Knowledge of SAP PP and MM modules Good command of written and spoken English Knowledge of Value Stream Mapping, Kaizen, Lean Management, Production System tools and/or Six Sigma projects Knowledge of SolidWorks and AutoCAD Living in or willing to relocate to the Asian side of Istanbul Completed military service (for male candidates) Job Responsibilities 1. Electrical Design & Technical Documentation Design and develop Low Voltage (LV) electrical projects and automation systems. Create high-quality electrical drawings and schematics using WSCAD or Eplan . Prepare comprehensive technical reports, specifications, and project documentation. Develop detailed Bill of Materials (BOM) for new control panels and electrical systems. Utilize AutoCAD and Solidworks for layout and mechanical-electrical integration tasks. Manage material movements and production data using SAP (PP and MM modules) . 2. Project Management & Planning Create and manage project schedules, cost estimates, and regular status reports. Coordinate Production Planning by collaborating with internal stakeholders to align manufacturing capacities with project timelines. Lead the Commissioning phase of automation projects, ensuring systems are fully operational and meet quality standards. Serve as the primary technical point of contact for clients, translating their needs into tailored engineering solutions. 3. Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement Knowledge in Value Stream Mapping (VSM), Kaizen, and Lean Management to optimize production flow. Identify bottlenecks and execute Six Sigma continuous improvement projects to enhance efficiency and reduce waste. 4. Quality & Supply Chain Coordination Evaluate and audit suppliers to ensure the quality of components and external services. Work closely with operations personnel and external subcontractors to ensure seamless project execution on-site. Ensure all projects comply with international electrical standards and safety regulations.

title: Boya Üretim Mühendisi
description: Kansai Altan olarak; gelecek nesillerin ve müşterilerimizin beklentilerini odağa alan yaklaşımımızla, yenilikçi fikirleri üretim süreçlerimize entegre ediyor, her zaman daha iyisini hedefliyoruz. Bu doğrultuda gelişim odaklı, sorumluluk bilinci yüksek bir organizasyon yapısı ile yol alıyoruz. Etik ilkelere, çevresel duyarlılığa ve şeffaf ilişkilere dayalı satın alma yaklaşımımız sayesinde; tedarikçilerimizle güven temelli, sürdürülebilir iş birlikleri kuruyoruz. Bu yaklaşımı iş yapış biçimimize yansıtıyor; uzun vadeli değer yaratmanın her adımında sorumlulukla hareket ediyoruz. Bu vizyon doğrultusunda, İzmir/Kemalpaşa’da bulunan üretim tesisimizde görev almak üzere, aşağıda belirtilen niteliklere sahip “ Boya Üretim Mühendisi” arayışımız bulunmaktadır. Görev ve Sorumluluklar Haftalık ve günlük üretim planlarının kontrolü, uygulanması ve takibi, Hammadde ve yarı ürün ihtiyaçlarının takip edilmesi, oluşan problemlerin ilgili birimlerle çözülmesi, Üretim süreçlerinde kalite, verimlilik ve sürekliliğin sağlanması, Uygunsuzlukların takibi ve düzeltici faaliyetlerde rol alınması, Üretim proseslerinin iyileştirilmesi ve verimlilik çalışmalarına katkı sağlanması, Üretim ekipmanlarının bakım, onarım ve ihtiyaçlarının koordinasyonu, İş Talimatlarının hazırlanması ve güncelliğinin sağlanması, Sayım, eğitim ve dokümantasyon süreçlerinin yürütülmesi, Kendisine bağlı ekibin performans, eğitim ve gelişim süreçlerinin takip edilmesi, Ar-Ge, Kalite, Planlama ve diğer ilgili departmanlarla koordineli çalışılması. Aranan Nitelikler Üniversitelerin Kimya Mühendisliği bölümünden mezun, İyi düzeyde İngilizce bilgisine sahip, MS Office ve tercihen SAP uygulamalarını etkin kullanabilen, Planlama, organizasyon, problem çözme ve ekip yönetimi yetkinlikleri gelişmiş, İletişim ve koordinasyon becerileri güçlü. Neden Kansai Altan? Türkiye'nin öncü endüstriyel boya üreticilerinden biri Uluslararası normlara uygun satın alma sistemleri ve süreç yönetimi Sistematik, güvenlik odaklı, sürdürülebilirlik bilinciyle hareket eden iş kültürü Gelişim olanakları sunan kurumsal yapıyla uzun vadeli kariyer imkanı Siz de profesyonel kariyerinize güçlü bir adım atmak istiyorsanız, başvurunuzu bekliyoruz! HAKKIMIZDA Biz, İzmir’de 110 bin m²'lik alanda konumlanan, 90 bin ton boya üretimi ve 32 bin ton polimer üretimi kapasiteli bir boya üretim şirketiyiz. Teknoloji rehberliğinde, insan ve toplum odağında sürdürülebilir kimya çözümleri üretiyoruz. Kansai Altan olarak yetkin iş gücü ve kolektif bilinçle müşteri odaklı bakış açımızı en üst seviyede tutmak için, dünyadaki en son teknoloji ve trendlerle güçlerimizi birleştiriyoruz. Müşterilerimizin ve gelecek nesillerin beklentileri doğrultusunda yenilikçi fikirleri üretim sürecine entegre ederek her zaman daha iyi olmak için çalışıyoruz.

title: Maintenance Leader

title: Üretim Mühendisi

At ADI you will work alongside the brightest minds to collaborate on solving complex problems that matter from autonomous vehicles, drones and factories to augmented reality and remote healthcare. ADI fosters a culture that focuses on employees through beneficial programs, aligned goals, continuous learning opportunities, and practices that create a more sustainable future. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X. Analog Design Engineer About the Role As an Analog Design Engineer at Analog Devices, you'll design and develop analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits for a variety of applications. Working under normal supervision with guidance from experienced engineers, you'll apply standard principles and techniques to solve moderately complex problems in circuit design. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure designs meet performance requirements while gaining valuable experience that furthers your professional development. This position provides an excellent opportunity to expand your technical skills while making meaningful contributions to innovative semiconductor solutions. Key Responsibilities Design and Development: Design and develop analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits including sensor interfaces, data converters, multiplexers, filters, and power distribution systems Circuit Simulation: Perform block and transistor-level design, simulation, evaluation, and debugging to verify design performance across specified conditions Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with product definers, verification engineers, process engineers, test engineers, and application engineers to meet performance objectives Performance Verification: Ensure designs meet performance objectives across process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) ranges Documentation and Reporting: Create comprehensive documentation of designs, test results, and technical specifications Problem Solving: Identify and resolve design issues with guidance from senior team members Statistical Design: Apply statistical design principles to ensure robustness and reliability of integrated circuits Must Have Skills Analog Circuits Design: Practical knowledge of analog circuit fundamentals including amplifiers, filters, and data converters with ability to implement these circuits under supervision Mixed-Signal IC Design: Working understanding of analog/digital circuit integration principles and implementation techniques in mixed-signal environments Simulation Modeling: Proficiency with simulation tools such as SPICE, MATLAB, and Cadence Design Suite to validate design performance Integrated Circuit Layout: Understanding of physical IC layout considerations and hands-on experience with layout tools and techniques CMOS Technology: Knowledge of CMOS circuit design principles and practical application experience Analog/Digital Conversion: Fundamental understanding of ADC/DAC design concepts and implementation challenges Laboratory Skills: Ability to use standard lab equipment including oscilloscopes, function generators, and spectrum analyzers to validate and troubleshoot designs Preferred Education and Experience Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field 2+ years of relevant experience in analog circuit design Experience with integrated circuit design for sensor interfaces, data converters, or power management is a plus Why You'll Love Working at ADI At Analog Devices, you'll be part of a collaborative and innovative team that's shaping the future of technology. We offer a supportive environment focused on professional growth, competitive compensation and benefits, work-life balance, and the opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects that make a real impact on the world. You'll have access to continuous learning opportunities and mentorship from industry experts. Join us and help create the technologies that bridge the physical and digital worlds, making a tangible difference in how people live, work, and connect. title: Satellite System Engineer
description: Job Description We are a startup developing missions for Low Earth Orbit (LEO) and are looking for a mid-level Satellite Systems Engineer with a strong design mindset and hands-on execution capability. This role is design-heavy, with end-to-end responsibility spanning system architecture, subsystem selection, integration, environmental testing, and launch preparation. You will play a key role in shaping the spacecraft design, making pragmatic trade-offs appropriate for LEO environments, and selecting and procuring COTS subsystems and components that balance performance, reliability, cost, and schedule. Responsibilities: • Drive system-level spacecraft design for LEO CubeSat missions, including architecture definition, requirements flow-down, and interface management. • Perform design trade-offs considering LEO environmental constraints such as thermal cycling, radiation exposure, and launch loads. • Lead or contribute to the selection, evaluation, and procurement of COTS subsystems and components, including avionics, power systems, radios, payload electronics, and sensors. • Assess vendor documentation, qualification data, heritage, and risks associated with COTS hardware; define acceptance or additional screening tests as needed. • Prepare and maintain clear, traceable technical documentation, including system requirements, interface control documents, test plans and procedures, verification matrices, and anomaly or corrective action reports. • Define and maintain electrical architectures, including power distribution, grounding, harnessing, and data interfaces. • Work directly with spacecraft interfaces and protocols such as RS-422/232, UART, I2C, CSP, SPI, CAN, and similar onboard buses. • Support and execute hands-on AIT activities, including hardware bring-up, integration, debugging, rework, and re-test. • Plan, support, and analyze environmental testingappropriate for LEO missions, including TVAC, TID, vibration, and shock. • Understand and apply launch environment requirements, including static and dynamic loads, acoustic environments, deployer constraints, and separation events. • Apply EMI/EMC design principles throughout the spacecraft; investigate and mitigate interference issues discovered during integration or test. • Generate and maintain system documentation including ICDs, test plans, verification matrices, anomaly reports, and corrective action records. • Support launch integration activities and early mission operations as a technical contributor when required. Minimum Qualifications: • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Aerospace, Systems, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline. • 3+ years of relevant experience in satellite, aerospace, or high-reliability embedded hardware systems. • Understand basic orbital mechanics and assess how orbit characteristics impact mission operations • Strong design experience at system or subsystem level for small satellites or equivalent complex hardware. • Demonstrated experience selecting and working with COTS hardware, including vendor evaluation and technical due diligence. • Solid understanding of CubeSat system hierarchy and subsystem interactions. • Practical experience with embedded and spacecraft interfaces (RS-422/232, UART, I2C, CSP, SPI, CAN, etc.). • Working knowledge of environmental testing for space hardware • Strong understanding of EMI/EMC fundamentals and grounding • Ability to troubleshoot issues using schematics, test and lab equipment, logs, and engineering judgment. Preferred Qualifications: • Prior experience in an aerospace company. • Direct involvement in at least one LEO missionthrough integration, environmental testing, and launch preparation. • Experience defining acceptance vs. qualification test strategies for COTS-based spacecraft. • Working proficiency with mechanical and electrical CAD tools to review layouts, assess integration constraints, and support design trades. • Familiarity with deployers, launch integrators, launch provider requirements, and rideshare integration processes. • Experience with power systems, avionics boards, harness design, and grounding strategies for space applications. • Comfortable operating with incomplete information and making pragmatic engineering decisions under startup constraints. • Hands-on experience with spacecraft Assembly, Integration, and Test (AIT), including hardware bring-up, environmental testing support, and anomaly resolution in a lab setting. • Familiarity with IPC standards and PCB quality, including inspection, workmanship criteria, and acceptance testing relevant to high-reliability aerospace hardware. Benefits: Competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance and fuel support. Continued support for candidates currently enrolled in a master's or doctoral program. Opportunities for continuous professional growth and skill development. Engage in a collaborative and innovative work environment. Enjoy a positive and enriching work environment, situated in a desirable location.

title: Power Systems Engineer
description: At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. This position reports to: ELSE Cluster Manager North Europe __ Your Role And Responsibilities In this role you will work as a power engineer on a range of exciting projects for global clients in a rewarding team environment, developing technical and solution development skills to develop into an industry-recognized consulting engineer. The position would suit a practical and adaptable individual who wishes to work in a progressive, innovative electrical consultancy. We are seeking experienced Power Systems Engineers who are eager to deepen their technical expertise and contribute to complex engineering projects for global clients. This role is ideal for a practical, adaptable, and technically driven engineer who wants to grow into an industry-recognized consulting specialist within a progressive and innovative electrical consultancy environment. The work model for the role is: #hybrid, Driven by strong business growth and increasing customer demand, we are expanding our team and recruiting multiple professionals for this role across the listed countries. You will be mainly accountable for: Providing technical input and leadership on a variety of complex projects. Working closely with clients to understand their technical and business requirements and translating them into practical engineering solutions. Ensuring project outputs meet client expectations, quality standards, timeframes, and budget requirements. Conducting in-depth power systems analysis using industry-leading methodologies and software tools. Preparing detailed technical and non-technical reports, presenting clear recommendations and actionable insights. Attending client meetings remotely, building trusted relationships and managing expectations through effective communication and responsiveness. Tracking and reporting on project performance and client satisfaction. Mentoring, coaching and developing more junior engineers. Online training to be delivered where applicable. Typical projects include: Power system studies include load flow, short circuit, protection coordination and system resilience assessments. Electrical safety and power quality studies, including arc flash, harmonics and earthing assessments. Grid connection and renewable energy integration projects, covering stability, harmonics and compliance analyses. Reliability assessments and failure investigations for critical electrical infrastructure. Software-based engineering solutions and emerging technology evaluations. Supporting wind energy projects from design through installation and commissioning. Qualifications For The Role You are highly skilled in power system studies, including short circuit, protection coordination and arc flash analysis, and enjoy working on complex electrical infrastructure projects. You have 3+ years of experience in power systems engineering, applying technical expertise to deliver reliable, safe and efficient electrical solutions. You possess advanced knowledge of industry-leading power system analysis tools such as SKM, EasyPower, ETAP or similar. You have proven experience in protection system design, settings development and coordination studies, with exposure to transformer and bus differential protection, REF and directional protection schemes. You have experience performing electrical calculations and developing designs in accordance with relevant IEC standards. Knowledge of power quality, harmonics and renewable energy integration studies would be an advantage. You are passionate about solving technical challenges, collaborating with clients and stakeholders, and continuously expanding your expertise. Degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field. You are at ease communicating in English and can clearly present technical concepts to a wide range of audiences Compensation Package This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage. The offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards. Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

description: Wil je niet een onderdeeltje van een machine ontwerpen, maar de complete mechanische basis van een tool die nog nergens anders bestaat? Voor een jonge, snelgroeiende deep-tech startup in Eindhoven zoek ik een Mechanical Design Engineer . Het bedrijf bouwt inspectie- en metrologieapparatuur voor de halfgeleiderindustrie en zit volop in de opbouwfase. Wat ga je doen? Je ontwerpt de hardware die de metingen draagt: van machinebehuizing en frames tot de wafertafel en de draagconstructies van het systeem. ✅ Ontwerpen van concept tot productietekening, inclusief materiaal- en oppervlaktekeuze ✅ Zelf schakelen met CNC-bedrijven en leveranciers over offertes, toleranties en wijzigingen ✅ FEM-, thermische en dynamische analyses waar het ertoe doet, eenvoud waar het kan ✅ Je eigen ontwerpen assembleren en testen in het lab, en leren voor de volgende versie ✅ Nauw samenwerken met mechatronica-, optica- en systeemengineers Wie ben jij? 🔹 3+ jaar hands-on ervaring met mechanisch ontwerp van high-tech apparatuur (semicon, metrologie of wetenschappelijke instrumenten) 🔹 Je ontwerpen zijn van CAD naar werkende hardware gegaan 🔹 Sterk in 3D-CAD (Creo bij voorkeur, SolidWorks of NX ook prima) 🔹 Goede kennis van GD&T, tolereren en DfMA 🔹 Je weet wat een CNC-bedrijf wel en niet kan 🔹 Je staat net zo graag aan de labtafel als achter je CAD-scherm 🔹 Professioneel niveau Engels Pluspunten: cleanroom- of vacuümontwerp, trillingsisolatie en thermisch management, SEMI-standaarden en CE-markering, opto-mechanisch ontwerp, een leveranciersnetwerk in Brainport. Geen perfecte match? Geen probleem. Engineering-inzicht en eigenaarschap tellen hier zwaarder dan het afvinken van een lijstje. Heb je precisiehardware ontworpen én gebouwd, dan wil ik je spreken. title: Mechanical Engineer Machinebouw
description: Ben jij een ervaren Mechanical Engineer met ervaring in de machinebouw en kun je moeiteloos door alle fasen van een project navigeren? Dan is de rol bij VIRO in Schiedam de perfecte uitdaging voor jou! Als Mechanical Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van mechanische systemen en componenten. Je werkt aan uitdagende en innovatieve projecten, waarbij je jouw technische expertise inzet om producten te creëren die volledig aansluiten op de wensen en eisen van onze klanten. Je bent van begin tot eind betrokken bij het project, van de conceptontwikkeling en het ontwerp tot de testfasen en de uiteindelijke oplevering. In samenwerking met een multidisciplinair team zorg je ervoor dat elk project voldoet aan de hoogste kwaliteitsstandaarden en bijdraagt aan de klanttevredenheid. We zoeken een gedreven collega met voldoende ervaring om zelfstandig aan de slag te gaan, maar je hoeft het niet alleen te doen. Bij VIRO kun je rekenen op de steun van je collega’s, want dat is de kracht van werken bij VIRO: een toonaangevende ontwikkelingspartner voor de industrie. Wat ga je doen? Zelfstandig en samen met het team technische oplossingen vinden voor diverse machinebouwprojecten. Proactief rapporteren aan betrokken stakeholders, zoals lead engineers en projectleiders, over de planning, voortgang en wijzigingen in de opdracht of het ontwerp. Controleregistraties uitvoeren, ontwerpen verifiëren en zorgen voor de benodigde rapportages. Waar nodig verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor zowel de concept- als detailengineering. Regelmatig contact onderhouden met de klant en, indien nodig, af en toe op locatie werken. Overleggen met externe partijen en collega's binnen VIRO om projecten succesvol af te ronden. Collega’s ondersteunen en junior engineers begeleiden in hun ontwikkeling en projecten. In de pauze is er altijd tijd voor een potje poolen of tafelvoetballen, als dat in de smaak valt! Vereisten Een afgeronde hbo- en/of wo-opleiding in de richting Mechanical Engineering, Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar Een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring in de machinebouw om zelfstandig te kunnen werken Projecten binnen de gestelde tijd en het budget succesvol opleveren is één van je drijfveren Oplossingsgericht om de diverse vraagstukken op te kunnen lossen Je communiceert makkelijk met je klanten en collega’s in het Nederlands en in het Engels Je draagt bij aan het teamgevoel Flexibele instelling omdat elk project weer anders is Wat bieden wij je? Afwisselende projecten met veel ruimte voor innovatieve en duurzame ideeën Een uitdagende en afwisselende baan in een gemoedelijk maar professioneel team Enthousiaste, vakkundige collega’s en een open, prettige sfeer Regie over je eigen carrière via onze VIRO Academy Prima mogelijkheden en faciliteiten om hybride te werken, inclusief thuiswerkvergoeding 22 vakantiedagen en 13 ATV-dagen Vergoeding voor het woon – werkverkeer of gebruik van een zakelijke NS-business card Je kunt gebruik maken van een fietsleaseplan, een aantrekkelijke fitnessregeling en/of het hybride warmtepompplan Profiteer van een uitstekende pensioenvoorziening bij Nationale Nederlanden en onze collectieve zorgverzekering via VGZ Onze actieve personeelsvereniging zorgt voor de nodige ontspanning en voor mooie verhalen bij de koffieautomaat Je afdeling VIRO vestiging Schiedam is een bruisende, jonge en ambitieuze vestiging waar een enthousiast team collega’s met elkaar samenwerkt en elkaar helpt wanneer dat nodig is. De sfeer is informeel en collega's ondernemen vaak activiteiten. Of dit nu gaat om een gezellige gameavond of filmavond op kantoor, iets sportiefs ondernemen, genieten van een biertje in onze VIRO bar of een potje poolen op kantoor, er is altijd ruimte voor gezelligheid en elkaar ook na werktijd leren kennen. We moedigen initiatieven aan, stimuleren persoonlijke ontwikkeling en betrekken onze collega’s bij het meedenken over de groei en de ontwikkeling van onze vestiging. Interesse? Bij interesse in deze vacature zien we je sollicitatie graag tegemoet en wie weet maak jij dan binnenkort deel uit van ons enthousiast team in Schiedam! Heb je vragen over deze of andere vacatures binnen VIRO, bel of whatsapp dan onze talentspecialist Rutger van Rugge via 0614756851 of We willen deze functie rechtstreeks invullen en maken hierbij geen gebruik van werving- en selectiebureaus.

title: Senior Design Engineer CAD
description: Ben jij een gedreven en ervaren werktuigbouwkundig ingenieur die energie krijgt van het omzetten van concepten naar slimme, produceerbare oplossingen? Sluit je aan bij ons team en speel een belangrijke rol in het vormgeven van de toekomst van technologie voor pluimveeverwerking. Over de functie Als Senior Design Engineer CAD ben je verantwoordelijk voor het vertalen van innovatieve concepten naar basis- en detailontwerpen van machines. Je vervult een centrale rol binnen de concept- en definitiefase van productontwikkeling en werkt nauw samen met een multidisciplinair team om hoogwaardige ontwerpen, stuklijsten (BOM's) en technische documentatie voor seriematige productie te ontwikkelen. Je bent vertrouwd met het werken binnen een engineerings- en productieomgeving en begrijpt de belangen, onderlinge relaties en doelstellingen van verschillende stakeholders. Je draagt niet alleen bij als ervaren engineer, maar ook als coach en sparringpartner voor collega’s. Met jouw scherpe blik op produceerbaarheid, hygiëne, veiligheid en kostenefficiëntie help je elk ontwerp naar een hoger niveau te tillen, van de eerste schets tot het uiteindelijke technische dossier. Deze functie biedt veel technische diepgang en afwisseling. Je wordt regelmatig uitgedaagd met nieuwe vraagstukken en werkt aan machines die een cruciale rol spelen binnen een wereldwijde hightechindustrie. Je neemt deel aan FAT- en SAT-tests, ondersteunt verbetertrajecten en bent actief betrokken bij de conceptfase als productspecialist op het gebied van ontwerp. Om de functie nog dynamischer te maken, krijg je de mogelijkheid om enkele keren per jaar internationaal te reizen (gemiddeld 2 tot 4 reizen per jaar). Je bezoekt productielocaties en werkt rechtstreeks samen met internationale klanten en partners. Hierdoor krijg je een waardevol praktijkperspectief en worden projecten nog tastbaarder en interessanter. Ben jij op zoek naar een functie waarin techniek, eigenaarschap en internationale exposure samenkomen? Dan is dit jouw kans. Wat breng je mee? Een bachelor- of masteropleiding in Werktuigbouwkunde of een vergelijkbare richting Minimaal 5 jaar relevante ervaring in mechanisch ontwerp en 3D CAD-engineering Ervaring met het opstellen van technische tekeningen, waaronder maar niet beperkt tot overzichtstekeningen (General Arrangements), ontwerpspecificaties, werkplaatstekeningen en pneumatische- en hydraulische schema’s Ervaring met modulair ontwerpen, ERP en wijzigingsbeheer-/change management-systemen Kennis van materialen, productieprocessen en hygiënisch ontwerpen (HACCP) Bekendheid met CE-richtlijnen, risicoanalyses en technische documentatie Goede beheersing van CAD-software (bij voorkeur CATIA V5 of V6) Ervaring met Infor LN is een pré Ervaring met FEM-berekeningen en bewegingsanalyses is een pluspunt Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Engels; kennis van het Duits is een pre Een gestructureerde, praktische instelling met passie voor technische nauwkeurigheid en teamwork Waarom bij ons werken? Je wordt onderdeel van een samenwerkend, internationaal engineeringteam dat tastbare en hoogwaardige producten ontwikkelt. Deze functie biedt een unieke combinatie van technische diepgang, ontwerpverantwoordelijkheid en teamwork . Je helpt mee aan het ontwikkelen van machines die een essentiële rol spelen in de wereldwijde voedselproductie, terwijl je tegelijkertijd je eigen expertise verder ontwikkelt binnen een dynamische en ondersteunende werkomgeving. Wat maakt deze functie aantrekkelijk? Je krijgt de kans om innovatieve concepten om te zetten in concrete, produceerbare oplossingen Je neemt deel aan het testen van je eigen ontwerpen en bent hier direct getuige van in onze eigen testfaciliteiten Je werkt in een projectmatige omgeving waarin jouw werk een directe impact heeft op wereldwijde operaties Je begeleidt en ontwikkelt jongere engineers, waardoor je zowel hun groei als je eigen leiderschapsvaardigheden stimuleert Je hebt een gezonde afwisseling tussen ontwerp-, test-, verbeter- en documentatiewerkzaamheden Je bent betrokken bij en getuige van de bouw van machines tijdens en na de opstartfase in onze eigen productiefaciliteiten Wat bieden wij Salaris tussen € 3665,00 en € 5.845,00 afhankelijk van opleiding en werkervaring Aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling Royale vrije tijd: in totaal 33 dagen, waarvan 25 vakantiedagen en 8 ADV-dagen Groei- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden: ruime mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling en loopbaangroei Reiskostenvergoeding: € 0,25 per kilometer Over Meyn Al meer dan 65 jaar is Meyn een vertrouwde wereldwijde leider in oplossingen voor pluimveeverwerking. Als Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) ontwerpen en bouwen wij onze eigen machines en systemen, die wereldwijd door klanten worden gebruikt. Door bij Meyn te komen werken, word je onderdeel van een team dat wordt gedreven door innovatie, samenwerking en een voortdurend streven naar excellentie. Solliciteer nu en word onderdeel van een team dat succes drijft. Geïnteresseerd Solliciteer via de sollicitatieknop. Heb je vragen over de vacature? title: Mechanical Engineer
description: Job Description About Us E2M Technologies BV, part of the MTS group, is a fast-growing high-tech company headquartered in Amsterdam, the Netherlands, with manufacturing facilities in Mijdrecht. We design, develop, and manufacture electric motion and control loading systems for applications such as vehicle simulation, entertainment rides and R&D environments. Our products are exported and serviced worldwide. At E2M, we combine engineering excellence with an informal, dynamic and collaborative working culture. Are you passionate about mechanical design and turning concepts into working machines? We are looking for a Mechanical Engineer to join our team and work on innovative motion platforms from concept and design through manufacturing, testing, and delivery. Key Responsibilities As our Mechanical Engineer, you'll be involved throughout the entire product lifecycle from concept and design to assembly, testing and delivery. You Will Design mechanical parts and assemblies using Siemens NX. Create detailed production drawings and Bills of Materials (BOMs). Perform kinematic, motion, and collision analyses. Select and apply appropriate manufacturing methods such as machining, laser cutting, welding, casting, and 3D printing. Support assembly, testing, and commissioning activities together with our workshop team. Research and evaluate new technologies and engineering solutions. Collaborate closely with Mechanical, Electrical, and Software Engineers. Contribute throughout the entire product lifecycle, from concept development to customer delivery. Participate in technical reviews and help drive continuous improvement. Take ownership of engineering decisions and technical problem-solving. What You Bring You don't need to tick every box, but this role will likely suit you if you have: A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Industrial Design Engineering, or a related field. Up to 4 years of engineering experience. Experience with 3D CAD software, preferably Siemens NX. A solid understanding of mechanical design and manufacturing processes. A practical, hands-on engineering mindset. A proactive attitude and willingness to take ownership. Strong communication skills and the confidence to share and challenge ideas. Professional proficiency in English. Experience with mechatronic systems. Experience working in a multidisciplinary engineering environment. Why Join Us? Freedom to take ownership, innovate, and lead improvements. Modern working environment with a collaborative team culture and short communication lines. Opportunities to growth in responsibilities. Access to courses and personal development opportunities. Competitive salary and benefits. An international working environment. The chance to work with cutting-edge high-tech products. Have the freedom to explore additional responsibilities outside your job description. Apply If you enjoy hands-on engineering, technical challenges, and seeing your designs come to life, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your application via ITW Careers. Please note that we do not provide relocation assistance for this role. Candidates must already be legally authorized to work in the Netherlands at the time of application. E2M manage our recruitment process directly. Should we require additional support, we will contact our preferred recruitment partners ourselves.

title: Mechanical Engineer

title: Project Engineer
description: Do you enjoy cross-functional collaboration and customer-focused projects? As a Project Engineer at GEA, you will gain valuable insight into our customers' products and production processes while playing an active role in designing and implementing systems that expand and optimise their operations. From design to implementation, you can look forward to collaborating with skilled colleagues across our many areas of expertise to develop tailored solutions that meet each of our customers’ unique challenges. At our office in Skanderborg, you will become part of our Liquid Technologies department, where we deliver customized liquid processing and engineering solutions primarily to the food and dairy industries in the Nordic region. Responsibilities / Tasks Joining GEA Liquid Technologies, you will develop a comprehensive understanding of the full project lifecycle for liquid projects in the Nordic region – from sales through project execution and aftermarket services. You will contribute to the execution of customer projects from design to handover (including commissioning and start-up), as well as occasionally participating in the pre-project and proposal stages. Depending on project size and your experience, you may assume responsibility for both the technical and commercial execution of projects, acting as project engineer and project manager. Our projects typically run for 12 to 18 months and combine complex technical tasks with close collaboration across multiple disciplines. More Specifically, You Will Develop process flow diagrams (PFDs), mass balances and piping & instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs) for hygienic process applications and review associated 3D models prepared by technical designers. Size and specify process equipment, tanks and flow components, perform hydraulic and utility consumption calculations, and support plant layout optimisation. Serve as a technical point of contact for customers throughout project execution. Specify, procure and technically evaluate process equipment, packages and services from approved suppliers and subcontractors in collaboration with our procurement department. Collaborate with project managers to develop project schedules and resource planning. Coordinate process requirements with automation engineers to support functional design, control philosophy development and commissioning activities. Lead and support equipment commissioning, site acceptance testing (SAT), start-up and performance validation activities at customer sites. As you will be collaborating closely with our customers, you can expect some travel in the Nordic region for customer meetings, supplier visits and customer site activities. Your Profile / Qualifications You enjoy building strong relationships across the organisation and naturally collaborate with colleagues to draw on their expertise. Combining an analytical mindset with a practical approach, you work through technical challenges while maintaining the attention to detail needed to deliver high-quality engineering solutions. Additionally, We Imagine That You Bring A degree in mechanical engineering, process engineering, dairy engineering or a similar field. Previous experience in project engineering, process engineering or equipment design, preferably within food, dairy, beverage, pharmaceutical or related process industries. Experience with commissioning or start-up of liquid processing systems is an advantage, but not a prerequisite. Strong proficiency in spoken and written English. We are open to candidates at different stages of their careers. Responsibilities and degree of autonomy will be adapted to your experience level. Finally, you preferably live near our site in Skanderborg, as this will be your regular work location. Would you like to know more? If you would like to find out more about this position, please contact Engineering Manager, Stephanie Gunn, at stephanie.gunn@gea.com. Please apply via the indicated link. Please note that GEA exclusively uses electronic recruiting, and only applications received through our application system will be considered. Did we spark your interest? Then please click apply above to access our guided application process.

title: Senior Application Engineer
description: Senior Application Engineer – har du mod på at blive et stort tandhjul i et mindre maskineri Dan-iso A/S, Aars · Fuldtid · Tiltrædelse efter aftale Da vores mangeårige Engineer har søgt nye udfordringer som selvstændig, søger vi dig der vil være den, der omsætter kundernes behov til nye produkter – fra den første skitse til færdig løsning i produktionen? Hos Dan-iso bliver du virksomhedens tekniske omdrejningspunkt. Du får ansvar, frihed og kort vej fra idé til beslutning, da du refererer direkte til direktøren. Vi er ikke en stor koncern med mange lag, men en specialiseret produktionsvirksomhed, hvor din faglighed gør en synlig forskel hver dag. Om Dan-iso A/S Siden 1986 har Dan-iso udviklet og produceret isolering i hårdt polyurethanskum (PUR og PIR) på fabrikken i Aars. Vi leverer rørskåle og bøjninger, rørbæringer, blokskum, montageskum, færdige isolerings-kits og specialemner efter tegning – og vi fræser emner, forme og prototyper på egne CNC-maskiner. Vores produkter bruges i fjernvarme, industrikøling, vindindustrien, byggeri, offshore og marine samt Power-to-X. Fælles for dem er, at de skal isolere effektivt på lidt plads, holde i mange år og ofte tilpasse til en helt specifik opgave. Dine opgaver Som vores eneste ingeniør ejer du den tekniske udvikling fra start til slut. Du kommer til at: Udvikle og materiale afprøvning af nye produkter, der møder konkrete behov i markedet Udvikle kundespecifikke løsninger – ofte ud fra en tegning, en skitse eller en udfordring, kunden ikke selv har løst Besvare tekniske forespørgsler fra kunder og være salgets tekniske sparringspartner Udarbejde og vedligeholde virksomhedens tekniske dokumentation, fx datablade, produktspecifikationer og vejledninger Stille de rigtige spørgsmål til vores leverandører – både råvareleverandører af polyoler og isocyanat og leverandører af maskiner og procesudstyr Udfordre leverandørerne, når en ny løsning kræver mere end standardsortimentet Samarbejde med leverandørerne om udvikling af nye produkter og materialer Du driver selv dine projekter og planlægger din hverdag. Til gengæld kan du se dine løsninger blive produceret og leveret til kunderne. Din profil Du er uddannet ingeniør, gerne cand.polyt. eller civilingeniør inden for maskinkonstruktion. Er du proces-, kemi-, bygge-, materialeingeniør eller har en anden relevant uddannelse og erfaring fra produktionsindustrien, er du måske det match vi søger. Du har mindst 5 års erfaring som ingeniør, gerne med produktudvikling i en mindre produktionsvirksomhed Du arbejder selvstændigt og kan drive projekter i mål uden et stort teknisk team omkring dig. Du er nysgerrig, analytisk og træffer beslutninger på et fagligt grundlag. Du kan kommunikere klart med både kunder, leverandører og kolleger i produktionen. Du taler og skriver dansk og engelsk; (tysk er en fordel). Erfaring med polyurethan, plast eller kompositter er et plus, men ikke et krav. Ligeledes er erfaring med termisk isolering et plus, men ikke et krav. Vi lægger mest vægt på din tekniske dømmekraft og lyst til at lære materialet at kende. Vi tilbyder En central rolle med stor indflydelse på virksomhedens produkter og fremtid Kort beslutningsvej: du refererer direkte til ejer og adm. direktør, uden unødigt bureaukrati Varierede opgaver, hvor du følger dine løsninger fra udvikling til produktion og levering Tætte samarbejder med kunder og leverandører i både Danmark og udlandet Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø i en solid nordjysk produktionsvirksomhed med 40 års erfaring Mulighed for faglig udvikling og efteruddannelse Konkurrencedygtig løn og pension efter kvalifikationer Mulighed for sidemandsoplæring og sparring For yderligere information, er du velkommen til at kontakte direktør Erik H. Møller på ehm@dan-iso.dk eller på 2947 9433. Din ansøgning sendes til ehm@dan-iso.dk eller via Jobindex – hvor den naturligvis behandles fortroligt. Ansøgningsfrist: Ansøgningerne behandles løbende.

title: Mekanikkonstruktör: Från idé till färdig konstruktion
description: Företagsbeskrivning AFRY erbjuder tjänster inom teknik, design, digitalisering och rådgivning. Vi är dedikerade experter inom industri, energi och infrastruktur och skapar värde för kommande generationer. AFRY har nordiska rötter med global räckvidd. Våra gemensamma principer – Result driven, Client centric, Empowering och Accountable – vägleder oss i hur vi arbetar, utvecklas och lyckas tillsammans. Var med och accelerera övergången till ett hållbart samhälle. Jobbeskrivning Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens produkter, maskiner och produktionslösningar? Nu söker vi en mekanikkonstruktör som vill kombinera teknisk kreativitet med praktisk problemlösning i spännande uppdrag inom industrin. Som mekanikkonstruktör hos AFRY får du arbeta genom hela konstruktionsprocessen, från tidiga idéer och konceptutveckling till färdig konstruktion och implementerad lösning. Du tar fram 3D-modeller och teknisk dokumentation i moderna CAD-verktyg såsom SolidWorks och Inventor, samtidigt som du bidrar med materialval, komponentval och tekniska bedömningar för att säkerställa hållbara och kostnadseffektiva lösningar. Du blir en viktig del av våra projektteam och arbetar nära kollegor inom flera teknikområden för att omsätta kundernas behov till smarta och funktionella lösningar. Rollen innebär ett stort eget ansvar där du driver konstruktionsarbetet framåt och säkerställer att leveranser håller hög kvalitet, uppfyller tekniska krav och följer projektets tidplan. Arbetet sker främst från AFRYs kontor eller ute hos kund, med möjlighet till visst distansarbete beroende på uppdragets karaktär. Som ny medarbetare hos oss får du stöd från både chef och en utsedd buddy som hjälper dig att snabbt komma in i verksamheten. Du blir även en del av AFRYs breda nätverk av specialister där kunskapsutbyte, samarbete och kompetensutveckling är en naturlig del av vardagen. För dig som vill utvecklas finns goda möjligheter att forma din fortsatta karriär utifrån dina intressen. Du kan exempelvis fördjupa dig inom hållfasthetsberäkningar, utvecklas mot konstruktionsledning eller projektledning, eller bredda din kompetens som teknisk konsult med ansvar för större helhetsleveranser. Vissa uppdrag kan kräva säkerhetsprövning, vilket innebär att rollen framöver kan komma att innefatta arbete inom säkerhetsklassade projekt. Kvalifikationer I rollen som mekanikkonstruktör är dina personliga egenskaper avgörande för att lyckas. Du behöver vara en Problemlösare som kan hantera komplexa utmaningar i konstruktionen genom att se helheten och angripa problem från flera infallsvinklar. Vidare är det viktigt att du Planerar och strukturerar ditt arbete, med tydliga planer för konstruktionsuppdrag och ordning på ritningar och utgåvor för att säkerställa kvalitet i projektet. Rollen kräver också att du är Initiativtagande, då du som konsult ofta förväntas driva arbetet framåt utan att någon detaljstyr dig. Slutligen är det avgörande att du är Serviceinriktad, eftersom du representerar AFRY ute hos kund och behöver agera med serviceanda, leverera enligt kundens behov och vara lyhörd för nya möjligheter. title: Erfaren Ingenjör inom produktutveckling
description: Jobbeskrivning Vi letar just nu efter drivna ingenjörer som har minst 4-10 års erfarenhet utav produktutveckling (meriterande om det varit mot konsumentprodukter) och är redo för nya utmaningar i arbetslivet. Sigma Industry South erbjuder ett varierande jobb där flexibilitet och social förmåga är viktiga egenskaper för att trivas och lyckas i rollen. Vi söker Som konsult och produktutvecklare hos oss får du möjligheten att under en och samma arbetsgivare utvecklas i flera spännande projekt och många olika branscher. För att lyckas bäst som konsult tror vi att du bör vara en flexibel och lyhörd person som kan hantera olika typer av arbetsuppgifter och människor. Du är en lagspelare med god kommunikationsförmåga då arbetet innefattar nära kontakter med både kunder och kollegor, internt och hos marknadsbolagen. För att kunna utföra detta jobb bäst ska du uppfylla följande baskunskaper: Utbildning på högskole- eller civilingenjörsnivå inom t.ex. maskinteknik, produktutveckling eller annat relevant område 4-10 års dokumenterad arbetslivserfarenhet inom produktutveckling och konstruktion Meriterande: Produktutveckling mot konsumentprodukter Färdigheter i något av de större CAD-programmen (Creo, SolidWorks, Inventor, NX, CATIA) Meriterande färdigheter: Kunskap inom PLM-system såsom PTC Windchill Självorganiserande, självmotiverande & ett stort eget ansvar Goda kunskaper i svenska & engelska Skicklig på att uttrycka sig i muntligt och skriftlig, god social förmåga Sigma Industry South Hos Sigma Industry South blir du en del av en kultur som präglas av entreprenörskap, engagemang och gemenskap. Du får stor frihet att påverka din verksamhet, stöd av erfarna kollegor och tillgång till ett starkt varumärke. Vi tror på människor som vill framåt – och vi skapar förutsättningar för att du ska lyckas. Sigma Industry South är ett ledande teknikkonsultföretag i södra Sverige med kontor i Lund, Jönköping, Malmö, Helsingborg, Halmstad, Växjö, Hässleholm och Karlskrona. Bolaget startade 2014 och vi har på dessa år byggt upp ett företag med över 400 medarbetare uteslutande med organisk tillväxt. Vi är en del av Sigmakoncernen med 5000 medarbetare i elva länder – men med hjärtat kvar i entreprenörsandan. För att våra konsulter ska trivas så bra som möjligt anordnar vi: Återkommande avdelningsmöten och roliga aktiviteter för att stärka teamet Kompetensutveckling på konferenser och bolagsträffar Brett nätverk av duktiga ingenjörer inom bolaget Utbildningar för att stärka kompetensen Utöver detta erbjuder vi bland annat: Konkurrenskraftig lön Distanskostnadsersättning vid arbete utanför kontoret Förmånsprogram via vår partner Benify Flexibla arbetstider Betald övertid enligt kollektivavtal 4000 kr i Friskvårdsbidrag Bonus vid tips om rekrytering eller uppdrag Kollektivavtal via TechSverige #SISO Meriterande färdigheter, egenskaper och erfarenheter Vi erbjuder Som konsult hos oss får du arbeta tillsammans med de främsta utvecklingsintensiva företagen inom svensk industri. Uppdragen anpassas alltid i möjligaste mån, för att nivån ska bli så utvecklande och stimulerande som möjligt. Omkring dig kommer du ha många duktiga kollegor och ett aktivt erfarenhetsutbyte. Vår företagskultur präglas av entreprenörskap och korta beslutsvägar. Gemenskap, engagemang och glädje är viktiga element som vi anser skapar trivsel. Sigma Industry South AB är ett dynamiskt teknikkonsultföretag inom produkt- och produktionsutveckling som utmanar de etablerade standarderna. Kombinationen av lång branscherfarenhet, stort engagemang, interna och externa uppdrag samt ett tätt samarbete mellan Sigmas olika verksamheter i regionen skapar ett unikt branschöverskridande växthus för ingenjörer. Med mångfald, delaktighet och entreprenörskap stärker och utvecklar vi vår verksamhet och våra medarbetare. Skulle du vilja utvecklas i denna miljö?
