title: Rör- och mekkonstruktör till AFRY – starta din karriär med talangprogram
description: Rör- och mekkonstruktör till AFRY i Piteå – starta din karriär med talangprogram Vill du vara med och utveckla några av Sveriges mest spännande industriprojekt samtidigt som du får en trygg och inspirerande start på karriären? Nu söker vi dig som är nyexaminerad ingenjör och vill arbeta med tekniskt avancerade lösningar inom processindustrin tillsammans med AFRY. Genom Framtidens Talangprogram får du en unik möjlighet att växa in i konsultrollen, bygga ett starkt professionellt nätverk och utvecklas tillsammans med erfarna specialister. Här får du kombinera teori med praktik från dag ett och vara med och skapa lösningar som gör verklig skillnad för industrin. Talangprogrammet: den bästa starten på din ingenjörskarriär Du blir en del av Framtidens talangprogram i samarbete med AFRY, ett program som är utvecklat för att ge dig mer än ett jobb. Redan från dag ett arbetar du i riktiga projekt tillsammans med några av branschens mest erfarna specialister. Under det första året kombinerar du konsultuppdrag med ett skräddarsytt utvecklingsprogram med: Utbildning och kontinuerligt stöd i takt med att du tar större ansvar Mentorskap och coachning Ett nätverk av andra nyutexaminerade talanger från Norra Sverige Målet är att du ska växa till en självständig konsult och specialist. Oavsett om du siktar mot att bli teknisk expert, projektledare eller framtida ledare får du en stark grund att bygga vidare på. Om rollen Som rör- och mekkonstruktör blir du en viktig del av AFRY:s grupp Project & Plant Engineering Piteå. Här arbetar du nära några av Sveriges största industribolag inom papper och massa, gruv- och kemiindustrin. Du kommer att vara involverad genom hela projektprocessen, från förstudier och projektering till installation och idrifttagning. Rollen ger dig en bred förståelse för industriprojekt samtidigt som du utvecklar din tekniska specialistkompetens. Hos AFRY får du dessutom tillgång till ett stort internt nätverk av specialister och goda möjligheter att på sikt utvecklas mot exempelvis projektledning eller montageledning. Det här kommer du att göra Ta fram teknisk handling för processindustrin, främst inom papper och massa, gruva och kemi Rita i 3D och 2D i AutoCAD, Cadmatic och Plant 3D Ta fram layouter, isometrier, flödesscheman och materiallistor Genomföra spänningsanalyser och ta fram pumpuppställningar Ta fram kostnadskalkyler och vara med i hela projektprocessen Delta i förstudier, projektering och idriftagning samt i arbete med att effektivisera produktionen Bidra i större projekt, både som del av internt projekt och ute hos kund Det här söker vi hos dig Relevant eftergymnasial utbildning inom maskinteknik, energiteknik eller annat relevant område Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift Vana att arbeta i CAD B-körkort Meriterande Erfarenhet av arbete inom processindustrin Personliga egenskaper Du är social och framåt och har lätt för att prata med människor, både kollegor och kunder. Du är noggrann och vill göra det lilla extra för att leverera ett bra resultat. Du är flexibel, trivs med förändring och anpassar dig till nya uppgifter och projekt. Teamet du kommer ingå i Project & Plant Engineering Piteå består av 17 personer i Piteå och Umeå. Gruppen arbetar med projektledning, rörkonstruktion, mekanik och HVAC, med många uppdrag inom papper och massa samt gruva. Teamet växer och har stor samlad erfarenhet. Du blir en del av ett prestigelöst och kunnigt team som värdesätter samarbete och kunskapsdelning, och som välkomnar nya kollegor med olika erfarenhetsnivåer. Om AFRY AFRY är ett internationellt teknikkonsultbolag och är rankat som en av Sveriges mest populära arbetsgivare bland ingenjörer. AFRY har över 19 000 medarbetare och kontor i 50 länder. De är experter inom inom områdena infrastruktur, industri och energi. De arbetar över hela världen för att skapa hållbara lösningar för kommande generationer där de har en uttalad strategi inom just hållbarhet och transformativa segment. Om Framtiden Framtiden är ett rekryterings- och bemanningsföretag med kontor på åtta orter i Sverige. Vi finns för att fler ska älska måndagar! Inom Tech People är vi experter på ingenjörer, med roller för både juniora och seniora profiler inom IT och teknik. Inom Business People är vi experter på ekonomer på alla erfarenhetsnivåer, från specialister, chefer och interimsledare till juniora talanger inom ekonomi/finans, HR, lön och administration. Vår rekrytering bygger på evidensbaserade metoder för en rättvis och träffsäker matchning. Vi gör skillnad genom att hjälpa människor att hitta rätt jobb och rätt kollega. I denna tjänst påbörjar du din resa som anställd hos Framtiden, vilket innebär att du får fullt stöd och resurser från vårt team. Sedan har du möjlighet att gå över och bli anställd direkt hos AFRY. Rekryteringsprocessen : CV-granskning → telefonavstämning → kompetensbaserad intervju → referenstagning → slutintervjuer Villkor Start: mars 2027 · Heltid, vardagar · Placeringsort: Piteå/Umeå Vi arbetar löpande med urval, och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum – vänta inte! Skicka in din ansökan redan idag. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

title: Manufacturing Engineer – Mechanical Tooling & Equipment
description: Location: Gothenburg, Sweden Aurora Engineering is looking for an experienced Manufacturing Engineer for an assignment within Manufacturing Engineering at Volvo Cars, supporting the industrialisation of advanced high-voltage battery assembly systems for electric vehicles. You will lead the mechanical development and verification of automated production equipment, tooling, fixtures, nests, grippers and handling solutions. The focus is on robust mechanical design, equipment interfaces, supplier delivery and production readiness. Your Responsibilities Develop and review mechanical concepts for production stations, tooling, fixtures, nests, grippers and handling devices. Translate process, product, geometry, safety, maintainability and cycle-time needs into technical equipment requirements. Review supplier layouts, 3D concepts, detailed designs, calculations, engineering drawings and interface definitions. Ensure equipment provides safe access, ergonomics, serviceability, efficient changeovers, error-proofing and an appropriate replacement-parts strategy. Coordinate mechanical interfaces with automation, robotics, controls, utilities, process equipment and facilities. Support RFQs, supplier selection, design reviews, manufacturing follow-up, equipment buy-off, installation and commissioning. Drive mechanical risk assessments, tolerance reviews and technical issue resolution. Support equipment acceptance and handover, documenting deviations and outstanding actions. You will work closely with manufacturing, process, product, automation and quality teams, as well as equipment suppliers. Your background 5+ years developing automated production equipment and tooling. 5+ years reviewing mechanical designs using 3D CAD and engineering drawings. 3+ years working with equipment suppliers from concept through commissioning. 3+ years working with machine safety, maintainability, ergonomics and tolerance engineering. 3+ years in high-volume automated manufacturing industrialisation. A bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant engineering discipline, or equivalent demonstrated professional experience. You bring senior-level industrialisation experience from automotive, battery manufacturing, electrification or comparable high-volume automated production. You can work independently, take ownership of technical deliverables and collaborate effectively with engineering teams and suppliers. Additional Advantages Experience with high-voltage battery assembly equipment. Experience with precision handling, joining fixtures, grippers, conveyors or pallet systems. Familiarity with CATIA, Teamcenter or equivalent CAD/PLM tools. Knowledge of CE conformity, machinery risk assessments and equipment acceptance. Key deliverables Approved tooling and mechanical equipment concepts. Mechanical requirements and interface specifications. Documented supplier design reviews and action tracking. Mechanical risk assessments and mitigation plans. Equipment buy-off, installation and commissioning documentation. Equipment acceptance and handover packages. Application Apply through our careers site with your CV in English .

title: Mechanical Design Engineer - Life Science
description: Company Description TTP is an employee-owned technology and product development consultancy, with a 40-year track record of helping ambitious clients solve complex technical challenges and bring innovative, commercially successful solutions to market. We invent, design, and manufacture impactful products and technologies across a wide range of industries – including healthcare, life science, energy, and communications – and at the intersection of biology, physical science and engineering. Our working culture encourages entrepreneurship, shared ideas and technical collaboration, while providing you with the freedom to do your best work. Job Description We’re looking for a talented Mechanical Design Engineer to join our Molecular Synthesis & Omics team (part of a larger Life Science department) and help tackle some of the challenging engineering problems at the interface of biology, chemistry and technology. The interdisciplinary team develops innovative technologies and products for genomics, molecular synthesis and life-science research. We work with leading biotechnology companies and research organisations to turn emerging scientific ideas into practical, robust and scalable products — from novel microfluidic consumables and molecular processing systems to complex automated laboratory instruments. Projects span areas such as next-generation DNA synthesis, sequencing sample preparation, precision liquid handling, automated molecular workflows and novel biological measurement technologies. Your work as a Mechanical Design Engineer will be varied, technically demanding and often involves developing solutions that don't yet exist. You'll work closely with molecular biologists, chemists, physicists and engineers in both our MS&O and the broader Life Science team, contributing mechanical design expertise from early concept generation through detailed design, prototyping, testing and product development. You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of mechanical design challenges, develop creative solutions and see your ideas become working prototypes and ultimately commercial products. If you are an experienced mechanical designer who enjoys hands-on engineering, thrives on solving unfamiliar problems and wants to apply their skills to technologies that could shape the future of life sciences, we’d love to hear from you. Qualifications You'll be an experienced Mechanical Design Engineer with excellent design capabilities, a wider understanding of the electromechanical considerations of product development and an innovative approach to problem solving. This role will be a full-time, on site position. Essential Experience And Skills Strong experience in mechanical design and development of complex products or instruments. Excellent 3D CAD skills, ideally including SolidWorks (and ideally familiarity with Onshape). Good understanding of mechanical and electromechanical system design. Experience taking designs from initial concepts through detailed engineering, prototyping and testing. Knowledge of manufacturing processes, materials and design for manufacture. Ability to perform tolerance analysis and develop robust mechanical assemblies. Strong practical engineering skills, including building, testing and troubleshooting prototypes. Ability to communicate technical ideas clearly through CAD models, sketches, prototypes and design reviews. Experience working collaboratively with engineers and scientists from different disciplines. Ability to manage competing priorities and take ownership of design deliverables. Desirable experience Design of precision motion systems, positioning mechanisms or automated instrumentation. Experience with microfluidics, liquid handling, laboratory automation or life-science instruments. Design of plastic injection-moulded parts and single-use consumables. Experience designing assembly jigs, fixtures and test equipment. Experience of structured concept-generation techniques and engineering risk assessments, including dFMEA and pFMEA. Experience sourcing custom components and working with specialist manufacturing suppliers. Experience using rapid prototyping, visualisation and rendering tools to communicate and evaluate design concepts. Additional Information Benefits TTP is an employee-owned business, based at TTP Campus in Melbourn, just 10 miles south of Cambridge. Our purpose-built, sustainable offices and laboratories are set in green surroundings, creating an inspiring environment for innovation. Our working culture encourages entrepreneurship, shared ideas and technical collaboration, while providing you with the freedom to do your best work. Our employee benefits include: Annual profit-related bonus 25 days holiday Employer pension contribution of 10% of salary Free, nutritious lunch in our on-site restaurant Private medical insurance for employees and dependants Enhanced family friendly leave Life insurance worth 6x salary Electric car leasing scheme Cycle to work scheme Season ticket loan An activities and community fund that supports healthy activities that bring colleagues together; whether it’s lunchtime squash or football, Zumba or our own rock band. Local sports facilities and theatre discounts and memberships Please click the following link to read the TTP Group Diversity Statement.

title: Mechanical Design Engineer (All Genders)
description: At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments. We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions. WHY JOIN US The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty. You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms. We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing. About The Team You will join an agile, multidisciplinary engineering team dedicated to bringing next-generation autonomous flight systems from concept to operational deployment. Working at the intersection of design engineering and manufacturing, our team collaborates daily with Stress, Systems, and Flight Test specialists to iterate at rapid pace. In this environment, you will bridge the gap between digital modeling and the factory floor, ensuring our platforms transition smoothly from initial prototypes into high-rate production. YOUR MISSION As a Mechanical Design Engineer at STARK, you will serve as a key contributor to the mechanical architecture of our next-generation UAV platforms. You will take critical subsystems from initial concept through to high-rate production, working closely with our manufacturing facilities to ensure our airframes are robust, cost-effective, and mission-ready. What You Will Do At Stark Own the mechanical design of major assemblies and payload integrations across current and future UAV platforms. Optimise designs for high-rate production to scale platforms seamlessly from prototype to hundreds of units without quality degradation. Apply advanced parametric modeling, GD&T, and tolerance stack-up analysis to ensure first-time-right assembly on the factory floor. Drive material selection, structural layouts, and manufacturing processes with an emphasis on composites, additive manufacturing, and machining. Collaborate with Stress, Flight Test, and Systems teams to validate structural integrity and support successful flight trials. Execute hands-on rapid prototyping, CAD iterations, and shop-floor troubleshooting to solve manufacturing bottlenecks at pace. What You Bring To The Mission Professional experience in mechanical design within aerospace, UAVs, automotive, light aircraft, or autonomous systems. Proven track record of taking structural parts and assemblies from initial sketch through verification and into full production. High proficiency in SolidWorks for complex 3D parametric modeling and drafting. Strong working knowledge of manufacturing processes, including composites, 3D printing, CNC machining, and injection moulding. Clear technical communication skills with the ability to articulate trade-offs to engineering peers and programme leadership. Eligibility for UK Security Clearance (SC). NICE TO HAVE Experience using CATIA for advanced surface modeling or aerospace assemblies. Familiarity with MIL standards and military/civil aerospace certification pathways. Armed Forces Commitment We are proud to hold the Bronze Award from the Defence Employer Recognition Scheme (ERS) , reflecting our meaningful commitment and ongoing support for UK defence personnel. At our core, we believe in championing those who serve, those who have served, and their families. As part of this scheme, we are dedicated to providing an inclusive, supportive environment where members of the Armed Forces community can thrive and bring their invaluable skills to our team. If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English . We're looking forward to meeting you! SECURITY CLEARANCE Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. title: Engineering Criticality Assessment Engineer
description: Contribute to the safe and reliable installation of offshore pipelines by defining acceptable weld flaw sizes and advancing weld integrity assessment methods. Allseas is a world-leading contractor in the offshore energy market. Our specialised vessels and advanced systems enable us to perform complex projects in some of the world’s most challenging offshore environments.For our Pipeline Production Department in Delft, we are looking for an Engineering Criticality Assessment Engineer, or ECA Engineer. The position is open to both early-career engineers and experienced specialists. Your role As ECA Engineer, you assess the structural integrity of pipeline girth welds for offshore installation projects. Using specialist ECA software and 3D modelling techniques, you calculate weld flaw acceptance criteria in line with international standards. You work with internal engineering teams and external parties to gather pipeline design, installation and material data. Based on this information, you define testing programmes for girth welds and pipeline materials. You also contribute to the development of welding techniques and improved weld integrity assessment methods through in-house studies and cooperation with external organisations. Your Responsibilities Perform Engineering Criticality Assessments for offshore pipeline installation projects; Calculate girth weld flaw acceptance criteria; Apply fracture mechanics principles and relevant international standards; Evaluate pipeline installation, post-lay design and material data; Define testing programmes for girth welds and linepipe materials; Translate assessment results into clear technical reports and recommendations; Coordinate technical requirements with internal and external stakeholders; Contribute to welding development and weld integrity research. What we expect from you Bsc or Msc in a relevant technical field Knowledge of welding metallurgy and fracture mechanics; Strong analytical skills and a practical approach; An accurate and structured way of working; Good communication skills and a customer-focused mindset; Fluency in written and spoken English; The ability to work independently and within a multidisciplinary team. Experience in Engineering Criticality Assessments, pipeline engineering, welding engineering, material testing or integrity assessment is an advantage. Motivated graduates with a relevant technical background are also encouraged to apply. What we Offer Working at Allseas means joining an entrepreneurial organisation where technical innovation, collaboration and a down-to-earth culture are central. You Can Expect A competitive, industry-benchmarked salary and pension; Performance-based salary increases and bonuses; 30 holiday days and flexible working hours; Training, development opportunities, study budgets and coaching; A company-sponsored fitness scheme; Internal clubs, social activities and sporting events. Interested? Would you like to apply your knowledge of welding metallurgy and fracture mechanics to challenging offshore pipeline projects? Apply via the Apply button and submit your CV and motivation letter. An online personality questionnaire may form part of the selection procedure.

title: R&D Engineer

Als R&D Engineer bij Royal SMIT Transformers werk je nauw samen met je collega's binnen het R&D-team, teamleiders en belanghebbenden op alle niveaus en binnen alle afdelingen van onze organisatie. Daarnaast werk je samen met de R&D-afdelingen van andere bedrijfsonderdelen binnen de SGB-SMIT Group, internationale experts in werkgroepen en commissies, en externe partijen, zoals universiteiten in binnen- en buitenland. Je werkt voornamelijk projectmatig en ondersteunt andere afdelingen wanneer specifieke R&D-kennis nodig is. Daarnaast behoren de volgende werkzaamheden tot jouw verantwoordelijkheden: Ontwikkelen en verbeteren van rekenmodellen en ontwerpmethoden voor de diëlektrische prestaties van vermogenstransformatoren. Onderzoeken en optimaliseren van isolatiesystemen en -materialen om de betrouwbaarheid en prestaties te verbeteren. Ontwerpen en uitvoeren van experimenten om simulatiemodellen en voorgestelde technische oplossingen te valideren. Analyseren van meetgegevens en ondersteunen van de afdelingen Engineering en Testing bij complexe diëlektrische onderzoeken. Vertalen van onderzoeksresultaten naar praktische ontwerpregels, engineeringtools en aanbevelingen voor de productie. Uitvoeren van onderzoeksprojecten in samenwerking met collega's binnen de SGB-SMIT Group, universiteiten, externe laboratoria en leveranciers. Wat breng je mee? Een afgeronde masteropleiding (MSc) in Elektrotechniek, Hoogspanningstechniek of een vergelijkbare richting. Een promotie (PhD) binnen een relevant vakgebied is een pré. Aantoonbare ervaring met het analyseren en modelleren van het diëlektrische gedrag van isolatiematerialen is een pré. Ervaring met het analyseren en ontwikkelen van (productie)processen en producten. Kennis van en ervaring met FEM-software, MATLAB en andere relevante technische software, met name voor het modelleren van elektrische velden en diëlektrische eigenschappen. Uitstekende probleemoplossende vaardigheden en een sterk analytisch denkvermogen. Goede mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatieve vaardigheden in professioneel Engels. Kennis van het Nederlands, Duits of Frans is een pré. Wat bieden wij? Wij bieden je een uitdagende functie binnen het R&D-team van een internationale organisatie die zich inzet voor duurzaamheid en innovatie. Je krijgt de kans om te werken aan projecten die van groot belang zijn voor zowel onze organisatie als de maatschappij. Een pensioenregeling via PME. Een reiskostenvergoeding. Een bonusregeling op basis van bedrijfsdoelstellingen. Fiscale voordelen via ons FiscFree-programma. Deelname aan ons fietsstimuleringsprogramma (Trappers), waarmee je beloningen kunt verdienen door vaker de fiets te pakken. Werken bij Royal SMIT Bij Royal SMIT stap je in de wereld van de toekomst, waarin vermogenstransformatoren centraal staan. Onze moderne productielocatie in Nijmegen is een toonbeeld van innovatie en kwaliteit. Wij dragen wereldwijd bij aan de opwekking en distributie van elektrische energie. Vanuit deze afdeling werken we nauw samen met en ondersteunen we de afdeling Engineering, waar ongeveer 80 engineers, verdeeld over zes disciplines, zich dagelijks inzetten voor het ontwerpen van hoogwaardige transformatoren. Door technische expertise te combineren met innovatief denken, verbeteren we voortdurend onze ontwerpmethoden, optimaliseren we de prestaties van onze transformatoren en ondersteunen we Engineering bij het ontwikkelen van betrouwbare, efficiënte en toekomstbestendige oplossingen. Op zoek naar een nieuwe uitdaging? Bij ons draait alles om mensen. Met fijne collega's en een prettige werkomgeving ga je elke dag met plezier naar je werk. title: Mechanical engineering- Research department
description: Introduction to the job ASML is relentlessly driving the semiconductor industry’s ongoing quest for producing faster, smarter and more energy-efficient chips. We are a young, dynamic, international and highly skilled workforce creating, with strong support of our suppliers, the lithographic tools the industry needs to achieve its goals. Are you passionate about enabling breakthrough research through the development of advanced laboratory capabilities and experimental infrastructure? Then you will enjoy this position in the Testbench and System Design group at ASML Research. You will be part of a multidisciplinary team responsible for developing and maintaining the experimental environments, laboratory capabilities, and technical infrastructure that enable research projects for the next generation of ASML’s lithography and metrology products. In this role, you will combine technical leadership, practical skills, and design engineering to accelerate research and technology development across ASML and external partners. Role and responsibilities As a Research Engineer within the Testbench and System Design group, you will be involved in designing and realizing advanced laboratory setups that support cutting-edge research activities. You will use your practical skills to help researchers translate new ideas into experimental environments, helping to build the evidence to make breakthrough advances in technology. You will work in the highly multidisciplinary environment of Research, including collaboration with relevant D&E stakeholders and external suppliers. Many Research projects involve completely new technology and a mindset of curiosity and exploration is essential. The job consists of: Working with the project team, use agreed specifications to create designs and drawings for components or modules, including realization and qualification of your designs and de-risking. Using a pragmatic ability to translate concepts into designs for new setups or experiments, interacting with other engineering disciplines in Research and D&E. Manage technical uncertainties and risks for setups and tools. Participate in running experiments, and be able to assist in troubleshooting of unexpected laboratory results. Coordinate internal and external farm-out activities at technical level. Build and maintain a network with suppliers. Contribute to standardization of modular laboratory tooling and measurement capabilities across research projects. Education and experience Bachelor or equivalent degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related technical field. Experienced in 3D CAD modeling (preferably UG/NX) Dedicated knowledge of precision engineering, opto-mechanics, constraint design Experience working in multidisciplinary R&D environments preferably on complex engineering challenges with limited supervision Experience with FEM or holding a NAFEMS Certificate or experience with the Simcenter (Pre/Post) would be an advantage. Skills Working at the cutting edge of technology, you will continuously face new challenges and opportunities. You will collaborate with experts from a wide range of disciplines and play a key role in shaping the experimental capabilities required for future technology breakthroughs. To thrive in this job, you will need the following skills: Good technical skills and the ability to work independently on designs. Practical problem-solving capabilities with an out-of-the-box mindset. Ability to translate research needs into practical laboratory and infrastructure solutions. Good communication skills and ability to influence decision-making across organizational boundaries. Flexible, committed, and self-propelling. Other information This position is available in the Testbench and System Design group, within the Research Metrology department of ASML. At Research, we aim to identify and fill the technological gaps within ASML, extending roadmaps of the lithography and metrology market. We work in small, diverse, and multidisciplinary teams of approximately 5 to 15 persons and deliver proofs-of-concepts and fundamental understanding that can be transferred within the company. We intensively collaborate with external research institutes, universities, and industrial partners. ASML Research offers an informal and innovative work atmosphere, opportunities for personal development, and a promising position from which to grow into other technical and leadership roles within ASML. This position requires access to controlled technology, as defined in the United States Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R. 730, et seq.). Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to access such controlled technology prior to beginning work. Business demands may require ASML to proceed with candidates who are immediately eligible to access controlled technology. Inclusion and diversity ASML is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values and respects the importance of a diverse and inclusive workforce. It is the policy of the company to recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We recognize that inclusion and diversity is a driving force in the success of our company. Need to know more about applying for a job at ASML? Read our frequently asked questions.

Our people enjoy solving interesting technical challenges in a culture where everyone trusts each other to do the right thing. For you, working with us can mean deeper job satisfaction, better rewards, and a great quality of life inside and outside of work. Job Title Manufacturing Engineer – CNC Machining Reporting To Manufacturing Engineering Manager Work Schedule Onsite – Tewkesbury, GBR Applications are welcomed from candidates across the UK. Support may be available for candidates required to relocate closer to the Tewkesbury area, subject to business approval. Due to continued growth across our Commercial Aircraft Group, Moog is expanding its Manufacturing Engineering team. Moog Commercial Aircraft Group Tewkesbury is seeking a Manufacturing Engineer to support the development and optimisation of manufacturing processes for complex aerospace components across a range of materials. This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer with machining and CAD/CAM experience who is looking to further develop their career within a highly regulated aerospace environment. We welcome applications from candidates with experience using a range of CAD/CAM platforms. Training on Siemens NX can be provided for the right candidate. As Manufacturing Engineer, You Will Develop and implement lean manufacturing processes focused on quality, cost and delivery. Create machining processes for complex components with tight tolerances using CAD/CAM software. Select cutting tools, design fixtures and produce shop documentation. Support New Product Introduction (NPI) activities, including Design for Manufacture (DfM) reviews. Lead and support process improvement projects, ensuring minimal downtime within the machine shop. Review engineering drawings for manufacturability and recommend design changes to enhance productivity and standardisation. Provide technical support to internal stakeholders and manufacturing operations. Collaborate with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain and Operations teams to achieve business objectives. To be considered for this role, here's what you'll typically bring with you: Experience in manufacturing or process engineering within a precision machining environment 5 Axis Milling and/or Millturn Background CAD/CAM programming experience using Siemens NX, CATIA, Mastercam, Edgecam, FeatureCAM, PartMaker or similar systems. Strong understanding of CNC machining processes. Knowledge of lean manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies. Analytical problem-solving skills with the ability to deliver practical solutions. Strong communication and collaboration skills. It's Preferred If You Bring Degree, HNC or HND in Mechanical, Production or Manufacturing Engineering (or equivalent). Aerospace, Automotive, defence, medical or other highly regulated manufacturing experience. PFMEA experience. Siemens NX experience. 5 Axis Milling (Okuma MU4000V or equivalent) and Mill turn (Mazak I100, I200 or DMG NTX 1000) Knowledge of GD&T principles. Exposure to advanced manufacturing processes. How We Care For You Flexible benefits package and development opportunities to support career progression. Training and development opportunities, including Siemens NX training where appropriate. 33 days annual leave (including bank holidays). Private medical insurance, mental health support and financial advice. Generous life assurance and company pension contribution (from 6%). Employee share options. Free onsite parking, EV charging and gym facilities. We review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the vacancy once a suitable candidate has been identified. We aim to create a culture where everyone is valued, respected, and given equal opportunities. We strive to empower employees to bring their authentic selves to work, celebrating our differences to foster a welcoming environment for all. You’ll be empowered to reach your full potential through managing your own personalised development plan and access to our learning and development programs. In this role, you won’t just maintain the status quo—you will optimize products, validate cutting-edge equipment, mentor peers, and serve as the lead technical expert for complex manufacturing programs. What You’ll Do Design & Optimize: Develop cost-effective, robust manufacturing solutions and new product designs that consistently meet customer specifications and quality benchmarks. Product & Equipment Ownership: Oversee equipment, conduct validations, and lead product verification testing using specialized lab and measurement tools. Continuous Improvement: Leverage data-driven insights and Statistical Product Control (SPC) to identify bottlenecks, reduce waste, and increase yields. Technical Collaboration: Act as the primary technical point of contact across cross-functional teams, translating complex product requirements into seamless shop-floor execution. Documentation & Compliance: Create thorough product documentation, specifications, and change management records that adhere to strict quality standards. Knowledge Sharing: Build your own area of technical specialization while mentoring junior team members. What You Bring Education & Experience: HNC or Bachelors Degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline, paired with hands-on manufacturing or Manufacturing Engineering experience (an equivalent mix of education and experience will be considered). Analytical Mindset: Proven background in data analysis, root-cause troubleshooting, structured design, and statistical analysis. Strong understanding of customer data pack analysis (Assembly drawings, Bills of Materials, supporting documents) and FMEA creation and maintenance. Hands-on Tooling Knowledge: Familiarity with hand tools, manufacturing equipment, and precision measurement instruments. Communication & Teamwork: Strong verbal and written communication skills with the confidence to collaborate directly with customers and production teams alike. Self-Starter Drive: Ability to take ownership of assigned product phases and run with projects independently. Why Join Us? Meaningful Impact: Play a pivotal role in taking advanced products from blueprint to finished reality. Career Growth: Expand your technical depth with opportunities to specialize and lead within a collaborative engineering culture. Balanced Schedule: Standard operational focus with no routine travel requirements. Your Rewards and Wellbeing We believe in rewarding your contribution with a comprehensive package designed to support your life both inside and outside of work. Growth: Bespoke development plans and volunteer time off Health: Private medical insurance, Employee Assistance Program and vision care Wealth: Enhanced pension contributions, life assurance, and group income protection Lifestyle: Electric Vehicle and Cycle to Work schemes, plus 33 days of annual leave Application Process At Plexus, we don't look for culture fit, we look for culture add. We value the unique perspectives you bring and review every candidate holistically, balancing professional experience, education and individual journey. Accessibility and Accommodations As a Disability Confident employer, we recruit purely on the basis of skills and merit, ensuring an equitable process for everyone. title: Manufacturing Process Engineer
description: About OLIX AI is growing faster than any technology in history and the explosion in demand has created a massive infrastructure gap; we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The industry is still leaning on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. A new paradigm that is faster and more efficient will be the biggest economic opportunity of the next century and create the most important company of the next decade. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect enables a step change in system level performance. The Role As a Manufacturing Process Engineer at OLIX, you will be responsible for turning our optical interconnect technology for co-packaged optics (CPO) into scalable, manufacturable, and reliable hardware. You will work closely with our development team in London to establish high-throughput, high-yield manufacturing processes, then transfer those processes to our manufacturing partners and support them through ramp. This is a hands-on, high-impact role. The lines you build are how our optical interconnect reaches production. The role involves extensive travel (up to 50% of the time), including to our manufacturing partner sites. Responsibilities Establish and qualify robust, high-throughput, high-yield manufacturing lines for our optical interconnect technology Work with our manufacturing partners to establish high throughput, high yielding manufacturing lines and support those partners through qualification and volume ramp Specify, commission and qualify production equipment Develop new and improved manufacturing processes, and drive continuous improvement in throughput and yield Improve process capability through statistical process control Represent OLIX to the management, engineering and production teams at our manufacturing partners Collaborate across R&D, Process Engineering, Equipment Engineering, Characterisation & Test and Production, within OLIX and at our partners, to hit project milestones Contribute to strategic IP development and patents Ensure compliance with site and factory protocols and safety regulations Skills & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Materials Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry or a related field Experience with process development in high-volume, high-technology manufacturing (e.g. semiconductors, electronics or display technologies), including New Product Introduction (NPI) and scaling to volume Experience working in controlled or cleanroom environments Proven track record of designing DoEs and executing structured experiments Experience applying statistical process control, yield improvement and throughput optimisation in production Ability to interpret complex experimental data, troubleshoot process issues and drive systematic improvements Excellent teamwork, documentation and communication skills Nice to Have Experience transferring processes to contract manufacturers or foundries Failure analysis experience Patent or IP contributions Compensation & Equity Competitive Salary: Commensurate with your experience, skills, and location Equity & Ownership: Meaningful stock options. You’re not just joining the mission; you’re owning a piece of it Proximity Bonus: We value your time. To minimise your commute and maximise your life, we offer an annual Living-Local Bonus if your residence is within 20 minutes of the office Retirement Benefits: Employer-contributed retirement plans to help you build long-term financial security Due to U.S. export control regulations, candidates’ eligibility to work at OLIX depends on their most recent citizenship or permanent residency status. We are generally unable to consider applicants whose most recent citizenship or permanent residence is in certain restricted countries (currently including Iran, North Korea, Syria, Cuba, Russia, Belarus, China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Venezuela). Applicants who have subsequently obtained citizenship or permanent residency in another country not subject to these restrictions may still be eligible. We do not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies, will not be liable for any fees, and prohibit unauthorised use of our company name in recruitment activities.

Starke Fähigkeiten zur Problemlösung.Hinweis:Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind.Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden.Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern.Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern. title: Junior Mechanical Engineer
description: Pozzuoli (Naples), Italy | Full-time | Primarily on-site Role Overview Join TSD-Space to design, integrate, and test precision mechanical components and assemblies for high-reliability electronic systems used in space missions. Working closely with experienced colleagues, you will contribute to the full mechanical hardware development lifecycle, from 3D CAD design and manufacturing documentation to supplier coordination, hands-on assembly, inspection, and testing. Who We Are Techno System Developments (TSD-Space) is an Italian aerospace electronics company specializing in the design, development, and manufacturing of high-reliability onboard and ground electronic systems. With flight heritage dating back to 1993, TSD-Space has contributed to over 50 space missions and accumulated more than 500,000 hours of flight operations. Today, our hardware is on eight currently operating space systems, spanning Earth-orbiting satellites, deep-space spacecraft and orbiters, and the International Space Station. Our expertise spans the complete payload data chain, from imaging and data acquisition to handling, compression, storage and onboard processing, together with spacecraft avionics and ground support equipment. We develop solutions for a broad range of applications, including Earth Observation, in-orbit servicing, navigation and inspection, and deep-space exploration. What You'll Do Mechanical design: Develop 3D CAD models of mechanical parts and assemblies, and prepare 2D manufacturing drawings with appropriate dimensions and tolerances. Manufacturing support: Prepare production documentation, support manufacturing activities, and coordinate technical matters with external suppliers. Assembly and integration: Assemble mechanical components and subassemblies, supporting the integration of electronic equipment. Prototype work: Perform light workshop operations, including drilling, tapping, minor milling, and threaded insert installation. Inspection and quality control: Verify manufactured parts against technical drawings and specifications, including dimensional inspections using measurement instruments. Testing and troubleshooting: Support mechanical, functional, and environmental tests, investigate issues, and contribute to corrective actions. Engineering support: Assist with structural and thermal analyses, and prepare technical documentation covering analysis, design, integration, and test activities. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related engineering field. Solid understanding of mechanical design principles, engineering drawings, dimensional tolerances, and manufacturing requirements. Ability to develop 3D CAD models and produce accurate 2D technical drawings. Basic knowledge of mechanical materials, manufacturing processes, and measurement instruments. Practical aptitude and attention to detail when working with precision components and laboratory equipment. Ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams while taking responsibility for assigned tasks. Full professional fluency in Italian and English proficiency at B2 level or above (CEFR). Nice to Have Experience with SolidWorks or comparable parametric CAD software. Practical experience in mechanical assembly, prototyping, or workshop operations. Familiarity with dimensional inspection and quality control of manufactured components. Knowledge of structural or thermal analyses, including finite element analysis (FEA). Previous experience with high-reliability electronic equipment, aerospace hardware, or environmental testing. We welcome candidates who are eager to develop their skills through hands-on work and close collaboration with experienced engineers and technicians. Why Join TSD-Space At TSD-Space, you'll play an active role in demanding space missions, from Earth orbit to deep-space exploration, working side by side with experienced engineers and technicians to turn innovative designs into flight-ready hardware. Our focused, multidisciplinary teams give you the opportunity to: Experience the full development lifecycle: Gain exposure to projects from customer requirements and system design through manufacturing, integration, testing, and delivery. Grow through responsibility: Take on meaningful technical ownership early, with opportunities for career progression that reflect your contributions and increasing responsibilities. Engage with international stakeholders: Work on projects involving leading space agencies, international customers, and industrial partners, with opportunities for direct technical interaction. Keep growing: Develop well-rounded expertise in your field through hands-on engineering and exposure to a broad range of technical challenges. What We Offer Permanent employment: An open-ended employment contract under the applicable Italian National Collective Bargaining Agreement (CCNL Terziario). Competitive compensation: A competitive salary with a 14-month pay structure and an annual bonus based on individual and company performance. Flexible working arrangements: We value in-person collaboration, particularly for hands-on engineering activities, while offering flexible working hours and remote work arrangements depending on role requirements and project needs. Recruitment Process Our selection process typically includes two online interviews, one introductory and one technical, followed by a practical assessment, usually conducted on-site. The process may vary depending on the role. Apply Today Ready to contribute to the next generation of space systems? Apply directly through LinkedIn or send your CV to recruiting@tsd-space.it TSD-Space is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and inclusion, reject all forms of discrimination, and are committed to treating every candidate with fairness and respect. Applications are welcome from all qualified candidates, in accordance with applicable law.

EngineerHub programı, 2026 Kasım - 2027 Haziran tarihleri arasında Kapsül Teknoloji Platformu içinde bulunan Aselsan Konya Laboratuvarı'nda gerçekleştirilecek. Başvurunu yaparken program süresince Konya’da bulunman gerektiğini unutma. Başvuru Yapabileceğiniz Projeler; Silah Geliştirme Projesi Elektro Kimyasal Yöntem ile Namlu Yiv-Set İmalatı Yazılım Tasarım Projesi Uzaktan Komutalı Silah Sistemleri için Yapay Zekâ Destekli Görüntü İşleme ve Yapay Zekâ Sistem Uygulamaları Elektromekanik Sistem Tasarımı Projesi Pan – Tilt Bu programın temel amacı, genç mühendislere savunma sanayi alanını tanıtmak ve ihtiyaç duyulan temel seviyede teknik & davranışsal yetkinlikleri kazandırmaktır. EngineerHub programı neler sunuyor? Yetenek Geliştirme ve Mentorluk: Program kapsamında, Aselsan Konya'nın deneyimli mühendisleriyle bir araya gelerek mentorluk desteği alacak ve kendini geliştirme fırsatı bulacaksın. İş Hayatına Hazırlık: EngineerHub programı Savunma Sanayi ve iş hayatına yönelik temel becerileri kazandırmayı hedefliyor. CV hazırlama ve mülakat teknikleri gibi farklı konulardaki eğitimler, ilk profesyonel adımları atmana yardımcı olacak. Network Geliştirme & Deneyim Paylaşımı: Program süresince düzenlenecek etkinliklerde sektör profesyonelleriyle tanışma ve deneyimlerinden faydalanma imkanı bulacaksın. Güncel gelişmeleri ve pratik bilgileri işin uzmanlarından öğrenerek kariyerine bir adım önde başlayacaksın. Genç Mühendislerin Potansiyelini Ortaya Çıkarma: Farklı bakış açıları, yenilikçi düşünce ve projelerle senin ve genç mühendislerin potansiyelini açığa çıkartmak ve savunma sanayisine değer katmak için buradayız. Kapsül Teknoloji Platformunu Kullanabilme İmkanı: Kapsül Teknoloji Platformu içerisinde yer alan Aselsan Konya laboratuvarını kimlik kartınla istediğin zaman kullanabilme imkanı. #GelecekŞimdiBaşlıyor Kimler Başvurabilir? Gelecekte Savunma Sanayi sektöründe kariyer yapmayı hedefleyen, (Programa aktif katılım gerektiği için) Konya’da bulunan Üniversitelerin Bilgisayar, Yazılım, Elektrik-Elektronik, Mekatronik ve Makine Mühendisliği bölümlerinde Yüksek Lisans veya 4. sınıf lisans öğrencisi olan, Program süresi boyunca Konya lokasyonunda bulunacak öğrenciler başvurabilir. Başvurunu heyecanla bekliyoruz! :)

title: PROJE VE ÜRETİM MÜHENDİSİ
description: PROJE VE ÜRETİM MÜHENDİSİ Firma: ON TRAILER Çalışma Yeri: Ankara / Başkent Organize Sanayi Bölgesi Çalışma Şekli: Tam Zamanlı – Fabrika / Ofis Pozisyon: Proje ve Üretim Mühendisi İş Tanımı Ankara Başkent Organize Sanayi Bölgesi'nde faaliyet gösteren, araç üstü ekipman, özel amaçlı mobil araç ve üstyapı sistemlerinin tasarım ve üretimini gerçekleştiren firmamız bünyesinde görevlendirilmek üzere; proje tasarımı, teknik çizim, üretim planlama ve üretim takibi süreçlerinde aktif rol alabilecek, en az 3 yıl deneyimli Proje ve Üretim Mühendisi arıyoruz. Adayın, projelerin teknik şartname aşamasından tasarım ve üretim süreçlerinin tamamlanmasına kadar olan çalışmaları takip edebilmesi beklenmektedir. Görev ve Sorumluluklar Proje ve Tasarım Süreçleri SolidWorks ve AutoCAD programlarını kullanarak 2D ve 3D teknik çizimler hazırlamak. Araç üstyapı sistemleri ve özel amaçlı mobil araç projelerinin tasarım çalışmalarını yürütmek. Üretime esas teknik resimleri, montaj çizimlerini ve imalat detaylarını hazırlamak. Teknik şartnameleri incelemek, şartname gerekliliklerine uygun proje ve tasarımlar oluşturmak. Projelere ait malzeme listelerini (BOM) ve teknik dokümantasyonları hazırlamak. Proje kapsamında ihtiyaç duyulan teknik hesaplamaları ve uygunluk kontrollerini gerçekleştirmek. Proje revizyonlarını yönetmek ve güncel teknik dokümanların üretime aktarılmasını sağlamak. Üretim ve İmalat Süreçleri Fabrika içerisindeki imalat ve montaj faaliyetlerinin teknik resimlere ve proje gerekliliklerine uygunluğunu kontrol etmek. Üretim aşamalarında ortaya çıkan teknik problemlere çözüm geliştirmek. Üretim personeliyle koordineli çalışarak işlerin planlanan takvime uygun ilerlemesini sağlamak. Proje bazında üretim ilerlemesini takip etmek ve yönetime düzenli durum raporları sunmak. Malzeme ihtiyaçlarını belirlemek ve satın alma birimiyle koordinasyon sağlamak. Üretim tamamlandığında gerekli teknik kontrolleri gerçekleştirmek ve teslimat süreçlerine teknik destek vermek. Aranan Nitelikler Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği bölümünden mezun. Proje, tasarım veya üretim mühendisliği alanında en az 3 yıl mesleki deneyime sahip . SolidWorks ve AutoCAD programlarını aktif ve iyi derecede kullanabilen. Teknik resim hazırlama, okuma ve yorumlama konusunda yetkin. 3D modelleme, montaj tasarımı ve imalat detaylandırma süreçlerine hâkim. Teknik şartnameleri okuyabilen, yorumlayabilen ve şartnameye uygun proje geliştirebilen. Üretim planlama, imalat takibi ve üretim koordinasyonu konularında deneyimli. Malzeme bilgisi, temel imalat yöntemleri ve üretim süreçleri konusunda teknik bilgi sahibi. Proje dokümantasyonu, malzeme listesi ve teknik raporlama hazırlayabilen. Fabrika ortamında üretim ekipleriyle koordineli çalışabilecek. Problem çözme, planlama ve organizasyon becerileri gelişmiş. İş takibi kuvvetli, disiplinli, sorumluluk sahibi ve sonuç odaklı. Erkek adayların askerlik görevini tamamlamış olmak. Tercih Sebebi Olacak Deneyimler Aşağıdaki alanlarda proje, tasarım veya üretim tecrübesi bulunan adaylar değerlendirme sürecinde öncelikli olarak tercih edilecektir: Araç üstü ekipman ve ticari araç üstyapı projeleri. Frigorifik kasa ve soğutuculu araç üstyapı sistemleri. Mobil sağlık araçları, mobil klinikler, mobil laboratuvarlar ve özel amaçlı araç projeleri. Kapalı kasa, panelvan dönüşümü ve sandviç panel üstyapı sistemleri. Mobil yaşam alanları, özel üretim römorklar ve yarı römork projeleri. Çelik konstrüksiyon, sac metal, kompozit panel ve mekanik montaj uygulamaları. Sincan , Etimesgut, Elvankent bölgelerinde ikamet etmek Çalışma Koşulları Çalışma Yeri: Ankara / Başkent Organize Sanayi Bölgesi Çalışma Şekli: Tam zamanlı, yerinde çalışma Çalışma Saatleri: Pazartesi – Cuma, 08.00 – 18.00 Çalışma Ortamı: Proje ofisi ve fabrika üretim sahası Başvuru Araç üstü ekipman ve özel amaçlı mobil araç projelerinde tasarım ve üretim süreçlerinde sorumluluk almak isteyen, teknik bilgi ve tecrübesiyle ekibimize katkı sağlayabilecek mühendis adaylarının başvurularını bekliyoruz.

title: Welding Engineer (Brazing Processes)
description: What You Will Do Lead the development, optimization, and standardization of brazing processes used in manufacturing operations. Support New Product Introduction (NPI) activities, including process design, validation, and production transfer. Investigate production and quality issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement sustainable corrective actions. Drive projects aimed at reducing scrap, rework costs, and process losses. Collaborate with product design teams to improve the reliability and manufacturability of brazed joints. Support continuous improvement initiatives and lean manufacturing projects across the factory. How You Will Do It Analyze process performance and identify opportunities to improve quality, productivity, and cost efficiency. Apply structured problem-solving methodologies such as 8D, Root Cause Analysis, and Kaizen. Develop and maintain process documentation, PFMEA, Control Plans, and process control strategies. Deliver process training and technical support to operators and technicians. Support the evaluation, installation, and commissioning of new manufacturing equipment. Ensure compliance with EHS and quality standards throughout all process improvement activities. What We Look For Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Metallurgical & Materials Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Minimum 3 years of experience in manufacturing engineering, welding, brazing, or joining processes. Hands-on experience with brazing process development, validation, and production support. Knowledge of PFMEA, SPC, MSA, and Control Plan methodologies. Experience with structured problem-solving tools and continuous improvement practices. Strong analytical, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Good command of English.

title: Mekanik Tasarım Mühendisi
description: Biz Kimiz? 1993 yılında kurulan Rönesans Holding, bugün Türkiye, Avrupa, Orta Asya ve Afrika’yı kapsayan geniş bir coğrafyada; inşaat, gayrimenkul, enerji, endüstri ve sağlık alanlarında ana müteahhit ve yatırımcı olarak faaliyet göstermektedir. 40.000’i aşkın çalışanı ve 60’tan fazla milletten oluşan güçlü ve çok kültürlü ekibiyle Rönesans, dünyanın en büyük müteahhitlik şirketleri arasında yer almakta; sürdürülebilir bir gelecek inşa etme vizyonuyla yenilikçi ve küresel ölçekteki mühendislik projelerini hayata geçirmeye devam etmektedir. Bu Rolde Seni Neler Bekliyor? Konsept tasarım aşamasından shop drawing ve asbuilt süreci sonuna kadar mekanik tesisat sistemlerinin Revit ortamında modellenmesi ve projelendirilmesi, Havalandırma, ısıtma, soğutma, sıhhi tesisat ve yangın tesisatı sistemlerine ilişkin uygulama projelerinin hazırlanması, Projelerin ilgili standartlar, işveren şartnameleri ve saha uygulama gerekliliklerine uygun olarak geliştirilmesi, Disiplinler arası koordinasyon süreçlerine destek verilmesi ve çakışma analizlerinin gerçekleştirilmesi, Genel proje koordinasyonunu etkileyebilecek teknik konuların ilgili ekiplerle paylaşılması ve gerekli çözüm önerilerinin sunulması, Şantiye ekipleri ile koordineli çalışarak uygulama süreçlerine teknik destek verilmesi. Adaylardan Beklentilerimiz Şirketimizin Ankara’da yapımını üstlendiği Veri Merkezi Projesi’nde değerlendirilmek üzere ; Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği bölümünden mezun, Alanında en az 3 yıl deneyimli, Üç boyutlu modelleme ve Yapı Bilgi Modellemesi (BIM) süreçlerine hakim, İleri seviyede Revit, Navisworks ve AutoCAD kullanabilen, Mekanik tesisat uygulama projeleri ve shop drawing hazırlama süreçlerinde deneyimli, Teknik çizim standartlarına, ölçülendirme ve proje dokümantasyon süreçlerine hakim, Tercihen büyük ölçekli altyapı ve üstyapı projelerinde (hastane, havaalanı, endüstriyel tesis, AVM vb.) görev almış, Navisworks Clash Detection süreçlerinde deneyimli, Ekip çalışmasına yatkın, çözüm odaklı ve analitik düşünme becerisine sahip, Planlama, takip ve dokümantasyon süreç becerileri gelişmiş, İleri seviyede İngilizce bilgisine sahip, Ankara’da ikamet eden veya edebilecek, “Mekanik Tasarım Mühendisi” aramaktayız. Biz Neler Sunuyoruz? Performans ve başarıyı destekleyen prim uygulamaları Kapsamlı yan haklar ve çalışan destek uygulamaları Özel Sağlık Sigortası kapsamında çalışanlarımızı destekleyen sağlık uygulamaları Mesleki ve kişisel gelişimini destekleyen eğitim ve gelişim programları Çeşitlilik ve Eşitlik Beyanımız Rönesans Holding, şirketlere stratejilerini ve operasyonlarını evrensel insan hakları, çalışma, çevre ve yolsuzlukla mücadele ilkelerine uygun hale getirmeye ve toplumsal hedefleri ilerletecek önlemler almaya çağıran BM Küresel İlkeler Sözleşmesi'nin imzacıları arasında yer almaktadır ve Birleşmiş Milletler Küresel İlkeler Sözleşmesi çerçevesinde evrensel kabul görmüş beyanlara dayalı ilkeleri benimser. Rönesans Holding, ana ilkeleri olan dürüstlük, rekabetçilik ve yenilikçilikten ödün vermeden şeffaf ve etik değerleri gözeterek insan kaynakları uygulamalarında eşitliği sağlamayı amaçlayan bir işverendir. Tüm başvurular cinsiyet, dil, din, ırk ve etnik kökene bakmaksızın fırsat eşitliğine göre değerlendirilir ve ayırımcılık yapılmaz.

title: İşletme Mühendisi
description: Aydem Enerji’de 40 yılı aşkın bir süredir ülkemizin sürdürülebilir geleceği için çevik, yenilikçi yaklaşımımızla elektrik üretimi, dağıtımı ve perakende alanlarında “hayat için enerji” üretiyor ve sektörümüzde imza attığımız pek çok ilkle fark yaratıyoruz. İşimizi “başarı” ile yaparak ve “hayata” dokunarak kurumu “geleceğe” taşırken, enerjimizin kaynağı olan çalışma arkadaşlarımız tarafından neden “Harika Bir İş Yeri” seçildiğimizi merak ediyorsan detaylara web sitemizden ve hakkında alanından ulaşabilirsin. Sen de bu ekibin bir parçası olmak istiyorsan Aydem Yenilenebilir Enerji A.Ş. bünyesinde bulunan Rüzgar, Hidroelektrik ve Hibrit GES Santrallerimizde çalışacak “İşletme Mühendisi” pozisyonunda görevlendirilmek üzere ilanımıza başvur, bizimle birlikte “enerji için biz” de. Senden neler bekliyoruz? Üniversitelerin Elektrik, Elektrik-Elektronik veya Makina Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezun, Tercihen Enerji üretim tesislerinin işletme ve bakım süreçlerinde 2–5 yıl deneyimli; RES ve/veya GES tecrübesine sahip, Rüzgâr türbinleri, güneş panelleri, inverterler ve yardımcı sistemlerin çalışma prensipleri hakkında bilgi sahibi, OG/YG sistemleri, güç transformatörleri, şalt ekipmanları ve koruma sistemleri konusunda temel teknik bilgiye sahip, SCADA üzerinden üretim, ekipman durumu ve alarm takibi yapabilen; işletme verilerini analiz edip raporlayabilen, Planlı bakım, arıza takibi ve kök neden analizi çalışmalarına katkı sağlayabilecek, Üretim kayıpları, duruş süreleri, emreamadelik ve santral performans göstergelerinin takibi konusunda bilgi sahibi, Teknik çizimleri, tek hat şemalarını ve ekipman dokümanlarını okuyup yorumlayabilen, Yüklenici ve servis ekipleriyle saha çalışmalarını koordine edebilecek, İş sağlığı ve güvenliği kurallarını benimseyen, saha çalışmalarında güvenli çalışma kültürünü gözeten, MS Office programlarını, özellikle Excel’i etkin kullanabilen; tercihen SAP PM veya benzeri bakım yönetim sistemlerinde deneyimli, Teknik dokümanları takip edebilecek düzeyde İngilizce bilgisine sahip, Analitik düşünme ve problem çözme becerileri gelişmiş, ekip çalışmasına yatkın ve sorumluluk sahibi, B sınıfı sürücü belgesine sahip ve aktif araç kullanabilen, Santral lokasyonunda ikamet eden veya edebilecek. Temel sorumlulukların neler olacak? Kayıp zaman ve kayıp enerji değerlerinde kalıcı bir azalma sağlamak, İşletme personelinin üretimde verimliliği esas alınmasını sağlayarak, olağanüstü işletme şartlarına karşı hazırlıklı olmasını sağlamak, İşletme giderlerini belirli bir bütçe dahilinde disiplin altına almak, Dışarıdan sağlanan fayda ve hizmetleri, rekabete dayalı objektif değerlendirme yaparak temin ve tedarik etmek için gerekli desteği sağlamak ve belirli limitler dahilinde satınalma işlemlerini yapmak. İşletme raporlamalarının amaçlarına uygun bir şekilde yapılmasını sağlamak, Tüm periyodik bakım ve onarımların gerçekleştirmesini sağlamak, İşletmenin her zaman (bakım çalışmaları dışında da) emre amade tutulmasını sağlamak. Bu şekilde kayıp zamanın minimize edilmesini ve kayıp enerjinin sıfırlanmasını sağlamak, Seninle enerjimiz nasıl tutar? Hayata dokunan duyarlı bakış açınla, Sorumluluk bilincinle, Dinamik oluşunla, Yenilikçi yaklaşımınla.

title: SENIOR DATACENTER FACILITIES ENGINEER
description: Turkcell olarak yeteneklerimize eşsiz insan deneyimi yaşatarak, değer yaratan sürdürülebilir bir organizasyon inşa etmeyi ve işveren markamızı zirveye taşımayı hedefliyoruz. Bu hedef doğrultusunda benimsediğimiz değerlerimizi iş yapış biçimlerimize yansıtıyoruz. Turkcell’de Neye Değer Veriyoruz? title: Field Service Engineer
description: Job Description The Field Service Engineer is responsible for overseeing and executing the installation, maintenance, repair, and troubleshooting of Avery Dennison systems and equipment across customer locations within our apparel business segment. This role acts as a point of escalation for regular technical issues and requires a blend of technical proficiency, leadership, and customer-focused service delivery. As our "eyes and ears" in the market, you will observe and share feedback on customer needs and market trends with our internal commercial and engineering teams to drive business development. Key Responsibilities This is an on-site position based at our Istanbul site, requiring an average of 40-60% travel to customer locations. Manage the installation and system integration of Avery Dennison equipment at customer sites using provided pool cars or expensed travel. Execute troubleshooting and problem resolution for mechanical, electrical, hardware, and software systems. Perform proactive maintenance and performance optimization to ensure equipment reliability. Act as a market intelligence link by providing feedback to internal commercial and engineering teams regarding observations at customer sites. Qualifications Expert knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hardware, and software systems in the apparel industry (e.g., RFID, thermal printing, PLCs, IoT). Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Turkish and English, with the ability to simplify complex technical information. Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, capable of diagnosing issues under pressure. A minimum of 2 years in the field service industry with experience in complex systems. Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel 40-60% of the time to support customer sites. What we offer Here's a glimpse of the great benefits you can expect: Financial & Health Benefits: We offer Health insurance and various allowances, including Social, Food, Bairam, Transportation and Heating allowances, plus meal ticket. Time Off: Enjoy a minimum of 16 days of Annual Leave (increasing with seniority) and we also provide specific paid leave for life events. Continuous Development: We invest in your growth with individually set-up development plans, access to language courses, and various internal trainings. Community Engagement: Opportunities to participate in volunteer activities to support Non-Profit Organizations. Why join Avery Dennison We are a global materials science and digital identification solutions company with locations in over 50 countries, and approximately 35,000 employees worldwide. As a science and innovation company, we believe that diverse teams are stronger teams. We are committed to fostering a culture of curiosity and courage, where you can grow your career with a company that has innovation in its DNA. Founded on creating real-world impact to enable a better future, we strive to provide an open, collaborative culture where diversity of thought is encouraged and respected. Hear from our employees about what it's like working at Avery Dennison. Learn more at www.averydennison.com. At Avery Dennison, we work with the biggest brands in the Apparel Industry. Our site in Istanbul, founded in 2008, is a collaborative and dynamic environment that supports our Apparel Solutions division and employs 5 talented individuals. The main function at this site is Technical Solutions offering opportunities for growth in this field. Equal Opportunity Employer Avery Dennison is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other protected status. If you are unable to use our online application process due to a disability, please contact us to request an accommodation at Requestaccomodation@eu.averydennison.com. In the EMEA region, we foster an inclusive culture through active Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) like Elevate, Unite, and our Mental Health group. Please visit our DE&I page to learn more about our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion approach.

description: Description The Maintenance Technician (Mechanical) plays a key role in ensuring the mechanical reliability and operational continuity of conveyor systems, material handling equipment, and rotating machinery within our IST2 Fulfillment Center. This position is responsible for performing preventive and corrective maintenance on a wide range of mechanical components including bearings, motors, gearboxes, belts, rollers, and conveyor systems. Key job responsibilities Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on conveyor systems, motors, gearboxes, reducers, belts, rollers, and bearings. Perform motor coupling alignments, V-belt and chain drive maintenance, and shaft/seal replacements. Collaborate with engineers and other RME teams to support equipment upgrades and reliability improvement projects. Assist in root cause analysis for mechanical failures and develop corrective action plans. Document all work performed in the CMMS system, including parts used and time spent. Ensure compliance with safety policies, procedures, lockout/tagout (LOTO) standards, and mechanical safety practices. Basic Qualifications Technical Diploma in Mechanical , Industrial Maintenance, or related field. Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience with industrial mechanical maintenance. Solid understanding of conveyor systems, power transmission components (bearings, gearboxes, couplings, belts, chains). Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings and schematics. Proficient in using hand tools, precision measurement tools (calipers, dial gauges), and alignment equipment. Knowledge of LOTO (Lockout/Tagout) procedures and mechanical safety standards. Willingness to work shifts, weekends, or on-call as needed. Preferred Qualifications Experience in high-volume manufacturing, logistics, or e-commerce fulfillment environments. Hands-on experience with conveyor belt systems, roller replacements, and sortation equipment. Knowledge of lubrication programs and bearing failure analysis. Familiarity with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS). Experience with vibration analysis tools or basic condition monitoring techniques. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. title: Mechanical engineer
description: As a Mechanical Engineer, you’re looking for a role where you can fully express your creativity and problem-solving skills. Ideally, you'd like to do this for an innovative company, one you can be proud of. At Teqram, we’re working on one of the biggest innovations in industrial automation: autonomous vision guided robots. Your Key Challenge as a Mechanical Engineer: Together with our other mechanical engineers, you will be responsible for quickly developing high-quality, mechatronic systems. We build standardized solutions which are highly configurable to customer specific use-cases. Most of our robots are used in the sheet metal and plate industry, so every solution you create must not only be functional but also robust. Your work starts with a problem that probably has not been solved before. On top of that there are challenging constraints and demands such as space, form-factor, cost, maintainability and durability. You will be part of a dynamic, social, and highly intelligent team of professionals who are passionate about what they do. We expect you to have a strong interest in other disciplines such as electrical engineer and software in order to be succesful. Your responsibilities include: Developing concept solutions. Drafting concepts in Solidworks. Improving existing systems. Liasing with production for any design questions Supervising prototype construction. We take on the challenges others didn't dare to, will you? We are looking for a pragmatic, inventive, and technically skilled colleague. You design in a way that ensures the robot performs its tasks effectively and consistently. Every design you create has been carefully thought through. You either have experience or a strong affinity with industrial automation, robotics, and/or machinery. You’re an approachable team member, someone who quickly gets to the heart of the matter and isn’t satisfied until you fully understand the problem. During busy periods, you know how to set your priorities. You also enjoy being part of a close-knit team and work well with your colleagues. What we expect from you as a Mechanical Engineer: A BSc or MSc degree in Mechanical Engineering or Industrial Automation. Proficiency in both Dutch and English, both spoken and written. Experience with Solidworks or other 3D software. Hands-on technical skills Job Requirements: We ask a lot, but we offer much more. Most importantly, you will be contributing to one of the most significant innovations in robotics in recent years. You will also work in an environment where you can apply your experience and ideas. We expect commitment, but we also offer it in return. Together, we strive for continuous improvement, and from day one, your opinions will be valued. Teqram is financially stable, allowing us to invest strategically to maintain and expand our unique position. We ensure that you will find challenges here and, importantly, continue to find them. Are you ready to push the boundaries of robotic automation? Join Teqram and be part of a team that’s shaping the future! For more information, feel free to contact Martin Bruins via 06-29113915 or m.bruins@tosec.nl

title: Mechanical Engineer
description: Food Machinery Manufacturing · Zeeland · Internationale projecten · Machine- en lijnontwikkeling · Tot €5.600 bruto per maand Introductie Wil jij niet alleen machines tekenen, maar écht begrijpen hoe ze werken en hoe ze onderdeel worden van een complete productielijn? Voor een internationaal opererende machinebouwer binnen food processing zoeken we een Mechanical Design Engineer die zich wil ontwikkelen binnen machine- en lijnontwikkeling. Je werkt aan klantspecifieke machines en complete productielijnen die wereldwijd worden gerealiseerd. Je krijgt veel vrijheid om technische vraagstukken zelf te onderzoeken, oplossingen te bedenken en steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Ervaring is welkom, maar technisch inzicht, nieuwsgierigheid en ontwikkelpotentieel zijn minstens zo belangrijk. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden Je werkt aan zowel individuele machines als de manier waarop deze machines samen één goed functionerende productielijn vormen. Ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van klantspecifieke machines en mechanische systemen. Uitwerken van concepten naar 3D-modellen, detailengineering en productietekeningen. Meedenken over de opbouw en inrichting van complete productielijnen. Ontwerpen van onder andere conveyors, frames, constructies en mechanische interfaces. Rekening houden met de operator: bediening, bereikbaarheid, onderhoud, veiligheid en praktische inzetbaarheid. Technische vraagstukken onderzoeken voordat je tot een oplossing komt: waarom is iets nodig en kan het slimmer? Afstemmen met klanten, collega-engineers, leveranciers en andere technische disciplines. Ondersteunen bij productie, assemblage, installatie en het oplossen van technische uitdagingen. Bestaande machines verbeteren en bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van nieuwe equipment. Jouw ontwikkeling De engineeringorganisatie in Nederland wordt verder opgebouwd. Daardoor krijg je de kans om vanaf een vroeg stadium mee te groeien met de afdeling. Je kunt je ontwikkelen richting: zelfstandig machineontwerp; complete lijnontwikkeling; product development / R&D; technische projectverantwoordelijkheid; en op termijn eventueel een leidende rol binnen het engineeringteam. Je krijgt daarbij de mogelijkheid om kennis op te doen van ervaren engineers die wereldwijd food processing machines en productielijnen hebben ontwikkeld, gebouwd en opgestart. Als jij een kickstart aan jouw carrière in machinebouw wilt geven, is dit jouw kans. Bedrijfsprofiel Je komt terecht bij een internationale organisatie die machines, productielijnen en turnkey oplossingen ontwikkelt voor de voedingsmiddelenindustrie. Projecten lopen uiteen van individuele machines tot complete productielocaties en worden wereldwijd gerealiseerd. Binnen de Nederlandse organisatie wordt momenteel verder gebouwd aan een eigen product development- en engineeringteam. De ambitie is om steeds meer kennis rondom machine- en lijnontwikkeling lokaal op te bouwen. De cultuur is praktisch, ondernemend en informeel. Engineers krijgen vrijheid, maar er wordt ook verwacht dat je initiatief neemt, vragen stelt en verantwoordelijkheid pakt. Jouw profiel We zoeken vooral iemand met technisch potentieel en een praktische engineeringmentaliteit. Hbo- of wo-opleiding in Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar. Je bent starter of hebt enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen machinebouw, mechanical engineering of productontwikkeling. Ervaring met Inventor, SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Solid Edge of vergelijkbare CAD-software. Je vindt het leuk om uit te zoeken waarom iets technisch op een bepaalde manier moet werken. Je denkt niet alleen aan het ontwerp, maar ook aan degene die de machine uiteindelijk moet bedienen en onderhouden. Je bent nieuwsgierig, praktisch ingesteld en niet bang om vragen te stellen. Ervaring binnen food processing, conveyors of productielijnen is mooi meegenomen, maar geen harde eis. Goede beheersing van het Engels. Je hoeft dus zeker niet alles al te kunnen. Belangrijker is dat je de ambitie hebt om machines écht te leren begrijpen en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Aanbod Salaris passend bij jouw ervaring, tot circa €5.800 bruto per maand. 25 vakantiedagen + 13 ADV-dagen. Arbeidsvoorwaarden volgens de cao Metaal & Techniek. Veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid binnen je eigen projecten. Persoonlijke begeleiding en ruimte om technisch sterk door te groeien. Internationale projecten en de mogelijkheid om machines en productielijnen ook in de praktijk te zien. De kans om mee te bouwen aan een groeiende engineering- en product development-afdeling in Nederland. Interesse? Ben jij een engineer die niet alleen wil tekenen, maar vooral wil begrijpen, ontwikkelen en verbeteren? Neem dan contact op met: Fabrice Craenmehr McFly & Brown Telefoon/WhatsApp: +31 6 44 03 97 73 E-mail: fabrice.craenmehr@mcflybrown.com
