title: LGS Design Lead
description: Job Type: Full-time, Permanent Work Location: In person (some flexibility is possible), Louth/South Monaghan Oriel Recruitment is hiring an experienced Light Gauge Steel (LGS) System Design & Development Lead on behalf of our client, a leading construction technology company based in the North Louth / South Monaghan area. Our client is embarking on an exciting period of development and is seeking an experienced LGS System Design & Development Lead to support the development of a new off-site construction system. The role will initially focus on a structured R&D; programme covering design development, prototyping, testing, certification support and manufacturing readiness. Following successful completion of the R&D; programme, the LGS System Design and Development Lead is expected to remain with the business in a broader technical leadership role. Key Responsibilities - Lead development of the LGS elements of the system. - Develop and refine frame layouts, connection details, apertures and interfaces. - Produce and maintain 3D models, technical drawings and design documentation. - Coordinate structural design input and technical review with external Chartered Structural Engineers. - Support prototype development, testing and design iteration. - Liaise with specialist consultants, suppliers and test organisations. - Support development of manufacturing methods and Design for Manufacture and Assembly principles. - Contribute to quality control, design review, traceability and technical documentation. - Support certification activities, including preparation of technical information required for NSAI Agrément and external test house assessment. - Attend prototype, pilot and early-stage installations where required and incorporate lessons learned into subsequent design development. - Support the future integration of in-house LGS roll-forming and associated digital design workflows. Following completion of the R&D; programme, the role is expected to develop into a broader technical leadership position with responsibility for: - Technical ownership of the LGS design system. - Design process development and standardisation. - Management of external engineering partners and vendors. - Continuous product and process development and value engineering. - Technical support to manufacturing and project delivery teams. - Certification maintenance. - Technical team development and leadership. Candidate Profile Essential - Relevant third-level qualification in engineering, architectural technology or a related discipline. - Minimum 5 years' relevant experience in LGS, cold-formed steel, off-site construction or panelised systems. - Strong knowledge of light gauge steel design and detailing. - Experience with 3D design and technical drawing production. - Working knowledge of Irish Building Regulations and relevant standards. - Experience coordinating with structural engineers, consultants and suppliers. - Strong technical problem-solving and documentation skills. - Proficient in Microsoft Excel and Word. Desirable - Experience with Vertex, Tekla, Revit, AutoCAD, FRAMECAD or equivalent. - Experience in MMC, modular or panelised construction. - Experience of product development, prototyping and testing. - Familiarity with NSAI Agrément or similar certification processes. - Experience with DfMA and automated roll-forming systems. Personal Attributes - Technically rigorous and detail oriented. - Practical and solutions focused. - Comfortable working in a development environment. - Able to work effectively across design, manufacturing and site teams. - Collaborative with external technical specialists. - Organised in maintaining controlled technical documentation. Remuneration Package: An attractive remuneration package will be on offer to suitable candidates. To apply: Please submit your CV to Oriel Recruitment for confidential consideration

title: Industrial Designer
description: Dolmen Design are looking for an experienced Senior Product Designer to join our team to help shape the future for some of the world’s most exciting brands in the fields of FMCG and Medtech & Life Sciences. We pride ourselves on our collaborative, supportive design process where we continually grow our team's ability and ambition at our Dublin studio. This is an exciting opportunity for a designer who is passionate about detail, quality and innovation where you will get to lead projects, shape design direction and inspire clients while honing your creative skills. About Dolmen We are an award-winning product design + R&D agency specialising in breakthrough product innovation. We partner with the world’s most ambitious brands to create transformative product portfolio pipelines. For the past 30 years we have been developing patent rich and internationally recognized award-winning products across a range of exciting sectors. We are based in Dublin, Ireland, one of Europe’s most vibrant and friendliest cities. Our studio is in the leafy suburb of Drumcondra, a short 15min cycle from Dublin city centre, and 15mins by car to the airport. We moved into our purpose built 1500m2 studio 3 years ago with dedicated ideation spaces where we regularly host events for some of the world's leading brands. Our 200m2 fully kitted out workshop and labs are where we create, experiment and craft breakthrough innovations. At lunch you’ll find our team of researchers, designers & engineers taking walks in the nearby Botanic gardens, playing spike-ball or the more intellectually inclined relaxing with a game of chess! We would love to hear from talented designers to join our growing team. The Role Bring products through the entire design process from discovery to R&D, to manufacture guiding clients and influencing decisions & strategy, You will get to fulfil your passion as a designer solving complex design challenges with innovative solutions We pride ourselves on building strong relationships with our clients, embedding ourselves into their team where you will get to foster a collaborative spirt, understanding their needs and translating them into effective solutions Story telling is a big part of our process where you will help generate content to inspire internal and external teams Lead collaborative ideation sessions, setting the themes and guiding clients through the process with support from lead designers Get exposure to projects from a diverse client base, managing resources, commercial objectives, costs and aligning project activities with business goals. You will get to flex your technical and creative muscles on projects that combine innovative engineering solutions married with aesthetic designs & visualisations that reflect and elevate our clients designs language. Lead R&D prototype development and testing schedules and translate these into cost effective manufacturable products. Liaise with manufacturers and suppliers to ensure costs targets & design intent are kept during manufacturing process. We want our team to keep the passion that inspired them to become a designer by encouraging and supporting self-development to help you grow With the help of the team leads you will be part of nurturing and mentoring junior members of the team to help bring on the next wave of talent. Skills And Knowledge Sketching: Strong sketching skills to quickly communicate design concepts and ideas, both digitally and by hand, with a high level of creativity and precision. Visualisation: ability to create compelling and emotive visuals that communicate the design intent using Adobe CS and Keyshot. CAD: Strong CAD capabilities (e.g. SolidWorks and Creo) to rapidly develop complex assemblies with accurate parts which are specified with detailed drawings. An advantage to have working knowledge of simulation tools (FEA, CFD, Moldflow) to optimise parameters. Prototyping: Strong hands-on prototyping skills to build and test physical models, ensuring aesthetics, functionality and usability are verified at each project stage. DFM: Experience in designing for manufacture (e.g. injection moulding, sheet fabrication, casting) to ensure feasible concepts are developed and design intent is maintained to production. Time Management: Excellent time management skills to deliver multiple projects and meet tight deadlines without compromising quality. Agility + Initiative: Strong ability to adapt quickly to changing project requirement and proactive initiative to evaluate, prioritise and deliver on project commitments. Teamwork: Proficient teamwork skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional project teams (internal and external) and ensure alignment on key project decisions. Communication: Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, to articulate topics clearly and in accessible language to clients, stakeholders, and team members. Leadership: Experience leading teams, mentoring and guiding them through the design process and ensuring delivery of project goals. Experience And Qualifications A 6+ years of relevant experience in industrial design or design engineering in a fast-paced environment, with experience in leading design projects and teams. A recognized degree level qualification in Product Design / Industrial Design / Product Design Engineering or a related technical discipline. Further qualifications in related topics is advantageous (e.g. UI/UX, electronics, CAD, sustainability).

Translate customer needs, regulatory obligations, and market insights into clear, robust engineering solutions. title: Technical Design Engineer

Du skal kunne løse komplekse designopgaver og tage ansvar for at udvikle og levere de bedste tekniske løsninger til tiden og med fokus på en effektiv projektøkonomi. Samtidig skal du kunne skabe tillid og kommunikere vores tekniske løsninger klart over for både kunder, rådgivere og øvrige interessenter. Det kommer du til at arbejde med Indgå i vores designteam i København og sikre design af høj kvalitet, leveret til tiden og omkostningseffektivt. Selv tage ansvar for komplekse designopgaver og finde løsninger. Arbejde tæt sammen med vores øvrige projektteams, herunder R&D, Sales, Legal og Operations, så vi sikrer en samlet tilgang til kundernes projekter gennem hele værdikæden. Kommunikere komplekse designløsninger klart og tillidsvækkende til både interne og eksterne interessenter gennem alle projektets faser. Samarbejde tæt med vores designteam i Sverige om udvikling og standardisering af vores designløsninger. Hvem er du? Vi forestiller os, at du: Har solid erfaring med detaljeret design af HVAC-systemer eller procesanlæg, herunder dimensionering og valg af komponenter såsom pumper, varmevekslere mv. samt udarbejdelse af tekniske specifikationer, layouts, P&ID og anden projektdokumentation. Erfaring fra hele designprocessen, fra tidlige forstudie og projektering til endeligt udførelsesdesign, herunder at følge designet gennem udbud, indkøb, udførelse og implementering samt sikre, at løsningerne er praktiske, bygbare og enkle at drifte. Har erfaring med tværfaglig systemintegration og kan koordinere grænseflader mellem mekaniske, elektriske, konstruktionsmæssige og styringstekniske systemer. Arbejder selvstændigt og struktureret og kan drive egne designopgaver i tæt samarbejde med teamet og øvrige interne og eksterne interessenter. Kan identificere og håndtere tekniske risici, afhængigheder og udfordringer i designet samt sikre relevant eskalering og opfølgning. Har stærke kommunikative evner og kan formidle komplekse tekniske løsninger til både kunder, rådgivere og entreprenører. Er samarbejdsorienteret og trives med at arbejde på tværs af teams. Tør udfordre traditionelle designkriterier, eksempelvis systemtemperaturer og bygningernes behov for varme, køling og varmt brugsvand. Har stærke IT-kompetencer og interesse for at integrere digitale løsninger i designprocessen. Er flydende i dansk og engelsk. Har minimum 5 års relevant erfaring Det er en fordel, hvis du desuden har: Erfaring med design af varmepumpe- og geotermi baserede energisystemer. Kendskab til bygningsautomatik og PLC-baserede styringssystemer. Erfaring med idriftsættelse og opfølgning på bygningers og systemers performance. Erfaring med BIM/CAD-management. Har en relevant ingeniøruddannelse inden for energi, maskinteknik, HVAC, procesteknik eller lignende samt flere års erfaring med komplekse tekniske designprojekter. Det får du hos os Du bliver en del af en virksomhed i vækst med stor frihed, høj faglighed og mulighed for at arbejde med nogle af markedets mest innovative energiløsninger. Samtidig bliver du en del af et ambitiøst og engageret team med en uformel kultur, højt tempo og korte beslutningsprocesser. Vi har travlt, men aldrig for travlt til at hjælpe hinanden, fejre succeserne og have det sjovt undervejs. En fuldtidsstilling med stor frihed under ansvar. Faglig udvikling og specialisering. Pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring. 5 feriefridage. Fri telefon. Frokostordning og sociale arrangementer. Flad organisation og korte beslutningsprocesser. Ambitiøse og dygtige kolleger. Mulighed for at gøre en reel forskel i den grønne omstilling.

title: Erfaren mekanikkonstruktör till pumptillverkning
location: Östra Göinge kommun, Skåne ili, İsveç
description: Om företaget W. Ruberg är ett svenskt industriföretag med en lång och gedigen historia som sträcker sig tillbaka till 1932. Från anläggningen i Immeln utvecklar och tillverkar vi brandpumpar, nödkylningspumpar, skumsystem, vatten- och skumkanoner som används i moderna brandbekämpningsfordon. Med lång erfarenhet, hög teknisk kompetens och ett starkt fokus på kvalitet har W. Ruberg etablerat sig på en internationell marknad och levererar produkter till kunder i flera länder. Trots sin globala närvaro är W. Ruberg ett mindre och familjärt företag, där cirka 20 medarbetare arbetar tillsammans i en modern produktionsmiljö. Vi söker nu en erfaren konstruktör som bor i närområdet. I denna rekrytering samarbetar vi med Wikan Personal. Dina arbetsuppgifter Som konstruktör hos oss får du en bred, varierad och utvecklande roll där du får stor frihet att planera ditt arbete och möjlighet att ta ett stort ansvar. Du blir en viktig del av våra projekt och får vara med hela vägen – från idé och konstruktion till färdig produkt. Du arbetar med att ta fram bearbetningsritningar, outlineritningar och sprängskisser samt konstruerar kundanpassade pumpar, större pumpaggregat, skumsystem och kringutrustning såsom hydraul- och växellådsdrivningar. Dina arbetsuppgifter omfattar bland annat layoutarbete, konstruktion och teknisk dokumentation i olika projekt. Du kommer in tidigt i projekten och arbetar parallellt med flera olika applikationer, vilket ger dig en omväxlande vardag med många tekniska utmaningar. Som en del av rollen arbetar du i Autodesk Inventor och hanterar även projektadministration i vårt affärssystem Monitor. Du arbetar nära din konstruktörskollega och utvecklingsavdelningen, vilket ger goda möjligheter att utbyta kunskap och utvecklas tillsammans. För rätt person finns dessutom goda möjligheter att växa med rollen och ta ett större ansvar över tid. Din bakgrund/Dina egenskaper Vi söker dig som har minst gymnasieutbildning med inriktning mot maskinteknik och som har byggt på din kompetens genom några års erfarenhet av konstruktionsarbete. Erfarenhet av CAD är ett krav, och du har en god teknisk förståelse och ett genuint intresse för hur konstruktioner fungerar i praktiken. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet från tillverkande industri och har arbetat nära produktion eller verkstad, gärna i en mindre organisation där du fått ta ett brett ansvar. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av pumpkonstruktion eller arbete med gjutmodeller. Du har goda kunskaper i Officepaketet och behärskar svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift. För oss är din personlighet viktig. Vi söker dig som har ett genuint intresse för teknik, konstruktion och produktion och som trivs i en miljö där du får vara delaktig, påverka och ta ansvar. Du är självgående, social och lösningsorienterad, samtidigt som du är noggrann och strukturerad i ditt arbete. Du har ett kostnadsmedvetet förhållningssätt och förstår vikten av att hitta smarta och effektiva lösningar utan att kompromissa med kvaliteten. Framför allt är du en person som tar ansvar, gillar att utvecklas och trivs med att se dina konstruktioner gå från idé till verklig produkt. Information och kontakt Tjänstgöringsort är Immeln och vi har en stark närvarokultur, vilket kräver att du har B körkort och tillgång till bil. Vi ser därför att du har maximalt 45 minuters pendling. Tjänsten är på 100 % och du kommer att jobba dagtid. Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning hos W. Ruberg. Välkommen med din ansökan senast 6 november via Wikans hemsida www.wikan.se . För mer info kontakta rekryteringskonsult Sara Kvist på telefon 044-590 65 12. Välkommen med din ansökan! Om Wikan Personal Wikan Personals verksamhet är grundad på närhet och engagemang för att alltid kunna tillgodose bra service till våra kunder och anställda. Vi är djupt övertygade om att lokal förankring, långsiktiga kundrelationer och kompetenta medarbetare är nyckeln till framgångsrika samarbeten inom rekryterings- och bemanningsbranschen. Med närvaro på 17 orter i Sverige, en omsättning på cirka 400 miljoner kronor och omkring 700 engagerade anställda, strävar vi efter att vara en pålitlig samarbetspartner. Läs mer på www.wikan.se

title: Tooling & Equipment Mechanical Engineer
description: At Tata Technologies we make product development dreams a reality by designing, engineering and validating the products of tomorrow for the world’s leading manufacturers. Due to our continued growth, we are now recruiting for a Tooling & Equipment Mechanical Engineer strengthen our team in Gothenburg, Sweden. The role This assignment is within Manufacturing Engineering and supports the industrialization of advanced High Voltage Battery Assembly systems for Battery Electric Vehicles. The work is performed in a cross-functional engineering environment covering manufacturing processes, automated production equipment, product-to-process interfaces, quality assurance and supplier collaboration. The consultant will lead mechanical development and assurance of production equipment, tooling, fixtures, nests, grippers and handling solutions used in automated High Voltage Battery Assembly. The focus is on robust mechanical design, equipment interfaces, supplier execution and production readiness. Responsibilities Develop and review mechanical concepts for production stations, tooling, fixtures, nests, grippers and handling devices. Convert process, product, geometry, safety, maintainability and cycle-time needs into technical equipment requirements. Review supplier layouts, 3D concepts, detailed designs, calculations, drawings and interface definitions. Secure access, ergonomics, serviceability, changeover, error-proofing and replacement-part strategy. Coordinate mechanical interfaces with automation, robotics, controls, utilities, process equipment and facilities. Support RFQ, supplier selection, design reviews, manufacturing follow-up, buy-off, installation and commissioning. Drive mechanical risk assessments, tolerance reviews and technical issue resolution. Support equipment acceptance and handover with documented deviations and remaining actions. Approve tooling and mechanical equipment concepts. Technical mechanical requirements and interface specification. Documented supplier design reviews and action tracking. Mechanical risk assessment and mitigation plan. Buy-off, installation and commissioning support documentation. Equipment acceptance and handover package. Required Competencies Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant engineering discipline, or equivalent demonstrated professional experience relevant to the assignment. Senior-level industrialization experience in automotive, battery manufacturing, electrification or comparable high-volume automated production. Automated production equipment and tooling development Mechanical design review using 3D CAD and engineering drawings Equipment supplier development from concept through commissioning Machine safety, maintainability, ergonomics and tolerance engineering High-volume automated manufacturing industrialization Preferred Competencies High Voltage Battery Assembly equipment experience. Precision handling, joining fixtures, grippers, conveyors or pallet systems. CATIA, Teamcenter or equivalent CAD/PLM tools. CE conformity, machinery risk assessment and equipment acceptance. If you are passionate about bringing innovation to the projects you work on and want to join a global company, then this is the place for you. Tata Technologies: Engineering a better world. If you do not hear from us within 10 working days following the closing date, it will mean that unfortunately your application has not been successful. title: Structural Engineer - Heavy Lift
description: The Heavy Lift department is responsible for the concept, basic and detailed engineering phases of topside and jacket installations and removals of up to 60,000 tonnes for both the oil & gas and renewables industries. The department brings together a creative, multidisciplinary team of Heavy Lift Engineers, Structural Engineers, Naval Engineers and Draftsmen. Our agile teams perform all engineering and feasibility analyses required for the safe and efficient execution of projects by Allseas’ heavy lift fleet. With the North Sea rapidly transforming, driven by large-scale decommissioning of aging oil and gas platforms and the expansion of offshore wind farms, Allseas is uniquely positioned to lead this new era. Our flagship vessel, Pioneering Spirit , the world’s most powerful heavy lift and construction vessel, can remove or install entire platforms in a single lift, setting new standards for safety, speed and sustainability. Since 2016, the department has contributed to a total lifted weight of 330,000 tonnes, with a record-breaking 123,000 tonnes in 2022. With an order book of more than 30 assets, Allseas continues to drive the transition of offshore infrastructure in the North Sea and beyond. Your role As a Structural Engineer, you can be involved in all stages structural scope within your projects, from concept design and detailed calculations to offshore support . You will contribute to the engineering work for single-lift platform installations and removals executed by Pioneering Spirit , ensuring that all designs, analyses and procedures meet the highest technical and safety standards.You will be a key point of contact for both internal teams and external stakeholders. We’re looking for a technically strong, results-driven professional who combines deep analytical ability with practical, hands-on insight. Someone who thrives in a collaborative environment, and are motivated by the challenge of pushing the boundaries of heavy lift engineering. Job Specific Tasks You define methodologies, priorities and progress, ensuring quality and efficiency; You perform and validate design studies, calculations and simulations for complex structures; You develop procedures for the use and testing of installation or removal aids, and align outcomes with project and offshore teams; You review subcontractor designs and methods, ensuring alignment with project goals and standards; You support offshore operations and troubleshoot during execution when required; You prepare input for engineering close-out reports and lessons learned; You contribute to the continuous improvement of departmental standards and working methods. What we expect from you In order to be a fit for this job, you should largly recognize yourself in the following criteria: You hold a BSc / MSc degree in Civil, Mechanical or Structural Engineering (or equivalent), preferably with a specialisation in Maritime and Offshore Preferably, you already have a few years of relevant experience in Structural Enigneering in an industry relevant environmen You can think on an abstract level as well as translate analysis to practical solutions You are proficient with structural engineering software (preferably FEMAP and GeniE) or eagerness to expand your expertise; You are fluent in English and comfortable working in and English environment; Dutch is a plus; Occationally, you are willing to travel offshore to one of our vessels; Affinity with offshore and/or marine environments is a huge asset What we Offer Working at Allseas means joining a pioneering team that’s shaping the future of offshore energy. You’ll work in a dynamic, fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment where innovation, teamwork and hands-on problem-solving are at the core of everything we do. Our flat structure and open culture give you the freedom to take initiative, lead projects and make a real impact. Apart From That, You Can Count On A competitive, industry-benchmarked salary and excellent pension scheme; Performance-based salary increases and annual bonuses; 30 holiday days per year and flexible working hours (start between 7:00 and 10:00); Extensive training and development opportunities, including study budgets and coaching; A company-sponsored fitness and wellbeing programme; Internal clubs, social events and sports activities that bring colleagues together. Ready to take on the challenge? Apply today and help us shape the future of offshore engineering!

Als Mechanical Engineer ontwerp je maatwerk tooling en behuizingen die moeten presteren onder zware operationele omstandigheden en dynamische rotatiekrachten. Je bent hier geen nummertje dat alleen 3D-modellen doortikt; je bent een allround productontwikkelaar die actief meebouwt in de werkplaats en meegaat tijdens pilotfases om te zien hoe jouw innovaties in de praktijk functioneren. Multidisciplinair Sparren: Je stemt nauw af met embedded software- en elektrotechnisch engineers om mechanica en hoogwaardige sensortechnologie naadloos te integreren. Wat breng je mee? title: Starter Scientist in Ship Design of Future
description: About This Position A liveable future for everyone. That is what drives us at the Naval and Offshore Structures department. We design, analyse and test a wide range of structures for the maritime and offshore industries, as well as for defence applications. Ensuring these structures remain safe and reliable throughout their service life, even under the most demanding conditions, is at the core of our work. The transition to new energy sources for ship propulsion, including hydrogen-based fuels and nuclear energy, presents major engineering challenges. How do ships and offshore systems perform under these new operating conditions? How can regulations be developed to enable their safe introduction? What happens in the event of a collision, and what are the consequences for the vessel, its crew and the surrounding environment? Answering these questions requires more than assessing risks alone. It also means developing practical solutions and validating them through both theoretical and experimental research. Are you excited by these challenges and would you like to help shape the safe and sustainable vessels of the future? If so, this role could be the perfect fit. What will be your role? As a Starter Scientist in Ship Design of Future, you will investigate how emerging energy systems influence the design, operation and safety of ships and offshore installations. Your work will focus on technologies such as hydrogen carriers, including ammonia, small modular reactors (SMRs), and the systems and structures needed to deploy them safely. Working closely with your colleagues, you will analyse, model and test maritime structures and systems to help bring innovative solutions to market in a safe and cost-effective way. Examples include collision-resistant ship structures and lightweight shielding concepts for nuclear applications. You will also assess the impact of incident scenarios on vessels, crew members and the surrounding environment. Your findings will support the evaluation of existing and future regulations, helping to determine whether they adequately address emerging risks and where improvements may be needed. You will join the Naval and Offshore Structures department, a team of around 60 dedicated experts in maritime engineering, civil engineering, aerospace engineering, applied physics and mechanical engineering. Supported by our state-of-the-art mechanical testing laboratories, we combine experimental and theoretical expertise to solve highly complex engineering challenges and validate breakthrough structural solutions. Our research covers topics ranging from the safe use of alternative fuels on board ships and the structural integrity of offshore wind turbines to ship structures designed to withstand shock and explosion loads. In doing so, we address some of today's most pressing challenges the energy transition and the growing need for safety and security at sea. What we expect from you You hold a Master's degree from a research university in a relevant engineering discipline, such as Maritime Engineering, Aerospace Engineering or Mechanical Engineering, with a specialisation in ship design and structural design. You have a solid theoretical foundation and a practical understanding of ship design, including the interaction between vessel layout, structural arrangements and operational safety. Experience with energy systems is an advantage. Alongside your technical expertise, you are a strong communicator with a collaborative mindset and a focus on delivering results. You enjoy working with colleagues, clients and partners to develop solutions that are both scientifically sound and practically applicable. An employer working towards a respectful, inclusive, and equitable work environment where every employee can flourish, with various initiatives such as Jong TNO, numerous expertise based guilds, Rainbow Community and Round Tables on diverse inclusion topics. title: Mechanical Integrity Engineer
description: As a Mechanical Integrity Engineer, you will assess whether critical gas turbine components can operate safely and reliably throughout their intended service life. You will carry out detailed stress, thermal and dynamic analysis of components including turbine blades, vanes, rotors and casings, supporting both new product development and upgrades to existing turbine designs. Based in Lincoln, you will join the Turbine Engineering function and work closely with Mechanical Design, Heat Transfer, Materials and test teams. You will use engineering analysis, test data and operational experience from the global fleet to understand component behaviour in demanding high-temperature operating conditions. How You’ll Make An Impact Perform static, transient, linear and non-linear thermal and thermomechanical finite element analysis of gas turbine components, including blades, vanes, rotors and casings. Complete static and dynamic stress analysis, producing component life assessments for high-cycle fatigue, low-cycle fatigue, thermo-mechanical fatigue and creep. Partner with Mechanical Design and Heat Transfer teams to establish component life against operating duty cycles and required life targets. Support new product and upgrade programmes by analysing and adapting component designs, using root cause analysis, weighted decision analysis and design of experiments where needed. Define component and engine test requirements, then calibrate structural models using engine test data and operational fleet experience. Produce technical reports, presentations and method documents, while supporting analysis tool-chain improvements, software validation and the development of more effective engineering methods. What You Bring A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with significant mechanical or structural design content, ideally in aerospace, automotive, power generation turbomachinery or materials science, or equivalent verified vocational experience. At least two years’ professional experience in finite element stress analysis and component life calculation. A sound understanding of stress theory, material behaviour and high-temperature failure mechanisms under cyclic and steady operating conditions. Knowledge of component stress analysis, dynamic analysis and lifing methods, including fatigue and creep assessment. Experience using finite element analysis and pre- and post-processing software, ideally Abaqus. Experience with ANSYS, NX Simcenter, Nastran or RR SC03 would also be relevant. The ability to validate and challenge analysis results using simplified one-dimensional methods and hand calculations, alongside effective communication skills for multidisciplinary working. About The Team Our Gas Services division offers low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. We bring together gas turbines, steam turbines, generators and digital service solutions under one roof. Through modernization, digitalization and innovative service offerings, we support customers worldwide in improving reliability, efficiency and sustainability. You will join the Turbine Engineering function in Lincoln, supporting the structural integrity and durability of gas turbine components throughout product development, upgrades and operational life. The team brings together mechanical design, heat transfer, materials, testing and fleet experience to understand how turbine parts behave in high-temperature service and ensure they achieve the required safety, reliability and lifespan. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo Our Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fuelled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character, no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits 26 days holiday, increasing to 29 days with time served. Access to a flexible benefits portal, including private medical cover and cycle-to-work schemes. A class-leading adjustable pension scheme. Career development and continuous learning opportunities. The opportunity to develop specialist expertise in gas turbine structural integrity, high-temperature material behaviour and advanced engineering analysis methods.

Problem Solving & Root Cause Analysis: Investigate manufacturing and production issues using structured problem-solving methodologies, including 8D, Ishikawa (Fishbone) diagrams and 5 Whys, implementing effective corrective and preventive actions. Process Risk Management: Develop, review and maintain PFMEAs, identifying potential process failures, assessing risks and implementing appropriate mitigation measures. Production Analysis: Analyse production performance, labour requirements, material usage and manufacturing costs to identify opportunities for improvement. Data Management & Reporting: Maintain accurate product and process databases, analyse manufacturing trends and prepare reports to support operational decision-making. Equipment Reliability: Coordinate maintenance and repair activities to ensure production equipment remains safe, reliable and operational. Continuous Improvement: Identify and implement improvements to manufacturing processes, productivity, quality and efficiency. Technical Support & Training: Provide technical guidance and support to technicians, contributing to successful project delivery and knowledge sharing. Quality & Compliance: Support and adhere to established quality management systems, including ISO 9001 and IATF 16949. Health & Safety: Ensure all engineering activities comply with relevant health, safety and operational procedures. Essential Skills & Experience A recognised engineering qualification. Experience in a production or manufacturing environment , preferably within the automotive sector. Strong knowledge of manufacturing processes, production methods and process optimisation. Practical CAD modelling skills, ideally relating to tooling, fixtures or production equipment. Strong knowledge of structured problem-solving tools , including 8D, Ishikawa/Fishbone diagrams, 5 Whys and root cause analysis. Good understanding and practical experience of PFMEA , including process risk assessment, failure prevention and the implementation of corrective actions. Experience investigating production issues and implementing sustainable solutions to improve quality, reliability and efficiency. Good analytical skills, with the ability to interpret manufacturing data and identify trends. Good IT skills, including Microsoft Windows and Office applications. Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional engineering, production and quality teams. A proactive approach to continuous improvement, quality and operational excellence. Desirable Skills & Experience Programming and Coding: Experience with programming languages such as C++, C#, Lua or VBA. PLC & Automation: Knowledge of PLC programming, industrial automation and control systems. Manufacturing Equipment: Experience designing, developing and commissioning production equipment, tooling and fixtures. Quality Systems: Familiarity with ISO 9001 and IATF 16949 quality management standards. New Product Introduction: Experience supporting prototype builds, product launches and manufacturing industrialisation. Lean Manufacturing: Knowledge of continuous improvement techniques and methodologies to reduce waste and improve production performance. The Ideal Candidate You'll be a practical, analytical and solutions-focused engineer who can combine strong manufacturing knowledge with a structured approach to problem-solving. You'll have the confidence to investigate complex production issues, identify root causes and implement lasting improvements. Your understanding of PFMEA and risk management will help prevent issues before they occur, while your CAD and coding knowledge will support the development of innovative manufacturing solutions. You'll also be comfortable collaborating with technicians, production teams, quality engineers and external suppliers to deliver measurable improvements across the manufacturing process. Interested? If you're an experienced Manufacturing Engineer looking for a role where you can apply your technical expertise, improve production performance and contribute to engineering excellence, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today to take the next step in your manufacturing engineering career. LNKD1_UKTJ

title: Graduate Mechanical Design Engineer
description: Company NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there. Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris. Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators. Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it. Hiring now We are hiring as soon as possible. This role is for someone who has already graduated, or who will complete their degree in time to start with us very soon. We are not able to consider final-year students who graduate in summer 2027 or later, and this is not a graduate scheme with a fixed annual intake. Role Overview This is a first full-time engineering role on the NEO-1 satellite. You will design satellite hardware and help keep the satellite's full CAD assembly organised as the design matures, learning from our lead designer and working in a small, multidisciplinary team. You will take ownership of real parts early, translate requirements into manufacturable designs and support their validation through prototyping and environmental testing. Key Responsibilities Design and develop mechanical hardware for the satellite, such as brackets, panels, component mounts, thermal-control hardware and cable and harness routing, with guidance from the lead designer. Work in the satellite's large 3D CAD assembly alongside the wider design team, learning how to keep interfaces, configurations and revisions in step as several designers work in the same model. Support assembly configuration, PLM data (3DEXPERIENCE ('3DX') or similar), bills of materials and engineering change control (ECO/ECR/ECN), so that models, drawings and interfaces stay consistent as changes are released. Run interference and clash checks and help maintain the digital mock-up, working with each subsystem owner to allocate space and resolve conflicts. Produce dimensioned, manufacturing-ready drawings using GD&T, with review from senior engineers. Support design reviews (PDR and CDR) and qualification, working with structural and thermal engineers. Work with manufacturers and suppliers to make designs easier to build, and to balance cost, mass and reliability. Support prototype builds, integration and environmental test campaigns, iterating designs based on results. Collaborate with electrical, software, systems and thermal engineers to integrate mechanical components into the satellite platform. Required Skills & Experience Bachelor's or master's degree in mechanical, aerospace or a related engineering discipline, completed or completing very soon. Hands-on 3D CAD skills from university projects, a placement or an internship (SolidWorks preferred; CATIA, NX or Creo also considered). Working knowledge of GD&T and experience producing engineering drawings, including from coursework or a team project. Solid grounding in mechanical design principles, materials and thermal management, with a working understanding of structural mechanics. Evidence of designing, building and testing something real, such as a placement project, Formula Student, a UAV, or a rocketry or satellite team, including troubleshooting and iteration. Clear communicator who is comfortable explaining and defending design decisions, and open to feedback and challenge in a fast-moving team. Preferred Experience A placement, internship or year in industry in aerospace, space, motorsport or another high-reliability field. Experience of several people working in one CAD assembly, for example in a Formula Student or university team, including how files and revisions were controlled. Exposure to PLM or PDM systems (for example 3DEXPERIENCE ('3DX'), Windchill, Teamcenter, ENOVIA or SolidWorks PDM) or to formal engineering change processes (ECO/ECR/ECN). Experience of design reviews, documented requirements and standards. Satellite, CubeSat or rocketry project experience, including hardware that has launched. Basic FEA familiarity and exposure to manufacturing processes. Why NewOrbit Space? Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO. Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology. Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success. Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups. Hybrid working - One dedicated remote day per week. Visa sponsorship and relocation support - We sponsor visas and provide relocation support for candidates moving to join us.

title: Medior R&D Engineer Machinebouw

Je krijgt verantwoordelijkheid over uitdagende ontwikkelvraagstukken en ziet jouw ideeën terug in werkende oplossingen. Wat ga je doen? Je vertaalt technische eisen en vraagstukken naar slimme concepten en werkt deze uit tot een betrouwbaar en maakbaar ontwerp. Met 3D CAD-software ontwikkel je constructies en beoordeel je onder andere materiaalkeuzes, toleranties en componenten. Je voert technische berekeningen uit en onderbouwt zelfstandig belangrijke ontwerpkeuzes. Daarbij houd je rekening met prestaties, kosten, kwaliteit en maakbaarheid. Binnen R&D ben je betrokken bij het volledige ontwikkeltraject: van conceptontwikkeling en engineering tot prototyping en testen. Je stelt testplannen op, analyseert resultaten en vertaalt deze naar concrete ontwerpverbeteringen. Technische knelpunten onderzoek je zelfstandig en je bespreekt mogelijke oplossingen met specialisten binnen Engineering en Manufacturing. Ook draag je bij aan design reviews en bewaak je technische specificaties tijdens het ontwikkelproces. Met jouw ervaring lever je zo een belangrijke bijdrage aan nieuwe machines en aan de verdere ontwikkeling van bestaande technologie. Jouw werkzaamheden Ontwikkelen en uitwerken van nieuwe machineconcepten, modules en mechanische constructies; Zelfstandig maken en beoordelen van 3D CAD-modellen en technische tekeningen; Uitvoeren van technische berekeningen en onderbouwen van ontwerpkeuzes; Opstellen en uitvoeren van testplannen voor prototypes en nieuwe technische oplossingen; Analyseren van testresultaten en doorvoeren van verbeteringen in het ontwerp; Beoordelen van materialen, componenten, toleranties en productietechnieken; Deelnemen aan design reviews en bewaken van technische specificaties; Oplossen van complexe technische vraagstukken tijdens ontwikkeling en productie; Afstemmen met Engineering en Manufacturing over maakbaarheid, kwaliteit en technische haalbaarheid. Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar; Enkele jaren relevante werkervaring binnen R&D, mechanical engineering, productontwikkeling of machinebouw; Ruime ervaring met 3D CAD-software en het uitwerken van technische ontwerpen; Goede kennis van mechanica, materiaalkunde, constructieleer en productietechnieken; Ervaring met prototyping, testen en het analyseren van technische resultaten; Een zelfstandige en analytische werkwijze waarmee je complexe technische vraagstukken omzet in praktische oplossingen. title: Mechanical Engineer
description: If you want to be a part of the Tüpraş family, let's get to know each other better. Who We Are? Tüpraş is Türkiye’s leading energy producer and largest industrial company. With its four refineries located in İzmit, İzmir, Kırıkkale and Batman totalling to 30 million tons of annual crude oil processing capacity, Tüpraş is the 7th largest refining company in Europe. It is also one of the most complex refining companies in the Mediterranean basin. In addition to refining, Tüpraş operates with its subsidiaries, (OPET) focusing on fuel retail, (Ditaş Denizcilik) marine transportation, (Körfez Ulaştırma) railway transportation (Tüpraş Trading Ltd) crude oil and oil products trading and (Entek Elektrik) electricity generation. In 2021 The company launched its Strategic Transition Plan alongside its goal to become Carbon Neutral by 2050. In 2022, Tüpraş established its corporate venture capital arm, Tüpraş Ventures to invest in, partner with and support technology startups in its strategic focus areas, as well as energy transition solutions. (For further information on Tüpraş Strategic Transition Plan and focus business areas: Strategy - Tüpraş (tupras.com.tr) What You’ll Do? Lead and manage mechanical engineering activities throughout all project phases, including static and rotating equipment, piping systems, tankage, installation, construction, commissioning, and handover activities. Prepare technical specifications, tender packages, and technical evaluations, and provide support during procurement and contracting processes. Coordinate engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning activities as Owner's Engineer to ensure project objectives are achieved. Lead the technical review and assessment of engineering designs, technical deliverables, deviations, and change requests, ensuring compliance with project scope, applicable standards, operational requirements, and investment objectives, and provide recommendations to support key project decisions. Monitor site construction and inspection activities and ensure the successful integration of new investments into existing facilities. Ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with quality and performance expectations. Provide technical input for project planning, reporting, progress monitoring, and performance tracking activities. Organize and participate in meetings, workshops, and coordination activities with internal and external stakeholders. Ensure compliance with HSE, quality management systems, company procedures, and relevant regulations. What We Look For? Bachelor's degree in a relevant field. Minimum 2 years of experience in a similar role. Proficiency in English. Proficient in MS Office applications. Valid driver's license and active driving experience. Continuously follows technological and industry developments, as well as changes in legislation and standards related to the area of responsibility. Highly adaptable to change and able to quickly embrace new ways of working. Dynamic, proactive, and committed to continuous self-development. Flexible, open-minded, and receptive to new perspectives. Strong teamwork and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively follow through on responsibilities, think innovatively and strategically, demonstrate a strong sense of social responsibility, and build sustainable professional relationships. What’s In It For You? Trainings for technical and behavioral development under the leadership of Tüpraş Academy, Koç Academy training and development programs, Opportunity for rotation within Tüpraş and other Koç Group companies, Koç Ailem: Opportunity to benefit from a special privilege platform for Koç employees, Opportunities to take part in future-oriented work such as initiatives and innovation projects developed with agile approaches, Employee experience practices that focus on continuous improvement. How will you be notified about the progress of the application process? We will notify you by email at the end of each step. Therefore, we kindly ask you to actively check the mailbox (including junk/spam/junk folders) of the e-mail address you applied to. *The only criterion evaluated in recruitment and employment is suitability for the job; equal opportunity is provided without any discrimination.

title: Kıdemli Borulama İşleri Mühendisi
description: Biz Kimiz? 1993 yılında kurulan Rönesans Holding, bugün Türkiye, Avrupa, Orta Asya ve Afrika’yı kapsayan geniş bir coğrafyada; inşaat, gayrimenkul, enerji, endüstri ve sağlık alanlarında ana müteahhit ve yatırımcı olarak faaliyet göstermektedir. 40.000’i aşkın çalışanı ve 60’tan fazla milletten oluşan güçlü ve çok kültürlü ekibiyle Rönesans, dünyanın en büyük müteahhitlik şirketleri arasında yer almakta; sürdürülebilir bir gelecek inşa etme vizyonuyla yenilikçi ve küresel ölçekteki mühendislik projelerini hayata geçirmeye devam etmektedir. Şirketimizin Türkmenistan’da yapımını üstlendiği endüstriyel tesis projesinde görevlendirilmek üzere Kıdemli Borulama İşleri Mühendisi aramaktayız. Bu Rolde Seni Neler Bekliyor? Kıyanlı Tesisi kapsamındaki proses ve yardımcı boru hatlarının tüm bakım, revizyon, imalat, montaj ve mekanik tamamlanma süreçlerini iş programı ve saha önceliklerine göre planlamak ve yürütülmesini sağlamak. Günlük ve haftalık iş planları doğrultusunda; borulama ekipleri ile alt yüklenici personelini sevk ve idare etmek; iş dağılımı, saha disiplini, üretkenlik ve montaj/kaynak ekiplerinin performansını takip etmek. İşe başlamadan önce risk değerlendirmesi ve çalışma izinlerinin (PTW) hazırlanmasını sağlamak; LOTO grubuyla koordineli olarak hat izolasyon süreçlerini takip etmek. Fit-up, kaynak, NDT, montaj, hidrostatik/pnömatik test, flushing, blowing ve reinstatement faaliyetlerinin onaylı prosedürlere uygun yürütülmesini sağlamak Kaynak kayıtlarını, NDT sonuçlarını, test paketlerini ve punch listelerini takip ederek hatları hidrotest ve mekanik tamamlanma aşamasına getirmek. Sahada tespit edilen saha-tasarım uyumsuzluklarını ve ilave işleri kayıt altına alarak proje yönetimi ve teknik ofisle koordine etmek. Sorumlu olduğu ünitedeki vana, conta, saplama, destek ve sarf malzemelerinin ihtiyaçlarını önceden belirlemek; sahaya gelen spool ve malzemelerin teknik uygunluğunu kontrol etmek. Günlük, haftalık, aylık ilerleme raporlarını hazırlanmasını sağlamak; metraj, kaynak çap-inç takibi ve hakediş dosyaları için teknik ofise saha kayıtlarıyla destek vermek. Borulama işlerinin yürütülmesi kapsamında; operasyon, mekanik, enstrümantasyon, kalite, İSG ve devreye alma ekipleriyle disiplinler arası saha koordinasyon süreçlerinde yer almak; bu doğrultuda teknik değerlendirme toplantılarına katılarak alınan kararların ve aksiyonların zamanında tamamlanmasını takip etmek. Tamamlanan borulama sistemlerinin mekanik tamamlanma, test, kabul ve işletmeye teslim süreçlerini ilgili taraflarla birlikte yürütmek. Adaylardan Beklentilerimiz Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği, bölümlerinden mezun, Endüstriyel tesislerde yer altı (UG) ve yer üstü (AG) borulama montajı, test ve mekanik tamamlanma süreçlerinde en az 5 yıl deneyimli, Fit-up, kaynak, montaj, hat kontrolü, hidrostatik/pnömatik test, flushing, blowing ve reinstatement faaliyetlerinde deneyimli, P&ID, izometrik, plot plan, boru sınıfları (pipe class) ve destek projelerini iyi derecede okuyup yorumlayabilen, ASME ve API standartları ile tercihen Türkmenistan mevzuatı (SNiP/GOST) hakkında bilgi sahibi, İSG, kalite ve çevre kurallarına uygun saha çalışması konusunda güçlü uygulama deneyimine sahip, Ekip ve alt yüklenici yönetimi, iş planlaması, koordinasyon ve saha raporlaması konularında yetkin, MS Office ve Navisworks programlarını etkin şekilde kullanabilen, Tercihen iyi derecede İngilizce ve/veya Rusça bilen, Türkmenistan Kıyanlı Tesisi’nde çalışmaya ve proje çalışma düzenine uyum sağlayabilecek. Biz Neler Sunuyoruz? Performans ve başarıyı destekleyen prim uygulamaları Kapsamlı yan haklar ve çalışan destek uygulamaları Özel Sağlık Sigortası kapsamında çalışanlarımızı destekleyen sağlık uygulamaları Mesleki ve kişisel gelişimini destekleyen eğitim ve gelişim programları Çeşitlilik ve Eşitlik Beyanımız Rönesans Holding, şirketlere stratejilerini ve operasyonlarını evrensel insan hakları, çalışma, çevre ve yolsuzlukla mücadele ilkelerine uygun hale getirmeye ve toplumsal hedefleri ilerletecek önlemler almaya çağıran BM Küresel İlkeler Sözleşmesi'nin imzacıları arasında yer almaktadır ve Birleşmiş Milletler Küresel İlkeler Sözleşmesi çerçevesinde evrensel kabul görmüş beyanlara dayalı ilkeleri benimser. Rönesans Holding, ana ilkeleri olan dürüstlük, rekabetçilik ve yenilikçilikten ödün vermeden şeffaf ve etik değerleri gözeterek insan kaynakları uygulamalarında eşitliği sağlamayı amaçlayan bir işverendir. Tüm başvurular cinsiyet, dil, din, ırk ve etnik kökene bakmaksızın fırsat eşitliğine göre değerlendirilir ve ayırımcılık yapılmaz.

title: Kaynak Mühendisi (Borulama)
description: Biz Kimiz? 1993 yılında kurulan Rönesans Holding, bugün Türkiye, Avrupa, Orta Asya ve Afrika’yı kapsayan geniş bir coğrafyada; inşaat, gayrimenkul, enerji, endüstri ve sağlık alanlarında ana müteahhit ve yatırımcı olarak faaliyet göstermektedir. 40.000’i aşkın çalışanı ve 60’tan fazla milletten oluşan güçlü ve çok kültürlü ekibiyle Rönesans, dünyanın en büyük müteahhitlik şirketleri arasında yer almakta; sürdürülebilir bir gelecek inşa etme vizyonuyla yenilikçi ve küresel ölçekteki mühendislik projelerini hayata geçirmeye devam etmektedir. Şirketimizin Türkmenistan’da yapımını üstlendiği endüstriyel tesis projesinde görevlendirilmek üzere Kaynak Mühendisi (Borulama) aramaktayız. Bu Rolde Seni Neler Bekliyor? Kıyanlı Tesisi kapsamındaki borulama ve mekanik imalat/montaj projelerine ait tüm kaynak faaliyetlerinin uluslararası standartlara, müşteri şartnamelerine ve onaylı prosedürlere uygun olarak yürütülmesini sağlamak. Proje gereksinimlerine uygun olarak WPS ve PQR dokümanlarını hazırlamak, test süreçlerini (tahribatlı/tahribatsız) yönetmek ve ilgili onay merci/klas kuruluşlarına onaylatmak. Kaynakçıların uluslararası standartlara göre yeterlilik testlerini (WPQ) organize etmek, performanslarını değerlendirmek, kaynakçı sertifikalarını güncel tutmak ve sahada sadece yetkili oldukları yöntemlerde çalışmalarını sağlamak. Kaynak tamir (repair) oranlarını günlük/haftalık bazda analiz etmek, hata trendlerini belirleyerek kök neden analizi yapmak ve tamir oranlarını düşürmeye yönelik düzeltici/önleyici saha aksiyonları geliştirmek. Saha imalatı ve atölye süreçlerinde kullanılacak kaynak elektrotları, telleri, tozları ve argon/gaz sarf malzemelerinin teknik uygunluğunu denetlemek; depolama ve kurutma/fırınlama şartlarını kontrol etmek. Kaynak haritalarının tutulmasını, kaynakçı rumuzlarının işlenmesini ve tüm kaynak geçmişinin izlenebilirliğini sağlamak. Kaynak öncesi fit-up, kaynak esnası parametre (akım, gerilim, paso arası sıcaklık vb.) ve kaynak sonrası görsel kontrollerin (visual inspection) kalite planına uygun yapılmasını denetlemek. Gereken hatlar için kaynak sonrası ısı işlemi (PWHT) ve sertlik testi (hardness test) prosedürlerini hazırlamak, sahada uygulanmasını ve raporlamasını kontrol etmek. title: Makine ve Enerji Müdürü
description: 1947 yılında Hakkı Saruhan’ın Rize’de açtığı mağaza ile temeli atılan Saruhan Holding, 1970 yılında Saruhan Ailesi’nin ikinci neslinin yeni bir vizyon geliştirerek İstanbul’da farklı alanlardaki girişimleri sayesinde daha kapsamlı bir yapı halini aldı. Alçak ve yüksek gerilimli elektrik malzemeleri satışıyla başlayan ticaret; • Elektrikli Ev Aletleri • Endüstriyel Temizlik Makineleri • Her türlü toz ve sıvı deterjanların ithalatıyla devam etti. 1985 yılına gelindiğinde, Saruhan Holding, Alman Fakir Hausgeräte ve Nilco markalarının Türkiye ve yakın coğrafyasının genel distribütörü oldu. Bu birliktelik bir süre sonra kurulacak ilk fabrikanın da zeminini oluşturdu. 1996 yılında Saruhan Holding, Çorlu’da kendine ait makine fabrikasını kurarak, Alman mühendislerle birlikte üretilen sanayi tipi temizlik makinelerini dünyaya ihraç etmeye başladı. Şirket, 1999’da Çorlu’da yeni bir yatırım daha yaparak Saruhan Kimya Tesisleri’ni faaliyete geçirdi. Bu tesislerde hem yurt içinde satılmak hem de yurt dışına ihracat yapmak amacıyla yılda 25.000 ton deterjan ana hammaddesi Labsa, 55.000 ton toz deterjan, 60.000 ton sıvı deterjan üretimi gerçekleştirildi. Ürettiklerini satmak adına yurt içi ve yurt dışı distribütörlük ağlarını kurmasıyla birlikte dağıtım anlamında da güçlü bir isim halini aldı. 2007 yılına gelindiğinde, Almanya’da Saruhan Deutschland Holding kuruldu. Almanya merkezli faaliyetler geliştirmek adına kurulan firma ile Fakir Holding arasında kısa sürede stratejik ortaklık anlaşması yapıldı. Ardından hisse alımıyla tam ortaklık yapısına ulaşan Saruhan Holding, elektrikli ev aletlerinde 80 yıllık Alman teknolojisinin birikimine sahip Fakir ve Nilco’nun tüm “know-how”ıyla üretim yapan, dünya pazarlarına dağıtımını birlikte sürdüren sağlam bir beraberliğin de temelini attı. Son olarak De'Longhi ve Braun markalarının resmi distribütörü olan Saruhan Holding, kendi yolunda güvenle büyümeye devam etmektedir… Hızlı tüketim malları (FMCG) sektöründe lider konumda olan, deterjan ve hijyen ürünleri üretiminde yenilikçi çözümler sunan fabrikamız için, büyüme ve yatırım süreçlerimize liderlik edecek dinamik bir Makine ve Enerji Müdürü arıyoruz. Genel Nitelikler Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği , Elektrik Mühendisliği veya ilgili mühendislik fakültelerinden mezun. FMCG veya kimya sektörü ve bakım süreçlerinde en az 10 yıl deneyimli. Üretim tesislerinde bakım yönetimi, enerji optimizasyonu ve yeni yatırım projelerinin devreye alınması konularında güçlü, kanıtlanmış bir geçmişe sahip. SAP sistemini (özellikle PM - Plant Maintenance ve MM modüllerini) etkin bir şekilde kullanmış ve bakım süreçlerine entegre edebilen. Yasal mevzuatlara, iş sağlığı ve güvenliği (İSG) ile çevre standartlarına tam uyum sağlayarak çalışabilecek. Güçlü liderlik, analitik düşünce, problem çözme ve karar verme yetkinliklerine sahip. İyi derecede İngilizce bilen. Tekirdağ Çorlu, Çerkezköy, Kapaklı, Ergene ilçelerinde ikamet eden veya edebilecek olan. İş Tanımı Fabrika genelindeki tüm üretim hatlarının, ekipmanların ve planlı ve arıza bakım (kestirici/önleyici bakım) faaliyetlerini yönetmek. Üretim verimliliğini artırmak, arıza duruşlarını en aza indirmek ve OEE (Genel Ekipman Etkinliği) metriklerini sürekli iyileştirmek. Fabrikanın enerji tüketimini (elektrik, buhar, su vb.) optimize etmek, sürdürülebilirlik ve enerji verimliliği projelerine liderlik etmek. Planlanan yeni yatırım projelerinin (makine, altyapı, otomasyon) fizibilite, bütçeleme, satın alma, montaj ve devreye alma süreçlerini yönetmek. Bakım ve yatırım süreçlerinin tamamını SAP sistemi üzerinden takip etmek, raporlamak ve süreç iyileştirmeleri yapmak. Bakım ekibinin teknik gelişimini sağlamak, performansını yönetmek ve departman içi bütçeyi etkin bir şekilde yönetmek. İş Sağlığı, Güvenliği ve Çevre (İSG-Ç) kurallarına eksiksiz uyulmasını sağlayarak güvenli bir çalışma ortamı tesis etmek. Bu ilana başvurmanız kapsamında elde edilen kişisel verileriniz yalnızca başvurunuzun değerlendirilmesi, insan kaynakları süreçlerinin yürütülmesi, ilgili yönetici/birimle yapılacak görüşmelerin yürütülmesi ve şirketimiz bünyesinde pozisyona uygunluğunuzun ölçülmesi amaçlarıyla işlenir. Kişisel verileriniz yalnızca kurum içi iletişim teknolojilerinin kullanılması, saklama ve arşiv faaliyetlerinin yürütülmesi ve bilgi güvenliğinin sağlanması amacıyla teknoloji tedarikçilerimize aktarılır. Detaylı bilgi ve haklarınıza ilişkin ayrıntılar için saruhan.com.tr/kvkk adresini ziyaret edebilirsiniz.

title: Mechanical Design Engineer - Damascus Based
description: Position Objective: To provide independent technical review of mechanical design deliverables produced by the design consultant for data centre facilities. The Mechanical Designer acts on behalf of the PMO to verify that submitted designs are technically sound, code-compliant, buildable, and fully aligned with the project brief, employer’s requirements, and applicable standards across all stages from concept through Issued for Construction and Shop Drawings. Job Description & Responsibilities: Review and technically assess mechanical design submissions across all stages (concept, schematic, detailed design, Issued for Construction (IFC) and Shop Drawings) and issue structured, actionable review comments within agreed turnaround times. Assess mechanical design submissions including cooling load calculations, precision cooling system layouts (CRAC/CRAH, chillers, cooling towers), pipework schematics, Fire Fighting, HVAC ductwork arrangements, and equipment specifications against project requirements and industry best practice. Review fire suppression, plumbing, and drainage design packages for completeness, standard compliance, and compatibility with the wider building and mechanical systems. Verify that submitted designs comply with the applicable Tier classification requirements (TIA-942, Uptime Institute), resilience configurations (N+1, 2N), and the power usage effectiveness (PUE) targets set out in the project brief. Check mechanical design coordination across disciplines, identify unresolved spatial conflicts, interface gaps between mechanical sub-systems, and missing cross-discipline coordination between electrical, CSA, and ICT/ELV packages. Review BIM models and coordination reports submitted by the contractor, verify that mechanical systems are modelled to the required LOD, and confirm clash detection has been carried out and resolved prior to IFC issue. Track the status of all open review comments, verify the adequacy of contractor responses and resubmissions, and maintain a live register of outstanding and closed technical issues. Attend design review meetings, design coordination workshops, and BIM coordination sessions as the PMO’s mechanical technical representative; prepare and issue meeting minutes and action trackers. Support the PMO team during construction by reviewing mechanical shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, FAT and SAT procedures, and commissioning plans; flag deviations from the approved IFC design and raise non-conformance records as required. Qualifications & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering. Minimum 8–12 years of experience in mechanical engineering for data centers or mission-critical facilities, with a demonstrated track record in design on consultancy-side engagements. Deep technical knowledge of data center mechanical systems: Precision cooling, diesel generators, BMS, drainage, fire suppression, and HVAC. Strong familiarity with Tier classification standards (TIA-942, Uptime Institute), resilience design principles, and PUE benchmarking. Proficiency in reviewing mechanical design packages produced in AutoCAD, Revit MEP, ETAP, or equivalent tools; ability to interrogate calculation reports and verify design assumptions. Working knowledge of BIM coordination processes (Revit, Navisworks) sufficient to review federated models and assess LOD compliance. Thorough knowledge of applicable standards: IEC 60364, BS 7671, NFPA 70/75, ASHRAE A2, and local authority requirements. Strong written communication skills: able to produce clear, well-referenced review comment schedules and technical correspondence.

title: Stembio / StemHeart - Tıbbi Cihaz Kalite ve Regülasyon Kıdemli Uzmanı / Medical Device Quality & Regulatory Senior Specialist
description: StemHeart, şu anda erken prototipleme aşamasında bulunan yenilikçi bir sentetik kalp kapağı teknolojisi geliştirmektedir . StemHeart, Koç Healthcare bünyesinde faaliyet gösteren Stembio’nun yönetimi altında çalışmalarını sürdürmekte olup; Stembio’nun kalite, regülasyon ve operasyonel altyapısından ve daha geniş Koç Healthcare ekosisteminden faydalanmaktadır. Proje kapsamında ayrıca Koç Üniversitesi Hastanesi bünyesinde, ilerleyen dönemde akredite bir kalp kapağı test ve geliştirme merkezine dönüştürülmesi planlanan özel bir alan bulunmaktadır. StemHeart için kalite ve regülasyon altyapısını kuracak ve hayata geçirecek bir Tıbbi Cihaz Kalite ve Regülasyon Kıdemli Uzmanı arıyoruz. Pozisyonun temel sorumluluğu, Sınıf III bir tıbbi cihaz için ISO 13485’e uygun bir Kalite Yönetim Sistemi’ni (KYS) sıfırdan kurmak ve kalite ile mevzuat gerekliliklerinin prototip ve tasarım geliştirmeden doğrulama ve geçerli kılma çalışmalarına, üretime hazırlıktan tedarikçi kontrollerine, ruhsatlandırma/uygunluk değerlendirme başvurularından piyasaya arz sonrası süreçlere hazırlık ve ticarileştirmeye kadar ürün yaşam döngüsünün tüm aşamalarına entegre edilmesini sağlamaktır. Bu pozisyon ayrıca hastane bünyesindeki kalp kapağı test ve geliştirme tesisinin, akreditasyon kapsamı doğrultusunda ISO/IEC 17025 gerekliliklerini karşılayan akredite bir test ve geliştirme merkezi olarak yapılandırılmasını destekleyecektir. Mevcut bir kalite sistemini yalnızca sürdürmekle sınırlı kalmayıp, kurum genelinde tıbbi cihaz Kalite Yönetim Sistemi’ni kurabilecek ve uygulamaya alabilecek, sahada aktif rol üstlenen bir profesyonel arıyoruz. İdeal adayın prototip ve tasarım geliştirme → tedarikçi ve üretim kontrolleri → doğrulama ve geçerli kılma → düzenleyici onay/uygunluk değerlendirmesi → ticarileştirme süreçlerinin bütününe hâkim olması ve her aşamada gerekli kalite altyapısını oluşturabilmesi beklenmektedir. Genel Nitelikler Biyomedikal Mühendisliği, Makine Mühendisliği, Malzeme Mühendisliği, Biyomühendislik, Yaşam Bilimleri veya ilgili bir alanda lisans veya üzeri derece. Tercihen en az 5 yıl tıbbi cihaz kalite güvencesi/regülasyon (QA/RA) deneyimi; KYS’yi bağımsız olarak kurup yönetmesi beklenen adaylar için 7 yıl ve üzeri deneyim tercih sebebidir. ISO 13485 KYS’nin kurulması, kapsamlı biçimde iyileştirilmesi veya uygulanmasında doğrudan sorumluluk üstlenmiş olmak zorunludur. ISO 13485, ISO 14971, EU MDR 2017/745 ve Türkiye’de geçerli tıbbi cihaz mevzuatı hakkında güçlü uygulama bilgisi. Tasarım kontrolleri, teknik dokümantasyon, risk yönetimi, CAPA, iç/dış denetimler, validasyon, üretim kalitesi ve tedarikçi kalitesi alanlarında uygulamalı deneyim. Onaylanmış Kuruluş denetimleri, belgelendirme projeleri veya düzenleyici otoritelerle yürütülen süreçlerde deneyim güçlü tercih sebebidir. Kardiyovasküler, implante edilebilir, Sınıf III veya diğer yüksek riskli tıbbi cihazlarda deneyim önemli tercih sebebidir. Önceki görev kapsamına bağlı olarak ISO 5840 serisi, ISO 10993, sterilizasyon/ambalaj validasyonu veya ISO/IEC 17025 bilgisi avantajdır. ISO 13485 iç denetçi/baş denetçi yetkinliği ve/veya geçerli şartlar kapsamında Mevzuata Uygunluktan Sorumlu Kişi (PRRC) rolünü üstlenme şartlarını karşılamak avantajdır. Türkçe ve İngilizcede güçlü iletişim, dokümantasyon ve paydaş yönetimi becerileri. Bağımsız çalışabilme, riskleri önceliklendirebilme, yapıcı biçimde sorgulayabilme ve birden fazla fonksiyon ile lokasyonda uygulamaya liderlik edebilme. Rol ve Sorumluluklar 1. Kalite Yönetim Sistemi • ISO 13485’e uygun bir KYS oluşturmak, uygulamak ve düzenleyici gerekliliklere hazırlık yol haritasını geliştirmek. • Standart operasyon prosedürleri (SOP), kayıtlar, doküman ve değişiklik kontrolü, sapmalar, düzeltici ve önleyici faaliyetler (CAPA), denetimler ve yönetimin gözden geçirmesi dâhil temel KYS dokümantasyonunu hazırlamak ve güncel tutmak. • Ar-Ge, mühendislik, üretim, tedarik zinciri, insan kaynakları ve yönetim birimleri arasında süreç sahipliğini, sorumlulukları, eskalasyon mekanizmalarını ve fonksiyonlar arası uygulamayı netleştirmek. 2. Tasarım, Risk ve Ürün Geliştirme Planlama, tasarım girdileri ve çıktıları, tasarım gözden geçirmeleri, doğrulama, geçerli kılma, tasarım transferi ve tasarım değişiklikleri dâhil tasarım ve geliştirme kontrollerini oluşturmak ve sürdürmek. ISO 14971’e uygun yaşam döngüsü boyunca risk yönetimini uygulamak ve sürdürmek; risk kontrollerinin tasarım, test, üretim ve üretim sonrası bilgilerle ilişkilendirilmesini sağlamak. Kalp kapağının prototip/Ar-Ge aşamasından kontrollü ve valide edilmiş üretime aktarılmasını desteklemek. 3. Üretim ve Tedarikçi Kalitesi Üretim, ekipman kalifikasyonu, proses validasyonu, çevresel ve üretim kontrolleri, ürün kabulü/serbest bırakılması ve uygunsuzluk yönetimine ilişkin kalite gerekliliklerini oluşturmak. Tedarikçi kalifikasyonu ve performans takibi, gerektiğinde kalite anlaşmaları, satın alma kontrolleri, girdi muayenesi ile malzeme/bileşen izlenebilirliği süreçlerini oluşturmak. Dış kaynaklı ve kritik süreçler üzerinde yeterli kalite gözetimini sağlamak. Uygulanabilir olduğu durumlarda sterilizasyon, ambalajlama, taşıma ve raf ömrü validasyonuna ilişkin kalite gerekliliklerini koordine etmek. 4. Personel ve Eğitim • İnsan Kaynakları ve ilgili birim yöneticileriyle birlikte yetkinlik, eğitim ve kalifikasyon gerekliliklerini belirlemek. Pozisyona dayalı eğitim matrislerini güncel tutmak ve personelin düzenlemeye tabi faaliyetleri bağımsız olarak gerçekleştirmeden önce gerekli yetkinliğe sahip olmasını sağlamak. Farklı fonksiyonlardaki ekiplere uygulamaya dönük kalite rehberliği sunmak ve önleyici yaklaşıma dayalı kalite kültürünün yerleşmesini desteklemek. 5. Regülasyon Süreçleri Türkiye ve Avrupa Birliği için AB Tıbbi Cihaz Tüzüğü (EU MDR 2017/745), CE işaretlemesi ve teknik dokümantasyon dâhil regülasyon stratejisini desteklemek. • Dış kuruluşlar, test merkezleri, sertifikasyon kuruluşları ve Onaylanmış Kuruluşlar ile yürütülen regülasyon, sertifikasyon ve test faa

title: Research Engineer – Multi-Agent Systems & A2A Intelligence
description: Türkiye R&D Center is pioneering the next frontier of autonomous network intelligence through OpenAN (Open Autonomous Networks) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) collaboration architectures for 5.5G and future 6G systems. We are seeking Research Engineers in Computer Science or Artificial Intelligence to join our research team. In this role, you will tackle fundamental challenges in distributed agent coordination, collaborative negotiation protocols, semantic intent alignment, and safe agentic workflows. You will conduct cutting-edge applied research with direct impact on carrier-grade networks operating at global scale. Key Research Focus Areas 1- Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Coordination & Negotiation Protocols Distributed multi-agent architectures for autonomous cross-domain network orchestration. Negotiation protocols, dynamic consensus mechanisms, and conflict resolution in heterogeneous multi-agent systems. Deadlock detection, prevention, and cycle-breaking in iterative multi-agent communications. 2- Intent Understanding, Knowledge Graphs & Semantic Alignment Natural language intent parsing and bidirectional translation between business objectives and technical network configurations. Domain-specific Knowledge Graph (KG) construction, ontology design, and schema alignment across OSS and RAN domains. Multi-turn dialogue management and persistent memory architectures for autonomous agents. 3- Safety, Trust & Hallucination Mitigation in Multi-Agent Workflows Hallucination detection and mitigation in LLM-based autonomous decision-making loops. Trust models, formal verification, and policy guardrails for agent-to-agent interactions in critical infrastructure. Key Responsibilities Conduct fundamental and applied research at the intersection of Multi-Agent Systems, Foundation Models, and Autonomous Systems. Design novel algorithms, protocols, and architectural prototypes validated on real-world and simulated network environments. Publish research findings in top-tier AI and networking venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, AAAI, AAMAS, SIGCOMM, INFOCOM). File high-value international patents and contribute novel proposals to global standardization initiatives (e.g., 3GPP, O-RAN, ITU-T). Collaborate with global Telecom Operators, Huawei HQ researchers, and local academic partners at top Turkish universities. Qualifications Required: PhD with strong publication in related area / MSc Degree with 3+ years research experience in academics/industry Demonstrated research track record in at least two of the following areas: Multi-Agent Systems (MAS), Game Theory, or Distributed AI Large Language Model (LLM) Agents, Tool Use, and Agentic Workflows Knowledge Graphs, Ontologies, or Semantic Web Natural Language Processing (NLP) / Information Extraction Formal Methods, Deadlock Prevention, or Consensus Protocols Solid publication record in reputable conferences or journals. Strong programming skills in Python and deep learning/agent frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, LangGraph, AutoGen, or custom distributed agent platforms). Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal). Preferred: Prior exposure to telecommunications concepts, network management (OSS/RAN), or 3GPP service architecture (helpful, but domain background will be provided). Experience with open-source foundation models (fine-tuning, RLHF, alignment, quantization). Track record of filing patents or contributing to open-source systems.

Tijdens deze afstudeerstage werk je aan een actueel vraagstuk binnen de wereld van beweegbare bruggen. Je kiest een onderwerp dat past bij jouw interesses, zoals de aandrijving van bruggen, verbindingen in constructies of het hergebruik van onderdelen. Het afstudeeronderwerp bespreken wij samen tijdens een kennismakingsgesprek. Je combineert onderzoek met praktijkgerichte adviezen en levert een bijdrage aan een veilige, duurzame en betrouwbare infrastructuur. Dit ben jij bij Movares je volgt een hbo- of wo(master)-opleiding Werktuigbouwkunde; je toont initiatief, pakt kansen op en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je onderzoek; je werkt analytisch, legt verbanden en vertaalt inzichten naar heldere adviezen; je zoekt actief de samenwerking op en deelt kennis met collega's. Een stage bij Movares is een kickstart van je carrière, en dat heeft verschillende redenen. Daarnaast kom je terecht in een groep mede-afstudeerders, allemaal gelijkgestemden. Elk jaar verwelkomt Movares namelijk tussen de 30 en 40 stagiaires. Hen ontmoet je tijdens de maandelijkse bijeenkomsten van Movares Backstage, waar de verbinding met anderen voorop staat. Soms gaan jullie samen lunchen of bezoeken jullie een project. Andere maanden staat er een inhoudelijke sessie op de planning en leer je bijvoorbeeld beter presenteren of adviseren. En ook als lid van onze jongerenvereniging staan er regelmatig leuke activiteiten in je agenda. Daarnaast kun je elke tweede dinsdag van de maand aanschuiven bij het Café van de Toekomst: een inspiratiesessie waarbij je samen met je collega’s wordt bijgepraat over onderwerpen en projecten die in onze organisatie spelen. En dat is nog niet alles: je kunt gebruikmaken van onze eigen Academy met ruim 3.000 verschillende leerlijnen, trainingen en e-learningmodules. Dit krijg je bij Movares Bij Movares werk je mee aan een uitdagende opdracht met volop kansen om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Er hangt een leuke en gezellige sfeer. Je krijgt een kijkje in de keuken van een toonaangevend advies- en ingenieursbureau, volop ruimte voor eigen initiatief en goede begeleiding. De duur en startdatum zijn in overleg nader te bepalen. Verder krijg je: een aantrekkelijke vergoeding van €550 op basis van een fulltime dienstverband; ruimte voor het vinden van jouw ideale werk-privé-balans; leuke collega’s en een afstudeerplek in hartje Utrecht. En er is méér. Want afstuderen bij Movares betekent ook: bijdragen aan een schone wereld, omdat je stageloopt bij het eerste bedrijf in Nederland met een Zero Waste-certificaat; lid worden van Young Movares, de jongerenvereniging waar je leert van én met andere jonge collega’s. Jouw team bij Movares Voor jou als Afstudeerstagiair(e) Werktuigbouwkunde is er plek op onze afdeling Civiele Constructies in team Werktuigbouw. Je komt terecht in een hecht team van betrokken specialisten die werken aan beweegbare bruggen en andere complexe kunstwerken. Binnen het team combineren we diepgaande technische kennis met nieuwsgierigheid en innovatiekracht. We werken nauw samen met collega's uit de disciplines Staalbouw, Beton en Bruginstallaties. Daardoor kijk je ook verder dan je eigen vakgebied en leer je hoe integrale oplossingen tot stand komen. De sfeer is open en toegankelijk: collega's helpen elkaar graag, delen kennis actief en geven je de ruimte om ideeën uit te werken. Samen werken we aan een veilige, duurzame en betrouwbare infrastructuur voor Nederland.
