Over this 4-year programme, you’ll study towards a BEng (Hons) in Professional Engineering (Product Design) while gaining hands-on experience on initiatives that support the safe delivery of nuclear new build and decommissioning projects. It provides a solid foundation for a rewarding career in the nuclear industry. About The Programme As a Mechanical Engineering Apprentice at Cavendish Nuclear, you’ll join a collaborative and experienced team working across all phases of the engineering lifecycle. Whether you’re supporting new build or decommissioning projects, you’ll play a vital role in the UK’s civil nuclear sector helping to deliver national energy resilience, meet net zero commitments, and safely clean up the nuclear legacy. You’ll work on a variety of nuclear projects, from developing new technologies and maintaining essential systems to extending the life of vital infrastructure. Your day-to-day activities will include hands-on experience with Computer Aided Design (CAD), 3D modelling, mechanical calculations, and producing engineering documentation to national and international standards. You’ll support operational teams, resolve technical issues, and inform decisions that impact real-world outcomes. As part of your role, you’ll define design requirements, develop 3D CAD models, produce detailed engineering drawings, and carry out scoping calculations. You’ll also prepare equipment specifications, technical reports, and help manage plant and equipment obsolescence to ensure systems remain safe and reliable. Supporting assembly, testing, and operational teams, you’ll offer technical guidance, resolve engineering queries, and manage nonconformance issues, while gaining exposure to advanced engineering tools such as Finite Element Analysis (FEA) software. Based at one of our key sites in Warrington, you’ll support major projects at locations like Sellafield. You’ll begin by shadowing experienced engineers, building a strong foundation in design, modelling, calculations, and documentation. As you develop, you’ll take on more complex tasks and gain valuable experience across the full design lifecycle. Every drawing, design, or calculation you contribute to plays a part in protecting people, the environment, and the nation’s energy future. Throughout your apprenticeship, you’ll be surrounded by supportive mentors and experienced engineers who are invested in your growth. You’ll be part of a wider emerging talent community, sharing experiences and learning alongside other apprentices across the business. You’ll be trusted to take ownership of your development and supported every step of the way as you turn theory into real-world impact. Your education/training You will study towards the Product Design and Development Engineer (Degree) Apprenticeship standard through the University of Lancashire. Your training will be delivered through a blended learning model that combines in-person and online teaching. Each semester begins with a three-day block of face-to-face delivery, followed by weekly online sessions throughout the term. This structure is designed to support both academic learning and practical application. The programme is tailored for engineers involved in product development and integrates key disciplines such as materials science, computer-aided design (CAD), systems integration, and prototyping. It focuses on equipping learners to create fit-for-purpose solutions in regulated environments. Upon successful completion, you will be awarded a BEng (Hons) in Professional Engineering (Product Design) and a Level 6 Degree Apprenticeship qualification. Future prospects By the end of your apprenticeship, you’ll be ready to take on the role of Mechanical Engineer. You’ll also have the opportunity to build on your progress toward professional registration as an Incorporated Engineer, a recognised benchmark of engineering competence. As a global organisation, Babcock provides countless opportunities to enhance your skills and advance your career. To support your growth, we’ve introduced the Babcock Role Framework, which outlines roles, career pathways, and development opportunities. With every job mapped to these frameworks, you’ll have a transparent view of the steps needed to reach Senior Engineer and beyond. title: Manufacturing Engineer
description: We are seeking a Manufacturing Engineer to own the manufacture, assembly, and scale-up of the robotic hardware that powers our company. As we move from our first facility to a global fleet, you will turn engineering prototypes into reliable, repeatable, manufacturable systems — and build the processes that let us produce them at pace and at quality. What sets this role apart is that you are not maintaining a mature line — you are building how we manufacture our platform, with direct influence on the hardware itself. If turning ambitious hardware into a repeatable, scalable reality sounds like the right shape of job for you, we’d love to welcome you to our team. Key Responsibilities Take robotic and instrument hardware from prototype to repeatable production, owning build and assembly processes. Drive design-for-manufacture and design-for-assembly feedback back into the hardware teams. Develop and document assembly procedures, test rigs, jigs/fixtures, and acceptance/QC criteria. Manage build quality, troubleshoot issues on the floor, and drive continuous improvement. Work with supply chain on components, BOMs, tolerances, and supplier quality. Support installation, commissioning, and bring-up of systems Work with contract manufactures to manage build quality, troubleshoot issues on the floor, and drive continuous improvement. About You You are a hands-on manufacturing engineer who is as comfortable on the workshop floor as in a design review. You like turning one-off builds into repeatable processes, and you are rigorous about quality and documentation without losing pragmatism. We expect you to bring: 3–5+ years in manufacturing, production, or mechanical/automation engineering, ideally for complex electromechanical or robotic hardware. Hands-on experience with assembly processes, DFM/DFA, fixturing, test, and QC. Comfort reading mechanical drawings and working closely with design engineers. A practical, problem-solving mindset and rigour around process and documentation. Familiarity with relevant safety and quality standards in a workshop/production environment. Beneficial Skills Experience scaling hardware from low volume to higher-volume production. Exposure to fluidics, pumps, valves, motion systems, or lab instrumentation. Lean / continuous-improvement and supplier-management experience.

Demonstrated ability to lead projects, coordinate cross-functional teams, and deliver improvements in quality, cost, and delivery performance. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proficiency in using data and metrics to drive decisions. title: Graduate Mechanical Engineer
description: Company NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there. Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris. Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators. Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it. Hiring now We are hiring as soon as possible. This role is for someone who has already graduated, or who will complete their degree in time to start with us very soon. We are not able to consider final-year students who graduate in summer 2027 or later, and this is not a graduate scheme with a fixed annual intake. Role Overview This is a first full-time engineering role on the NEO-1 satellite. You will design satellite hardware and help keep the satellite's full CAD assembly organised as the design matures, learning from our lead designer and working in a small, multidisciplinary team. You will take ownership of real parts early, translate requirements into manufacturable designs and support their validation through prototyping and environmental testing. Key Responsibilities Design and develop mechanical hardware for the satellite, such as brackets, panels, component mounts, thermal-control hardware and cable and harness routing, with guidance from the lead designer. Work in the satellite's large 3D CAD assembly alongside the wider design team, learning how to keep interfaces, configurations and revisions in step as several designers work in the same model. Support assembly configuration, PLM data (3DEXPERIENCE ('3DX') or similar), bills of materials and engineering change control (ECO/ECR/ECN), so that models, drawings and interfaces stay consistent as changes are released. Run interference and clash checks and help maintain the digital mock-up, working with each subsystem owner to allocate space and resolve conflicts. Produce dimensioned, manufacturing-ready drawings using GD&T, with review from senior engineers. Support design reviews (PDR and CDR) and qualification, working with structural and thermal engineers. Work with manufacturers and suppliers to make designs easier to build, and to balance cost, mass and reliability. Support prototype builds, integration and environmental test campaigns, iterating designs based on results. Collaborate with electrical, software, systems and thermal engineers to integrate mechanical components into the satellite platform. Required Skills & Experience Bachelor's or master's degree in mechanical, aerospace or a related engineering discipline, completed or completing very soon. Hands-on 3D CAD skills from university projects, a placement or an internship (SolidWorks preferred; CATIA, NX or Creo also considered). Working knowledge of GD&T and experience producing engineering drawings, including from coursework or a team project. Solid grounding in mechanical design principles, materials and thermal management, with a working understanding of structural mechanics. Evidence of designing, building and testing something real, such as a placement project, Formula Student, a UAV, or a rocketry or satellite team, including troubleshooting and iteration. Clear communicator who is comfortable explaining and defending design decisions, and open to feedback and challenge in a fast-moving team. Preferred Experience A placement, internship or year in industry in aerospace, space, motorsport or another high-reliability field. Experience of several people working in one CAD assembly, for example in a Formula Student or university team, including how files and revisions were controlled. Exposure to PLM or PDM systems (for example 3DEXPERIENCE ('3DX'), Windchill, Teamcenter, ENOVIA or SolidWorks PDM) or to formal engineering change processes (ECO/ECR/ECN). Experience of design reviews, documented requirements and standards. Satellite, CubeSat or rocketry project experience, including hardware that has launched. Basic FEA familiarity and exposure to manufacturing processes. Why NewOrbit Space? Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO. Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology. Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success. Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups. Hybrid working - One dedicated remote day per week. Visa sponsorship and relocation support - We sponsor visas and provide relocation support for candidates moving to join us.

title: Graduate Mechanical Engineer (Building Services)
description: Let’s Transform Society Together We are Sweco. We are Europe’s leading design, engineering, environment and regulatory consultancy. We are future planners, city shapers, urban innovators, digital transformers, net zero chasers, community connectors, social enterprisers and lifestyle improvers. We are #DifferenceMakers. And we are now taking applications for the Autumn 2027 cohort of our Early Careers Graduate Scheme. Now Recruiting: Graduate Mechanical Engineer to Join Our Building Services Division Uniquely, we recruit to role and right now we’re looking for Graduate Mechanical Engineers to join our innovative Building Services division. Given Sweco’s global recognition as a successful Building Services Consultant, and our history of delivering the world’s most sustainable buildings such as the Bloomberg European headquarters and achieving the highest ever BREEAM score, we’d like to hear from graduates that share our ethos and values but are driven to truly transform the world around them. What Does the Role Involve? As a Graduate Mechanical Engineer, You Will Work as an integral team member on some of the most prestigious construction projects in the UK, working alongside world class architects and innovative engineering teams. Carry out thermal analysis and assessment of ventilation requirements to determine loads for central plant and systems. Compare alternative mechanical design proposals and develop the building with the design team to incorporate passive and active design solutions. Develop the building energy strategy to adopt appropriate sustainable and low carbon mechanical design systems. Select appropriate plant and equipment to develop mechanical plantroom configurations. Write technical reports, design presentations and prepare tender drawings and specifications. Use thermal modelling software and CAD including AutoCad and Revit. Visit construction sites and witness system commissioning. Who Are We Looking For? Our unique, personalised programme is designed for passionate, forward-thinking graduates who want to change the world around them, who will thrive in a dynamic team environment, and who are hungry to collaborate not only with fellow graduates, but also with mentors and leaders across the business. Our Graduate Scheme offers a two-year blended learning experience, with a tailored programme delivered virtually and face-to-face. You’ll have the chance to network and grow with the 2027 cohort. Personal growth will be supported by our Early Careers team, mentors and subject matter experts from across the business. Structured masterclasses focus on Internal Insight, Skills Development, and Subject Matter Expertise, helping fast-track your development as you pursue professional accreditation. The programme builds your confidence early in your career and gives you a platform for genuine impact within Sweco. You’ll receive a permanent position with an industry-standard salary and benefits package, including 25 days holiday, a great pension and life assurance. Please note, we will hold an assessment centre for this position in January / February 2027. All applicants will be contacted regardless of the outcome. We provide feedback to all attendees of interviews or assessment centres but are unable to offer personal feedback at the application stage. Ready to Make a Difference with Us? Apply now, and let's transform society together. Employee Benefits Flexible and hybrid working (Flexworks Policy) Competitive pension contribution Life Assurance Private Medical Insurance Discretionary Annual Bonus Scheme Payment of two relevant professional subscriptions 25 days holiday plus bank holidays (with the option to purchase up to 5 additional days per year) Cycle2Work Scheme Employee Assistance Programme (wellbeing, mental health, financial and work advice) Employee discounts via Sweco Benefit Select (Faircare) Salary Sacrifice Electric Vehicle Scheme We plant a tree for all new starters! About Us Transforming society together, we're planning and designing sustainable communities and cities of the future. Solving the great societal challenges of our time is more relevant, demanding and inspiring than ever before. At Sweco, we bring together experts with different perspectives and skills to develop solutions that address the challenges of urbanisation, harness the positive power of digitalisation and make societies more sustainable. We offer our clients a combination of global expertise and local presence, adapted to their business and reality. Our ambition is to be our clients’ most relevant partner, working together to help them solve their challenges, today and into the future. Sweco is committed to enabling all its colleagues to achieve a great balance between work and their other priorities, such as caring responsibilities, leisure activities, further learning or other interests. We offer flexible start and finish times, part time and hybrid working options so that you can flex your hours around your day to day needs. Equality, Diversity & Inclusion It’s important to us that that all our colleagues thrive at work - we strive to have a friendly and inclusive culture which respects the contribution individuals can bring to Sweco. We aim to promote equality, inclusivity and diversity for everyone. Here at Sweco we positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment

title: Ingeniero mecánico
description: Somos Pramac, una empresa de Generac, que lidera la evolución hacia soluciones energéticas más resilientes, eficientes y sostenibles. Fundada en 1966, nuestra empresa ha evolucionado constantemente, ampliando nuestra cartera de productos y convirtiéndose en un referente mundial en la producción de generadores y equipos para la manipulación de materiales en almacenes. Nuestras diversas líneas de negocio nos posicionan como líderes en una amplia variedad de mercados globales. Ingeniero/a mecánico/a – Desarrollo de producto Responsable del diseño y desarrollo de soluciones mecánicas para grupos electrógenos y cuadros eléctricos de Pramac, desde la definición técnica hasta su industrialización. El puesto combina tareas de diseño con la toma de decisiones de ingeniería, la validación de soluciones y la optimización del producto, asegurando su funcionalidad, fabricabilidad y cumplimiento de los requisitos normativos y de calidad. Documentación técnica: elaborar, revisar y mantener planos, especificaciones y listas de materiales, garantizando su coherencia y trazabilidad. Industrialización: apoyar la transferencia del diseño a producción, asegurando la fabricabilidad y resolviendo incidencias durante su implantación. Colaboración técnica: trabajar con Producción, Calidad, Compras e Industrialización para resolver problemas y asegurar la correcta interpretación y ejecución del diseño. No se requiere experiencia profesional previa. Se valorará experiencia en el sector de grupos electrógenos o en diseño y desarrollo de maquinaria.

description: Would you like to work with Industrial & Energy Technology business? Do you thrive on transforming complex engineering challenges into reliable, manufacturable solutions? Partner with the best Baker Hughes stands as a leading global energy‑technology company, delivering innovative solutions that make energy safer, cleaner, and more efficient across the entire value chain. Operating in more than 120 countries, the company blends deep industrial expertise with advanced engineering and digital technologies to support energy production, transformation, and decarbonization. With over a century of heritage, Baker Hughes partners with customers in oil and gas, industrial sectors, and emerging energy markets to accelerate progress toward a more sustainable energy future. Fuel your passion Person in this position will be responsible for the design of centrifugal compressors. It includes activities linked to technical improvement of existing products and components. Positions require understanding of concepts, methods and procedures used in the design of mechanical components for compression products. On this position you will be responsible to cooperate effectively with engineering suppliers to ensure smooth project execution and highest quality of technical documentation. This role is ideal for early-career mechanical engineers with initial experience in the Oil & Gas, energy, turbomachinery, or rotating equipment industries who are looking to further develop their expertise in centrifugal compressor design. As a Mechanical Engineer you will be responsible for: Leading and executing the compressor design process in the assigned role of Design Engineer (DE) or Mechanical Design Engineer (MDE), depending on project complexity and technical requirements. Performing key calculations, sizing, stage selection, and mechanical analyses to define the machine configuration and to ensure technical compliance with project scope. Collaborating with assigned engineering suppliers to coordinate project execution, while reviewing and validating 2D/3D designs and engineering calculations using Unigraphics NX. Releasing documentation and BOM’s in a timely manner and in accordance with project plan (Teamcenter, SAP). Leading design reviews throughout the engineering process to ensure the highest quality standards and full compliance with API 617, ASME, and other applicable industry standards. Collaborating with manufacturing, quality and testing departments to support project execution. Driving continuous improvement by capturing and sharing lessons learned across engineering teams, promoting technical excellence and knowledge transfer. To be successful in this role you will: Demonstrate a solid understanding of centrifugal compressor applications and related engineering principles, and have experience as a mechanical design engineer, preferably for centrifugal compressors. Possess knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) in accordance with ANSI Y14.5 standards, along with basic knowledge of the mechanical analyses required for rotating equipment design, including rotor dynamics, stress analysis, and component sizing. Bring basic knowledge about material selection, coating systems, welding processes, corrosion mechanisms, and non-destructive examination (NDE) techniques. Be proficient in 3D CAD modeling, preferably using Siemens NX (Unigraphics NX). Demonstrate strong verbal and written communication skills in English and effectively collaborate within multicultural and cross-functional teams. Successfully manage multiple priorities and deliverables while working in a project-driven environment. Show a proactive, results-oriented mindset with a strong commitment to quality, safety, and continuous improvement. Bring a Master’s degree in mechanical engineering from a recognized university, preferably in disciplines such as Energy Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Robotics, or related fields. Work in a way that works for you We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following hybrid working patterns: Working in a hybrid environment : This role requires a high level of autonomy, accountability, and ownership. Success depends on effective coordination with multiple internal and external stakeholders. Therefore, regular on-site presence is preferred to support collaboration, communication, and execution. During the initial onboarding and team integration phase, a full-time on-site presence (five days per week) will be expected for approximately 6-9 months. Thereafter, and depending on the performance and progress demonstrated within the role, the working arrangement may transition to a hybrid model with a minimum on-site presence of 3-4 days per week. Working for you Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we must push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. title: Advanced R&D Engineer

At Intralox, one of the world’s leading innovators in conveyance solutions, we are looking for an Advanced R&D Engineer to join our R&D team in Eindhoven and play a key role in turning emerging technologies into practical products and customer solutions. Why this role matters Our Advanced R&D team explores new and emerging technologies that can shape the next generation of Intralox solutions. We work across disciplines including magnetics, motors, actuators, sensing, vision, robotics, and mechatronics. Rather than focusing on one established product or repeating the same assignments, the team investigates varied applications and develops net-new technology. Curiosity, experimentation, collaboration, and practical problem-solving are central to how we work. As an Advanced R&D Engineer, you will explore promising technologies and translate them into prototypes, concepts, and integrated solutions. Based in Eindhoven, you will work closely with local technical colleagues and collaborate with Advanced R&D team members in the US. You will have the freedom to move between different technologies and applications, combining sound engineering principles with hands-on experimentation to solve real customer challenges. What You’ll Do Explore new and emerging technologies to identify opportunities for innovative products and customer solutions. Develop and evaluate prototypes to turn early-stage ideas into technically viable concepts. Design, build, and test concepts involving magnetics, motors, actuators, sensing, vision, robotics, or related technologies. Apply simulation and engineering analysis to improve design decisions and reduce technical risk. Use rapid-prototyping methods, including 3D printing, to accelerate learning and concept validation. Investigate supplier technologies and assess their potential for use in future Intralox applications. Combine multiple technologies into integrated solutions that address practical customer needs. Consider machining, injection molding, and other production methods to improve the manufacturability of proposed designs. Document and communicate technical findings so that colleagues across locations can build on your work. Collaborate with engineers in Europe and the US to connect global expertise and advance shared R&D initiatives. Participate in occasional customer visits, installations, and technical collaboration sessions in Europe and the US. What You Bring A bachelor’s, master’s, or doctoral degree in mechatronics, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, robotics, applied physics, or a related technical discipline. At least five years of relevant experience in industrial engineering, product development, advanced R&D, or a comparable applied-technology environment. An understanding of manufacturability, including machining, injection molding, and other relevant production processes. Hands-on experience developing, prototyping, testing, or validating physical products and technical concepts. The ability to connect theoretical engineering principles with practical implementation and customer needs. The flexibility to work across unfamiliar technologies and pivot between different applications and development challenges. A curious, open-minded, and collaborative approach, with the confidence to work effectively when requirements or solutions are not yet fully defined. Willingness to work from our Eindhoven office at least three days per week and to travel occasionally. Nice-to-have: Experience in one or more of the following areas: magnetic drives, motors, actuators, sensing, vision systems, robotics, mechatronics, simulation, or 3D printing. If you don’t meet every requirement but are excited about the role, we still encourage you to apply. Why Intralox? International environment with opportunities to grow your career globally. A supportive, high-performing team that values collaboration. A workplace driven by ideas, innovation, and ownership. A financially strong, market-leading brand. Performance-based profit sharing. 25 holiday days + 6 ATV days. Excellent benefits package including a mobility card for business and personal use, pension scheme and contributions to health & life insurance. Building great things together Intralox is a global leader in innovative conveyance solutions, with more than 3,000 employees across 20+ countries. For over 50 years, we’ve helped customers grow by solving complex challenges with smart, reliable solutions. At our core is a simple principle: do the right thing. We’ve built a culture grounded in honesty, fairness, and respect, where every idea is valued, and great thinking can come from anywhere. Self-managed, curious individuals thrive here. We believe great results start with great people. That’s why we bring together driven, collaborative teams who are passionate about making a real-world impact. You’ll be empowered to take initiative, supported in your growth, and encouraged to continuously improve, while working alongside colleagues who celebrate shared success. Note: To be considered for this role, you need to be based in the Netherlands and have a valid work permit. EOE/M/F/Vet/Disabled

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer - Deployable Solar Arrays
description: Job Description Rockets have not gotten wider. Satellites need far more power than they used to. The only way through is structures that pack into a fairing and unfold into something massive on orbit. Gama is building that: ultra-light deployable solar arrays, from 3 kW to over 100 kW, in a factory sized for 100 MW a year by 2028. Almost nothing about this exists off the shelf. Most of it has to be invented, tested, and made manufacturable, here, by a small team. We are hiring a senior mechanical engineer to own a large piece of that invention. You do not need to have worked on a solar array. You do need to have built something new from nothing and made it work at scale. Gama operates with extreme ownership: you own the outcome, not just the parts or the process. Your Mission Will Be To Design, develop and qualify key mechanical subsystems of an extremely lightweight deployable solar array, taking end-to-end ownership of a major share of the mechanical architecture, including panel structure and PV integration Drive design trades and analyses (structural, thermal, mechanism kinematics) from early concept through detailed design and test. Requirements at Gama are a starting hypothesis; you are expected to challenge them and make them better. Start from physics, not from heritage. Get hands-on with hardware. Prototype in the morning, put it in the thermal chamber in the afternoon, learn from what broke, iterate. We test in-house and we treat failure as data. Design for a production line, not a one-off. 100 MW a year means every part you draw has to be made thousands of times. Build robust, flight-proven solutions that meet aggressive mass and volume targets in demanding launch and orbital environments Raise the bar for the engineers around you: mentor, review, and become the person others come to when the physics gets hard. Requirements Must have Multiple full development cycles under your belt: you have taken hardware from blank sheet to working hardware more than once. Any domain: robotics, motorsport, aircraft, drones, medical devices, consumer hardware, industrial machinery, research rigs. What matters is that it did not exist before, you designed it, it got built, and it worked. First-principles mechanical engineering. Given an unfamiliar problem, you open the textbook, and find the governing equations. You can explain the "why" behind every design decision you have made. Fluency with CAD (e.g. CATIA, Siemens NX, Solidworks) and FEA tools; comfort with hand calculations to sanity-check results Strong analytical skills, a proactive attitude, excellent interpersonal skills and unbounded curiosity Autonomy, and a willingness to be fully responsible for a significant part of the finished product A proven track record of delivering reliable systems for harsh environments Roughly 5+ years of relevant experience, but we care far more about what you built than how long you have been working. Professional English. French is a plus, not a requirement. Nice to have Hands-on experience in spacecraft or launch vehicle mechanical design, ideally with direct exposure to solar array or deployable panel structures, within a fast-paced New Space environment Experience with design for manufacturing, making a design that is not only producible but easy to make This role is probably not for you if your typical work has been executing a design against a standard or requirements list handed to you, or if you are most comfortable working in a rigidly defined engineering process. At Gama, everyone is a systems engineer and we embrace the ownership and the messy reality of hardware development to produce world-changing products.

title: Senior R&D Product Engineer

As the company moves to bring the development and manufacture of a device retrieval system from a third-party partner, you will play a central role in shaping the technical direction and operational success of this key product line. This role is ideally suited to an engineer who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment and enjoys the challenge of working across the full product lifecycle. Role Overview Reporting directly to the Senior R&D Manager, the Senior R&D Product Engineer will lead and support projects from initial concept through to regulatory approval and commercial scale-up. You will be responsible for the design, manufacture, and testing of innovative medical devices, ensuring that technical excellence is maintained throughout the transition to in-house production. This is a hands-on role requiring a blend of design expertise, process validation knowledge, and the ability to troubleshoot complex manufacturing issues in real-time. Key Responsibilities - Lead R&D projects through the complete development cycle, ensuring all milestones meet regulatory requirements for 510k and PMA submissions. - Support Operations in sustaining and optimising manufacturing lines, focusing on production flow and process efficiency. - Take ownership of real-time troubleshooting, including CAPA and NCR investigations, to maintain high quality standards. - Manage the Design History File (DHF) and compile necessary documentation for EU MDR and ISO 13485 compliance. - Partner with Quality and Operations teams to develop and execute robust validation protocols and reports. - Provide technical guidance to external suppliers and mentor junior members of the engineering team. Requirements Essential: - A degree in a relevant Engineering or Science discipline. - A minimum of 5 years experience within the medical device industry. - Proven track record in product and process validation, including design verification and validation (V&V). - Proficiency in Solidworks or similar CAD software, backed by strong mechanical design fundamentals. - Excellent technical writing and communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information to cross-functional teams. - A flexible, proactive approach suited to a small-team, start-up environment. Desirable: - Experience with polymer-based delivery systems, catheters, or rigid/flexible endoscopes. - Familiarity with medical device materials such as Nitinol and metallic introducers. - In-depth knowledge of FDA CFR 820/QMSR and ISO 13485 standards. - Demonstrated experience in project planning and execution. What the Opportunity Offers You will have the unique chance to lead the in-sourcing of a critical product kit, providing you with high visibility and the ability to influence the companys manufacturing strategy. The role offers a technical challenge that spans prototyping to commercialisation, providing a breadth of experience rarely found in larger corporate structures. You will work within a collaborative, fast-paced culture that values technical autonomy and professional growth. Application Process If you are a motivated engineer looking to take the next step in your career within Galways thriving medtech hub, please submit your CV for consideration. LNKD1_IJ

title: Intern in the Mechanical Department - Structures Section
description: Intern in the Mechanical Department - Structures Section Job Requisition ID: 21052 Date Posted: 1 November 2026 Closing Date: 30 November 2026 23:59 CET/CEST Publication Method: External Only Directorate: Technology, Engineering and Quality Workplace: Noordwijk, NL Location ESTEC, Noordwijk, Netherlands Our team and mission The Structures Section TEC-MSS is in charge of all structural engineering aspects: Structural Design and Verification Methods / Tools; Static / Dynamics / Vibro-Acoustics; Crash / Impacts / Meteoroids Absorption Analysis; Damage Tolerance / Fracture Control / Health Monitoring; Fluid Structure Interaction (e.g. Sloshing); Launcher Coupled Dynamic Analysis; Demisability / Re-Usability; Thermo-Elastic distortion; High Stability / High Precision Structures; Active / Adaptive Structures; Inflatable and Deployable Structures; Launchers / Re-Entry (Hot Structures) / Planetary Landing Vehicles; Crew Habitation / EVA Suits. The ESA Structures Section brings together a diverse team of approximately 43 engineers and specialists covering the complete structural lifecycle of space systems—from early concept development and structural sizing to analysis, verification, testing and in-flight performance. Our expertise includes structural design and analysis, loads and coupled-loads analysis, structural dynamics, vibro-acoustics, shock, micro-vibration, thermo-elastic performance, fracture control and fatigue, advanced materials and manufacturing, deployable structures, structural digitalisation and emerging technologies. The team supports ESA missions across Earth observation, science, exploration, telecommunications, navigation and space transportation, working closely with project teams, European industry, research organisations and partner agencies. Our mission is to ensure that European spacecraft, payloads and launch systems are structurally robust, reliable and fit for purpose throughout their operational life. We provide independent technical expertise, solve complex engineering challenges and help projects manage structural risks through sound engineering judgement and proportionate verification. Beyond direct project support, the Section develops new technologies and methodologies, preserves and shares structural-engineering knowledge, contributes to European standards and technical guidelines, and strengthens industrial capabilities. By connecting operational experience with research and innovation, we aim to anticipate future needs and maintain Europe’s technical excellence and autonomy in spacecraft structures. Candidates interested are encouraged to visit the ESA website: http://www.esa.int Field(s) of activity for the internship You will contribute to the development and analysis of advanced structural solutions for space systems. The internship will focus on applying modern design, simulation, and testing methods to improve the performance, reliability, and efficiency of spacecraft structures. Depending on your background and interests, you may work in one of several key domains, such as: structural optimisation: exploring lightweight and high-performance structural concepts through numerical and computational design methods; fracture control and damage tolerance: supporting studies and simulations related to material strength, crack propagation, and structural integrity in extreme environments; vibro-acoustics: analysing vibration and acoustic environments during launch and their influence on structural behaviour; ultra-stable structures: investigating thermo-elastic stability and precision design techniques for optical or scientific payloads; hypervelocity impacts: studying the effects of micrometeoroid and debris impacts on spacecraft structures and assessing protection or resilience strategies through modelling and test data. You will learn how advanced structural engineering is applied to real space missions, gaining hands-on experience with modelling tools, simulation techniques, and engineering processes. title: Intern in the Projects Department - EnVision Project: Thermo-Elastic Modelling
description: Intern in the Projects Department - EnVision Project: Thermo-Elastic Modelling Job Requisition ID: 20952 Date Posted: 1 November 2026 Closing Date: 30 November 2026 23:59 CET/CEST Publication Method: External Only Directorate: Science Workplace: Noordwijk, NL Location ESTEC, Noordwijk, Netherlands Our team and mission EnVision is a Venus orbiter mission selected by ESA’s Science Programme Committee as the fifth Medium-class mission in the Agency’s Cosmic Vision plan. It will be the first mission to investigate Venus from its inner core to its upper atmosphere, characterising the interaction between its atmosphere, surface/subsurface and interior. It aims at providing a holistic view of Venus, studying the planet’s history, activity, and climate. The project team in which this internship is proposed is in charge of the implementation of the mission: the procurement of the spacecraft and the launch vehicle and the liaising with the developers of the instruments that will be embarked on EnVision. As with most Science missions, the instruments are provided by Member States, with ESA providing several specific payload elements. At the time of writing (September 2026), the EnVision spacecraft is undergoing the Preliminary Design Review. This proposed activity is of significant interest to the EnVision project, as thermo-elastic distortion analyses play a key role in the verification of several mission performance requirements, particularly those related to the pointing stability of scientific instruments or the link budget of communication antennae. Candidates interested are encouraged to visit the ESA website: http://www.esa.int Field(s) of activity for the internship Topic of the internship: Improving Thermo-Elastic Modelling of Spacecraft and Payload Coupling You will be part of the EnVision project team at ESA's European Space Research and Technology Centre and will work closely with spacecraft engineering specialists and experts from the ESA Technical Directorate. Your task will be to investigate how interactions between a spacecraft platform and its payload equipment influence thermo-elastic distortions, and how these effects can be represented more accurately and efficiently in engineering analyses. Starting from the existing EnVision thermo-elastic analysis model, you will enhance the spacecraft structural model by integrating representations of payload instruments, electronics units, and other heat-dissipating equipment. You will then perform thermo-elastic analyses to evaluate how the thermal and structural behaviour of these units affects the deformation of the spacecraft structure. A particular focus of the work will be to assess coupling effects between payload equipment and the spacecraft platform. You will investigate how temperature gradients and structural stiffness within payload units and electronics boxes influence the deformation of the spacecraft panels on which they are mounted, and how these distortions may propagate to neighbouring areas supporting other sensitive instruments. Based on your findings, you will develop simplified modelling approaches that can reproduce the key coupling effects without requiring the use of highly detailed models. These simplified representations could significantly improve analysis efficiency while maintaining the accuracy needed for engineering assessments. Finally, you will evaluate the extent to which separate analyses of the spacecraft platform and payload units can reproduce the results of a fully integrated thermo-elastic analysis. Where appropriate, you will propose methods to better capture platform-to-payload interactions when payload units are analysed independently. The results of this work could contribute to improving future thermo-elastic modelling practices and increasing the representativeness of performance predictions for space missions. Using the EnVision mission as a case study, you will explore modelling aspects that are often neglected in conventional analyses and help identify practical methods to account for spacecraft-payload coupling effects. During this internship, you will gain experience in: thermo-elastic analysis of spacecraft structures; structural and thermal modelling using finite element methods; interpretation of spacecraft performance impacts arising from thermo-mechanical distortions; development and validation of simplified engineering models; collaboration with multidisciplinary spacecraft engineering teams; application of advanced analysis techniques to a real ESA space mission. title: Stagiair Werktuigbouwkunde (Zwolle, NL)
description: Functietitel: Stagiair Werktuigbouwkunde Recruiter: Mark Hietkamp Vacature-ID: 4622 Voor ons team Ontwerp & aanleg zijn wij op zoek naar een proactieve derde- of vierdejaars stagiair. Ben jij een hbo-student Werktuigbouwkunde of Technische Bedrijfskunde en wil je bijdragen aan een belangrijk vraagstuk binnen de drinkwatersector? Tijdens deze afstudeer- of meewerkstage onderzoek je de toepassing van pneumatische en elektrische aandrijvingen voor vlinderkleppen binnen Vitens. Je combineert technische analyses met bedrijfseconomische inzichten en levert een concreet standaardisatieadvies waarmee Vitens haar installaties efficiënter, betrouwbaarder en toekomstbestendig kan beheren. Je krijgt de kans om zelfstandig onderzoek uit te voeren, samen te werken met technische specialisten en direct impact te maken op de keuzes die Vitens maakt voor haar infrastructuur. Geen dag is hetzelfde en je draagt bij aan iets belangrijks: Iedere dag 1 miljard liter drinkwater van topkwaliteit winnen, zuiveren en leveren. Elke druppel telt! Waar jij mee aan de slag gaat Tijdens deze stage onderzoek je de technische, operationele en economische prestaties van pneumatische en elektrische afsluiteraandrijvingen binnen Vitens. Je vertaalt jouw bevindingen naar een objectieve Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)-analyse en een onderbouwd advies voor standaardisatie. Belangrijke taken Onderzoeken en analyseren van bestaande installaties met pneumatische en elektrische actuatoren Verzamelen en beoordelen van gegevens over investeringskosten, energieverbruik, onderhoud en betrouwbaarheid Ontwikkelen van een TCO-model voor beide aandrijfconcepten Vergelijken van technische prestaties, onderhoudsbehoefte, fail-safe eigenschappen en benodigde infrastructuur Opstellen van een onderbouwd standaardisatieadvies voor de toepassing van afsluiteraandrijvingen binnen Vitens Je werkt samen met verschillende technische collega’s en krijgt inzicht in zowel de operationele als strategische kant van de afdeling Ontwerp & aanleg. Daarmee lever je een concrete bijdrage aan de optimalisatie van vitale drinkwaterinstallaties. Wat breng jij mee? We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wie jij bent én wat jij kunt. Belangrijk is dat jij jezelf bent én een analytische en nieuwsgierige houding meebrengt. Die zien we terug in het uitvoeren van technische analyses en het vertalen van data naar concrete adviezen. Verder rekenen we op jou: Je volgt een hbo-opleiding in Werktuigbouwkunde, Technische Bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare technische studie Je hebt affiniteit met technische installaties en procesoptimalisatie Je kunt data analyseren en gestructureerd verwerken in rapportages Je werkt zelfstandig en neemt initiatief in je onderzoek Je communiceert helder en werkt prettig samen met verschillende stakeholders Je hebt interesse in techniek, duurzaamheid en infrastructuur Zo zorgen wij voor jou Als Stagiair Werktuigbouwkunde draai je mee in een enthousiast team en krijg je de mogelijkheid om praktijkervaring op te doen. Het aantal uren en stagedagen stemmen we samen af. Daarnaast bieden wij onder andere de volgende arbeidsvoorwaarden: Een stagevergoeding van € 525,00 per maand Een reiskostenvergoeding conform de CAO Waterbedrijven Deelname aan de Dag van de Stagiair en andere activiteiten binnen Vitens Een leerzame stage met professionele begeleiding en ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling Onze toekomst, jouw toekomst Meewerken aan het toekomstbestendig maken van ons drinkwatervoorziening? Dan ontvangen wij graag je sollicitatie. Vragen over de procedure? Kijk hier naar de sollicitatieprocedure binnen Vitens of stel je vragen aan onze recruiter Mark Hietkamp via Mark.Hietkamp@vitens.nl. Meer weten over de inhoud van de functie? Mail teammanager George Keijzer via george.keijzer@vitens.nl Samen elke druppel duurzaam Wij hebben als grootste drinkwaterbedrijf het doel om voor 2030 elke druppel duurzaam te maken. Benieuwd hoe wij dit willen realiseren? Kijk dan even op Over Vitens | Vitens. Vitens is belangrijk voor de basisvoorzieningen in onze maatschappij. Daarom vragen wij altijd een screening aan voordat we iemand aannemen. Onderdeel van deze screening is het aanleveren van een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG). title: Mechanical Design Engineer – Photonic Hardware
description: PsiQuantum’s mission is to build the first useful quantum computers—machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems. Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries. Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry—including partners like GlobalFoundries—we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don’t feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure. In 2024, PsiQuantum announced government-funded projects to support the build-out of our first utility-scale quantum computers in Brisbane, Australia, and Chicago, Illinois. These initiatives reflect a growing recognition that quantum computing will be strategically and economically defining—and that now is the time to scale. PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies—including Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical—to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact. Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift—and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we have a clear path to make it real. Come join us. Job Summary We are looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer to support the development of next-generation photonic hardware systems. This is an R&D role focused on the mechanical and thermal design, prototyping and validation of high-specification hardware for demanding optical quantum computing. The role will involve developing robust, testable and manufacturable hardware for controlled operating environments, working closely with photonics, systems and architecture colleagues, as well as external partners and suppliers. It will suit a serious engineer with experience of precision experimental or industrial hardware, who is motivated by solving difficult multidisciplinary engineering problems and translating novel concepts into reliable hardware. We welcome candidates from both conventional academic routes and hands-on engineering pathways, including those who have developed equivalent experience through apprenticeships, national laboratories, experimental physics facilities, or advanced industrial R&D. Responsibilities Contribute to the mechanical design of precision hardware systems, from early concepts through prototype build and validation. Develop enclosure, packaging and internal layout solutions for hardware operating in controlled or stability-critical environments. Design mechanically robust solutions for precision assemblies, including routing, handling, support and integration of sensitive components. Support the development of thermal management and temperature stabilisation approaches, including environmental control and, where appropriate, active feedback methods. Carry out mechanical and thermal analysis and simulation to inform design choices and identify technical risks. Plan and execute validation activities to assess mechanical stability, thermal performance, environmental sensitivity and repeatability. Work with photonics, systems architecture and experimental teams to translate system requirements into practical hardware designs. Engage with suppliers and external collaborators on components, fabrication methods, manufacturability and assembly approaches. Support prototype build activities, including design documentation, drawings, procurement, assembly planning and test support. Contribute to the development of hardware that can move from laboratory demonstrator to repeatable and manufacturable system. Experience/Qualifications Required Degree, apprenticeship-based qualification, or equivalent practical experience in mechanical engineering, physics, engineering science, hardware design or a related discipline. title: Electro-Acoustic Engineer
description: Electro Acoustic Development Engineer If electro acoustic development of hearing instruments throughout the spectra form concept to finial product seems interesting, and if having fun at work makes you smile, then read on! We may just have the job for you. In the Device Hardware area, we are looking for an Electro Acoustic engineer to expand our team. You will work with product development using cutting-edge tools in well-equipped modern facilities with the goal of developing the best hardware for our hearing instruments. Join the Hardware development team As an electro acoustic developer, you would be part of an agile development team with responsibility for design and verification of the electroacoustic concepts. We focus on delivering solutions that enable us to deliver high-quality hearing instrument solutions, including in-depth transducer knowledge and development of new acoustic concepts for future products. We are depending on, and facilitating, in-depth knowledge about vibroacoustic behavior of subsystems and complete hearing aid solutions. We participate in product development as well as maturation of concepts, before they are used in product development. Sometimes we participate in after launch activities as well. Building, documenting and sharing knowledge is key to our success. Communication of key findings and results gained in is cross functional cooperation with mechanical and electronics developers in our Agile Release Trains are sessional. Building innovative Electro Acoustic Solutions In collaboration with skilled team members within your own Agile Release Train, you will work to innovate electro acoustic and mechanical solutions that elevate the experience of both end-users and customers. The excitement this group faces daily is the development of highly complex platforms, due to the high degree of functionality that hearing instruments offer. Furthermore, we focus on developing our platforms to fit multiple brands, adding to the complexity. The team works closely together with other professionals, i.e., audiologists and engineers specializing in amplifiers and embedded systems. The biggest hardware challenge is to develop a platform that provides the needed acoustical gain and at the same time securing a good mechanical and acoustic feedback margin. Here a close cooperation with the mechanical engineers and the pre-production team is crucial for a good result. You will be involved in: Acoustic systemdesign and Development Platform calibration/settings Design specifications Selection of components i.e. transducers – microphones, receivers/speakers Testing, verifying and documenting electro-acoustical performance of HW platforms Effort estimation and planning done in an agile framework In the role of Electro Acoustic Developer, you will collaborate with skilled team members to advance the design of next-generation cutting-edge hearing instruments. Apart from working together with motivated colleagues you will experience that we have great focus on your skills development, the department’s professional skills and in Work-life balance. You can expect 1-5 travel days a year, visiting suppliers and our production site in Poland. Qualifications We expect you to hold a degree in Engineering, focusing specifically on electro acoustics. We anticipate that you possess strong qualifications in Sound Quality, Acoustic measurements, vibro-acoustics, and sound path design. Knowledge from working with electro acoustic or magnetic designs of hearing instruments or other smaller products such as cell phones, headsets or similar is an advantage. You perform best in a vibrant atmosphere and enjoy partnering with experienced coworkers to make the most of your skills. We offer further development opportunities and believe Oticon is a good place to develop your career further. As a person, you are proud of your profession, curious and a team player by heart. You have good communication skills and enjoy networking and navigating in a delivery driven, cross-functional organization with several parallel development tracs. Apply Please send your CV and motivation letter no later than November 15th, 2026. Interview are planned for November 20th and 23nd and 2. Interview are planned for November 26., 2026 If you would like to know more about the position, you are welcome to contact. Team Manager, Anders Eriksen on aens@demant.com. We are looking forward to hearing from you. At Demant we value diversity, equity, and inclusion (DE&I) and we are committed to creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of ethnic background, personality, age, gender, and education. Diversity is p art of our cultural DNA. Women in STEM areas are particularly encouraged to apply, as Demant supports United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 5 on gender equality.

title: Mekanikingenjör Veprox
description: Vill du arbeta med mekanisk konstruktion och produktutveckling i en miljö där teknik, kreativitet och problemlösning står i centrum? Utveckling och förbättring av mekaniska komponenter och produkter utifrån tekniska krav. Medverkan vid framtagning, testning och utvärdering av prototyper. Materialval och konstruktionsanpassning med hänsyn till funktion, hållfasthet och tillverkningsmetoder. Tekniskt samarbete med andra discipliner, exempelvis elektronik och mjukvaruutveckling. Din bakgrund Vi söker dig som har ett genuint teknikintresse och erfarenhet av mekanisk konstruktion och produktutveckling. Vi ser gärna att du har: Teknisk utbildning inom maskinteknik, mekanisk konstruktion eller motsvarande kompetens förvärvad genom arbetslivserfarenhet. Erfarenhet av mekanisk konstruktion och arbete i något etablerat 3D-CAD-system. Förståelse för tekniska ritningar, material och tillverkningsmetoder. Förmåga att omsätta tekniska krav till praktiska konstruktionslösningar. God förmåga att samarbeta, lösa tekniska problem och dokumentera ditt arbete. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av: CAD-system som Creo, SolidWorks, CATIA, Inventor eller Fusion 360. Produktutveckling från koncept till färdig produkt. Prototypframtagning och teknisk verifiering. PDM- eller PLM-system. Konstruktion inom medicinteknik eller annan tillverkande industri. Du behöver kunna kommunicera och dokumentera tekniskt arbete på svenska eller engelska. Vi lägger stor vikt vid ditt tekniska kunnande, din problemlösningsförmåga och din vilja att utvecklas tillsammans med oss. Om Veprox Veprox grundades 2005 av konsulter för konsulter. Vi är ett personligt och teknikdrivet konsultföretag som erbjuder ingenjörskompetens inom bland annat medicinteknik, industri, energi, fordon, försvar och digitalisering. Vårt kontor i Jönköping ligger i nyrenoverade lokaler med historisk karaktär, med närhet till både Jönköpings centrum och den växande Munksjöstaden. Vi erbjuder förmåner såsom kollektivavtal, friskvård, sjukvårdsförsäkring, föräldraledighetstillägg och tjänstepension.

title: Design and Development Graduate Scheme
description: Salary: Starting Salary - Circa £32,000 Contract Type: Full Time Working Pattern: Graduate The Opportunity - Design and Development Graduate Scheme The Opportunity - Design and Development (Mechanical Engineering) Graduate Scheme Start Date - September 2027, typically for 24 months Minimum Entry Criteria – You’ll need to be near to, or have completed within the last 2 years, an appropriate bachelor’s or master’s degree such as mechanical engineering, automotive engineering, motorsport engineering, aeronautical engineering and be on track to secure a 2:1 or higher Unfortunately, JCB is unable to offer visa sponsorship or immigration support for its Emerging Talent Schemes, either now or in the future. This includes individuals currently on sponsored visas. What does the Design and Development (Mechanical Engineering) Graduate Scheme involve day-to-day? This exciting 18-month programme gives you the chance to rotate across different areas of the business whether that be machine focused, working with one of our components such as attachments. This scheme will cover Design, Development, Product Innovation and offers the opportunity to experience a commercial placement to truly broaden your understanding of our business. We’ll help you figure out just where your passion lies (not to mention your skills), as you learn to connect the conceptual thinking behind one set of Engineering problems. What could I be doing? Current product - There are always updates required to suit changing legislation and customer demands, so part of the team focuses on keeping what the production line is building every day up to the latest and greatest specification it can be. This includes upgrading parts in assemblies, designing new features and developing existing ideas. New product - To stay ahead of the market trends, we must constantly look at what we offer to our customers; part of the team designs the next machines, which will be on sale in years to come. Working on elements of our five-year product plan includes reviewing challenges to create solutions, testing machines with new parts, and talking with customers to understand their needs. Development and Endurance - JCB machines are used in harsh environments and are relied upon to be robust. Part of the team focuses on testing our designs to fail to find what needs to be improved. Working this way lets us catch issues before they get to the customer, making our machines action ready. What comes next? We’ll be reviewing applications against the essential criteria then shortlisting and sending out links to our online assessments in November 2026 (we’d recommend you keep a look out for emails at this point as you’ll hear from us either way). Once you’ve fully completed your online assessment, we’ll review it and provide you with an update within a few weeks. Please note, if you’ve not completed your online assessment then we won’t take your application further (we’ll send you a few reminders to make sure you don’t forget). If you've been progressed, you’ll be sent an invite to attend one of our in-person Assessment Centres. In-person Assessment Centres will take place from January to April 2027 (we’ll send you all the details you need). Following your Assessment Centre, whether you’ve been successful or not, our promise to you is that you’ll receive a call with feedback. If successful, congratulations! We’ll now take you through the onboarding process, which will include a familiarisation day. Welcome to JCB – our Emerging Talent cohorts ordinarily start in early September. What's in it for you? When you join JCB, you'll enjoy a great package designed to reward, support and help you make the most of every day: 33 days' holiday (including most bank holidays) Market leading company pension scheme through Royal London Access to an in-house doctor, dentist, and an award winning Occupational Health team Onsite gym to help you stay active ULEV car scheme Bupa Private Medical Health Scheme Exclusive discounts through the JCB Rewards Hub Cycle to Work scheme Professional outdoor development programme We also encourage our cohorts to network and get involved in our “NextGen” society. Building a Brighter Future We value diversity and welcome applications from candidates from all backgrounds. We’re committed to ensuring our recruitment process is fair and inclusive. If you face any accessibility challenges with your online application and require additional support, you have the option of speaking to a member of our Resourcing team who can support you to complete an application in an alternative format. If you would benefit from this support, please email recruitment@jcb.com, and a member of the team will be in touch.

title: R&D Engineer
description: This is where your work makes a difference. At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride. We are seeking an R&D Engineer to join our team in Malta. This is an exciting opportunity for an early-career engineer to contribute to product development activities, engineering simulations, prototyping, and innovation projects within a collaborative R&D environment. Duties and responsibilities · CAD design and engineering drawings including 3D modelling, assemblies, detailed drawings, tolerance definition and design documentation; · Select and evaluate materials based on mechanical, thermal, chemical, manufacturing and application requirements; · Design and develop jigs, fixtures, test setups, assembly aids and small tooling to support R&D and prototyping activities; · Translate concepts into physical prototypes using rapid prototyping and manufacturing techniques, and support design iterations; · Perform Finite Element Analysis (FEA), including structural, stress, deformation and thermal simulations to support design decisions and optimization; · Conduct Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) simulations, including fluid flow, pressure drop and thermal analysis to predict product and system behaviour; · Apply Design for Manufacture and Assembly (DFM/DFA) principles to ensure designs are practical, robust and suitable for prototype and production processes; · Correlate simulation results with prototype and test data to verify designs and drive continuous improvement; · Investigate technical issues and develop solutions using engineering fundamentals, modelling and experimental methods; · Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product Development, Testing, Manufacturing, Quality and external suppliers from concept through verification stages; · Explore and prototype AI-powered engineering tools and methodologies for CAD, design optimisation, FEA and CFD simulations; · Maintain engineering documentation and contribute to technical reports and design reviews; · Adhere to Quality System requirements and maintain a safe and organized work environment. title: Plan Keşif Mühendisi
description: 1948 yılında temelleri atılan Karadeniz Holding, enerji ve gemi inşa başta olmak üzere geniş bir sektör yelpazesinde inovasyonu ön planda tutarak büyümeyi ekonomik ve çevresel sürdürülebilirlik açısından destekleyen, vizyoner sektör lideridir. 30 farklı milletten 3.000’den fazla çalışanı ile 20’den fazla ülkede faaliyet gösteren, 8.000 MW’tan fazla kurulu güce sahip Grup, 45 Powership™ ve 11 LNG gemisinden oluşan filosuyla 4 kıtada güvenilir ve temiz elektrik üretirken dünya genelinde 10 bini aşkın kişiye istihdam alanı sağlamaktadır. Powership™ filosunu, uluslararası markası Karpowership altında yöneten Karadeniz Holding; Avrupa, Afrika, Amerika ve Asya kıtalarında faaliyet gösterdiği ülkelerin %10- %100 oranındaki elektrik ihtiyacını karşılamaktadır. Powership™, kara elektrik santralleri ve aynı zamanda yüzen LNG altyapısının dahil olduğu yüksek kapasiteli enerji çözümleriyle, Karpowership ülkelere ve şirketlere enerji geçişi süreçlerinde yardımcı olmaktadır. “ Yalova/Altınova ” lokasyonunda bulunan “ Plan Keşif ” departmanımızda görevlendirilmek üzere “ Plan Keşif Mühendisi ” arayışımız bulunmaktadır. NE BEKLİYORUZ? Üniversitelerin Gemi İnşa Mühendisliği, Makine Mühendisliği veya Endüstri Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezun, Gemi inşa ve planlama alanında en az 2 yıl deneyimli, Tercihen SAP ya da diğer ERP programlarını kullanmış ya da bilgi sahibi, Depo süreçleri, stok yönetimi ve envanter takibi konularında deneyimli, Raporlama ve kontrol süreçlerine hakim, Sözlü ve yazılı iyi derecede İngilizce bilen, Yurtdışı seyahat engeli bulunmayan , (Güney Kore, Singapur, vb.) Tercihen Yalova, İstanbul Anadolu Yakası, Gebze veya Kocaeli çevresinde ikamet eden veya edebilecek. SENİ NELER BEKLİYOR? Gemi İnşa bünyesinde yürütülen Powership projelerinin satınalma süreçlerini, üretim ekipleriyle koordineli şekilde raporlamak, takip etmek ve kontrol etmek, Projelere ait siparişlerin, belirtilen ve talep edilen tarihlerde tersane teslimlerinin takibini yapmak, gecikmeleri ilgili birimlere raporlamak ve süreçleri izlemek, Projeye ait siparişlerin teslim edileceği lokasyonlarda gerekli depo ve mal kabul süreçlerini sağlanmak ve takibinin yürütülmek, Projelere ait satınalma ve malzeme takip raporlarını düzenli olarak hazırlamak ve üretim ekiplerine raporlamak. NE SUNUYORUZ? Doğum gününde 1 gün izin hakkı, Kapsamlı Özel Sağlık Sigortası, Mesleki ve kişisel eğitim & gelişim fırsatları, Çalışanlara özel indirim ve kampanyalar Çalışma arkadaşlarımız, adaylarımız ve tüm paydaşlarımızla “Tek Dünya” felsefemiz doğrultusunda başarılarımıza başarı katıyoruz. İlanlarımıza başvuru yapan tüm adaylarımıza ırk, din, dil, cinsiyet gözetmeksizin fırsat eşitliği sağlamayı ilke edinerek; farklılıklarımızla başarılarımızı taçlandırıyoruz.

title: Üretim Otomasyon Operatörü
description: Fresenius Medical Care olarak kronik böbrek hastalığı olan hastaların yaşamlarını iyileştirmeye yönelik yenilikçi ve yüksek kaliteli bakım sunma konusunda kararlıyız. Dünya genelinde 125.000'den fazla çalışanımız ve 3.700 diyaliz merkezimizle, tıbbi uzmanlığı ileri tedavi ve teknolojilere odaklanarak birleştiriyoruz. Care Enablement bünyesindeki küresel bir iş birimi olan Üretim ve Tedarik Zinciri (MSC), bu misyonda kilit bir rol oynamaktadır. 39 üretim tesisi ve 23 dağıtım merkezi işleten MSC, yaklaşık 150 ülkede böbrek ve çoklu organ tedavisi ürünlerinin verimli üretimini ve güvenilir teslimatını sağlar. Ekiplerimiz, üretimden dağıtıma kadar tüm tedarik zincirini yöneterek hemodiyaliz, periton diyalizi ve akut tedaviler için kritik çözümler sunar. Değerlerimiz çalışma şeklimize yön verir: Hastalarımıza, birbirimize ve toplumlarımıza özen gösteririz. Takımlar ve sınırlar arasında bağlantı kurar, birlikte mükemmellik sunarız. Doğru olanı yapmaya, amaçla büyümeye ve böbrek bakımında dürüstlük ve yenilikle liderlik etmeye kararlıyız. Antalya Serbest Bölgede bulunan fabrikamızNova MedGmbH bünyesinde 1600 çalışanımızla bu sürece katkı sağlamaktayız. Tutkulu ekibimize katılın ve dünya çapında sağlık hizmetlerinin şekillenmesine katkıda bulunun! GEREKEN NİTELİKLER Meslek Liseleri veya Üniversitelerin; Endüstriyel Otomasyon, Kontrol, Makine, Mekatronik, Elektrik, Elektronik vb. ilgili bölümlerinden mezun, Daha önce benzer endüstriyel üretim tesisinde üretim bölümünde çalışmış, Teknolojik ve Otomasyon seviyesi yüksek montaj makinelerinde; Montaj Makine Operatörü olarak çalışmış / çalışmaya istekli, Mekanik, elektrik, pnömatik, robotik sistemler hakkında bilgisi ve tecrübesi olan, Tercihen İngilizce bilen, Vardiyalı sistemde çalışabilecek, Detaylara dikkat eden, disiplinli ve titiz, fabrika kurallarına uyum sağlayabilecek, Gelişime açık ve istekli, Ekip çalışmasına yatkın, Yurt dışı seyahat engeli bulunmayan, Antalya'da ikamet eden veya edebilecek “Üretim Otomasyon Operatörü” rolünde çalışacak ekip arkadaşları arıyoruz. ESAS SORUMLULUKLAR Medikal parça montajı ve üretimi yapan otomasyon makinelerinde operatörlük yapılması, Üretim vardiya bilgilerinin(üretim verileri, devam eden sorunlar vb.) sistemler de kayıt altına alınması, Ham madde problemlerinin çözümünde rol alınması, Makinelerin periyodik kontrollerinin ve bakımlarının takibi, prosedürlere uygun yürütülmesi, Vardiya boyunca ayakta çalışma ve üretimin aktif bir şekilde takip edilmesinde bir engelinin olmaması, Çalışma esnasında İSG bilincinin ön planda tutulması, Sürekli İyileştirme kültürüne sahip, Kalite ve performans düşüşlerinde kök sebep analizi, 5N1K, Balık Kılçığı vb. metodları uygulayarak, gerekli aksiyonların zamanında alınıp çözüm sağlanması, Kalite süreçleri ile alakalı analiz yapılması, Makine teknik problemlerinin ve arızalarının analiz edilmesi, Makine performanslarının artırılmasında aktif rol alınması, Makine üretim hedeflerinin tutturulması SUNDUĞUMUZ FIRSATLAR Maaşların Euro para birimi ile ödenmesi, 13. maaş ödemesi, Doğum günü izni, Özel sağlık sigortası

title: Bölge Satış Mühendisi – Ege Bölgesi (İzmir)
description: FabricAir’in Ege Bölgesi’ndeki büyümesine yön verecek, teknik uzmanlığını güçlü müşteri ilişkileriyle birleştiren bir Bölge Satış Mühendisi arıyoruz. İzmir merkezli bu pozisyonda, tekstil bazlı hava dağıtım çözümlerimizin bölgesel satış ve iş geliştirme faaliyetlerini yürüteceksiniz. Mekanik proje firmaları, mekanik tesisat yüklenicileri, mimarlar ve son kullanıcılarla yakın çalışarak projelere değer katacak, uzun vadeli iş birlikleri geliştireceksiniz. Rolünüz ve sorumluluklarınız Ege Bölgesi’nde satış hedefleri doğrultusunda yeni iş fırsatları geliştirmek ve satışları gerçekleştirmek. Mevcut müşterilerle ilişkileri güçlendirmek; düzenli saha ziyaretleriyle müşteri ve proje ağını genişletmek. Proje ihtiyaçlarını analiz ederek uygun FabricAir çözümlerinin belirlenmesini sağlamak. Tasarım, teklif ve sipariş süreçlerinde müşterilerin ana iletişim noktası olmak; ilgili ekiplerle koordinasyonu yürütmek. Projeleri ilk görüşmeden sipariş aşamasına kadar takip etmek. Bölgedeki pazar gelişmelerini ve rekabet koşullarını izleyerek büyüme fırsatlarını değerlendirmek. Müşteri, proje ve satış bilgilerini CRM sistemi üzerinden güncel tutmak. Aradığımız nitelikler Makine Mühendisliği veya ilgili mühendislik bölümlerinden mezun. Satış veya iş geliştirme alanında en az 5 yıl deneyimli; tercihen ısıtma, soğutma, havalandırma ve iklimlendirme (HVAC) sektöründe saha satış tecrübesine sahip. Tercihen mekanik proje firmaları ve mekanik tesisat yüklenicileriyle güçlü iş ilişkileri bulunan. Teknik ihtiyaçları doğru analiz edebilen ve müşterilere çözüm odaklı bir yaklaşımla rehberlik edebilen. İletişim, sunum ve müzakere becerileri güçlü. İşini planlı yürüten, detaylara özen gösteren ve sonuç odaklı çalışan. Zamanının önemli bir bölümünü sahada ve müşteri ziyaretlerinde geçirmeye istekli. Microsoft Office uygulamalarını ve Pipedrive gibi CRM sistemlerini etkin kullanabilen. B sınıfı sürücü belgesine sahip, aktif araç kullanabilen ve seyahat engeli bulunmayan.
