title: Production Associate Manager
description: Job Description About the Position We have an excellent opportunity available for Production Associate Manager to make a difference at Kraft Heinz Turkey. Production Associate Manager role lies within the Production team and is based in our Susurluk factory. Key Responsibilities Lead production areas to achieve Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost and People objectives. Develop and execute daily, weekly and monthly production strategies. Ensure achievement of production KPIs including OEE, Yield, Labor Productivity, Waste and Service Level. Own production performance reviews and drive sustainable improvements. Lead production escalation management during operational disruptions. Ensure production continuity during planned and unplanned events. Lead, coach and develop Production engineers, Supervisors and frontline leaders. Improve organizational capability through succession planning and talent development. Helping to drive employee engagement and ownership culture. Conduct regular performance reviews and coaching sessions. Develop future production leaders through mentoring and structured development plans. Lead KHMS implementation across all responsible areas. Drive Lean Manufacturing, TPM and Continuous Improvement initiatives. Ensure PDCA discipline across the organization. Remove organizational barriers preventing operational excellence. Own overall safety performance for responsible production areas. Ensure full compliance with GMP, HACCP, QRMP and company standards. Lead investigations for significant quality or safety incidents. Ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented effectively. Promote proactive food safety and safety culture. Collaborate with Maintenance, Engineering, Planning, Quality, Warehouse and EHS departments. Support and manage capital investment (CAPEX) implementation and production readiness. Participate in annual business planning and budget preparation. Align production priorities with factory objectives. Monitor/optimize/improve labor cost, manufacturing cost and productivity performance. Support cost-saving initiatives and productivity improvements. Drive data-based decision-making using production KPIs. What You Bring Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (Food, Chemical, Mechanical, Industrial or related disciplines). Minimum 3 years of manufacturing leadership experience. Previous people management experience preferred. Experience in FMCG manufacturing. Experience leading cross-functional improvement projects. Experience with Lean / TPM / Continuous Improvement methodologies. Experience managing multiple production lines or departments is preferred. What We Offer You A fast career track like only few other companies can match Always room for new ideas; if you have an excellent idea- please let us know and we can set it in action! About Us The Kraft Heinz Company is one of the largest food and beverage companies in the world, with eight $1 billion+ brands and global sales of approximately $25 billion. We’re a globally trusted producer of high-quality, great-tasting, and nutritious foods for over 150 years. Our brands are truly global, with products produced and marketed in over 40 countries. These beloved products include condiments and sauces, cheese and dairy, meals, meats, refreshment beverages, coffee, infant and nutrition products, and numerous other grocery products in a portfolio of more than 200 legacy and emerging brands. No matter the brand, we’re united under one vision To sustainably grow by delighting more consumers globally. Bringing this vision to life is our team of 39,000+ food lovers, creative thinkers, and high performers worldwide. Together, we help provide meals to those in need through our global partnership with Rise Against Hunger. We also stand committed to responsible, sustainable practices that extend to every facet of our business, our consumers, and our communities. Every day, we’re transforming the food industry with bold thinking and unprecedented results. If you share our passion – and are ready to create the future, build a legacy, and lead as a global citizen – there’s only one thing to do join our table and let’s make life delicious! Our Culture of Ownership, Meritocracy and Collaboration We're not afraid to think differently. Embrace new ideas. Dream big. We empower our people at every level – from entry-level intern to senior leader – to own their work. We share a responsibility to think like Owners – to be mindful of the collective and sustained success of Kraft Heinz – which we apply to every situation, every day. As part of Kraft Heinz, you're supported to grow and achieve. You’re expected to bring your authentic self to work every day, to lead with humility, and drive outstanding performance at every level – and you’ll be rewarded. You’re given opportunities to leave a mark and build a legacy. But you won’t do it alone. You’re supported by passionate teammates along the way, and our collective, collaborative spirit fuels our incredible progress. Our work powers progress across industries as diverse as glass, ceramics, construction, coatings, polymers, and water purification. Beyond our materials, we’re proud of our commitment to sustainability, innovation, and empowering people from all walks of life to thrive and make a meaningful impact. Are We the Perfect Match? At Sibelco, we believe building a successful career is a two-way journey. We’re looking for individuals who share our values and vision, just as much as you’re seeking a company that aligns with your aspirations. Together, we can shape the future. Job Description: As the Senior Engineer Automation Actions , you will be in charge of programming, optimizing, maintaining and repairing plant automation & control systems to optimize and continuously improve the operational process. You will also provide guidance and technical advice to colleagues and assisting them with improvement requests & automation projects. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Automation Engineer to join team to work in our new, state of the art plant in Ali Pasa and move our operation towards the future. Your Impact in This Role As the Automation Engineer, your responsibilities will include but are not limited to: Lead Automation & Digitalization activities in Cine to ensure compliance with Sibelco regulations and with other requirements & constraints Continuous improvement by researching and developing new ideas or solutions that contribute to create systems in a cost-effective and efficient way Stay up to date with new engineering technologies (such as AI tools) and innovation in the industry Act as an Engineering & Operational interface to support Central Digitalization and Automation Team. Optimize, maintain, and repair the automation systems & instrumentation according to defined procedures, frequencies, and standards Maintain the systems from a hardware, software, and process instrumentation point of view Diagnose faults in automation systems and fix issues with PLCs, DCS, and SCADA Keep PLCs, field instruments and control interfaces in good shape Execute and follow the calibrations of the used instrumentation Apply the prescribed safety rules and execute LMRA (Last Minute Risk Assessment) Establish good professional relations with Contractors and keep in close contact with the contractors on the different Sibelco sites What You Bring To The Table Bachelor’s or Masters degree in Engineering (Automation, Electrical, Programming, Instrument, Computer, etc.) Focused expertise in either Automation, Electrical, Programming, Instrument, Computer engineering and basic understanding of the other specializations Experience with Scada InTouch as well as Siemens PLC is imperative 3-4 years professional experience in automation projects with experience working with field instruments, flow sensors and so forth Understanding of mining and mineral processing is an advantage Proactive approach and ability to work independently Experience with AI and digitalization projects is appreciated Systematic and solutions-orientated problem-solver Ability to plan, execute and evaluate a project Proficient in ERP systems (SAP S4 Hana), advanced Excel and Power BI Fully proficient in English and Turkish is a must Employee Type: Permanent Why Join Us? title: Süreç Tasarım ve Geliştirme Yönetmeni

Bu kapsamda, Genel Müdürlük ihtiyaçları doğrultusunda “Süreç Tasarımı ve Geliştirme Yönetmeni” pozisyonunda değerlendirilmek üzere başvurularınızı beklemekteyiz. İş Tanımı Şirketin tüm iş süreçlerinin analiz edilmesi, tasarlanması, modellenmesi, güncellenmesi ve optimize edilmesi, Süreçlerin dijitalleştirilmesi ve otomasyonu için uygun alanların belirlenmesi, iyileştirme ve otomasyon projelerinin yürütülmesi, BPM ve iş akışı otomasyon platformları üzerinden süreçlerin tasarlanması, geliştirilmesinin koordine edilmesi ve uygulamaya alınmasının sağlanması, İş birimleriyle koordineli çalışarak süreç otomasyonuna ilişkin ihtiyaçların ve iş kurallarının belirlenmesi, Mevcut iş akışlarının analiz edilerek manuel işlemleri azaltacak, operasyonel verimliliği artıracak dijital çözümlerin geliştirilmesi, Süreç otomasyon projelerinde bilgi teknolojileri ve ilgili iş birimleri arasında koordinasyonun sağlanması, test ve devreye alma çalışmalarının yürütülmesi, Süreçlerin şirket prosedürlerine, yönetim sistemi standartlarına ve ilgili mevzuata uygun yürütülmesinin sağlanması, Kurumsal süreç dokümantasyonunun oluşturulması, güncellenmesi ve yönetilmesi, Süreç performanslarının takip edilmesi ve sürekli iyileştirme çalışmalarının yürütülmesi, Verimlilik artırıcı süreç geliştirme ve dijital dönüşüm projelerinde aktif rol alınması.

title: Sales Engineer | Turkey
description: About Avaya Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections. The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships. We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way. Learn more at https://www.avaya.com Description Avaya has shifted the global enterprise customer experience (CX) landscape toward a unified, AI-driven, and open cloud architecture. We are seeking a highly accomplished Sales Engineer to be a primary technical driver in accelerating our Infinity platform adoption—focused on CCaaS (Contact Center as a Service), Omnichannel, AI/ML, Intelligent Orchestration, and Business Application Integration. This role is for a strategic technologist and storyteller who can translate complex, multi-modal capabilities into tangible business outcomes. While foundational knowledge of legacy communications platforms is beneficial, success in this role is fundamentally tied to demonstrating expertise and driving adoption of our modern, open, and cloud-based CX solutions. Key Responsibilities The successful candidate will spend approximately 80% of their time focused on the strategic CCaaS, AI, and Orchestration portfolio, and 20% on migration strategies from legacy environments. Solution Architecture & Desig n (CCaaS/Omnichannel): Lead the technical discovery and design of complex, large-scale CCaaS solutions, ensuring seamless integration of voice and digital channels (chat, email, social, messaging). AI Integration & Orchestration : Architect and present solutions utilizing embedded and third-party AI/ML services for conversational AI, real-time agent assist, sentiment analysis, and intelligent workflow orchestration across the customer journey. Demonstration & Proof of Value : Create, customize, and deliver compelling, high-impact product demonstrations and Proof of Concepts (PoCs) that clearly illustrate the business value of our platforms, showcasing integrations with core business applications (CRM, WFO, ERP). Technical Expertise & Advocacy : Act as the trusted technical advisor to the sales team and customer executives, guiding discussions on security, compliance, API integration , cloud architecture, and total cost of ownership (TCO) for modern cloud CX solutions. Competitive Strategy : Maintain expert-level knowledge of the CCaaS competitive landscape (e.g., Genesys, NICE CXone, Amazon Connect) and effectively position Avaya’s differentiation. Qualifications Required Core Competencies & Skills Experience : Minimum of 8 years in a technical pre-sales, solution consulting, or solution architecture role, with 5+ years of CCaaS/SaaS/Cloud contact center experience (Genesys, NICE, 8x8, Five9, Talkdesk, Calabrio, etc) CCaaS Architecture : Deep, hands-on experience designing and presenting modern cloud contact center reference architectures, including knowledge of microservices, global multi-region deployments, and consumption models. AI/Intelligent Automation : Proven ability to articulate the value of AI in CX (e.g., self-service containment, agent augmentation, journey analysis) and experience integrating conversational AI solutions (bots, NLP). Omnichannel Journey Desig n: Expertise in mapping and designing end-to-end customer journeys that leverage digital channels and maintain context across channels and systems. API/Integration Proficiency : Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, Webhooks, and CPaaS concepts, with the ability to discuss business application integrations (Salesforce, ServiceNow, etc.) with technical teams. title: Mechanical Engineer | Werktuigbouwkunde | Machinebouw
description: Werk aan uiteenlopende technische uitdagingen: van complexe machines en bewegende systemen tot productielijnen en maatwerkconstructies. Welkom bij Akkodis Als Mechanical Engineer bij Akkodis in Nijmegen hoef je niet te kiezen voor één product, machine of technische omgeving. Je werkt aan engineeringprojecten binnen verschillende sectoren. Zo blijft je werk uitdagend en pas je jouw technische kennis steeds in een andere omgeving toe. De ene keer ontwerp je een nieuwe machine of constructie, de andere keer werk je aan een modificatie of optimalisatie van een bestaand ontwerp. Je werkt bijvoorbeeld aan de engineering van zware graafmachines en achtbanen, maar ook aan geautomatiseerde transportsystemen en machines voor de voedingsindustrie. Elk project vraagt daarmee weer om andere technische kennis en oplossingen. Je maakt deel uit van een hecht team op de Novio High-Tech Campus in Nijmegen, waar junior engineers samenwerken met collega's die al tientallen jaren bij Akkodis werken. De sfeer is nuchter en persoonlijk: iedereen kent elkaar en collega's helpen elkaar graag verder. Je werkt op onze eigen projectafdeling of op locatie bij een opdrachtgever in de regio. Ook wanneer jij en je collega's aan verschillende projecten werken, zie je elkaar regelmatig tijdens kennissessies, teamactiviteiten of een spontane BBQ tijdens de lunch. Hoe ziet jouw werkdag eruit als Mechanical Engineer? Ontwerpen en construeren van machines, productielijnen en mechanische constructies Uitwerken en detailleren in 3D CAD Vertalen van eisen naar maakbare oplossingen Berekenen en onderbouwen van ontwerpkeuzes Oplossen van technische vraagstukken Verbeteren en optimaliseren van ontwerpen Sparren en kennis delen met collega-engineers Meer verantwoordelijkheid pakken? Je kunt zelfstandig aan de slag, maar spart net zo makkelijk met een collega over een ontwerp of oplossing. Lijkt iets technisch niet mogelijk? Dan ben jij degene die uitzoekt hoe het wél kan. Een praktische instelling en een beetje gezonde eigenwijsheid passen daar goed bij. Hoe word jij succesvol als Mechanical Engineer bij Akkodis? Achtergrond in Werktuigbouwkunde 4+ jaar ervaring binnen mechanical engineering Ervaren met Inventor, SolidWorks of vergelijkbaar In staat om zelfstandig ontwerpkeuzes te maken Oog voor maakbaarheid, constructies en materialen Analytisch sterk bij complexe technische vraagstukken Proactief in afstemming met collega's en opdrachtgevers Jij staat centraal Jij bepaalt de richting van je carrière. title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description: Mechanical Design Engineer Location: Cork, Ireland Job Type: Permanent | Full-time The Opportunity Occupli is partnering with an established engineering business specialising in the design and manufacture of bespoke capital equipment for the pharmaceutical and life sciences sectors. We are seeking a Mechanical Design Engineer to join an experienced engineering team, contributing to the design and development of complex, engineered equipment from initial concept through to manufacture, assembly and testing. This is an opportunity for an engineer who enjoys combining practical mechanical design expertise with problem-solving, technical collaboration and involvement in the full project lifecycle. The Role Working as part of a multidisciplinary project team, you will translate technical and customer requirements into detailed mechanical designs and manufacturing documentation, ensuring solutions are technically sound, practical to manufacture and delivered in line with project specifications. You will also work closely with production, fabrication, automation, procurement and project management teams, providing technical support throughout the design and manufacturing process. Key Responsibilities Develop 3D models and 2D engineering drawings for specialist mechanical equipment using CAD software. Interpret technical specifications and customer User Requirement Specifications (URS). Produce detailed engineering drawings, general arrangements, component details, bills of materials and manufacturing documentation. Undertake mechanical concept and detailed design, including sheet metal components and fabrication drawings. Apply Design for Manufacture (DFM) principles to ensure designs are practical, efficient and cost-effective to produce. Provide technical support to fabrication and assembly teams, resolving design queries and addressing manufacturing challenges. Participate in engineering design reviews and coordinate technical documentation for customer approval. Collaborate with project managers and multidisciplinary engineering teams to achieve project milestones and delivery schedules. Support supplier identification, component selection and procurement activities. Manage engineering design changes and associated technical documentation. Contribute to Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) activities. Skills & Experience To be considered, you should have: A degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline. A minimum of three years' experience in mechanical design, ideally involving machinery, specialist equipment or engineered systems. Strong 3D CAD capability, with experience in Solid Edge, SolidWorks, Autodesk Inventor or comparable software. Good knowledge of sheet metal design, fabrication and flat pattern development. Experience producing detailed engineering and manufacturing drawings, including general arrangements, component details and assembly documentation. An understanding of Design for Manufacture and the practical requirements of fabrication and machining. Experience working with technical specifications and managing multiple engineering deliverables. Good communication and organisational skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, production and customer-facing teams. Additional experience that would be advantageous: Exposure to pharmaceutical or life sciences equipment manufacturing. Familiarity with Good Documentation Practices (GDP) and GMP-related engineering documentation. Knowledge of relevant machinery safety standards and regulatory requirements, including ATEX, CE and UL. Experience with Factory Acceptance Testing and Site Acceptance Testing. The Opportunity Join a technically specialised engineering environment where you will have the opportunity to work on complex equipment, contribute to engineering solutions and see your designs progress from concept through to physical manufacture. If you are a Mechanical Design Engineer looking for your next opportunity within a specialist engineering and manufacturing environment, we would welcome a confidential conversation. Apply through Occupli to find out more.

title: Mekanik Tasarım Mühendisi
description: CANATEK A.Ş., Otomotiv ana ve yan sanayi kuruluşları ile genel endüstrinin imalatçı kuruluşlarının malzeme taşıma/kaldırma ve endüstriyel montaj alanlarında yüksek üretkenlik, yüksek kalite ve en iyi ergonomiye olan ihtiyaçlarını karşılamak üzere müşteriye özel yenilikçi mühendislik çözümlerini müşteriyle işbirliği yaparak geliştiren, tasarlayan, üreten, uygulayan ve satış sonrası hizmetlerini sunan Türkiye merkezli bir grup firması olup ayrıca SA ve BAE’de yerleşik firmalarıyla Orta Doğu pazarında da satış ve servis faaliyetleri yürütmektedir. Yüksek kaliteli ürün ve çözümlerimizi müşterilerimize sunarken, tasarım alanındaki yeniliklere odaklanıyoruz. Dinamik ekibimize katılacak Mekanik Tasarım Mühendisleri arıyoruz. Pozisyon Hakkında Bu rol, imalat endüstrilerinin ihtiyaçlarına yönelik, yenilikçi çözümlerin ve yüksek teknolojili makinelerin tasarım süreçlerini yönetecek, yaratıcı fikirler üretecek ve mevcut tasarımları geliştirecek bir pozisyondur. Sektördeki vizyonumuzu ve inovasyon gücümüzü ileriye taşımanıza katkı sağlamanız beklenmektedir. Görev ve Sorumluluklar Proje başlangıç ("Kickoff") toplantılarına katılarak, projenin tüm paydaşlarıyla birlikte gereksinimleri netleştirmek ve kayıt altına almak. Tasarım planına sadık kalarak, belirlenen zaman çizelgesine uygun şekilde tasarım süreçlerini tamamlamak. Müşteri ve diğer departmanlarla etkin iletişim kurarak takım çalışmasına katkı sağlamak. Tasarım ilerleme aşamalarına göre kontrol ve onay toplantılarına katılarak sunumlar yapmak. Proje kriterleri doğrultusunda, 3D CAD programları kullanarak detaylı tasarımları gerçekleştirmek. Makine elemanlarının dayanım hesaplamalarını yaparak uygun ürün seçimini sağlamak. Pnömatik hesaplamaları ve otomasyon ekibinden gelen verileri kullanarak uygun bileşenleri belirlemek. 3D modelleme ortamında simülasyon ve analiz çalışmaları yürüterek tasarımların doğruluğunu test etmek. Devreye alma aşamasında, sahadaki veya müşteri lokasyonundaki eksikleri tespit edip gidermek için yerleşim planı yapmak ve aksiyon almak. Tasarım onayı için gerekli belge ve simülasyonları hazırlamak. Onaylanan tasarımların firma standartlarına uygun şekilde numaralandırılmasını sağlamak. Üretim için gerekli teknik resimleri ve malzeme listelerini (BOM) oluşturmak. Üretim ve tedarikçi toplantılarında, doğru malzeme ve imalat yöntemlerinin belirlenmesi konusunda aktif rol almak. Proje teslimi sonrası dokümantasyon çalışmaları için gerekli bilgi ve belgeleri sağlamak. Tasarım ve standart parçalarla ilgili ortaya çıkan sorunlara hızlı çözümler sunmak ve revizyon çalışmalarını yönetmek. Proje dışı durumlarda, firma standartlarını geliştirmek için standart tasarımlar ve kütüphane çalışmaları yapmak. Aranan Nitelikler Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği, Mekatronik Mühendisliği veya Teknik Öğretmenlik bölümlerinden mezun olmak. Makine konstrüksiyonu ve mekanik sistem tasarımı konusunda en az 5 yıllık deneyime sahip olmak. SolidWorks gibi 3D CAD programlarına ileri düzeyde hakim olmak. Teknik resim okuma, ölçümlendirme ve ileri düzeyde hakim olmak. Kuvvet, moment, tork ve mekanik dayanım hesaplamaları yapabilecek Pnömatik sistemler, silindir seçimi ve mekanik hareket mekanizmaları hakkında bilgi sahibi. Malzeme seçimi, mukavemet ve maliyet optimizasyonu becerilerine sahip olmak. Talaşlı imalat, sac şekillendirme ve yüzey işlemleri gibi üretim tekniklerini tasarımlarına uygulayabilmek. Kaldırma ve taşıma sistemleri veya montaj ekipmanları alanında deneyim sahibi olmak tercih sebebidir. Aranan Yetkinlikler: Analitik düşünme ve problem çözme becerisi gelişmiş olmak. Planlama ve zaman yönetimi konusunda disiplinli olmak. Sürekli öğrenmeye ve kendini geliştirmeye açık olmak, yeni teknolojileri takip edebilmek. Sonuç odaklı, titiz ve dikkatli bir çalışma tarzına sahip olmak. B sınıfı sürücü ehliyetine sahip olmak ve aktif araç kullanabilmek. Gerektiğinde yurt içi seyahat engeli bulunmamak. Davranış Göstergeleri Bu rol için başarıyı getirecek temel davranışsal yetkinlikler şunlardır: İşbirliği ve Takım Çalışması: Proje paydaşları ve diğer ekip üyeleriyle uyum içinde çalışabilmek, bilgiyi etkin şekilde paylaşabilmek. Fikir alışverişine açık, yapıcı ve çözüm odaklı bir yaklaşım sergilemek. Problem Çözme ve İnisiyatif Alma: Karşılaştığı teknik zorlukları analiz ederek yaratıcı çözümler üretebilmek. Gerekli durumlarda inisiyatif alarak süreçlerin ilerlemesini sağlamak. Detay Odaklılık: Tasarım ve dokümantasyon süreçlerinde en ufak detayı dahi gözden kaçırmamak. Üretim ve montaj aşamalarında sorun yaratabilecek olası hataları önceden tespit etmek. Esneklik ve Uyum: Proje gerekliliklerindeki değişikliklere ve revizyonlara hızla adapte olabilmek. Hem ofis içi hem de saha çalışmalarında farklı ortamlara kolayca uyum sağlamak. Sorumluluk ve Hesap Verebilirlik: Sorumluluğundaki işlerin zamanında ve eksiksiz tamamlanmasını sağlamak. Aldığı kararların ve yaptığı işlerin sonuçlarından sorumluluk duymak.

title: PROJE VE TEKLİFLENDİRME MÜHENDİSİ
description: Atılım Tek Klima Sistemleri Lokasyon: İstanbul / Ümraniye Çalışma Şekli: Tam Zamanlı – İş Yerinde Departman: Proje ve Teknik Hizmetler İş İlanı Hakkında Atılım Tek Klima Sistemleri olarak, iklimlendirme sektöründeki tecrübemiz ve güçlü proje altyapımızla faaliyetlerimizi sürdürüyoruz. Proje Departmanımızda görevlendirilmek üzere; iklimlendirme ve mekanik tesisat sistemleri konusunda teknik bilgiye sahip, proje çizimi, maliyet analizi ve teklif hazırlama süreçlerinde deneyimli, planlama ve koordinasyon becerileri gelişmiş Proje ve Tekliflendirme Mühendisi arıyoruz. Görev ve Sorumluluklar Gelen mekanik tesisat ve iklimlendirme projelerini incelemek, teknik analizlerini gerçekleştirmek. Klima ve iklimlendirme sistemlerine yönelik projelendirme ve sistem seçimlerini yapmak. AutoCAD üzerinden proje çizimleri hazırlamak, mevcut projelerde gerekli revizyonları gerçekleştirmek. Projelerin keşif, metraj ve malzeme listelerini oluşturmak. Proje maliyetlerini hesaplamak, detaylı fiyat teklifleri hazırlamak. Teknik şartnameleri incelemek, projeye uygun ürün ve ekipman seçimlerini yapmak. Satış ekibinden gelen talepleri değerlendirerek doğru ve hızlı tekliflendirme süreçlerini yürütmek. Onaylanan tekliflerin sipariş, satın alma ve uygulama süreçlerini ilgili departmanlarla koordineli şekilde takip etmek. Proje sahalarında gerekli teknik kontrolleri ve uygunluk değerlendirmelerini gerçekleştirmek. Devam eden projelerdeki teknik değişiklikleri, ilave işleri ve revizyonları takip etmek. Proje dokümanlarının, tekliflerin ve siparişlerin düzenli şekilde kayıt altına alınmasını sağlamak. Tekliflerin zamanında, eksiksiz ve hatasız hazırlanmasını sağlamak. Aranan Nitelikler Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği veya ilgili mühendislik bölümlerinden mezun. Tercihen iklimlendirme, HVAC ve mekanik tesisat sektöründe deneyimli. AutoCAD programını iyi derecede kullanabilen. Mekanik tesisat projelerini okuyabilen, yorumlayabilen ve teknik çizim yapabilen. Klima sistemleri, VRF, split klima ve ticari iklimlendirme sistemleri hakkında teknik bilgi sahibi. Keşif, metraj, maliyet analizi ve teklif hazırlama süreçlerine hâkim. MS Office, özellikle Excel programını iyi derecede kullanabilen. Teknik dokümanları, şartnameleri ve proje detaylarını analiz edebilen. Planlama, organizasyon ve iş takibi konusunda disiplinli. Detaylara önem veren, dikkatli ve sonuç odaklı. Analitik düşünme ve problem çözme becerileri gelişmiş. Ekip çalışmasına yatkın, iletişim becerileri güçlü ve sorumluluk sahibi. Atılım Tek Klima Sistemleri'nde Kariyer İklimlendirme sektöründe 30 yılı aşkın tecrübeye sahip şirketimizde, farklı ölçeklerdeki ticari ve kurumsal projelerde görev alabileceğiniz, teknik bilgi ve deneyiminizi geliştirebileceğiniz bir çalışma ortamı sunuyoruz. Ekibimize katılmak ve projelerimizde birlikte çalışmak için başvurularınızı bekliyoruz.

title: Mechanical Manager-Engineering
description: We, as Çalık Enerji, offer the energy from nature to the people to build a better and sustainable future. Since its establishment in 1998, Çalık Enerji has become one of the world’s leading energy companies, bringing the energy of nature to the service of people through successful projects conducted across a wide geographic area encompassing CIS countries, the Middle East, Central Asia, Africa, Europe and the Balkans in order to create a better and sustainable future. We are looking for a " Mechanical Manager" in Çalık Enerji Headquarters - Engineering Division located in Istanbul. Lead the preparation of complex material requisitions and take final responsibility for Technical Bid Evaluations (TBE). Manage technical relations with global vendors and subcontractors. Willingness to travel internationally for technical meetings, factory tests (FAT), and site visits.

title: Teknik Servis Mühendisi
description: Teknik Servis Mühendisi Arıyoruz! Biz Kimiz? CNC makineleriyle üretimi hızlandıran, hataları minimize eden ve sanayiye değer katan bir mühendislik firmasıyız. Sahada çözüm üretmekten çekinmeyen, her durumda "Bu iş bizde!" diyebilen bir ekibiz. Müşterilerimize sadece teknoloji sunmakla kalmıyor, güvenilir bir iş ortağı olmanın sorumluluğunu da taşıyoruz. Bizim için teknoloji ne kadar önemliyse, doğru insan ilişkileri ve güven de o kadar kıymetli. Ürettiğimiz her çözümde yüksek teknolojiyi sağlam insan bağlarıyla birleştiriyoruz. Kimi Arıyoruz? Takım ruhunu önemseyen, “Sahaya çıkayım, sorunu yerinde çözeyim” diyen bir Teknik Servis Mühendisi arıyoruz. Sadece kabloları değil, insan ilişkilerini de doğru bağlayabilen, iletişimi güçlü bir ekip arkadaşı. Görevlerin Neler Olacak? CNC makinelerinin mekanik/elektrik kurulumu ve devreye alma süreçlerinde aktif rol almak; her şeyin kusursuz çalıştığından emin olmak. Müşteri sahasında veya uzaktan bağlantıyla arıza tespiti yapmak, periyodik bakımları yürütmek ve hızlı, kalıcı çözümler üretmek. Kurulum sonrası operatör eğitimlerini vermek; müşterilerle güvene dayalı bir iletişim kurarak karmaşık teknik konuları anlaşılır bir dille aktarmak. Yapılan işlemleri kayıt altına alarak teknik servis raporlarını düzenli hazırlamak ve Ar-Ge/üretim ekibine saha geri bildirimleri sağlamak. Aradığımız Özellikler: Üniversitelerin Makine, Mekatronik, Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği veya ilgili teknik bölümlerinden mezun olmak (ya da “Bu işi gerçekten çözerim” diyebilecek güçlü bir saha ve teknik altyapıya sahip olmak), CNC makineleriyle yolu kesişmiş; hareket kontrol, mekanik, pnömatik ve otomasyon sistemlerine yabancı olmamak, Başta Beckhoff ve Siemens olmak üzere; Fanuc, , Fagor gibi kontrol üniteleriyle en az bir kahve içmiş, hatta ikinciyi söyleyecek kadar samimi olmak, Elektrik şemalarını ve teknik resimleri harita çözer gibi okuyabilmek; kabloların, sensörlerin ve bağlantıların dilinden anlamak, B sınıfı ehliyete sahip olmak ve aktif araç kullanırken sadece direksiyonu değil, sorumluluğu da yönetebilmek, Yoğun tempoda soğukkanlılığını korumak, seyahat etmeyi ve yolda olmayı bir dert değil, deneyim olarak görmek, Ve belki de en önemlisi: Güçlü teknik bilginin yanında, müşteriyle kısa sürede ortak dil yakalayabilmek ve sahada markamızı güvenle temsil edebilmek. Neden Biz? Çünkü bizde iş sadece bir görev değil, her gün yeni bir şeyler öğrenebileceğin dinamik bir deneyimdir. Burada sadece makinelerle değil, gerçek mühendislik çözümleriyle ilgilenirsin. “Sen yaparsın” derken sana gerçekten inanır ve her zaman arkanda dururuz. Gelişmek isteyenler için her zaman alan açar, işimizi ciddiye alırız. Sadece makineleri çalıştırmakla kalmayıp müşterilerine değer katan, her sorunun bir çözümü olduğuna inanan bir ekibin parçası olmak, yenilikçi bir ortamda çalışmak ve her gün biraz daha iyiye gitmek istiyorsan doğru yerdesin. Çalışma Yeri ve Şekli: Kayseri – Tam Zamanlı (Saha destekli pozisyon; gerektiğinde Türkiye genelinde seyahat) Başvuru: CV’ni ve seni anlatan kısa bir ön yazıyı info@fournuco.com adresine gönderebilirsin. Bizim için soğuk bir resmiyet değil, samimiyet önemli. Kendin ol, yeter.

title: CAD/CAM Uzmanı | Siemens NX – CNC Freze – CMM
description: Savunma Sanayi | Hassas Talaşlı İmalat | Siemens NX Çalışma Yeri: Ankara / Sincan Çalışma Şekli: Tam Zamanlı Pozisyon Hakkında Savunma sanayi ve hassas talaşlı imalat alanında faaliyet gösteren firmamızın üretim ve mühendislik süreçlerinde görevlendirilmek üzere; Siemens NX CAD/CAM yazılımına hâkim, CNC freze operasyonlarında deneyimli, teknik resim ve ölçüm teknolojileri konusunda yetkin CAD/CAM Programcısı arayışımız bulunmaktadır. Aradığımız çalışma arkadaşımızın yalnızca CNC programlama süreçlerini değil, parçanın teknik resimden nihai kalite kontrol aşamasına kadar olan üretim süreçlerini değerlendirebilmesi; işleme verimliliği, ölçüsel doğruluk ve ürün kalitesinin geliştirilmesine katkı sağlaması beklenmektedir. Aranan Nitelikler CAD/CAM ve Teknik Tasarım Siemens NX CAD/CAM yazılımını etkin ve ileri düzeyde kullanabilen, 2D/3D teknik resim okuma, yorumlama ve üç boyutlu katı modelleme konusunda deneyimli, CNC freze tezgâhları için 3 ve 4 ve Beşikli 5 eksen CAM programları hazırlayabilen, 4 ve 5 eksen işleme stratejilerine hâkim, Takım yolu oluşturma, simülasyon, işleme optimizasyonu ve postprocessor süreçlerinde bilgi sahibi, Kesici takım, takım tutucu, bağlama aparatları ve işleme stratejilerini doğru belirleyebilen. CNC Freze ve Talaşlı İmalat CNC freze tezgâhlarının çalışma prensiplerine ve talaşlı imalat yöntemlerine hâkim, CNC programlarının tezgâh üzerinde uygulanması, kontrol edilmesi ve gerektiğinde revize edilmesi konularında deneyimli, G/M kodları, takım ofsetleri, iş parçası sıfırlama ve koordinat sistemleri hakkında bilgi sahibi, Kesme hızı, ilerleme, talaş derinliği ve takım ömrü gibi parametreleri optimize edebilen, Fikstür tasarımı, iş parçası bağlama yöntemleri ve operasyon sıralaması konusunda bilgi sahibi, İşleme hataları, ölçüsel sapmalar, takım aşınmaları ve yüzey kalitesi problemlerine teknik çözümler geliştirebilen, İşleme sürelerini azaltmaya ve üretim verimliliğini artırmaya yönelik çalışmalar gerçekleştirebilen. Kalite Kontrol, Ölçüm ve CMM Teknik resimlerdeki ölçü, tolerans, geometrik toleranslandırma (GD&T) ve yüzey pürüzlülüğü gerekliliklerini yorumlayabilen, Kumpas, mikrometre, komparatör, mihengir ve diğer hassas ölçüm ekipmanlarını kullanabilen, CMM (Koordinat Ölçüm Cihazı) çalışma prensipleri ve üç boyutlu ölçüm teknikleri hakkında bilgi sahibi, Tercihen CMM cihazlarında ölçüm programı hazırlama ve ölçüm raporlarını değerlendirme deneyimi bulunan, Tercihen PC-DMIS, ZEISS CALYPSO veya benzeri CMM yazılımlarından en az birini kullanabilen, İlk parça kontrolü, proses içi ölçüm, son kontrol ve uygunsuzluk değerlendirme süreçlerine katkı sağlayabilen, Ölçüm sonuçlarını değerlendirerek gerekli CAD/CAM ve üretim iyileştirmelerini gerçekleştirebilen. Genel Yetkinlikler Tercihen savunma, havacılık, otomotiv veya hassas talaşlı imalat sektörlerinde deneyimli, Kalite yönetim sistemleri ve izlenebilirlik gereklilikleri hakkında bilgi sahibi, Tercihen ISO 9001, AS9100/EN 9100 veya savunma sanayi kalite gerekliliklerine aşina, Üretim, kalite kontrol ve mühendislik ekipleriyle koordineli çalışabilen, Teknik problem çözme, analitik düşünme ve sürekli iyileştirme becerilerine sahip, Üretim sahasında aktif çalışabilecek, sorumluluk sahibi ve sonuç odaklı. İş Tanımı ve Sorumluluklar 1. Süreç İyileştirme ve Dokümantasyon Üretim süreleri, takım ömürleri ve işlem verimliliklerini analiz etmek, Tekrarlayan üretim hatalarının giderilmesine yönelik kalıcı çözümler geliştirmek, CNC programlarının, revizyonlarının ve ilgili teknik dokümanların kontrollü şekilde yönetilmesini sağlamak, Üretim süreçlerinde standardizasyon, verimlilik ve sürekli iyileştirme çalışmalarına katılmak, Firma bünyesinde yürütülen dijital üretim takibi ve süreç geliştirme çalışmalarını desteklemek. Tercih Sebepleri Siemens NX ile aktif CNC programlama tecrübesi, 4 veya 5 eksen CNC freze işleme bilgisi, CMM programlama ve ölçüm raporlama deneyimi, Savunma sanayine yönelik yüksek hassasiyetli parça üretimi tecrübesi, Fikstür, işleme stratejisi ve çevrim süresi optimizasyonu deneyimi, Üretim ve kalite kontrol süreçlerinde birlikte görev almış olmak. Başvuru CAD/CAM programlama, CNC freze ve hassas talaşlı imalat süreçlerinde deneyimli, teknik bilgisini üretim sahasında uygulayabilen ve gelişime açık adayların başvurularını bekliyoruz.

title: PROCESS QUALITY ENGINEER
description: About the Job Location: Tekirdağ / Ergene, Türkiye At Sistem Alüminyum , we are looking for a Process Quality Engineer to join our team at our manufacturing facility in Ergene, Tekirdağ . In this role, you will be responsible for monitoring process quality, ensuring compliance with quality standards, identifying opportunities for improvement, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives across manufacturing operations. We are looking for a detail-oriented, analytical, and collaborative professional who is passionate about quality and operational excellence. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Industrial Engineering. Good command of English, both written and spoken. Experience in quality processes and knowledge of quality management principles and practices. title: Senior Platform Engineer (100% Remote within Türkiye)
description: Welcome to the good side of tech 👋 You might have heard about us, but with a different name: DoktorTakvimi. It all started 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step of making the healthcare experience more human? Docplanner at scale We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 90 million patients trust us every month. 300k+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 10 years ago. At Docplanner we are a diverse group of over 300 people working in Engineering, Data, and Product teams. We are responsible for building the product for all locations. Many of us have been here for over 5 years, yet we still welcome each new person with great joy and excitement. We could tell you about us, but we will let our reviews on Glassdoor speak for themselves. In case you’d like to see how it feels to be 100% yourself at work, here’s a video of us. And why should you join us? Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs. We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that taking the diversity of human experience into account makes a better healthcare experience for all . We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we're 100% remote friendly. Team vision and mission Doctoralia Practice is Docplanner's practice management system for individual doctors: agenda, EHR, prescriptions, invoicing and Noa, our AI clinical assistant, in one product. The Practice Adoption team makes Practice win in each market by adapting it to local regulation and local doctor needs, on top of a shared global platform run by Core Platform. In Türkiye, that means one clear mission: give DoktorTakvimi, Doctoralia Practice and our telehealth product a platform that is fully compliant with the Ministry of Health, with every byte of patient data stored and processed in Türkiye, while keeping the reliability and cost profile of the global platform. About The Role We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer based in Türkiye to own the infrastructure behind our Turkish products. You will run production Kubernetes workloads on AWS, migrate our relational databases from RDS to databases running on EKS, and operate the PHP, .NET and Node.js applications that run in them. You will be the platform's reference for data residency, encryption and audit evidence during the Ministry of Health certification, working with the Practice Adoption engineers, the local compliance team and the global Core Platform team, which supports you on the shared platform. We want a strong platform engineer first: someone who knows Kubernetes inside out from running it in production and can figure out the rest. Ideally you have already run databases on Kubernetes. If not, you have the depth to learn it fast and the judgment to do it safely. What You'll Work On Run the Kubernetes platform. You own the EKS clusters behind our Turkish products: node lifecycle and upgrades, autoscaling, resource policy, networking, deployment and observability. This is the core of the job and where we need depth from day one. Your first big project: databases from RDS to Kubernetes. Our Turkish products run centralised on RDS today. You will plan and execute the migration to databases on EKS, operated through a Kubernetes operator: replication, cutover with a tested rollback, backups and point-in-time recovery to S3, and monitoring. Then: bring the rest of Türkiye in. Applications, data plane and the services around them still have to move to the Turkish platform. Plenty of technologies, plenty of challenges. Finally: operate the platform the certification depends on. The local team has secured ISO 27001 and ISO SPICE, moved telehealth data to the AWS Türkiye Local Zone and been accepted into KTS, the Ministry's registration system. The remaining USBS (Remote Health Information System) requirements put concrete obligations on the platform Day to day: high availability and autoscaling of PHP, .NET and Node.js workloads (KEDA, Karpenter), GitOps delivery with Argo CD, cross-cluster networking and Datadog monitoring. Key Responsibilities Run the Kubernetes platform for the Turkish products: node lifecycle, upgrades, autoscaling (HPA, KEDA, Karpenter), resource policy. Lead the migration of relational databases from RDS to databases on EKS: operator choice, replication, cutover, rollback, backups and point-in-time recovery. Own the platform's compliance evidence: data residency, encryption, secrets and privileged access, backups, and the artefacts the Ministry audit asks for. Keep PHP, .NET and Node.js workloads highly available: zero-downtime deploys, DB-safe releases, graceful shutdown, right-sized scaling. Own delivery through GitOps: Argo CD structure, deployment strategies (rolling, blue-green, canary), environment promotion. Design and debug networking: ingress, cross-cluster and cross-VPC communication, controlled egress to Ministry systems. Build observability with Datadog: SLOs, actionable alerts, APM and database monitoring, audit-grade logging. Operate those databases once migrated: failover, upgrades, storage performance,

title: R&D Engineer
description: Do you want to turn innovative ideas into medical devices that make a difference? If you have a flair for mechanical design, enjoy taking ownership and solving complex challenges, we would love to hear from you. Ambu is currently looking for an Experienced R&D Engineer to join our Mechanical Engineering team. In this role, you will join a passionate team of engineers, all with different backgrounds, collaborating to drive our continued product innovation. You can expect to use your strong design background to broaden your experience across the full development cycle, ensuring continued professional and technical development. In this position, you will likely thrive the most if you naturally tend to take charge and support your colleagues. You may be a strong mechanical designer in your field, but you should also identify yourself with the values of Taking Charge and Team Up. If you have experience in driving technical development, that will certainly help you succeed in this role. The role is based at our Innovation Site in Ballerup, Denmark. Key responsibilities In this role, you will be in a key position in the development of Ambu’s future products. You can therefore expect to: Identify user needs, design inputs and specifications through participation in the project start-up phase where interaction with key opinion leaders, doctors and other experts worldwide is crucial to fulfil the ambitious innovation targets Be a key influencer in significant development projects within Ambu Develop new, and further improve existing, mechanical design solutions of components and assemblies as well as optimization of existing designs for Ambu's extensive product portfolio within endoscopy, anesthesiology, and patient monitoring Have the responsibility for the mechanical design and construction of functionalities, parts and assemblies including quality aspects for robust and safe medical products Translate technology concepts into fully working prototypes ready for feasibility testing and process evaluation including documentation Ensure that the component or product is manufacturable in high volume, fulfils function and stays within defined cost framework Ensure continually updated documentation in accordance with the regulations from FDA and ISO certification including FMEA's, risk assessments and tolerance analyses Trust cooperation with internal and external partners. You will work in international development teams from Germany, Denmark, and Malaysia as well as with external partners, users, physicians, and suppliers Suggested candidate profile Skills and experience can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are, however, likely to succeed in this position if you have. Ideally, you can assess manufacturability from a designer’s perspective and bring practical, hands-on insights rather than purely academic approaches. Experience with micromanufacturing or integrating design for small metal and plastic parts will be considered an advantage. We welcome candidates with expertise in microparts, and previous experience with hearing aids or similar precision devices would be a strong plus. Successfully completed a technical or scientific course of study, e.g., mechanical or medical engineering resulting in a broad technical understanding Good strong knowledge of working with a CAD system e.g. Inventor, Solidworks, Creo, Catia Have some experience in product development and/or design of safety-critical products Experience working with the development of Medical Devices is considered an advantage, however other highly regulated industries could also be relevant Relevant experience in the design of mechanical and plastic components for high volumes from the fields of injection molding, extrusion, and tool design Professional level of both written and spoken English Strong team and communication skills, initiative, and courage to take charge in development project groups Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment. We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social, and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development. Do you want to grow with Ambu? The team is expanding and would love to hear from you! If this role sparks your interest, go ahead and apply today.

title: Maskiningeniør til mekanikafdeling
description: Erfaren Mekanikingeniør til produktudvikling og teknisk rådgivning Hos Prevas hjælper vi vores kunder med at løse komplekse tekniske udfordringer og udvikle robuste produkter, der kan produceres, certificeres og fungere i virkeligheden. Til vores kontor i Aarhus eller Aalborg søger vi derfor en erfaren mekanikingeniør, som trives i dialogen med kunderne og kan omsætte udfordringer til konkrete løsninger. Du har sandsynligvis 10+ års erfaring inden for mekanisk produktudvikling og er vant til at navigere i krydsfeltet mellem design, produktion, elektronik og myndighedskrav. Du ved, at den bedste løsning sjældent findes alene i CAD-systemet, men gennem forståelse af hele produktets livscyklus. Hvad kommer du til at arbejde med? Dine opgaver vil variere fra kunde til kunde, men vil typisk omfatte: Teknisk sparring og rådgivning af kunder Teknisk lead på udviklingsprojekter Vurdering og løsning af problemer relateret til plastkomponenter og plastprocesser Analyse af vibrationer, levetid og robusthed Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFMA) Risikoanalyser, FMEA og tekniske vurderinger Produktionsmodning og optimering af eksisterende produkter Teknisk afklaring i forbindelse med miljøkrav, compliance og certificering Samarbejde med designere, elektronik-, software- og systemingeniører Fejlfinding på produkter, der ikke opfører sig som teorien siger Hvem er du? Vi forestiller os, at du: Er uddannet maskiningeniør eller tilsvarende Har mindst 10 års relevant erhvervserfaring Har arbejdet med produktudvikling fra idé til serieproduktion Er stærk i dialogen med kunder og interessenter Kan skabe overblik og træffe beslutninger på et ufuldstændigt grundlag Er pragmatisk og løsningsorienteret Forstår hvornår en analyse skaber værdi, og hvornår erfaring er den hurtigste vej til en god beslutning Derudover ser vi gerne, at du har erfaring med flere af følgende områder: Plastmaterialer og plastkonstruktion Vibrationer og udmattelse Miljø- og produktkrav (CE, REACH eller lignende miljøregulerede regulativer) Produktionsprocesser og kvalitetsudfordringer Mekanik i samspil med elektronik Tolerancekæder og produktrobusthed CAD og teknisk dokumentation Leverandørdialog og produktion i ind- og udland Hvad tilbyder vi? Hos Prevas bliver du en del af et stærkt mekanikteam med erfarne kolleger, som hjælper hinanden og deler viden på tværs af projekter og fagområder. Vi tilbyder: Spændende og varierede udviklingsprojekter, med mulighed for at præge både projekter og afdelingens udvikling. Stor grad af frihed og ansvar Direkte kundekontakt og indflydelse på løsningerne Et stærkt fagligt miljø med høj teknisk troværdighed Moderne laboratorie- og prototypefaciliteter Fleksibel hverdag og gode kolleger Det vigtigste Vi leder ikke nødvendigvis efter den person, der kan lave de største beregningsmodeller eller de flotteste præsentationer. Vi leder efter en ingeniør, der har prøvet det før. En person, der kan, forstå problemet, stille de rigtige spørgsmål og finde den løsning, der virker i praksis. Hvis det lyder som dig, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig. Ved spørgsmål til stillingen, kontakt: Engineering Manager Kim Bøndergaard Tlf: 5154 3961 Email: kim.bondergaard@prevas.dk Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når den rette kandidat er fundet. Om Prevas Prevas er et udviklingshus, hvor opfindsomheden står i centrum. Med høj teknisk kompetence og forretningsforståelse hjælper vi kunder inden for vidt forskellige brancher med at få større udbytte af vor tids tekniske udvikling. Til fordel for People, Planet and Profit. Prevas startede i 1985, og har i dag 1000 medarbejdere i Sverige, Danmark, Norge og Finland. Prevas har været børsnoteret på NASDAQ Stockholm siden 1998. title: Senior Mechanical Design Consultant - Robust Design
description: Pls note that we do not support relocation or visa sponsorship for this position Do you enjoy working through complex mechanical problems, questioning assumptions and understanding why a design behaves the way it does? At RD8, you will work hands-on with mechanical product development, using analysis and practical design work to solve challenging client problems. You will join an international team of mechanical engineers in a dedicated technical environment where specialist expertise is central to the work as part of a dynamic start-up This role is for engineers who want to stay close to the engineering work and don’t shy away from the hard and interesting challenges where you have to use all of your toolbox About RD8 We help companies that cannot afford to get it wrong make better engineering design decisions. Through consulting, software and ventures, we strengthen how mechanical R&D teams think, design and deliver. Our aim is to make Robust Design an everyday engineering practice. Our engineering ecosystem brings together specialist knowledge, training, documentation and software. We work with R&D, operations and manufacturing organizations across industries, including major international companies, to make mechanical products less sensitive to variation. What you will do As a Senior Robust Design Consultant, you will work directly on clients’ mechanical design challenges. You will investigate how parts interact, how tolerances affect function, and how designs can be improved. The role combines engineering work with client dialogue and technical responsibility for project delivery. Work with small teams to design, analyze, and improve mechanical products. We work either inside our clients’ teams or as more independent teams. Develop solutions for new products across several industries. Analyze and improve existing products in a range of industries. Mentor and spar with junior consultants Create data-driven transparency in your solutions to improve decision-making. Explain findings and design recommendations to clients, help deliver projects, and coordinate technical work within the team. You will be working on these tasks with frontrunners within the area of Robust Design - experts on a global level in a start-up with global ambitions. We are continuously developing our framework and adopting or creating solutions for our engineering ecosystem. There’s a short way from decision to action and a high degree of freedom to shape the company and solutions. Great opportunities to take responsibility and shape the business areas going forward Your background We are looking for senior profiles with 5+ years of relevant professional experience, ideally in mechanical product development, who want to deepen their expertise and remain hands-on. A master’s degree in mechanical engineering or a related field. Strong analytical skills across mechanical function, tolerance variation, and solid mechanics. Knowledge of Robust Design principles. Knowledge of production technologies and Design for Manufacturing (DFM). Fluent English. Additional experience we value Working knowledge of statistical methods and finite element simulation methods. Experience with prototyping tools and methods. Strong communication and presentation skills. Danish or German language skills. Advanced simulation expertise. Location and travel This is a hybrid role based at our headquarters at Strandboulevarden 122, 3rd floor, 2100 Copenhagen, Denmark. Expect 0–20 travel days per year. Why join RD8 Work alongside Robust Design specialists on mechanical challenges across products and industries. Have a high degree of freedom in how you approach your work and contribute to the methods and tools we develop. Flexibility to work from home when project and client commitments allow, with support for a home office setup Optional monthly social events, a subsidized lunch scheme and coffee, tea and snacks at the office. Take on responsibility and help shape our services and business areas as the company develops. Apply If you're a problem-solver who is excited about working on cutting-edge technology to create world-class solutions, then apply now with your CV For further information about the position, contact Casper Høgh at Csh@ing.dk Please mention in your application that you have seen the job on TechJob.

title: Senior Equipment Engineer, Capability Building
description: Job Description Just imagine developing the next generation of fully automated production equipment that helps bring LEGO® bricks to life. Then make it real. About The Role As our Senior Equipment Engineer, you'll develop fully automated Processing Equipment Solutions for decorating, pre-assembling and coating LEGO® bricks. Working closely with project teams and key partners, you'll turn business needs into robust equipment solutions involving robotics, vision, feeding and product transport systems. You'll take equipment from early concepts through detailed design and implementation, balancing performance, safety, quality and maintainability. Required Qualifications Experience in developing fully automated, high-speed and high-precision manufacturing equipment from early concepts through detailed design and implementation. Proficient with mechanical design using CAD tools and technical document management systems, for example Siemens NX and Teamcenter or similar. The ability to contribute to technical decisions, planning and structured problem solving. Experience with testing, validation and systematic problem solving. Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with others to achieve shared success. Fluency in English, both written and spoken. Preferred Qualifications Insight into Industry 4.0, for example digital twins and simulations. High level of experience with robotics, vision, feeding and product transport systems. Life on the team You'll join Technology Development, where we combine innovation, engineering and industrialization to create future manufacturing capabilities and capacity for decoration and pre-assembly of LEGO bricks. Joining the team gives you the opportunity to work on highly automated machinery, new technologies and strategic development initiatives while collaborating with skilled engineering specialists and project teams across the LEGO Group. The team embraces the LEGO approach of "Thinking BIG, Starting Small, and Implementing with Speed." What success looks like You'll become a trusted technical contributor who can independently create machine concepts and detailed designs while owning complex technical challenges. Looking ahead, you'll help us develop next-generation processing platforms with greater use of automation, robotics and digital technologies. You'll work closely with project managers, equipment engineers, platform owners, production sites, procurement, technical specialists and external suppliers as we build scalable manufacturing capabilities for future LEGO products. This position is based in Billund, Denmark. Please note that relocation support is not offered for this role. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. What’s in it for you? Here is what you can expect Family Care Leave - We offer enhanced paid leave options for those important times. Insurances – All colleagues are covered by our life and disability insurance which provides protection and peace of mind. Wellbeing - We want our people to feel well and thrive. We offer resources and benefits to nurture physical and mental wellbeing along with opportunities to build community and inspire creativity. Colleague Discount – We know you'll love to build, so from day 1 you will qualify for our generous colleague discount. Bonus - We do our best work to succeed together. When goals are reached and if eligible, you'll be rewarded through our bonus scheme. Your workplace Your workplace will be the office, store or factory specified in this advert. Hybrid Working Our hybrid work model, Best of Both offers you the option of flexibility to work from home up to two days per week. Your People Leader will discuss the principles of the model, including how this option applies to your role and team. Learn more about our benefits, culture and workplace experience here Children are our role models. Their curiosity, creativity and imagination inspire everything we do. We strive to create a diverse, dynamic and inclusive culture of play at the LEGO Group, where everyone feels safe, valued and they belong. The LEGO Group is highly committed to equal employment opportunity and equal pay and seeks to encourage applicants from all backgrounds (eg. sex, gender identity or expression, race/ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, age and religion) to apply for roles in our team. The LEGO Group is fully committed to Children’s Rights and Child Wellbeing across the globe. Candidates offered positions with high engagement with children are required to take part in Child Safeguarding Background Screening, as a condition of the offer. Thank you for sharing our global commitment to Children’s Rights. Just imagine building your dream career. Then make it real. Join the LEGO® team today.

title: Design Engineer
description: Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens lantbruksmaskiner och se dina idéer bli verklighet? Som Design Engineer hos oss arbetar du med hela utvecklingsresan, från koncept och konstruktion till prototyp, testning i fält och färdig produkt. Du blir en del av ett erfaret team med specialistkompetens inom bland annat hydraulik, mekanikkonstruktion och prototyputveckling. Om rollen Som Design Engineer har du en central roll i våra utvecklingsprojekt och arbetar med både nyutveckling och vidareutveckling av befintliga produkter. Du samarbetar nära kollegor inom konstruktion, testning och produktutveckling för att ta fram innovativa lösningar för framtidens lantbruk. I rollen kommer du bland annat att: Utreda, analysera och genomföra konstruktionsuppgifter inom konceptutveckling, produktutveckling, produktunderhåll och komponentutveckling. Designa och utveckla produkter utifrån uppsatta krav, processer och tekniska ramverk. Delta aktivt genom hela utvecklingsprocessen och ta ansvar för kvalitet, leveranstid och produktkostnad inom dina konstruktionsområden. Medverka vid byggnation av prototyper samt utvärdering och verifiering av tekniska lösningar. Dokumentera och kommunicera tekniska lösningar på ett tydligt och strukturerat sätt. Bidra med tekniskt stöd och kunskapsdelning till kollegor samt vara delaktig i utvecklingen av metoder och arbetssätt inom konstruktionsområdet. Om dig Vi söker dig som är engagerad, analytisk och strukturerad. Du har ett stort tekniskt intresse och motiveras av att lösa tekniska utmaningar tillsammans med andra. Som person är du ansvarstagande, kommunikativ och trivs med att samarbeta i tvärfunktionella team. Du delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och bidrar till både teamets och produkternas utveckling. Vi söker dig som: Har en högskole- eller civilingenjörsexamen inom maskinteknik eller motsvarande. Har minst 1–2 års erfarenhet av mekanikkonstruktion. Har erfarenhet av att arbeta i CAD-system, med fördel Creo och Windchill. Har goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift. Har du kunskap inom lantbruk ser vi det som meriterande. Varför du ska välja Väderstad På Väderstad kombinerar vi lång erfarenhet med en stark vilja att utvecklas och tänka nytt. Här får du arbeta tillsammans med kunniga kollegor i en verksamhet där samarbete, innovation och teknisk utveckling står i fokus. Vi erbjuder stort eget ansvar, korta beslutsvägar och goda möjligheter att utvecklas i din roll. Som en del av vårt team får du vara med och bidra till lösningar som hjälper lantbrukare världen över att bedriva ett mer effektivt och hållbart lantbruk. Övrig information Placeringsort är Väderstad. Som en del av rekryteringsprocessen kan psykometriska tester komma att användas för att säkerställa en objektiv och rättvis bedömning. För frågor gällande rollen vänligen kontakta Design Manager, Patrik Sjögren Fritz på +46 (72) 5940278 eller patrik.sjogrenfritz@vaderstad.com För frågor gällande rekryteringsprocessen vänligen kontakta Talent Acquisition Specialist, Ellinor Lindell på 0142-810 59 eller ellinor.lindell@vaderstad.com Ansökan Är du intresserad av tjänsten och motsvarar kraven är du välkommen att skicka in din ansökan med CV och personligt brev senast den 2026-11-13. title: Konstruktör
description: Konstruktör med intresse för maskinutveckling till Paxxo i Malmö Är du den praktiska maskinkonstruktören som inte bara vill rita, utan också se dina idéer ta form i produktionen? Hos Paxxo i Malmö får du en självständig och bred roll i ett familjärt bolag med världsunika produkter och kunder i hela världen. Produktionen är modern, sker helt in-house och bolaget fortsätter att investera i dess utveckling – här följer du hela resan från idé till färdig maskin under samma tak. Nu söker vi en Maskinkonstruktör till Paxxo i Malmö! Det här är en tillsvidaretjänst på heltid med önskad start snarast möjligt. Vad gör Paxxo? Paxxo är det mindre, familjära bolaget med de stora ambitionerna. Grundat 1980 i Malmö med ett tydligt syfte: att utveckla hållbara säcksystem för effektiv avfallshantering. Bolagets produkt – Longopac – är ett världsunikt säcksystem som idag säljs globalt med stor framgång. Det som gör Paxxo unikt är att all produktion sker i Sverige, i de egna lokalerna i Östra Hamnen i Malmö. De senaste åren har man gjort stora investeringar i produktionen och befinner sig nu i en tydlig expansionsfas. Här är alla delaktiga, beslutsvägarna är korta och du har verklig möjlighet att påverka, både i din roll och i bolaget i stort. Läs mer om oss här Vad gör en Konstruktör hos oss? Som Maskinkonstruktör hos Paxxo har du en nyckelroll och tar ett stort eget ansvar för den fortsatta utvecklingen av bolagets maskiner. Du arbetar brett med allt från konstruktionsarbete och ritningar till att bygga prototyper och felsöka ute i produktionen. Rollen är fri och självständig, med ett eget kontor och stor möjlighet att forma ditt arbetssätt. Du driver egna utvecklingsprojekt av delar, tillbehör och hela maskiner, och stöttar produktionen när det behövs anpassningar eller förändringar. Kort sagt: du får vara med från idé till färdig lösning. Du kommer att: Arbeta med CAD-konstruktion – ca 30 % nykonstruktion, 30 % anpassning, 30 % underhåll (vi använder Onshape) Skapa och uppdatera tillverkningsritningar, detaljritningar och toleransberäkningar Testa koncept och bygga prototyper, inkl. 3D-printade detaljer och fästen CE-märka och uppdatera befintliga maskiner vid konstruktionsändringar Ge teknisk support till inköp vid komponentval och tillverkningsfrågor Samarbeta tätt med maskinbyggare, underhållschef och produktionspersonal Driva egna projekt parallellt med löpande uppgifter i produktionen Vem är du? Vi tror att du är den tekniskt nyfikna konstruktören som gillar att tänka ut lösningar och sedan gå ut i verkstan och testa dem. Du har flera års erfarenhet av konstruktionsarbete och trivs lika bra vid CAD-datorn som ute i produktionen. Vi tror att du: Har flera års erfarenhet av maskinkon struktion, maskinutveckling eller liknande Har praktisk erfarenhet av mekanik och pneumatik – stål och aluminium Är trygg i CAD-konstruktion i 3D, gärna Inventor eller annat 3D-system Har erfarenhet av att skapa tillverknings- och detaljritningar Är självgående och van att fatta egna tekniska beslut Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift Erfarenhet av CE-märkning, beräkningar och simuleringar, eller förståelse för el och elritningar är meriterande. Vi uppskattar också om du är praktiskt lagd på fritiden – har du en uppfinnarprofil och gillar att skruva är du rätt person för oss. Vad erbjuder vi? Hos Paxxo får du en bred och fri roll i ett bolag som satsar och där du verkligen kan påverka. Du har eget kontor, stor frihet under ansvar och ett team av engagerade kollegor som delar ditt intresse för teknik och maskinutveckling. En självständig nyckelroll med stort eget ansvar och mandat att påverka Möjligheten att följa projekt hela vägen – från idé och ritning till färdig maskin Expansivt bolag med hållbara, världsunika produkter och globala kunder Familjär kultur med platt organisation, snabba beslut och humor på jobbet Välkommen med din ansökan! Du är varmt välkommen att söka via ansökningsformuläret. I den här rekryteringen gör vi ett löpande urval. Observera att vi inte tar emot ansökningar via e-post. I den här rekryteringsprocessen samarbetar vi med ROI Rekrytering. Vid frågor vänligen kontakta rekryteringskonsult Lisa Alsterberg – lisa.alsterberg@roirekrytering.se Varmt välkommen med din ansökan! title: Mekanikkonstruktör till flyg- och försvarsindustri

Om rollen I rollen som mekanikkonstruktör kommer du att arbeta med utveckling och vidareutveckling av mekaniska konstruktioner för produkter inom flyg- och försvarsindustrin. Du blir en del av ett erfaret konstruktörsteam där du får arbeta genom flera delar av produktens livscykel, från koncept och detaljkonstruktion till ritningsframtagning, dokumentation och produktvård. Rollen innebär många kontaktytor och nära samarbete med bland annat konstruktörer, produktägare, projektledare, systemingenjörer och produktion. Working in a dynamic environment, you will respond to evolving technologies, production challenges, and customer requirements while contributing to the optimisation of manufacturing processes and systems. You will play a key role in the industrialisation of new products, process development and improvement, implementation of innovative manufacturing tools and techniques, and the delivery of engineering support across a diverse range of programmes. The role also offers the opportunity to contribute to sustainability initiatives, advanced manufacturing technologies, and continuous improvement activities that enhance quality, efficiency, and productivity across the business. Act as the primary interface between Engineering and Manufacturing, ensuring technical requirements, design intent, and production challenges are communicated effectively and resolved in a timely manner. Develop and maintain Subject Matter Expert (SME) knowledge in gear manufacturing processes, including hobbing, shaping, profile grinding, and finish grinding of journals, cones, and thrust faces, providing technical guidance to both Design Engineering and machine shop personnel. Assess component manufacturability and manufacturing process capability to support a right-first-time approach, while actively contributing manufacturing expertise during design reviews and product development activities. Lead Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) activities, including process mapping, risk assessment, mitigation planning, and the development and approval of manufacturing procedures and control protocols. Interpret engineering drawings and specifications, producing and approving manufacturing drawings and supporting documentation to facilitate efficient production. Ensure manufacturing plans, processes, and documentation fully incorporate Quality Assurance requirements and support compliance with internal and customer standards. Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on enhancing product quality, reducing cycle times, improving productivity, and increasing process capability. Develop bespoke manufacturing methods, tooling, fixtures, and process solutions, ensuring compliance with Machinery Safety Regulations and safe working practices. Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams including Manufacturing, Design Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and external stakeholders such as suppliers and auditors to achieve programme objectives. Create and maintain work orders, technical packs, routings, operation sheets, and manufacturing instructions to support effective production planning and execution. Apply a strong understanding of heat treatment processes and their impact on material properties, dimensional stability, manufacturing methods, and final product performance. Qualifications Degree qualified in a relevant STEM discipline (e.g.,Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering), or equivalent experience. Professional member of a relevant engineering institution (e.g., IMechE, IMarEST, IMechE, IET). Essential Skills Deep understanding of manufacturing processes associated with rotating components, including turning, boring, milling, and other precision machining operations. Good knowledge of engineering principles, manufacturing techniques, and business systems used to support production and operational activities. Strong understanding of dimensional inspection methods, measurement systems, and metrology principles to ensure product conformity and quality. Ability to interpret complex engineering drawings and specifications, and generate or approve manufacturing-stage drawings and associated documentation. Comprehensive knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) and its application in manufacturing and inspection processes. Comprehensive knowledge of SAP and its application within a manufacturing engineering environment, including production routings, work orders, Bills of Materials (BOMs), and engineering change control. Proficient in the use of 2D and 3D CAD software to develop manufacturing layouts, tooling concepts, technical documentation, and engineering records. Chartered member of a relevant engineering institution (e.g., IMechE, IMarEST, IMechE, IET) Experience Experience within a heavily regulated industry e.g. Marine, Aerospace, Defence etc. Experience in CNC programming, machining practices, and process optimisation to support efficient and repeatable manufacturing operations. title: Graduate Engineer - Product Development

Working alongside experienced engineers across multiple disciplines, they will gain broad exposure to automotive systems, including body, chassis, powertrain, electrical and electronic, thermal, safety, and vehicle integration. They will contribute to innovative, cost-effective, high-quality, and manufacturable solutions that meet vehicle targets for function, performance, safety, durability, customer experience, and regulatory compliance. Create and maintain CAD models, engineering drawings, calculations, specifications, and technical documentation using appropriate engineering tools. Engineering Analysis & Validation Collaborate with design, CAE, test, electrical, software, materials, manufacturing, quality, and specialist engineering teams to assess system and component performance through calculation, simulation, analysis, and physical validation. Support the development and implementation of engineering solutions based on analysis, simulation, and physical test results. Participate in design reviews, problem-solving activities, and failure investigations with guidance from experienced engineers. Manufacturing & Launch Support Ensure designs are optimized for manufacturing and assembly processes. Support prototype builds and production launch activities. Resolve manufacturing and quality concerns through root cause analysis and corrective actions. Work with suppliers to ensure design intent and quality standards are maintained. Program Management Deliver engineering releases in line with program timing and milestones. Manage component development through design gateways and release processes. Support engineering change management activities. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with cross functional teams with a product focused mindset. Support design reviews and technical presentations with internal and external stakeholders. Qualifications: Degree or equivalent qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Electrical or Electronic Engineering, Mechatronics, Motorsport Engineering, Product Design Engineering, or a related discipline. A broad interest in automotive engineering and a willingness to develop knowledge across different vehicle systems, technologies, and engineering disciplines. Experience gained through university projects, placements, internships, Formula Student, personal projects, or similar practical engineering activities is desirable. Technical Skills: Basic understanding of engineering principles, technical drawings, data analysis, and structured problem-solving methods. Awareness of automotive systems, component interfaces, materials, manufacturing processes, testing methods, and vehicle development activities. Hands-on approach and willingness to work across disciplines in a small team environment. Good communication, teamwork, and problem-solving skills. Familiarity with CAD, CAE, data analysis, programming, requirements management, or engineering release and change processes is advantageous. Right to Work Please note that this role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK at the time of application. Right-to-work checks will be carried out in accordance with Home Office requirements. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know and we will be happy to support you.

Van het eerste technische ontwerp en de sterkteberekeningen tot het testen en de uiteindelijke inbedrijfstelling.
