Salaris en voorwaarden Een bruto maandsalaris tussen de €3.000 en €4.500 (o.b.v. fulltime en ervaring); Fulltime functie voor de lange termijn, of minimaal 32 uur per week; 30 vakantiedagen, waarvan 5 vooraf ingepland; 8% vakantiegeld en pensioenopbouw; Laptop van de zaak; Reiskostenvergoeding; Hybride werken in Barneveld en testen/inbedrijfname in onze fabriek in Hengevelde. Wat je kunt verwachten Innovatieve projecten die een echte impact hebben in diverse industrieën; Een veelzijdige functie bij een internationaal bedrijf met combinatie van ontwerp en praktijk; Een prettige werksfeer met ruimte voor eigen inbreng; Donderdagmiddagborrel en iedere maand een dönerdag die heel creatief aangekondigd wordt. Wat breng je mee? Een afgeronde HBO opleiding (Werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbaar); Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal; Affiniteit met hijsmiddelen en zware machinebouw is een pré; Een zelfstandige, flexibele en initiatiefrijke instelling. Over de functie Als Mechanical Engineer bij Aerolift ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen en berekenen van geavanceerde machines met een hefcapaciteit van 1 tot maar liefst 200 ton. Als werktuigbouwkundig engineer profiteer je van onze eigen productie, doordat je direct ziet hoe jouw ontwerpen in de praktijk tot leven komen. Dit versnelt je leerproces en geeft je de unieke kans om de impact van je werk echt te ervaren. Je werkt in een klein, hecht team waarin je je eigen projecten van A tot Z oppakt. Jij zorgt voor een strakke begeleiding van het project: je signaleert knelpunten, bewaakt de planning en bent betrokken bij alle stappen; van het ontwerp en de berekeningen tot het selecteren van grote inkoopdelen, de productie, het testen en het inbedrijfstellen van de machine. Daarbij heb je rechtstreeks contact met klanten en leveranciers. Naast de projecten voor Aerolift werk je ook aan technische oplossingen en engineeringprojecten voor ons zusterbedrijf Niconlift. Dit zorgt voor extra diversiteit en technische uitdagingen binnen je functie. In deze rol krijg je te maken met alle facetten van techniek: van constructies en hydrauliek tot elektrische installaties en besturingstechniek. Geen project is hetzelfde; elke keer zet je jouw technische creativiteit en kennis in om een oplossing te creëren die precies past bij de situatie. Jouw taken op een rij: Sparren met de verkoopafdeling over de technische oplossing; Het bedenken en ontwerpen van klantspecifieke hefoplossingen, gedeeltelijk in teamverband; Projecten begeleiden in nauw contact met leveranciers, klanten en collega’s; Het maken van tekeningen en stuklijsten; Het maken van de benodigde sterkteberekeningen; Het selecteren van aandrijvingen en besturingen; Het ondersteunen van onze collega’s in de fabriek bij de fabricage en het testen van onze machines; Bijdragen aan de verdere standaardisatie en modularisatie van onze ontwerpen door het ontwikkelen van herbruikbare technische modules en het uitbreiden en optimaliseren van de engineeringdatabase. Over ons Aerolift is al meer dan 60 jaar gespecialiseerd in het ontwerpen en bouwen van hijssystemen en handlingsoplossingen voor verschillende lasten, zoals beton, tunnelsegmenten, metalen platen, buizen en papierrollen. Onze vacuümheffers, vacuümkantelaars, mechanische spreaders en C-haken hebben hefcapaciteit van 1 tot 200 ton en bevatten doordachte techniek, zowel mechanisch, elektrisch als hydraulisch. Deze hefoplossingen produceren wij volledig in onze eigen fabriek, voordat ze wereldwijd naar onze eindklanten worden verscheept. Ons zusterbedrijf Niconlift biedt efficiënte laad- en losoplossingen voor exceptioneel transport met afneembare sideloadersystemen voor het hanteren van zware kabelhaspels en transformatorhuizen. Wie wij zoeken Om deze rol succesvol te kunnen uitvoeren, is het belangrijk dat jij in staat bent een machine van A tot Z te bedenken, te berekenen en te tekenen, zodat deze gebouwd kan worden. Hierbij is het van groot belang om nauwkeurig te werk te gaan en kwalitatief goed werk te leveren. Ervaring is geen vereiste voor deze functie; we zoeken vooral naar talent en potentieel. Of je nu net bent afgestudeerd of al enkele jaren werkervaring hebt, we nodigen je uit om te solliciteren. Interesse? Stuur je CV en korte motivatie naar hr@aerolift.nl of bel ons via 0346 354 333. Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. Aan cv’s die ongevraagd door bureaus worden aangeleverd kunnen geen rechten worden ontleend.

title: Junior Mechanical Engineer

Onze projecten zijn multidisciplinair, wat betekent dat je samenwerkt met collega's van verschillende vakgebieden om tot de beste oplossingen te komen. Wat ga je doen? Hierbij kun je inschatten wat de impact is van defecten en help je bij het maken en uitvoeren van verbetervoorstellen Je maakt een persoonlijke werkplanning als onderdeel van je project Je werkt in multidisciplinaire teams waarbij soms de voertaal Nederlands en soms de voertaal Engels is Vereisten Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in de richting Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar Ervaring met diverse 3D CAD programma’s Je bent een echte teamspeler die zelfstandig kan werken maar ook collega’s opzoekt om de projecten samen tot een succes te maken Een flexibele instelling, omdat je meestal vanuit het VIRO kantoor in Beverwijk werkt maar soms ook bij de klant Woonachtig in de regio Noord-Holland (maximaal 40 km van Beverwijk) Je communiceert gemakkelijk met klanten en collega’s, in het Nederlands en Engels Je bent proactief en denkt graag mee hoe zaken nog beter kunnen Wat bieden wij je? Een uitdagende en afwisselende baan in een gemoedelijk maar professioneel team Enthousiaste, vakkundige collega’s en een open, prettige sfeer Regie over je eigen carrière via onze VIRO Academy Prima mogelijkheden en faciliteiten om hybride te werken, inclusief thuiswerkvergoeding 22 vakantiedagen en 13 ATV-dagen Vergoeding voor het woon – werkverkeer of gebruik van een zakelijke NS-business card Je kunt gebruik maken van een fietsleaseplan, een aantrekkelijke fitnessregeling en/of het hybride warmtepompplan Profiteer van een uitstekende pensioenvoorziening bij Nationale Nederlanden en onze collectieve zorgverzekering via VGZ Onze actieve personeelsvereniging zorgt voor de nodige ontspanning en voor mooie verhalen bij de koffieautomaat Je afdeling VIRO vestiging Beverwijk is een ambitieuze vestiging waar collega’s als een team samenwerken en elkaar helpen waar nodig. Er is volop ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. We zoeken hiervoor enthousiaste en proactieve engineers die samen de projecten tot een succes willen maken. Interesse? Heb je vragen over deze of andere vacatures binnen VIRO, bel dan onze talentspecialist Rutger van Rugge via 0614756851 of We willen deze functie rechtstreeks invullen en maken hierbij geen gebruik van werving- en selectiebureaus.

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description: Akkodis è un leader globale nel mercato dell'ingegneria e della ricerca e sviluppo, che mira ad accelerare l'innovazione e la trasformazione digitale utilizzando la forza dei connected data. Akkodis vanta un’esperienza quarantennale e un forte know-how in settori tecnologici chiave come la mobilità, i servizi software e tecnologici, la robotica, i test, le simulazioni, la sicurezza dei dati, l'intelligenza artificiale e l'analisi dei dati. La combinazione di competenze informatiche e ingegneristiche porta a un'offerta unica di soluzioni end-to-end, con quattro linee di servizio - Consulting, Solutions, Talents e Academy - per supportare i clienti nel ripensare ai loro processi di sviluppo prodotto e di business, migliorare la produttività, ridurre al minimo il time-to-market e dare forma a un domani più smart e sostenibile. La divisione Industry di Akkodis è un punto di riferimento in Italia per i servizi di ingegneria nel settore dell'automazione industriale, e dei prodotti dedicati sia all’industria che al residenziale. Composta da un team di consulenti altamente qualificati con una solida esperienza nelle tecnologie di automazione e nello sviluppo di nuovi prodotti, la divisione garantisce soluzioni innovative e personalizzate per le aziende operanti nei settori: White Goods, Building Automation, IoT, Industrial Automation, Industrial products and components Nell’ottica di un potenziamento della divisione, ricerchiamo una figura di: Mechanical Design Engineer – Industry Entra a far parte della nostra divisione Industry, la nostra forza è da sempre l’integrazione delle nostre competenze, che ci permettono di avere una visione a 360° del mondo Industriale. Quale sarà il tuo contributo in Akkodis? Sarai inserito nel team di progettazione e sviluppo di soluzioni innovative di distribuzione di energia per data center. Attività: Progettare e sviluppare componenti e assemblaggi meccanici creare modelli 3D, assemblaggi e disegni di produzione utilizzando CATIA V5 tradurre i requisiti del prodotto in progetti meccanici robusti, convenienti e realizzabili supportare le attività di sviluppo, test, convalida e qualificazione dei prototipi collaborare con team interfunzionali tra cui ingegneria elettrica, produzione, qualità, catena di fornitura e gestione dei prodotti preparare e conservare la documentazione tecnica, i disegni tecnici, le specifiche e le distinte base (BOM) promuovere iniziative di miglioramento continuo del prodotto incentrate su prestazioni, affidabilità, producibilità e ottimizzazione dei costi fornire supporto durante produzione, risoluzione dei problemi e industrializzazione. Profilo Hai una Laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica o discipline affini ed hai svolto uno stage o un progetto di tesi come mechanical design? title: Junior System- und Projektingenieur (m/w/d) HVAC & Hilfssysteme Offshore Wind
description: Du möchtest die Energiewende aktiv mitgestalten? Bei SeaRenergy arbeitest du in einem internationalen Umfeld an anspruchsvollen Offshore-Wind- und Energieinfrastrukturprojekten. Unsere 361° Offshore Expertise steht für ganzheitliche Unterstützung über den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus – plus das eine Grad, das den Unterschied macht. Wir gehen die Extra-Meile für unsere Kunden, Projekte und Mitarbeitenden. So entstehen vielfältige Möglichkeiten für deine berufliche Entwicklung – in unseren eigenen Teams oder in spannenden Projekteinsätzen bei unseren Kunden. Für unser Engineering-Team in Hamburg suchen wir eine*n Junior System- und Projektingenieur (m/w/d) HVAC & Hilfssysteme für Offshore-Plattformen Startdatum : ab sofort| Standort : Hamburg | Arbeitsmodell : Hybrid | Beschäftigungsart : Festanstellung In dieser Position wirst du Teil unseres internen Teams bei SeaRenergy und arbeitest direkt an Themen mit, die unsere Projekte, Fachbereiche und Unternehmensgruppe voranbringen. Wir begrüßen ausdrücklich Bewerbungen aller Personen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft oder anderen persönlichen Merkmalen. Im Rahmen deiner Tätigkeit wirst du folgende Aufgaben übernehmen: Du unterstützt bei der Entwicklung und Prüfung von HVAC- und mechanischen Hilfssystemen für Offshore-Fundamente, Umspann- und Konverterplattformen – von der Konzeptphase über Pre-FEED und FEED bis zum Detail Design. Dazu gehören je nach Projekt Lüftung, Heizung und Kühlung, Kühlwasser, Trinkwasser, Sanitär und Entwässerung, Druckluft sowie Dieselversorgung. Du arbeitest an der Definition von Systemgrenzen, Schnittstellen, Betriebskonzepten sowie Redundanz- und Wartungsanforderungen mit und lernst, Systemverhalten im Normalbetrieb, bei Ausfällen, Notfällen und Wartung zu bewerten. Du erstellst und überarbeitest unter Anleitung technische Unterlagen wie Auslegungsberechnungen, Layouts, P&IDs, Schemata, technische Spezifikationen und Equipmentlisten. Du stimmst dich mit den Disziplinen Elektro, Struktur, Rohrleitungsbau, Architektur, Brandschutz, Automatisierung und Installation ab und lernst die Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden, Lieferanten und externen Engineering-Partnern kennen. Du prüfst Lieferantendokumentation gegen Projektanforderungen und einschlägige Normen und wirkst bei Design Reviews, Risikobewertungen (z. B. FMEA) und der technischen Beschaffung mit. Du begleitest Fertigung, Installation, Tests und Inbetriebnahme und lernst dabei die Praxis auf Werften und – nach entsprechenden Sicherheitstrainings – auch offshore kennen. Du bringst dich in Projekte und Angebote ein, etwa bei Aufwandsschätzungen und der Abgrenzung von Engineering-Leistungen. Dein Profil erfüllt die meisten der folgenden Anforderungen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung: Abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor oder Master) im Maschinenbau, Schiffbau/Schiffstechnik, in der Versorgungstechnik/TGA oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Erste praktische Erfahrungen im maritimen Umfeld, z. B. durch Praxissemester, Werkstudententätigkeit oder Abschlussarbeit in den Bereichen Offshore-Wind, Offshore-Plattformen, Schiffbau oder Schiffstechnik. Grundkenntnisse in HVAC und mechanischen Hilfssystemen, z. B. Thermodynamik, Lüftungs- und Klimatechnik oder Fluidsysteme. Erste Erfahrung mit einem CAD-Tool (z. B. AutoCAD, Inventor, SolidWorks, Revit, Siemens NX) und die Bereitschaft, dich in unsere Tools einzuarbeiten. Von Vorteil: Erfahrung mit Berechnungen, Risikoanalysen wie FMEA oder technischer Dokumentation. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse für technische Abstimmungen und Dokumentation sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise, Freude an Teamarbeit und die Bereitschaft, regelmäßig im Hamburger Büro zu arbeiten und zu Kunden, Werften und Offshore-Anlagen zu reisen. SeaRenergy bietet dir vielseitige Benefits für Beruf und Privatleben: Dein Plus an Lebensqualität – Mitarbeiterrabatte, umfassende Sport- & Wellnessangebote sowie vertrauliche Beratung rund um Familie, Gesundheit und Work-Life-Balance (EGYM Wellpass, pme Family Service). Mitarbeiterempfehlungsprämie – Empfiehl einen Kandidaten aus deinem Netzwerk und erhalte bis zu 3.000 €, nachdem dieser seine Probezeit erfolgreich abgeschlossen hat. BusinessBike-Leasing – Lease oder kaufe dein Fahrrad über eine steuerbegünstigte Gehaltsumwandlung, mit Paketen von Basic bis Pro. Betriebliche Altersvorsorge – Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 20 % für alle Voll- und Teilzeitbeschäftigten, in Zusammenarbeit mit Bernhard Assekuranzmakler. An unserem Hauptsitz in Hamburg bieten wir eine Reihe von Benefits, die jeden Arbeitstag angenehmer machen: Modernes Büro & angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre – Unser neuer Standort im Herzen Hamburgs (Holstenhof/Gänsemarkt) bietet ein offenes, modernes Arbeitsumfeld mit viel Raum für Austausch, Zusammenarbeit und kurze Kommunikationswege im Team. Lunch & Team-Momente – Ein großzügiger Mitarbeiterbereich lädt zu gemeinsamen Pausen, spontanen Gesprächen oder einer entspannten Mittagspause mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen ein. Weiterentwicklung & Performance-Reviews – Deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung ist uns wichtig. In regelmäßigen Performance-Reviews besprechen wir gemeinsam deine nächsten Entwicklungsschritte und unterstützen dich aktiv bei deiner fachlichen Weiterbildung. Duscheinrichtungen vor Ort – Ideal, wenn du vor der Arbeit Sport machst oder dich zwischendurch kurz frisch machen möchtest. Dich erwartet eine abwechslungsreiche Position mit viel Eigeninitiative und Verantwortung in einem dynamischen Team im Offshore-Windenergie-Umfeld, in der du wertvolle praktische Erfahrungen sammelst und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterentwickelst. Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt? Bewirb dich gerne auch dann, wenn dein Profil nicht in allen Punkten der Ausschreibung entspricht, da wir Lernbereitschaft ebenso schätzen wie fachliche Kompetenz.

title: GRADUATE MECHANICAL ENGINEER
description: 🔧 FUTURE TALENT ENGINEERING PROGRAM 2026 🔧 GRADUATE MECHANICAL ENGINEER 📍 Athens, Greece Build your engineering career through real project experience! On behalf of our client, HumanGrounds is looking for a Graduate Mechanical Engineer to join the technical team and develop through hands-on involvement in construction projects and site operations. Our client is an established technical and construction company involved in technically complex projects, with a focus on hospital facilities, electromechanical infrastructure and cultural projects, alongside a range of public and private construction works . This is an opportunity for a recent graduate to work alongside experienced engineers, understand how projects are delivered in practice and gradually build the technical and professional skills needed to grow in the industry. We're looking for someone with a solid engineering foundation, genuine interest in construction and the motivation to learn through experience. ✨ The Opportunity As a Graduate Mechanical Engineer , you will have the opportunity to gain hands-on exposure across different aspects of construction project execution, including: Mechanical & electromechanical installations Site operations & technical coordination Technical documentation, drawings & specifications Subcontractor & supplier coordination Materials, procurement & project requirements Quality, safety & compliance Working closely with experienced engineers, you will participate in real projects while progressively developing your technical knowledge and taking on greater responsibility. 📌 Key Responsibilities Support the planning and execution of construction projects. Assist in monitoring mechanical and electromechanical works on site. Support engineers with technical documentation, drawings and reports. Coordinate with subcontractors, suppliers and other project stakeholders. Follow up on project progress, materials and assigned deliverables. Support quality and compliance requirements. Assist in identifying technical issues and practical solutions. Take ownership of assigned tasks. 🎯 What We Are Looking For We are looking for a recent Mechanical Engineering graduate with strong potential and the motivation to build a career in construction. We don't expect you to know everything from day one. We are looking for someone who is willing to learn, asks questions, takes responsibility and wants to develop through real project and site experience. 🎓 Education Bachelor's Degree / Diploma in: Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering from an AEI / University-level institution Mechanical Engineering degree from a TEI / University of Applied Sciences, combined with a relevant Master's Degree 💡 Profile You are someone who: Is genuinely interested in engineering, construction and site-based work. title: Mechanical Development Engineer
description: As a Mechanical Development Engineer( Hydrophone Sensor) at Optics11, you contribute to the development and engineering realization of the hydrophone sensor subsystem throughout the product development lifecycle. You translate allocated product and subsystem requirements into robust engineering solutions while developing your technical expertise in underwater sensor technology. Our fiber-optic hydrophones need to detect pressure fluctuations smaller than the background hum of the ocean, while surviving deep-sea hydrostatic pressure, temperature swings, vibration, handling, and years of immersion in seawater. Acoustics, structural mechanics, optics, materials science and sealing all pull in different directions. There is rarely a single perfect design, as there are many trade-offs in performance and manufacturability, which is what makes hydrophone design such a rich multi-physics optimization problem. You work closely with Product System Engineering, Product Integration, Verification & Validation, Lifecycle Engineering, manufacturing partners, and other subsystem development teams to develop reliable hydrophone sensor solutions while continuously expanding your technical capability. Key Responsibilities: Contribute to the development and realization of the hydrophone sensor subsystem throughout the product development lifecycle. Translate product and subsystem requirements into robust engineering solutions. Develop hydrophone sensor assemblies, mechanical housings, internal structures, and subsystem interfaces. Produce detailed mechanical designs, engineering drawings, specifications, calculations, and design documentation. Develop prototypes and support subsystem integration, testing, and verification activities. Perform engineering analysis, characterization, and validation of hydrophone sensor assemblies. Support acoustic characterization and correlate engineering models with experimental results. Analyze engineering results, identify technical issues, and implement design improvements. Apply engineering expertise in precision mechanical design, fiber-optic sensing technology, materials, sealing, and structural design. Contribute to technical trade-off studies, design reviews, and multidisciplinary engineering discussions. Support root cause investigations and implement corrective engineering solutions. Improve subsystem robustness, manufacturability, maintainability, reliability, and production readiness. Plan and execute assigned engineering activities within agreed priorities and timelines. Communicate technical progress, risks, and dependencies proactively with stakeholders. Collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams and share engineering knowledge and best practices. Ensure engineering deliverables meet quality, performance, and reliability requirements. Contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering processes, methods, and product quality. Why Join Us? Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups. Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization. Competitive salary and benefits package. Enjoy regular team activities and company events. Fresh team lunches provided 5 times/week. Qualifications: BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering, Applied Physics, Precision Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Approximately 2–5 years of experience in precision mechanical design, instrumentation, sensor systems, or product development. Experience with CAD (SolidWorks or equivalent) and engineering analysis tools, like Comsol or ANSYS. Understanding of materials, sealing, and mechanical design principles. Experience with Python or similar scripting tools for engineering analysis is an advantage. Interest in precision instrumentation, underwater sensing technologies, and multidisciplinary product development. Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills. Good written and verbal communication skills in English. Eligible to obtain EU/NATO security clearance. Preferred: Experience with fiber-optic sensors, underwater systems, or precision instrumentation. Familiarity with engineering testing, prototype development, or product verification. Security & Compliance: You'll be working with clients in the defense and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. For more information, please refer to details on security screening.

Lasers, optics, precision motion, thermals, airflow, materials handling, chemistry, sensing, controls, and software all have to work at micron-scale precision, for thousands of layers, with almost no tolerance for error. Making that work reliably is an extraordinary engineering problem. That’s what we do. At Formlabs, we’re building 3D printers that are changing the way things get made. We have the smartest minds across every engineering discipline, and the technology they’re building is deployed at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. This is a salaried role, so you will always be paid based on the assumed 40 hours per week as a full-time intern. This position does not offer housing or relocation assistance. The weekly pay range for this role is: $1,000 — $1,300 USD

title: Mechanical Design Engineer – Electric Motor Development
description: About The Role As a Mechanical Design Engineer, you will contribute directly to the development and lifecycle support of electric motors for demanding industrial applications. At our motor factory in Oradea, you will help shape platform architectures, improve product quality, and industrialize robust, scalable mechanical solutions. The role provides a high level of ownership and close collaboration within a global R&D network. Your Responsibilities Develop mechanical components and assemblies for electric motors; add platform elements and modular building blocks where required by the assignment, while meeting performance, cost, and manufacturability targets. Lead improvements in product and component quality, conducting structured analyses (e.g., root cause, design reviews) and driving corrective actions. Identify and implement cost‑reduction opportunities, ensuring an optimal balance between technical performance, manufacturability, and reliability. Ensure Design for Manufacturing (DfM) and Design for Automation (DfA) in close cooperation with Manufacturing Technology and industrialization engineers. Act as a key technical interface for suppliers, Sales, Product Management, and customer engineering teams, supporting technically demanding customer requirements. Collaborate closely with Quality, Logistics, Manufacturing Technology, Manufacturing, Procurement, and Controlling throughout the product lifecycle. Ensure complete documentation, validation, and release of mechanical designs in accordance with internal standards and industrial development processes. Contribute to the platformization and standardization of mechanical solutions, ensuring reuse and scalability across the motor portfolio. What You Bring Education & Experience Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or Mechatronics (required). Experience in motor design, rotating machinery, or precision mechanics (preferred). Proven experience with mechanical CAD tools (mandatory); Siemens NX preferred. Technical Skills Strong knowledge of materials, thermal behavior and cooling, ISO GPS tolerancing, and mechanical design principles, plus a basic understanding of FEM. Mandatory exposure to platform architectures and industrial product development standards (e.g., requirements engineering, validation processes, release cycles). Familiarity with the following tools / environments: NX for mechanical design Teamcenter for Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) Polarion for requirements and process management Simcenter or comparable simulation tools Languages Romanian and English — fluent German — considered a plus Soft Skills Strong ownership & accountability for product quality and deliverables. Effective cross-functional communication with factory functions and global R&D teams. Structured problem-solving mindset and hands-on approach. Travel 10-20% travel expected after the initial onboarding and training phase (e.g., to Germany or suppliers). What We Offer Work directly in the motor factory, enabling fast feedback loops between design and manufacturing. High customer involvement and exposure to demanding technical requirements. Collaboration within international R&D and engineering networks. Opportunity to take end-to-end ownership of mechanical components and assemblies throughout the product lifecycle.

title: Kalıp Tasarım ve Uygulama Takım Üyesi
description: KoçMedical I Bıçakcılar Hakkında Pandeminin en yoğun dönemlerinde yaşanan yoğun bakım solunum cihazı eksikliğine çözüm olarak, Mart 2021’de Sağlık Bakanlığı ile Sanayi ve Teknoloji Bakanlıklarının talepleri doğrultusunda, Nisan 2021’de 100 adet ve Haziran 2021’de 5000 adet ventilatör üretimi sağlanmıştır. Bu kısa sürede gerçekleşen üretim süreci, KoçMedical hikayesinin başlangıcını oluşturmuştur. Koç Topluluğu’nun sağlık teknolojileri alanında faaliyet gösteren Hollanda merkezli şirketi olarak, sağlık alanındaki ihtiyaçlara yenilikçi çözümler sunmak, sağlığa erişimi geniş kitlelere ulaştırmak ve bölgesel bir sağlık teknoloji gücü haline gelmek amacıyla kurulduk. KoçMedical olarak, tek kullanımlık tıbbi sarf malzemeler ve tıbbi cihazlar olmak üzere iki ana ürün grubunda faaliyet göstermekte, medikal cihaz ve sarf malzemelerinin tasarımı ve üretimine odaklanmaktayız. Temmuz 2023’te KoçMedical bünyesine katılan Bıçakcılar Tıbbi Cihazlar Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş., 60 yılı aşkın deneyimiyle tıbbi cihazlar alanında pazar lideridir. Medikal sarf malzemeler kategorisinde kateter ve tüp setlerinde Türkiye’nin lider üreticisi olan Bıçakcılar, ameliyathane ve yoğun bakım ünitelerine yönelik geniş ürün portföyüyle Türkiye’de 150’den fazla bayiye, 1.500’den fazla hastaneye ve dünya genelinde 100’den fazla ülkeye hizmet sunmaktadır. Bünyesinde bulunan akredite Ar-Ge merkezinde ürün geliştirme çalışmalarını sürdürürken aynı zamanda kaliteli ve yenilikçi ürünlerin Türkiye ve yakın coğrafyalar distribütörlüğünü üstlenmektedir. KoçMedical | Bıçakcılar, bu güçlü birleşimle sürdürülebilir büyüme hedefini benimseyerek Avrupa merkezli bir global firma olmayı, sağlık teknolojilerinde ürün yelpazesini genişletmeyi ve ihracat pazarlarını büyüterek sektöre uluslararası düzeyde katkı sağlamayı hedeflemektedir. KoçMedical I Bıçakcılar’ın Sundukları KoçMedical | Bıçakcılar, Fortune Global 500'de yer alan güçlü bir grubun parçası olarak, yenilikçi bir şirket ruhu ve dinamik bir çalışma ortamı sunuyor. Çevik, eğlenceli ve esnek yapısıyla, profesyoneller için hem kurumsal bir düzen hem de yenilikçi bir kariyer yolculuğu vadediyoruz. Eşitlik ve birlik ilkelerini her fırsatta vurgulayarak çalışanlarımızın değerli hissetmesini sağlıyoruz. “Sağlığa yenilik, hayata iyilik katmak” misyonuyla çıktığımız bu yolda kalite ve inovasyonu ön planda tutarak sektörün geleceğini şekillendiren bir vizyonla ilerliyoruz. Bizimle çalışmak, sadece bir iş değil; insanı odağına alan bir ortamda gelişim, öğrenme ve başarıya ulaşma yolculuğudur. Çalışma anlayışımız, bireysel katkıyı desteklemek ve güçlü bir takım ruhu oluşturmak üzerine kuruludur. Şirket içi etkinlikler, sosyal sorumluluk projeleri, takım çalışmaları ve düzenli toplantılar ile hem birlikte öğreniyor hem de büyüyoruz. Çalışanlarımızın fikirlerine değer veriyor ve her seviyede katılımı teşvik ediyoruz. Koç Grubu’nun “Koç’lu Olmak” kültüründen ilham alarak, çalışanlarımıza eşitlik ve değer odaklı bir deneyim sunuyoruz. Onların gelişimlerini desteklemek ve kariyer yolculuklarında ilerlemelerine olanak tanımak için yanlarında oluyoruz. Eğer siz de bu heyecan verici, yenilikçi ve gelişim odaklı ortamda bizimle çalışmak istiyorsanız, Üretim ekibimize katılacak bir Kalıp Tasarım ve Uygulama Takım Üyesi arıyoruz. Talaşlı imalat süreçlerinin sevk ve idaresinin yapılması. Kalıp problemlerinin önlenmesi ve tekrarlanmasının engellenmesi. İhtiyaç duyulan aparat, fikstür ve parçaların tasarım ve imalatının gerçekleştirilmesi. Performans raporlarına göre kalıplarda alınacak aksiyonların belirlenmesi ve planlanması. title: Senior E2E Test Engineer – Payments & Channels
description: Design the future architecture of one of Europe's most innovative banking networks while empowering engineers to do their best work. Role Summary At ING Hubs Türkiye, we're looking for a Senior E2E Test Engineer who enjoys looking beyond individual applications and understanding how complete payment journeys work from start to finish. This role combines hands-on end-to-end testing, payment domain knowledge, system integration, API testing, and test automation. You'll validate complex payment flows across multiple applications and interfaces while helping move testing from manual execution toward scalable, maintainable automation. You'll work within an Agile and DevOps environment, collaborating closely with Product Owners, Customer Journey Experts, IT Business Analysts, Solution Architects, DevOps Engineers, application teams, and testing specialists across different squads and domains. Your focus will be on translating business requirements, user journeys, functional specifications, and technical designs into effective E2E test coverage. You'll execute both manual and automated tests, validate data and transaction outcomes across systems, and take ownership of test preparation, evidence, defect retesting, and regression testing. At the same time, you'll play an important role in strengthening test automation using tools such as Postman, Playwright, GitHub, and GitHub Copilot , while contributing to ING's internal testing frameworks and engineering capabilities. Work Model At ING Hubs Türkiye, flexibility is more than a benefit, it's part of how we work. Our hybrid way of working is designed to balance collaboration, innovation, and personal flexibility. Team members typically come together at our Vadistanbul office for two days per week during three weeks of the month, while one week each month is fully remote. We also offer additional flexibility during the summer period, with remote working opportunities throughout August, allowing colleagues to spend more time where they feel most productive while staying connected to their teams. As part of a globally distributed organization, you'll collaborate with colleagues across multiple ING locations while contributing to solutions that create impact across the bank. About the Team You will join the E2E Testing team within the Payments and Channels Area of the Transaction Services Tribe , working in an environment where payment journeys cross multiple applications, interfaces, teams, and locations. We believe quality goes beyond testing a single application. It means understanding how a transaction moves across the complete payment chain, identifying risks across system boundaries, and making sure data, statuses, and outcomes remain accurate and consistent throughout the journey. Our teams work in an Agile environment with a strong DevOps mindset, combining hands-on testing with automation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Curiosity and initiative matter here, and new ideas that improve the way we test are encouraged. What You'll Do Analyze business use cases, functional specifications, solution designs, and acceptance criteria to define the right E2E test coverage. Design and maintain test cases covering complete payment journeys across channels, APIs, processing components, and downstream systems. Execute manual and automated E2E tests, including happy flows, unhappy flows, error handling, boundary conditions, and regression scenarios. Validate payment data, statuses, and outcomes as transactions move between different systems. Prepare and maintain test data, test accounts, access rights, and environment prerequisites. Collect clear test evidence, including expected and actual results, logs, API responses, screenshots, and relevant transaction or message identifiers. Retest resolved defects and perform targeted regression testing to ensure fixes don't create unintended impact elsewhere in the payment chain. Build and maintain automated test suites and help move E2E scenarios from manual testing toward maintainable automation. Collaborate across squads and domains to identify blockers, communicate quality risks, and drive issues toward resolution. About You We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you'll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we'll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself. Ideally, you bring: A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Around 3–6 years of experience in software testing or quality engineering. Strong hands-on experience with end-to-end, system integration, API, functional, and regression testing . Experience designing test cases based on business requirements, functional specifications, user journeys, and technical designs. Experience building and maintaining automated test suites. Practical experience with Postman, GitHub, GitHub Copilot , and modern automation frameworks such as Playwright . A hands-on ownership mindset, taking responsibility from test preparation through execution, evidence, retesting, and follow-through. Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to translate complex testing topics into clear risks and decisions. A proactive and resilient approach when priorities shift, dependencies create blockers, or delivery pressure increases. Strong problem-solving, communication, and presentation skills. Good command of English and confidence collaborating across international teams. Equal Opportunity Don't meet every single requirement? Don't let that hold you back. Studies show many talented professionals hesitate to apply unless they meet every qualification. If you're excited about this role and believe you can make an impact, we'd love to hear from you. title: Maintenance Manager
description: I am Sara , an Executive Consultant , with over 10 years of experience in executive recruitment and consulting for top-tier companies. Projekts is proud to collaborate with over 600 clients, including (Fortune 500 companies), operating in more than 20 countries worldwide. We are currently seeking a Maintenance Manager for GreenField My client, an automotive OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) veyr well knowed and established in EV markets, has just entered a phase of external growth that will profoundly reshape its industrial footprint over the coming years. Several acquisitions are already under review, and executive management has made a clear choice. Position Overview The Maintenance Engineer ensures equipment reliability, maintainability and availability across all four Powertrain APUs — Stator & Rotor, Inverter & Battery, Powertrain Assembly, and Dyno Technology & Testing. Rather than being dedicated to a single line, this role is a shared resource deployed flexibly wherever ramp-up needs are highest, establishing maintenance standards from commissioning through serial production, driving preventive and predictive maintenance, and developing the local maintenance capability required for stable operations plant-wide. Key Responsibilities Maintenance & Reliability Strategy Define preventive, predictive and autonomous maintenance routines across all APUs. Establish equipment handover, maintenance standards and critical spare-parts requirements. Deploy TPM / reliability routines and maintenance performance tracking plant-wide. Commissioning & Equipment Handover Support FAT/SAT, installation, commissioning and maintainability verification across lines. Ensure documentation, spares, PM plans and technical acceptance are complete before handover. Breakdown Elimination & Continuous Improvement Lead troubleshooting and permanent corrective actions for recurring failures on any line. Drive equipment uptime, MTBF and MTTR improvement across the four APUs. Partner with Process and Automation teams to eliminate chronic losses. Cross-APU Prioritization Flex support across APUs based on real-time ramp-up priority, breakdown severity and launch schedule. Maintain visibility of equipment condition and open maintenance issues across all four lines. Technical Scope — By APU APU 1 — Stator & Rotor Winding/forming equipment, impregnation/curing systems, balancing machines and presses. APU 2 — Inverter & Battery HV assembly equipment, dispensing/sealing systems, torque tools and test equipment. Safe maintenance practices for high-voltage manufacturing equipment. APU 3 — Powertrain Assembly Robots, conveyors, presses, torque systems, leak testers and material handling. APU 4 — Dyno Technology & Testing Dynamometers, cooling/conditioning systems, sensors, instrumentation and test racks. Calibration support and utility reliability. Across all APUs: preventive/predictive maintenance, TPM, MTBF/MTTR, spare-parts strategy, equipment availability and rapid breakdown recovery during ramp-up. Capability Transfer Train local technicians and build structured troubleshooting capability across all four APUs. Develop skills matrices and certification requirements for maintenance ownership plant-wide. Skills Strong TPM / RCM, preventive and predictive maintenance knowledge. Advanced troubleshooting across automated manufacturing equipment of different types. Strong reliability analysis, MTBF / MTTR and spare-parts discipline. Working knowledge of CMMS such as SAP PM, Maximo or equivalent. Ability to prioritize and reallocate effort across multiple lines under changing operational pressure. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics or related Engineering discipline. 5-8+ years automotive / EV maintenance or reliability experience. Hands-on commissioning, equipment handover and ramp-up experience. Broad maintenance experience spanning multiple production technologies (e.g. stator/rotor, HV/battery, robotic assembly, or test/dyno systems) is a strong asset. Fluent English required. Preferred Profile A versatile, reliability-focused maintenance engineer who can establish the maintenance system across all four APUs, stabilize equipment performance during ramp-up wherever it is needed most, and build strong local technical capability plant-wide — rather than being anchored to a single line. What is being offered Competitive compensation commensurate with the stakes, a real and openly stated path toward regional leadership, and the rare opportunity to build your own industrial footprint rather than take over someone else's. Added to that are an environment where initiative is expected and rewarded, and flexible working conditions that recognize the importance of your personal balance. Why take this step of your career with Projekts Projekts today supports more than six hundred industrial clients across more than twenty countries, among them Fortune 500 groups. That footprint gives us a concrete reading of executive markets across three continents, and a precise understanding of what separates an appealing promise from a genuine career opportunity. Our approach rests on a simple principle: we take the time to understand in depth the challenges facing our clients and the aspirations of our candidates, because an executive placement only succeeds when both trajectories truly meet. We never present a position without having measured its solidity ourselves, and we support every candidate throughout the process, through to taking up the role and beyond. If this mandate matches what you are seeking for the next stage of your career, I would be glad to discuss it with you directly. All applications are treated in the strictest confidence
